song.title: ā pādapadmattil
song.source: A pada padmattil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ā pādapadmattil chērnn-irikkām kaṇṇāorupāḍu prēma-kāvyam rachikkām
stanza.meaning: I will remain close to your lotus feet, O Krishna, and compose countless melodies of love.

stanza.lyrics: ā prēma-bhaktiyil ozhukām ozhuki ā - kāvya-yamunayāyi ñān māṙiḍām
stanza.meaning: Carried by the currents of my devotion, I will flow endlessly—becoming a Yamuna of poems.

stanza.lyrics: ā pādapadmattil chērnn-irikkām kaṇṇāorupāḍu prēma-kāvyam rachikkām
stanza.meaning: I will remain close to your lotus feet, O Krishna, and compose countless melodies of love.

stanza.lyrics: ā prēma-muraḷiyil gānam utirttu ñān - chērnnirikkām chuṇḍil gītam ākām
stanza.meaning: I will remain near you, a song in your flute of love. I will become a song on your lips, a melodious flow of love, O Krishna.

stanza.lyrics: ā prēma saṅgīta dhārayākām kaṇṇā - śrutiyāy nityavum chērnnirikkām
stanza.meaning: I will remain ever with you, as the finest of tunes.

stanza.lyrics: ā pādapadmattil chērnn-irikkām kaṇṇāorupāḍu prēma-kāvyam rachikkām
stanza.meaning: I will remain close to your lotus feet, O Krishna, and compose countless melodies of love.

stanza.lyrics: tāḷamāy īṇamāy gānamāy tīrnniḍāmninnilāy dhyāna nimagnayākām
stanza.meaning: I shall become rhythm, melody, and song. I shall merge with you in meditation,

stanza.lyrics: oḍuvil ā bhakti tan ārdratayil kaṇṇānirmala prēmānubhūti ākām
stanza.meaning: and in the tenderness of devotion, I shall become the pure ecstasy of divine love.

stanza.lyrics: ā pādapadmattil chērnn-irikkām kaṇṇāorupāḍu prēma-kāvyam rachikkām
stanza.meaning: I will remain close to your lotus feet, O Krishna, and compose countless melodies of love.

stanza.lyrics: svaramāy layamāy chērnnaliyām kaṇṇāparamārtha satyamē ninnil ākām
stanza.meaning: I shall dissolve in you as the notes of tender rhythm. I shall become one with you, the Ultimate Truth.

stanza.lyrics: ñānilla ēkamām tatvam ākām kaṇṇā - satyamāy svatvamāy sattayākām
stanza.meaning: No longer will I exist, Krishna—I shall become the One Truth, the very essence of love.

stanza.lyrics: ā pādapadmattil chērnn-irikkām kaṇṇāorupāḍu prēma-kāvyam rachikkām
stanza.meaning: I will remain close to your lotus feet, O Krishna, and compose countless melodies of love.

song.title: abhayamāy amṛtamāy
song.source: Abhayamay Amritamay 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: abhayamāy amṛtamāymanassil uṇarum mantramāy
stanza.meaning: As the refuge, as the nectar of immortality, as the mantra that arises in the mind,

stanza.lyrics: karuṇayāy snēhamāy ammayuṇḍueṅgum iruḷakaṫṫum neyttiriyāy ammayuṇḍu
stanza.meaning: as compassion and love, as the flame that dispels darkness all around - Mother is there.

stanza.lyrics: tēnmalarāy veṇṇilavāykanalaṇakkum tennalāy
stanza.meaning: As a flower brimming with nectar, as silver moonlight, as the breeze that puts out the embers of pain,

stanza.lyrics: gītamāy nādamāy ammayuṇḍuennum praṇavamām ōmkāramāy ammayuṇḍu ammayuṇḍu
stanza.meaning: as a melodious song, as the essence of sound, as the primordial syllable om – Mother is there.

stanza.lyrics: vānavillāy mēghamāyazhalakaṫṫum pūmazhayāy
stanza.meaning: As a rainbow, as a rain-cloud, as a shower of flowers that dispels our sorrow,

stanza.lyrics: gītamāy, nādamāy, ammayuṇḍuennum matiyil teḷiyum jñānamāy ammayuṇḍuammayuṇḍu
stanza.meaning: as a melodious song, as the essence of sound, as wisdom that shines within the mind – Mother is there.

stanza.lyrics: kālamāy prakṛtiyāy puṇyamēkum gangayāy
stanza.meaning: As time, as nature, as the purifying Ganga,

stanza.lyrics: nityamāy satyamāy ammayuṇḍuennum aruma-makkaḷkk-īśvariyāyammayuṇḍu ammayuṇḍu
stanza.meaning: as eternity and truth, as the divine Goddess for her darling children – Mother is there

song.title: ādiparāśakti ambikē
song.source: Adi parashakti Ambike 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ādiparāśakti ambikē
stanza.meaning: Mother! You are the primordial cosmic energy, the Supreme Goddess.

stanza.lyrics: ādiparāśakti ambikēkāttu-koḷḷēṇamē ñaṅgaḷe
stanza.meaning: Mother! You are the primordial cosmic energy, the Supreme Goddess. Protect us,

stanza.lyrics: samasta-aparādham poṙuttu nīvasikkēṇam uḷḷil karuṇāmayi
stanza.meaning: forgive our faults and misdeeds, and abide within us, O compassionate one.

stanza.lyrics: avyāja-karuṇā mūrttiyāyiulakatte pōṭriḍum jaganmayi
stanza.meaning: You have manifested as all of creation, sustaining the world through your boundless grace.

stanza.lyrics: kalmaṣam tīrttu mūvulakineullāsa-bharitam ākkum kāḷi nī
stanza.meaning: O Kali, you purge the impurities of the three worlds and revive them with joy and divine strength.

stanza.lyrics: īrēzh-ulakaṅgaḷ okkeyumlīlā-vinōdini nin kēḷi-raṅgam
stanza.meaning: O One who delights in your cosmic play! The fourteen worlds are your playground

stanza.lyrics: nin icchayillāt-oraṇuvumēulak-eṅgum calikkilla atu satyam
stanza.meaning: —without your will, not even a single atom stirs.

stanza.lyrics: atu satyam… atu satyam… atu satyam…
stanza.meaning: This alone is the eternal truth.

stanza.lyrics: nin kṛpa ēṫṫu maruvīḍunnasukṛtikaḷkk-atonnē sāyūjyam
stanza.meaning: Those blessed to live in your grace find therein their ultimate liberation,

stanza.lyrics: ā mahākāruṇya-sindhuvil allōsaccidānandamām parama-satyam
stanza.meaning: for the supreme truth—existence, consciousness, and bliss—dwells in the vast ocean of your compassion.

stanza.lyrics: parama-satyam… parama-satyam…
stanza.meaning: O Supreme Truth!

song.title: ādimātastava caraṇa-rēṇu
song.source: Adimatastava 2025 Samskritam in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ādimātastava caraṇa-rēṇumāyā prapañcikādhāra-rēṇu
stanza.meaning: O Primordial Mother! This vast universe of illusion was born from the dust of your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: ālōkajīvīnām āśraya-hētukālimātastava caraṇa-rēṇu
stanza.meaning: O Mother Kali! All beings, on earth and in the heavens seek refuge in that sacred dust.

stanza.lyrics: sakalānām akhilādhi vyādhihāriihapara jīvitāmaya hāriṇi
stanza.meaning: It destroys mental afflictions and cures the deepest diseases. It wipes away sorrow from every heart, of all beings on heaven and earth.

stanza.lyrics: ihapara lōkaika lābhakārimama mātuḥ pāvana pādarēṇu
stanza.meaning: O Divine Mother! The dust from your feet bestows merit upon both heaven and earth.

stanza.lyrics: kāḷikē karuṇāmayijagadāśraye līlāmayi
stanza.meaning: O Kali, embodiment of compassion… Refuge of the whole world, playful One…

stanza.lyrics: ādinātha purā sṛjanakālēāśritam khalu tava caraṇa-rēṇu
stanza.meaning: Even Brahma, the creator, took the dust from your lotus feet to create this universe.

stanza.lyrics: āśraya hīnayā ēkālambamāśrayēham sadā jñāna-rēṇu
stanza.meaning: I am helpless with no one to call my own but you. I take refuge in the dust of your feet, seeking the light of true knowledge.

stanza.lyrics: anarhayām mayi tava divyarēṇuanukṣaṇam pātaya karuṇāmayi
stanza.meaning: I am unworthy but if even a speck of that dust touches me, O Compassionate One, all the impurities in my heart will be destroyed.

stanza.lyrics: alamalam tadalam tvad caraṇarēṇuhṛnmalanāśāya sakalāśrayē
stanza.meaning: In that sacred dust, O Mother, I take refuge to purify this heart of mine.

stanza.lyrics: kāḷikē karuṇāmayijagadāśraye līlāmayi
stanza.meaning: O Kali, embodiment of compassion… Refuge of the whole world, playful One…

song.title: ādiyum antavum āyorammē
song.source: Adiyum antavum ayoramme 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ādiyum antavum āyorammēādimātāvāya kāḷi mātē
stanza.meaning: Mother Kali! You are the origin of this universe—without beginning or end.

stanza.lyrics: dēvakaḷum vēda-vāṅmayavumninne tiraññu taḷarnniḍunnu
stanza.meaning: Even the gods cannot fathom you, and the Vedas cannot grasp your essence.

stanza.lyrics: kāruṇya-rūpiṇi kāḷimātēkālāti-varttiyām prēma-sattēkālāti-varttiyām prēma-sattē
stanza.meaning: Mother Kali! You are the embodiment of compassion—the unchanging essence of divine love that transcends all time.

stanza.lyrics: āgamam colli nī nāriyallanaranalla mṛgamalla vihagamalla
stanza.meaning: The Vedas declare, “You are neither man nor woman, neither bird nor beast.”

stanza.lyrics: onnu mātram ñān aṙiññiḍunnunī ende amma āṇenna satyam
stanza.meaning: But deep within my heart, I know this truth—you are my true Mother.

stanza.lyrics: amma ninnaṅkē vasiccoru nāḷjīvitam enna kināvu kaṇḍu
stanza.meaning: Once, I was a child, safe in your lap. Then I dreamt of this world,

stanza.lyrics: māyayāl ninde kaiviṭṭ-uzhannumārgam aṙiyāte ambarannu
stanza.meaning: and in that sleep—lost in Maya’s spell—I let go of your loving hands. Now I wander, unable to find my way back home.

stanza.lyrics: eṅgane ninnōḍu cērum ennuētum aṙiyilla ende ammē
stanza.meaning: I do not know the way to merge into you,

stanza.lyrics: eṅkilum ammayōḍ-onnu cērānenn-udyamam ñān veḍiyukilla
stanza.meaning: but I will never give up the effort to become one with my Mother!

stanza.lyrics: onnuṇḍ-uṙapp-enikk-innu tāyēen viḷi kēṭṭu nī ōḍi ettum
stanza.meaning: Of one thing I am certain, Mother—when you hear my call, you will come running.

stanza.lyrics: ende karam grahicc-umma veykkumenne nin māṙōḍu cērttu vaykkum
stanza.meaning: You will take my hand, cover me with kisses, hold me close in your embrace, and never let me go.

song.title: āgaka… sāgipō
song.source: Agaka_sagipo_2025_Telugu_in_English_v3.pptx

stanza.lyrics: āgaka… sāgipō munduku sāgipō
stanza.meaning: Don’t stop… keep moving forward

stanza.lyrics: tānokaṭi talichēnu daivamokaṭi chēsēnu - dēvamu talichēnu nīvokkaṭī chēsēnu
stanza.meaning: I intended one thing, but God did another; God willed one thing, but I chose another

stanza.lyrics: tappu evaridi oppu evaridiō manujā… jīvita payanamidi
stanza.meaning: Who can say with certainty what’s right or wrong? O human… this life is a journey

stanza.lyrics: āgaka… sāgipō munduku sāgipō
stanza.meaning: Don’t stop… keep moving forward

stanza.lyrics: talapulu phaliñcaka daivamunu dūṣiñchērutalachēdī jaragaka maniṣinī tappupaṭṭērū
stanza.meaning: Some blame God when desires go unfulfilled. Some blame human error when wishes don’t come true

stanza.lyrics: tappulu ennaku oppulu ennakuō manujā… anitya jīvitamidi
stanza.meaning: Count not the rights, nor the wrongs. O human… life is impermanent

stanza.lyrics: āgaka… sāgipō munduku sāgipō
stanza.meaning: Don’t stop… keep moving forward

stanza.lyrics: ēdī kākunnā āgaka sāgipōendaṙaḍḍukunnā munduku sāgipō
stanza.meaning: Even when nothing works out, keep moving on. Even when others stand in your way, press forward

stanza.lyrics: annī mana mañchikē āgaka sāgipō ammē nī balam mundukū sāgipō
stanza.meaning: All things unfold for your good… don’t pause, just go. The Divine Mother is your strength—walk ahead

song.title: ajñāna tamassil mayaṅgunna
song.source: Ajnana tamassil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ajñāna tamassil mayaṅgunna makkaḷkkukāvalāḷāy amma kāttirippū
stanza.meaning: Mother remains a vigilant guardian of her children, who slumber in dark ignorance.

stanza.lyrics: enn-uṇarnnīḍum ī makkaḷ ennorttammakāruṇya mūrtiyāy kāttirippū
stanza.meaning: With boundless compassion, she waits, wondering when they will awaken.

stanza.lyrics: uṇarān maḍikkunnu makkaḷ innum bhūvilmōhāndhakāravum pēṙiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: Her children are reluctant to awaken, burdened by the darkness of delusion.

stanza.lyrics: kai nīṭṭi māṙōḍu chērtt-aṇaykkumbōzhummanam etra dūreykk-akaṫṫīḍunnu
stanza.meaning: Even as she reaches out and draws us to her bosom, our mind pulls us far away.

stanza.lyrics: ajñāna tamassil mayaṅgunna makkaḷkkukāvalāḷāy amma kāttirippū
stanza.meaning: Mother remains a vigilant guardian of her children, who slumber in dark ignorance.

stanza.lyrics: māyā-marīchika tēḍi alayunnusatyamat-onninē tēḍiḍāte
stanza.meaning: Wandering in pursuit of mirages, we do not seek the One Truth.

stanza.lyrics: enn-uṇarnnīḍum ī makkaḷ tan hṛdayaṅgaḷennonnu chērum ā… padatāratil
stanza.meaning: When will her children awaken in their hearts? When will they merge with her lotus feet?

stanza.lyrics: ajñāna tamassil mayaṅgunna makkaḷkkukāvalāḷāy amma kāttirippū
stanza.meaning: Mother remains a vigilant guardian of her children, who slumber in dark ignorance.

song.title: ākāśa-mēlāppil
song.source: Akasa melappil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ākāśa-mēlāppil kārmēgha-tuṇḍonnupeyyuvānāyi vitumbi nilpū
stanza.meaning: In the sky above, a dark rain cloud waits eagerly to pour down as rain.

stanza.lyrics: āzhi tan tīrattum ammayām kārmēghamvātsalya-varṣavumāy kāttirippū
stanza.meaning: By the sea, the radiant Mother, dark as a rain cloud, waits to shower tender compassion.

stanza.lyrics: tantanam tintōm taka taka tantanam tintōmtantanam tintōm taka taka tantanam tintōm
stanza.meaning: Traditional music

stanza.lyrics: ākāśa-mēlāppil minnunna minnalilmālōkar-ellām bhayappeḍavē
stanza.meaning: People tremble in fear at the brilliant lightning streaks that flash across the sky,

stanza.lyrics: ammayām kārmēghakkaṇ kaḍākṣikkavēmālōkarkk-ellām uḷppuḷakam
stanza.meaning: but when touched by the brilliance of Mother’s glance, their hearts overflow with joy.

stanza.lyrics: tantanam tintōm taka taka tantanam tintōmtantanam tintōm taka taka tantanam tintōm
stanza.meaning: Traditional music

stanza.lyrics: ākāśa-mēlāppil poṭṭi puṙappeḍummēgha-nādaṅgaḷāl ñeṭṭi viṙaykkavē
stanza.meaning: People tremble in fear at the thunderclaps that echo across the sky.

stanza.lyrics: āzhi tan tīratte kārmēgha-tuṇḍindecuṇḍilāy kāṇām orindra-dhanussu
stanza.meaning: But when they behold the rainbow-like smile upon Mother’s lips—she who shines with the radiant beauty of a dark rain cloud…

stanza.lyrics: tantanam tintōm taka taka tantanam tintōmtantanam tintōm taka taka tantanam tintōm
stanza.meaning: Traditional music

stanza.lyrics: āru kaṇḍālum akam kuḷirkkum pinneā savidhattilāy cērnn-aṇayum
stanza.meaning: …their minds are soothed and refreshed, and they come to her abode.

stanza.lyrics: āzhi tan tīrattu samsāra-vahniyilātapippōrkk-ellām ātma-śānti
stanza.meaning: By the sea, in Mother’s compassionate presence, all who are scorched by the fire of samsara find serenity of mind.

stanza.lyrics: amma tan sannidhi ātma-śānti
stanza.meaning: in Mother’s compassionate presence, all who are scorched by the fire of samsara find serenity of mind.

song.title: akatāril enne ñān ārāññu cellavē
song.source: Akataril enne 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: akatāril enne ñān ārāññu cellavēalivārnnu maṙayunnit-antaraṅgam
stanza.meaning: When I turn within, seeking to know who I am, the mind and all its sorrows dissolve in the peace of experiencing the true Self.

stanza.lyrics: azhalokke nizhal-pōle atulita śāntiyilaṙivinde teḷimayil akanniḍunnu
stanza.meaning: When I turn within, seeking to know who I am, the mind and all its sorrows dissolve in the peace of experiencing the true Self.

stanza.lyrics: ārōrum illāte paital karaññ-ennālammayā cāratt-aṅañña-pōle
stanza.meaning: Just as a mother will rush to comfort a crying child who has no one else,

stanza.lyrics: ātmānubhūtiyil azhivilla nōkkukilaṙiyuvān akatār-oruṅgiḍēṇam
stanza.meaning: the Self reveals itself when the mind longs deeply for its bliss. The bliss of the Self is ever-full and never diminishes.

stanza.lyrics: aṙiyuvān akatār-oruṅgiḍēṇam
stanza.meaning: the Self reveals itself when the mind longs deeply for its bliss. The bliss of the Self is ever-full and never diminishes.

stanza.lyrics: alivuḷḷil niṙayaṇam akatāru piḍayaṇamaham atin sattayil ninniḍēṇam
stanza.meaning: We must cultivate compassion for all beings, maintain an unquenchable thirst for truth, and keep the awareness of “I” anchored in its true source.

stanza.lyrics: abhimāna-dhanam ellām aḍarāḍi veḍiyaṇamātmāvin tatvattil ninniḍēṇam
stanza.meaning: We must conquer prideful ego, and stand firmly established in the Atman, our true essence.

stanza.lyrics: ātmāvin tatvattil ninniḍēṇam
stanza.meaning: We must conquer prideful ego, and stand firmly established in the Atman, our true essence.

song.title: akatāril nombaram azhalāy eriyumbōḷ
song.source: Akataril nombarm 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: akatāril nombaram azhalāy eriyumbōḷanutāpa-cinta niṙaññiḍumbōḷ
stanza.meaning: Sorrow smoulders within my heart, and regret fills all my thoughts.

stanza.lyrics: akaneñcu piḷarunna viṅgalum pēṙiinn-ēkānta-pathikanāy alayunnu ñān
stanza.meaning: My heart is torn apart by pain, as I wander on—a lonely traveller.

stanza.lyrics: aṇayukillē ammē aṇayukillē? /ī alayunna jīvane puṇarukillē?
stanza.meaning: Mother! Won’t you draw near to this wandering soul and embrace him as your own?

stanza.lyrics: bhuvanavum bhūtādhi-nāthanum paṇiyunnabhaya-lēśam ēlātta bhāgya-śōbha
stanza.meaning: The embodiment of pure consciousness, the refuge of all and worshipped by every being in this world,

stanza.lyrics: abhayakaram nīṭṭi ānandam ēkilumakalattil eṅgō alayunnu ñān
stanza.meaning: waits to grant me shelter and bliss—yet I stray far away from you.

stanza.lyrics: karuṇaykk-oratirilla karaḷ aliññ-akhilarkkumamṛtēki ozhukum ā viṇgaṅga tan
stanza.meaning: From heaven, you flowed with boundless grace as the divine Ganga, bestowing ambrosia upon all,

stanza.lyrics: maḍiyil vīṇatil oru kaṇamāy aliyātevijanamām marubhuvil alayunnu ñān
stanza.meaning: everywhere. Yet instead of merging into you like a drop, I wander through a barren, arid desert.

stanza.lyrics: aham onnu mātram pakaramāy vāṅgi tanakhilavum nalkuvān vembum amma
stanza.meaning: You long to grant me an empire of bliss in exchange for my ego, yet I still resist.

stanza.lyrics: alivōḍu mēvumbōḷ atinottu nīṅguvānarutāttat-innende bhāgya-dōṣam
stanza.meaning: How unfortunate I am—unable to surrender, unable to offer my ego at your feet.

stanza.lyrics: aṇayukillē ammē aṇayukillē? īalayunna jīvane puṇarukillē?
stanza.meaning: Will you not take away the pain I bear—the pain of a child wandering in deep despair?

stanza.lyrics: atidūram atidīnam alayum ī paitalinaṇayātta nōvonn-akaṫṫukillē?
stanza.meaning: Won’t you embrace this distressed son of yours and ease the anguish in his heart?

song.title: ālakālam ēṫṫru kātta nīlakaṇṭhanē2025
song.source: Alakalam ettru katta 2025 Tamil in Eng v2.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Alakalam ettru katta 2025 Tamil in Eng v2.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ālakālam ēṫṫru kātta nīlakaṇṭhanēādiśakti pāti nirkkum ammaiyappanē
stanza.meaning: O Blue-Throated One, who held the deadly poison in your throat! O Father who stands united with the Primordial Shakti!

stanza.lyrics: ālamaram kīzhamarnta jñānadēśikāāgamaṅkaḷ vāzhttukinḍra tāyumānavā
stanza.meaning: O Guru of wisdom, who sat beneath the banyan tree! O One whom the scriptures praise as both Mother and Father!

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷamatu nilayillāmal ōḍi alayumēuḷḷa śakti payanillāmal virayamākumē
stanza.meaning: The mind, without steadiness, runs and wanders aimlessly; its inner power, without purpose, is wasted away.

stanza.lyrics: untanatu nāmarūpam dhyānam seyyavēuḷḷamatu amaitiyāki āṫṫral ōṁkumē
stanza.meaning: But by meditating on your name and form, the mind becomes peaceful and its strength grows.

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷakkuḷḷē unnaikkāṇum bhakti perukavēulakeṅkum unnaikāṇum pēṙu vāykkumē
stanza.meaning: As devotion grows to see you within the heart, the good fortune to see you everywhere in the world arises.

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷatellām nīyenḍruṇarum jñānam tōṇḍrumēulakattin sēvai untan sēvayākumē
stanza.meaning: Knowledge dawns, realizing that all that exists is only you, and serving the world becomes service to you.

stanza.lyrics: īśā paramēśā girivāsā azhakēśānēśā aruṇēśā jagadīśā amṛtēśā
stanza.meaning: Lord, supreme lord, dweller of the mountain, lord of beauty, beloved lord, lord of arunachala, lord of the universe, lord of immortality…

song.title: aḷavillā ānanda vaḍivāna ammā
song.source: Alavilla ananda 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: aḷavillā ānanda vaḍivāna ammāazhivillā ānandam aruḷvāy ammā
stanza.meaning: O Mother, embodiment of boundless bliss, bestow your eternal bliss upon me, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: aṙiyāmal nān seytapizhai kāttaruḷvāyēanbōḍu enai untanpadam cērttaruḷvāyē
stanza.meaning: Please forgive the mistakes I have made unknowingly, and with love, bless me to take refuge at your feet.

stanza.lyrics: jagam yāvum āzhkinḍra mahāṙāṇi nīyēen manamāḷa maṙantāyō mahākāḷi tāyē
stanza.meaning: You are the great Queen who permeates the entire universe-have you forgotten to reign over my heart, O Mother Mahakali?

stanza.lyrics: madam koṇḍu aḍaṅkāmalalaipāyum manattai – unpadam koṇḍu sīrākkumkalaiyai ñān aṙindēn
stanza.meaning: I have come to understand the art by which the restless, pride-filled, and unrestrained mind can be transformed and sanctified—by anchoring it at your sacred feet.

stanza.lyrics: ulakattār aṙiyāta poruḷai nān aṙiyaunnaruḷālē aṙiyāmai iruḷ yāvum nīṅga
stanza.meaning: By your grace, O Mother, may I come to know that truth which the people of the world do not perceive; let the darkness of ignorance be dispelled entirely.

stanza.lyrics: vazhi-seytāy ammā unmahimai ñān pāḍa – nīsariseytāy kuṙayāvummaṙaint-ōḍipōga
stanza.meaning: You have shown me the path so I may sing of your glory—and you have made all my shortcomings disappear without a trace.

song.title: amba tan padatārin dhūḷikaḷ nannāy
song.source: Amba tan padataril 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: amba tan padatārin dhūḷikaḷ nannāyen śirassiṅkal patiyēṇam ennum
stanza.meaning: Mother! May the dust of your lotus feet, which leads one to the supreme goal, adorn my head each day.

stanza.lyrics: abhaya-pradamā hastaṅgaḷ ennilanugraha-varṣam coriyēṇam ennum
stanza.meaning: May your divine hands of refuge ever shower their blessings upon me.

stanza.lyrics: ammē… bhakti-gamyē… prēma-rūpē… jagad-vandyē…
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are attained only through devotion; your very form is love, and the universe bows in worship before you.

stanza.lyrics: ātma-viśvāsamāy ā mandahāsamantaraṅgattil niṙayēṇam ennum
stanza.meaning: May your smile fill my heart with faith in my true Self.

stanza.lyrics: aviratam ennil ā tṛkkaṇ-kaḍākṣamiruḷ nīkki mārgam tēḷiykkēṇam ennum
stanza.meaning: May the glance of your eyes dispel all darkness and ever illumine my path.

stanza.lyrics: ammē… bhakti-gamyē… prēma-rūpē… jagad-vandyē…
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are attained only through devotion; your very form is love, and the universe bows in worship before you.

stanza.lyrics: aviḍutte mozhimuttu-mālakaḷ ennilhṛdayattin-alaṅkāram ākaṇam ennum
stanza.meaning: May the garland of your words ever adorn my heart.

stanza.lyrics: amma tan jīvita-sandēśam endekarmaṅgaḷ ujvalippikkēṇam ennum
stanza.meaning: O Mother, may the message of your life shine forth and make my every action worthy.

stanza.lyrics: ammē… bhakti-gamyē… prēma-rūpē… jagad-vandyē…
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are attained only through devotion; your very form is love, and the universe bows in worship before you.

song.title: amba tava cāru-śyāma-varṇṇattil
song.source: Amba tava 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: amba tava cāru-śyāma-varṇṇattilsamyutamākā varṇṇaṅgaḷ uṇḍō
stanza.meaning: Mother, is there a colour that does not merge into your beautiful dark hue?

stanza.lyrics: ambarē śvētavarṇṇē tāvakēpratiphalicciḍā varṇṇam onnuṇḍō
stanza.meaning: Is there any shade in all creation that is not reflected in the pure white of your saree? You embrace and include all beings in this world.

stanza.lyrics: amba tava madhura-vāṇi sāntvanamaruḷiḍā dīna-hṛdayam atuṇḍō
stanza.meaning: Do your sweet words not bring solace, even to those burdened by deep sorrow?

stanza.lyrics: avabōdham ēki tava vācavīcivīthi teḷiykkā hṛdayam onnuṇḍō
stanza.meaning: Do your words of guidance not touch even the hardest of hearts, opening the way for the light of awareness to arise?

stanza.lyrics: amba tava cāru-śyāma-varṇṇattilsamyutamākā varṇṇaṅgaḷ uṇḍō
stanza.meaning: Mother, is there a colour that does not merge into your beautiful dark hue?

stanza.lyrics: amba-padamalar-sēvayil viḍarānatajana-mānasa-malarukaḷ uṇḍō
stanza.meaning: Do not the heart-lotuses of the humble blossom when they serve your lotus feet?

stanza.lyrics: mandahāsābha tiṅgum vadanattālāndhyam akalātta mānasam uṇḍō
stanza.meaning: Does not the radiance of your smile not dispel the darkness in every human heart?

stanza.lyrics: amba tava cāru-śyāma-varṇṇattilsamyutamākā varṇṇaṅgaḷ uṇḍō
stanza.meaning: Mother, is there a colour that does not merge into your beautiful dark hue?

stanza.lyrics: amba karuṇā-kaḍākṣa-vīcikaḷaruḷiḍā bhāgya-śṛṅgam-atuṇḍō
stanza.meaning: Mother, does not your compassionate glance bestow the highest fortune?

stanza.lyrics: antar-prasādam tāvakamaruḷāsantōṣattin prāsādam uṇḍō
stanza.meaning: Is the joy we receive by pleasing your divine heart not beyond all measure?

song.title: ambāḍi paitalē
song.source: Ambadi paitale 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ambāḍi paitalē cāyuṙaṅgūnīlakkārvarṇṇane cāyuṙaṅgū
stanza.meaning: Krishna, the darling child of Ambadi, go to sleep. Kanna, my baby, hued like the dark blue clouds, close your eyes and rest.

stanza.lyrics: añcita rāvit neñcilāy cērnnoruambiḷi pālāzhī veṇmayāṇō
stanza.meaning: Does your body shine with the radiance of the silvery moon, the same moon that the night holds close to her heart?

stanza.lyrics: kuvalaya-pūvu viḍarnnu cirikkumbōḷcinni ozhukunna bhaṅgi āṇō…
stanza.meaning: Does your smile have the enchanting beauty of the blue water lily as it blooms and smiles at the world?

stanza.lyrics: ambāḍi paitalē cāyuṙaṅgūnīlakkārvarṇṇane cāyuṙaṅgū
stanza.meaning: Krishna, the darling child of Ambadi, go to sleep. Kanna, my baby, hued like the dark blue clouds, close your eyes and rest.

stanza.lyrics: ambāḍi paitalē ninnu ciṇuṅgātepūmetta-mēl onnu cāyuṙaṅgū
stanza.meaning: Krishna, child of Ambadi, stop resisting now. Come to your soft bed, soft as a flower, and go to sleep.

stanza.lyrics: nalmayil pīliyum ōḍakkuzhal atumnāḷe pularkāle ēkiḍām ñān
stanza.meaning: In the morning, I shall give you a fresh peacock feather and your beloved flute.

stanza.lyrics: mañña-pizhiññuḷḷa paṭṭ-onnuḍuppikkāmañjanam koṇḍu nin kaṇṇ-ezhutām
stanza.meaning: I will clothe you in bright yellow silk robes and line your eyes with dark collyrium.

stanza.lyrics: ambāḍi paitalē cāyuṙaṅgūnīlakkārvarṇṇane cāyuṙaṅgū
stanza.meaning: Krishna, the darling child of Ambadi, go to sleep. Kanna, my baby, hued like the dark blue clouds, close your eyes and rest.

stanza.lyrics: ponmaṇi kiṅgiṇi kālttaḷayum pinne nalla vaḷakaḷum cērtt-orukkām
stanza.meaning: Mother shall adorn you with anklets, with golden bells that softly tinkle. I shall dress you in many bangles to grace your little arms

stanza.lyrics: nal kanakāmbaram tuḷasi-katirkkulacērttoru mālayum cārtti tarām
stanza.meaning: I will place on your body a garland woven with kanakambara flowers, the color of the rosy dawn, and leaves of the sacred basil.

stanza.lyrics: nanpezhum veṇṇa niṙaccu ñān nalkiḍāmnalmizhi cimmi nī cāyuṙaṅgū
stanza.meaning: I shall feed you fresh, nourishing butter. Now close your eyes, my sweet child, and go to sleep.

stanza.lyrics: rārīram rārīram rārōrārīram rārīram rārōrārīram rārīram rārīrārōrārīram rārīram rārīrārō
stanza.meaning: (Words of a lullaby)

song.title: ambikē jagadambikē mama
song.source: Ambike Jagadambike mama saranameku 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Ambike Jagadambike mama saranameku 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ambikē jagadambikē mamaśaraṇam ēku padāmbujē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, divine Mother of the Universe, grant me refuge at your sacred feet.

stanza.lyrics: snēha-masṛṇa-lōlamām tiru-mizhiyiṇa ennil patiyaṇē
stanza.meaning: Let your gaze, overflowing with love, fall upon me.

stanza.lyrics: bhōga-lālasa talpara cittambhrāntamāy alaññīḍavē
stanza.meaning: My mind, ever chasing after sensual pleasures, roams like a lunatic.

stanza.lyrics: eṅgane mama mānasam gurōr-aṅghri-padmē uracciḍum
stanza.meaning: O Mother, how can I turn it toward you and anchor it at the feet of the Guru?

stanza.lyrics: śōka-vivaśamām hṛttaḍattilāśā-dīpam teḷikkaṇē
stanza.meaning: Please light the lamp of hope in my heart, which is heavy with sorrow.

stanza.lyrics: varaṇḍ-uṇaṅgum en hṛdaya-vāḍiyilsnēhamāri pozhikkaṇē
stanza.meaning: Come, like a shower of love, to the parched garden of my heart.

stanza.lyrics: svasthayalloru nāḷilum ihabaddha-paravaśa āṇu ñān
stanza.meaning: Because my mind is entangled in so many bonds, I do not experience any peace at all.

stanza.lyrics: śrīpadāmbujam ēkam āśrayammuktam ākkukī jīvanē
stanza.meaning: Your sacred feet are my only hope—please liberate this soul.

song.title: ambujam viḍaruvatum nōkki ninnoren
song.source: Ambujam vidaruvatum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ambujam viḍaruvatum nōkki ninnorenuḷḷu tellonnu piḍaññu
stanza.meaning: I watched the lotus blossom, and my heart stirred with a deep longing

stanza.lyrics: ennu viḍarum en cinta tan ōjassālamba tannāsyāmbujavum
stanza.meaning: . When will the lotus-face of my Mother bloom in the light and life-energy of my every thought?

stanza.lyrics: bhṛngamatin madhu nukaruvatum nōkkininnoren mānasam tēṅgi
stanza.meaning: I watched the honeybee drink its nectar, and my heart sobbed with sorrow.

stanza.lyrics: ennakatāril madhuvennu niṙayumambayām bhṛṅgam aṇayum
stanza.meaning: When will sweet nectar fill this heart of mine, and you, Mother, come like the bee to sip its essence?

stanza.lyrics: ambudhiyil nadi vilayippatum nōkkininnoren hṛdayam vitumbi
stanza.meaning: I watched the river merge with the sea, and my soul wept with grief.

stanza.lyrics: enn-aṇaññīḍum ī jīvitadhārayum amṛtāmbudhiyil vilīnam
stanza.meaning: When will the stream of this life flow into the ocean of immortality?

song.title: amē ramakāḍā
song.source: Ame ramakada 2025 Gujarati in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: amē ramakāḍā, māḍi tārā hāthanā
stanza.meaning: We are toys, O mother, in your hands.

stanza.lyrics: tu ramāḍē tēm ramiyēkyārēka sāpa nē siḍi
stanza.meaning: However you make us play, so we play. Sometimes it is snakes and ladders,

stanza.lyrics: kyārēka santā kūkuḍitō pachi kaṭhappūtḷī tayi rahiyē
stanza.meaning: sometimes it is blind man’s buff, and we just remain as wooden puppets.

stanza.lyrics: amē ramakāḍā, māḍi tārā hāthanā
stanza.meaning: We are toys, O mother, in your hands.

stanza.lyrics: sāpa nē siḍi mātārā nāmnī siḍi par jāyiyē… dūr dūr
stanza.meaning: In snakes and ladders, on the ladder of your name we reach great heights

stanza.lyrics: tyā āvi pahōṅcē aham nō sāp
stanza.meaning: but then comes the serpent of ego,

stanza.lyrics: mārē ḍaṅkh ēvō, amē dhaḍ dhaḍ paḍiyē
stanza.meaning: striking us so hard that we fall down with a thud

stanza.lyrics: amē ramakāḍā, māḍi tārā hāthanā
stanza.meaning: We are toys, O mother, in your hands.

stanza.lyrics: santā kūkaḍi mātu rahē antar mā, śōdhiyē tanē… dūr dūr
stanza.meaning: In blind man’s buff, you remain within, yet we search for you far and wide

stanza.lyrics: bhaṭkē mana ēvū, na vaḷē vāḷiyē
stanza.meaning: This wandering mind does not turn inward, however much we try.

stanza.lyrics: havē śū kahiyē, kēm karinē tanē pāmīē…
stanza.meaning: What can we say now, how can we ever reach you? We are toys…

stanza.lyrics: amē ramakāḍā, māḍi tārā hāthanā
stanza.meaning: We are toys, O mother, in your hands.

stanza.lyrics: upāy ēk j pāmvānō tanēkaṭhappūtḷī tārā hāthanī bani rahēvū
stanza.meaning: The only way to attain you is to become the puppet in your hands,

stanza.lyrics: jīvana ḍōr māri sōmpī tārā hāthamā
stanza.meaning: giving the string of my life into your keeping.

stanza.lyrics: tu ramāḍē tēm ramiyētu nacāvē tēm nāciyē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, however you make us play, so we play. However you make us dance, so we dance.

song.title: Ami que recherches-tu
song.source: Ami que recherches-tu 2025 French in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: Ami que recherches-tuEn ce monde éphémère ?
stanza.meaning: Friend, what are you seeking in this fleeting world?

stanza.lyrics: Veux-tu les plaisirs sans finQui ne mèneront à rien
stanza.meaning: Do you desire endless pleasures that lead nowhere,

stanza.lyrics: Tant de peines et regrets Pour en arriver làToujours insatisfait
stanza.meaning: with so many pains and regrets only to arrive at that point, always left unsatisfied?

stanza.lyrics: Ami que recherches-tuEn ce monde éphémère ?
stanza.meaning: Friend, what are you seeking in this fleeting world?

stanza.lyrics: Richesse et réputation Ne sont que disillusions
stanza.meaning: Wealth and reputation are but delusions,

stanza.lyrics: Car tout passe à jamaisComme les jours et les nuitsEt les vagues de l’océan
stanza.meaning: for everything passes away forever, like the days and nights, like the waves of the ocean.

stanza.lyrics: Si tu recherches la paixSi tu veux la vérité
stanza.meaning: If you seek peace, if you long for truth,

stanza.lyrics: Unis ton cœur à la Mère Qui soutient l’Univers
stanza.meaning: unite your heart with the Mother who upholds the universe.

stanza.lyrics: Chante son nom... jai jagadambē mā
stanza.meaning: Sing her name, glory to the mother of the Universe!

stanza.lyrics: Implore sa grâce... jai jagadambē mā
stanza.meaning: implore her grace, —glory to the mother of the Universe!

stanza.lyrics: Sers tout les êtres… jai jagadambē mā
stanza.meaning: serve all beings—glory to the mother of the Universe!

stanza.lyrics: jai jagadamba mā… jai jagadamba mā…
stanza.meaning: glory to the mother of the Universe!

song.title: ammā ammā ammā en ammā
song.source: Amma Amma Amma en 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Amma Amma Amma en 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ammā ammā ammā en ammā ammā…
stanza.meaning: Mother, O my Mother…

stanza.lyrics: un pādattil oru pūvāy nān irundāl
stanza.meaning: if I could be just a flower at your feet,

stanza.lyrics: unnai maṭṭum piḍittu nirpēn ammā undan aḍikaḷil śaraṇaḍaiyvēn
stanza.meaning: I would cling to you alone and never let go. I would surrender at your feet,

stanza.lyrics: ammā ammā ammā en ammā ammā…
stanza.meaning: Mother… O my Mother…

stanza.lyrics: nī ennai eḍuttu pārppāyā ammāunnuḍan sērttu aṇaiyppāyā
stanza.meaning: Will you take me into your arms and hold me close, Mother?

stanza.lyrics: un nāmam en nāvil japittu tudittukāttiruppēn ammā kāttiruppēn
stanza.meaning: Will you embrace me and keep me near? I will go on chanting your name with deep devotion, waiting for you, Mother…

stanza.lyrics: anda nannāḷai vēṇḍi kāttiruppēn
stanza.meaning: I will wait, I will wait for that blessed day to come.

stanza.lyrics: ammā ammā ammā en ammāammā varuvāy anbai taruvāy
stanza.meaning: Mother, O my Mother, come to me and give me your love.

stanza.lyrics: ammā ammā ammā en ammā ammā…
stanza.meaning: Mother, my Mother…

stanza.lyrics: un anbin naṙumaṇam anubhavittu ammāellōriḍamum parappavēṇḍum
stanza.meaning: Let me experience the fragrance of your love, Mother, and may I spread that fragrance to all beings everywhere

stanza.lyrics: anda ānandattil nī sirikka sirikkakāttiruppēn ammā kāttiruppēn
stanza.meaning: —seeing that, you will smile and laugh in blissful joy…

stanza.lyrics: anda nannāḷai vēṇḍi kāttiruppēn
stanza.meaning: Mother, I will wait, I will wait for that blessed day to come.

song.title: amma ēkīḍām uṇṇī ninakkinnu
song.source: Amma ekidam unni 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: amma ēkīḍām uṇṇī ninakkinnuūṣmaḷa-vātsalya kṣīram
stanza.meaning: Child, Mother will feed you milk—warm with her tenderness.

stanza.lyrics: nannāyitu kaḍaññīḍukil pontiḍumjñānamām tūnavanītam
stanza.meaning: If you churn it with care, the butter of fresh knowledge will rise.

stanza.lyrics: ennāl atin mumpu śuddham ākkīḍaṇammānasamām ninde pātram
stanza.meaning: But before Mother feeds you her milk, you must purify the vessel of your heart.

stanza.lyrics: allāykil amma pakarunna kṣīravumārkkum illāteyām vyarttham
stanza.meaning: Otherwise, the milk she gives will be wasted—of no benefit to anyone.

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷam parakkeyā kṣīram ozhukaṇamuṇṇi-manam kuḷirkkēṇam
stanza.meaning: The milk should flow fully into your heart. Child, your mind must be fresh and still.

stanza.lyrics: uṙatairāyatil upadēśam cēraṇamulayāte kāttukoḷḷēṇam
stanza.meaning: Mother’s words of wisdom must be mixed with the curd starter, and kept undisturbed, without wavering.

stanza.lyrics: prēmattin pāśattāl bandhicc-ātmavicārattin mattu tiriccāl
stanza.meaning: If love is the bond, and self-inquiry the churner,

stanza.lyrics: mananamām mathanattāl, ponti varum veṇṇanukarnnīḍām sarvarkkum ēkām
stanza.meaning: then—when churned with meditation—the butter will rise. You can enjoy it and share it with all.

song.title: amma en bōdha-nilāvāyitā amma en jīvita-saṅgītamāy
song.source: Amma en bodha nilavayita 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Amma en bodha nilavayita 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: amma en ātma-tuḍippumāy amma en śvāsa-niśvāsamāy
stanza.meaning: the heart beat of my soul—Mother is my very breath

stanza.lyrics: amma en kāvya-vasantamāyammayā kuḷir-tūkum pūntennalāy
stanza.meaning: Mother is the springtime of my poetry, the breeze scented with blossoms.

stanza.lyrics: ammayā bhakti tan hima-varṣamāy - ammayā prēmattin pēmāriyāy
stanza.meaning: Mother is the celestial snowfall of devotion, the torrent of divine love.

stanza.lyrics: ammayā kanivūṙum pulariyāy - ammayā kṛpa tūkum sūryanāy
stanza.meaning: Mother is the dawn that pours forth compassion, the sun that radiates grace.

stanza.lyrics: ammayā prabhayārnna hṛdaya-vānil - ammayāy sarvavum uṇmayāy
stanza.meaning: In the luminous sky of the heart, she becomes the very essence of all existence.

song.title: ammā nī pōgum
song.source: Amma ni pogum idam 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Amma ni pogum idam 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ammā nī pōgum iḍam ellām koṇḍāṭṭamunai nāḍi vandōmē vaṇḍāṭṭam
stanza.meaning: Mother, wherever you go, that place turns into a celebration. We come in search of you, like a swarm of bees.

stanza.lyrics: vāzhkkaiyilē vandu sērum tiṇḍāṭṭamunnaruḷāl paṙandiḍumē pañjāṭṭam
stanza.meaning: Life may bring its challenges, but in your grace, they disperse like whisps of cotton in the breeze.

stanza.lyrics: ammā nī pōgum iḍam ellām koṇḍāṭṭamunai nāḍi vandōmē vaṇḍāṭṭam
stanza.meaning: Mother, wherever you go, that place turns into a celebration. We come in search of you, like a swarm of bees.

stanza.lyrics: aruḷmāri vazhaṅgiḍum un anbukkaramkarumāri paṇindōmē undan padam
stanza.meaning: Mother, your loving hands shower us with grace. Goddess Karumari, we bow before your sacred feet.

stanza.lyrics: vinaigaḷai aṙuthiḍum undan sūlam - piṇigaḷai tīrttiḍum padamalar darśanam
stanza.meaning: Your trident will eradicate our past karmas, the vision of your holy feet will heal our ailments.

stanza.lyrics: ammā nī pōgum iḍam ellām koṇḍāṭṭamunai nāḍi vandōmē vaṇḍāṭṭam
stanza.meaning: Mother, wherever you go, that place turns into a celebration. We come in search of you, like a swarm of bees.

stanza.lyrics: pūmālai eḍuttu vandōm pārammā - pāmālai toḍuttu vandōm kēḷammā
stanza.meaning: Please accept the flower garlands we have brought as offerings. Please listen to the song we have composed in your honor.

stanza.lyrics: tēnāga inittiḍum un pērammā - tiraḷāga unai vaṇaṅgum ūrammā
stanza.meaning: Your name is as sweet as honey. A great gathering of people will come together to worship you.

stanza.lyrics: ammā nī pōgum iḍam ellām koṇḍāṭṭamunai nāḍi vandōmē vaṇḍāṭṭam
stanza.meaning: Mother, wherever you go, that place turns into a celebration. We come in search of you, like a swarm of bees.

stanza.lyrics: kāḷiyammā nī irukka kavalaiyillaidēviyin śaktikku ellaiyillai
stanza.meaning: Goddess Kali, we have no worries when you are by our side. O Devi, your power knows no limits.

stanza.lyrics: sūliyammanin anbirkō pañjamillainīyaṇḍri emakku vēṙu thañjamillai
stanza.meaning: Goddess Sooli, your love is abundant and unwavering. Mother, we have no other refuge but you.

stanza.lyrics: ammā nī pōgum iḍam ellām koṇḍāṭṭamunai nāḍi vandōmē vaṇḍāṭṭam
stanza.meaning: Mother, wherever you go, that place turns into a celebration. We come in search of you, like a swarm of bees.

stanza.lyrics: ōm śaktiyē ōmkāriyē mahākāḷiyē tirisūliyē
stanza.meaning: O Powerful Goddess, essence of the sacred sound ‘Om’, Great Kali who wields the trident!

song.title: amma ninna neraḷinalli
song.source: Amma ninna neralinalli 2025 Kannda in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: amma ninna neraḷinalliprēma-bhakti viśvāsadallininna kṛpeyalli bāḷalunityōtsava jīvana nityōtsava
stanza.meaning: Mother, in your shadow, in love, devotion, and faith, to live in your grace is a life of eternal celebration, a life of eternal festival.

stanza.lyrics: āśapāśagaḷu nīgibandhanagaḷu cūrāgibhaktibhāva dvandāgalunityōtsava jīvana nityotsava
stanza.meaning: Hopes and attachments dissolve in you, bonds are broken, feelings of devotion overcome dualities — a life of eternal celebration, a life of eternal festival.

stanza.lyrics: amma ninna neraḷinalliprēma-bhakti viśvāsadallininna kṛpeyalli bāḷalunityōtsava jīvana nityōtsava
stanza.meaning: Mother, in your shadow, in love, devotion, and faith, to live in your grace is a life of eternal celebration, a life of eternal festival.

stanza.lyrics: nī tōrida dāriyalliñānemba bhāva nīgininnontige ontāgalunityōtsava jīvana nityōtsava
stanza.meaning: On the path you have shown, if, shedding the sense of ‘I’, we move forward and become one with you — life will become an eternal celebration.

stanza.lyrics: amma ninna neraḷinalliprēma-bhakti viśvāsadallininna kṛpeyalli bāḷalunityōtsava jīvana nityōtsava
stanza.meaning: Mother, in your shadow, in love, devotion, and faith, to live in your grace is a life of eternal celebration, a life of eternal festival.

song.title: ammā yē mērī jīvan savāri
song.source: Amma ye meri 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ammā yē mērī jīvan savāritērē hi dar pē rōk lēnā
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are the one who has shaped my life. Keep me at your doorstep,

stanza.lyrics: kahīṅ yē – āgē na baṭ jāēkabhi yē – pīchē na muṭ pāē
stanza.meaning: so I may go no further ahead, nor ever fall behind.

stanza.lyrics: tērī caraṇōṅ sē bāndh lēnā
stanza.meaning: Bind me to your holy feet.

stanza.lyrics: janam janam kī kaṭhin ḍagar sē tērī dar par ātē haiṅ
stanza.meaning: From the difficult paths of many lifetimes, we have come to your door.

stanza.lyrics: caraṇōṅ meiṅ tērē ṭhahar milē jabdukh-sāgar tar pāte haiṅ
stanza.meaning: When we find rest at your feet, we are able to cross the ocean of sorrow.

stanza.lyrics: māyāpāś kī bandhan khōlsab visrā kē ammā bōl
stanza.meaning: Undo the bonds of the net of illusion, and forgetting everything, call out—Mother,

stanza.lyrics: ammā ammā cāmuṇḍēśvari māammā ammā cintapūrṇī mā
stanza.meaning: Mother Chamundeshwari, Mother, Mother Chintapurni.

stanza.lyrics: tērī caraṇōṅ mē sthān dēnātērī caraṇōṅ sē bāndh lēnā
stanza.meaning: Give me a place at your feet, bind me to your holy feet.

stanza.lyrics: ammā yē mērī jīvan savāritērē hi dar pē rōk lēnā
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are the one who has shaped my life. Keep me at your doorstep,

stanza.lyrics: sāñj ḍhaḷe ham pañcī lauṭēammā-vṛkṣ meiṅ ātē haiṅ
stanza.meaning: When evening falls, we birds return and come to rest in the Mother-tree.

stanza.lyrics: śākhā-śākhā nīṭ banākar sukh-śānti kō pātē haiṅ
stanza.meaning: From branch to branch we make our nests, and find comfort and peace.

stanza.lyrics: saccidānanda apnē meiṅ ghōl sab visrā kē ammā bōl
stanza.meaning: Dissolve me into your own being of existence, consciousness, and bliss; and forgetting everything, call out—Mother,

stanza.lyrics: ammā ammā hē baglā dēviammā ammā harsiddhi dēvi
stanza.meaning: Mother Bagla Devi, Mother, Mother Harsiddhi Devi.

stanza.lyrics: tērī caraṇōṅ meiṅ sthān dēnā tērī caraṇōṅ sē bāndh lēnā
stanza.meaning: Give me a place at your feet, bind me to your holy feet.

stanza.lyrics: ammā yē mērī jīvan savāritērē hi dar pē rōk lēnā
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are the one who has shaped my life. Keep me at your doorstep,

stanza.lyrics: ammā ammā cāmuṇḍēśvari māammā ammā cintpūrṇi mā
stanza.meaning: Mother, Mother Chamundeshwari, Mother, Mother Chintapurni,

stanza.lyrics: ammā ammā hē baglā dēvīammā ammā harsiddhi dēvī
stanza.meaning: Mother, Mother Bagla Devi, Mother, Mother Harsiddhi Devi

stanza.lyrics: tērī caraṇōṅ meiṅ sthān dēnātērī caraṇōṅ sē bāndh lēnā
stanza.meaning: —give me a place at your feet, bind me to your holy feet.

song.title: ammana pādake
song.source: Ammana padake 2025 Kan in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ammana pādake śaraṇādallibhayavēthake manavē
stanza.meaning: O mind, why fear when you have taken refuge at Mother’s feet?

stanza.lyrics: trilōka māteyu baliyalli iruvāganaḷidāḍu manavēnīnu kuṇidāḍu manavē
stanza.meaning: The Mother of the three worlds dwells within you. Rejoice and dance with delight, O mind.

stanza.lyrics: indriyagaḷige nī aḍiyāḷagadeātmadi mere manavē
stanza.meaning: O mind, revel in the self and do not become a slave to the senses.

stanza.lyrics: amma nammellara karahiṭidiruvāgacinte yēke manavēamma noḍane naḷi naḷi manavē
stanza.meaning: When Mother holds us all in her care, why should you worry? Dance in joy with the divine Mother, O mind.

stanza.lyrics: amma nannamma śaraṇu śaraṇu ammaamba jagadamba nī manadali nelesamma
stanza.meaning: Mother, my own Mother—you are my refuge. O Mother of the universe, come and dwell within my heart.

stanza.lyrics: jīvana rathada lagāmanu nīnuammage koḍumanavē
stanza.meaning: O mind, place the reins of the chariot of life in Mother’s hands.

stanza.lyrics: karma niratanāgu dṛḍhamanadi nīphalava apēkṣisadesadā naḷi naḷidāḍu manavē
stanza.meaning: Perform your duties with a firm and steady heart, yet without craving the fruits of your actions. O mind, always dance with joy.

stanza.lyrics: amma nannamma śaraṇu śaraṇu ammaamba jagadamba nī manadali nelesamma
stanza.meaning: Mother, my own Mother—you are my refuge. O Mother of the universe, come and dwell within my heart.

song.title: ammē kaniññēkū
song.source: Amme Kaninyeku 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ammē kaniññēkū prēma-bhaktiprahḷādan tan niṣkaḷaṅka bhakti
stanza.meaning: Mother, with compassion, grant me loving devotion—the innocent love of Prahlada,

stanza.lyrics: nin divyapāda-smaraṇāmṛtam nukarnn-unmattayāyiḍum dhanya-bhakti
stanza.meaning: the love that becomes ecstatic in the sweet nectar of remembrance of your divine feet.

stanza.lyrics: māntaḷir uṇḍu rasikkum kuyil eṅgāntēḍumō pavizhappuṫṫētu nāḷum?
stanza.meaning: Does a koel, feasting on the nectar of tender mango shoots, go in search of coral reefs?

stanza.lyrics: nin cāru-pādāmbuja-tēn bhujikkukilen manam tēḍumō lōka-bhōgam?
stanza.meaning: If I can drink the honey of your lovely lotus feet, why would my mind wander after worldly pleasures?

stanza.lyrics: en manam tēḍumō lōka-bhōgam?
stanza.meaning: why would my mind wander after worldly pleasures?

stanza.lyrics: ammē kaniññēkū prēma-bhaktiprahḷādan tan niṣkaḷaṅka bhakti
stanza.meaning: Mother, with compassion, grant me loving devotion—the innocent love of Prahlada,

stanza.lyrics: sūrya-tējassināl nēṭṭam entandhanilśaṅkhu-nādattāl badhiranilum
stanza.meaning: What use is the sun’s radiance to the blind, or the conch’s sound to the deaf?

stanza.lyrics: sadgurō nin pāda-bhakti ezhāykil enjīvitam ā vidham arttha-śūnyam
stanza.meaning: O Satguru, if I do not attain love for your divine feet, my life will remain empty and without meaning.

stanza.lyrics: jīvitam ā vidham arttha-śūnyam
stanza.meaning: my life will remain empty and without meaning.

stanza.lyrics: ammē kaniññēkū prēma-bhaktiprahḷādan tan niṣkaḷaṅka bhakti
stanza.meaning: Mother, with compassion, grant me loving devotion—the innocent love of Prahlada,

stanza.lyrics: nin divyapāda-smaraṇāmṛtam nukarnn-unmattayāyiḍum dhanya-bhakti
stanza.meaning: the love that becomes ecstatic in the sweet nectar of remembrance of your divine feet.

song.title: ammē en hṛdayattin spandanam
song.source: Amme en hridayattin 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ammē en hṛdayattin spandanam okkeyumnin pādadhvanikaḷ allē?
stanza.meaning: Mother! Aren't my heartbeats the sound of your footsteps?

stanza.lyrics: nī ende snēhavum śaktiyum śāntiyumprāṇande madhuravum allē – ammēprāṇande madhuravum allē?
stanza.meaning: Aren’t you my love, my strength, my peace — the sweetness in every breath I take? Aren’t you the very essence of my life?

stanza.lyrics: nin nāma-jāpanam nin gītālāpanamnī nādabrahmam tānallē
stanza.meaning: Aren't you the sound that rises when I chant your mantra and sing your hymns? Are you not the N?da Brahma, the eternal sound behind all creation?

stanza.lyrics: nin divya-rūpam kaṇḍ-en mizhikaḷ niṙayumbōḷkaṇṇīril minnuvatum nī allēā kaṇṇīril minnuvatum nī allē
stanza.meaning: When tears fill my eyes at the sight of your divine form, isn’t it you who shines through those very tears?

stanza.lyrics: iruḷ mūḍum en manam teḷiyippū nī sadāśubhacintā-dīpti parattunnu
stanza.meaning: You illumine the darkness in my heart, kindling within me pure and auspicious thoughts.

stanza.lyrics: bhayam ellām ozhiyunnu manam maunam ākunnuen cinta nin cinta ākumbōḷ – ammēen cinta nin cinta ākumbōḷ
stanza.meaning: When my mind is filled with thoughts of you, all fear dissolves, and a profound silence fills my heart.

stanza.lyrics: en ōrō ciriyāyum nisvārttha-kṛtiyāyum karuṇāmṛtam nī coriyunnu
stanza.meaning: You pour your compassion into every smile of mine, into every action born of selfless love.

stanza.lyrics: amṛtāmbikē ñān aṙiyāte nī ennenin karmōpādhiyāy māṫṫunnu – ñānnin kayyil nimittamāy māṙunnu
stanza.meaning: O Immortal Mother Ambika, without my knowing, you make me your instrument, and through me, perform actions that benefit the world.

song.title: ammē en priya tāyē
song.source: Amme en priya taye 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Amme en priya taye 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ammē en priya tāyē itā nintirusannidhiyil ñān…
stanza.meaning: My dearest Mother, here I stand in your divine presence.

stanza.lyrics: ninniccha pōl ende vēṣavum pūrṇamāyāḍānitā ñān tozhunnēn…āḍānitā ñān tozhunnēn…
stanza.meaning: I pray, let me play my role fully and perfectly, according to your will. I pray, let me fulfil my role to perfection.

stanza.lyrics: ammā… ammā… ammā… ammā…
stanza.meaning: O Mother…

stanza.lyrics: āśā vaśamvadayāy ñānvṛthā lakṣyam illāte alaññū
stanza.meaning: I wandered, aimlessly without purpose, enslaved by countless desires.

stanza.lyrics: nin vazhiyālē nī ende āāśā-śataṅgaḷ aṙukkū…ammē āśā-śataṅgaḷ aṙukkū
stanza.meaning: Mother, in your own way, cut away the deep-rooted cravings within me.

stanza.lyrics: ammā… ammā… ammā… ammā…
stanza.meaning: O Mother…

stanza.lyrics: ninnilēkk-uḷḷen prayāṇamtaḍuttīḍunnu māyāviṣaṅgaḷ
stanza.meaning: The poison of illusion clouds my path, and blocks my efforts to reach the luminous sky of inner consciousness.

stanza.lyrics: nin divyadyōvil ettānāy kaḍākṣikkūnī en mānasatte…ammē nī en mānasatte…
stanza.meaning: Mother! let your loving glance fall on me each day, and bless my heart to reach you within me.

stanza.lyrics: ammā… ammā… ammā… ammā…
stanza.meaning: O Mother…

stanza.lyrics: sarvam sadā nalkum ammēñān āśayōḍiṅgitā nilpū
stanza.meaning: Mother, you who always grant what we seek, I wait expectantly before you,

stanza.lyrics: satyam entenn-aṙiññīḍān namikkunnuñān nin munnil ennum…ammē ñān nin munnil ennum…
stanza.meaning: seeking the eternal truth, I stand before you in prayer.

stanza.lyrics: ammā… ammā… ammā… ammā…
stanza.meaning: O Mother…

stanza.lyrics: yōgya allennirunnālummakaḷ kēzhunnitātma-dṛṣṭikkāy
stanza.meaning: This daughter, though unworthy, longs deeply for self-realisation.

stanza.lyrics: nin kṛpayākum abhayam atilcērkkēṇam enne ennennum…ammē cērkkēṇam enne ennennum
stanza.meaning: Grant me your grace, your shelter, and lead me to the abode of fearlessness. Mother, grant me the grace to merge forever in you.

stanza.lyrics: ammā… ammā… ammā… ammā…
stanza.meaning: O Mother…

song.title: ammē nin kaṇṇil viriyum
song.source: Amme nin kannil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ammē nin kaṇṇil viriyumkāruṇya-pūnilāvuentē ī kuññin manassilevēdana tan iruḷ nīkkīlā
stanza.meaning: Mother! Compassion blooms in your eyes, Radiant as the cool, silvery moonlight. Why then does it not dispel the darkness of sorrow in this child's heart?

stanza.lyrics: snēhattin kaḍalallē nītīrattil ñān nilkkunnu
stanza.meaning: Are you not the boundless ocean of love? I stand waiting upon your shore.

stanza.lyrics: oru tuḷḷi prēmajalam nīkanivōḍe nalkaṇam ammē
stanza.meaning: Mother! In your compassion, grant me a single drop of your love.

stanza.lyrics: ammaykku makkaḷ ellāmtulyar ennōrttīḍunnu
stanza.meaning: I remember that to you, all children are equal.

stanza.lyrics: amma tan prēma-nilāvilaliyānāy mōhikkunnu
stanza.meaning: Mother! I long to dissolve into the moonlight of your love.

song.title: ammē nin pālināyi
song.source: Amme nin palinay 2025 bodham Mal in English.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Amme nin palinay 2025 bodham Mal in English.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ammē nin pālināyietra nāḷāy kotikkunnu
stanza.meaning: O Mother how many days have I longed for your milk?

stanza.lyrics: prēmappāl nukarnnīḍān koti ēṙunnuammē koti ēṙunnu ammē koti ēṙunnu
stanza.meaning: The yearning to drink the milk of divine love is grows ever stronger, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: prēmam ennāl bhaktiyallēbhaktiyō nal prēmavum
stanza.meaning: Is divine love not devotion, and is devotion not pure love?

stanza.lyrics: onnāy chērnnīḍumbōḷjñāna gaṅga ozhukīḍumammē… jñāna gaṅga ozhukīḍum
stanza.meaning: When the two unite as one, the Ganga of knowledge will flow, O Mother, the Ganga of knowledge will flow.

stanza.lyrics: pāl aṅgane palat-uṇḍujñāna-pālum sēva-pālum pinn-ammiñña-pālum
stanza.meaning: There are many kinds of milk—the milk of knowledge, the milk of seva, and then a mothers own breast milk.

stanza.lyrics: ellām onnāy chērnnālamma tan prēma-pālallō
stanza.meaning: When all of these come together, they become Mother’s milk of divine love.

stanza.lyrics: vinayavum eḷima tan viḷanilamāyālsarvatum ammayāy viḷaṅgum allō
stanza.meaning: If we become the field where humility is the harvest, then everything will shine forth as Mother.

stanza.lyrics: ā maḍittaṭṭilāy kēzhum ī kuññineprēmappāl ūṭṭi uṙakkukillēammē prēmappāl ūṭṭi uṙakkukillē
stanza.meaning: Won’t you gather this crying child into your lap, and lull me to sleep with the milk of your love?

song.title: ammē nin ponniḷam paitalallē
song.source: Amme nin ponnilam paitalalle 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Amme nin ponnilam paitalalle 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ammē nin ponniḷam paitalallēenne nin kaiyāl talōḍukillē
stanza.meaning: Mother, am I not your tender little one? Will you not gather me into your arms and caress me with your loving hands?

stanza.lyrics: nin maḍittaṭṭil pāḍi uṙakki nitya-śānti kaniññ-ēkukillē
stanza.meaning: Will you not place me on your lap and sing me a lullaby, granting me eternal peace?

stanza.lyrics: ānanda-dhāmattil ninnōḍoppamkaḷiccu ciriccu ñān nṛttam āḍum
stanza.meaning: When will that sacred day dawn, when I may laugh and play with you, dancing in the abode of bliss where you are eternally enthroned?

stanza.lyrics: puṇya-dinam tāyē ennu varumjanmam itennu saphalam ākum
stanza.meaning: When will that blessed day come, when the purpose of my life is fulfilled?

stanza.lyrics: ammē amṛtēśvarī…dēvī dayāmayī…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, immortal Goddess… Devi, Compassionate One…

stanza.lyrics: yuddha-kaḷamām en manassilpōrāḍiḍān kāḷī śakti nalkū
stanza.meaning: O Kali! Grant me the strength to fight the battle within my mind, to conquer the dark forces of negative tendencies.

stanza.lyrics: nin cēlattumbin piḍi viḍātesanmārggē tuḍarān śakti nalkū
stanza.meaning: Give me the strength to cling to the hem of your saree and never let go—to walk steadfastly on the path of virtue you have shown.

stanza.lyrics: ammē amṛtēśvarī…dēvī dayāmayī…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, immortal Goddess… Devi, Compassionate One…

stanza.lyrics: ādhikaḷ ellām akaṫṫiḍunna ninmandasmitam atil ennaliyum?
stanza.meaning: When will I dissolve into your beautiful smile? That smile which dispels the suffering of all who meditate upon it?

stanza.lyrics: nin snēha-sindhuvil ennu cērumennu ñān ammayil vannu cērum?
stanza.meaning: When will I plunge into the ocean of your love and become one with it? When, O Mother, will I reach and merge into you?

stanza.lyrics: ammē amṛtēśvarī…dēvī dayāmayī…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, immortal Goddess… Devi, Compassionate One…

song.title: ananta-varṇini ānanda-pūraṇi
song.source: Ananta Varnini 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ananta-varṇini ānanda-pūraṇi ananta mukhamuḷḷa anantane pōl
stanza.meaning: O Devi, blissful and praised in countless ways, if you become my mind, O Eternal One,

stanza.lyrics: ananta-gānaṅgaḷ arppikkām ninakkāyanaśvarē nī en manamāy tīrukil
stanza.meaning: I will offer you countless songs, boundless as Ananta, the thousand-headed serpent on which Vishnu rests.

stanza.lyrics: śakti-pradāyini śakti-rūpē ennilśaṅkiyāt-onnu śayikkum ennākilō
stanza.meaning: O Embodiment and Source of strength, if you would dwell in me,

stanza.lyrics: śakti-svarūpē nin śaktiyāl āśa tanśākhakaḷ niścayam naśiccu pōyēne
stanza.meaning: with your strength, the roots of desire in me will be uprooted.

stanza.lyrics: śata-kōṭi brahmāṇḍa pūrakē nī ennilsvanamāy vannu layiccīḍum eṅkilo
stanza.meaning: If you, who creates innumerable worlds, merge into me as the divine notes of music,

stanza.lyrics: sapta-svaraṅgaḷāl nin svana-yuktamāystutikaḷ āyiram nirgatam āyēnē
stanza.meaning: then a thousand hymns of praise will arise from me as the seven notes blend with your voice.

stanza.lyrics: niyati tan nigūḍha niyōgattāl nistulēnī en svaramāy māṙumō?
stanza.meaning: By fate’s mysterious ways: peerless Nistula, be my voice;

stanza.lyrics: niścalē nī en manamāy tīrumō?nirmalē nī en tanuvil layikkumō?
stanza.meaning: tranquil Nischala, be my mind; pure Nirmala, be my body.

stanza.lyrics: nī en tanuvāy nī en manamāynī ennil svanamāy teḷiññīḍukil
stanza.meaning: If you become my body, my mind, and my voice,

stanza.lyrics: nin stuti-gānaṅgaḷ anavadhi ninnilozhuki ozhuki layiccēnē
stanza.meaning: then many hymns in your glory will be born, flow, and be offered back to you.

stanza.lyrics: ammē, ozhuki ozhuki layiccēne
stanza.meaning: Mother, they will flow and be offered back to you.

song.title: annai enḍrālē azhakallavā
song.source: Annai endrale 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: annai enḍrālē azhakallavāazhakinai pōḍriḍum ulakallavā
stanza.meaning: Isn't it beautiful just to say "Mother"? Doesn't the whole world praise that beauty?

stanza.lyrics: akhilattai ālum dēviyai kavarumazhakō akattin azhakallavā
stanza.meaning: The beauty that draws the Goddess who rules the entire universe is the beauty within the heart!

stanza.lyrics: kaṇkaḷukkazhaku kanivallavākaikaḷukkazhaku koḍaiyallavā
stanza.meaning: Isn't compassion the beauty of the eyes? Isn't generosity the beauty of the hands?

stanza.lyrics: annaiyai vaṇaṅki padamalar vaiykkummanamalar pūjaykku azhakallavā
stanza.meaning: Isn’t it the flower of the heart, offered prayerfully at Mother’s lotus feet, that makes the worship beautiful?

stanza.lyrics: anpukku sutantiram azhakallavāaṙivukku aḍakkamum azhakallavā
stanza.meaning: Isn't freedom the beauty of love? Isn't humility the beauty of knowledge?

stanza.lyrics: anpinil vaḷarntu ahantai tuṙantaaḍiyavar ulakukku azhakallavā
stanza.meaning: Those who grow in love and are free of ego — aren’t they the true beauty of the world?

stanza.lyrics: maṇiyē maṇi oḷiyē arumaṙaiyin parimaḷamē
stanza.meaning: O precious gem, radiant light, fragrance of the sacred Vedas,

stanza.lyrics: niṙai azhakē umayavaḷē piṙappaṙukkum pēramudē
stanza.meaning: perfect beauty, Goddess Uma, nectar that ends the cycle of birth!

song.title: anpuḍan aṇaittiḍum un kaikaḷ
song.source: Anpudan anaittidum 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: anpuḍan aṇaittiḍum un kaikaḷarumaruntu un tiruvāy mozhikaḷ
stanza.meaning: Your hands embrace us lovingly. Your sacred words are the rarest medicine.

stanza.lyrics: annai umayē tañcam aḍaintōmakalaṭṭum em mana kavalaikaḷ
stanza.meaning: O Mother Uma, we have taken refuge in you—may all the burdens of our minds be removed forever.

stanza.lyrics: āṙutal mozhikaḷukkaḷavum uṇḍō?tīrtta tīvinaikaḷukk-ellai uṇḍō?
stanza.meaning: Is there any measure to your words of comfort? Is there any limit to the sorrows you have have dispelled?

stanza.lyrics: vāñcaiyuḍan emmai vaḷarttiḍuvāyvāḍum uḷḷasumayai akaḍriḍuvāy
stanza.meaning: With love, you nurture us and lift the burden from our weary hearts.

stanza.lyrics: kaḍalaiviḍa āzham un anbubhūmiyinum peritu un poṙumai
stanza.meaning: Deeper than the ocean is your love. Greater than the earth is your patience;

stanza.lyrics: vānatte pōlē un uḷḷamvāzhvitu tāyun tāḷ śaraṇam
stanza.meaning: as vast as the sky is your heart. O Mother, we take refuge at your feet.

song.title: antaryāmiyām amṛtāmbikē
song.source: Antaryamiyam Amritambike 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: antaryāmiyām amṛtāmbikē enantaraṅgattin pontamburuvil
stanza.meaning: O Ambika, indweller of my heart, will you play melodies of yearning on the golden tamburu within me?

stanza.lyrics: nombara-rāgaṅgaḷ śruti cērttu mīṭṭumōkambaṅgaḷ sarvam akaṫṫiḍumō anpōḍ-ambuja-pādattil cērttīḍumō
stanza.meaning: O Ambika, indweller of my heart, will you play melodies of yearning on the golden tamburu within me? Will you remove all my desires and draw me lovingly to your lotus feet?

stanza.lyrics: padapadma-rēṇukkaḷ mama hṛtsarassitilpariśuddhi tan pūrṇṇata ēkīḍumbōḷ
stanza.meaning: When the radiant rays from your lotus feet purify the lake of my heart,

stanza.lyrics: bhaktipriyē prēmabhakti niṙaññ-ennilmukti tan mārgam prakāśiccīḍillēen dukhaṅgaḷ sarvam śamiccīḍillē
stanza.meaning: O lover of devotion, will not pure love overflow within me, and the path to liberation shine bright? Will not my sorrows vanish?

stanza.lyrics: akhila-carācaram niṙayum caitanyam ‘ambika tān’ ennaṙiyum parāvidya
stanza.meaning: Mother, will you bless me with the highest knowledge—that you, O Ambika, are the pure consciousness pervading the entire universe?

stanza.lyrics: anugrahicc-ennil pakarnnīḍumō ammēamṛtapadattil aṇaccīḍumō ñāntava hṛdayattil layiccīḍumō
stanza.meaning: Will you not grant me refuge at your lotus feet? Won’t I merge into your heart?

song.title: ārāy kāṇēṇam ārāy bhajikkēṇam
song.source: Aray kanenam aray bhajikkenam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Aray kanenam aray bhajikkenam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ārāy kāṇēṇam ārāy bhajikkēṇam mātṛ-rūpam pūṇḍen guruvāyo
stanza.meaning: In what form should I behold you and worship you? As my Guru, who has taken the form of the Mother?

stanza.lyrics: śrī viṭhala-smaraṇa ēkum śyāmayāyōatō prāṇanum prāṇan en śyāmanāyō?
stanza.meaning: Or as Kali, who reminds me of Sri Vithala, sharing the same dark hue? Or as Sri Krishna, the very life of my life?

stanza.lyrics: ārāy kāṇēṇam…
stanza.meaning: In what form should I behold you?

stanza.lyrics: kārmēgha-varṇṇattil māṫṫamilla tellum kusṛti-kuṙumbilum māṫṫamilla
stanza.meaning: The color of dark rain clouds has not changed—the mischief remains the same.

stanza.lyrics: karivaṇḍu pōluḷḷor-aḷakaṅgaḷum pinne ellām aṙiyum mṛḍu-smēravum
stanza.meaning: Krishna, Kali, and my Mother all share the same curly locks, dancing like black bees upon their brows, and the same all-knowing, tender smile.

stanza.lyrics: ārāy kāṇēṇam…
stanza.meaning: In what form should I behold you?

stanza.lyrics: pādam piṇaccu ninnēṙe kazhaññatō paramaśivan tirumāṙil vaccu
stanza.meaning: When I see Mother Kali standing with her feet upon Lord Shiva’s chest, it feels to me as though it is Krishna, resting his feet—tired from standing long with legs crossed.

stanza.lyrics: nāvu nīṭṭunnatu rudhirattinalla en hṛdayattil ūṙum navanītattināy
stanza.meaning: And when I see Mother Kali with her tongue out, I don’t feel she is thirsting for blood; I feel it is Lord Krishna, eager to lick up the fresh butter filling my heart.

stanza.lyrics: ārāy kāṇēṇam…
stanza.meaning: In what form should I behold you?

stanza.lyrics: muḍiyil tirukiya mayilppīli vīṇatō makuḍattin maṙayil nī oḷiccu vaccō?
stanza.meaning: Has the peacock feather fallen from your hair, or have you hidden it behind Mother Kali’s crown?

stanza.lyrics: enikku kāṇām kṛṣṇā ā pīli innum nin vaśya-saundaryattin niṙappakiṭṭāy
stanza.meaning: You may try to hide it, to conceal who you are, but even today, as I gaze upon Mother Kali, I see your peacock feather—adding color to her bewitching beauty.

stanza.lyrics: ārāy kāṇēṇam…
stanza.meaning: In what form should I behold you?

stanza.lyrics: āvōḷam mātṛ-vātsalyam uṇḍeṅkilum ā prēmam entē nī oḷiccu vaccū?
stanza.meaning: You are showering us with overwhelming love in the form of Mother—but why are you hiding the boundless love you once gave the gopis?

stanza.lyrics: oru vaṭṭam kūḍi nin vṛndāvanam viḍān maḍiyārnnō jananiyāy nī lasippū?
stanza.meaning: Are you reveling here as Mother because you cannot bear to leave Vrindavan again?

stanza.lyrics: prēmam rahasyamāy eṅkilum ivaḷkku nalkū kaṇṇā rahasyamāy tanne ñān oḷiccu vekkām
stanza.meaning: Krishna, give me that same love, even if in secret. I will treasure it within, hidden from all. Give me that love without anyone knowing—I will conceal it deep in my heart, where no one can see.

stanza.lyrics: ārāy kāṇēṇam ārāy bhajikkēṇam? kāḷiyō kṛṣṇanō collukammē?
stanza.meaning: Tell me, Mother—whom should I see you as and worship: Kali or Krishna?”

stanza.lyrics: ‘janma-janmaṅgaḷāy nin sakhan kṛṣṇanāyum ninnile nīyāyum aṙiññu koḷka’ennennōḍ-annamma mozhiññ-uṇartti
stanza.meaning: Mother replied, “See me as your Krishna—the one who has been with you in every birth, the one who dwells within you as the You in you.

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvanēśā kṛṣṇā harē…rādhā-priyaṅkarā śyāmā harē…
stanza.meaning: Krishna! Lord of Vrindavan, grant me refuge... Beloved of Radha,

stanza.lyrics: amṛtapurēśā prāṇēśā harē…mama hṛdaya-nivāsā amṛtēśā harē…
stanza.meaning: Lord of Amritapuri, Lord of my life who dwells within my heart—grant me refuge...

song.title: Ardiente es el llanto
song.source: Ardiente es el llanto 2025 Spanish in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Ardiente es el llanto 2025 Spanish in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: Ardiente es el llantodel alma que clama / por unas gotitasde amor infinito
stanza.meaning: The soul’s cry blazes with yearning for a few drops of infinite love.

stanza.lyrics: y es dulce presenciala madre divina /
stanza.meaning: The Divine Mother is a sweet presence

stanza.lyrics: misterio brillantesusurro de paz
stanza.meaning: —a shining mystery, a whisper of peace.

stanza.lyrics: llenas de gozollenas de amor, amma /amma… amma…amma… amma…
stanza.meaning: You fill me with joy, you fill me with love, Mother. You fill me with joy, you fill me with love.

stanza.lyrics: se quema la flamay perfuma el camino de aquel que te buscaen profundo silencio
stanza.meaning: The flame burns and perfumes the path of the one who seeks you in deep silence.

stanza.lyrics: y es dulce presenciala madre divina / misterio brillantesusurro de paz
stanza.meaning: The Divine Mother is a sweet presence—a shining mystery, a whisper of peace.

song.title: arivanu nīḍuva śivane
song.source: Arivanu niduva Sivane 2025 Kan in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: arivanu nīḍuva śivanemareveya nīgisu śivane
stanza.meaning: O Shiva, giver of knowledge, remove our forgetfulness.

stanza.lyrics: mīralu itimiti gaḷanellāsanmati samyama nīḍu
stanza.meaning: Grant us awareness and patience, so we may go beyond our limitations.

stanza.lyrics: balāḍhya buddhi miduḷallivivēkavilla manadalli
stanza.meaning: There is great intelligence in the brain, but no discrimination within.

stanza.lyrics: sakkare guḍḍava māḍiṭetinnuva iruveyu nānāde
stanza.meaning: I piled up a heap of sugar granules—then became the ant that consumed it.

stanza.lyrics: dhyānakkendu kaṇṇumucci kuḷidecinteya kūpadi muḷugikeṭṭe
stanza.meaning: I sat with eyes closed to meditate, but fell into the well of endless thoughts.

stanza.lyrics: satsaṅga gaṅgeyali mindubandēvāsane maṇṇali horaḷāḍide
stanza.meaning: I bathed in the Ganga of satsang, but once out, I rolled again in the sand of vasanas.

stanza.lyrics: śivanē haranējñāna-dāyaka guruvē
stanza.meaning: O Shiva, O Hara! O Guru, bestower of true knowledge!

song.title: aṙivinde amṛtēkum
song.source: Arivinde Amritekum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: aṙivinde amṛtēkum abhirāma-gēhamaṙivinde śruti cērnnu viḍarunna svapnam
stanza.meaning: The heart is a home, delighting in the gift of self-realization—a dream that blossoms in the rhythmic beat of compassion.

stanza.lyrics: aṙiyāt-oranubhūti utirunna kalpamatimōhanam divya-sukṛtam ī kṣētram
stanza.meaning: It abides in divine exultation, in a bliss yet unknown. The temple of the heart is sacred and serene, a radiant abode of auspiciousness.

stanza.lyrics: ulakinde aḍivēru tirayunna dharmamuṇarvinde śṛṅgaṅgaḷ uṇarunna maunam
stanza.meaning: Its dharma is to seek the source of all creation. In silence, it ascends to the summit of awareness.

stanza.lyrics: madhura-gītattinde taraḷam oru tāḷamaviratam oranubhūta dhanyam ī kṣētram
stanza.meaning: When the heart dissolves into that stillness, life becomes a melody—a rhythm of magnanimity. The sacred temple of the heart abides in constant bliss.

stanza.lyrics: uyiril oru suragaṅga ozhukunna yāmammahita-snēhattinde mṛdulam oru spandam
stanza.meaning: The heavenly Ganga flows through the body when the heart rests in deep silence. It feels the soft throbbing of renewal—of divine love.

stanza.lyrics: nityatā-bōdhattil amarunna cittamtirayaḍicc-uṇarunnor-arṇṇava-kṣētram
stanza.meaning: Immersed in the knowledge of eternal truth, the heart becomes an ocean, awakened by tumultuous waves of bliss.

stanza.lyrics: hṛdayam oru kṣētramatil oru suddīpamaṇayātt-oruṇma tanteḷivuṫṫa bōdham
stanza.meaning: The heart is a sacred temple, where an eternal flame burns bright—a clear and steady awareness of a truth that never dies.

song.title: āruṇḍu bandhukkaḷ
song.source: Arundu bandhukkal 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: āruṇḍu bandhukkaḷ āruṇḍu mitraṅgaḷennammē nī ozhiññ-ī ulakil
stanza.meaning: O Mother, in this world, who else do I have as my kin or friend but you?

stanza.lyrics: en-manam eppōzhum ennum aṙiyunnor-ālambanam maṫṫorēḍatt-ammē?ālambanam maṫṫorēḍatt-ammē?
stanza.meaning: Where else can I find support or shelter, other than in you, who knows my heart at all times?

stanza.lyrics: iruḷum veḷiccavum ī ulakil kāṭṭitannōru śakti enn-ammayalle?
stanza.meaning: Mother, are you not the primordial power revealed to me both in darkness and light?

stanza.lyrics: ikkāṇum vānavum nakṣatra-jālavumen kaṇṇil teḷiyiccat-ammayalle?
stanza.meaning: Do not the skies above and the clusters of stars clearly show your form to my eyes?

stanza.lyrics: āruṇḍu bandhukkaḷ āruṇḍu mitraṅgaḷennammē nī ozhiññ-ī ulakil
stanza.meaning: O Mother, in this world, who else do I have as my kin or friend but you?

stanza.lyrics: kārmukil nīḷe kanakkunna mānatteveḷḷi-nakṣatram enn-ammayalle
stanza.meaning: Mother, are you not the shining star in the sky where dark rain clouds gather?

stanza.lyrics: kālatt-uṇarunna kaṇṇil prakāśamāytazhukum prabhākaran ammayalle?
stanza.meaning: Are you not the luminous sun that caresses my eyes as I awaken in the morning?

stanza.lyrics: āruṇḍu bandhukkaḷ āruṇḍu mitraṅgaḷennammē nī ozhiññ-ī ulakil
stanza.meaning: O Mother, in this world, who else do I have as my kin or friend but you?

stanza.lyrics: jīvita-vīthiyil iḍam valam kāvalāyoppam ennum enikk-ammayalle
stanza.meaning: Mother, on the path of life, are you not there to guard me to my left and my right?

stanza.lyrics: duritakkayattil āzhum mumbe kai pidicc-enne rakṣikkaṇē amṛtēśvarī
stanza.meaning: O Amriteswari, before I sink into the depths of suffering, take my hand and rescue me.

stanza.lyrics: āruṇḍu bandhukkaḷ āruṇḍu mitraṅgaḷennammē nī ozhiññ-ī ulakil
stanza.meaning: O Mother, in this world, who else do I have as my kin or friend but you?

song.title: Auf der langen Reise
song.source: Auf der langen Reise 2025 Ger in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Auf der langen Reise 2025 Ger in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: Auf der langen Reiseauf dem Weg des Lebens
stanza.meaning: On the long journey along the path of life,

stanza.lyrics: eine tiefe Sehnsuchtliess die Seele rufen
stanza.meaning: a deep longing made the soul cry out

stanza.lyrics: Amma… Amma… Amma… Amma…
stanza.meaning: —O Mother, Mother…

stanza.lyrics: Sanft in deinen Armenan deiner Lotus Wange
stanza.meaning: Gently in your arms, against your lotus-like cheek,

stanza.lyrics: umschliesst mich deine Liebeein Moment der Ewigkeit
stanza.meaning: your love enfolds me in a moment that feels like eternity

stanza.lyrics: Amma… Amma… Amma… Amma…
stanza.meaning: —O Mother, Mother…

stanza.lyrics: Geborgenheit, Vertrauenmein Herz von dir getragen
stanza.meaning: Comforted and trusting, my heart—carried by you—

stanza.lyrics: singt stetig deinen Namenniemehr getrennt von dir
stanza.meaning: sings your name without ceasing, never again apart from you

stanza.lyrics: Amma… Amma… Amma… Amma…
stanza.meaning: —O Mother, Mother…

stanza.lyrics: Wie tausend kleine Sterneam Nachthimmel erstrahlen
stanza.meaning: Like a thousand little stars shining in the night sky,

stanza.lyrics: funkeln deine Augendie meinen Weg erhellen
stanza.meaning: your eyes sparkle and illuminate my path

stanza.lyrics: Amma… Amma… Amma… Amma…
stanza.meaning: —O Mother, Mother…

song.title: āyē haiṅ mayyā tērē dvār
song.source: Aye he mayya tere dvar 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Aye he mayya tere dvar 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: āyē haiṅ mayyā tērē dvār āj śērāvāli - māthā ṭhēknē aur caḍhānē tujhē lāl cunarī
stanza.meaning: We have come to your doorstep today, O Mother Sherawali, to bow our heads in reverence and offer you a red shawl.

stanza.lyrics: kartī hai sab kī abhilāṣā pūrījananī hai tū sārē jag kī
stanza.meaning: You fulfill the wishes of all who seek you, for you are the Mother and creator of the entire universe.

stanza.lyrics: kartī hai mā tū sab kō svīkārapnātī hai binā kōyi bhēd bhāv
stanza.meaning: O Mother, you accept everyone and make them your own without showing any discrimination.

stanza.lyrics: hō kē lācār mā… jō āyē tērē dvār - lauṭ jātē haiṅ vō pāke śānti apār
stanza.meaning: Those who come to your door in helplessness return filled with immense peace, for you turn no one away.

stanza.lyrics: jay mātā kī jaykārōṅ sē gūñjē - tērā divya darbār kā kaṇ kaṇ
stanza.meaning: Chants of “Victory to the Mother!” echo through every particle of your divine court.

stanza.lyrics: bhaktajan śraddhā aur prēm sē ātē haiṅ - karnē mayyā tujhē sādar naman
stanza.meaning: Devotees arrive with faith and love in their hearts, O Mother, to offer you their heartfelt reverence.

stanza.lyrics: jay mātā kī jay mātā kī jay mātā kī
stanza.meaning: Victory to Mother!

song.title: āyiram nāvuṇḍ-ennālum
song.source: Ayiram navund ennalum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: āyiram nāvuṇḍ-ennālum ārāl vāzhttiḍān āvum ī rūpam?nīrada-śyāmaḷa-rūpam ennamma nin kōmaḷa rūpam
stanza.meaning: Even if we spoke with a thousand tongues, how could we ever praise your glory enough? Who could truly describe the dark blue splendour of your form—the wondrous beauty of my Mother?

stanza.lyrics: taṅkattiṅkaḷ tikavil-aṇiññō amma nin ponmukhaśrī?tan kallōlam aḍiyaṙa vaccō nin kolusinnu kāyal?
stanza.meaning: Does the silvery full moon borrow the radiance of your face? Do the gentle waves echo the soft chime of your tinkling anklets?

stanza.lyrics: nin kaṇṇiṇa tan azhaku pakarnnō cāru-nīlōlpalaṅgaḷ?
stanza.meaning: Do the blue lotuses take on the beauty of your eyes, O Mother?

stanza.lyrics: nitya-saundaryamē nin kazhalkkīzhil viśvam ennum namippūammē viśvam ennum namippū…
stanza.meaning: Eternally beautiful one, the universe bows at your feet! Mother, the whole universe offers its reverence.

stanza.lyrics: cantam cintum naṙumulla nin divya-gandham kavarnnōmandam vīśum… kuḷir pavananum nin kara-sparśam ēṫṫō?
stanza.meaning: Do the fragrant jasmine flowers steal your divine scent? Does the softly moving breeze imitate the tenderness of your touch?

stanza.lyrics: anticcōppāy citaṙi vitaṙī nin kuṙikkuṅkumamō
stanza.meaning: Is it your sindoor that spreads across the sky as the purple hue of dusk?

stanza.lyrics: nitya-saundaryamē nin kazhalkkīzhil viśvam ennum namippūammē viśvam ennum namippū…
stanza.meaning: Eternally beautiful one, the universe bows at your feet! Mother, the whole universe offers its reverence.

stanza.lyrics: kārmukil nin rucira tanuvin śyāma-varṇam pakarnnōpāḍum kōkilam kaṭṭeḍuttō nin bhāva pīyūṣa gītam?
stanza.meaning: Do the rainclouds borrow their dark hue from the splendour of your form? Did the singing koel steal from you its ambrosial songs of love and longing?

stanza.lyrics: mōdam cērkkān pularoḷi ōrttō nin madhusmēra-pūram
stanza.meaning: Does the dawn wear your lovely smile to awaken joy in every heart?

stanza.lyrics: nitya-saundaryamē nin kazhalkkīzhil viśvam ennum namippūammē viśvam ennum namippū…
stanza.meaning: Eternally beautiful one, the universe bows at your feet! Mother, the whole universe offers its reverence.

stanza.lyrics: hṛdayēśvari bhuvana-sundarī…paramēśvari patita-pāvanī…
stanza.meaning: Mother Amriteswari, beauty of this world, supreme goddess, purifier of the fallen,

stanza.lyrics: śruti-bōdhini sujana-pālinī…mana-mōhini sukha-dāyini jaya jaya jaya tripura-sundari…
stanza.meaning: the one revealed through the Vedas, protector of the virtuous, enchantress of our hearts, bestower of bliss… Victory to Tripura Sundari, the highest form of the Great Goddess!

song.title: teyyō tinantō āzhakka mūzhakkam
song.source: Azhakka muzhakkam - teyyo tinanto 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Azhakka muzhakkam - teyyo tinanto 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: teyyō tinantō tinantinantō takateyyō tinantō tinantinantō…teyyō tinantō tinantinantō… takateyyattinantinam tintinam tō…
stanza.meaning: (joyful chorus)

stanza.lyrics: āzhakka mūzhakkam āḍiḍunnē – takauḷḷakam ellām kuḷirttiḍunnē
stanza.meaning: O Supreme Self, you have taken away the deep sorrows in my heart and illumined the truth within.

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷile nīṫṫal oḍukkiyiṭṭu – takauṇmayat-uḷḷil aruḷiyillē
stanza.meaning: My inner self is immersed in bliss, your grace has calmed the burning pain in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷam niṙaccuḷḷa puñciriyāl – takauḷḷu niṙaccamma tannatillē
stanza.meaning: Mother, your radiant, beautiful smile has overwhelmed my heart with joy.

stanza.lyrics: ānanda pālamṛt-ūṭṭiyillē – takaāzhipōl-anpatu nalkiyillē
stanza.meaning: You clasped me to your bosom and fed me the milk of ambrosial bliss. You immersed me in the ocean of your compassion.

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷilāy nanma vitaccatillē takauḷḷam ulakināy ēkiyillē
