stanza.meaning: You planted the seeds of goodness in me, you taught me to serve you without selfishness.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇunīr oppi mukarnnatillē – takakaṇṇinum kaṇṇatu nalkiyillē
stanza.meaning: You wiped my tears and kissed me, and opened my inner eye.

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷil iruḷu nī māṫṫiyillē – takauḷḷil poruḷāy udiccatillē
stanza.meaning: You removed the darkness of ignorance in me. You rose in my heart as the Supreme Self,

stanza.lyrics: iṅguyir-okkeyum ūṭṭiyillē – takaī ulakinnu nī pōṫṫiyillē
stanza.meaning: as the sun of self-realization. You create, sustain, and destroy this universe, and will be praised forever.

stanza.lyrics: vāzhvitu vāzhāte pōkayillēūzhiyil nin nāmamuḷḷa kālam
stanza.meaning: My life will reach its fulfilment before it ends, as long as your divine name is heard in this world.

stanza.lyrics: ammayāy acchanāy īśvaranāy takauḷḷil veḷiccamāy kāttiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: You live in me as both father and mother, as God, as the bright light within.

stanza.lyrics: ākāśa-vāyuvum-agniyumāy – takasiddhiyāy buddhiyāy sadgatiyāy
stanza.meaning: Mother is everything to her children: the five great elements, the mind, the great powers, the way and the goal.

stanza.lyrics: amma ī makkaḷkku sarvamallē – takaammayallāt-ini onnumillē
stanza.meaning: For her children, on earth and in heaven, there is no one else but Mother.

stanza.lyrics: iruḷil udikkunna tāramallēhṛdayattil eriyunna dīpamallē
stanza.meaning: When darkness covers our life, Mother becomes the bright star in the sky; she is the lamp shining within our heart.

stanza.lyrics: piriyillā jīvan poliyum vare aṙiyēṇam ammē en uḷḷam ennum
stanza.meaning: Mother, as long as I live, I will not leave you Mother, always know my heart and dwell within it.

song.title: azhavum aṙiyēn aṇugavum aṙiyēn
song.source: Azhavum ariyen 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: azhavum aṙiyēn aṇugavum aṙiyēnvaṇaṅgum muṙaiyum nān aṙiyēn
stanza.meaning: I do not know how to cry for you, nor how to draw near you.

stanza.lyrics: uṇarvē inḍri uṫṫru nōkkumennai pārppāy ponnammā
stanza.meaning: I do not even know the proper way to worship you. I simply gaze at you alone—will you look upon me, darling Mother?

stanza.lyrics: munvinai niṙainta bhāram sumantorubālannuṇḍu ennuḷḷil – piñcubālannuṇḍu ennuḷḷil
stanza.meaning: Carrying the heavy burden of past karma, a little child lives within me

stanza.lyrics: anbai pozhivāy piḷḷai kāppāytīvinai azhippāy ponnammā
stanza.meaning: —yes, a tender child dwells within. Shower this child with your love, protect it, and keep all evil away, darling Mother.

stanza.lyrics: kotikkum kaliyil tavitta ennaikaiyil eḍutta ponnammā – ennaikaiyil eḍutta ponnammā
stanza.meaning: From this scorching Kali Yuga, you lifted me up—O darling Mother,

stanza.lyrics: ippōtennai āḍavaittuāzham pārppatēn ennamā
stanza.meaning: you gathered me into your arms. Then why now do you test the strength of my mind by immersing me in your divine play?

stanza.lyrics: ulakai maṙantāl tannai maṙantālninaivu tirumbum enpāyē – iṙaininaivu tirumbum enpāyē
stanza.meaning: If one forgets the world, if one forgets oneself, it is said the mind will turn back to God.

stanza.lyrics: amaiti taruvāy teḷivum taruvāyvīḍu sērppāy en tāyē
stanza.meaning: Dear Mother, grant me peace, grant me clarity of mind, and take me to my true abode.

song.title: āzhiyil vīṇu pōyammē kadanamām
song.source: Azhiyil vinupoyamme 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: āzhiyil vīṇu pōyammē kadanamāmāzhiyil āṇḍu pōy ennē manamāzhiyil vīṇu pōyammē
stanza.meaning: Mother! My mind has fallen into the ocean of sorrow—it has sunk deep into its shadowy depths.

stanza.lyrics: rāgādi-vairikaḷ narttanam āḍīmāyā-mōham enne piḍi muṙukkī
stanza.meaning: Likes and dislikes, aversions and attachments—these inner enemies dance wildly in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: samsāra-mōham enne valicc-iṙukkī ammē valicc-iṙukkī
stanza.meaning: This world, steeped in delusion and allure, has bound me tightly in its chains.

stanza.lyrics: janmaṅgaḷ etrayō kozhiññu vīṇu dēvinin mṛdu mizhi ennil paticcīḍuvān
stanza.meaning: Countless lives I wandered, until I gained this precious birth.

stanza.lyrics: māyāndhakāram enne taḷarttiyallōgurupadam aṇayuvān vaikiyallō
stanza.meaning: And then, O Devi! Your tender glance fell upon me. Yet the darkness of ignorance left me weary I reached the Guru’s feet too late.

stanza.lyrics: antamillāt-ōḍi enn-antaraṅgamkāṇunnat-ellām ñān satyamāy ninaccu
stanza.meaning: My mind chased after all it saw, desiring everything, mistaking it for truth.

stanza.lyrics: eṅkilum amba tan vātsalya-dugdhamenikkāy ammē nī karuti veccu
stanza.meaning: Even so, Mother, you reserved for me the milk of your tenderness.

stanza.lyrics: amma tan pādaṅgaḷ nitya satyamanpināy ammē ñān koticciḍunnu
stanza.meaning: Your sacred feet are the eternal truth. I yearn for your boundless love.

stanza.lyrics: ā divya-rūpam en hṛttil niṙayuvānkāruṇyam ēkān kai tozhunnēn
stanza.meaning: With folded palms, I pray: May your divine form fill my heart, and may your grace descend upon me.

song.title: barsē badariyā
song.source: Barse badariya savan ki 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Barse badariya savan ki 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: barsē badariyā sāvan kīsāvan kī man bhāvan kī
stanza.meaning: The clouds of the monsoon are pouring, the rains of Sawan bring delight to the heart.

stanza.lyrics: sāvan meiṅ umaṅgyō mērō manvājhanak sunī hari āvan kī
stanza.meaning: In the month of Sawan my heart overflows with joy, for I hear the tinkling sound that tells of Hari’s coming.

stanza.lyrics: umaḍ ghumaḍ cāhuṅ dēs sē āyōdāminī dhamkē jhar lāvan kī
stanza.meaning: From all directions the clouds have gathered and rolled in, lightning flashing as showers descend.

stanza.lyrics: nanhē nanhē būndan mēghā barsēśītal pavan suhāvan kī
stanza.meaning: Tiny drops fall as the clouds rain down, and a cool, gentle breeze soothes the air.

stanza.lyrics: mīrā kē prabhu giridhar nāgarānand maṅgal gāvan kī
stanza.meaning: For Meera’s Lord, Giridhar Nagar, songs of joy and auspicious celebration are sung.

song.title: beloved amma, divine mother
song.source: Beloved Amma 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: beloved amma, divine mother sitting with you, there is no other
I write ‘ōm’ in the cloudsI bow down to the stars
and I kiss the moon.I pray to you, amma.
no more harm to nature’s lifethe world needs to survive
everywhere life needs our carenot to perish, be aware
our prayers and respectto all lives on earth
love longs to flowto set all things aglow
let us rise in unitypeacefully in harmony
let us rise in unitythe world is family

song.title: bhajē viśva-vandyam jaganmātṛ-rūpam
song.source: Bhaje visva vandyam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: bhajē viśva-vandyam jaganmātṛ-rūpambhajē vēda-vēdyam bhavāmbōdhi-pōtam
stanza.meaning: Mother! We worship you, the mother of this universe. You are the essence of the Vedas, the great ship that carries us across the ocean of Samsara.

stanza.lyrics: tamaghnōjvalam citprakāśam svarūpamanantāmṛtānanda-sandāna-rūpam
stanza.meaning: Meditation on your divine form destroys the darkness of ignorance in our heart, and the brilliant light of consciousness shines forth. Your divine form grants immortal bliss!

stanza.lyrics: anantāmṛtānanda-sandāna-rūpam
stanza.meaning: Your divine form grants immortal bliss!

stanza.lyrics: manasām nabhassin mazhakkōḷin-ettumtamassāṇḍa samsāra-kāḷāmbudaṅgaḷ
stanza.meaning: The sky of the mind is veiled by the dark, poisonous clouds of samsara.

stanza.lyrics: ahassāḷumārkkām śūbhāsōpamam ninkaḍakkaṇ-kaḍākṣam labhikkyān bhajikkām
stanza.meaning: I pray for a glance from your divine eyes—like the radiant sun rising in all its glory, reigning over the heavens to dispel the clouds.

stanza.lyrics: paḍaykkunn-anaṅgan madāndhāntaraṅgēperuttuḷḷa rāgādi-vairi-vrajatte
stanza.meaning: Defeat the enemies of attachment and aversion with your sword of knowledge.

stanza.lyrics: turattīḍu nī jñānamām vāḷ uyarttitimarttāḍu nin tērttaḍam hṛttaḍam mē
stanza.meaning: Dance in joy within my heart, the floor of your chariot.

stanza.lyrics: bhajē viśva-vandyam jaganmātṛ-rūpambhajē vēda-vēdyam bhavāmbōdhi-pōtam
stanza.meaning: Mother! We worship you, the mother of this universe. You are the essence of the Vedas, the great ship that carries us across the ocean of Samsara.

stanza.lyrics: tamaghnōjvalam citprakāśam svarūpamanantāmṛtānanda-sandāna-rūpam
stanza.meaning: Meditation on your divine form destroys the darkness of ignorance in our heart, and the brilliant light of consciousness shines forth. Your divine form grants immortal bliss!

stanza.lyrics: anantāmṛtānanda-sandāna-rūpam
stanza.meaning: Your divine form grants immortal bliss!

stanza.lyrics: ninakkāy orukkī sadā cittavāḍītiru sparśam ēlkkaññahō! tellu vāḍī
stanza.meaning: The garden of my mind is ever prepared, awaiting your arrival. Yet it gently wilted beneath the heat, longing for the touch of your divine feet.

stanza.lyrics: ninaykkāt-irikkē sudhā-varṣam ēkīkaniññ-āgamicc-āgamōdyāna kēkī
stanza.meaning: Then you blessed me with ambrosial rains and appeared compassionately—a magnificent peacock dancing in my heart, the garden of the Vedas.

stanza.lyrics: muzhaṅgum hṛdantattil nin mantram ennālcuruṅgum calatcitta-vṛttipravāham
stanza.meaning: When your mantra constantly resounds in my heart, thoughts subside, and the mind turns inward.

stanza.lyrics: oḍuṅgum bhavadbhāram ennum manassilviḷaṅgum śivē nin prasannāsya-bimbam
stanza.meaning: All the sorrows of the world are destroyed, O Shive, most auspicious one, and your radiant face shines within my heart.

stanza.lyrics: bhajē viśva-vandyam jaganmātṛ-rūpambhajē vēda-vēdyam bhavāmbōdhi-pōtam
stanza.meaning: Mother! We worship you, the mother of this universe. You are the essence of the Vedas, the great ship that carries us across the ocean of Samsara.

stanza.lyrics: tamaghnōjvalam citprakāśam svarūpamanantāmṛtānanda-sandāna-rūpam
stanza.meaning: Meditation on your divine form destroys the darkness of ignorance in our heart, and the brilliant light of consciousness shines forth. Your divine form grants immortal bliss!

stanza.lyrics: anantāmṛtānanda-sandāna-rūpam
stanza.meaning: Your divine form grants immortal bliss!

stanza.lyrics: smarikkāvu nin rūpa-nāmaṅgaḷ ennumjvalikkāvu hṛnnāḷam ennum ninakkāy
stanza.meaning: May I always remember your name and form. Let the flame of this life burn brightly for you alone.

stanza.lyrics: patikkāvu nin kālkkal en jīva-puṣpamjaniykkātini-saccidānandam uṇṇān
stanza.meaning: And in the end, may the flower of my heart fall in worship at your divine feet. May this jiva transcend the cycle of birth and death, and realize truth, consciousness and bliss.

stanza.lyrics: jagatsāla-vittē param sarvaśaktēsadā sadrasa-tēn nukarnnuḷḷa tṛptē
stanza.meaning: You are the seed of the tree of this universe, the embodiment of supreme cosmic energy.

stanza.lyrics: śiva-śakti yuktē viḷaṅgende cittēcidānanda-mādhūrya-sattē namastē
stanza.meaning: You are the union of Shiva and Shakti, ever content, sipping the nectar of the supreme absolute. You are the very essence of blissful consciousness, O Mother, dwell resplendent in my heart forever.

stanza.lyrics: bhajē viśva-vandyam jaganmātṛ-rūpambhajē vēda-vēdyam bhavāmbōdhi-pōtam
stanza.meaning: Mother! We worship you, the mother of this universe. You are the essence of the Vedas, the great ship that carries us across the ocean of Samsara.

stanza.lyrics: tamaghnōjvalam citprakāśam svarūpamanantāmṛtānanda-sandāna-rūpam
stanza.meaning: Meditation on your divine form destroys the darkness of ignorance in our heart, and the brilliant light of consciousness shines forth. Your divine form grants immortal bliss!

stanza.lyrics: anantāmṛtānanda-sandāna-rūpam
stanza.meaning: Your divine form grants immortal bliss!

song.title: bhavakānanāgniyil bhavabhītayāyi
song.source: Bhava kananagniyil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: bhavakānanāgniyil bhavabhītayāyi ñānbhavatāriṇī ninde padam aṇaññū
stanza.meaning: Afraid of the roaring fires in this wild forest of the world, I came to you, O Bhavatarini

stanza.lyrics: bhavarōga-timirattinn-amaram ñān tēḍiammē nin pariśuddha-padam aṇaññūend-ammē nin pariśuddha-padam aṇaññū
stanza.meaning: —you who ferry us across the ocean of samsara. Seeking the medicine to cure the blindness caused by worldly illusion, O Mother, I came to your divine feet! My Mother, I reached the refuge of your sacred feet.

stanza.lyrics: amṛtatvam aṇayunna vazhikāṭṭān ī pārilammē nī enyē ār-anyamāyī
stanza.meaning: In this world, who else is there but you to lead us on the path to immortality?

stanza.lyrics: kāṇunnill-avaniyil maṫṫill-abhayamāynin kazhalenyē dayāvāridhēnin kazhalenyē dayāvāridhē
stanza.meaning: I see no one else to take refuge in—nothing but your lotus feet. O ocean of compassion, only your lotus feet are my refuge.

stanza.lyrics: kadanam oru koḍuṅkāṫṫāy irambīḍunnūsadayam nī rakṣaykkāy vannīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: Sorrow comes roaring like a typhoon-please come and rescue me!

stanza.lyrics: azhalinde tīnāḷam ālunnu cuṫṫilumnin nāma-rūpāmṛtam auṣadhamnin nāma-rūpāmṛtam auṣadham
stanza.meaning: Flaming burdens close in from every side. The only healing is your immortal name and form.

stanza.lyrics: ambikē kāruṇya-vārirāśē sāntvanam ēkān aṇaññīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: O Mother Ambika, boundless sea of compassion, come and comfort this aching heart.

stanza.lyrics: ātmārpaṇattinde kāvya-sūnaṅgaḷālkōrttōru hāram aṇiyicciḍāmkōrttōru hāram aṇiyicciḍām
stanza.meaning: I shall weave for you a garland of verses, each flower blossoming from the surrender of my self. With that garland, O Mother, I shall adorn you.

song.title: bhavābdhi-tāriṇī
song.source: Bhavabdhi tarini 2025 Samskritam in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: bhavābdhi-tāriṇī bhavāni bhadrakāḷikēhimādri-nandinī mahēśi mahiṣa-mardinī
stanza.meaning: O Bhavani, Bhadrakali, who ferries us across the ocean of samsara, daughter of Himavan, supreme goddess, slayer of the demon Mahishasura.

stanza.lyrics: sudhābdhi-vāsinī surēśi-sundarāmbikējanārdanārcitē jaya trilōka-nāyikē
stanza.meaning: Dweller in the ocean of nectar, adored by all celestial beings, Mother Tripurasundari, sovereign of the three worlds, worshipped by Mahavishnu, victory to you!

stanza.lyrics: jay durgē jay kāḷi jay māta bhavāni
stanza.meaning: Mother Durga, Devi, Kali, Bhavani—victory to you!

stanza.lyrics: jay jay mā… jay jay mā… jay jay mā…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, victory to you!

stanza.lyrics: samasta-pālinī sarōja-lōcanē rame
stanza.meaning: You who protect and sustain all life, lotus-eyed Devi Lakshmi,

stanza.lyrics: manōjñā-bhāṣiṇi mahālayaṅkari śivē
stanza.meaning: speaker of noble and melodious words, with tender, wide eyes; Into whom the universe dissolves,

stanza.lyrics: niśēśa-śēkharē nirākṛtē nirāmayē
stanza.meaning: who is the absolute truth, who wears the crescent moon upon your brow, formless, sorrowless,

stanza.lyrics: mṛgēndra-vāhanē dinēśa-kōṭi-bhāsvarē
stanza.meaning: rider of the mighty lion, blazing with the brilliance of a hundred thousand suns…

stanza.lyrics: dinēśa-kōṭi-bhāsvarē
stanza.meaning: blazing with the brilliance of a hundred thousand suns…

stanza.lyrics: jay durgē jay kāḷi jay māta bhavāni
stanza.meaning: Mother Durga, Devi, Kali, Bhavani—victory to you!

stanza.lyrics: jay jay mā… jay jay mā… jay jay mā…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, victory to you!

stanza.lyrics: karātta-pustakē kavitva-śakti-dāyikē
stanza.meaning: Holder of the sacred book, granter of poetic skill,

stanza.lyrics: dayārdra-mānasē jaganmayē caturbhujē
stanza.meaning: compassionate one who pervades the universe, four-armed,

stanza.lyrics: manōvinōdinī viśāla-lōcanē śubhē
stanza.meaning: who delights our mind, with long lotus eyes, auspicious One

stanza.lyrics: bhayārtti-nāśini bhajē tavāṁghrim ambikē
stanza.meaning: who delights our mind, with long lotus eyes, destroyer of fear, O Mother Ambika,

stanza.lyrics: bhajē tavāṁghrim ambikē
stanza.meaning: we worship your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: jay durgē jay kāḷi jay māta bhavāni
stanza.meaning: Mother Durga, Devi, Kali, Bhavani—victory to you!

stanza.lyrics: jay jay mā… jay jay mā… jay jay mā…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, victory to you!

song.title: bhavābdhiyil muṅgum mānavan ennum
song.source: Bhavabdiyil mungum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: bhavābdhiyil muṅgum mānavan ennum onnē parihārambhaṅgyā-cēraṇam antaḥ-karaṇam ōrē mahatādhāram
stanza.meaning: The only salvation for one drowning in the ocean of Samsara is for the mind to take refuge in a realized soul.

stanza.lyrics: bhayāśakaḷ pōkkum bhakti uṇarttum bhāgya-vidhātārambhēṣāy cērkkum manamē nin vazhi mantram bhavatāram gurumantram bhavatāram
stanza.meaning: This refuge dispels all fear, awakens devotion, and brings fortune. Let the mind attune itself to the mantra, the mantra that ferries us across the ocean of samsara. This is the Guru Mantra.

stanza.lyrics: kaitavam ēṙum manamē ninavukaḷ aṙiyaṇam atunēramkaitava maṫṫavan uṫṫavan ākān vāram japavāram
stanza.meaning: O mind, weighed down by suffering and falsehood, remember to chant the mantra—so that the One, untouched by sorrow and deceit, may become your heart’s dearest.

stanza.lyrics: kāzhcaykk-oppam kāzhcapāḍin oḷitūkām nitarāmkālam kaḷayāt-ētum manamē vāram japavāramgurumantram bhavatāram
stanza.meaning: Let your vision be illumined, even as countless sights pass before you. Do not waste this precious time, Chant the mantra. Chant the Guru Mantra—the one that ferries us across the ocean of Samsara.

stanza.lyrics: yātoru guruvaruḷ nalamāy jīvita-taruvē pōṫṫunnuyātonnāl iyulakin kathayatu curuḷazhiv-ākunnu
stanza.meaning: The Guru, whose words are the fertile ground from which the plant of life grows—through whom this world is created and its story revealed.

stanza.lyrics: yātoru naukayil manavazhi tāṇḍīṭṭ-uṇmayil ettunnuyātonnē atu sadguru mantram āzhi kaḍattunnugurumantram bhavatāram
stanza.meaning: The boat that carries the mind toward eternal truth is the Satguru’s mantra. It is the Guru Mantra that ferries us across the ocean of Samsara.

song.title: bhāvanāgamya en amma ennākilum
song.source: Bhavanagamya 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: bhāvanāgamya en amma ennākilumbhāvanayil ñān āzhnn-iṙaṅgi
stanza.meaning: It is said that the Mother cannot be reached through imagination, yet I plunged deep into visualizations of her in my heart,

stanza.lyrics: śyāma-sundari tan bhāvaṅgaḷ endemānasa-śilayil kotti vaccu
stanza.meaning: sculpting her image and her many moods and emotions.

stanza.lyrics: śyāma-sundarī… ende śyāma-sundarī…
stanza.meaning: O my dark and beautiful Mother!

stanza.lyrics: kusṛtiyāl āḍunna kuṙunirakaḷ tazhuki talōḍi ñān otukki veccu
stanza.meaning: I gently arranged the dark curls that danced upon her brow,

stanza.lyrics: annēram amma tan mizhikaḷ raṇḍumen antaraṅgattilēkk-āzhnnu patiññu
stanza.meaning: and in that tender moment, her eyes gazed deep into my being.

stanza.lyrics: ammayōḍ-ī vidham bhāviccu bhāviccuennātma kathakaḷ ñān paṅku veccu
stanza.meaning: I imagined myself sharing the stories of my life with her,

stanza.lyrics: amma tan bhāvanayil antaraṅgamamma tan kēḷī-vihāramāyi
stanza.meaning: and as I pictured her in my heart, it became her sacred playground.

song.title: bhuvanaika-sundarā
song.source: Bhuvanaika Sundara 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: bhuvanaika-sundarā aṇayuvān vaikunnōmama pāṇipādaṅgaḷ taḷarnnīḍunnu
stanza.meaning: O Lord, the only beauty in the universe, why do you delay in coming to me? My hands and feet grow weary,

stanza.lyrics: śravaṇa-nayanaṅgaḷil kūriruḷ cūzhunnuvirahānalakkanal uḷḷil eriyunnu
stanza.meaning: darkness engulfs my eyes and ears, and my heart smoulders in the unbearable pain of separation from you.

stanza.lyrics: śōkārdra-rāgam orāyiram varumō nīhṛdaya-vēṇuvitil śruti mīṭṭiḍām
stanza.meaning: Will a thousand melodies of sorrow come to me? I shall play them upon the veena of my heart.

stanza.lyrics: panthāvenyē śatam cintāgōvṛndam vṛndāraṇyam enn-akamitil mēyciḍām
stanza.meaning: My thoughts, like a hundred herds of cows, will wander through my heart—now the forest of Vrindavan.

stanza.lyrics: satvaram en manōratham itil aṇayū nīhastam itu nīṭṭi nilkkunnu ñān
stanza.meaning: Come swiftly in the chariot of my heart. Like Rukmini, I stand with outstretched hand, waiting for you to lift me up.

stanza.lyrics: hṛttitin sandēśam ettiyillē ennemukti tan dhāmam aṇaccīḍillē
stanza.meaning: Has the message of my yearning heart not yet reached you? You who dwell in every heart, you who are ever tender toward your devotees—will you not carry me to your abode of liberation?

song.title: bōdhimaram
song.source: Bodhimaram 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: bōdhimaram nī ammā buddhanāga māṙuvōmjāti mata bhēdam inḍri samattuvam kuṙuvōm
stanza.meaning: You are the Bodhi tree, O Mother; through you we transform into Buddhas. With your grace there are no distinctions of caste or creed, and equality naturally arises.

stanza.lyrics: pāti īnta śivanuḍan pakkamuḷḷa pārvati
stanza.meaning: You are Parvati, ever by the side of Shiva, and the mother of both Murugan and Ganesha;

stanza.lyrics: bālamurukan aiṅkaranum un pārvaiyil aḍakkamē
stanza.meaning: all of them are contained within the radiance of your glance.

stanza.lyrics: ādinārāyaṇanuḍan aiśvarya-lakṣmi
stanza.meaning: Together with Adi Narayana and with Lakshmi who bestows prosperity,

stanza.lyrics: aṇḍa-carācaram ellām untan uḷḷil aḍakkamē
stanza.meaning: the entire universe is contained within you.

stanza.lyrics: ammā… aṇḍacarācaram ellāmuntan uḷḷil aḍakkamē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, the entire universe is contained within you.

stanza.lyrics: vēdi koṇḍa brahmanum vīṇai mīṭṭum vāṇiyum
stanza.meaning: Brahma who spoke the Vedas, Saraswati who plays the veena,

stanza.lyrics: vēdam kūṙum tatvamum untan vākkil aḍakkamē
stanza.meaning: and the truths declared by the Vedas themselves are all encompassed and contained within your words.

stanza.lyrics: anbumikka karaṅkaḷai karuṇai poṅkum kaṇkaḷaiammā un tiruvaḍiyai akhilam ellām vaṇaṅkumē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, the entire universe worships your hands that are filled with love, your eyes that overflow with compassion, and your holy feet.

stanza.lyrics: ammā… ammā un tiruvaḍiyaiakhilam ellām vaṇaṅkumē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, the entire universe worships your holy feet.

song.title: Ardiente es el llanto
song.source: Caliente es el llanto 2025 Spanish in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Caliente es el llanto 2025 Spanish in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: Ardiente es el llantodel alma que clama / por unas gotitasde amor infinito
stanza.meaning: The soul’s cry blazes with yearning for a few drops of infinite love.

stanza.lyrics: y es dulce presenciala madre divina /
stanza.meaning: The Divine Mother is a sweet presence

stanza.lyrics: misterio brillantesusurro de paz
stanza.meaning: —a shining mystery, a whisper of peace.

stanza.lyrics: llenas de gozollenas de amor, amma /amma… amma…amma… amma…
stanza.meaning: You fill me with joy, you fill me with love, Mother. You fill me with joy, you fill me with love.

stanza.lyrics: se quema la flamay perfuma el camino de aquel que te buscaen profundo silencio
stanza.meaning: The flame burns and perfumes the path of the one who seeks you in deep silence.

stanza.lyrics: y es dulce presenciala madre divina / misterio brillantesusurro de paz
stanza.meaning: The Divine Mother is a sweet presence—a shining mystery, a whisper of peace.

song.title: cāriḍāṙilla ñān ennaka vātil
song.source: Charidarilla nyan 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: cāriḍāṙilla ñān ennaka vātilāśayōḍ-ennum nin āgamattināy
stanza.meaning: I do not close the doors of my heart—each day, I wait in longing for your arrival.

stanza.lyrics: āmōdamōḍ-en manavīṇā-tantrikaḷānanda-rāgam utirkkukayāy vīṇḍumprēmāśru-gānam pozhikkukayāyi
stanza.meaning: The veena of my mind plays joyful melodies, overflowing with songs of love and yearning.

stanza.lyrics: ennile ñān enna bhāvam akannu pōyikāṇunnat-ennu ñān ā mātṛ-caitanyam
stanza.meaning: When will this ego dissolve? When will I behold the pure consciousness of the Mother within?

stanza.lyrics: ennuḷḷil ēṙi nī vannu teḷikkumōsarvacarācara-sīmayaṫṫā bōdham
stanza.meaning: Will you come and dwell in my heart, filling me with the awareness that sees no separation among beings?

stanza.lyrics: ānanda-nṛttam caviṭṭi nī en hṛttilaṙivinde advaita-prabha parattīḍumō
stanza.meaning: Will you dance in bliss within me, radiating the light of non-dual knowledge?

stanza.lyrics: sapta-varṇṇaṅgaḷe onnākki māṫṫunnaprēma-prapañcattil ātmabhāvam
stanza.meaning: You are the true Self of this universe of love, transforming the seven hues of the rainbow into the brilliance of pure white light.

stanza.lyrics: harita-varṇṇābhamām prakṛti tannuḷḷil ninn-uyarunn-itamma tan praṇava-dhvani
stanza.meaning: Mother’s Omkara echoes from within Nature decked in countless shades of green.

stanza.lyrics: ōrō aṇuvilum teḷiyunn-itamma tanparamārtha-tatvatin nityabhāvam
stanza.meaning: In every atom, your eternal essence shines forth revealing you as the Supreme Reality that pervades all.

song.title: cembaṭṭ-aṇiññorā
song.source: Chembattaninyora 2025 Mal in Mal.pptx

stanza.lyrics: cembaṭṭ-aṇiññorā sandhyābhrattilminni jvalicca nakṣatramē
stanza.meaning: Mother, you shine like a brilliant star in the evening sky, which has the colour of crimson silk.

stanza.lyrics: bhrāntikaḷ nīkki nin kāntiyil uttūṅga śānti-dhāmattil cērnnīḍaṭṭe…
stanza.meaning: Dispel my ignorance with the radiance of your beauty, and lift me into your abode of eternal peace.

stanza.lyrics: ammē dēvī… ammē dēvī…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, Devi…

stanza.lyrics: vēda-vēdāntaṅgaḷ pāḍi pukazhttunnaśāśvata-satya-svarūpiṇiyē
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are the embodiment of the eternal truth sung in the Vedas.

stanza.lyrics: māyē jaganmōhana-rūpiṇinīyē gati bhava-sāgarattil
stanza.meaning: You are the divine illusion, enchanting the universe with your unfathomable beauty. You alone are my path—only you can carry me across the vast ocean of birth and death.

stanza.lyrics: ammē dēvī… ammē dēvī…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, Devi…

stanza.lyrics: ammē nin āgamam kāṅkṣiccirikkavēniṙanilāvoḷi ettiyappōḷ
stanza.meaning: Mother, when this child of yours waited for you with longing, you appeared, resplendent, like the soft glow of moonlight.

stanza.lyrics: mizhiyākum tālattil niṙa-dīpam ēnti ñān aṇayunnu ammē nin sannidhiyil
stanza.meaning: In the ceremonial plate of my eyes, I have lit an oil lamp and come into your presence.

stanza.lyrics: ammē dēvī… ammē dēvī…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, Devi…

stanza.lyrics: prēma-prasūnamē nin prēma-gaṅgayilaliññiḍān uḷkarutt-ēkīḍumō?
stanza.meaning: You are the flower of love, will you grant me the courage to dissolve into the sacred Ganga of your love?

stanza.lyrics: oru mōham ennum ī jīvanil piḍayunnunin pāda-padmattil cērnnīḍuvān
stanza.meaning: There is but one desire in my life: my heart burns with deep anguish to merge into your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: ammē dēvī… ammē dēvī…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, Devi…

song.title: cēṙu puraṇḍorī jīvane
song.source: Cheru purandori 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: cēṙu puraṇḍorī jīvanecēlotta karaṅgaḷ nīṭṭi
stanza.meaning: Who stretched out her lovely arms to draw close this life, stained with countless impurities?

stanza.lyrics: cāratt-aṇaccat-ārōkṛpa tūki kaḍākṣiccat-ārō
stanza.meaning: Who looked upon me with eyes full of pure compassion?

stanza.lyrics: tēnmāriyāy tūveṇ-śalabhamāyitūveṇṇilāvāy tennalāyi
stanza.meaning: Whenever I thought of you, who came to me as fresh rain showers, as a pure white butterfly, as the silvery moonlight?

stanza.lyrics: ninaykkunna nēram en akamalarilniṙavāy uṇarvāy viḷaṅgunnat-ārō?
stanza.meaning: Who shines resplendent within me as a surge of fresh, new energy?

stanza.lyrics: ennilum ninnilum eṅgum niṙayunnanavyānubhūtiyām ende ammē
stanza.meaning: You are the one who appears as the very life-energy within me, and you are the one who pervades all of creation. Mother! You are the ever-new experience of bliss.

stanza.lyrics: nī allātonnilla enn-aṙiññīḍilummōhāndhatayil mayaṅgunnu ñān
stanza.meaning: Though I understand with my intellect that you alone exist as the non-dual reality, I remain caught in the darkness of illusion, unable to directly experience that oneness.

stanza.lyrics: mōhāndhatayil mayaṅgunnu ñān
stanza.meaning: I remain caught in the darkness of illusion, unable to directly experience that oneness.

stanza.lyrics: niṙabhakti ēki nirmalam ākki enmanatārilāy vasiccīḍuk-ammē
stanza.meaning: Fill me with devotion. Make me pure and reside in the lotus of my heart, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: ā bhakti-dhārayil muṅgi en jīvan ā padatāriṇa pūkiḍaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: Let me be immersed in the currents of your devotion and carried to your sacred lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: ā padatāriṇa pūkiḍaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: Let me carried to your sacred lotus feet.

song.title: chētuletti mrokkutunnā
song.source: Chetuletti mrokkutunna 2025 Tel in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: cētuletti mrokkutunnā karuṇāmayi śarvāṇīnī padamula viḍuvanammā śrī mātā jagajjanani
stanza.meaning: With folded hands, I bow to You, O compassionate Goddess Parvati. I shall never leave Your feet, O Śrī Mātā, Mother of the Universe.

stanza.lyrics: hṛdaya mandirāna ninu darśimpa kōrutunnāantaraṅga kavāṭamū terucukonuṭa lēdamma
stanza.meaning: In the temple of my heart, I long to behold You, but the inner door will not open, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: viṣayādula murikicēri bigisina cittappu bīgamuśuddha parici teracu teruvu, nī kṛpakē sādhyam ammā
stanza.meaning: My mind, stained and swollen with worldly desires, is unable to unlock that sacred gate. Only Your grace can cleanse and open it, O compassionate one.

stanza.lyrics: sadbhāvana kusumālanu nī pūjaku kōyabōtēvyatirēka śaktūlanē kanṭakālu guccēnammā
stanza.meaning: I tried to pluck the flowers of goodness to offer in your worship, O Mother, but the dark shades of ego pricked me like thorns.

stanza.lyrics: āturapaḍi naḍuvabōtē trōva tappi cīkaṭilōmāyaterala musugulōna bandinai pōtinammā
stanza.meaning: When I walked forward in anxious haste, I stumble and fell in the darkness, bound by the illusions of this world.

stanza.lyrics: ajñānapu penu cīkaṭi samsārapu kāraḍaviariṣaḍvargapu mṛgamula ākasmika penudāḍi
stanza.meaning: In the pitch darkness of ignorance, as I wander through the dense forest of worldly life, I am ambushed by the six wild beasts—the inner enemies.

stanza.lyrics: viṣayādula eḍārilō santōṣapu eṇḍamāvi - kāla-bhramaṇa paridhilōna janimṛta valayāvṛti
stanza.meaning: Lost in the desert of desires, where true happiness always shimmers like a distance mirage, I find myself trapped within the vicious cycle of birth and death, bound by the illusion of time.

stanza.lyrics: dāṭalēka vēḍutunnā nī caraṇame śaraṇamanidāricūpi dariki cērcu dayāmayī viśvajanani
stanza.meaning: Unable to find a way out, I seek refuge in Your feet, O compassionate Mother, embodiment of compassion! By your grace, show me the right path and lead me to liberation.

song.title: cinmaya-rūpiṇi kanmaṣa-nāśini
song.source: Chinmaya rupini 2025 Sanskrit in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: cinmaya-rūpiṇi kanmaṣa-nāśinitava padayugaḷam vandē
stanza.meaning: Embodiment of Supreme Consciousness, destroyer of all sorrow, I humbly prostrate at your lotus feet!

stanza.lyrics: mānasa-vāsini mōhanivāriṇisarasija-lōcanē vandē
stanza.meaning: You dwell within our hearts, removing all desire — with your long, wide, and lovely eyes, like lotus petals in full bloom.

stanza.lyrics: śubha-sandāyini svara-mandākiniabhayam dēhi dēvi
stanza.meaning: O Giver of all auspiciousness, sacred Ganga of music, O Devi, grant me refuge at your feet!

stanza.lyrics: abhayam dēhi dēvi
stanza.meaning: O Devi, grant me refuge at your feet!

stanza.lyrics: himagiri-nandini sakala-nirañjanibhuvana-vimōhini mātē
stanza.meaning: Daughter of Himavan, who delights his heart and enchants the entire universe

stanza.lyrics: bhuvana-vimōhini mātē
stanza.meaning: who delights his heart and enchants the entire universe

stanza.lyrics: budhajana-pūjitē madabhaya-varjitēśivadē varadē mātē
stanza.meaning: — worshipped by the virtuous, destroyer of fear and jealousy, bestower of the supreme state — O Mother Ambika, Creator of this universe, I bow to you!

stanza.lyrics: śivadē varadē mātē
stanza.meaning: bestower of the supreme state — O Mother Ambika, Creator of this universe, I bow to you!

stanza.lyrics: ambikē jagadambikē…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, Mother of the World…

song.title: dari nīvu dāri nīvu
song.source: Dari nivu 2025 Telugu in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: dari nīvu dāri nīvu dāri lōni tōḍu nīvū
stanza.meaning: You are the goal, you are the path, you are my only companion on the journey.

stanza.lyrics: dāri cūpē dyuti nīvu mati nīvuammā… ammā…
stanza.meaning: You are the light and wisdom that reveals the way, O Mother!

stanza.lyrics: dari nīvu dāri nīvu dāri lōni tōḍu nīvū
stanza.meaning: You are the goal, you are the path, you are my only companion on the journey.

stanza.lyrics: dārikiruvaipu manōhara dṛśyāluāhlādaparicē sundara vanālu
stanza.meaning: On both sides of the path lie enchanting scenes-delightful gardens that bring joy.

stanza.lyrics: māyalō munigī nilicina vēḷalōdyuti nīvu mati nīvu dhṛti nīvu ammā
stanza.meaning: When I falter in my journey, ensnared by this illusion (maya), you are the light, you are the wisdom, you are the strength and courage, O Mother!

stanza.lyrics: gati evaru mari nā śaraṇāgati nīvu ammā
stanza.meaning: Who else is my guide but you? You are my refuge at all times, O Mother!

stanza.lyrics: ettaina koṇḍalu lōtaina lōyalubhīkara mṛgālunna ciṭṭaḍavulennō
stanza.meaning: The journey is filled with towering mountains and deep valleys, with terrifying wild beasts lurking in dense forests.

stanza.lyrics: gāḍhāndhakāramulō naḍicē vēḷalōdyuti nīvu mati nīvu dhṛti nīvu ammā
stanza.meaning: When I walk through profound darkness, you are the light, you are the wisdom, you are the strength, O Mother!

stanza.lyrics: gati evaru mari nā śaraṇāgati nīvu ammā
stanza.meaning: Who else is my guide but you? You are my refuge at all times, O Mother!

stanza.lyrics: velugu nīḍala āṭala naḍumaāpada lennainā aḍḍu lennainā
stanza.meaning: Through the play of light and shadow, through every obstacle and challenge

stanza.lyrics: dārilō nilavaka munduku naḍipēdyuti nīvu mati nīvu dhṛti nīvu ammā
stanza.meaning: —who else leads me forward without stopping? You are the light, you are the wisdom, you are the courage, O Mother!

stanza.lyrics: gati evaru mari nā śaraṇāgati nīvu ammā
stanza.meaning: Who else is my guide but you? You are my refuge at all times, O Mother!

song.title: dēkhā thā pēhlī bār
song.source: Dekha tha pehali bar 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Dekha tha pehali bar 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: dēkhā thā pēhlī bār usē mainē dēkhā thā pēhlī bār
stanza.meaning: I saw him for the first time, I had seen him for the very first time

stanza.lyrics: vō jamunā kī rāh mēiṅ
stanza.meaning: there, on the path by the Yamuna.

stanza.lyrics: bāl ghūṅgar vālē thēik muralī thī un hāthōṅ mēiṅ
stanza.meaning: His hair curled in ringlets, a flute held gently in his hands,

stanza.lyrics: mōr paṅkh baiṭhī sir pē aur ghuṅguṙū thī pāōṅ pē
stanza.meaning: a peacock feather rested on his head, and anklets adorned his feet.

stanza.lyrics: dēkhā thā pēhlī bār usē mainē dēkhā thā pēhlī bār
stanza.meaning: I saw him for the first time, I had seen him for the very first time

stanza.lyrics: aur āṅkhēṅ milī… hāyē/aur āṅkhēṅ milī un āṅkhōṅ sēdil khō baiṭhī usī pal mēiṅ/us matvālī muskān mēiṅ
stanza.meaning: And then our eyes met… oh! My eyes met his—in that very moment, I lost my heart to that intoxicating smile.

stanza.lyrics: dil kī bāt khul gayī akhiyōṅ mēiṅ - kis ghūnghaṭ mē chipāūṅ is dil ko maiṅ
stanza.meaning: The secret of my heart unfolded in my eyes. How can I hide this heart in any veil?

stanza.lyrics: mērī kālī āṅkhēṅ ban gayīṅ hai nīlē usē dēkh dēkh kē
stanza.meaning: My dark eyes have turned blue—from gazing at him, again and again.

stanza.lyrics: ab kahāṅ sē ā rahī hai yē bāṅsurī kī dhunyē pāyal kī jhan jhan/
stanza.meaning: Now, where is this tune of the flute coming from? This tinkling of anklets—

stanza.lyrics: mērē dil kī dhaḍkan hai uskī pāyal kī jhan jhanhar āh mērī hai uskī bāṅsurī kī dhun
stanza.meaning: my heartbeat is the sound of his anklets, every breath of mine echoes the melody of his flute.

stanza.lyrics: ab lāj chōḍ kē gā mērē man – harī madhur nām kī dhun
stanza.meaning: Now, casting aside all shame, sing, O my heart, the melody of the sweet name of Hari.

stanza.lyrics: mēra dil pukāṙē harī harī… harī harīmērī āh sunātī harī harī… harī harī
stanza.meaning: My heart calls out, "Hari Hari..." My breaths echo, "Hari Hari..."

stanza.lyrics: harī harī harī harī

song.title: dhim dhimi takadhimi
song.source: Dhimi dhimi takadhimi 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: dhim dhimi takadhimi dhim dhimi takadhimikāḷikē śrī bhadrakāḷikē
stanza.meaning: (Blissful dance beats) O Kalika! Most auspicious and powerful Kali,

stanza.lyrics: dhim dhimi takadhimi dhim dhimi takadhimikaitozhunnēn bhadrakāḷikē
stanza.meaning: (Blissful dance beats) I fold my palms in reverence to the dark and gracious Sri Bhadrakali.

stanza.lyrics: tāraka-pūkkaḷāl śōbhikkum kārkkuntalvīṇaṅg-azhiññ-aṅg-ulaññiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: Your long, heavy locks of black hair, gleaming with stars, flow wildly, dancing and swaying on their own.

stanza.lyrics: duṣṭarkku kāḷasarppaṅgaḷāy tōnnikkumbhadrē nin kārkkuntal kaitozhunnēn
stanza.meaning: To the cruel, they appear as black serpents of destruction. Bhadre! O gentle and graceful one, I fold my palms in adoration to your dark tresses.

stanza.lyrics: dhim dhimi takadhimi dhim dhimi takadhiminaḍanam āḍū bhadrakāḷikē
stanza.meaning: Dance, O Bhadrakali!

stanza.lyrics: dhim dhimi takadhimi dhim dhimi takadhimikaitozhum aḍiyanē kāttīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: Protect those who stand with folded palms and pray to you.

stanza.lyrics: śatru-samhārattin-ādhāramāy mēvumtṛkkaṇṇu śōbhippū nin lalāḍē
stanza.meaning: On your brow shines the third eye that destroys your enemies.

stanza.lyrics: makkaḷil teṫṫu kāṇumbōḷ vaḷayunnapurikakkoḍikaḷum kaitozhunnēn
stanza.meaning: I join my palms in adoration to your beautiful, curved eyebrows—those that arch in warning when you see a fault in your children.

stanza.lyrics: mūvulakattinum pakalum nilāvumāysūrya-candranmārām mizhiyiṇakaḷ
stanza.meaning: Your eyes are the brilliant sun and the radiant moon, bestowing day and night upon the three worlds.

stanza.lyrics: teṫṫēṫṫu paṙayunna makkaḷil kāruṇyamcoriyumā mizhikaḷum kaitozhunnēn
stanza.meaning: I fold my palms in adoration to Your gentle gaze, which showers compassion upon Your children as they confess their wrongdoing.

stanza.lyrics: dhim dhimi takadhimi dhim dhimi takadhiminaḍanam āḍū kālabhairavī
stanza.meaning: Dance, O terrifying Kala Bhairavi, guardian of time and destroyer of all negativities.

stanza.lyrics: dhim dhimi takadhimi dhim dhimi takadhimikaitozhunnēn tripurasundarī
stanza.meaning: I fold my palms in adoration of Tripurasundari, the Supreme Goddess, the embodiment of beauty.

stanza.lyrics: añcukall-okkum nin mūkkile mūkkuttipañca-bhūtaṅgaḷāy śōbhikkunnu
stanza.meaning: The five jewels that adorn your nose shine as the five great elements from which the universe emerges.

stanza.lyrics: pañca-bhūtaṅgaḷkkum dhātriyāy mēvunnabhadrē nin nāsika kaitozhunnēn
stanza.meaning: You reign as the protective Mother from whom the five elements, arise. O auspicious One, I fold my palms in adoration to your nose, small and delicate like a flower bud.

stanza.lyrics: mūvulakattinum ādhāramām bhadrēmukkaṇṇan nin pāda-dāsanāyī
stanza.meaning: Shiva, the three-eyed Lord and the substratum of the three worlds, serves at Your feet!

stanza.lyrics: paḷḷivāḷ ēnti nī nṛttam caviṭṭumbōḷñān ennabhāvam ariññiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: As You dance, sword of sovereignty in hand, You cut away the ego within us.

stanza.lyrics: dhim dhimi takadhimi dhim dhimi takadhimita takiḍa dhi takiḍa tittōm
stanza.meaning: (Blissful dancing to the accompaniment of drum beats)

stanza.lyrics: dhim dhimi takadhimi dhim dhimi takadhimitaka takiḍa taka takiḍa tittōm
stanza.meaning: (Blissful dancing to the accompaniment of drum beats)

stanza.lyrics: dhim dhimi takadhimi dhim dhimi takadhimita takiḍa dhi takiḍa tittōmdhim dhimi takadhimi dhim dhimi takadhimitaka takiḍa taka takiḍa tittōm
stanza.meaning: (Blissful dancing to the accompaniment of drum beats)

song.source: Did you hear my call 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx

I have searched for youeverywhere
waxing and waning the moon knows my plight
weeks turn to months you are nowhere in sight
giridhāri… vanamāli…
the blue of the moon makes my eyes fill with tears
I've cried for your darshan for so many years
giridhāri… vanamāli…

song.title: dinkar candā bhū jaladhi nadiyā
song.source: Dinkar chanda bhu jaldi 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Dinkar chanda bhu jaldi 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: dinkar candā bhū jaladhi nadiyāsunō sab inkī vāṇī
stanza.meaning: All of you please listen to what The sun, the moon, the earth, the ocean, and the rivers have to say.

stanza.lyrics: prēm aman se jiyē jag meiṅhar mānav har prāṇī
stanza.meaning: Let every human being and creature live in this world with Love and peace.

stanza.lyrics: nisvārth prēm sē hamman vacan nirmal karēṅ
stanza.meaning: With Selfless Love let us purify our mind and speech.

stanza.lyrics: mānav meiṅ mādhav kō dēkh karā ō ham niṣkām sēvā karēṅ
stanza.meaning: Seeing the divine presence of Madhava (God) in every human being, let us engage in service without any desire for personal gain — dedicating our work for the welfare of all.

stanza.lyrics: sṛṣṭi kā na karēṅ śōṣaṇbhū mā kō pūjēṅ har dam
stanza.meaning: We should not exploit creation. Instead, we must always worship and care for Mother Earth.

stanza.lyrics: mukt karō is jag kōyuddh rōg pīḍā sē bhagavan
stanza.meaning: O Lord, free this world from war, disease, and suffering so that peace and well-being may flourish everywhere.

stanza.lyrics: vasudhaiva kuṭumbakam vicārjīvan meiṅ sākār karēṅ ham
stanza.meaning: “The World is One Family” – let us make this concept a reality in our life.

stanza.lyrics: bhinnatā bhūl kē śraddhā sē gāyēṛṣiyōṅ kā yē mantr milkē ham
stanza.meaning: Forgetting our divisions and differences, let us sing this mantra of the sages together, with deep faith and unity in our hearts.

stanza.lyrics: ōm lōkāḥ samastāḥ sukhinō bhavantu
stanza.meaning: May all beings in all the worlds be happy and be at peace.

song.title: Divine Painter
song.source: Divine Painter 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: Divine Painter please paint within me Lessons of wisdom, pearls of the sea
Oh Devi your beauty shines bright and strongYou show us through nature how to be One
I feel in my soul soaring freethe bird that you painted within me
The bird glides beyond thoughts and clouds of the mind
Attachment and sorrow fall far behind
A lake lies motionlessly,a lake that you painted within me.
May I dissolve in this deep still lake
Reflecting the perfect beauty of your face.
Divine Painter please paint within me Lessons of wisdom, pearls of the sea
Oh Devi your beauty shines bright and strong. You show us through nature how to be One.
Isha vasya idam sarvamPainter brush and canvas are one

song.title: durgē duḥkha-nivāriṇi bhavatāriṇī amṛtēśvarī
song.source: Durge Duhkha nivarini 2025 Mal in English.pptx

stanza.lyrics: durgē duḥkha-nivāriṇi bhavatāriṇī amṛtēśvarīā tṛkkaraṅgaḷil etti nityamām ātma-nirvṛti kaivarān
stanza.meaning: O Durga, dispeller of sorrow, you who ferry us across the ocean of samsara, goddess of immortal bliss—let me reach your divine arms and revel in the Self.

stanza.lyrics: śuddha-bhakti vivēka buddhikaḷ nalki nī kaniyēṇamēātma-bōdhattin paḍavukaḷ kēṙi ninnil vilayiccīḍuvān
stanza.meaning: Be compassionate; grant me pure devotion and a discerning intellect, that I may ascend the steps to the summit of Self-realization.

stanza.lyrics: triśūla-pāṇini en hṛdantam ninnil āṇu nirantaramśāradē tava prābhavam trimūrttikaḷkkkum appuṙam
stanza.meaning: O Trident-bearing One, my heart is ever immersed in you. O Śāradā, your splendour surpasses even the glory of the three great Gods.

stanza.lyrics: vāzhttiyillē strōtra-mālakaḷ tīrttu śaṅkaran ambikēkāttiḍēṇam īśvarī ī kuññine bhuvanēśvarī
stanza.meaning: Ādi Śaṅkara sang your praises in countless hymns—protect this child, O Mother Ambikā, Goddess of the universe.

stanza.lyrics: taḷḷiḍallē māya tann-atighōramām vipinattil nīende kai piḍicc-ennum tāvaka cārē cērttu piḍiykkaṇē
stanza.meaning: Do not cast me into the dark jungle of illusion. Hold my hand, hold me close to you and never let me go.

stanza.lyrics: citta-vṛttikaḷ pāññiḍunn-atibhrāntamāy cennāya pōl abhayam nin tiru pāda-yugaḷam avaniyil paramēśvarī
stanza.meaning: Thoughts hound me like mad wolves; O Supreme Goddess, your divine feet are my only refuge in this world.

stanza.lyrics: ninne mātram mati enikkī pāril āśrayam ēkuvānnirāśrayam ī janmam ammē nī veḍiññāl niṣphalam
stanza.meaning: You alone are all I need; you alone can grant me refuge in this world. If you abandon me, my life will be futile, with no one left to grant me shelter.

stanza.lyrics: abhayam ammē kuññu-laḷitaykk-abhayam prēma-svarūpiṇīsvīkarichiḍu ennē bhagavatī kāḷikē karuṇāmayī
stanza.meaning: Give refuge to little Lalitha, O Essence of Love—accept me, O Goddess Kali, most compassionate of all.

song.title: dvāpara-yugattinde
song.source: Dvapara yugattinde 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: dvāpara-yugattinde ātmāvil ninnorunūpura-nādam uṇarnnuvallō
stanza.meaning: From the soul of the Dwapara Yuga arose the rhythmic tinkling of anklets,

stanza.lyrics: karṇa-pīyūṣamām ā nāda-lahariyōrādha tan kālcilamboli āyirunnu
stanza.meaning: The enchanting sound, sweet as nectar to the ears, came from the anklets adorning Radha’s feet.

stanza.lyrics: rādha tan kālcilamboli āyirunnu
stanza.meaning: The enchanting sound, sweet as nectar to the ears, came from the anklets adorning Radha’s feet.

stanza.lyrics: dvāpara-yugattinde ātmāvil ninnorunūpura-nādam uṇarnnuvallō

stanza.lyrics: viraha-tāpattil urukum en mānasatantriyil utirunnu kṛṣṇa-nāmam
stanza.meaning: Krishna, your name rises from the strings of my mind, burning in the anguish of separation.

stanza.lyrics: madhuram alleṅkilum aviḍunnen gītatteazhalin naivēdyamāy kai-koḷḷumō?
stanza.meaning: Though my song lacks sweetness, will you accept it as an offering of sorrow?

stanza.lyrics: dvāpara-yugattinde ātmāvil ninnorunūpura-nādam uṇarnnuvallō
stanza.meaning: From the soul of the Dwapara Yuga arose the rhythmic tinkling of anklets,

stanza.lyrics: manatāril oru ceṙu maṇi-dīpam ēntimarataka-śyāma ñān kāttirippū
stanza.meaning: O one with the dark radiance of an emerald, I wait for you, with a small lamp glowing in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: oru nōkku kāṇuvān mizhikaḷkku munnil nīoru divya-kāntiyāy varumō kṛṣṇā?
stanza.meaning: Will I behold you, Krishna, will you appear before my eyes in your resplendent divinity?

stanza.lyrics: dvāpara-yugattinde ātmāvil ninnorunūpura-nādam uṇarnnuvallō
stanza.meaning: From the soul of the Dwapara Yuga arose the rhythmic tinkling of anklets,

song.title: eda lōtula
song.source: Eda lotula 2025 Tel in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: eda lōtula koluvu tīra īśaputra! kadalī rāvāpraṇavanāda sudhalu ponga vakratuṇḍa kanarāvā
stanza.meaning: O Ganesha, Son of Lord Shiva, please enter the depths of my heart and make it your palace. O Lord with the curved trunk, as you appear before me, the nectar of the sound ‘Om’ overflows.

stanza.lyrics: toli pūjalu andukoni ādipūjya gaṇēśā - vighnamula parihariñcu kāryasiddhi dāyakā
stanza.meaning: O Lord Ganesha, receiver of the first worship! You remove all obstacles and grant success.

stanza.lyrics: mōdakālū svīkariñci mōdamosagu vighnēśābuddhi-siddhulonagūrci mukti nosagu bhakta-varada
stanza.meaning: O Lord Vighnesha, you accept our offerings of modakas and bless us with happiness. O bestower of boons, you grant wisdom and knowledge, and lead us to liberation.

stanza.lyrics: svāmi! viśvāntarātmā praṇava-svarūpāvidyā jñānādhinātha gauri putra gajānanā
stanza.meaning: O Lord with the elephant face, son of Gauri! You are the soul of the universe, the embodiment of the primordial sound ‘Om,’ and the source of knowledge and wisdom.

stanza.lyrics: pādāśrita ahaṅkāra mūṣika-vāhana dēvāsakalēndriya cōdakā śakti dvāra samrakṣakā
stanza.meaning: O Lord, the ego that surrenders at your lotus feet becomes the mouse on which you ride. You are the master of the senses and the guardian of the gateways of Shakti.

stanza.lyrics: mūlādhāra cakravarti mūla gaṇapatipraṇati praṇati praṇati praṇati śaraṇu vēḍiti
stanza.meaning: O Moola Ganapati, ruler of the Muladhara, I bow to you and seek refuge at your feet.

stanza.meaning: My baby Krishna is as radiant as the full moon in the sky, as dazzling as the colors of the rainbow. The young cowherd boy ties on his yellow raiment, ready to lead the cows into the forest.

song.title: en hṛdayavīṇa mīṭṭāttat-entu nī
song.source: En hridaya vina mittattatentu ni 2025 - English.pptx

stanza.lyrics: en hṛdayavīṇa mīṭṭāttat-entu nī - cintakaḷil śruti cērkkāttat-entu nī
stanza.meaning: O Mother, why do you not play upon the veena of my heart? Why do you not tune the strings of my thoughts?

stanza.lyrics: tantrikaḷ ellām turumbiccatinālōvīṇayitinnoru maṇvīṇayatinālō
stanza.meaning: Is it that the chords have rusted with time? Or is it because I’m like a veena made of clay?

stanza.lyrics: ammē hṛdayāmbikē… ennil kṛpa tūkaṇē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, who dwells within the heart… please shower your grace upon me

stanza.lyrics: en manōvēdiyil āḍāttatentu nī - mōhana-nṛttam ceytīḍātat-entu nī
stanza.meaning: Why do you not dance upon the stage of my mind, O Mother? Why withhold your wondrous, blissful dance?

stanza.lyrics: vēdika svayamāḍi ulayunnatinālōoru tari iḍamatil illāttatinālō
stanza.meaning: Is it because the stage is shaky and unsteady—or is there simply no room left for you within it?

stanza.lyrics: ammē hṛdayāmbikē… ennil kṛpa tūkaṇē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, who dwells within the heart… please shower your grace upon me

stanza.lyrics: en jīvasyandanam teḷikkāttatentu nīsārathiyāyi tuṇaykkāttatentu nī
stanza.meaning: Why do you not guide the chariot of my life, O Mother? Why do you not offer me support as the charioteer?

stanza.lyrics: indriyāśvaṅgal patham teṫṫiyatinālōmanassām kaḍiññān nin kaiviṭṭatinālō
stanza.meaning: Is it because the horses of my senses have strayed down errant paths? Or because the reins of my mind slipped away from your hands?

stanza.lyrics: ammē hṛdayāmbikē… ennil kṛpa tūkaṇē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, who dwells within the heart… please shower your grace upon me

song.title: en manass-amma tan pūvāḍi ākki
song.source: En manasammatan 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: en manass-amma tan pūvāḍi ākkiennammē atilēkk-ezhunnaḷḷaṇē
stanza.meaning: Mother! Make my mind a garden of flowers, and dwell within it as your sacred abode.

stanza.lyrics: amma tan puñciri-pūnilāvil kuḷicc-encitta-mālinyam nīṅgiḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: Let the impurities of my thoughts dissolve, bathed in the moonlight of your radiant smile.

stanza.lyrics: ajñānam ākunna māyayil peṭṭu ñānkaṇṇunīr-āzhiyil muṅgi ammē
stanza.meaning: Mother, I am lost in ignorance, ensnared by your divine illusion, drowning in a sea of sorrow and tears.

stanza.lyrics: ammayām sūryan udicc-uyarnnilleṅkilī janmam ammē vṛthāvil ākum
stanza.meaning: If you, the divine sun, do not rise within my heart, this life will have been lived in vain.

stanza.lyrics: satya-svarūpīṇi sūrya-tējasviniammē en hṛttil viḷaṅgēṇamē
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are the embodiment of truth, the brilliance of the sun.

stanza.lyrics: kāruṇya-tīrttham pozhicc-en hṛdayattiljñāna-prakāśam teḷikkēṇamē
stanza.meaning: Come, illumine the depths of my heart; let the holy waters of compassion flow within and awaken the radiant light of true knowledge.

stanza.lyrics: tāvaka nāmamām tōṇi tuzhaññu ñānsamsāra-sāgarē nīṅgiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: Mother, I row the boat of your sacred name across the ocean of samsara.

stanza.lyrics: kāṫṫilum kōḷilum peṭṭ-uzhannīḍāteśrīpāda-padmattil cēṛttīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, do not let me be swept away by tempests and fierce winds. Guide me safely to the haven of your lotus feet.

song.title: eṅgine ñān aṙiyum
song.source: Engine nyan ariyum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: eṅgine ñān aṙiyum ennammayeeṅgine ñān aṙiyum
stanza.meaning: How will I know Mother, how will I know my Mother?

stanza.lyrics: ini etra dūram tāṇḍaṇam ñān ennammayil cērnnīḍānennammayil cērnnīḍān
stanza.meaning: How much further must I go before I reach Her?

stanza.lyrics: palavidha cintā vāsana tankoḍumkāṫṫil en manam uzhaṙunnu
stanza.meaning: My mind is tossed in the wild storm of countless thoughts and desires.

stanza.lyrics: kaiviḍāt-ivane kākkēṇamētava hṛdayattil cērttīḍaṇē tava hṛdayattil cērttīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, please do not let go—watch over me and draw me close to your heart.

stanza.lyrics: ēka lakṣyam end-amme mātrammaṫṫoru lakṣyavum ill-enikku
stanza.meaning: You alone are my one true goal, O Mother—I have no other aim.

stanza.lyrics: ennamma tan śrīcaraṇattilcērkkaṇē ammē śrī laḷitēcērkkaṇē ammē śrī laḷitē
stanza.meaning: Keep me at your sacred feet forever, O Mother Lalita.

song.title: enta citramu enta vairudhyamu
song.source: Enta Chitramu enta vairudhyamu 2025 Telugu in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Enta Chitramu enta vairudhyamu 2025 Telugu in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: enta citramu enta vairudhyamunī tatvamu mahādēvā
stanza.meaning: O Mahadeva, Lord of lords-what a wonder! How beautifully the opposites are woven into your being.

stanza.lyrics: enta vicitramu enta vaividhyamunī rūpamu kāmēśā
stanza.meaning: O Kamesha, Conqueror of all desires), what a wonder! How distinctly the many facets shine through your form.

stanza.lyrics: hara ōm… śiva ōm… hara ōm… śiva ōm…
bhasmam pulimina smaśānavāsīmaṅgaḷamiccē śubhamkarā
stanza.meaning: You dwell in a graveyard, smeared with ash, yet you bestow auspiciousness—O giver of all that is good.

stanza.lyrics: viṣamu trāgina nīlakaṇṭhākṛpa kuripiñcē karuṇākarā
stanza.meaning: You have consumed poison, O blue-throated Lord, yet you shower grace—you are the embodiment of compassion.

stanza.lyrics: hara ōm… śiva ōm… hara ōm… śiva ōm…
maunamutōnē jñānamiccitiviakṣaramiccina ḍamarūdharā
stanza.meaning: By sounding your damaru, you gave the world letters and words—yet you taught Self-knowledge through silence.

stanza.lyrics: sarvavyāpi nīvu cidambarēśāviśvacalanamaina naṭarājā
stanza.meaning: You are all-pervading, the infinite space of pure consciousness—yet you are the dancing universe, the Lord of the cosmic dance.

stanza.lyrics: hara ōm… śiva ōm… hara ōm… śiva ōm…

song.title: ētō ētō tēḍukiṙēn
song.source: Eto eto tedugiren 2025 - Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ētō ētō tēḍukiṙēn nīetirvantapōtō ōḍukiṙēn
stanza.meaning: I keep searching for something, yet when you come before me, I run away.

stanza.lyrics: tīdō nanḍrō teriyāmal sinatīyinil cikki vāḍukiṙēn
stanza.meaning: Unable to discern right from wrong, I get caught in the fire of anger and wither away.

stanza.lyrics: tēdi kizhikkumbōtinilē nāḷtēyntaṅkupōna nilayaṙintēn
stanza.meaning: While searching in vain, I realized that time was slipping away.

stanza.lyrics: pādi kiṇaṙai tāṇḍiṭṭān śivan pādattin perumai uṇarndiṭṭēn
stanza.meaning: Only after crossing half the well of life did I come to understand the greatness of Lord Shiva's feet.

stanza.lyrics: ētō ētō tēḍukiṙēn nīetirvantapōtō ōḍukiṙēn
stanza.meaning: I keep searching for something, yet when you come before me, I run away.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇkaḷ teriyumbōtinilē akakaṇṇil śivane kāṇāmal
stanza.meaning: Even if one's external eyes are intact, if one cannot behold the Lord with the inner eye,

stanza.lyrics: maṇṇil vanta pativukku śiva mahimai yāvum viḷaṅkiḍumō
stanza.meaning: can merely being born into this world lead to an understanding of Lord Shiva’s greatness?

stanza.lyrics: ētō ētō tēḍukiṙēn nīetirvantapōtō ōḍukiṙēn
stanza.meaning: I keep searching for something, yet when you come before me, I run away.

stanza.lyrics: śivanē uyirkaḷ anaittumena encintaikkuḷ oḷiyāy varavēṇḍum
stanza.meaning: May the thought that Lord Shiva is everything shine as a light within my mind.

stanza.lyrics: yamanē vantu ninḍrālum śivan aḍiyai maṙavā manam vēṇḍum
stanza.meaning: Even if Yama himself stands before me, may my mind never forget Shiva’s feet.

stanza.lyrics: ētō ētō tēḍukiṙēn nīetirvantapōtō ōḍukiṙēn
stanza.meaning: I keep searching for something, yet when you come before me, I run away.

stanza.lyrics: śivanē cidambaranē aḍiyārkkum aḍiyōnē
stanza.meaning: O Shiva, Lord of Chidambaram, you are devoted to your devotees.

stanza.lyrics: haranē guruparanē perum piṇitīrkkum perumānē
stanza.meaning: O Hara, supreme Guru, O Lord who removes our deepest afflictions…

song.title: ētō kāvyattin-ārō madhuramāy īṇam pakarunna pōle
song.source: Eto kavyattin aro 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ētō kāvyattin-ārō madhuramāy īṇam pakarunna pōleārō madhurita-svaralayamoḍ-atālapiccīḍunna pōle
stanza.meaning: Like one who sets a lovely tune to a poem another has penned, like one who sings the melody with sweetness

stanza.lyrics: jīvita-kāvyam racippat-ārō īṇam ēkuvatum ārōśrutilayamoḍu madhuramāyi ālapiccīḍuvat-ārō
stanza.meaning: —who wrote the poem of our life? Who set it to music? And who sang it into being as a sweet song?

stanza.lyrics: ētō kāvyattin-ārō madhuramāy īṇam pakarunna pōleārō madhurita-svaralayamoḍ-atālapiccīḍunna pōle
stanza.meaning: Like one who sets a lovely tune to a poem another has penned, like one who sings the melody with sweetness

stanza.lyrics: jīvita-kāvyam racippat-ārō īṇam ēkuvatum ārōśrutilayamoḍu madhuramāyi ālapiccīḍuvat-ārō
stanza.meaning: —who wrote the poem of our life? Who set it to music? And who sang it into being as a sweet song?

stanza.lyrics: ētō vipinē maṙaññoru śilaye ārō kāṇmatu pōleārō kaṇḍ-eḍutta śilayil ninnum śilpam racippatu pōle
stanza.meaning: Like one who discovers a stone hidden deep in the forest, and another who carves from it a beautiful sculpture

stanza.lyrics: jīva-śilaye kāṇmatum ārō śilpam racippatum ārōprāṇa-caitanyam ēkiyā śilpam divyamāy tīrkkuvat-ārō
stanza.meaning: —who transformed it into an idol divine by breathing life into the stone?

stanza.lyrics: ētō pāzhmuḷantaṇḍ-onnil ārō dvāraṅgaḷ ēkiya pōleārō adharam aṇaccatil ninnum gānaṅgaḷ ūtiya pōle
stanza.meaning: Like one who carves holes into a hollow bamboo reed, and another who lifts it to his lips and draws forth sweet melodies

stanza.lyrics: pāzhmana-muḷantaṇḍil dvāraṅgaḷ ēki vēṇu menayuvat-ārōnādam-anādi uṇarttiyatil svara-mādhuri tūkuvat-ārō
stanza.meaning: who pierced the reed and shaped it into a flute? Who awakened the primal music within, and poured it forth as song?

stanza.lyrics: jīvita-kāvyālāpa-vinōdinī nāda-rūpiṇī vandanammānasa-muraḷī-vādinī prāṇa-rūpiṇī amba! vandanam
stanza.meaning: Salutations to the One who sings the song of life, the very essence of music. Salutations to the Mother who plays the flute of our heart and is the breath of our lives;

stanza.lyrics: jīva-śilayatil śilpam racicciḍum viśva-śilpinī vandanamprēma-svarūpiṇī sadguru-rūpiṇī viśva-sākṣiṇī vandanam
stanza.meaning: salutations to the Universal Sculptor who transforms living stone into forms. Salutations to the essence of love, the form of the Satguru, the all-pervasive witness of this universe.

song.title: etra janmattile puṇyamō ñān innen
song.source: Etra janmattile 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: etra janmattile puṇyamō ñān innenamma tan tiru-rūpam kāṇumāṙ-āyatu
stanza.meaning: In this life, I have beheld your divine form-the fruit of worthy deeds from previous lives.

stanza.lyrics: ētētu janmattil ceyta tapassō ñāntāvaka sannidhi pūkumāṙ-āyatu
stanza.meaning: Through penance performed over many births, O Mother, I have been led to your sacred abode.

stanza.lyrics: karmatin tōṇi tuzhaññu ñān ennendeammayām divya-lakṣyattil aṇaññiḍum?
stanza.meaning: But when, O Mother, will I reach the final shore, rowing the boat of karma across this vast ocean of life?

stanza.lyrics: śuddhamām bhakti ennil niṙaññ-ennu ñānamma tan divyamām pādattil cērnniḍum?
stanza.meaning: When will pure and unwavering love arise within me, to carry me to your lotus feet?

stanza.lyrics: aham enna bōdham ennuḷḷil niṙayunnuvō?ammayilēkkuḷḷa dūram ēṙunnuvō?
stanza.meaning: I worry-has ego taken root in my heart? Is it what keeps me distant from you?

stanza.lyrics: aviḍutte tiru kṛpa tūki nin kuññineā maḍitaṭṭilēkk-etticcu koḷḷaṇē
stanza.meaning: O Divine Mother, shower me with your grace and draw this child close into your loving lap.

stanza.lyrics: ammē bhagavati dēvi mahēśvarikaitozhām kaitozhām ānanda-dhāmamē
stanza.meaning: O Devi, O Bhagavati, blissful and compassionate, I offer my heart in prayer with folded palms.

song.title: etra nāḷāy ende ammaye kāṇāte
song.source: Etra nalay ende Ammaye 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Etra nalay ende Ammaye 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: etra nāḷāy ende ammaye kāṇāte kuññumanassen vitumbī
stanza.meaning: Mother! My child’s heart has been weeping for so long, unable to behold you.

stanza.lyrics: pūñcēla-tumbil piḍiccu naḍanna nāḷ ōrtt-enmizhikaḷ tuḷumbī…
stanza.meaning: My eyes overflow with tears when I remember my childhood—how I held on to your saree as I walked.

stanza.lyrics: ammē… ammē… ōrtt-en mizhikaḷ tuḷumbī
stanza.meaning: Those memories fill my heart and eyes with longing, and I weep.

stanza.lyrics: ēṙe nāḷ vērppeṭṭirunna tan paitalincārattēkk-aṇayunna ammaye pōl
stanza.meaning: Mother, when a mother sees her child after a long time, she comes running eagerly and clasps the child to her heart.

stanza.lyrics: vembal-ārnn-ōḍi vann-enne ā mārttaṭṭilvāri puṇarum ennōrttū
stanza.meaning: I, too, hope that when my Mother sees me after so long, you will come running to embrace me.

stanza.lyrics: mōha-tēnmalar ennil viḍarnnu
stanza.meaning: That hope has bloomed in my heart like fresh, fragrant flowers.

stanza.lyrics: vārttiṅkaḷ tālam eḍuttorī rāvil ñānammaye ōrttōrtt-irippū
stanza.meaning: Tonight, beneath the full moon shining in all her glory, bathed in cool,

stanza.lyrics: candana śītaḷa candrika chāyayil ammayekāttaṅgirippū… kaṇṇīr-puzhayil kuḷiccaṅgirippū…
stanza.meaning: fragrant sandal-scented light, I wait for you. I am immersed in a river of my own tears, waiting with longing for you.

stanza.lyrics: vāruṫṫa tūmaṇam vazhiyum endamma tan pūmēnitazhukiyō tennal?
stanza.meaning: Did a gentle breeze touch the fragrant body of my Mother?

stanza.lyrics: pūntēnin tuḷḷipōl eṅgu ninnō kuḷirpaintennal enne puṇarnnu
stanza.meaning: For from somewhere, like a fresh dewdrop, a soft wind carrying your scent came and embraced me.

stanza.lyrics: atendamma tan karam āyirunnu
stanza.meaning: That breeze became my Mother's arms—and she embraced me.

song.title: etrayā maunattin-āzham
song.source: Etraya maunattin azham 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: etrayā maunattin-āzham aṙivīla - aṙiyāte manavum ēkāntamāyi
stanza.meaning: I do not know the depths of silence, yet the mind grew still on its own.

stanza.lyrics: niśśabda cittattil ānandam etrayō - mūkamāy layam ārnnu niścalatvam
stanza.meaning: In the silence of the heart, great bliss abides—silent, still, and merged in oneness.

stanza.lyrics: ā mauna-vīthiyil mozhikaḷ maṙayunnōēkānta-cittattil vilayiccuvō
stanza.meaning: Did I forget words on this path of silence? Or did they dissolve into my silent heart?

stanza.lyrics: eviḍēyō uṇma tan vērukaḷ tēḍavē amṛta tīratt-onnu cērnn-aṇaññō
stanza.meaning: In seeking the roots of eternal truth, did I arrive at the shores of immortality?

stanza.lyrics: amma tan makkaḷkku vazhi-viḷakk-ākavē - nistula-śānti pakarnniḍunnō?
stanza.meaning: Mother—the guiding star of her children—will she grant us matchless peace?

stanza.lyrics: aṙiyīla eṅkilum nukarunnu ñānum ā - amṛta-kṛpā-varṣa-dhārayuḷḷil
stanza.meaning: I do not know, yet within me flows the stream of her ambrosial grace.

song.title: etrayō janmam alaññu tiriññu ñān
song.source: Etrayo janmam alanyu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: etrayō janmam alaññu tiriññu ñānī janmam nin tiru munnil etti
stanza.meaning: I wandered aimlessly through many lifetimes, until in this birth, I arrived at your divine presence.

stanza.lyrics: amma tan māhātmyam aṙiññiḍān ākātejanma-janmaṅgaḷ kazhiññu pōyi
stanza.meaning: Life after life went by without knowing Mother’s glory.

stanza.lyrics: ādyamāy nin tiru sannidhi pūkavēniścalayāy nōkki ninnu pōyi
stanza.meaning: But when I first entered your sacred abode, I stood transfixed, gazing at you

stanza.lyrics: āru nī ennōrttu śaṅkiccu nilkavētṛkkaikaḷāl enne nī puṇarnnu
stanza.meaning: wondering who you truly were. Then, you reached out and embraced me with infinite tenderness.

stanza.lyrics: ā nimiṣattil en antaraṅgam collikēvalam mānuṣa śaktiyalla
stanza.meaning: In that moment, a voice rose within me: “This is not a mere human being,

stanza.lyrics: en manam tēṅgumbōḷ niṙayunna kaṇṇuḷḷaādiparāśakti ammayennu
stanza.meaning: this is Adi Parashakti, the Supreme Primordial Mother, whose eyes well up with tears when my heart weeps.”

stanza.lyrics: onnum mozhiyuvān ākāten mizhiyōramniṙaññu kaviññ-ozhukiyallō
stanza.meaning: Unable to utter a word, my eyes overflowed with tears.

stanza.lyrics: vēpathu-gātriyāy ñān naḍannīḍavēen hṛdayam nī varannīlayō
stanza.meaning: As I stepped away, my body trembling, you gently stole my heart.

stanza.lyrics: ā divya-kāntika śakti enne ninnīlēykkāyi nayiccīlayō
stanza.meaning: The divine magnetism of your love drew me back to you.

stanza.lyrics: ninde parīkṣaṇam tāṅgīḍuvānī kuññin-ākumō jagadīśvarī
stanza.meaning: O Goddess, creator of the universe, will this child of yours have the strength to endure your tests?

stanza.lyrics: ā divya-snēham nukarnnīḍuvānārum kotikkillē jagadambikē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, who would not long to dissolve into the ocean of your boundless love?

stanza.lyrics: ninne aṙiyuvān nin snēham aṙiyuvāninn-enikkāvumō jagadambikē
stanza.meaning: O Jagadambika! Will I be able to know you now? Will I ever truly realize your love?

song.title: etrayō janmamāy ammayōḍottu ñān
song.source: Etrayo janmamay 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: etrayō janmamāy ammayōḍottu ñānvasikkunnu ennirunnālum
stanza.meaning: I have lived with you, O Mother, through countless lifetimes,

stanza.lyrics: ennu ñān ninne aṙiyum – ammēeṅgane ninne aṙiyum
stanza.meaning: yet how do I truly know you, Mother? How will I ever realize you?

stanza.lyrics: kāruṇyam tūkum ā nōṭṭam en kaṇṇilētimirattāl ñān kāṇunnilla
stanza.meaning: Blinded by the cataract of ignorance, I fail to see your compassionate glance.

stanza.lyrics: ñān karayumbōḷ āśvasippikkum āmadhura-vākkukaḷ ñān kēḷkkunnilla
stanza.meaning: Deafened by my own cries, I do not hear your sweet words of comfort.

stanza.lyrics: kāliḍaṙi vīzhumbōḷ kaittāṅgāy nīettunnatum ñān aṙiyunnilla
stanza.meaning: I do not realize that you come to support me, as my steps falter and I stumble.

stanza.lyrics: ōrō aṇuvilum nin caitanyattemūḍhayāya ñān innum aṙiyunnilla
stanza.meaning: Ignorant as I am, even now I fail to see that it is your divine consciousness which pervades every atom of this universe.

stanza.lyrics: ambikē nin tiru caraṇattil śaraṇam aḍayumbōḷ innu aṙiññiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: O Mother, today as I surrender at your lotus feet, I realize

stanza.lyrics: niṙadīpamāy nī ennil uṇḍāyirunnuniṙadīpamāy ennum nayiccirunnu
stanza.meaning: you were always within my heart, a radiant lamp, illumining my path with your eternal light.

song.title: evaru unnāru ?
song.source: Evaru unnaru inkevaru unnaru 2025 Tel in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Evaru unnaru inkevaru unnaru 2025 Tel in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: evaru unnāru ? iṅkevaru unnāru? viśvamulo, nīvutappa evaru unnāru? svapnamulo, nīvutappa evaru unnāru?
stanza.meaning: Who is there? Who else is there? In this whole universe, who is there except you? Even in dream, who is there except you?

stanza.lyrics: pūvulu enno unnā, sāram madhuvu kādā
stanza.meaning: There may be countless flowers, but their essence is nectar, isn’t it?

stanza.lyrics: bommalu mannu kādā, nagalu kanakam kādā
stanza.meaning: Are dolls anything but clay, ornaments anything but gold,

stanza.lyrics: alalu kaḍali kādā, jīvulu cidātma kādā
stanza.meaning: waves anything but the ocean, and living beings anything but consciousness?

stanza.lyrics: cidātma nīve ayite, antā unnadi nīve
stanza.meaning: If you are that very consciousness, then all that exists is truly none other than you alone.

stanza.lyrics: bandhālu tolagi povā, dehamu kāli podā
stanza.meaning: Don’t relationships wither away? Isn’t the body ultimately reduced to ashes?

stanza.lyrics: āstulu karigi povā, jagamu, māruṭa ledā
stanza.meaning: Don’t possessions slip away, and isn’t this world ever changing?

stanza.lyrics: terapai bommalu annī, manasu kalpanalannī
stanza.meaning: All these appear like images on a screen—mere projections of the mind.

stanza.lyrics: viśvam svapnam ayite, antā unnadi nīve
stanza.meaning: If the entire universe is but a dream, then all that exists is truly none other than you alone.

song.title: ghanasāndram ī rātri
song.source: Ghanasandrami ratri 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ghanasāndram ī rātri mūḷunnu mūkamāyghanaśyāma-vēṇugānam…ghanaśyāma-vēṇugānam
stanza.meaning: The deep silence of the lovely night softly hums the melodies of Krishna’s flute.

stanza.lyrics: vanamulla tūkunnu vrajabālan aṇiyunnavanamāla tan sugandham…vanamāla tan sugandham
stanza.meaning: The wild jasmine’s fragrance stirs memories in Radha’s heart of the garland of forest flowers worn by her beloved.

stanza.lyrics: akalattil eṅgō pāḍīḍunnu rākkuyilsukhadamām nīlāmbari
stanza.meaning: From afar, the Koel’s soothing songs drift through the air,

stanza.lyrics: pakaram āvillonnum śyāmande prēmattinmakaranda-mādhurikku…makaranda-mādhurikku
stanza.meaning: yet none of these can match the sweetness of the dark-hued Krishna’s love.

stanza.lyrics: vidhurayām rādha tan vyathayārnna mizhikaḷōmathuraye nōkki nilppū
stanza.meaning: Radha’s eyes, filled with sorrow, gaze longingly towards the path that leads from Madhura.

stanza.lyrics: pathikar āreṅkilum pakarumō kaṇṇandevyatha nīkkum vāṅmadhuramvyatha nīkkum vāṅmadhuram
stanza.meaning: Will some traveller come along that path bearing stories of Krishna, or a tender message to ease the pain in her aching heart?

song.title: tintaka tintaka tārō taka tintaka tārō (gōlōka-pālakan kaṇṇan )
song.source: Goloka palakan - Tintaka Tintaka taro 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Goloka palakan - Tintaka Tintaka taro 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tārō taka tintaka tārōtintaka tintaka tintaka tintakatintaka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: Chorus of exultation

stanza.lyrics: gōlōka-pālakan kaṇṇan annugōkkaḷe mēykkān iṙaṅgiārum koticcu pōyiḍum tasyabālaka-sundara-rūpam
stanza.meaning: Krishna, the youthful guardian of Gokul, sets out to graze the cows in the forest. His radiant form, so enchanting, draws every heart to him.

stanza.lyrics: cēlotta vārmuḍi keṭṭil orucēṇuṫṫa pīli tirukituṅgi kiḍakkunnu tellu atilcūḍiya mullappū-māla
stanza.meaning: A peacock feather adorns his hair-knot, from which a jasmine garland gracefully cascades.

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tārō taka tintaka tārōtintaka tintaka tintaka tintakatintaka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: Chorus of exultation

stanza.lyrics: pītāmbara-paṭṭu cuṫṫi atil mīte aramaṇi cārttigōkulam pāḍi uṇarttum nallakōlakkuzhalum tiruki
stanza.meaning: A yellow cloth adorns his waist, over which a delicate belt of tiny bells softly tinkles. Tucked within it lies his cherished flute, whose melodies awaken and gladden every heart in Gokula.

stanza.lyrics: śrīvatsa vakṣasil ninnumveṙiṭṭu pōkāt-iriykkānpāḍupeṭṭ-oṭṭiyiriykkum tavanalla pulinakha-māla
stanza.meaning: Around his neck clings a tiger-claw necklace, struggling to remain upon the chest that bears the Śrīvatsa mark—the symbol of his divine glory.

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tārō taka tintaka tārōtintaka tintaka tintaka tintakatintaka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: Chorus of exultation

stanza.lyrics: āḍi-kaḷiykkunnu māṙil mōḍikūṭṭum ēṙe vanamālakayyil oru kālikkōlum – maṙukayyil kaḷiykkuvān pantum
stanza.meaning: Garlands of wildflowers sway upon his chest, enhancing the beauty of his form. In one hand he holds a herding staff, in the other, a ball for play.

stanza.lyrics: uccaykk-amṛtēttināyi – ceṙupātrattil nalla pāl cōṙumkūṭṭukārkk-ēkuvānāyi – maṫṫupātraṅgaḷil naṙuveṇṇa
stanza.meaning: For lunch, he carries a small pot of milk rice in other pots, fresh butter for friends he adores.

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tārō taka tintaka tārōtintaka tintaka tintaka tintakatintaka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: Chorus of exultation

stanza.lyrics: centāmara-pūkkaḷ vellum nindecentaḷir-pādaṅgaḷ pārilcintunnu śōbhayāl uḷḷam ennum antastham āyiriykkēṇam
stanza.meaning: Krishna, even red lotuses must bow before the beauty of your sacred feet. May my heart dive deep into the light that radiates from them.

stanza.lyrics: kāruṇya-vāridhē kṛṣṇā – tavakālkal arppiykkunni janmamtāvaka kāruṇya-varṣamennil ēkaṇam prēma-piyūṣam
stanza.meaning: Krishna, O ocean of compassion, I lay my life at your lotus feet. By your grace alone, may I be blessed with the nectar of your love.

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tārō taka tintaka tārōtintaka tintaka tintaka tintakatintaka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: Chorus of exultation

song.title: gōpikaḷ ellārum ottu cērnnu
song.source: Gopikal ellorum ottuchernnu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: gōpikaḷ ellārum ottu cērnnukaṇnane kāṇānāy kāttu ninnu
stanza.meaning: All the gopis gathered together, waiting eagerly to see Krishna.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇanu pīṭham orukki hṛttilkaṇṇanil tanne layicciḍānāy
stanza.meaning: In their hearts, they prepared a throne for him, longing to dissolve into him and dance in his joy.

stanza.lyrics: rāsakēḷikkāyi vannu kaṇṇanāmōdattōḍ-aṅgāḍiyallō
stanza.meaning: Krishna came to play the rasa leela and danced in supreme delight.

stanza.lyrics: tanne maṙannōrī gōpikaḷ tanuḷḷile pīṭhattil cennirunnu
stanza.meaning: Forgetting himself, he went and sat upon the throne that the gopis had prepared in their hearts.

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇa harē jaya kṛṣṇa harērādhā manōharā kṛṣṇa harēkṛṣṇa harē jaya kṛṣṇa harēgōpikā vallabhā jaya kṛṣṇa harē
stanza.meaning: Krishna, victory to you, O beautiful one, beloved of Radha, victory to you! Lord of the gopis, victory to you!

stanza.lyrics: uḷlil iḍam piḍicc-ende kaṇṇanvarṇṇa-prabhayil udicc-uyarnnu
stanza.meaning: Now my Krishna dwells within me, his radiance illumines my heart.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇande cuṫṫinum pūkkaḷam tīrttu ñānkaṇṇin-ānandam pakarnnu kaṇṇan
stanza.meaning: I spread a carpet of flowers around him, his divine form is a feast for my eyes.

stanza.lyrics: ānanda-cinmayan uḷḷil ākegōpikaḷ ānanda-magnarāyi
stanza.meaning: When the gopis beheld Krishna, the very form of bliss and pure consciousness, within their hearts,

stanza.lyrics: ennennum gōpikaḷkk-utsavamāykaṇṇanil ennum uṇarnnirunnu
stanza.meaning: life itself became a festival for them, and their hearts completely merged in him.

song.title: hara-hara śaṅkara śiva-śiva śaṅkara
song.source: Hara hara Sankara 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: hara-hara śaṅkara śiva-śiva śaṅkarasundara-rūpa surēśa harēhara-hara śaṅkara śiva-śiva śaṅkarasundara-rūpa surēśa harē
stanza.meaning: O Lord Shiva, O Hara, beautiful in form, Lord of the gods!

stanza.lyrics: candrakalā-dhara gaṅgā-dhara hara tava caraṇam aṇayunn-aḍiyan
stanza.meaning: The one who wears a sliver of the moon and the holy Ganga in his hair, bless me by granting refuge at your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: pārvati-patayē paramēśvaranē ārjita pāpavināśa-harēārjita pāpavināśa-harē
stanza.meaning: O consort of Devi Parvati, Supreme Lord, you who compassionately destroy the sins of countless lifetimes.

stanza.lyrics: hara-hara śaṅkara śiva-śiva śaṅkarasundara-rūpa surēśa harēhara-hara śaṅkara śiva-śiva śaṅkarasundara-rūpa surēśa harē
stanza.meaning: O Lord Shiva, O Hara, beautiful in form, Lord of the gods!

stanza.lyrics: bhasma-vibhūṣita vakṣa-sthalavumcandrōdbhāsita tiru śirassum
stanza.meaning: Sacred ash is smeared across your upper body, your face is aglow with the radiance of the moon nestled in your matted locks.

stanza.lyrics: nētra-trayavum vyāghrāmbaravum ānandāmṛta tava rūpamānandāmṛta tava rūpam
stanza.meaning: Your third eye is the mark of ultimate knowledge, your leopard-skin waistcloth, a symbol of supreme detachment. Your divine form fills me with ambrosial bliss.

stanza.lyrics: hara-hara śaṅkara śiva-śiva śaṅkarasundara-rūpa surēśa harēhara-hara śaṅkara śiva-śiva śaṅkarasundara-rūpa surēśa harē
stanza.meaning: O Lord Shiva, O Hara, beautiful in form, Lord of the gods!

stanza.lyrics: tirukandharattil kapālamālātiru jaṭayil ozhukiḍum bhāgīrathī
stanza.meaning: Around your neck hangs a garland of skulls, a symbol of dispassion, while the pure Bhagirathi flows down from your crown,

stanza.lyrics: tiṅgi-ñeriññoru ceñcaḍa naḍuvilpuñciri tūkum matilēkhayumpuñciri tūkum matilēkhayum
stanza.meaning: having descended from the heavens into your matted hair. The crescent moon smiles gently between your thick, tangled locks.

stanza.lyrics: hara-hara śaṅkara śiva-śiva śaṅkarasundara-rūpa surēśa harēhara-hara śaṅkara śiva-śiva śaṅkarasundara-rūpa surēśa harē
stanza.meaning: O Lord Shiva, O Hara, beautiful in form, Lord of the gods!

stanza.lyrics: garaḷam uṇḍu kaṙutta gaḷatte keṭṭi puṇarum phaṇi gaṇavum
stanza.meaning: Snakes coil around your throat, turned blue from swallowing dreadful poison to save the world in your boundless compassion.

stanza.lyrics: caḍula tāṇḍava narttana nāthācuḍala priyanē mām pāhicuḍala priyanē mām pāhi
stanza.meaning: O Lord Shiva! You dance the great Tandava—Lord of the cremation ground, protect me, I seek your grace.

song.title: haravādyam utirkkunnu āditāḷam
song.source: Haravadyam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: haravādyam utirkkunnu āditāḷamatil anugamicciḍum praṇava-mantram
stanza.meaning: The primal rhythm arises from Hara’s damaru; with each new beat, the pranava mantra resounds.

stanza.lyrics: prakambanam ākunnu prapañcam ellāmśivapādam aṇayunnu pañcabāṇan
stanza.meaning: Its sacred sound reverberates through all creation, and Kamadeva surrenders at Shiva’s feet.

stanza.lyrics: tirujaḍayil aḍarunna gaṅgayil nīrāḍipāpa-vimuktarāyi jīvakōḍi
stanza.meaning: Millions of jīvas, bathing in the waters that pour from Gaṅgā enshrined in your matted locks, are cleansed of all sin,

stanza.lyrics: tṛkkaṇ kaḍākṣattāl uṇarunnuuḷttaḍam puṇarunna ātmabōdham
stanza.meaning: and a loving glance from your third eye awakens the blissful Self within.

stanza.lyrics: naṭarāja-naḍanattil ādittimirkkilumnisvanāy mēvunnu viśvanāthan
stanza.meaning: Though he dances with boundless, ecstatic grace, the Lord of the Universe remains perfectly detached.
