stanza.lyrics: kāḷakkūḍattin viṣam svīkaricciḍumtyagarājan śivan nīlakaṇṭhan
stanza.meaning: He drank the dark Kālakūṭa poison to protect all life, becoming the blue-throated one — the king of sacrifice.

stanza.lyrics: pañca-bhūtaṅgaḷāl pañcōpacāraṅgaḷmānasa-vilvattāl arccanayum
stanza.meaning: By offering the five adorations with the five great elements, and worshipping with the heart’s bilva leaf,

stanza.lyrics: mṛtyuñjaya-mantram avirāmam ura ceytuēṙiḍām ānanda-śṛṅgamāḍiḍām ānanda-naḍanam
stanza.meaning: by chanting the Mṛtyuñjaya mantra without end, we can ascend to the pinnacle of bliss — we can dance the sacred dance of divine delight.

stanza.lyrics: tāṇḍavam śiva-tāṇḍavamparipāvanam śiva-tāṇḍavam
stanza.meaning: Śiva dances the Tāṇḍava, the sacred rhythm of the cosmos.

song.title: hē lakṣmi nṛsimha
song.source: He Laskhmi Narasimha 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: hē lakṣmi nṛsimha karuṇākā karālamba
stanza.meaning: O Lakshmi Narasimha, ocean of compassion and strength, extend your mighty hand to lift up the downtrodden and helpless.

stanza.lyrics: dīnōṅ kō dō apnē kar kā ālamba
stanza.meaning: Let your protective grace be the support that steadies those who falter.

stanza.lyrics: sansār kī laharōṅ meiṅ ḍūbā yē mankṛpā-dṛṣṭi sē dō mujhkō jīvan
stanza.meaning: This mind, tossed and submerged in the waves of worldly life, longs to live again through your merciful gaze.

stanza.lyrics: nāth kṛpā nidhi, caranōṅ meiṅ śaraṇ
stanza.meaning: Lord, treasure-house of grace, I surrender at your feet.

stanza.lyrics: bhav sē pār karō, dō karāvalamba
stanza.meaning: Carry me across the ocean of becoming—give me your hand to hold, and let it be my support.

stanza.lyrics: hē lakṣmi nṛsimha…
stanza.meaning: O Lakshmi Narasimha!

stanza.lyrics: jalatē hūē bhay kē van meiṅ khaḍātērāhi nām bas sahārā baḍā
stanza.meaning: I stand amidst the burning forest of fear, surrounded on all sides—your name alone is the strength I cling to.

stanza.lyrics: bhakta-vatsal tu trātā bhava-sāgar
stanza.meaning: O protector of your devotees, savior across the sea of worldly existence,

stanza.lyrics: dīna-bandhu mērē dō karāvalamba
stanza.meaning: friend of the forlorn, reach out and steady me with your hand.

stanza.lyrics: hē lakṣmi nṛsimha…
stanza.meaning: O Lakshmi Narasimha!

stanza.lyrics: hiraṇyakaśipu kō mārā bankē tukālprahlād kē liyē āyā bankē ḍhāl
stanza.meaning: You brought death to the demon Hiranyakashipu and became a shield and refuge for Prahlad.

stanza.lyrics: vaisē hi mujhkō bhī thāmō prabhō
stanza.meaning: In the same way, grasp me also, O Lord

stanza.lyrics: hē nṛsimha dēva dō karāvalamba
stanza.meaning: —Narasimha Deva, offer me your supporting hand.

stanza.lyrics: hē lakṣmi nṛsimha…
stanza.meaning: O Lakshmi Narasimha!

stanza.lyrics: māyā kē bandhan meiṅ jakaṭā hūāajñān meiṅ ḍubā bhramit aur thakā
stanza.meaning: Bound tightly in the snares of illusion, drowned in ignorance, lost and weary, I wander.

stanza.lyrics: satya aur sēvā kā bhāv jagā dē
stanza.meaning: Awaken in me the spirit of truth and selfless service.

stanza.lyrics: hē jaga prabhō ab dō karāvalamba
stanza.meaning: O Lord of the universe, now grant me the support of your hand.

song.title: hē manavē ele manavē
song.source: He Manave 2025 Kan in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: hē manavē ele manavē bhajisu pāṇḍuraṅganā
stanza.meaning: O mind, my mind! Worship Panduranga,

stanza.lyrics: pāpa rāśi nāśa gaiva prēma puṇya dhāmanā
stanza.meaning: the destroyer of sins piled high, the abode of love and merit.

stanza.lyrics: duritava dūra gaiva dēvakī kandanā
stanza.meaning: He is the son of Devaki, who removes all suffering.

stanza.lyrics: harivā kaṇṇīra oresi poreva punītana
stanza.meaning: He wipes away the streaming tears of his devotees, and embraces the pure.

stanza.lyrics: pārumāḍi bhava-sāgara pālipa paramātmana
stanza.meaning: He is the supreme one who helps us cross the ocean of worldly existence and protects.

stanza.lyrics: yāva bhēda bhāvavilladē bhaktigolipa bhūpana
stanza.meaning: Without any sense of division, He accepts all devotees—the King who welcomes all.

stanza.lyrics: viṭhala… pāṇḍuraṅga… viṭhala… pāṇḍuraṅga…
stanza.meaning: Oh Krishna

stanza.lyrics: bāḷa kattalalli beḷaku tōrabaruva mādhavā
stanza.meaning: O Madhava, you are the one who reveals light in the darkness of life.

stanza.lyrics: hagalu iruḷu ninna nenapu nīrajākṣa nirguṇā
stanza.meaning: O lotus-eyed, attributeless one, we remember you day and night.

stanza.lyrics: bhajipe ninna ananta divya nāma nārāyaṇā
stanza.meaning: O Narayana, we chant your infinite divine names.

stanza.lyrics: kṣamisi namma salahu dīna-bandhu śrī adhōkṣajā
stanza.meaning: O Adhokshaja, friend of the humble, forgive us and protect us.

stanza.lyrics: viṭhala… pāṇḍuraṅga… viṭhala… pāṇḍuraṅga…
stanza.meaning: Oh Krishna

stanza.lyrics: prēmadi karedoḍane baruva paṇḍarī-nāthanē
stanza.meaning: O Lord of Pandharpur, you come when called with love.

stanza.lyrics: moreya kēḷi varava nīḍi uddharipa upēndranē
stanza.meaning: O Upendra, you hear our prayers, grant boons, and uplift us.

stanza.lyrics: niṣṭheyinda dhyānisidare gōcaripa nirañjana
stanza.meaning: O stainless one, if meditated upon with steady devotion, you grant your vision.

stanza.lyrics: janana-maraṇadinda mukti nīḍu hē janārdana
stanza.meaning: O Janardana, you grant liberation from birth and death.

stanza.lyrics: viṭhala… pāṇḍuraṅga… viṭhala… pāṇḍuraṅga…
stanza.meaning: Oh Krishna

stanza.lyrics: pāṇḍuraṅga pāṇḍuraṅga viṭhala viṭhala pāṇḍuraṅga…
stanza.meaning: Oh Krishna

song.title: hē nīḷōmaṇi hē jogonnātho
song.source: He Nilomani 2025 Odiya in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: hē nīḷōmaṇi hē jogonnāthoākhi poḍilē tōrō chūṭṭē samsārō
stanza.meaning: O Blue Jewel, O Jagannatha, with just one glance from you, the bondage of this world is broken.

stanza.lyrics: nīḷāccōḷo moṇi hē prabhu cokkā ākhi tōrōtōrē dēkhīlē mottē śrīhori chūṭṭī jībō janmōcakr
stanza.meaning: O Jewel of Nilachala, O Lord, with your wide round eyes, if you look upon me just once, O Srihari, I shall be freed from the cycle of birth.

stanza.lyrics: subhra saṅkhu dhōri madhur tānnorētumē bhaktō rakhyākārī hē madhōbō
stanza.meaning: Holding a pure white conch, with melody resounding, O Madhava! You are the protector of your devotees.

stanza.lyrics: nīḷōmēghō sorīro kṛpādhārā odhōrē
stanza.meaning: Your body has the hue of a dark raincloud, and kindness flows from your lips.

stanza.lyrics: jībō jōgattō tumō antardṛṣṭirē – sabojībō jōgattō tumō antardṛṣṭirē
stanza.meaning: All living beings and this entire world world dwell within your inner vision.

stanza.lyrics: nirākārō rūpē tumē dhōricōprēmō ānandō madhur līlā tumē raccūchō
stanza.meaning: You are formless, yet you assume a form. You create sweet and blissful divine plays, filled with love.

stanza.lyrics: hāttō gōḍōnō thāyī prabhū seyī rūpē
stanza.meaning: O Lord, though without hands or feet, in that very form,

stanza.lyrics: jōgattorō sab līlā tumē kōruccō
stanza.meaning: you enact all the divine play of this world.

stanza.lyrics: dāsī hōyī tumō guṇō gāvūchitumō pādōdhyāno sadākōri cāhūchī
stanza.meaning: Becoming your humble servant, I sing your glories. I wish always to meditate upon your sacred feet.

stanza.lyrics: cāhūni svargō na mōkhyōrō sthānō
stanza.meaning: I desire neither a place in heaven or liberation.

stanza.lyrics: cāhūnci tumōkku prabhū ēhi nibēdonōcāhūnci tumōkku prabhū ēhi nibēdonō
stanza.meaning: O Lord, I long only for you — this is my heartfelt prayer.

stanza.lyrics: nīlō mādhōbhō bhakta vatsalo jagannāthō joy joy
stanza.meaning: You are the dark-blue Madhava, the compassionate Lord of devotees — Jagannatha.

stanza.lyrics: jōgattarō pālana hārō biśvanāthō joy joy
stanza.meaning: You are the protector and sustainer of the universe — the Lord of all worlds.

song.title: hō kē simha savār mā
song.source: Ho ke simha savar 2025 Hindi in Eng v2.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Ho ke simha savar 2025 Hindi in Eng v2.pptx

stanza.lyrics: hō kē simha savār māaṣṭa bhujāōṅ vāli māāyī hai dēkhō durgā mābarsānē prēm apār
stanza.meaning: Mounted on a lion, the eight-armed Mother comes. Look, goddess Durga has arrived! She has come to shower boundless love.

stanza.lyrics: bōlō mātāṙāṇī kī jay jaybōlō mahāṙāṇī kī jay jaybōlō mahādēvi kī jay jaybōlō mahākāḷi kī jay jay
stanza.meaning: Say: ‘Victory to Mother, victory to the supreme Queen, victory to the great Goddess, victory to the mighty Kali!’

stanza.lyrics: mā kī ārati utārōprēm bharā rūp nihārōman mēṅ mā kī chabi kō dēkhōdhyān magn hō jāvō
stanza.meaning: Let us wave a lamp in front of Mother. Behold her form, full of love. Envision her image in your mind and become absorbed in meditation.

stanza.lyrics: lagātī mā mamtā sē galēbarsātī hai sudhā sab pējīvan sab kā savārnējag meiṅ āyī mayyā
stanza.meaning: She embraces everyone with motherly affection, she showers nectar on all. To beautify everyone’s life, Mother has come into the world.

song.title: hō kē simha savār mā
song.source: Ho ke simha savar 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Ho ke simha savar 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: hō kē simha savār māaṣṭa bhujāōṅ vāli māāyī hai dēkhō durgā mābarsānē prēm apār
stanza.meaning: Mounted on a lion, the eight-armed Mother comes. Look, goddess Durga has arrived! She has come to shower boundless love.

stanza.lyrics: bōlō mātāṙāṇī kī jay jaybōlō mahāṙāṇī kī jay jaybōlō mahādēvi kī jay jaybōlō mahākāḷi kī jay jay
stanza.meaning: Say: ‘Victory to Mother, victory to the supreme Queen, victory to the great Goddess, victory to the mighty Kali!’

stanza.lyrics: mā kī ārati utārōprēm bharā rūp nihārōman mēṅ mā kī chabi kō dēkhōdhyān magn hō jāvō
stanza.meaning: Perform Mother’s arati. Behold her form, full of love. Envision her image in your mind and become absorbed in meditation.

stanza.lyrics: lagātī mā mamtā sē galēbarsātī hai sudhā sab pējīvan sab kā savārnējag meiṅ āyī mayyā
stanza.meaning: Mother embraces with affection, she showers nectar on all. To uplift everyone’s life, Mother has come into the world.

song.title: hṛdaya-mandirattile
song.source: Hridaya Mandirattile 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: hṛdaya-mandirattile kamala maṇḍapattil ñānammē ninakkāyi pīṭham iṭṭu
stanza.meaning: Mother! In the lotus mandapa of my heart, a seat awaits you.

stanza.lyrics: citta-vṛndāvanattil viḍarnna nanmalarālēammē ninakkāyi māla tīrttū
stanza.meaning: I have woven a garland of pure blossoms, flowering in the Vrindavan of my mind.

stanza.lyrics: hṛdaya-mandirattile kamala maṇḍapattil ñānammē ninakkāyi pīṭham iṭṭu
stanza.meaning: Mother! In the lotus mandapa of my heart, a seat awaits you.

stanza.lyrics: manassu nannāy mathiccu kaḍaññu ñān eḍuttoruprēmattin naṙuveṇṇa karutivaccū
stanza.meaning: Churning the depths of my heart, I beheld you—the one eternal truth; from that vision arose the fresh, fragrant butter of devotion, kept aside only for you.

stanza.lyrics: puzha pōle ozhukum ī mizhi-jalam ammē ninkazhaliṇa kazhukān ñān orukki vaccu…kazhaliṇa kazhukān ñān orukki vaccu
stanza.meaning: And the river of tears that streamed from my eyes, I have preserved to wash your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: jaya jaya śaṅkari śambhu-priyē…jaya jaya gauri gaṇēśa-priyē…
stanza.meaning: Victory to Shankari, beloved of Lord Shiva! Victory to Gauri, Mother of Ganesha!

stanza.lyrics: jaya jaya śrī girirāja-sutē…jaya jaya dēvi dayā-nidhiyē…
stanza.meaning: Victory to the daughter of Himavan, the king of mountains! Victory to Devi, treasure house of compassion!

stanza.lyrics: tava pādamalariṇa hṛdayattil patiññorānimiṣattil ellām ñān maṙannu pōyi
stanza.meaning: The moment your lotus feet entered my heart, all else was forgotten.

stanza.lyrics: prēma-payōdhiyil āṇḍu pōyenne nīkaram nīṭṭi bōdha-karaykk-aṇaccu…karam nīṭṭi bōdha-karaykk-aṇaccu
stanza.meaning: I sank deep into the boundless ocean of love, till you stretched forth your hands of grace, lifting me gently to the radiant shore of supreme consciousness.

song.title: hṛdayāravindē padarēṇu tūki
song.source: Hridayaravinde pada renu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: hṛdayāravindē padarēṇu tūki - maruvuvān amba nī vannaṇayū
stanza.meaning: O Mother Saraswati, will you come to dwell in the lotus of my heart, blessing it with the dust of your holy feet?

stanza.lyrics: vīṇāpāṇī māmaka mānasamaṇvīṇa pāṇiyāl tazhukū… tazhukū…
stanza.meaning: Gently caress the veena of my mind with your soft hands.

stanza.lyrics: kṣaṇam itil mama kṣaṇam kaikkoṇḍīīkṣaṇa-vīciyāl nī kṛpa coriyū
stanza.meaning: In this moment, accept my call and shower your grace upon my fleeting mind through the rays of your divine glance.

stanza.lyrics: kṣaram ī jagattil nāda-brahmattinakṣarātmikē dhvani utirkkū
stanza.meaning: O eternal Goddess, in this perishable world spread the resonance of the primordial sound.

stanza.lyrics: śruti mīṭṭuvān en cintātantrikaḷtava lāḷanam nukarnniḍumbōḷ
stanza.meaning: When the strings of my mind drink in your tender affection, to tune the melody,

stanza.lyrics: anādiyām nāda-taraṅgaṅgaḷsapta-svarādi utirttiḍaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: may the beginningless waves of sound pour forth as the seven notes of music.

song.title: hṛdayattil ennum orāmantraṇam
song.source: Hridayattil ennum ora mantranam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Hridayattil ennum ora mantranam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: hṛdayattil ennum orāmantraṇam – śuddhaprēmattin madhuramām madhu-mantraṇam
stanza.meaning: There is always a sacred calling within my heart — a calling of love, a calling so sweet,

stanza.lyrics: ātma-tatvattinde sphuraṇam utirttiḍumvātsalya-pīyūṣa-rasa-mantraṇam
stanza.meaning: a calling of tenderness, a calling that pulses with the knowledge of the true Self.

stanza.lyrics: amma tannōmal karalāḷanamkaiśōra-bhāvam uṇarttiḍumbōḷ
stanza.meaning: Mother’s tender caress, so gentle, awakens my childlike heart;

stanza.lyrics: mañjima vazhiyumā mandasmēramuṇarttunnat-ātmāvin dīprabhāvam
stanza.meaning: her smile, aglow with divine grace, illumines the depths of my inner self.

stanza.lyrics: amma tan ārdramām ālōkanamhṛttil uyarttunnu varṇṇavīci
stanza.meaning: Her tender glances awaken within me a wondrous path of myriad colors,

stanza.lyrics: ā varṇṇavīci tan dīpta-kāntiuṇarttunnu svasvarūpa-avabōdham
stanza.meaning: and the radiance of that luminous trail brings me insight into my true self.

song.title: hṛdayattil innu rāsa-kēḷi
song.source: Hridayattil innu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: hṛdayattil innu rāsa-kēḷihṛdayēśvarande naḍana-kēḷi
stanza.meaning: Within my heart, the rasa dance begins—it becomes the stage for the divine play of Krishna, the Lord of my heart.

stanza.lyrics: en muraḷika tānē uṇarunnuennile ñānum inn-uṇarnnu
stanza.meaning: My flute awakens on its own, and with it, my true Self—one with the Lord—awakens too.

stanza.lyrics: jagadīśvarā kṛṣṇā guru-pavanēśvarā
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, Lord of the universe, beloved Lord of Guruvayoor!

stanza.lyrics: paikkaḷum ṛtukkaḷum pūkkalum nōkkunnukaṇṇande nisvana-muraḷi-gānam
stanza.meaning: The calves, the seasons, and the blossoms gaze in wonder, searching for the source of Krishna’s flute song.

stanza.lyrics: vismaya-līlakaḷ āḍunna mādhavanvismaya-pūramī vṛndāvanam
stanza.meaning: Madhavan plays his wondrous, divine games, and all of Vrindavan is steeped in enchantment.

stanza.lyrics: māyayām yavanika māṫṫi nī eppōzhum māyāte nilkkumō kaṇṇan-uṇṇī
stanza.meaning: O my beloved Krishna, will you lift the veil of illusion from my mind and remain forever unveiled in the temple of my heart?

stanza.lyrics: ōrttu bhajikkām cittattil sarvadā samasta-śānti nī nalkiḍaṇē…
stanza.meaning: With all my mind, heart, and intellect, I shall worship you. O compassionate Lord, please grant peace to all beings, for all time.

song.title: hṛdayattin tāḷil ñān
song.source: Hridayattin talil 2025 Mal in Eng v2.pptx

stanza.lyrics: hṛdayattin tāḷil ñān aśru-kaṇaṅgaḷālezhutiya sandēśam eṅgu pōyi?
stanza.meaning: Krishna! Where has the message I wrote with teardrops on the pages of my heart gone?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā ninakkāy ñān nimiṣaṅgaḷ yugam-ākkikāttirikkunnatu maṙannu pōyō?
stanza.meaning: Have you forgotten that I am waiting for you, each moment stretching into an aeon?

stanza.lyrics: virahattin nombaram nī aṙiññīḍukilvṛndāvanatte veḍiññīḍumō?
stanza.meaning: Would you have ever left Vrindavan, Krishna, if you truly knew the agony of separation that I now endure?

stanza.lyrics: piḍayunnor-ōrmakaḷil eriyānī rādhaykkuvirahāgni nalki nī eṅgu pōyi?
stanza.meaning: Where have you gone, leaving Radha to bear the searing anguish of love’s longing?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇinnu kaṇṇāya kaṇṇan illāttoruvṛndāvanattil inn-andhakāram
stanza.meaning: Without you—the inner eye of our self—Vrindavan lies cloaked in darkness.

stanza.lyrics: nin mandahāsattin pūnilā-pāloḷiennī vrajattinn-iruḷ nīkkiḍum?
stanza.meaning: When will the radiant bloom of your smile once more bathe this land in light?

stanza.lyrics: nin divya-līlakaḷ dhanyamāy tīrttorīpuṇya-dēśattinde vīthikaḷil
stanza.meaning: Krishna, in this sacred land where you once played your divine leela,

stanza.lyrics: ā divya-madhuramām smaraṇayilūḍ-ennumkaṇṇane tēḍi naḍakkum en mānasam
stanza.meaning: my heart—immersed in your sweet and sacred memories—wanders ceaselessly in search of you.

song.title: I was lost in the darkness2025(English)
song.source: I was lost in darkness 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/I was lost in darkness 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: I was lost in the darknessIn the shadows of ignorance
Nowhere to go, I looked upon youYou lit the fire in me
Amma Amma Amma AmmaI see the truth I long for
I was lost in the parched worldCraving for peace of mind
Stuck in the desert, I looked upon youYou showered love on me
Amma Amma Amma AmmaI feel the love I long for
I was lost in the lifeless worldCaught in the grasp of fear
Searching for life, I looked upon youYou breathed life into me
Amma Amma Amma Amma

song.title: In the misty mountains Is our Mahadeva
song.source: In the misty mountains 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/In the misty mountains 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: In the misty mountains Is our Mahadeva
Eyes closed and heart openSilently protecting us
tam taka dhimi tam taka dhimiom namah shivayaDance in my heart Nataraja
As soon as you wakeEarth begins to shake
Will I get a chanceTo see your holy dance
You dance and you chanttrident in your hand
God of the three worldsYou are beyond words
tam taka dhimi tam taka dhimiom namah shivayaDance in my heart Nataraja
Cosmic and divineYou rise and you shine
Let me be your NandiTo carry you with me
tam taka dhimi tam taka dhimiom namah shivayaDance in my heart Nataraja
O NeelakanthaO Mahadeva
When I hear your drumMy heart beats in your rhythm

song.title: imbakkuḷattil nīnta ānandamē
song.source: Inbakulattil ninta anandame 2025 Tamil in English.pptx

stanza.lyrics: imbakkuḷattil nīnta ānandamē tumbakkuḍattil uzhala tuyaramē
stanza.meaning: To swim in the pond of happiness is delightful, to be caught in even a small pot of trouble is sorrowful.

stanza.lyrics: imbamō tumbamō tuḷinēramē – aruḷkaḍalētumbasumaiyil nāḍum unpādamē
stanza.meaning: Whether joy or sorrow, all is fleeting. Ocean of grace, Your lotus feet are my only refuge when I am overwhelmed by troubles.

stanza.lyrics: sarvaśaktiyē paramporuḷēgarvamakaṫṫri aravaṇaippāyē
stanza.meaning: O all-powerful, supreme Mother, free me from the grip of ego and gather me into your embrace!

stanza.lyrics: poy kōpam koṇḍa pōtummey unnai nāḍivanta pōtum
stanza.meaning: Even if I pretend to be angry, complaining that you don’t look at me, in reality I seek you.

stanza.lyrics: maiyal koṇḍāyē ennuḷḷamtaiyalāka piṇaiyumē ānandam
stanza.meaning: You have captured my heart, I remain bound to you in bliss.

stanza.lyrics: muḷḷaittuvi tumbam vitaippēnōmullaippū tūviyimbam peṙuvēnō
stanza.meaning: Will I scatter thorns of harshness and cause pain, or will I shower flowers of kindness and spread joy?

stanza.lyrics: muḷ malar māyayāl uzhalvēnōmuḷ nīkki tāyaruḷ peṙuvēnō
stanza.meaning: Will I remain caught in the whirlpool of thorns and flowers? O Mother, will I be able to let go of the thorns and become worthy of your grace?

song.title: iniyum uṇḍēṙe dinaṅgaḷ enikk
song.source: Iniyum undere dinangal 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: iniyum uṇḍēṙe dinaṅgaḷ enikk-ennuanudinam collunnor-en manassē
stanza.meaning: Each day, my mind reminds me that I still have a long life to live.

stanza.lyrics: aṙiyumō jīvande avadhiyī bhūmiyilavivēka-rūpanām nī mozhiyū
stanza.meaning: But O mind, you are the very embodiment of ignorance—how can you possibly know the lifespan of this jiva on earth?

stanza.lyrics: kuḍilata nī nin svarūpam ākki jīva-gati ēṙe yātanāpūrṇṇam ākki
stanza.meaning: You have made deception your very nature and filled my path with suffering.

stanza.lyrics: dharmārttha-kāma-mōkṣaṅgaḷ vidūramāmsvapnam ākki, kālam vyartham ākki
stanza.meaning: A life of dharma—meant to bring prosperity, the fulfilment of desires, and ultimate liberation—you have turned into a distant, fading dream. You have squandered all my time.

stanza.lyrics: paṙayuka nī etra mānava-janmaṅgaḷpatitam ākki pāram viphalam ākki
stanza.meaning: Tell me—how many lifetimes have you wasted, dragging me down?

stanza.lyrics: paṙayuka sārthakam ākēṇḍ-orījanmamitu nī tulaykkuvān mōhippatō?
stanza.meaning: Will you ruin this one too—this life, meant for the realization of my true Self

stanza.lyrics: oru noḍi nī onnu tiriyukillē nindevikala-svabhāvam veḍiyukillē
stanza.meaning: Will you not turn inward, even for a moment? Cast aside this contrary nature of yours.

stanza.lyrics: sahajāvabōdhattil aliyukille? svātma-sukha-makarandam nukarukillē?
stanza.meaning: Will you not merge into your true essence—pure awareness? Will you not taste the nectar of infinite bliss?

song.title: innende katha keḷkkān veṇṇayum uṇḍiḍān
song.source: Innende katha kelkkan 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: innende katha keḷkkān veṇṇayum uṇḍiḍānennōmal kaṇṇane kāttirunnuñān kāttirunnu
stanza.meaning: I wait expectantly for Krishna, hoping he will come to hear my stories and eat the fresh butter I’ve lovingly set aside for him.

stanza.lyrics: pīlittirumuḍi cūḍiḍum uṇṇikkāykācciya pālum ñān karuti vaccu – ennarikil vaccu
stanza.meaning: He will come—with a peacock feather tucked into the knot of his hair, my beautiful Krishna. I’ve boiled milk and kept it warm nearby, waiting with longing in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: ōḍa-kuzhalumāy ōḍi aṇaññīḍumambāḍi-kaṇṇanō entu bhaṅgientu bhaṅgi
stanza.meaning: When he comes running, flute in hand, he is so very beautiful to behold

stanza.lyrics: vaśyamām puñciri kārvarṇṇa niṙamēnivēṇḍilla vēṙini nī tanne mati ini
stanza.meaning: —his smile so alluring, his body the color of storm-laden clouds. I need nothing, no one else. I want only you, my Krishna!

stanza.lyrics: ōrkkuvān ottiri kāraṇam kaṇḍu ñānkaṇṇane kāṇāykil tāṅgumō ñān ini
stanza.meaning: I find endless reasons to remember you. But how will my heart bear it, if I can no longer see you?

stanza.lyrics: entu ñān nalkēṇam ennuṇṇi kaṇṇanāy?en manam ponnākki nalkīḍum ñān ini
stanza.meaning: What more can I give you, my beloved Krishna? I shall purify my mind and offer it to you.

stanza.lyrics: vanamāla ninakkāyi kōrttu vaccu atilenneyum nannāyi cērttu vaccu
stanza.meaning: I have strung a garland of wildflowers for you—and with it, I’ve strung my heart.

stanza.lyrics: kārmukil varṇṇā varuka en kaṇṇānanda-mukundā harē gōpabālā
stanza.meaning: Come, my Krishna, cloud-hued one! Come, protector of the world, embodiment of bliss—come, O son of Nanda!

song.title: innu ñān pūjaykk-irikkumbōḷ
song.source: Innu nyan pujaykku irikkumbol 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Innu nyan pujaykku irikkumbol 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: innu ñān pūjaykk-irikkumbōḷ en manaḥ - kōvilil oru prārthana udicc-uyarnnu
stanza.meaning: Today, as I sat to worship you, a prayer arose in the temple of my heart:

stanza.lyrics: muzhuvan brahmāṇḍavum niṙam-ārnna pūjā-puṣpaṅgaḷe pōle śōbha ārnnīḍaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: May the entire cosmos become like many-colored flowers of offering,

stanza.lyrics: sugandham parattunna candanattiri pōleorumayuḍe sugandham parattīḍaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: and like fragrant incense, may all beings spread the scent of oneness.

stanza.lyrics: ārati taṭṭile niścala-dīpam pōle - ēvarkkum manam niścalam ākaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: Like the steady flame upon the arati plate, may every mind become calm and unmoving.

stanza.lyrics: taṭṭil niṙaññu nilkkum eṇṇa pōle sadā - brahmāṇḍam muzhuvan maṅgaḷam niṙayaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: Like the oil that fills the lamp, may well-being fill the entire cosmos.

stanza.lyrics: tṛppādaṅgaḷil vīṇu kiḍakkunnapūvinde itaḷukaḷ pōle
stanza.meaning: Like each petal that blissfully falls at Your divine feet, may all beings in the universe offer daily worship.

stanza.lyrics: brahmāṇḍaṅgaḷile jīvajālaṅgaḷ ellāmnityōpāsana ceyyumāṙ-ākaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: Like each petal that blissfully falls at Your divine feet, may all beings in the universe offer daily worship.

stanza.lyrics: śānti samādhānam ānandam āhlādam - śaṅkhu-pūraṇam pōle pakarumāṙ-ākaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: Let peace and joy spread in every direction. Like the sound that rises when the conch is blown,

stanza.lyrics: hṛdayaṅgaḷil ninnum ōmkāra-nādam - maṇi-nādam pōle muzhaṅgumāṙ-ākaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: may the sacred Omkara resound in every heart like a bell.

stanza.lyrics: karppūra dīpam katti amarnn-onnumillāte āyatu pōle
stanza.meaning: Like camphor that burns itself into nothingness,

stanza.lyrics: nammaḷ parasparārpaṇamāyi śūnyatayilonnāyi tīrumāṙ-āyiḍaṭṭē
stanza.meaning: let us offer ourselves to one another and dissolve into Oneness

stanza.lyrics: onnāya nammaḷ guruvin tṛppādaṅgaḷilpavitratayārnna prasādamāy tīraṭṭe
stanza.meaning: When we become One, let us be a pure offering at the Guru’s lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: ī prārtthanayil sadguru tṛptanāyēvarilum kṛpa coriyumāṙ-ākaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: May the Sadguru be pleased with this prayer and bestow Her grace upon all.

stanza.lyrics: lōkāḥ samastāḥ sukhinō bhavantu
stanza.meaning: May all beings in all the worlds be happy.

song.title: iruḷ māṙi teḷiyānāy
song.source: Irul mari teliyanay 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: iruḷ māṙi teḷiyānāyitaḷ uḷḷam viriyānāyini entenn-aruḷīḍān kaniyēṇamē… ammē… tuṇa ēkaṇē…
stanza.meaning: For the darkness to dispel and the light to shine within my mind, for the flower of my heart to blossom — Mother, shower me with your grace and tell me what I must do… Mother, be with me always.

stanza.lyrics: vazhi ēṙe alaññu pōy…karakāṇāt-ulaññu pōy…mizhi tūki karakēṙān iḍayākkaṇē…
stanza.meaning: I have wandered long in the ocean of samsara, unable to see the shore, battered by the waves. Won’t you glance at me with compassion, so that I may reach the shore?

stanza.lyrics: matimōham vaḷarunnu gativēgam kuṙayunnunarajanma-guṇam ēki gati ēkaṇē
stanza.meaning: I am sinking deeper into delusion, and my journey is slowing down. Make this human birth worthwhile by leading me towards you.

stanza.lyrics: iruḷ māṙi teḷiyānāyitaḷ uḷḷam viriyānāyini entenn-aruḷīḍān kaniyēṇamē… ammē… tuṇa ēkaṇē…
stanza.meaning: For the darkness to dispel and the light to shine within my mind, for the flower of my heart to blossom — Mother, shower me with your grace and tell me what I must do… Mother, be with me always.

stanza.lyrics: hṛdivīṇa śruti cērān parabhakti-layam ākānniṙayēṇam mama manassil padam ēkaṇē
stanza.meaning: Fill my heart with your presence, so that the vīṇā of my heart may attune itself to supreme devotion and dissolve in it. Grant me the refuge of your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: taṇal tēḍi alayunnu, poruḷ tēḍi ettunnuvaram aruḷi mama hṛttil viḷaṅgīḍaṇē…
stanza.meaning: I wander in search of your life-giving shade; I come seeking the highest truth. Bless me, Mother, and make my heart your home.

stanza.lyrics: iruḷ māṙi teḷiyānāyitaḷ uḷḷam viriyānāyini entenn-aruḷīḍān kaniyēṇamē… ammē… tuṇa ēkaṇē…
stanza.meaning: For the darkness to dispel and the light to shine within my mind, for the flower of my heart to blossom — Mother, shower me with your grace and tell me what I must do… Mother, be with me always.

stanza.lyrics: ammē… tuṇa ēkaṇē
stanza.meaning: Mother, be with me always.

song.title: is duniyā kō kabtak
song.source: Is duniya ko 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: is duniyā kō kabtak manvātū apnī kehlāyēgāīśvar kōtū bhul na jānāant samay pachtāyēgā
stanza.meaning: O Man, how long will you go on claiming this world as yours? If you forget the Lord, in the end, you will have to repent.

stanza.lyrics: māyā kē har jālmēṅ phaskarek din aisā āyēgāgharvālē aur dhan dōlata sabyahī paḍā rah jāyēgā
stanza.meaning: Trapped in the snare of maya, a day surely will come when family, wealth and riches—all will be left behind.

stanza.lyrics: karle tū sat karm rē manvājaplē abtō rām kā nāmdharm sē karlē har ek karm tūbanjāyē jīvan sārthak
stanza.meaning: O Man, chant the name of Rama and engage in good deeds. Let every action be guided by dharma, and your life will become truly meaningful.

stanza.lyrics: marjānē par tū tō manvākuch bhī nālē jāyēgājō ab tak tū karm kiyāhēuskā phal sāth āyēgā
stanza.meaning: O Man, when you die, nothing will go along with you. Only the deeds you’ve done so far will follow and bear their due.

stanza.lyrics: rām rām rām siyā rām rām rām
stanza.meaning: Oh Ram, Sita Ram

song.title: jagadambikē jagadōdhāriṇi mā
song.source: Jagadambike jagadoddharini 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: jagadambikē jagadōdhāriṇi mānitya-kanyē viśvapālakī
stanza.meaning: Mother of the world, upholder of the universe, the immaculate One, sovereign of all creation.

stanza.lyrics: nin pāda-dhūḷiyil smṛtikaḷ layippūmanvantaraṅgaḷum ceṙu tariyāyi
stanza.meaning: The Vedas merge into the dust of your sacred feet, and countless eons shrink to a single grain of sand.

stanza.lyrics: niṙayunnu nāda-brahmavum ārdramāyśruti cērunnu nin mozhiyil
stanza.meaning: The primal sound of Om, which pervades the cosmos, finds its voice in your words.

stanza.lyrics: āḍunnu līlāmōdattāltēḍunnu tyāga-tapasvikaḷe
stanza.meaning: This world is your blissful, divine play. You seek the renunciates who live in disciplined devotion.

stanza.lyrics: ārttaṭṭahāsattōḍ-ennumnṛttam- caviṭṭi ramikkunnu
stanza.meaning: You dance in joy, your laughter echoing in thunderous delight.

stanza.lyrics: ēkākini… sṛṣṭi-pālini… nī
stanza.meaning: You, who dwell in solitude, sustain all of creation.

stanza.lyrics: jay mā… jay mā… jay mā… jay mā…
stanza.meaning: Victory to Mother

stanza.lyrics: jagadambikē jagadōdhāriṇi mānitya-kanyē viśvapālakī
stanza.meaning: Mother of the world, upholder of the universe, the immaculate One, sovereign of all creation.

stanza.lyrics: ēkāntatayil kēzhumī jīvaneoru kuḷirkāṫṫāy nī tazhukiḍillē?
stanza.meaning: Will you not come as a cool and soothing breeze, to caress this soul crying out in lonely solitude?

stanza.lyrics: eriyunna smaraṇa tan kanalāzhiyil nīoru kuḷir-mazhayāy peyyukillē?
stanza.meaning: Will you not pour down as gentle, healing rain upon the ocean of smoldering embers—embers of your memory that burn and sear within me?

stanza.lyrics: ādhikku nitya-virāmam nīmāyakaḷ nīkkum śūlattāl
stanza.meaning: You bring an end to suffering, once and for all. With your spear, you pierce through divine illusions.

stanza.lyrics: koyyunn-ahantaye vāḷttalayālcērkkunnu jīvane nityapadam
stanza.meaning: With your sword, you cut down ego’s pride, and merge the wandering souls into your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: vātsalyamayi… varadāyini… nī
stanza.meaning: You are the tender, compassionate one, the benevolent mother who blesses all beings.

stanza.lyrics: jay mā… jay mā… jay mā… jay mā…
stanza.meaning: Victory to Mother

song.title: jagadīśvarī mā… paramēśvarī mā…
song.source: Jagadisvari Ma Paramesvari Ma 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Jagadisvari Ma Paramesvari Ma 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: jagadīśvarī mā… paramēśvarī mā…bhuvanēśvarī mā… laḷitēśvarī mā…
stanza.meaning: Mother, Goddess who created this universe, supreme Goddess… Mother, source of all creation, O playful and radiant Lalita…

stanza.lyrics: ambē mā… ambē mā… ambē mā…
stanza.meaning: O Mother…

stanza.lyrics: nin tiru nāmam uraykkān… śivēnin pādabhaktiyil tēṅgān
stanza.meaning: O Shive - Supreme Consciousness, O Devi, will you grant me the grace to chant your sacred names, to weep in the ecstasy of love at your divine feet?

stanza.lyrics: tval kṛpa ēkumō dēvī…citpadamē citkalayē cinmayiyē
stanza.meaning: You are the energy of consciousness that pervades all beings, the rhythm of life, the breath of vitality. You are the blissful, divine awareness.

stanza.lyrics: vēdavum nī… nādavum nī… brahmavum nī…
stanza.meaning: You are the Vedas, the primal sound Omkara – You are the absolute truth.

stanza.lyrics: ambē mā… ambē mā… ambē mā…
stanza.meaning: Oh Mother

stanza.lyrics: ādiyum antavum nīyē… tāyē…nī tanne nī tanne satyam
stanza.meaning: Mother! You are the beginning and the end, you are Truth itself.

stanza.lyrics: tval padam ēkumō dēvī…brahma-rūpē… viṣṇu-rūpē… rudra-rūpē…
stanza.meaning: Devi, will you bless me with the grace of your sacred feet? You are Brahma, Vishnu, and Rudra — the powers of creation, preservation, and dissolution.

stanza.lyrics: bhakti ēkū… mukti ēkū… jñāna-dātrī…
stanza.meaning: Bestower of supreme knowledge, grant me devotion, grant me liberation.

stanza.lyrics: ambē mā… ambē mā… ambē mā…
stanza.meaning: Oh Mother

song.title: jāgō jāgō rē manvā
song.source: Jago Jago re manva 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Jago Jago re manva 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: jāgō jāgō rē manvājāgō jāgō rē manvā
stanza.meaning: Awaken, awaken, O human.

stanza.lyrics: bhōg kī nidrā sē ab jāgōmāyā kē is chal kō pēhcānō
stanza.meaning: Rise now from the slumber of worldly pleasures. Recognize the deceit of maya.

stanza.lyrics: ab dēr nā karnā jāgō jāgō rē manvā
stanza.meaning: Do not delay any longer — awaken, O human!

stanza.lyrics: jīvan yē ghaṭtā jāyē har ik kṣaṇ
stanza.meaning: Life is diminishing with every passing moment.

stanza.lyrics: man kī tṛṣṇā kō bujhāyejag pē tan man dhan luṭāye
stanza.meaning: The endless thirst of the mind only consumes itself, while body, mind, and wealth are scattered and wasted upon the world.

stanza.lyrics: rē manvā dēkh lē tērā jīvan kitnā sār hīn
stanza.meaning: O mind, look carefully and see how empty and meaningless your life has become.

stanza.lyrics: dēr huyī ab sambhal jā tērēātma-bhāv kō tū jagā
stanza.meaning: It is already late—gather yourself now and awaken your true inner self.

stanza.lyrics: jāgō rē jāgō jāgō…jāgō… jāgō… jāgō… jāgō…
stanza.meaning: Awaken, O human, awaken...

stanza.lyrics: māyā tujhē bhaṭkāyē har ik pal
stanza.meaning: Maya misleads you at every moment.

stanza.lyrics: sōnē kē piñjrē meiṅ bandhacēt sā pañchī hai tū
stanza.meaning: You are like a bird trapped in a golden cage, unconscious of your own freedom.

stanza.lyrics: jān jā jāg jāyē kaidēṅ tērā ghar nahīṅ
stanza.meaning: Know this, and wake up. These prisons are not your true home.

stanza.lyrics: jñān bhakti kē paṅkh lagākarbhar uḍān vivēk saṅg
stanza.meaning: Fasten to yourself the wings of knowledge and devotion, and with the company of wisdom, take flight.

stanza.lyrics: jāgō rē jāgō jāgō…jāgō… jāgō… jāgō… jāgō…
stanza.meaning: Awaken, O human, awaken...

song.title: jāgo baṅsi vālē
song.source: Jago bansi vale 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: jāgo baṅsi vālē lalanā jāgō mōrē pyārē... jāgō mōrē pyārē...lalanā jāgō mōrē pyārē...
stanza.meaning: Wake up, O bearer of the flute—wake up, my beloved. Wake up, my dear one; O beloved, please awaken now.

stanza.lyrics: rajnī bītī bhōr bhayō hai ghar ghar khulē kivāḍgōpī dahī mathat suniyat haiṅkaṅganā ke jhanakār
stanza.meaning: The night has passed and dawn has arrived; the doors of every home are opening. The gopis are busy churning curds, and the sweet sound of their bangles is echoing through the air.

stanza.lyrics: uṭhō lāl jī bhōr bhayō haisūr nar ṭhāḍē dvārēgvāl bāl sab karat kolāhaljay jay śabd ucārē
stanza.meaning: Rise, O Beloved, morning has come. Gods and sages are standing at your door, and the cowherd boys are making joyful noise, loudly chanting shouts of victory.

stanza.lyrics: mākhan rōṭī hāth meiṅ liṅhigauvan kē rakhvālēmīrā kē prabhu giridhar nāgarsaraṇ āyā kō tārē
stanza.meaning: You take butter and flatbread in your hand, protector of the cows. You are Meera’s Lord, Giridhar Nagar—the one who delivers all who come to you for refuge.

song.title: jalabindu tannilum mazhavil tīrkkum
song.source: Jala bindu tannilum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: jalabindu tannilum mazhavil tīrkkumsakalakalā-dēvatayām ammē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, Goddess of all arts, who paints a rainbow in a raindrop

stanza.lyrics: en hṛdayāśruvil karuṇāmśu tūki nin - prēma-varṇaṅgaḷ teḷiccīḍumō
stanza.meaning: —will you let your compassion fall upon the tears welling from my heart, and reveal your radiant hues of love?

stanza.lyrics: cippikaḷkk-uḷḷil muttukaḷ amba nīśilpa-cāturyattāl tīrttiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: Mother, with deft hands you craft pearls from seashells —

stanza.lyrics: cippiyām hṛttitil nin śilpa-cāturyambhakti tan muttukaḷ vārttīḍumō
stanza.meaning: will you, with the same sculptor’s grace, shape pearls of devotion within the fragile shell of my heart?

stanza.lyrics: mazhamukil kāṇke naḍam āḍīḍān - mayilinu śikṣaṇam ēkiya dēvī
stanza.meaning: O Devi! You taught the peacock to dance beneath rain-laden skies

stanza.lyrics: azhalmukil ennil niṙayumbōḷ nin - karuṇā-mayūram naḍanam āḍīḍumō
stanza.meaning: —when the clouds of sorrow gather in my heart, will the peacock of your compassion dance within me?

stanza.lyrics: mayilin pīliyil varṇṇaṅgaḷ cēloḍucāliccu cērttiḍum citrakārī
stanza.meaning: Divine Artist, who brushed the peacock’s plumes with colors so rare

stanza.lyrics: vairūpyam ārnnor-en uḷkkaḷattiṅkalumsārūpyam ārnna nin rūpam racikkumō
stanza.meaning: —my heart is disfigured; will you paint your eternal, true form within me?

song.title: janimṛti cakram palatum uruṇḍu
song.source: Jani mriti chakram 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: janimṛti cakram palatum uruṇḍujaniyuḍe lakṣyam itaṙiyāte
stanza.meaning: Having wandered through countless cycles of birth and death, without knowing life’s true purpose,

stanza.lyrics: jananī nin tiru kṛpayāl aḍiyantava tṛppaḍiyil itāyetti
stanza.meaning: by your grace, O Mother, this child has reached your sacred doorstep.

stanza.lyrics: pala janmārjita karmattinbhāṇḍam pēṙi valaññu ñān
stanza.meaning: Burdened by the weight of countless karmas across lifetimes, I have suffered deeply.

stanza.lyrics: kanivōd-aḍiyanu nalkiḍaṇējñānappālām tava bhikṣa
stanza.meaning: O Mother, in your compassion, grant this one the alms of your milk of wisdom!

stanza.lyrics: pakaram eniykk-inn-ēkānāypala janmārjita vāsanakaḷ
stanza.meaning: All I have to offer in return are the vasanas I have gathered over countless lifetimes.

stanza.lyrics: dayayārnn-aviḍunn-aruḷaṇamēamṛtatvattin aruḷmozhikaḷ
stanza.meaning: O Mother, shower your mercy upon me and bless me with your words that grant immortality.

stanza.lyrics: karuṇārdra nayanattālkatiroḷi vīśīḍu mama hṛttil
stanza.meaning: With the light of your compassionate gaze, illumine my heart.

stanza.lyrics: ā nayanārkkābhayil viḍaraṭṭehṛdaya-sarōjam mama jananī
stanza.meaning: In the radiance of your eyes, may the lotus of my heart bloom, O my Mother.

song.title: jani-mṛti suḷinīrḍ tikkondē yān
song.source: Jani mriti sulinirdu 2025 Tulu in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: jani-mṛti suḷinīrḍ tikkondē yāndik teriyande untude yān
stanza.meaning: I am caught in the whirlpool of birth and death, lost without any direction.

stanza.lyrics: sarvalōkōg ādhāra īre sarvēśvarākaruṇēdīd kāpule enna viśvēśvarā
stanza.meaning: O Lord —You are the substratum of all the worlds. O Lord of the Universe, please protect me with your compassion.

stanza.lyrics: samsāra-bandhanōḍu mugyūji duḥkha
stanza.meaning: Worldly bondage always leads to endless sorrow.

stanza.lyrics: sukha maḷebillada lekkanē kṣaṇika
stanza.meaning: Pleasures, like a rainbow of desires, are momentary and fleeting.

stanza.lyrics: hṛdayaguḍiṫṫ jñāna-dīpōnu beḷagāle
stanza.meaning: Please light the lamp of knowledge in the shrine of my heart

stanza.lyrics: cirantana āyina sādiḍ īre naḍapāle
stanza.meaning: —help me walk the path of eternal truth.

stanza.lyrics: kālada pōyya kaiyyiḍd enna jārondu uṇḍu
stanza.meaning: The sands of time are slipping through my hands, my life is drifting away.

stanza.lyrics: baduku kalpāvuna pāṭhōṇu teriyare uṇḍu
stanza.meaning: I have still got to learn the many lessons that life teaches us.

stanza.lyrics: malti puṇya oñje yeṅkalna beri barupuṇḍu
stanza.meaning: Only the acts of merit become our true and lasting wealth.

stanza.lyrics: kōpa tāpa buḍudu malpuga śiva dhyānōnu
stanza.meaning: Let me dissolve my anger and sorrow by meditating on Shiva.

stanza.lyrics: karmada kara dinjanaga pōḍu multu
stanza.meaning: When the pot of our deeds is full, the consequences can no longer be delayed.

stanza.lyrics: ill āsti baṅgārn mūlē buḍudu
stanza.meaning: At the time of death, we must leave behind our house, wealth, gold, and all possessions.

stanza.lyrics: nireḷādu īr kāpule enna karuṇāmayane
stanza.meaning: O Compassionate One, protect me under your shelter

stanza.lyrics: mōkṣa korudu kāpule īr muktēśvarane
stanza.meaning: —grant me liberation, O Mukteshvara...

stanza.lyrics: viśvēśvarā… sarvēśvarā…jagadīśvarā… yajñēśvarā…
stanza.meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva, the supreme ruler of all worlds, the entire universe and the controller of all sacrifices.

song.title: jaya śiva śaṅkara mahēśanē
song.source: Jay Siva Sankara Mahesane 2025 Kannada in Eng v2.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Jay Siva Sankara Mahesane 2025 Kannada in Eng v2.pptx

stanza.lyrics: jaya śiva śaṅkara mahēśanēkaruṇēya toru sadāśivanē
stanza.meaning: Hail Śaṅkara, the great Lord! O Sadāśiva, have mercy on us.

stanza.lyrics: bhava samsāradi baḷali toḷaliderakṣaṇa nīḍu jaṭhādharanē
stanza.meaning: We are exhausted by the struggles in the ocean of transmigration and are about to drown. O Lord with matted hair, please protect us.

stanza.lyrics: śivāya namaḥ ōm, śivāya namaḥ ōm, ōm namaḥ śivāya
stanza.meaning: Salutations to the auspicious one!

stanza.lyrics: candrana śiradali muḍidiruvē parama gaṅgēyanu dharisiruvē
stanza.meaning: A crescent moon adorns Your head. The supreme Ganges springs from Your locks.

stanza.lyrics: kāmēśwara kātyāyanī patīnīnē namage sadā gati
stanza.meaning: O master of passion and Lord of Goddess Kātyāyinī, You are always our refuge.

stanza.lyrics: śivāya namaḥ ōm, śivāya namaḥ ōm, ōm namaḥ śivāya
stanza.meaning: Salutations to the auspicious one!

stanza.lyrics: mṛtyu bhayava nī nivārisuprēma bhakti dayapālisu
stanza.meaning: O Lord, please dispel the fear of death. Bestow on us love and devotion.

stanza.lyrics: abhaya nīḍemage rudrēśanēpādakeraguvē pālākṣanē
stanza.meaning: Lord Śiva, please protect us. We surrender to your holy feet.

stanza.lyrics: śivāya namaḥ ōm, śivāya namaḥ ōm, ōm namaḥ śivāya
stanza.meaning: Salutations to the auspicious one!

song.title: jhūlat rādhā saṅg
song.source: Jhulat radha sang 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: jhūlat rādhā saṅg giridhar jhūlat rādhā saṅg
stanza.meaning: Giridhar is swinging together with Radha.

stanza.lyrics: abīr gulālkī dhūm macāyībhar pichkārī raṅg giridhar
stanza.meaning: He stirs up clouds of colored powders, and with the water-sprayer, Giridhar sprays colors.

stanza.lyrics: lāl bhayī bṛndāvan jamunākēsar cūvat raṅg giridhar
stanza.meaning: The Yamuna of Vrindavan has turned crimson, as Giridhar sprinkles saffron colors.

stanza.lyrics: nācat tāl ādhār surabhardhīmī dhīmī bājē mṛdaṅg giridhar
stanza.meaning: The melodies and rhythms give support to the dance, while the mridanga softly resounds, played by Giridhar.

stanza.lyrics: mīrā kē prabhu giridhar nāgarcaraṇ-kamalkū daṅg giridhar
stanza.meaning: Giridhar, the Lord of Mira, the noble one, fills hearts with wonder through his lotus feet.

song.title: jō tum tōḍō piyā
song.source: Jo tum todo piya 2025 Braj in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Jo tum todo piya 2025 Braj in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: jō tum tōḍō piyāmaiṅ nāhi tōḍūṅ rē
stanza.meaning: Beloved, even if you break with me, I will not break with you.

stanza.lyrics: tōrī prīt tōḍu kṛṣṇākaun saṅg jōḍū
stanza.meaning: O Kṛṣṇa, if I were to break my love with you, with whom else could I ever be joined?

stanza.lyrics: tum bhayē taruvar maiṅ bhāyī pañciyātum bhayē sarōvar maiṅ bhāyī macchiyā ā…
stanza.meaning: You are the tree, and I am the bird dwelling upon it; you are the lake, and I am the fish within it.

stanza.lyrics: tum bhayē girivar maiṅ bhāyī cārātum bhayē candā maiṅ bhāyī cakōrā
stanza.meaning: You are the great mountain, and I am but the grass upon it; you are the moon, and I am the cakora bird who gazes unceasingly at you.

stanza.lyrics: ham bhayē mōti prabhujī tum bhayē dhāgātum bhayē sōnā ham bhayē suhāgā
stanza.meaning: You are the pearl, O Lord, and I am the thread that holds it; you are the gold, and I am the ornament formed upon it.

stanza.lyrics: māī mīra kē prabhu vraj kē vāsīsunō hē gōpāl sunō hē gōpāl
stanza.meaning: You are the Lord of Mira, the dweller of Vraja. Listen, O Gopala, listen, O Gopala!

stanza.lyrics: tum mēre ṭhākūr maiṅ tēri dāsi…maiṅ tēri dāsi…
stanza.meaning: You are my master, and I am your servant…

song.title: Jump into the river of love
song.source: Jump into the river of love 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Jump into the river of love 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: Jump into the river of loveSwim through the waves of life,
Amma, guide me to the ocean,Bliss, eternal light.
Jai Amma… Jai Amma… Jai Amma… My Amma!Jai Amma… Jai Amma… Jai Amma… My Amma!
Teach me how to swimThrough happiness and strife,
Floating on the raft of graceI offer you my life.
Jai Amma… Jai Amma… Jai Amma… My Amma!Jai Amma… Jai Amma… Jai Amma… My Amma!
Looking at the river, See not the separate shores,
“I” and “you” merge into LoveWe’re one, forever more.
Jai Amma… Jai Amma… Jai Amma… My Amma!Jai Amma… Jai Amma… Jai Amma… My Amma!

song.title: kahiyō rē prabhu
song.source: Kahiyo re prabhu 2025 Braj in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kahiyō rē prabhu āvan kīāvan kī man bhāvan kīkōī kahiyō rē prabhu āvan kī
stanza.meaning: Someone, please say that the Lord is coming—coming, the one who pleases my heart. Someone, please say that the Lord is coming.

stanza.lyrics: āp na āve likh nahī bejevān paḍī lalcāvan kī
stanza.meaning: He does not come, nor does he send a letter, only the breeze brings a hint of longing.

stanza.lyrics: ye do nainā kahā nahī mānēnadiyā bahē jaisē sāvan kīāvan kī man bhāvan kī
stanza.meaning: These two eyes do not listen—they flow like rivers in the monsoon. Coming, the one who pleases my heart.

stanza.lyrics: kām karō kacu vas nahī mērōpankh nahī uḍ jāvan kī
stanza.meaning: I cannot work; I have no control—like a bird with no wings that longs to fly.

stanza.lyrics: mīrā kahe prabhu kab rē milō gēcērī bhayī hu tērē dāman kīāvan kī man bhāvan kī
stanza.meaning: Meera says, “O Lord, when will you meet me? I have become a servant of the edge of your garment.” Coming, the one who pleases my heart.

song.title: kaitozhunnēn ñān sakhē...
song.source: Kai tozhunen nyan sakhe 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Kai tozhunen nyan sakhe 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaitozhunnēn ñān sakhē... kṛṣṇā…kaitozhunnēn ñān sakhē…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna — my soul’s companion, I pray with folded palms.

stanza.lyrics: nirmala-prēmattin dhvanikaḷ uṇarnnu
stanza.meaning: A music of pure love has arisen inside me;

stanza.lyrics: śāntamāy enmanam niścala nadipōl
stanza.meaning: my mind has become a still river.

stanza.lyrics: vannīḍu en sakhē… en manatāril
stanza.meaning: My soul’s companion, come and dwell in my mind!

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇā… harē… jaya…kṛṣṇā… harē… jaya…kṛṣṇā… harē… jaya…kṛṣṇā… harē…
stanza.meaning: Victory to you, O Krishna!

stanza.lyrics: muḷantaṇḍil ūṙunna madhurita gānam enhṛdaya-tantrikaḷil āzhnn-iṙaṅgi
stanza.meaning: The melody from your flute entered the depths of my heart; in that blissful music,

stanza.lyrics: ā nāda-lahariyil ennātma-bōdhamārdramāy ennil layiccirunnu
stanza.meaning: I merged into the awareness of my true self.

stanza.lyrics: janma-janmāntara puṇyaṅgaḷālen manatāril vann-udiccu
stanza.meaning: O Bhagavan, by the merit gained from many past lives, you now shine brightly within me.

stanza.lyrics: ā prēma-vāridhiyil āṇḍu pōy en manampṛema-svarūpamāy tīrnniḍaṭṭē
stanza.meaning: Let my mind sink into the ocean of your love and be formed into love itself.

song.title: kaise dharuṅ maiṅ dhīrprabhujī
song.source: Kaise dharun main 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaise dharuṅ maiṅ dhīrprabhujī kaise dharuṅ maiṅ dhīrprabhujī prabhujī prabhujīkaise dharuṅ maiṅ dhīr
stanza.meaning: How can I remain courageous, O Lord, how can I remain courageous?

stanza.lyrics: bīt rahī hai yū hī umariyājyū añjali-gat nīrkaise dharuṅ maiṅ dhīr prabhujīkaise dharuṅ maiṅ dhīr
stanza.meaning: Life is slipping away just like that, like water through cupped hands. How can I remain courageous, O Lord, how can I remain courageous?

stanza.lyrics: jap tap dhyān kiyā nā jāyēsāth nā dēvē śarīrkaise dharuṅ maiṅ dhīr prabhujīkaise dharuṅ maiṅ dhīr
stanza.meaning: I can’t manage chants, penance, or meditation, even the body does not support me. How can I remain courageous, O Lord, how can I remain courageous?

stanza.lyrics: man na māne bāt ye merīvo to hai viṣayōṅ kā mītkaise dharuṅ maiṅ dhīr prabhujikaise dharuṅ maiṅ dhīr
stanza.meaning: My mind won’t listen to me, it is a friend of the senses. How can I remain courageous, O Lord, how can I remain courageous?

stanza.lyrics: kaise dekhūṅ tujh kō bhītarparde na pāvūṅ cīrkaise dharuṅ maiṅ dhīr prabhujīkaise dharuṅ maiṅ dhīr
stanza.meaning: How can I see You within, when I cannot tear through the veils? How can I remain courageous, O Lord, how can I remain courageous?

stanza.lyrics: maiṅ terī apnī hūṅ tō phirkyōṅ dētē virahā-pīrkaise dharuṅ maiṅ dhīr prabhujīkaise dharuṅ maiṅ dhīr
stanza.meaning: If I truly belong to You, why then do You give me the pain of separation? How can I remain courageous, O Lord, how can I remain courageous?

song.title: kālccilambaṅgu dhariccuḷḷōḷ2025
song.source: Kal chilambangu dharicchullol 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kālccilambaṅgu dhariccuḷḷōḷkāṙazhakinde niṙamuḷḷōḷkārmukil vēṇi aṇiññuḷḷōḷkāṭṭīḍuk-ammē karimkāḷī
stanza.meaning: She who wears heavy, tinkling anklets; she of radiant, dusky beauty, with dark, wavy hair like rain-laden clouds—protect us, O Mother, fierce and mighty Kali!

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm
stanza.meaning: Dance steps of exultation

stanza.lyrics: dārika-nigraham ceytavaḷdakṣande yajñam muḍiccavaḷdākṣāyaṇi ennu pēruḷḷōḷkāttīḍuk-ammē karimkāḷī
stanza.meaning: She who slew the demon Darika, who shattered Daksha’s prideful yajna, who is known as Dakshayani—protect us, O Mother, fierce and dark Kali!

stanza.lyrics: raktabījane vadhiccavaḷraktattil aṅgu nīrāḍiyōḷraktēśvariyāyi vāzhunnōḷkāttīḍuk-ammē karimkāḷī
stanza.meaning: She who slew the demon Raktabīja, who bathed in the torrent of his blood, who reigns supreme as Rakteswarī—protect us, O Mother, fierce and dark Kali!

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm
stanza.meaning: Dance steps of exultation

stanza.lyrics: nīṇḍu viḍarnna mizhiyuḷḷōḷtāraka-ratnam dhariccuḷḷōḷpauruṣam ārnna tējassuḷḷōḷkāttīḍuk-ammē karimkāḷī
stanza.meaning: She whose eyes are long and wide; who wears the stars as her ornaments; who embodies the vital force of Purusha, the Supreme Being—protect us, O Mother, fierce and dark Kali!

stanza.lyrics: cembaññiccāṙind-azhakuḷḷōḷcembaratti-māla cārttiyōḷcembaṭṭu cēla aṇiññuḷḷōḷkāttīḍuk-ammē karimkāḷī
stanza.meaning: She whose lovely hue resembles rosy red lac; who wears a garland of red hibiscus; who is draped in garments of deepest red—protect us, O Mother, fierce and dark Kali!

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm
stanza.meaning: Dance steps of exultation

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇīru kaṇḍāl aliyunnōḷmātṛvātsalyam curattunnōḷbhakta-janaṅgaḷe pālippōḷkāttīḍuk-ammē karimkāḷī
stanza.meaning: She who melts at the sight of our tears; from whom flows the milk of motherly tenderness; who ever protects her devotees—protect us, O Mother, fierce and dark Kali!

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm
stanza.meaning: Dance steps of exultation

song.title: kālacakram suzhalgiṙatu
song.source: Kala chakram 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kālacakram suzhalgiṙatukālan kālaḍi kēṭkiṙatu
stanza.meaning: The wheel of time keeps turning, and the footsteps of the Lord of Death draw near.

stanza.lyrics: unatu vāzhkkai muḍiyum munnē - uṇmayai uṇarntiḍu māniḍanē
stanza.meaning: Before your life comes to an end, O Man, awaken to the Truth.

stanza.lyrics: nēṫru iruntavar iṇḍru illaieṇḍrumiruppavar yārumillai
stanza.meaning: Those who were here yesterday are no longer with us; no one lives forever.

stanza.lyrics: guruvin vākkai ēṫṫru teḷintujñānum peṙuvīr māniḍarē
stanza.meaning: O Man, realize the supreme truth by listening to, reflecting on, and internalizing the Guru’s words.

stanza.lyrics: kālacakram suzhalgiṙatukālan kālaḍi kēṭkiṙatu
stanza.meaning: The wheel of time keeps turning, and the footsteps of the Lord of Death draw near.

stanza.lyrics: unatu vāzhkkai muḍiyum munnē - uṇmayai uṇarntiḍu māniḍanē
stanza.meaning: Before your life comes to an end, O Man, awaken to the Truth.

stanza.lyrics: vāzhkaiyenbatu iṙaivan varam - vāzhti paṇintiḍa aṙiya taruṇam
stanza.meaning: Human life is a divine gift—a rare opportunity to pray and surrender to God.

stanza.lyrics: maṙayum mumbē maṙaiporuḷ uṇarntiḍunīṙākum munnē uṇmayai aṙintiḍu
stanza.meaning: O Man, before you depart from this world, grasp the essence of the Vedas. Before you turn to ashes, seek to understand the Truth.

stanza.lyrics: kālacakram suzhalgiṙatukālan kālaḍi kēṭkiṙatu
stanza.meaning: The wheel of time keeps turning, and the footsteps of the Lord of Death draw near.

stanza.lyrics: unatu vāzhkkai muḍiyum munnē - uṇmayai uṇarntiḍu māniḍanē
stanza.meaning: Before your life comes to an end, O Man, awaken to the Truth.

stanza.lyrics: nāḷaiyenpatō nammiḍamillaiinḍru maṭṭumē niccayamānatu
stanza.meaning: Tomorrow is not in our hands; all we truly have is today.

stanza.lyrics: ēn piṙantōm enpataiyaṙintālpiṙavippayanai peṙuvāy manitā
stanza.meaning: O Man, if you come to understand the reason for your birth, you will fulfill the true purpose of this life.

stanza.lyrics: kālacakram suzhalgiṙatukālan kālaḍi kēṭkiṙatu
stanza.meaning: The wheel of time keeps turning, and the footsteps of the Lord of Death draw near.

stanza.lyrics: unatu vāzhkkai muḍiyum munnē - uṇmayai uṇarntiḍu māniḍanē
stanza.meaning: Before your life comes to an end, O Man, awaken to the Truth.

song.title: kāladaḷaṅgaḷ kozhiññu tīrnnu
song.source: Kaladalangal 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kāladaḷaṅgaḷ kozhiññu tīrnnuvarṣavum vasantavum pōy maṙaññu
stanza.meaning: The days, like petals of time, have fallen one by one. Many springs and summers have slipped away,

stanza.lyrics: manatāril nin divya-citraṅgaḷ cāliccupadayātra ceyyunna śaraṇārtthan ñān
stanza.meaning: yet still I paint your divine form in my heart with the colours of longing and love. I continue my journey on foot, a refugee seeking shelter in you.

stanza.lyrics: svārttha-mōhaṅgaḷ tyajicc-ende cittilprēma-simhāsanam ñān orukkām
stanza.meaning: I shall renounce all selfish desires and prepare a throne of love for you within my heart.

stanza.lyrics: citaṙiya svapna-kaṇaṅgaḷ koruttorumāla ninakkāy karuti vaykkām
stanza.meaning: From the shreds of my scattered dreams, I shall weave a garland for you.

stanza.lyrics: ī janma-sandhyayil iruḷunna vīthiyiliniyum taḷarnnu ñān mizhi-kūmbaṇō
stanza.meaning: The evening of my life has come, and the path ahead grows dim. Must I close my eyes in weariness and wait through yet another day?

stanza.lyrics: vaṫṫiyōren mizhi-cālil orittiriānanda-bāṣpam niṙacciḍumō?
stanza.meaning: The channels of my eyes have run dry — all my tears have long been wept. Won’t you fill them now with tears of bliss?

stanza.lyrics: nī ennil uṇarāte vēṇḍini pularikaḷpūkkaḷum puzhakaḷum pūntennalum
stanza.meaning: I no longer long for another dawn; what meaning have flowers, rivers, or the fragrant breeze, if you do not awaken within me?

stanza.lyrics: nī varum nāḷināy kāttirippū ammēkāḷikē dēvī kṛpā-varṣiṇī
stanza.meaning: Mother, I wait for the day you will come. O Kalika, most compassionate Devi, shower your grace upon me!

song.title: kālamām cuḍalayil
song.source: Kalamam chudalayil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kālamām cuḍalayil vīṇ-aḍiññucāramāyīḍum manuṣya-janmam
stanza.meaning: Human life will one day turn to ashes in the pyre of time.

stanza.lyrics: veṭṭi piḍikkuvān neṭṭōṭṭamōḍavēōrppatillārumī nityasatyam
stanza.meaning: Yet, when we set out to conquer the world through force and power, we forget this eternal truth.

stanza.lyrics: śāntiykku vēṇḍī āṇōṭṭūm eṅgumpakṣe viṭṭuvīzhcaykk-oru bhāvamilla
stanza.meaning: We are all running behind peace, but we refuse to make any concessions.

stanza.lyrics: svārtthavum kāmavum ñān enna bhāvavumkaiveḍiññāl śānti tēḍiḍēṇḍa
stanza.meaning: If we can let go of selfishness, endless desires, and ego, there will be no need to search for peace outside.

stanza.lyrics: kālamām cuḍalayil vīṇ-aḍiññucāramāyīḍum manuṣya-janmam
stanza.meaning: Human life will one day turn to ashes in the pyre of time.

stanza.lyrics: ūzhi iḷakki madiccu koṇḍu ēṙeūṫṫam paṙaññu naḍannīḍilum
stanza.meaning: One may control the world and go around boasting of power,

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷile uṇmaye tēḍuka allāteśāntiykku maṫṫu vazhikaḷ illa
stanza.meaning: yet there is no path to peace other than to seek the truth within.

stanza.lyrics: ānanda-sāramāy uḷḷil viḷaṅgumammaye kaṇ tuṙannonnu kāṇu
stanza.meaning: Open your eyes and behold the Mother who resides within as the eternal truth, as the very embodiment of bliss.

stanza.lyrics: ātma-tatvam pakarnnīḍunn-orā jaga-dambaye darśiccu śānti nēḍām
stanza.meaning: Let us seek the darshan of the Universal Mother, who leads us to self-knowledge and grants true peace.

song.title: kaḷavēṇu-gānam kēḷkke
song.source: Kalavenu ganam kelkke 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaḷavēṇu-gānam kēḷkke – kaṇṇankarimukil-varṇṇam smṛtiyil teḷiññu
stanza.meaning: When I heard the melody flowing from the Lord’s flute, his form, dark as the monsoon rain clouds, shone vividly in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: kadanaṅgaḷ āṫṫumā kara-calanaṅgaḷ enkaraḷin vēṇuve tazhuki uṇartti
stanza.meaning: His graceful movements, which dissolve all sorrow, caressed awake the flute of my heart.

stanza.lyrics: kaḷavēṇu-gānam kēḷkke – kaṇṇankarimukil-varṇṇam smṛtiyil teḷiññu
stanza.meaning: When I heard the melody flowing from the Lord’s flute, his form, dark as the monsoon rain clouds, shone vividly in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: tan sugandham tēḍi alayunna mān pōlesnēhattin-ulakil ñān alaññiḍāte
stanza.meaning: Like the kasturi deer, wandering the forests in search of fragrance that lies hidden within its own being, I too, should not roam the world seeking love.

stanza.lyrics: gōpyamāy nī ennum akatāril karutīḍumgōpikā-prēmam ennil uṇarttīḍumō?
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, the love that the gopikas bear for you, that you treasure in secret within your own heart will you not awaken that same love within me?

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇā… harē… kṛṣṇā…
stanza.meaning: Oh Krishna

stanza.lyrics: jīvtamām ghōra-saṅgara-bhūmiyilmamatayāl jīvan uzhanniḍave
stanza.meaning: This life is a terrible battlefield. So that my mind does not sink into the sorrow of worldly attachment,

stanza.lyrics: nī annu pārthan-uṇarttiya gīta tansārārtham ennil teḷiccīḍumō?
stanza.meaning: O Lord, reveal to me the essence of the Gita that you once spoke to Arjuna, which enlightened him.

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇā… harē… kṛṣṇā…
stanza.meaning: Oh Krishna

song.title: kāḷikē unnaḍi nān paṇintēn
song.source: Kalike unnadi 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kāḷikē unnaḍi nān paṇintēnkālam ellām ennai kāttiḍuvāy
stanza.meaning: O Kalika, I bow at your feet. Be with me through all time, guiding and protecting me.

stanza.lyrics: karppakamē ennil kanintaruḷakāḷiyāy iṅgu nī avatarittāy
stanza.meaning: O source of all nourishment and grace, you manifested here as Kali, out of compassion for people such as me.

stanza.lyrics: andhacarācaram aṇattilum viḷaṅgumarputa jōtiyē kāḷikē
stanza.meaning: O wondrous light that shines within all that moves and does not move, even in the tiniest atom — O Kalika!

stanza.lyrics: paramanin mārbinil patam patittāyun kōpam taṇiññu nī śāntamāyāy
stanza.meaning: You placed your foot upon the chest of the supreme. Your anger calmed, and you became calm.

stanza.lyrics: śānti svarūpiṇi kāḷikēsatya-svarūpiṇi kāḷikē
stanza.meaning: O Kalika, embodiment of peace… O Kalika, embodiment of truth...

stanza.lyrics: kāmattaiyum kāla-pāśattaiyumaṙuttu nī nilayāṇa vāzhvaḷippāy
stanza.meaning: You destroy desire and the noose of death, and for us to reach the highest goal.

stanza.lyrics: aṙiyāmai enum sirattai aṙuttiḍavējñānattin vāḷinai ēnti nindrāy
stanza.meaning: To sever the head of ignorance, you raised the sword of true knowledge and stood radiant and fierce.

stanza.lyrics: jñāna-svarūpiṇi kāḷikēamṛta-svarūpiṇi kāḷikē
stanza.meaning: O Kalika, embodiment of wisdom... O Kalika, embodiment of immortality...

stanza.lyrics: kāḷiyē tiruśūliyē karai kaḍattiḍa vantāykaruṇai-mazhai pozhintu ennai kāttiḍavantāy
stanza.meaning: O Kali, O sacred trident-wielder! You came to help me cross this vast shoreless world. Pouring down showers of compassion, you came to guide and protect me.

stanza.lyrics: ānanda naḍanam āḍi vanniḍuvāyēakhilattai kāttiḍa nī viṙaintiḍuvāyē
stanza.meaning: Dance the blissful dance and burn away all impurity — spread forth and illuminate the entire universe!

stanza.lyrics: kāḷi kāḷi kāḷi kāḷi kāḷi mādharmattin ādhāram nī ammā
stanza.meaning: Mother Kali! You are the very foundation of dharma, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: kāḷi mā ellām nī ammā
stanza.meaning: Kali Ma, you are everything, O Mother!

song.title: kāḷiya kaigaḷu nīḷa
song.source: Kaliya kaigalu 2025 Kan in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kāḷiya kaigaḷu nīḷa – nannammakāḷiya kaigaḷu nīḷa
stanza.meaning: My mother Kali has very long arms,

stanza.lyrics: baḷasalu iḷeyanu iḍiyāgiporeyalu pakṣimṛgādiporeyalu vṛkṣalatādi
stanza.meaning: long enough to embrace the whole world, to protect the birds and animals, the trees and creepers.

stanza.lyrics: kāḷiya kālu padapadmakāḷiya kālu padapadma
stanza.meaning: Mother Kali’s arms are beautiful and soft as lotus flowers.

stanza.lyrics: kāmēśa aideyanu meṭṭiha āpādake nānigō poḍamaḍuve/ā pādake nānigō poḍamaḍuve
stanza.meaning: I bow down to those sacred feet that stand upon Lord Shiva’s chest.

stanza.lyrics: kāḷiya kaigaḷanēka – nannammakāḷiya kaigaḷanēka
stanza.meaning: My Mother Kali has countless arms,

stanza.lyrics: kādalu rākṣasa duṣṭarannuporayalu akkare makkaḷannu/porayalu akkare makkaḷannu
stanza.meaning: My Mother Kali has countless arms, to destroy evil demons and protect her darling children.

stanza.lyrics: kāṇuva ellava nōḍuvaḷu – kāḷikāṇada ellava kāṇuvaḷu
stanza.meaning: Our Mother Kali sees all—both the outer world and the unseen inner realms.

stanza.lyrics: laya sthiti udbhava kāraṇakartaḷekāraṇa kāraki kāḷi amma/kāḷī mahākāḷī jaya kāḷī mahākāḷī
stanza.meaning: Mother Kali is the source of creation, preservation and destruction. She is the divine power that gives form to all that exists.

stanza.lyrics: kāḷī mahākāḷi jaya kāḷī mahākāḷī
stanza.meaning: O Kali, Great Kali, victory to you!

song.title: kaṇpārammā enai kaṇpārammā
song.source: Kan parammma ennai kan paramma 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Kan parammma ennai kan paramma 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaṇpārammā enai kaṇpārammā – kaḍaikaṇṇālē un makanai kaṇpārammā
stanza.meaning: O Mother, cast your glance on me—cast a sidelong glance upon your son.

stanza.lyrics: dēvarkaḷum unai sūzhntu pōṫṫriḍum pōtudēviyē nān bhaktiyindri uzhaluvatēnō?
stanza.meaning: Even the gods surround you and sing your praises—O Devi, am I to wander without devotion?

stanza.lyrics: tēḍuminta pāmaranum tuṇayaṫṫavanō?dēvi tiruppādam sērum nalgati uṇḍō?
stanza.meaning: Can this ignorant one who seeks you truly be without support? Do I not have the grace to reach your holy feet, O Devi?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇpārammā enai kaṇpārammā – kaḍaikaṇṇālē un makanai kaṇpārammā
stanza.meaning: O Mother, cast your glance on me—cast a sidelong glance upon your son.

stanza.lyrics: katiravan pōl samamāka kāṇpavaḷ nīyēkatiroḷiye parappiḍa ēn tāmatam tāyē
stanza.meaning: You are the one who looks upon all equally, like the sun—O Mother, why then delay in showering your rays of light on me?

stanza.lyrics: kuṙayētum illāta pūraṇi nīyēkuṙayētum pārāmal aravaṇaippāyē
stanza.meaning: You are the perfect One, lacking nothing, will you not overlook my shortcomings and take me in your arms?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇpārammā enai kaṇpārammā – kaḍaikaṇṇālē un makanai kaṇpārammā
stanza.meaning: O Mother, cast your glance on me—cast a sidelong glance upon your son.

stanza.lyrics: pāva puṇyam pārāta unnaruḷālēpāvikūḍa puṇṇiyanāy māṙiḍuvānē
stanza.meaning: Your grace doesn’t discriminate between sin and merit—By it, even the sinner turns saint.

stanza.lyrics: nīyē en manam ellām niṙaintiḍuvāyēnin karuṇai mazhaiyil enai nanaittiḍuvāyē
stanza.meaning: Please Mother, fill my heart—Soak me, O Mother, in the rain of your compassion.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇpārammā enai kaṇpārammā – kaḍaikaṇṇālē un makanai kaṇpārammā
stanza.meaning: O Mother, cast your glance on me—cast a sidelong glance upon your son.

stanza.lyrics: jaya jaya śaṅkari jaya abhayaṅkari ōmkārēśvariyējaya śiva śāmbhavi triśūladhāriṇi ādiśakti niyē
stanza.meaning: Victory to Shankari! Victory to you, O giver of fearlessness, Goddess of the primordial syllable ‘om’. Victory to You, consort of Shiva, bearer of the trident, the primal power!

song.title: kāṇān kotikkayāṇ-uḷḷam
song.source: Kanan kotikkayan ullam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kāṇān kotikkayāṇ-uḷḷam – ammēkāttu ninnīḍumō kālam
stanza.meaning: Mother, my soul aches for a glimpse of you… Will time not pause and wait?

stanza.lyrics: kātōram ettunnat-uṇḍō – enkātara-chitta vilāpam
stanza.meaning: Does the silent cry of my grieving heart reach your ears?

stanza.lyrics: maṇtōṇi māññiḍum munbē - mātṛtīram aṇaññiḍān-āmō?
stanza.meaning: Before this clay boat dissolves, will it reach the divine mother's shore?

stanza.lyrics: ālamba-tantuvāy onnē – prāṇatantriyil prēma-saṅgītam
stanza.meaning: Its only thread of support is this song of love, strung upon my very breath.

stanza.lyrics: paṅkiḍāten snēham ellām – ennum - nin nērkk-ozhukukayāṇ-ammē
stanza.meaning: Mother, I pour out my love to you completely—not a drop do I spare for another.

stanza.lyrics: eṅkilum nī enikk-ēkum – prēma - bhikṣakku tulyamat-uṇḍō?
stanza.meaning: Yet can all I offer compare to even the smallest trace of your divine love, given to me as mere alms?

stanza.lyrics: tulyamāyīḍaṇam snēham – tammilennumē prēma-svarūpē
stanza.meaning: May the love we share remain ever equal, O embodiment of love.

stanza.lyrics: alleṅkil valyapaṅk-ennum – ammēninnōḍ-enikkāyiḍēṇam
stanza.meaning: But, Mother, if one must receive more, let my love for you be the greater.

stanza.lyrics: kalppāntakālam varēkkum – ennil katti nilkkēṇam ī prēmam
stanza.meaning: Let this flame of love stay ablaze within me till the end of time.

stanza.lyrics: alleṅkil ājvāla pulki – ñānumprēma-svarūpi ākēṇam
stanza.meaning: Else, may I merge into that very flame and become the very embodiment of Love!

song.title: kānana kūriruḷ paṫṫi vaḷarnnoru
song.source: Kanana kurirul 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kānana kūriruḷ paṫṫi vaḷarnnorupāzhmuḷaṅkāṭṭil ninnuṫṫu patikkayāl
stanza.meaning: A tiny bamboo seed flew in the wind from a grove deep in the shadows of the dark forest.

stanza.lyrics: ceṫṫamuḷayari kāṫṫēṫṫu nīṅgavēnin prēma-vāḍiyil vīṇatō bhāgyamāy
stanza.meaning: By great good fortune, the wind carried it and placed it gently in your love-filled garden.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā mukiloḷi-varṇṇā… kaṇṇā mazhamukil-varṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, dark as a rain-laden cloud!

stanza.lyrics: gatakarma-anusārattin tāpavumsatkarma-sārattāl pōṣaṇavum
stanza.meaning: It grew, enduring the heat of past misdeeds and drawing nourishment from the fruits of virtue.

stanza.lyrics: uṇaṅgi taḷirttu vāḍi kiḷirkkavēyatnānusāram āyallō kriyāphalam
stanza.meaning: It wilted in the heat and sprouted with grace, understanding that it was experiencing the fruits of its actions.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā mukiloḷi varṇṇā… kaṇṇā mazhamukil-varṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, dark as a rain-laden cloud!

stanza.lyrics: varṣam-ozhiññu teḷiññoru vāḍiyilveṇṇilāvetti pūntennalumāy itā
stanza.meaning: The rains passed, and the garden bloomed. The fragrant breeze danced in, and moonlight poured down.

stanza.lyrics: puṣpa-phalaṅgaḷāl tiṅgi-kuniyavēsapta-svaraṅgaḷ utirttitā kaṇṇanum
stanza.meaning: When fruits and flowers filled the garden, Krishna arrived, playing the seven melodious notes on his flute.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā mukiloḷi varṇṇā… kaṇṇā mazhamukil-varṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, dark as a rain-laden cloud!

stanza.lyrics: pūkkaḷum illāte kāykaḷum illāteoṭṭoru śītaḷa-chāyayum illāte
stanza.meaning: The bamboo reed stood quietly aside in a far garden nook, no fruits, no flowers, no shade to offer.

stanza.lyrics: vāḍi tan kōṇil otuṅgi ninnīḍavēkātilāy-ettītā kaṇṇande vākkukaḷ
stanza.meaning: Yet from its lonely corner, it heard Krishna’s voice.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā mukiloḷi varṇṇā… kaṇṇā mazhamukil-varṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, dark as a rain-laden cloud!

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇanāl connoru kaṇṇande vēṇuvinkātara-kathanam kātōrttu nilkkavē
stanza.meaning: It listened as Krishna spoke tenderly of the flute he held, born of yearning and love.

stanza.lyrics: uḷkāmb-aṙiyāte artthiccu pāzhmanamkaṇṇanōḍ-onnāy cērnnīḍumō prāṇan
stanza.meaning: A deep longing stirred in the reed’s heart, and it prayed, ‘Krishna, will I too be held to your lips? Will this life also merge into yours?’

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā mukiloḷi varṇṇā… kaṇṇā mazhamukil-varṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, dark as a rain-laden cloud!

song.title: kaṇgaḷ unnai tēḍum
song.source: Kangal unnai tedum 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaṇgaḷ unnai tēḍumkālkaḷ tēḍi ōḍum
stanza.meaning: The eyes search for you, the feet run in search of you. Grant me the boon

stanza.lyrics: ōḍum manamumē oḍuṅki unnaiyēnāḍum varamum vēṇḍum
stanza.meaning: so that my ever-restless mind may become still and seeks only you.

stanza.lyrics: gōpiyarkaḷ kūḍagōpālan nīyum āḍa
stanza.meaning: When you, the cowherd boy, dances with the gopis, it becomes a divine dance

stanza.lyrics: āḍum līlaiyāka – orukōḍi piṙavi vēṇḍum
stanza.meaning: — I wish for a crore births just to witness it.

stanza.lyrics: ulakam teriyavillai – oru tavamum purintatillai
stanza.meaning: I did not know the ways of the world, nor did I perform any penance;

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇan nāmam sonnēnmanakavalai ētum illai
stanza.meaning: I simply uttered Krishna’s name, and now there is no worry in my mind at all.

stanza.lyrics: kaḍalaipōla vāzhvum – atannaḍuvil tānē nānum
stanza.meaning: Life is like the ocean - and in its midst, I too drift;

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇan ninaivu onḍrē – ennaikarayil sērkkum ōḍum
stanza.meaning: only the thought of Krishna is the boat that carries me safely to shore.

song.title: kaṇṇā nin kārvēṇikkeṭṭil lasiccīḍum
song.source: Kanna nin kar veni kettil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Kanna nin kar veni kettil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā nin kārvēṇikkeṭṭil lasiccīḍumpīliyāy enne nī cērttīḍumō?
stanza.meaning: Krishna, will you make me the joyous peacock plume that dances in your dark hair knot?

stanza.lyrics: pavizham pōl śōbhikkum madhurādharattilemaṇimuraḷikayāy māṫṫīḍumō?
stanza.meaning: Will you shape me into the flute that rests upon your lips, glowing red like coral? Will you make me your flute?

stanza.lyrics: maṇimuraḷikayāy māṫṫīḍumō?
stanza.meaning: Will you make me your flute?

stanza.lyrics: tirumēni cūḍunna pūkkaḷ koruttoruvanamālayāy enne māṫṫīḍumō?
stanza.meaning: Will you weave me into a garland of forest blooms to grace your sacred, radiant form?

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvanattine dhanyam ākkīḍunnapādam puṇarum cilambākkumō?
stanza.meaning: Will you make me the anklet that clasps your feet—the feet that sanctify Vrindavan? Will you make me your anklet?

stanza.lyrics: pādam puṇarum cilambākkumō?
stanza.meaning: Will you make me your anklet?

stanza.lyrics: tāmara-mizhikaḷ virikkunnor-azhakārnnamazhavillāy enne nī māṫṫīḍumō?
stanza.meaning: Will you turn me into the wondrous rainbow that spreads its beauty from your lotus eyes?

stanza.lyrics: veṇṇa kavarnnīḍum kaṇṇā nin hṛdayattilcērnnoru rādhayāy karutīḍumō? Ninde
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, stealer of butter, will you behold me as Radha—the one who dwells as oneness in your heart?

stanza.lyrics: Ninde priya sakhi rādhayāy karutīḍumō?
stanza.meaning: Will you claim me as your beloved Radha?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā kaṇṇākaṇṇā kaṇṇā kaṇṇāpīliyāy enne nī cērttīḍumō?
stanza.meaning: Krishna, will you make me the joyous peacock plume that dances in your dark hair knot?

song.title: kaṇṇaḍaccōrttāl manassil udikkum
song.source: Kannadacchorttal manassil udikkum 2025 - Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇaḍaccōrttāl manassil udikkumātma-prakāśam āṇamma
stanza.meaning: Mother is the light of the Self that dawns in the mind when we close our eyes and remember her.

stanza.lyrics: eviḍeyāṇeṅkilum dūrattil allāttauḷḷil niṙaññuḷḷa sattaā ātmānubhūtiyāṇamma
stanza.meaning: She is the essence that fills our heart, closer than the closest, wherever we are she is never distant. Mother is the blissful experience of the Self.

stanza.lyrics: ammē mahākāḷī… ammē parāśaktī…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, great goddess Kali! Mother Parashakti!

stanza.lyrics: naśvaram ākumī māyāprapañcattilveṙum oru sākṣiyāṇamma
stanza.meaning: O Mother, great goddess Kali! Mother Parashakti! You are only a witness to this epheremal world of maya.

stanza.lyrics: māyājālaṅgaḷ sṛṣṭīccum poṭṭiccum - hṛdayāntarāḷattil nī vasippū - ennum uḷḷil niṙaññuḷḷa satta
stanza.meaning: Creating and destroying illusions, you reside in the depths of the heart as the supreme unchanging essence.

stanza.lyrics: ammē mahākāḷī… ammē parāśaktī…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, great goddess Kali! Mother Parashakti!

stanza.lyrics: sṛṣṭijālaṅgaḷil kṛpa coriññeppōzhumāśīrvadikkunnu amma
stanza.meaning: Mother ever showers her grace and blesses all the beings in creation.

stanza.lyrics: uṇmayāy mauna sākṣiyāy varttikkumātmānubhūtiyāṇammaennum uḷḷil niṙaññuḷḷa satta
stanza.meaning: She dwells as the essence of existence, as the silent witness, as the experience of the blissful Self that shines within the heart.

stanza.lyrics: ammē mahākāḷī… ammē parāśaktī…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, great goddess Kali! Mother Parashakti!

song.title: tānēy tantānēnānō tānēy tantānēnānō
song.source: Kannan Kalyana rupan - taney tandanenano 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Kannan Kalyana rupan - taney tandanenano 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: tānēy tantānēnānō tānēy tantānēnānōtānēy tantānēnānō tānenānō…
stanza.meaning: (A joyful chorus)

stanza.lyrics: tantānai tānenanō tantānai tānenanōtantānai tānenanōtānenānō…
stanza.meaning: (A joyful chorus)

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇan kalyāṇa-rūpan indrādi vandyan-avannandā-yaśōda-sutan indu-mukhan
stanza.meaning: Let us all come together to sing the glory of Krishna—the embodiment of auspiciousness, adored by Indra and all the Gods, the beloved son of Nanda and Yashoda, whose face shines like the full moon,

stanza.lyrics: pārinn-uḍayavane pālāzhi-nāyakanegōpāla bālakane pāḍuka nām
stanza.meaning: the Lord of the earth and the Milky Way, the divine cowherd boy.

stanza.lyrics: kōlakkuzhalum ūti gōpīmanam kavarnnakōḍakkārvarṇṇan ākum ōmalavan
stanza.meaning: Let us all come together to sing the glory of Krishna—he who enchants the hearts of the gopis with the melodies of his flute, the beloved one,

stanza.lyrics: āyarkulattin ennum ānandam ēkiḍunnakāyāmbū-varṇṇanuḍe līla pāḍū
stanza.meaning: dark as a storm-laden rain cloud, who fills all of Gokulam with joy by his very presence.

stanza.lyrics: kālil cilamb-aṇiññōn kāmaneyum vellum avantādhittā tittai nṛttam āḍiḍumbōḷ
stanza.meaning: He surpasses even Kamadeva, the God of love, with his beauty. When he adorns his feet with tinkling anklets and dances to the rhythm of “tadhita tittai,”

stanza.lyrics: kāḷindi tan alayum kālikaḷum pāriḍavumcārē manam mayaṅgi ninniḍunnu
stanza.meaning: the waves of the Kalindi River grow still, the cows pause, and the entire world stands motionless, hearts captivated by the grace of his divine dance.

stanza.lyrics: kāḷindī tīramatil kāṫṫatt-iḷaki ninnanīlakkaḍambil avan ēṙi uḍan
stanza.meaning: Once, he climbed the branches of a Kadamba tree, heavy with blue blossoms swaying in the breeze along the banks of the Kalindi.

stanza.lyrics: kāḷiyan tan talayil cāḍī ā pāmbu tandekēmattam annu tanne tīrttuvallō
stanza.meaning: From there, he dove into the waters below and subdued the ego of the cruel, venomous serpent Kaliya.

stanza.lyrics: ōrttāl ivan kathakaḷ pērttum pērttum manassilārtti akannu sukham pārttiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: The more one remembers his divine stories, the more attachment to worldly things fades, and the mind is filled with joy and peace.

stanza.lyrics: ōrttīḍū nin manassil cērttīḍū nin padattilārttārtti nāśakanē kāttiḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: Krishna, hold me in your heart and draw me to your sacred feet. Protect me, O you who destroy the sorrows of the distressed who call out to you!

song.title: kaṇṇan eṅgē kāṇavillai
song.source: Kannan enge kanavillai 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇan eṅgē kāṇavillai, en kaṇgaḷin imaigaḷ mūḍavillai
stanza.meaning: Where is Kṛṣṇa? I can't see him anywhere. Tormented by his absence, I cannot close my eyes.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇanai nānum tēḍugirēnkaṇṇīr malgi ēṅgugirēn
stanza.meaning: I search for him restlessly, longing for him with tearful eyes.

stanza.lyrics: nīla mēghamē nilluṅgaḷ, ennīlavaṇṇanai kaṇḍīrō?
stanza.meaning: O blue clouds drifting by, stop: have you see my blue-skinned Kṛṣṇa?
