stanza.lyrics: gānam pāḍum kuyilgaḷē, avankuzhal isai gītam kēṭṭīrō?
stanza.meaning: O warbling cuckoos, have you heard the enchanting notes of Krishna’s flute?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇan eṅgē kāṇavillai, en kaṇgaḷin imaigaḷ mūḍavillai
stanza.meaning: Where is Kṛṣṇa? I can't see him anywhere. Tormented by his absence, I cannot close my eyes.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇanai nānum tēḍugirēnkaṇṇīr malgi ēṅgugirēn
stanza.meaning: I search for him restlessly, longing for him with tearful eyes.

stanza.lyrics: tēnīgaḷē solluṅgaḷ, avandēhattin narumaṇam nugarndīrō?
stanza.meaning: O honeybees, tell me: have you whiffed the divine fragrance of Kṛṣṇa’s form?

stanza.lyrics: pulveḷi mēyum pasukkaḷē, enbālanin kāl taḍam kaṇḍīrō?
stanza.meaning: O grazing cows, have you seen the footprints of my beloved Kṛṣṇa?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇan eṅgē kāṇavillai, en kaṇgaḷin imaigaḷ mūḍavillai
stanza.meaning: Where is Kṛṣṇa? I can't see him anywhere. Tormented by his absence, I cannot close my eyes.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇanai nānum tēḍugirēnkaṇṇīr malgi ēṅgugirēn
stanza.meaning: I search for him restlessly, longing for him with tearful eyes.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇanin kārkuzhal asaivinai, solkāṫṫrē nīyum uṇarndāyō?
stanza.meaning: O wandering wind, have you brushed against Kṛṣṇa’s curly locks?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇanai kaṇḍāl solvīrā? enkavalaigaḷ ellām tīrppīrā?
stanza.meaning: If any of you see Kṛṣṇa, please tell me—and save me from this sorrow of separation.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇan eṅgē kāṇavillai, en kaṇgaḷin imaigaḷ mūḍavillai
stanza.meaning: Where is Kṛṣṇa? I can't see him anywhere. Tormented by his absence, I cannot close my eyes.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇanai nānum tēḍugirēnkaṇṇīr malgi ēṅgugirēn
stanza.meaning: I search for him restlessly, longing for him with tearful eyes.

stanza.lyrics: rādhē kṛṣṇā rādhē kṛṣṇāgōpi kṛṣṇā rādhē śyāmrādhē śyām rādhē śyāmrādhā mādhava rādhē śyām

song.title: kaṇṇan varuvān anbu kaṇṇan varuvāngōpiyargaḷ kural kēṭṭu kaṇṇan varuvān
song.source: Kannan varuvan 2025 Tamil in English.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mannan varuvān maṇivaṇṇan varuvāngōkulamē koṇḍāḍa nammun varuvān
stanza.meaning: Our King will return — the one with the sapphire-blue hue. To fill the hearts of Gokulam with joy, Krishna will come.

stanza.lyrics: veṇṇai thiruḍiḍa nam illam varuvānaṇaikka seṇḍrāl akaṇḍrōḷivān
stanza.meaning: Krishna will come to steal butter from our house, but when we go to embrace him, he will run and hide.

stanza.lyrics: nam kaṇgaḷai mūḍi kaṇṇan nirppānkāṇa tirumbināl kaṇattil maṙaivān
stanza.meaning: Krishna will play with us by covering our eyes, but when we turn around to look at him, he will disappear.

stanza.lyrics: gōkula kṛṣṇa, gōpāla kṛṣṇagōvinda kṛṣṇa, gōpi kṛṣṇa
stanza.meaning: Oh Krishna

stanza.lyrics: mādhavan kaṇṇan māyaigaḷ seyvānvēdattin poruḷai viḷaṅga seyvān
stanza.meaning: Krishna will delight us with his magical tricks and impart the teachings of the Vedas.

stanza.lyrics: gōpiyar manam kuḷira kuḷalūtuvānāḍippāḍiyāḍi mayakkiḍuvān
stanza.meaning: He will play the divine music of his flute to enchant the gopis and mesmerize us with his singing and dancing.

song.title: kaṇṇande dvāraka tēḍi
song.source: Kannande Dvaraka tedi 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇande dvāraka tēḍi ñān cennappōḷkaṇṇan uṙaṅgukayāyirunnu
stanza.meaning: I went in search of Krishna’s Dwaraka. When I arrived, I found him asleep.

stanza.lyrics: nīla manōhara cārukaḷēbaramkaṇṇu kuḷirkke ñān kaṇḍu ninnuñān kaṇṇimaykkāt-aṅgu nōkki ninnu
stanza.meaning: I stood there, gazing to my heart’s content at his beautiful, blue-hued form. I couldn’t bring myself to look away, even for a moment.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇande dvāraka tēḍi ñān cennappōḷkaṇṇan uṙaṅgukayāyirunnu
stanza.meaning: I went in search of Krishna’s Dwaraka. When I arrived, I found him asleep.

stanza.lyrics: bhāva-vilōlayāy kaṇṇunīrālē ñānpuṇya-tṛppādattil onnu toṭṭu
stanza.meaning: Trembling with emotion, tears in my eyes, I gently touched his divine feet.

stanza.lyrics: tillilam koḷḷunna antaraṅgattindeuḷviḷi kēṭṭu kaṇṇan mizhi tuṙannu
stanza.meaning: Moved by the call of my yearning heart, Krishna opened his eyes.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇande dvāraka tēḍi ñān cennappōḷkaṇṇan uṙaṅgukayāyirunnu
stanza.meaning: I went in search of Krishna’s Dwaraka. When I arrived, I found him asleep.

stanza.lyrics: kātarayākum en kadana-bhāraṅgaḷ ellāmkaṇṇande kālkkal tuṙannu veccu
stanza.meaning: At his feet, I unburdened the weight of my heart’s sorrows.

stanza.lyrics: tṛkkaikaḷāl ende kaṇṇīr tuḍacc-avanmeyyōḍu cērtt-enne pulki mōdāl
stanza.meaning: He wiped away my tears with his divine hands and drew me close in boundless compassion.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇande dvāraka tēḍi ñān cennappōḷkaṇṇan uṙaṅgukayāyirunnu
stanza.meaning: I went in search of Krishna’s Dwaraka. When I arrived, I found him asleep.

stanza.lyrics: jīvattuḍippaṫṫa dēhamāy tīrum ñāngōkulabālā nī illayeṅkil
stanza.meaning: O boy from Gokula, without you, I am but a lifeless body.

stanza.lyrics: paṙayuvān palavuru śramiccu ñān eṅkilumkaṇṭhattil nādam kuruṅgi
stanza.meaning: Many times I tried to speak these words, but my voice faltered and caught in my throat.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇanantaraṅgattil niṙaññu ninnu
stanza.meaning: Krishna filled the depths of my being.

song.title: kaṇṇande kāruṇyam kaṇḍāl aṙiyilla
song.source: Kannande karunyam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇande kāruṇyam kaṇḍāl aṙiyillakēṭṭālum oṭṭum aṙiyukīla
stanza.meaning: Lord Krishna’s compassion cannot be grasped, even through seeing or hearing.

stanza.lyrics: ātmānubhūtiyāy kaṇṇan kaniññālēkāruṇya-pūram teḷiyuḷḷū
stanza.meaning: Only if Krishna, through his compassion, grants us the experience of the blissful Self, will we truly know the fullness of his loving kindness.

stanza.lyrics: ponmaṇi dīpam manassil teḷiyuvānsaccidānandam nukarnnīḍuvān
stanza.meaning: For the bright lamp of his radiant face to shine within our heart, and for us to savour the bliss of pure existence,

stanza.lyrics: nāma-saṅkīrttana mālakaḷ cārttēṇammānasa-sāndramām veṇṇa vēṇam
stanza.meaning: we must adorn him with garlands of his name and offer hymns of devotion. Our heart should be like butter floating on water—untouched by the impurities of the world.

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷinde uḷḷam kaṙann-oru bhaktiyāmpaimbāl karutēṇam kaṇṇanāyi
stanza.meaning: We must offer the pure milk of deep devotion that wells up from within.

stanza.lyrics: jīvanām rādhayāy kēṇu viḷiccālōkaṇṇan varum veṇulōlanāyi
stanza.meaning: Only when we cry out like Radha—with intense yearning and selfless love—will the Lord draw near, playing sweetly on his flute.

stanza.lyrics: prāṇa-svarūpanām kaṇṇande gītaṅgaḷprāṇa-praṇavamām nādam ākum
stanza.meaning: Then the songs of Krishna, who is our true Self, will become like the Pranava mantra, resonating with every breath we take.

stanza.lyrics: poncilambin nāda-layaṅgaḷ enuḷḷil tuḍikkunna nādam ākum
stanza.meaning: The music of his golden anklets will echo as the rhythm of our heartbeat.

stanza.lyrics: jīva-svarūpamām kāṙōḷi-varṇṇandekāliṇa keṭṭi puṇarnnu pōyāl
stanza.meaning: If we hold firmly to his divine feet—he who is the life within all beings

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇande kāruṇyam ēṙe teḷiññ-ennālkāruṇya-pūrattil ottu cērām
stanza.meaning: —and if Krishna’s heart is moved by pure compassion, we can become one with his loving Self.

song.title: kaṇṇane eṅgānum kaṇḍuvō?
song.source: Kannane enganum kanduvo 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇane eṅgānum kaṇḍuvō? endekaṇṇanām uṇṇiye kaṇḍuvō?
stanza.meaning: Have you seen my Krishna anywhere? Have you seen my little Krishna, the darling of my eyes?

stanza.lyrics: kāḷindi tannuḍe vārnikkuñjaṅgaḷalilmaṙayunna kaṇṇane kaṇḍuvō?
stanza.meaning: Have you caught a glimpse of –the palyful one who loves to hide amid the secluded thickets by the Kalindi, entwined with trees and blossoming vines?

stanza.lyrics: madhu tēḍi malar tōṙum alayunna madhupā nīmādhavane kaṇḍat-uṇḍō?
stanza.meaning: O honey bee, flitting from flower to flower in search of nectar, have you chanced upon Madhava?

stanza.lyrics: maṇam vīśi viḍarunna palavarṇṇa malarukaḷkk-iḍayil ā padamalar kaṇḍuvō?
stanza.meaning: Did you catch a glimpse of the imprint of His soft feet among the fragrant, many-coloured blossoms?

stanza.lyrics: kārmukilē niṅgaḷ mānatt-eṅgānum enkāyāmbu-varṇṇane kaṇḍuvō?
stanza.meaning: O black raincloud, have you seen my dark-hued Krishna somewhere up in the sky?

stanza.lyrics: māranum tōlkkum ā māyāmayanuḍetāraka-nayanaṅgaḷ kaṇḍuvō?
stanza.meaning: Have you beheld the radiant, starry eyes of the one who weaves divine illusion and whose beauty surpasses even that of the God of Love?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇ-onnaḍaccu ñān tēṅgi karayumbōḷkaṇḍende uḷḷilāy kaṇṇan
stanza.meaning: When I closed my eyes and wept in despair, I beheld my Krishna within me

stanza.lyrics: mānasa-poykayil nīrāḍi nilkkunnumānasa-cōran en kaṇṇan
stanza.meaning: —Krishna, the stealer of hearts, gliding blissfully in the lake of my heart!

song.title: kaṇṇane kāṇānuḷḷ-atimōham koṇḍennō
song.source: Kannane kananull atimoham 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇane kāṇānuḷḷ-atimōham koṇḍennōkaṇṇane kāṇunnu sarvattilum
stanza.meaning: I behold Krishna everywhere, in all things—is it because of my overwhelming yearning for him?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇunīr illāte karayān kazhiyātenīṙi pukayunnit-antaraṅgam
stanza.meaning: Though no tears well up in my eyes, and I am unable to cry, anguish sears my heart.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā..
stanza.meaning: Oh Krishna

stanza.lyrics: nīyām viśudhiyil onnāyi tīruvāntēṅgi piḍayunn-en ātmacittam
stanza.meaning: My true self yearns to dissolve into your pure being, to merge into your divine consciousness.

stanza.lyrics: tēṅgi piḍayunn-en ātmacittam
stanza.meaning: My true self yearns to dissolve into your pure being,

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā..
stanza.meaning: Oh Krishna

stanza.lyrics: aṙiññīḍaṇē kaṇṇā ennuḍe mānasamonnāyi cēruvān kaniyēṇamē
stanza.meaning: O Krishna! Be gracious and know my heart—be compassionate, and grant me oneness with you.

stanza.lyrics: antaraṅgam nī aṙiññīḍumō
stanza.meaning: Will you not know the longing of my inner being?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā..
stanza.meaning: Oh Krishna

song.title: kaṇṇīrōḍu vandēn
song.source: Kannirodu vanden 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇīrōḍu vandēn ammā kavalai ellām marandu cendrēnundan anbai ninaindēn ammā uḷḷam uruki nān azhudēn
stanza.meaning: O Mother, I was in tears when I came to you. But when I reached your presence, I forgot all my sorrow. Thinking of your love, O Mother, my heart melted and I wept.

stanza.lyrics: azhumbōtu āṙutal tandāy vizhumbōtu karamāy vandāytozhumpōtu tuṇaiyāy vandāy nīyē en tāy endrāy
stanza.meaning: O Mother, when I cried, you consoled me. When I stumbled, you extended a helping hand. When I prayed, you came as my companion, assuring me, ‘I am your Mother.’

stanza.lyrics: tūkkattil kanavāy vandāy uṇṇum vēḷai uṇavāy vandāyēkattil ninaivāy vandu eppōtum nī irundāy
stanza.meaning: In sleep, you came as a sweet dream. When I eat, you came as nourishment. In moments of yearning, you came as recollection. You were always there.

stanza.lyrics: vāḍumbōtu amaidi tandāy izhandapōtu tuṇivāy vandāytēḍumbōtu disaiyāy vandāy ilakkai nī kāṭṭi tandāy
stanza.meaning: In moments of sorrow, you offered solace. When I lost hope, you infused courage in me. When I searched, you came as a guide, showing me the spiritual goal.

stanza.lyrics: iruḷil oḷiyāy vandu ariyāmai akaṫṫri tandāymaruḷil teḷivai tandu aruḷāl nī unnaḍi cērttāy
stanza.meaning: In my dark moments, you came as light that dispelled my ignorance. When delusion overwhelmed me, you provided clarity and, with grace, led me to your feet.

song.title: kaṇṇu mucci dēvi nī 2025
song.source: Kannu mucchi Devi ni 2025 Kannda in Eng v2.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Kannu mucchi Devi ni 2025 Kannda in Eng v2.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇu mucci dēvi nī nōḍidē nī nammanu
stanza.meaning: O Goddess, you close your eyes and see us within you,

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇu teredu nāvu dēvihuḍukki hēvu ninnanu
stanza.meaning: while we search for you everywhere with open eyes.

stanza.lyrics: āṭṭa kaṇṇu muccālē āṭṭajīvana itontu kaṇṇu muccāle āṭṭa
stanza.meaning: This life itself is a game of blindfold.

stanza.lyrics: kantanannu kai hiḍidu naṭesihe samarpaṇa kaḍege
stanza.meaning: When you held my hand to guide me toward surrender,

stanza.lyrics: dēvi ninna kai biṭṭu ōṭihe iṣṭa deḍege
stanza.meaning: O Devi, I let go and ran after my desires.

stanza.lyrics: āṭṭa kaṇṇu muccālē āṭṭajīvana itontu kaṇṇu muccāle āṭṭa
stanza.meaning: This life itself is a game of blindfold.

stanza.lyrics: nityānityava tōrisaludēvi nī bayasihē
stanza.meaning: You try to make me understand the eternal and the temporary, O Devi

stanza.lyrics: satyāsatyava kāṇadebendu sōtu hōgihē
stanza.meaning: unable to discern the true from the false, am exhausted and lost.

stanza.lyrics: āṭṭa kaṇṇu muccālē āṭṭajīvana itontu kaṇṇu muccāle āṭṭa
stanza.meaning: This life itself is a game of blindfold.

song.title: kaṇṇunīr chāliccu chālicc-ezhutām
song.source: Kannu nir chalichu 2025 Mal in English v2.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Kannu nir chalichu 2025 Mal in English v2.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇunīr chāliccu chālicc-ezhutām ñān āyiram prēma-kāvyaṅgaḷ ammē
stanza.meaning: With the ink of my tears, I compose a thousand love songs.

stanza.lyrics: tṛppāda-pūjaykkāy prēma-puṣpaṅgaḷ arppicciḍām mana malarkaḷāyi
stanza.meaning: With the petals of love from my heart, I worship your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: entinō vēṇḍi alaññ-etra nāḷukaḷtēḍunnat-entenn-aṙiññiḍāte
stanza.meaning: For years I wandered, not knowing what I was searching for,

stanza.lyrics: vyartham ī jīvitam ennu cinticc-etranombaram pēṙi ī hṛttaḍattil
stanza.meaning: carrying an anguished heart and believing my life had been in vain.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇunīr chāliccu chālicc-ezhutām ñān āyiram prēma-kāvyaṅgaḷ ammē
stanza.meaning: With the ink of my tears, I compose a thousand love songs.

stanza.lyrics: samsāra-duḥkhaṅgaḷ peyt-iṙaṅgīḍunnapulariyil amma en cāre ettī
stanza.meaning: On a dawn when sorrow rained down, you came to me and held me close.

stanza.lyrics: ā māṙil cēṛnn-amarnn-āmayaṅgaḷ nīkkikāvya-pīyūṣam pakarnnu nalki
stanza.meaning: My anguish melted in your embrace, and you nourished me with the ambrosia of poetry.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇunīr chāliccu chālicc-ezhutām ñān āyiram prēma-kāvyaṅgaḷ ammē
stanza.meaning: With the ink of my tears, I compose a thousand love songs.

stanza.lyrics: ezhuti pakartti ōrāyiram kāvyaṅgaḷā divya smṛtiyilēkk-āzhnn-iṙaṅgī
stanza.meaning: I wrote and copied a thousand poems, diving deep into divine memories of you.

stanza.lyrics: enne maṙannu pōy ā prēma bhaktiyilammayil cērnnu manam aliññu
stanza.meaning: In loving devotion, I forgot myself, as my mind dissolved into you, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇunīr chāliccu chālicc-ezhutām ñān āyiram prēma-kāvyaṅgaḷ ammē
stanza.meaning: With the ink of my tears, I compose a thousand love songs.

stanza.lyrics: viśva-vinōdini nī tīrttiḍum māyayilonnum aṙiyātta paital ivaḷ
stanza.meaning: O Mother, who delights in the play of the universe, I am but a child, lost in your divine illusion.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇunīr cālicc-ezhutunnu ammē ninsāyūjya sāmrājya bhūvil ettān
stanza.meaning: Yet I continue to write, with the ink of my tears, in longing to reach your empire of immortal bliss.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇunīr chāliccu chālicc-ezhutām ñān āyiram prēma-kāvyaṅgaḷ ammē
stanza.meaning: With the ink of my tears, I compose a thousand love songs.

song.title: kaṇṇunīr vārnnu vārnn-innende
song.source: Kannu nir varnnu varnnu innende 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Kannu nir varnnu varnnu innende 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇunīr vārnnu vārnn-innende kaṇṇiṇakaṇṇande niṙam ārnnu… śyāma-varṇṇande niṙam ārnnu
stanza.meaning: Tears streaming endlessly from my eyes have turned my lids the dark hue of my Lord.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇunīrāl oru sāgaram tīrkkātekaruṇakkaḍal ozhukkū kaṇṇā karuṇakkaḍal ozhukkū
stanza.meaning: Do not wait for me to weep an ocean of tears, O Krishna, let your ocean of compassion flow toward me.

stanza.lyrics: muraḷīdharā ninde padatāru tēḍi ñānpadayātrayāyitā bhagavānēpadayātrayāyitā bhagavānē
stanza.meaning: O Bearer of the flute, I journey on foot, seeking your lotus feet, O Bhagavan.

stanza.lyrics: āruṇḍī ēzhaye pālikkān ippārilgiridhārī nī allāt-āruṇḍugiridhārī nī allāt-āruṇḍu
stanza.meaning: Who else in this world will care for this wretched one, but you—the One who lifted Govardhana?

stanza.lyrics: maṅgaḷa dēvā! en saṅkaḍam tīrkkuvānsaṅkōcam entinu sarvēśvarā…saṅkōcam entinu sarvēśvarā…
stanza.meaning: O Most Auspicious Lord, why do you hesitate to end my sorrows? Supreme God, why do you delay?

stanza.lyrics: nin kazhal paṅkajam tannōḍu vērpeṭṭajīvitam maṅgaḷamalla dēvājīvitam maṅgaḷamalla dēvā
stanza.meaning: A life apart from your lotus feet is full of misery— O Deva, it is truly inauspicious.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaḍalvarṇṇā… mukilvarṇṇā… maṇivarṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: Krishna, whose hue is that of the ocean, of dark monsoon clouds, and the deep blue sapphire…

song.title: karaḷil kanal eriyunnu
song.source: Karalil kanal eriyunnu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: karaḷil kanal eriyunnu - atinphalamāy manam varaḷunnu
stanza.meaning: The smouldering embers within have parched my heart.

stanza.lyrics: kuḷirmazhyāy nī peytāl en mana-vallari taḷiriḍum ammē (2)
stanza.meaning: O Mother, if you come as cool, gentle rain, the creeper of my heart will bloom.

stanza.lyrics: nin kaniv-uṙavil ariyāt-azhalukaḷozhukum mizhinīr puzhayāy
stanza.meaning: In your compassionate embrace, sorrows will unknowingly flow out as rivers of tears.

stanza.lyrics: ozhuki ozhuki nin prēmāmbudhiyilaṇayum oru-nāḷ ammē (2)
stanza.meaning: Caried by that river, I will reach your ocean of love.

stanza.lyrics: kātarayām ñān ādaravōḍ-enhṛdayam pūjā-malarāy
stanza.meaning: Yearning to be one with you, I have offered my heart as a flower at your feet,

stanza.lyrics: tṛṣṇa veḍiññ-akatāril pīṭhamorukki cēvaḍi paṇiyān (2)
stanza.meaning: with deep reverence. Renouncing all desires, I have made my heart a sacred shrine for you.

stanza.lyrics: varumō hṛttil oru nāḷ ammēsukṛtam ahō! onnōrttāl
stanza.meaning: O Mother! Won't you one day arrive in my heart? What bliss it is to imagine that!

stanza.lyrics: cinmōhana-rūpam akatārilteḷiyaṭṭē manam uṇaraṭṭe (2)
stanza.meaning: May your enchanting form shine within, and may my mind awaken.

song.title: karayunna kuññināy
song.source: Karayunna kunyinay 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: karayunna kuññināy pāl curattunnorukāruṇya-mūrtiyām jagadambikē
stanza.meaning: O Mother of the universe, embodiment of compassion who feeds her crying children with milk

stanza.lyrics: karayān aṙiyātta paitalum pālināyporiyunna vayaṙumāy kāttirippū
stanza.meaning: —this child of yours does not even know how to cry, yet I wait for your milk, my stomach burning with hunger.

stanza.lyrics: nin divyarakṣayām kāruṇya-hastaṅgaḷennum nī nīṭṭaṇē karuṇānidhē
stanza.meaning: Stretch out your compassionate hands — the hands that offer divine protection

stanza.lyrics: ninnil ninnanyamāy tīrāt-irunniḍānnī tanne ennum tuṇaccīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: — and help me, that I may never be separated from you.

stanza.lyrics: dīnata nī aṙiññenne nin cārattāy cērttunirttīṭaṇē ennum ennum
stanza.meaning: Know my helplessness and keep me always close to you.

stanza.lyrics: nin kaḍākṣattāl viḍarunna puñciri uḷḷil viriyaṇē amṛtāmbikē
stanza.meaning: With a single glance, you make a smile blossom in the hearts of all. O Mother Ambika, may a smile also blossom within my heart.

song.title: karinīla-mizhikaḷe
song.source: Kari nila mizhikale 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: karinīla-mizhikaḷe tazhuki uṙakkunnaañjana kūṭṭāṇu ñān
stanza.meaning: I am the dark collyrium that caresses your dark eyes to sleep.

stanza.lyrics: ninnil ninnanya allammē ñān ennum - ninnil ninnuṙiya madhuvāṇu ñān
stanza.meaning: O Mother, I am never apart from you. I am the honey that flows from your being

stanza.lyrics: mātāvallō nī paital allē ñān - nin maḍittaṭṭ-ende śānti-dhāmam
stanza.meaning: Are you not my mother, and am I not your child? Your lap is my abode of peace.

stanza.lyrics: nin rūpam nin chinta nin nāma jāpanam - ninn-aḍimalar ende śaraṇa-mantram
stanza.meaning: Your form, thoughts of you, the chanting of your mantra, your lotus feet are my refuge

stanza.lyrics: pārinnu mizhivēkum malarāṇu nī ammē - malarinn-uṇarv-ēkum maṇam āṇu ñān
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are the flower that makes the world bloom in beauty, and I am the fragrance of the flower.

stanza.lyrics: mānattinn-azhak-ēkum vārmazhavillu nīmazhavillinn-azhak-ēkum varṇṇavum ñān
stanza.meaning: You are the rainbow that graces the sky, and I am the colours of the rainbow

stanza.lyrics: prēmāmṛtānanda sāgaramē - atil oru kuññala ñānum ammē
stanza.meaning: O ocean of immortal, blissful love, O Mother, I am a tiny wave in you.

stanza.lyrics: ninnil allō ñān janicchum ramicchum - ninnil allō ñān layippatammē
stanza.meaning: In you I am born, in you I rejoice, and in you, O Mother, I merge.

song.title: karmavīrā karmavīrā karmavīrā
song.source: Karma vira 2025 - Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: karmavīrā karmavīrā karmavīrākaḍamai tavaṙākarmavīrā karmavīrā
stanza.meaning: Real warrior of action, tireless executor—Lord of Death, you never forsake your duty

stanza.lyrics: kālā kālattil kaḍamai āṭriḍum kāla dēvā
stanza.meaning: Real warrior of action, tireless executor—Lord of Death, you never forsake your duty

stanza.lyrics: kālam maṭṭum kāttāyō?dharmam kūḍa kāttāyō?dharmam kāttu ninḍradālēdharma-dēvan ānāyō
stanza.meaning: Not only did you uphold precise timing, but you also preserved Dharma—and thus came to be known as Dharma Deva.

stanza.lyrics: dharma-dēvan ānāyō
stanza.meaning: —and thus came to be known as Dharma Deva.

stanza.lyrics: karmavīrā karmavīrā karmavīrākaḍamai tavaṙākarmavīrā karmavīrā
stanza.meaning: Real warrior of action, tireless executor—Lord of Death, you never forsake your duty

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇimai imaikkāmal jīvakaṇakēṭṭai nōkki nēram
stanza.meaning: Unblinking, you keep the account of every mortal life, discerning where, when,

stanza.lyrics: iḍam kāraṇaṅgaḷ kaṇḍupuvi bhāram kuṙaikkiṙāy
stanza.meaning: Unblinking, you keep the account of every mortal life, discerning where, when, and why to claim each soul, thereby lightening the earth’s burden.

stanza.lyrics: puvi bhāram kuṙaikkiṙāy
stanza.meaning: thereby lightening the earth’s burden.

stanza.lyrics: karmavīrā karmavīrā karmavīrākaḍamai tavaṙākarmavīrā karmavīrā
stanza.meaning: Real warrior of action, tireless executor—Lord of Death, you never forsake your duty

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇirunthum kuruḍan avankādirunthum seviḍan avan
stanza.meaning: You turn a blind eye and refuse to hear.

stanza.lyrics: kalluḷi maṅgan avan (2)
stanza.meaning: It is for that reason you are known as the stone-hearted one.

stanza.lyrics: ena ēcchu pēccu kēṭṭālum kaḍamai tavaṙā vīrankaḍamai tavaṙā vīran
stanza.meaning: Yet, you are the assiduous executioner and steadfast protector of Dharma.

stanza.lyrics: karmavīrā karmavīrā karmavīrākaḍamai tavaṙākarmavīrā karmavīrā
stanza.meaning: Real warrior of action, tireless executor—Lord of Death, you never forsake your duty

stanza.lyrics: enai kātta guruvinoru darisanam peṙanān darisanam peṙa
stanza.meaning: Do forewarn me before you come, that I may seek the blessings of my protector—my Guru.

stanza.lyrics: un varavai munnē nī uṇarttiḍuvāy
stanza.meaning: Do forewarn me before you come,

stanza.lyrics: guru nāmam… mūchil nilaikkaguru rūpam… kaṇṇil niṙaya
stanza.meaning: Let her holy name resonate with every breath, her divine form fill my eyes;

stanza.lyrics: guru gītam… nāvum pāḍa guruvai tēḍi… kālgaḷ ōḍa
stanza.meaning: let my voice sing her infinite glories, Let my feet carry me to Her sacred abode,

stanza.lyrics: guru aṇaipil… mey silirkagurupādattil… śaraṇaḍaya
stanza.meaning: my heart soar in ecstasy within her embrace, and let me surrender completely at her feet.

stanza.lyrics: nanḍriyum kūṙi viḍeyum petru rājanaḍai pōṭiḍuvēn
stanza.meaning: With gratitude for all the grace bestowed, I walk forward with royal gait toward my death.

stanza.lyrics: enakku nāne amara gītam pāḍiḍuvēn
stanza.meaning: I shall sing my own hymn of immortality.

stanza.lyrics: namah śivāyōm namah śivāyōm namah śivāyōm
stanza.meaning: Om, I bow to the Auspicious One

song.title: kārmukil mānattu tiṅgi niṙayavē
song.source: Karmukil manattu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kārmukil mānattu tiṅgi niṙayavērādha tan mānasam kārvarṇṇamāy
stanza.meaning: As dark rain clouds gathered in the sky, Radha’s heart grew dark-hued with thoughts of her beloved Lord.

stanza.lyrics: manasā avaḷ connu kaṇṇanōḍāykaṇṇā nin rūpam en manam ēkavarṇṇam
stanza.meaning: Within herself, she softly murmured, “Krishna! My heart has taken on the colour of your form.”

stanza.lyrics: pēmārikkāyi mānam tuḍikoṭṭavēmaṫṫoru māriyāy rādha tan nayanaṅgaḷ
stanza.meaning: As the drumbeats of thunder rolled across the sky and the heavens opened in a heavy downpour, tears streamed from Radha’s eyes like rain.

stanza.lyrics: manasā avaḷ connu kaṇṇanōḍāyvrajabhūmi muṅgum en nētrāmbudhārayāl
stanza.meaning: In her heart, she softly said, “Krishna! The land of Vrindavan will drown in the flood of my tears.”

stanza.lyrics: tījvāla pōl avaḷ neñcakam eriyavēpukayunnu rādha tan rōmakūpam
stanza.meaning: As the flames of anguish rose within her heart and every cell of her being smouldered with their heat,

stanza.lyrics: manasā avaḷ connu kaṇṇanōḍāynin virahāgniyāl eriyumī vrajabhūmi
stanza.meaning: she softly said, “Krishna! The land of Vrindavan will burn in the fire of my longing for you.”

song.title: kārmukil niṙam ārnnor-en kārvarṇṇane
song.source: Karmukil niramarnnoren 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kārmukil niṙam ārnnor-en kārvarṇṇanenī en kaṇṇukaḷil nīr pakarnnat-entinu
stanza.meaning: O Krishna! You who have taken on the hue of a rain-laden cloud—why do you fill my eyes with tears?

stanza.lyrics: virahattin duḥkha-tāpam ericcīḍunnu vanamāliyuḍe ōrma ivaḷe mathiccīḍunnu
stanza.meaning: My heart burns with the pain of separation from you; thoughts of you bring great anguish, O you who wears a garland of wild forest flowers.

stanza.lyrics: kārmukil niṙam ārnnor-en kārvarṇṇanenī en kaṇṇukaḷil nīr pakarnnat-entinu
stanza.meaning: O Krishna! You who have taken on the hue of a rain-laden cloud—why do you fill my eyes with tears?

stanza.lyrics: tirike varū śyāma-varṇṇā tarika darśanam hṛttilporiveyil pōl perukiḍunnu śōka-tāpanam
stanza.meaning: Come back, O Krishna, grant me your darshan! Within my heart, sorrow wells up like the heat of noon.

stanza.lyrics: rādhikaykku virahāgniyil vāsam orukki… innīōtīḍunnat-onnum allal tīrkkuvatalla
stanza.meaning: You have left Radhika to dwell in the fire of your separation. The words you sent through your messenger cannot ease this grief.

stanza.lyrics: vāridhikaḷkk-appuṙattu arkkanuṇḍennāl iṅguvārijattin itaḷukaḷ viḍarnnīḍumō?
stanza.meaning: When the sun sets and slips beyond the oceans, the lotus petals cannot bloom.

stanza.lyrics: vāsudēvan vāṇiḍunna mathurayaṅgu tān ennālvārijākṣi rādhikayō gōkulattilum
stanza.meaning: Mathura, where you now reign, lies far from Gokulam, where lotus-eyed Radha waits.

stanza.lyrics: vāymozhiyāl connīḍuvān āvatillahō kaṇṇāvācyamāyatalla innavācyamām vyathā
stanza.meaning: Krishna, this sorrow that consumes me defies all words. It grows unbearable.

stanza.lyrics: ādhiyāl dahicciḍunnoren munnilāy nīādiśēṣa talpaśāyin āgamikkumō?
stanza.meaning: O Mahavishnu, who reclines on the serpent Adishesha, will you not come to me?

song.title: kārmukil varṇṇā ennuṇṇi kaṇṇā
song.source: Karmukil varnna 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kārmukil varṇṇā ennuṇṇi kaṇṇāiṅgu vā iṅgu vā cellakkaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: O Kanna, little one with the color of a raincloud, my darling, won’t you come here?

stanza.lyrics: amma viḷippatu kēḷppatillētiṇṇamiṅg-ōḍi aḍuttu vāyō
stanza.meaning: Won’t you hear your mother calling? Come running to the verandah, come close to me.

stanza.lyrics: uṇṇikkaviḷil orumma tarām - amma tan ponnuṇṇi ōḍi vāyō
stanza.meaning: Let Mother place a kiss on your little cheek. Come, mother’s precious one, come running!

stanza.lyrics: illā varilla ñān ammē viḷikkēṇḍa - ennē ‘kaḷḷan’ ennallī viḷippu nī
stanza.meaning: No, Mother, I’m not coming—don’t call me. You call me a thief

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷil kaḷattil uṙiyil oḷippiccaveṇṇa kaṭṭuṇṇuvān vanna kaḷḷan
stanza.meaning: —the one who came to steal the butter you hid in the kitchen pot.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇonnu teṫṫiyāl kotti paṙanniḍumkākane pōle kaṙutta kaḷḷan
stanza.meaning: The dark little thief who flies off with his prize like a crow the moment your eyes look away.

stanza.lyrics: kārmukil varṇṇā ennuṇṇi kaṇṇāiṅgu vā iṅgu vā cellakkaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: O Kanna, little one with the color of a raincloud, my darling, won’t you come here?

stanza.lyrics: illa varillammē vīṭṭil varilla ñān - kaḷḷanāy-enne nī kaṇḍiḍēṇḍā
stanza.meaning: No, Mother, I’m not coming—I won’t return home. Don’t look at me as if I’m a thief.

stanza.lyrics: uṇṇān enikku nī vaykkēṇḍatill-ammētiṇṇayil pāya viricciḍēṇḍā
stanza.meaning: Don’t set aside food for me, don’t spread a mat for me on the verandah,

stanza.lyrics: cemmē uṙakkuvān tārāṭṭu pāḍēṇḍā - nin koñcal alpavum vēṇḍa tāyē
stanza.meaning: and don’t sing me a lullaby to help me sleep. I don’t want any of your affection!

stanza.lyrics: kārmukil varṇṇā ennuṇṇi kaṇṇāiṅgu vā iṅgu vā cellakkaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: O Kanna, little one with the color of a raincloud, my darling, won’t you come here?

stanza.lyrics: illā varilla ñān ammē nin cārēennē viḷiccu nī kēṇiḍēṇḍā
stanza.meaning: No, Mother, I won’t come—I won’t come to you. Don’t call out and cry for me.

stanza.lyrics: mayilppīlī taṇḍināl talliyillē ennekallural-uḷḷatil keṭṭiyiṭṭu
stanza.meaning: Didn’t you strike me with the peacock feather? Didn’t you tie me to the mortar?

stanza.lyrics: kaṭṭutinnunn-avarkk-ittaram śikṣakaḷ - kiṭṭum enn-ennōḍ-uraccatillē?
stanza.meaning: Haven’t you yourself said that those who steal butter deserve punishments like these?

stanza.lyrics: kārmukil varṇṇā ennuṇṇi kaṇṇāiṅgu vā iṅgu vā cellakkaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: O Kanna, little one with the color of a raincloud, my darling, won’t you come here?

stanza.lyrics: illā varilla ñān ninnuḍe vākkukaḷ - onnumē kēḷkkayum illiniyum
stanza.meaning: No, Mother, I won’t come—starting now, I won’t listen to a single word you say.

stanza.lyrics: kaḷḷan ennennē viḷikkuvān ammaykku - entoru nāvāṇ-ennōrttu nōkkū
stanza.meaning: Just think what kind of tongue you have, to call me a thief!

stanza.lyrics: nannāyi ūṭṭunna vīṭṭil orikkalum - kaṭṭuṇṇum uṇṇimār uṇḍākilla
stanza.meaning: In a home where children are fed well, no child would ever need to steal.

stanza.lyrics: kārmukil varṇṇā ennuṇṇi kaṇṇāiṅgu vā iṅgu vā cellakkaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: O Kanna, little one with the color of a raincloud, my darling, won’t you come here?

stanza.lyrics: amma viḷippatu kēḷppatillētiṇṇamiṅg-ōḍi aḍuttu vāyō
stanza.meaning: Won’t you hear your mother calling? Come running to the verandah, come close to me.

stanza.lyrics: uṇṇikkaviḷil orumma tarām - amma tan ponnuṇṇi ōḍi vāyō
stanza.meaning: Let Mother place a kiss on your little cheek. Come, mother’s precious one, come running!

song.title: kārmukiloḷi-varṇā kōmaḷa
song.source: Karmukiloli varnna 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kārmukiloḷi-varṇā kōmaḷa-kānti tiṅgumtēja-svarūpam ī viśvam āke
stanza.meaning: O Krishna! This universe is a Vrindavan, glowing with the divine radiance of your beautiful dark-hued form.

stanza.lyrics: etra manōharam vṛndāvanam kṛṣṇānin tirusannidhi prēma-pūrṇam
stanza.meaning: Your sacred abode overflows with love.

stanza.lyrics: mādhavā mōhanā muraḷīdharā kṛṣṇāyādavā śrīdharā vāsudēvā
stanza.meaning: O enchanting Madhava, flute-bearer, Lord of the Yadu clan, upholder of all auspiciousness, who dwells in every being…

stanza.lyrics: ninne aṙiyāte ninnil onnākuvānvembum manatāril vann-aṇayū
stanza.meaning: Come into this heart that does not yet know you, yet longs to become one with you.

stanza.lyrics: aṙiyāte kēzhunnu gōpikayāy ñānmādhavā mōhanā muraḷīdharā
stanza.meaning: O enchanting Madhava, O flute-bearer… I am but a Gopika, yearning to know you.

stanza.lyrics: mādhavā mōhanā muraḷīdharā kṛṣṇāyādavā śrīdharā vāsudēvā
stanza.meaning: O enchanting Madhava, flute-bearer, Lord of the Yadu clan, upholder of all auspiciousness, who dwells in every being…

stanza.lyrics: nī niṙaññīḍunnī sarvacarācaramgōkkaḷum puṣpa-latādikaḷum
stanza.meaning: You are the one who dwells in all beings, sentient and insentient alike. You are in the cows, in the flowers, and in the creepers.

stanza.lyrics: māya kāṭṭi kaṇṇā nī maṙaññīḍunnueviḍe nin paramātma citsvarūpam
stanza.meaning: Yet, you have concealed yourself behind your divine illusion. Where is your supreme form of pure consciousness?

stanza.lyrics: mādhavā mōhanā muraḷīdharā kṛṣṇāyādavā śrīdharā vāsudēvā
stanza.meaning: O enchanting Madhava, flute-bearer, Lord of the Yadu clan, upholder of all auspiciousness, who dwells in every being…

stanza.lyrics: alayunnī gōpika etra janmaṅgaḷāyninnilā paramārtha sattayākān
stanza.meaning: I am a Gopika who has wandered through many lifetimes, seeking to merge with your supreme reality.

stanza.lyrics: mādhavā mōhanā muraḷīdharā kṛṣṇāyādavā śrīdharā vāsudēvā
stanza.meaning: O enchanting Madhava, flute-bearer, Lord of the Yadu clan, upholder of all auspiciousness, who dwells in every being…

song.title: karuṇāmayī dayānidhē
song.source: Karunamayi Dayanidhe 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: karuṇāmayī dayānidhē hṛdayēśvarītirumumbilāy en ātma nādam
stanza.meaning: O compassionate one, treasure-house of mercy, Goddess of my heart — receive this earnest, humble prayer arising from my innermost self.

stanza.lyrics: mantra-mugdhamāy tannāthanil mizhinaṭṭusāphalyam nēḍumā sūryakāntiyum pōl
stanza.meaning: The sunflower, purified by mantra, fixes its gaze on the Sun God to blossom and fulfil its life.

stanza.lyrics: ammē! ninnilēykkāy nīḷum en mizhikaḷummāmaka-janmavum saphalam ākkaṇē
stanza.meaning: So too, O Mother, may this life of mine — whose eyes ever seek you — find its fulfilment in you.

stanza.lyrics: pūntiṅkaḷ śōbhayil lasikkumā nīlāmbalānanda-nirvṛti nukarumbōle ammē
stanza.meaning: Like the blue lotus that celebrates itself in joyful exultation beneath the full moon’s silvery gaze — O Mother,

stanza.lyrics: nin pūrṇṇēndu vadanābhayil enmanamdīptamāy ānandamāy tīrttīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: enrapture and illumine my mind with the radiance of your face, more luminous than the full moon.

stanza.lyrics: muttāyi māṙuvān oru tuḷḷi māriykkāyitapassu ceytīḍumā cippipōle
stanza.meaning: The seashell, hidden in the ocean's depths, performs great penance for a single drop of rain — to transform that drop into a gleaming pearl.

stanza.lyrics: ammē nin cilambatin muttāyi māṙuvāntapam ceyyum ennilum nī kṛpa ēkaṇē
stanza.meaning: So too, I do penance, yearning to become a tiny bell on the sacred anklet that graces your feet. Mother, grant me your grace.

stanza.lyrics: sparśana-mātrayil ponnākki māṫṫumācintāmaṇi tan virutatupōl
stanza.meaning: The Chintamani gem skilfully turns all it touches to gold.

stanza.lyrics: ambikē nin divya sparśanattāl ennumamṛtamāy māṫṫaṇēyī jīvaneyum
stanza.meaning: O Mother Ambika, with your divine touch, transform this life into one of immortal bliss.

song.title: karuṇārdra-mānasē hṛdayēśvarī
song.source: Karunardra manase 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: karuṇārdra-mānasē hṛdayēśvarīkanivinn-agādha-hṛttē bhavatāriṇī
stanza.meaning: Mother, Goddess of my heart, whose heart overflows with compassion—Bhavatarini, who carries us across the ocean of samsara—your heart is a boundless lake of mercy.

stanza.lyrics: gurutatva nitya-sattē amṛtēśvarī
stanza.meaning: You are Amriteswari, the eternal essence of the Guru who leads us to liberation.

stanza.lyrics: karuṇārdra-mānasē hṛdayēśvarīkanivinn-agādha-hṛttē bhavatāriṇī
stanza.meaning: Mother, Goddess of my heart, whose heart overflows with compassion—Bhavatarini, who carries us across the ocean of samsara—your heart is a boundless lake of mercy.

stanza.lyrics: manassinde vīṇa mīṭṭum saṅgītamēmanatāril ūṙi vanna madhugītamē
stanza.meaning: You are the music that plays the veena of my mind, Mother, and also the song born of that divine melody.

stanza.lyrics: śruti āṇu nī… layam āṇu nī
stanza.meaning: You are the Goddess of music, the rhythm and melody of the universe,

stanza.lyrics: suralōka-pūrṇṇimē svara-rūpiṇī
stanza.meaning: delighting the Gods with a beauty as radiant as the full moon.

stanza.lyrics: karuṇārdra-mānasē hṛdayēśvarīkanivinn-agādha-hṛttē bhavatāriṇī
stanza.meaning: Mother, Goddess of my heart, whose heart overflows with compassion—Bhavatarini, who carries us across the ocean of samsara—your heart is a boundless lake of mercy.

stanza.lyrics: hima-śōbha tūki nilkkum manamōhinīmahi tande bhāgyamāya māhēśvarī
stanza.meaning: Clad in white, your glory surpasses even that of the Himalayas. O Great Goddess, you are the very fortune bestowed upon this world.

stanza.lyrics: varam ēkumō? niṙav-ēkumō?
stanza.meaning: You, the gracious giver of boons—will you not bless me too?

stanza.lyrics: caritārthan ākkumō varadāyinī?
stanza.meaning: Grant me a life of purpose, perfection, and fulfilment.

stanza.lyrics: karuṇārdra-mānasē hṛdayēśvarīkanivinn-agādha-hṛttē bhavatāriṇī
stanza.meaning: Mother, Goddess of my heart, whose heart overflows with compassion—Bhavatarini, who carries us across the ocean of samsara—your heart is a boundless lake of mercy.

song.title: karuṇārdra-mukilē karaḷ onnu kuḷirān
song.source: Karunardra mukile 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: karuṇārdra-mukilē karaḷ onnu kuḷirānkṛpa ennil coriyillayō?
stanza.meaning: Mother! You are the cloud heavy with compassion—will you not shower your grace upon me and revive this weary heart?

stanza.lyrics: śaradindu samam en amṛtamayī nīmanatāril teḷiyillayō?en manatāril teḷiyillayō?
stanza.meaning: Mother! You are the cloud heavy with compassion—will you not shower your grace upon me and revive this weary heart? I beseech you, O immortal one, shine in my heart like the autumn moon.

stanza.lyrics: śubha-cinta viriyān niṙamaṇam paḍarānśrutivāḍi hṛdi pūkkumō?
stanza.meaning: For noble thoughts to bloom within me and spread their colour and fragrance far and wide, must not the garden of sacred teachings blossom in my heart?

stanza.lyrics: nitya vasantamāy nī illayeṅkiluḷttaḍam maruvāyiḍumen uḷttaḍam maruvāyiḍum
stanza.meaning: But if you, O Mother, do not dwell there as the eternal spring of life, my mind will wither into a barren desert.

stanza.lyrics: jani-mṛti-cuzhiyil valayunnōr-ennekaram ēki kara ēṫṫaṇē
stanza.meaning: Mother! Stretch out your hand and lift me from this whirlpool of birth and death.

stanza.lyrics: aham-akann-akamē pakalu pōl teḷiyumaṙivinnum aṙivallayōnī aṙivinnum aṙivallayō
stanza.meaning: And when my ego dissolves, you—the pure essence of knowledge—will shine within me, clear and resplendent.

song.title: karuniṙa azhakā kaṇṇā
song.source: Karunira azhaga 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: karuniṙa azhakā kaṇṇā – unkaruvizhi rādhai kāttu nirkkinḍrāḷ
stanza.meaning: O dark-hued, beautiful Kanna —Your dark-eyed Radha waits and yearns for you. O dark-hued, beautiful Kanna…

stanza.lyrics: karuniṙa azhakā kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: O dark-hued, beautiful Kanna…

stanza.lyrics: tirumukham kāṇum varamum – inikanavinil tānō kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: The boon of seeing your divine face — will it be only in dreams now, Kanna?

stanza.lyrics: tēnāy iruvarin naḍanam – inikathaiyinil tānō kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: The sweet dance of Radha and Krishna—will it only be retold as stories now, Kanna?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… inikanavinil tānō kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: Kanna, will I receive your vision only in my dreams?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… inikathaiyinil tānō kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: Will the sweet dance be only in stories now, Kanna?

stanza.lyrics: karuniṙa azhakā kaṇṇā – unkaruvizhi rādhai kāttu nirkkinḍrāḷ
stanza.meaning: O dark-hued, beautiful Kanna —Your dark-eyed Radha waits and yearns for you. O dark-hued, beautiful Kanna…

stanza.lyrics: karuniṙa azhakā kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: O dark-hued, beautiful Kanna…

stanza.lyrics: oru vazhi-pātaiyil tānō –avaḷ nēsattin payanam kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: Will her journey be a path that she travels alone, Kanna—will you not return her love?

stanza.lyrics: unaiyē enḍrum nāḍum – uyirsērumō padamalar kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: Will this life that always seeks you ever reach your lotus feet, Kanna?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… avaḷnēsattin payanam kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: Kanna… the journey of her love, Kanna…

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… uyirsērumō padamalar kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: will this life ever reach your lotus feet, Kanna?

stanza.lyrics: karuniṙa azhakā kaṇṇā – unkaruvizhi rādhai kāttu nirkkinḍrāḷ
stanza.meaning: O dark-hued, beautiful Kanna —Your dark-eyed Radha waits and yearns for you. O dark-hued, beautiful Kanna…

stanza.lyrics: karuniṙa azhakā kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: O dark-hued, beautiful Kanna…

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā…

song.title: kāruṇya-vāridhi ākum ī ammaye
song.source: Karunyavaridhi akumi 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kāruṇya-vāridhi ākum ī ammayekāṇān kazhiññat-āṇende bhāgyam
stanza.meaning: It is my great fortune to behold Mother, the ocean of compassion.

stanza.lyrics: etra kaṇḍālum mativarill-ammayecittattil ennum ñān ōrttu pōkum
stanza.meaning: No matter how long I gaze upon her, it is never enough. I always remember Mother in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: cittattil ennum ñān ōrttu pōkum
stanza.meaning: I always remember Mother in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: duḥkha-bhāraṅgaḷkk-orattāṇi āṇ-ammanitya-satyattin pratīkam amma
stanza.meaning: She is the resting place for the burden of our sorrows, the very embodiment of eternal truth.

stanza.lyrics: kadanaṅgaḷ anpōḍ-akaṫṫi amma
stanza.meaning: With boundless love, she removed my pain,

stanza.lyrics: sāntvanam ēki abhayam ēki
stanza.meaning: consoled me, and granted me refuge.

stanza.lyrics: kāruṇya-vāridhi ākum ī ammayekāṇān kazhiññat-āṇende bhāgyam
stanza.meaning: It is my great fortune to behold Mother, the ocean of compassion.

stanza.lyrics: etra kaṇḍālum mativarill-ammayecittattil ennum ñān ōrttu pōkum
stanza.meaning: No matter how long I gaze upon her, it is never enough. I always remember Mother in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: cittattil ennum ñān ōrttu pōkum
stanza.meaning: I always remember Mother in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: kāruṇya-mūrttiyām amma tan tiru munnil kāṇikka veykkānāy onnumilla
stanza.meaning: I have nothing to offer Mother, the personification of compassion.

stanza.lyrics: ā pāda-padmam atonnu tān āśrayam
stanza.meaning: My only refuge lies at her lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: ātmārpaṇattinnāy namikkunnitā
stanza.meaning: I bow before her, surrendering my atman, my true self.

stanza.lyrics: kāruṇya-vāridhi ākum ī ammayekāṇān kazhiññat-āṇende bhāgyam
stanza.meaning: It is my great fortune to behold Mother, the ocean of compassion.

stanza.lyrics: etra kaṇḍālum mativarill-ammayecittattil ennum ñān ōrttu pōkum
stanza.meaning: No matter how long I gaze upon her, it is never enough. I always remember Mother in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: cittattil ennum ñān ōrttu pōkum
stanza.meaning: I always remember Mother in my heart.

song.title: kārvarṇṇan oru dinam
song.source: Karvarnnan oru dinam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kārvarṇṇan oru dinam prēmārdra-muraḷikakalpaḍavonnil maṙannu veccu
stanza.meaning: One day, the dark-hued Lord forgot his flute on the stone steps leading down to the river Yamuna.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇane kāṇāttor-ōrmmayil kaḷavēṇukairava-pūṣpāśru-dhārayāyi
stanza.meaning: The flute’s tears, filled with longing for Krishna, poured into the river and became white water lilies.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇunīr-pūvukaḷ viraltoḍum nērattuśruti cērnna gānam onnālapikkē
stanza.meaning: When those flowers, born of sorrow, were gently touched, they sang a tender, melodious song

stanza.lyrics: karaḷinde kūṭṭile kalviḷakkil cērummṛdu dīpanāḷam atēṫṫu vāṅgi
stanza.meaning: —a song that sank deep into my heart, illumining it with the light of pure awareness.

stanza.lyrics: priyapadam ōrkkavē viḍarumī itaḷukaḷmozhikaḷil cērkkunnu tēnkaṇaṅgaḷ
stanza.meaning: The white-water lilies, blossoming from Krishna’s memory, poured sweet honey into each word of their song.

stanza.lyrics: kadanaṅgaḷ tēḍunna tīraṅgaḷil snēhamadhuraṅgaḷ ēkunnu vṛndāvanam
stanza.meaning: In the hearts of the sorrowing, Vrindavan awakens with the sweetness of divine love.

stanza.lyrics: nīlakkaḍambukaḷ pūkkunnorīṇaṅgaḷōrttu mayaṅgunnu rākkiḷikaḷ
stanza.meaning: The night birds drift into sleep, intoxicated by the beauty of the flowering Kadamba trees.

stanza.lyrics: yamunayil ōḷaṅgaḷ ālapikkum dēvayadukula kāmboji rāgasudha
stanza.meaning: The wavelets of the Yamuna sway to the gentle strains of the Yadukula Kamboji raga.

stanza.lyrics: paribhavam ellām otukkiya pakalindevirahāgni nombaram vāḍi vīzhkē
stanza.meaning: The sun, scorched by the sorrow of separation from the Lord, has set,

stanza.lyrics: atiraṫṫa mōha-pratikṣakaḷ taḷiriḍumtīrattu pūkkunnu candrōdayam
stanza.meaning: now, it is time for the moon of expectation to rise above the serene banks of the Yamuna. The Lord, radiant as the full moon, will soon arrive.

song.title: kathakaḷ aṙiyāte kaḷiyaraṅgil vannu
song.source: Kathakal ariyate 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kathakaḷ aṙiyāte kaḷiyaraṅgil vannukathakaḷi āḍukayallō…
stanza.meaning: Unknowing how the story of my life will unfold, I play out its drama upon the vast stage of this world.

stanza.lyrics: cuvaḍ-ētum aṙiyāte poruḷ entenn-aṙiyātecuvaḍu vaccīḍunnu ñān…
stanza.meaning: I do not know which path is mine, nor do I know my true self—I dance in the darkness of unknowing.

stanza.lyrics: śithilamām vīṇa tan tantriyil mīṭṭunnaśrutibhaṅga-saṅgītamō…
stanza.meaning: Am I but the music of discordant notes, played on a veena with broken strings?

stanza.lyrics: śruti cērnna gītamāy tīrttīḍumō ammēsutanām ivande janmam…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, will you not tune this shattered melody? Will you not make this child’s life a song of harmony?

stanza.lyrics: ammē… sutanām ivande janmam
stanza.meaning: Will you not make this child’s life a song of harmony?

stanza.lyrics: paramārtha-bōdhamām tūveṇṇilāv-ennilparamārtha-bandhu nī tūkukillē?
stanza.meaning: You are my one true kin—will you not illumine me with the moonlight of supreme knowledge?

stanza.lyrics: kadana-tiramāla nīnti kaḍakkuvānkaruṇārdra-mūrtē tuṇaykkukillē?
stanza.meaning: You, the embodiment of compassion, will you not help me cross these turbulent waves of sorrow? O Mother, whose heart melts with mercy, will you not take my hand and lead me home?

stanza.lyrics: enne karuṇārdra-mūrtē tuṇaykkukillē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, whose heart melts with mercy, will you not take my hand and lead me home?

song.title: kāṫṫrinile ilaiyinaippōl
song.source: Kattrinile ilaiyinaippol 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kāṫṫrinile ilaiyinaippōl kaiyyinile ēnti nammai - kālam eṅkē koṇḍu sellum yārukku teriyumatu yārukku teriyum? /
stanza.meaning: Like a leaf in the wind, time carries us in its arms to unknown destinations.... Who knows where?

stanza.lyrics: gōpurattin ucciyilō kuzhinilō kazhivinilō - nāḷai eṅkē nāmiruppōm yārukku puriyumvidi yārukku puriyum?
stanza.meaning: To the top of the highest tower, the depths of the lowest ditch, or a heap of discarded waste - who can say where we will be tomorrow? Who knows what fate has in store for us?

stanza.lyrics: matiyinile mayakkam vantāl, manatinile āsai vantālmāṙukindra anubavaṅkaḷ sokattai koḍukkum /
stanza.meaning: If our intellect is clouded by delusion and our mind consumed by desires, the ever-changing experiences of life will bring sorrow.

stanza.lyrics: matiyinile teḷivu vantāl manatinile daivam vantāl - māṫṫrattilum manitarukku śāntiyum nilaikkum manaśāntiyum nilaikkum
stanza.meaning: But if the intellect is clear and unclouded, and the mind is filled with divinity, peace will prevail even amidst change.

stanza.lyrics: nalamuḍanē vāzhumbōtu naṅku poruḷ īṭṭumbotunālu pērkku nanmai seyya nāmum maṙantāl /
stanza.meaning: If we neglect to help others in need during our good times—when we are thriving and accumulating wealth—

stanza.lyrics: nōyinilē vīzhumbōtu nontu manam vāḍumbōtu - nāḍi sendru utavippeṙa namakkenna urimaipeṙa namakkenna urimai?
stanza.meaning: Then, when misfortune strikes, when illness and sorrow fill our hearts, what right do we have to seek help from others?

song.title: kāttu kāttirunnoru kaḍavilāṇu
song.source: Kattu kattirunnoru 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kāttu kāttirunnoru kaḍavilāṇuamma kaḍalōḷam kanivumāy ettiyatu
stanza.meaning: Mother arrived at the riverbank, where I had been waiting and waiting for so long. She came, carrying an ocean of compassion for me.

stanza.lyrics: kāṫṫil āḍunnoru kotumbu-vaḷḷattekaruṇārdramām kaikaḷāl kāttatu
stanza.meaning: With hands tender with grace, she steadied this little wooden rowboat, swaying in the wind of sorrow.

stanza.lyrics: nukarān koticcoru vātsalyavumkēḷkkān koticcoru tārāṭṭatum
stanza.meaning: The tenderness I longed to savour, the lullaby I yearned to hear, the loving kiss I waited for

stanza.lyrics: pāti-mayakkattil kotiyōḍe kāttirunn-oru muttavum innen svantamallō
stanza.meaning: —even in half-sleep—all of them have now become mine.

stanza.lyrics: kaikaḷe kūppi karaññōru kuññinhṛttile nombaram kaṇḍōramma
stanza.meaning: Mother saw the despair in the heart of this child, who wept with palms joined in worship.

stanza.lyrics: vāri puṇarnnonnu māṙōḍu cērttammakātil ōti ende muttāṇu nī
stanza.meaning: She gathered me into her arms and held me close to her bosom, whispering gently in my ear, “You are my pearl.”

stanza.lyrics: kāttu kāttirunnoru kaḍavilāṇuamma kaḍalōḷam kanivumāyi ettiyatu
stanza.meaning: Mother arrived at the riverbank, where I had been waiting and waiting for so long. She came, carrying an ocean of compassion for me.

stanza.lyrics: amma kaḍalōḷam kanivumāyi ettiyatu
stanza.meaning: She came, carrying an ocean of compassion for me.

song.title: kavalai illaiyē enakku
song.source: Kavalai illaiye 2025 Tamil in English.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kavalai illaiyē enakku kavalai illaiyēen uḷḷam untan iruppiḍamena nān aṙindēnē
stanza.meaning: I have no worries, truly no worries, for I have come to know that my heart is your dwelling place.

stanza.lyrics: undan iccai endan iccaiyēen seyalkaḷ yāvum untan pūjaiyē
stanza.meaning: Your will is my will, all my actions are offerings at your feet,

stanza.lyrics: nigazhum ellā nigazhvukaḷumēnī enakku tanda vara-prasādamē
stanza.meaning: and every single event that unfolds in my life is your gift, your sacred blessing to me.

stanza.lyrics: ondrum aṙiyātta pēdai nān un piḷḷaiyēen kai piḍittu naḍatti selvāy nīyum en tāyē
stanza.meaning: I am but a helpless child who knows nothing, your own little one, so hold my hand and lead me, for you are my mother,

stanza.lyrics: un maḍiyil kiḍakkum piḷḷai nān tānē – enaikai viḍāmal kāttu nirkkum tāyum nī tānē
stanza.meaning: and I am the child who lies cradled in your lap. The mother who guards me without ever letting go is none other than you.

stanza.lyrics: tāyum nī tānē, undan sēyum nān tānēNee maḍiyil vaittu kākkum cellappiḷḷai nān tānē
stanza.meaning: You alone are my mother, and I am yours entirely, your precious child nestled in your lap, protected and loved.

stanza.lyrics: cellappiḷḷai nān tānēammā piḷḷai nān tānē
stanza.meaning: Yes, I am your cherished child, Mother, I am your own little one.

song.title: kayppēṙum jīvita-panthāvil
song.source: Kaypperum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kayppēṙum jīvita-panthāvil ninnu ñānkaruṇa tan attāṇi tēḍi etti
stanza.meaning: I came seeking Mother’s compassion, to lay down the burdens of my life’s bitter journey before her.

stanza.lyrics: amma tan āliṅganattil amarnna ñānānanda-bāṣpattil āṙāḍiyallō
stanza.meaning: In the warmth of her deep embrace, I wept tears of bliss.

stanza.lyrics: ātmīya-jīvita bāla-pāṭhaṅgaḷōāśrama-jīvitattin mahimayō
stanza.meaning: I had not learnt even the first lessons of spiritual life, nor did I know the greatness of living in the ashram.

stanza.lyrics: anyam itellām ennākilum enne nīī puṇya-bhūmiyil svīkariccallō
stanza.meaning: Yet, you accepted me into this sacred land.

stanza.lyrics: kayppēṙum jīvita-panthāvil ninnu ñānkaruṇa tan attāṇi tēḍi etti
stanza.meaning: I came seeking Mother’s compassion, to lay down the burdens of my life’s bitter journey before her.

stanza.lyrics: nūtana jīvita-darśanam ēki ennīṙunna cintakaḷkk-antyam kuṙiccu
stanza.meaning: You gave me a new vision of life, dispelling my thoughts of despair.

stanza.lyrics: nistula-snēhattin āzham aṙiññu ñānninnōmal-kuññāyi māṙān koticcu
stanza.meaning: As I experienced the depths of your incomparable love, I longed to be your beloved child.

stanza.lyrics: eṅkilum ammē nin ‘nalmakaḷ’ ākuvānēzhayām ī makalkk-innum kazhiññilla
stanza.meaning: Even so, Mother, this child has not yet become worthy of being called your good daughter.

stanza.lyrics: ārjjicca puṇyam illeṅkilum ammē ñānazhalōḍe kēzhunnu nin kṛpaykkāyi
stanza.meaning: Lacking any past merits, I pray with deep yearning for you to shower your grace upon me.

song.title: kēḷkkunnat-ellām
song.source: Kelkkunnat ellam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kēḷkkunnat-ellām ā pullāṅkuzhalindepuḷakita-nādamāy tīruvatennō
stanza.meaning: Krishna, when will the day come when every sound I hear becomes the melody of your flute,

stanza.lyrics: nānātva-rūpam ī prapañcattil ennu nincāruśyāma-rūpam kāṇum en kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: and every form I see becomes your beautiful dark form?

stanza.lyrics: cintāsaraṇikaḷ śrī caraṇattilgaṅgābhiṣēkamāy patiyuvat-ennō
stanza.meaning: When will my thoughts flow like the pure waters of the Ganga, to bathe your lotus feet in sacred abhisheka?

stanza.lyrics: nāmāmṛtatte nukarnnu nukarnn-endenāvu nin muraḷikayāvat-ennu?
stanza.meaning: When will the ceaseless chanting of your mantra on my lips bring peace to others, like the soothing music of your flute?

stanza.lyrics: gōvindā hari gōvindā harigōvindā hari gōvindāgōpālā hari gōpālā harigōpālā hari gōpālā
stanza.meaning: O Govinda

stanza.lyrics: karmaṅgaḷ ellām yōgamāy māṙi enjanmamā pādattil arpaṇam āyiḍān
stanza.meaning: Krishna, when will you bless me with the pure devotion that transforms every action into karmayoga

stanza.lyrics: aḍimalariṇakaḷil avikala-bhakti nīaḍiyanum ēkunna nāḷ ini ennō?
stanza.meaning: —union with you? When, O Lord, will my whole life become a true offering at your lotus feet?

stanza.lyrics: gōvindā hari… gōvindā hari… gōvindā hari… gōvindā…gōpālā hari gōpālā hari… gōpālā hari gōpālā…
stanza.meaning: O Govinda

song.title: kināccillayil ende kūḍonn-orukki
song.source: Kinacchillayil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kināccillayil ende kūḍonn-orukkivazhikkāzhcca tan lāsyam ellām nukarnnum
stanza.meaning: I was immersed in the dreams of youth—enjoying the sights,

stanza.lyrics: kaḷiccum madiccum jīvarāgam camaccumpatukke patukke en kālam kazhikke
stanza.meaning: lost in worldly play, full of pride and arrogance, mistaking it all for life, while time slipped silently away.

stanza.lyrics: amma… amma… amma… amma…
stanza.meaning: O Mother…

stanza.lyrics: kizhakkennum ettum sūrya-bimbam kaṇakkeśaralkkāla rāvin pālnilāv-enna pōle
stanza.meaning: Like the sun that rises each day in the east, like the silvery moonbeams of an autumn night,

stanza.lyrics: kaḍal pōlum tōlkkum snēha-vāyppinde āzhampakarnnēki annamma tūmaññu peytu
stanza.meaning: with a love deeper than the boundless ocean, Mother entered my life like fresh, dewy snow.

stanza.lyrics: amma… amma… amma… amma…
stanza.meaning: O Mother…

stanza.lyrics: kazhalttāriṇa cērnnu prēmam nukarnnumaḍittaṭṭil ēṙi kuññ-āmōdamōḍe
stanza.meaning: I fell at her feet and drank deeply of her love. Climbing into her lap like a blissful child,

stanza.lyrics: prabhā-pūrṇṇam ākum cidākāśa tīramkutikkān koticcannu nairmalyam ārnnu
stanza.meaning: I felt my heart grow pure, longing to leap into the inner sky of radiant consciousness.

stanza.lyrics: amma… amma… amma… amma…
stanza.meaning: O Mother…

stanza.lyrics: madiccetti sauvarṇa māyāmarāḷammaṙannu ñān tāy viral-tumbonnu viṭṭu
stanza.meaning: But golden illusions veiled my eyes once more, and I let go of Mother’s secure fingertip.

stanza.lyrics: kitaccum tapiccum muṅgi āzhnniḍum nērampiḍiccen karam amma melle uyartti
stanza.meaning: As I swam and sank, weary and lost in the vast ocean of samsara, Mother gently took my hand and lifted me up.

stanza.lyrics: amma… amma… amma… amma…
stanza.meaning: O Mother…

stanza.lyrics: āṇaccamma en kātil melle mozhiññu‘maṙakkallē mutte! nī ennōmal allē
stanza.meaning: She held me close and softly whispered in my ear: “Do not forget, my pearl—you are my darling,

stanza.lyrics: kiḍakkām ninakkī maḍittaṭṭil ennumkaḍal tāṇḍuvān tōṇi amma tuzhayām’
stanza.meaning: and you may always rest in my lap. Mother shall row the boat that carries you across the ocean of samsara.”

stanza.lyrics: amma… amma… amma… amma…
stanza.meaning: O Mother…

song.title: kiṇu saṅg khēlūṅ hōlī
song.source: Kinu sang 2025 Marwari in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kiṇu saṅg khēlūṅ hōlīpiyā taj gayē haiṅ akēlī
stanza.meaning: With whom can I play Holi now that my beloved has left me and I am alone?

stanza.lyrics: māṇika mōtī sab ham chōḍēgal meiṅ pahanī sēlī
stanza.meaning: I have given up all my jewels and pearls and wear only a simple necklace.

stanza.lyrics: bhōjan bhavan bhalō nahīṅ lāgīpiyā kāraṇ bhayī rē akēlī
stanza.meaning: The dining halls no longer please me; because of my beloved I am left solitary.

stanza.lyrics: mujhē dūrī kyōṅ mēlīpiyā taj gayē haiṅ akēlī
stanza.meaning: Why has this distance come between us? My beloved has left me and I am alone,

stanza.lyrics: kiṇu saṅg khēlūṅ hōlī
stanza.meaning: and I have no one with whom to play Holi.

stanza.lyrics: ab tum prīt avarō sū jōḍīham sē karī… kyōṅ pahēlī
stanza.meaning: Now that you have bestowed your love on another, why do you leave me so bewildered?

stanza.lyrics: bahu din bītē ajahuṅ na āyēlag rahī tālā bēlī
stanza.meaning: Many days have passed, and you have not returned. I am distraught, wondering where your affections are now.

stanza.lyrics: kin bil mā yē hēlīpiyā taj gayē haiṅ akēlīkiṇu saṅg khēlūṅ hōḷī
stanza.meaning: My beloved has left me, and I am alone, with no one to play Holi with.

stanza.lyrics: śyām binā jīyaḍō murjhāvējaisē jal bin bēlī
stanza.meaning: Without Shyam my heart withers like a creeper without water.

stanza.lyrics: mīrā kō prabhu darśan dījōmaiṅ tō janam janam kī cēlī
stanza.meaning: O Lord, grant Meera your darshan, for I am your servant through countless births.

stanza.lyrics: daraś binā khaḍī duhēlīpiyā taj gayē haiṅ akēlī
stanza.meaning: Without the sight of you I stand in sorrow. My beloved has left me and I am alone,

stanza.lyrics: kiṇu saṅg khēlūṅ hōḷī
stanza.meaning: with no one to play Holi with.

song.title: kive karāṅ

stanza.lyrics: ō dāttiye kive karāṅ… ō dāttiye kive karāṅ

stanza.lyrics: ō dāttiye kive karāṅ… ō dāttiye kive karāṅ

stanza.lyrics: pūjā layi mey phāl liyāntē... hōy

stanza.lyrics: pūjā layi mey phāl liyāntēō ciḍiyāṅ dē jūṭhē

stanza.lyrics: ō dāttiye kive karāṅ… ō dāttiye kive karāṅ

stanza.lyrics: pūjā layi mey ṣaid liyāndā… hōy

stanza.lyrics: pūjā layi mey ṣaid liyāndāō makhiyāṅ dā jūṭhā

stanza.lyrics: ō dāttiye kive karāṅ… ō dāttiye kive karāṅ

stanza.lyrics: dāttiye… dāttiye…

stanza.lyrics: mērī bhakti pūrī karkēpūjā kardē pūrī

stanza.lyrics: ō dāttiye… mātā ṙāṇiye

song.title: kṛṣṇā hṛdayēśvarā…
song.source: Krishna Hridayesvara 2025 Mal in Mal.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇā hṛdayēśvarā… kṛṣṇā sakalēśvarā…cirasukha-dāyakā giridhara-bālakāmānasa-cōrā mōhana-rūpā rāsēśvarā
stanza.meaning: Krishna, Lord of my heart, Krishna, Lord of all, bestower of eternal bliss, the boy who lifted Govardhana mountain, the one who stole our hearts, the Lord of the divine Rasa dance.

stanza.lyrics: illa guṇaṅgaḷ collīḍuvāntellum prēmattin madhurimayum
stanza.meaning: I have no worthy virtues to my name, nor the sweetness of true love to offer

stanza.lyrics: nin ninavonnatu mātram enikkuennum tuṇayāy sarvēśvarā
stanza.meaning: —yet O Lord of the universe, your remembrance has been my unfailing support.

stanza.lyrics: jaya jaya śyāma-gōpabālājaya jaya vēṇu-vādalōlā
stanza.meaning: Victory to the dark-hued one, victory to the enchanting flute-player!

stanza.lyrics: jaya jaya śōka-nāśa dēvājaya jaya vāsudēva śaurē
stanza.meaning: Victory to the Lord who dispels all sorrow, victory to the courageous Vasudeva!

stanza.lyrics: kazhaliṇa tozhuvān varam ēkumō?kaṇikaṇḍ-uṇarān kaniv-ēkumō?
stanza.meaning: Will you bless me, that I may worship at your lotus feet? Will you be compassionate, that I may awaken to see your radiant form before my eyes?

stanza.lyrics: mativaruvōḷam en manassām poykayilmaṇivarṇṇā nī kaḷiyāḍumō?
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, my precious jewel, come, play and delight, bathe in the lake of my heart for as long as you desire.

stanza.lyrics: jaya jaya śyāma-gōpabālājaya jaya vēṇu-vādalōlā
stanza.meaning: Victory to the dark-hued one, victory to the enchanting flute-player!

stanza.lyrics: jaya jaya śōka-nāśa dēvājaya jaya vāsudēva śaurē
stanza.meaning: Victory to the Lord who dispels all sorrow, victory to the courageous Vasudeva!

song.title: kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa nārāyaṇā kṛṣṇa
song.source: Krishna Krishna Narayana 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa nārāyaṇā kṛṣṇagōvindā mādhavā harē
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, Narayana, Govinda, Madhava, I take refuge in you.

stanza.lyrics: dīnanātha sundarānanā harēvāsudēva nitya-satyamē
stanza.meaning: You are the beautiful Lord who uplifts the suffering. You are the son of Vasudeva, the eternal truth.

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa nārāyaṇā kṛṣṇagōvindā mādhavā harē
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, Narayana, Govinda, Madhava, I take refuge in you.

stanza.lyrics: karṇikārasūna śōbhitā cala-kaṇṭhahāra sundarāṅgitā
stanza.meaning: Adorned with a garland of golden shower flowers, your radiant beauty glows. The necklaces on your chest sway with every graceful movement you make.

stanza.lyrics: kāmarūpa cārulōcanā cira-kāmitārtthadāna mōhanā
stanza.meaning: Your splendour rivals that of Kamadeva, the God of Love. O enchanting Krishna, you are the one who fulfills my long-held, ardent desires.

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa nārāyaṇā kṛṣṇagōvindā mādhavā harē
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, Narayana, Govinda, Madhava, I take refuge in you.

stanza.lyrics: kuṫṫam ēṙe uṇḍenikkahō tavabhakti onnu mātram āśrayam
stanza.meaning: I have many faults and shortcomings, I have only my devotion to you as my refuge.

stanza.lyrics: kūṭṭin-ārumill-enikkahō sadākūḍe ninnu kāttukoḷḷaṇē
stanza.meaning: I have no one else to call my own, Krishna, be with me always, and protect me!

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa nārāyaṇā kṛṣṇagōvindā mādhavā harē
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, Narayana, Govinda, Madhava, I take refuge in you.

stanza.lyrics: kēḷi kēṭṭa sādhu-rakṣakā mamadēhabōdha-bādha nīkkaṇē
stanza.meaning: You are renowned as the protector of the poor and the helpless. Release me from this false identification with the body.

stanza.lyrics: kaitozhunnu kāruṇyāmbudhē tavakaikaḷ tannu kara-kayaṫṫaṇē
stanza.meaning: O ocean of compassion! I pray to you with folded palms- extend your hand and lead me safely to the shore of this vast ocean of samsara.

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa nārāyaṇā kṛṣṇagōvindā mādhavā harē
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, Narayana, Govinda, Madhava, I take refuge in you.

stanza.lyrics: kautukaṅgaḷ nīkki enne nī madhukaiṭabhāri kāttukoḷḷaṇē
stanza.meaning: Krishna! You who slew the asuras Madhu and Kaitabha — remove from me the desire for worldly comforts and protect me.

stanza.lyrics: ambujaṅgaḷ kaitozhunnorā pada-paṅkajaṅgaḷ kaitozhunnitā
stanza.meaning: I humbly bow down at your lotus feet that are worshipped by the blooming lotuses themselves.

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa nārāyaṇā kṛṣṇagōvindā mādhavā harē
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, Narayana, Govinda, Madhava, I take refuge in you.

song.title: kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa vāsudēva satyabhāma-cittacōrā
song.source: Krishna Krishna Vasudeva 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa vāsudēva satyabhāma-cittacōrāacyutā gōvinda śaurē nitya-nirmalā
stanza.meaning: Krishna, son of Vasudeva, Stealer of Satyabhama’s heart, eternally steadfast, indestructible, pure and courageous Govinda…

stanza.lyrics: karṇṇikāram pūttulaññū kārvarṇṇane kāttirunnuariyorarayil aramaṇiyumāy araṅgorukkīḍān
stanza.meaning: The golden shower trees are in full bloom, setting the stage for your arrival, their waists adorned with belts of yellow flowers.

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvana veṇ maṇṇinu dāhamāy… āambiḷikkala neṫṫiyil oru toḍukuṙi ākkān
stanza.meaning: The pure white earth of Vrindavan longs to place a tilak upon your forehead, as beautiful as the crescent moon.

stanza.lyrics: mandārappū viḍarnnu nanda-gēhattil… ānanda-nandanan māṙil oru mālayāy tīrān
stanza.meaning: Mandara flowers have started to blossom in Nanda’s home, eager to become garlands to grace your neck.

stanza.lyrics: kēkīvṛndam nṛttamāḍi pīli utirttu… ānīla vārmuḍi keṭṭil oru pīlippū cūḍān
stanza.meaning: Peacocks dance in delight, awaiting you, letting their feathers fall to the ground, hoping their plumes will adorn your hair.

stanza.lyrics: prēmagītam pāḍi āḍi pāzh-muḷantaṇḍum… āprāṇa-nāthan adharam aṇayum muraḷika āvān
stanza.meaning: The bamboo reeds hum tunes in practice, longing to be held to your lips, to sing songs of love with the Lord of their life.

stanza.lyrics: mathura pōyoru kāṫṫu vannu kathakaḷ mūḷunnu… kaṇṇāvidhurayām tava rādhayinnum kāttirikkunnu…
stanza.meaning: The breeze that wandered to Mathura returns, carrying whispers of your news. Krishna, your beloved Radha still awaits, yearning deeply for you.

my soul is yearning for my beloved one”
Krishna, Radha is longing for you
Krishna, Krishna may I merge in you
in her eyes is flowing the river Yamuna
in her pain is revealed, Krishna's divine leela
“may your will be done, we surrender indeed
we will chant your name serving those in need”
Krishna, Radha is longing for you
Krishna, Krishna may I merge in you
with the peacock feather, comes her Giridhari
in a surge of sharing, she calls all the gopis
and losing themselves in the Rasa Leela
to the sound of his flute, they all dance with Krishna

Krishna, Krishna may I merge in you

song.title: kuṙavellām kazhivākki tīrkkunn-orammē
song.source: Kuravellam kazhivakki tirkkunnoramme 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kuṙavellām kazhivākki tīrkkunn-orammēen kizhivellām kazhivākki tīrkkēṇamē nī…
stanza.meaning: Mother, you transform all our inadequacies into strengths. Turn my weaknesses into abilities.

stanza.lyrics: kazhivonnum illāte kazhiyunnor-enne ninkaratārāl tazhuku en akatāronn-uṇarān
stanza.meaning: I remain without any worthy qualities; gently caress me with your soft hands, so that I may awaken from within.

stanza.lyrics: mōhattin kanalālen manam urukum nēramjñānattin prabha tūki matiyil nī uṇarū
stanza.meaning: My mind smoulders with the embers of desire; awaken within me a radiant understanding.

stanza.lyrics: vazhi ellām aḍayumbōḷ teḷiyunna śaktī ninkṛpayālē mizhivāy ennakamē nī teḷiyū
stanza.meaning: When every door is closed, your strength shines forth. Let your grace illumine my inner self.

stanza.lyrics: dhyānattin saurabhyam uḷppūvil niṙayānnāmattin mādhuryam akamalarān nuṇayān
stanza.meaning: May the fragrance of meditation permeate the blossom within; may the sweetness of your name be savoured deep within.

stanza.lyrics: kadanam viṭṭakalān en duritam pōy maṙayānmōdattil muzhukān nin kṛpa ennil coriyū
stanza.meaning: Let my sorrows fade away and all suffering dissolve, so I may revel in the blissful Self. Shower upon me your boundless grace.

the truth that is told, is what you must know
you are free (2)
don't you grow tired of this journey?In ancient dreams you are searching
bonds you have made, all you have gainedwill be lost like tears in the rain
life and death are within youheaven and hell are within you

all that is seen cannot be truethe seer alone is the real you
awake from this dream, truth's glory singbe as you are - ever free
life and death are within youheaven and hell are within you
the truth that is told, is what you must know

song.title: Lumière du dharma
song.source: Lumiere du dharma 2025 French in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ô fils de Dasharathachemin de la vérité
stanza.meaning: O son of Dasharatha, Path of truth

stanza.lyrics: que ta bonté guide mes pasau royaume du soi
stanza.meaning: —may your goodness guide my steps to the realm of the Self.

stanza.lyrics: Rama jaya Rama honneur à toi Rama
stanza.meaning: O Rama, honor to you;

stanza.lyrics: l'amour guide ton cœur tu as conquis la peur
stanza.meaning: Rama, love guides your heart. You have conquered fear,

stanza.lyrics: lumière du dharma bien-aimé de Sita
stanza.meaning: you are the light of dharma, beloved of Sita…

stanza.lyrics: on t'a banni de ton rangtu as bravé les tourments
stanza.meaning: You were banished from your rank, you endured every torment.

stanza.lyrics: dis-moi comment, l'âme en peinetu n'as pas eu de haine
stanza.meaning: Tell me—how, in the face of such sorrow, did you harbor no hate?

stanza.lyrics: tu as vaincu Ravanadémon de la vanité
stanza.meaning: You defeated Ravana, demon of vanity,

stanza.lyrics: et tu as libéré Sitajoyau de pureté
stanza.meaning: and you freed Sita, jewel of purity.

song.title: mahānaukē
song.source: Mahanauke 2025 Kannada in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mahānaukē… amṛtatvakē…
stanza.meaning: O mighty ship to immortality!

stanza.lyrics: bhavasāgaravā dāṭisalendēnī bandu kādiruvē
stanza.meaning: You have arrived and anchored at the horizon, waiting for our sake.

stanza.lyrics: digantadalli laṅkaru hākkikaibīsi karediruvē – nammannukaibīsi karediruvē
stanza.meaning: You beckon us to join you, ready to help us cross the sea of worldliness.

stanza.lyrics: mahānaukē… amṛtatvakē…
stanza.meaning: O mighty ship to immortality!

stanza.lyrics: nī kaḷisida sādhane dōṇiyanānigō ēṙi kuḷittiruvē
stanza.meaning: I have boarded the boat of sadhana that you so kindly sent for me.

stanza.lyrics: tīrada alegaḷa tīrava dāṭininnatta sāgiruvē – igōninnatta sāgiruvē
stanza.meaning: See—having crossed the shore of endless waves, I am now moving toward you.

stanza.lyrics: mahānaukē… amṛtatvakē…
stanza.meaning: O mighty ship to immortality!

stanza.lyrics: viṣāda tīrilla vinōda mugidillamanavinnu hindakē horaḷutidē – ayyō
stanza.meaning: I still have regrets; I have not yet exhausted fun and frolic.

stanza.lyrics: manavinnu hindakē horaḷutidē
stanza.meaning: I still have regrets; I have not yet exhausted fun and frolic.

stanza.lyrics: toreda tīrada hambala biḍisuparabrahma-sāgara sērisu – ennaparabrahma-sāgara sērisu
stanza.meaning: Rid me of the longing for the shore I have abandoned. Unite me with the ocean of the Supreme Brahma!

stanza.lyrics: mahānaukē… amṛtatvakē…
stanza.meaning: O mighty ship to immortality!

stanza.lyrics: parabrahma-sāgara sērisu
stanza.meaning: Unite me with the ocean of the Supreme Brahma!

song.title: mājī sāṅvarē
song.source: Maji samvare 2025 Braj in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mājī sāṅvarē raṅg rācīsāṅvarē… raṅg rācīmāji sāṅvarē raṅg rācī
stanza.meaning: My beloved, the dark-hued one, has dyed me in his color. My beloved has steeped me in his hue.

stanza.lyrics: gayā kūmataḍhyā…gayā kūmataḍhyā rādhā saṅgat
stanza.meaning: Gone is my stubborn pride… it left when I joined Radha’s company.

stanza.lyrics: śyām prīti jag sāñcīmāji sāṅvarē raṅg rācī
stanza.meaning: The love of Shyam is now established in the world. My beloved has dyed me in his hue.

stanza.lyrics: gāyā gāyā…gāyā gāyā hari guṇ nisa din
stanza.meaning: I sang and sang… sang the glories of Hari day and night,

stanza.lyrics: kāl byāl rī bāṅcīśyām binā jag khārā lāgā
stanza.meaning: avoiding the traps of time and illusion. Without Shyam, the world feels bitter.

stanza.lyrics: jaga rī bātāṅ kācīmājī sāṅvarē raṅg rācī
stanza.meaning: The words of the world are empty glass. My beloved has dyed me in his hue.

stanza.lyrics: mīrā śrī giridharnaṭ nāgarbhagat rasīli jāñcī… māji sāṅvarē raṅg rācī
stanza.meaning: Mirabai speaks of the Lord of Giridhar (the lifter of Govardhan), the charming, noble beloved. She is soaked in the sweet nectar of devotion. My beloved has dyed me in his hue.

song.title: malayinai uyarttiya gōkulakkaṇṇā!
song.source: Malayinai uyarttiya 2025 Tamil in Mal.pptx

stanza.lyrics: malayinai uyarttiya gōkulakkaṇṇā! enmanadine uyarttiḍa tayaṅkuvatēnō?
stanza.meaning: O Krishna of Gokula, who lifted the mountain! Why do you hesitate to raise my mind towards you?

stanza.lyrics: iḷavēnir kālamāy koḍuppavan nīyēilayutir kālamāy eḍuppavan nīyē
stanza.meaning: You are the one who gives in the tender season of early youth and the one who takes away in the ripening season of later years.

stanza.lyrics: koḍuppatum eḍuppatum un līlai tānē
stanza.meaning: Both the giving and the taking are but your divine play.

stanza.lyrics: en kaṇṇā en mun varuvāyō
stanza.meaning: My dear Kanna, will you come before me?

stanza.lyrics: kuṙunagayāl enaiyum kavarvāyō?
stanza.meaning: Will you, with your mischievous smile, steal me away as well?

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷattai vāṭṭiḍum vēdanai tīravē
stanza.meaning: To heal the pain that withers the heart,

stanza.lyrics: un kuzhal nādattin mellisai pōdumē
stanza.meaning: the soft music of your flute alone is enough.

stanza.lyrics: gītayin nāyakan nīvēdattin sārattai tantavan nī
stanza.meaning: You are the hero of the Gita; you are the one who has given the very essence of the Vedas.

stanza.lyrics: mādhavanē unai nān maṙavēnēun magimai nānum aṙiyēnē
stanza.meaning: Madhava, I will never forget you. And yet, I don't fully know your greatness.

stanza.lyrics: un siram sūḍiḍum siṙu mayil tōgaiyāl
stanza.meaning: Your form, your head adorned with a small peacock feather,

stanza.lyrics: eṅkaḷin dhyānattin uḷḷoḷi perukumē
stanza.meaning: deepens the inner light of our meditation.

stanza.lyrics: jñānattin sūriyan nīñālattai oḷira seybavan nī
stanza.meaning: You are the sun of wisdom, the one who illumines the whole world.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā giridhari…kaṇṇā vanamāli…
stanza.meaning: O Kanna, lifter of Govardhana! O Kanna, the one who wears the garland of the forest!

song.title: man magan huā
song.source: Man magan hua 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: man magan huātērē prēm meiṅ tērē prēm meiṅban saghan huā ras-prēm meiṅ ras-prēm meiṅ
stanza.meaning: My mind is immersed in your divine love. Your love made my garden of devotion grow even denser

stanza.lyrics: tērē nainōṅ se bahatī snēha kī dhārā tērī aur bahā lē calī
stanza.meaning: Waves of compassion emanating from your eyes drew me closer to you.

stanza.lyrics: ab na śikvā kōī na śikāyat kōī
stanza.meaning: I have no complaints, no grievances in life

stanza.lyrics: tērē prēm kī barkhā bhigā lē gaī
stanza.meaning: your shower of love has soaked me completely.

stanza.lyrics: apnī gōdī meiṅ sar rakhnē dē mā
stanza.meaning: Let me rest my head in your lap;

stanza.lyrics: apnē āñcal meiṅ mujhko chupā lē tū mā
stanza.meaning: hide me in your embrace, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: man magan huātērē prēm meiṅ tērē prēm meiṅban saghan huā ras-prēm meiṅ ras-prēm meiṅ
stanza.meaning: My mind is immersed in your divine love. Your love made my garden of devotion grow even denser

stanza.lyrics: māyā meiṅ khōyā huā thāsatya sē maiṅ añjān thā
stanza.meaning: Ensnared by maya, I was oblivious to the eternal truth.

stanza.lyrics: tērē nainōṅ kē darpaṇ meiṅ jhāṅkājānā tū hī tū sab meiṅ basī hai
stanza.meaning: But gazing into your eyes, I recognized that you are the essence of all life.

stanza.lyrics: rāga-dvēṣ bhāvanāēṅ nā rahīṅmērī lau tērī jyoti meiṅ ram gaī
stanza.meaning: I am now free from attachment and aversion. My flame has merged into your light.

stanza.lyrics: sab sukhōṅ kā basērā tū basērāmērē jīvan kā savērā tū savērā
stanza.meaning: You are the dwelling place of all joy—you are the dawn of my life.

stanza.lyrics: man magan huātērē prēm meiṅ tērē prēm meiṅban saghan huā ras-prēm meiṅ ras-prēm meiṅ
stanza.meaning: My mind is immersed in your divine love. Your love made my garden of devotion grow even denser

stanza.lyrics: ab dūr mujhsē na hōnātērē chāṅv meiṅ hī rakh lēnā
stanza.meaning: O Mother, don't keep me away from you. Nurture me always in your shade.

stanza.lyrics: he amṛtē mā amṛt banā dē mujhē tū ānand hai ānand banā dē mujhē
stanza.meaning: O Mother of immortality, lead me to immortality. O blissful One, make me blissful too.

song.title: maṇtari tan spandanavum
song.source: Man tari tan spandanavum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Man tari tan spandanavum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: maṇtari tan spandanavumennile spandanavumninakkāy mātramen ammaykkāy mātram
stanza.meaning: The pulsation within a grain of sand, and the life that pulses within me — all of it is for you, my Mother, only for you!

stanza.lyrics: vīṇa tan tantrininakkāy mīṭṭiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: The strings of the Veena are played for you,

stanza.lyrics: en hṛdaya-tantriyumninakkāy mātramen ammaykkāy mātram mīṭṭiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: and the strings of my heart — they too are yours, played only for you, always for you!

stanza.lyrics: varṣa-mēghaṅgaḷ ninnesparśikkān ettum pōl en
stanza.meaning: Like dark rainclouds drawn down to touch you,

stanza.lyrics: en cintayum vākkum ninnil layikkānāy – enammayil layikkānāy tennalāy aṇayunnu
stanza.meaning: my thoughts and words rise only to merge in you — they drift toward you like a gentle breeze.

song.title: manaḥsākṣi āṇ-īśvaran ennaṙiññāl
song.source: Manah sakshiyan isvaran 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: manaḥsākṣi āṇ-īśvaran ennaṙiññālmanam maunam niścalam āyiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: When we know that our very conscience is God, the mind becomes silent and still.

stanza.lyrics: aṙivāyirikkum ninnuḷḷilallōtirayēṇḍat-ellām nī ennaṙiyū
stanza.meaning: God abides within as pure awareness. To realize His presence, we are to turn inward.

stanza.lyrics: akaleyallā nin arikil uṇḍuaṙiyānuḷḷ-avabōdham ninnil uṇḍu
stanza.meaning: God is not distant; he is ever close. We need only delve deep within to unveil this truth.

stanza.lyrics: aṙiyēṇḍat-ellām nī aṙiññiḍumbōḷaṙivāy tanne viḷaṅgiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: When we know all that is to be known the pristine Self within shines as pure knowledge.

stanza.lyrics: manassinn-uṇarvonn-īyannavarkkumana-malam ellām ozhiññiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: All the impurities of the mind dissolve in those whose hearts are awakened to this truth;

stanza.lyrics: cittam tuḍikkunna spandattinōjñānattin mudra patiññiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: every beat of their heart resonates with the seal of supreme knowledge.

song.title: manam itra śāntamāyi
song.source: Manam itra santamayi tirnnatu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Manam itra santamayi tirnnatu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: manam itra śāntamāyi tīrnnat-entē?ende maṇivarṇṇane ñān ninaccatinālō
stanza.meaning: Why has my mind become so calm and peaceful? Is it because I was lost in Krishna’s memories?
