stanza.lyrics: mazhamukil varṇṇane kaṇḍatinālō! ākazhaliṇa kūppi tozhutatinālō
stanza.meaning: Or because I saw my dark-hued Lord? Is it because I offered my worship at his lotus feet?

stanza.lyrics: madhuv-ozhukunnorā malar mozhiyālōkṛpa ozhukunnorā mizhi malarālō
stanza.meaning: Did my mind become calm upon hearing his sweet words? Or because I saw his eyes overflowing with compassion towards me?

stanza.lyrics: madhuramām pālnilāvoḷi parattīḍumāmandasmitattinde kāntiyālō
stanza.meaning: Is it because of the beauty of his smile, which spreads radiance all around?

stanza.lyrics: manam itra śāntamāyi tīrnnat-entē?ende maṇivarṇṇane ñān ninaccatinālō
stanza.meaning: Why has my mind become so calm and peaceful? Is it because I was lost in Krishna’s memories?

stanza.lyrics: muraḷī-ravattinde madhurimayāl endemānasam malarpōl viḍarnnuvennō
stanza.meaning: Listening to the sweet melody of his flute, my heart blossomed like a flower.

stanza.lyrics: madhuvuṇṇān śalabham pōl vannuvennō kaṇṇanmanatāril ciri tūki ninnuvennō
stanza.meaning: Has Krishna, like a honeybee, come to sip its sweet nectar? Is he within my heart, blissfully smiling?

stanza.lyrics: manam itra śāntamāyi tīrnnat-entē?ende maṇivarṇṇane ñān ninaccatinālō
stanza.meaning: Why has my mind become so calm and peaceful? Is it because I was lost in Krishna’s memories?

song.title: manamayil untan varavinai nōkki
song.source: Manamayil 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: manamayil untan varavinai nōkkipazhamutir-cōlaiyil kāttirukkum
stanza.meaning: Like a peacock in the groves, my mind waits for your arrival.

stanza.lyrics: manam kavar murugā nī vantu amaramakizhvuḍan vānil siṙak-aḍikkum
stanza.meaning: O Muruga, who steals the mind, once you come and dwell within, it will soar in the sky with joy.

stanza.lyrics: kanavinil vantu maṇimaṇiyākakanimozhi pēsum kantavēlā
stanza.meaning: O Lord Vela! You come in my dreams, and speak sweet, gentle words.

stanza.lyrics: nanavilum untan nanmozhi kēṭṭunān koṇḍa piṙavi nalam peṙaṭṭum
stanza.meaning: Likewise, may my life find its purpose by hearing your blessed words even in my waking state.

stanza.lyrics: vēlavā tutikaḷ pāḍavāmanamum nāḍavā makizhntu āḍiḍavā
stanza.meaning: O Vela! May I sing your praises, may my mind seek you, may I dance in joy.

stanza.lyrics: vēlavā viraivil nāḍivākuṙaiyum tīravā enaiyum āḷavā
stanza.meaning: O Vela! Come quickly and seek me out, remove all my shortcomings, and make me yours…

stanza.lyrics: tiruppukazh pāḍi tiruppaṇi seyyumaḍiyavar uṙavē amaintiḍaṭṭum
stanza.meaning: May I be in the company of devotees who sing the Tiruppukazh and perform sacred service;

stanza.lyrics: vaḷḷi daivānai sērntamar katirvēlātīrāta vinaikaḷ tīrntiḍaṭṭum
stanza.meaning: O Muruga, radiant as the sun, united with Valli and Daivanai, may my endless karmas be brought to an end!

song.title: manamē narajīvitamākum
song.source: Maname Narajivitam 2025 Odiya in Eng v4.pptx

stanza.lyrics: bāy mŏno dina jāvūcci bitti reṭāṅkora hĕlā to jībana māṭṭi re
stanza.meaning: O mind, the field of human life is turning arid and dry

stanza.lyrics: belottāvu cāha bīlo ku ttorĕcaso bāso kĕbe sikhi bu ā rĕ
stanza.meaning: With no cultivation, crop or yield, it is turning increasingly barren

stanza.lyrics: bāy mŏno dina jāvūcci bittibāy mŏno dina jāvūcci bitti
stanza.meaning: O mind, the field of human life is turning arid and dry

stanza.lyrics: bāy mŏno dina jāvūcci bitti reṭāṅkora hĕlā to jībana māṭṭi re
stanza.meaning: O mind, the field of human life is turning arid and dry

stanza.lyrics: chāso būyi ŏṭṭĕ monīso jībonāchosīlĕ sophol̤o hĕbo to jŏnomā
stanza.meaning: How to sow the seeds properly, or to cultivate them well…

stanza.lyrics: nā sikhilu chāso no chinnu bihonokhetokku ĕṇīkki de ārĕ mono
stanza.meaning: …neither do you have the knowledge, nor do you have the slightest wish to know.

stanza.lyrics: bāy mŏno dina jāvūcci bittibāy mŏno dina jāvūcci bitti
stanza.meaning: O mind, the field of human life is turning arid and dry

stanza.lyrics: bhūyi cosi khoto de ghāso bācci depāṇi pago dekhi bihono buṇī de
stanza.meaning: If you enrich the soil, till it properly, remove the weeds…

stanza.lyrics: deho mihonoto koribu jĕ besunāro phasolo pāyi bu tĕbĕ
stanza.meaning: … and maintain it diligently, you will be able to reap plenty of good harvests

stanza.lyrics: bāy mŏno dina jāvūcci bittibāy mŏno dina jāvūcci bitti
stanza.meaning: O mind, the field of human life is turning arid and dry

stanza.lyrics: kantokŏṭṭāl̤ĕ pilādino golākāmini kāṅñcŏnĕ jatu bŏno bitilā
stanza.meaning: Your childhood is wasted in crying helplessly

stanza.lyrics: deho hĕla ĕbĕ kiṭṭo pŏrā yĕjībŏno dhāvuṇu dharamo sāñcinĕ
stanza.meaning: Your youth is wasted in lustful attachment

stanza.lyrics: bāy mŏno dina jāvūcci bittibāy mŏno dina jāvūcci bitti
stanza.meaning: O mind, the field of human life is turning arid and dry

stanza.lyrics: khasibo boyasochāhu chāhu a hāapārŏgo deho kiyĕ hĕbo sā hā
stanza.meaning: Finally old age approaches. All your talents are gone,and you become like a worm

stanza.lyrics: kĕu kāmakurĕ nuhĕ se jibŏnojamo baṭṭo chāhi koṭṭibo dino
stanza.meaning: You will stop working, and spend your time with one foot in the grave.

stanza.lyrics: bāy mŏno dina jāvūcci bittibāy mŏno dina jāvūcci bitti
stanza.meaning: O mind, the field of human life is turning arid and dry

song.title: manamē nī ini kalaṅgādē
song.source: Maname ni ini kalangate 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Maname ni ini kalangate 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: manamē nī ini kalaṅgādēnaḍandadai eṇṇi varundādē
stanza.meaning: O Mind, set aside your worries from this moment on; let go of regrets about the past

stanza.lyrics: varuvadai eṇṇi pataṙādēnaḍappadai nanḍrē sey manamē
stanza.meaning: and do not fear what the future may bring. Instead, focus your energy on doing your best in the present.

stanza.lyrics: aḍuttavar maraṇattin ārudal solvāraḍuttatu tān ena maṙandiḍuvār
stanza.meaning: When someone dies, people gather to offer comfort, yet they forget that their own turn will come;

stanza.lyrics: vāzhvai nilai ena ninaittiḍuvārmāyai idu ena maṙandiḍuvār
stanza.meaning: many live as if this human life will last forever, forgetting that all of this is Maya—the great illusion.

stanza.lyrics: uyir nīṅgin uḍan yār varuvār - unpeyarai nīkki piṇam enbār
stanza.meaning: When your final moment arrives, who will accompany you? You will no longer be called by your name but simply referred to as a body.

stanza.lyrics: viṙagu erindāl paṙandu selvār - pinedarkku āṇavam eṇṇippār
stanza.meaning: Your near and dear ones will disappear once the funeral pyre is lit. Why, then, do you cling to your ego?

stanza.lyrics: ōḍi tēḍi avar ponnai sērppārōṭṭattin muḍivil maṇṇ āvār
stanza.meaning: All their lives, people chase after wealth, but in the end, they become one with the soil.

stanza.lyrics: nīrkkumizhi pōl nilaiyaṫṫra vāzhvunilaiyāy yār iṅgu vāzhndiḍuvār
stanza.meaning: Life is as short-lived as a bubble; no one lives here forever.

song.title: manatāril kaṇṇīril nanavu tōrtti
song.source: Manataril Kanniril 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: manatāril kaṇṇīril nanavu tōrttiteḷivezhum veḷivinde katiru vīzhtti
stanza.meaning: Gently drying my heart after the downpour of tears, harvesting the crop of awareness,

stanza.lyrics: mizhikaḷil kanivinde tēn ozhukkimaruvunnu guru-mātā antaraṅgē
stanza.meaning: and letting the honey of compassion flow from her eyes — my Mother, my Guru, forever dwells within me.

stanza.lyrics: kanavāyi kāṇmatin uṙava tēḍānciṙakāy māṙunna śraddhayamma
stanza.meaning: Mother becomes the wings of faith and focus, lifting us in flight toward the truth we now only dream of.

stanza.lyrics: nērāy oruṇma tān ennaṙivāyuṇarān uyirinn-uṇarttu-gītam
stanza.meaning: She is the song that uplifts the self, raising our lives to the awareness that we are the eternal truth.

stanza.lyrics: prēma viśuddhi tan pūrṇatayāmpularī teḷikkumā jñāna-bhānu
stanza.meaning: She is the sun of knowledge, bringing the dawn of perfection and pure love.

stanza.lyrics: niṙavāṇu prēmam niṙavāṇ-aṙivumāniṙavāṇ-ennōmalē nīyum ōrkkā
stanza.meaning: ‘Remember, my darling, you are love and knowledge in their fullest form. You are perfection.

stanza.lyrics: nērinde pātayil pāntharkkitāmmātāvu tūvunnu tūveḷiccam
stanza.meaning: For those who journey on the path of truth, Mother illumines the way with her golden rays.

stanza.lyrics: iruḷ-ārnna hṛttil ninnoḷi tūkum vāṅmadhutūkātuḷpūkuvān kaniyuk-ammē
stanza.meaning: From minds once dark, may sweet, luminous words arise. O Mother, with your boundless compassion, bless us with this grace.

song.title: mānattu mazha-mēgham vannu niṙayunnu
song.source: Manattu mazhamegham 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mānattu mazha-mēgham vannu niṙayunnumayilukaḷ arikilitā āḍi timirkkunnu
stanza.meaning: Rain-laden clouds gather in the sky, and near me, peacocks dance in delight.

stanza.lyrics: māṅkani mazha peyyum pūṅkāṫṫu vīśunnumāntaḷir-ūṇḍiṭṭu pāḍunnu kuyilukaḷ
stanza.meaning: A fragrant breeze shakes down ripe mangoes like rain, while koels feast on tender mango shoots and sing sweet melodies.

stanza.lyrics: mānattu mazha-mēgham vannu niṙayunnumayilukaḷ arikilitā āḍi timirkkunnu
stanza.meaning: Rain-laden clouds gather in the sky, and near me, peacocks dance in delight.

stanza.lyrics: mānasam eṅkilum śōkārdram āṇallōmāmaka mātāvin darśanam illāykayāl
stanza.meaning: Yet my heart is heavy with sorrow, for I have not received the darshan of my Mother.

stanza.lyrics: mātāvē nī sarva-vyāpi āṇeṅkilummāmaka mizhi munnil kāṇunnum illallō
stanza.meaning: O Mother, though you pervade the entire universe, I am unable to see you in front of my eyes.

stanza.lyrics: mānattu mazha-mēgham vannu niṙayunnumayilukaḷ arikilitā āḍi timirkkunnu
stanza.meaning: Rain-laden clouds gather in the sky, and near me, peacocks dance in delight.

stanza.lyrics: mēvīḍaṇē sadā mānasatāril nīmāṫṫīḍaṇē ende viraha-duhkhatte nī
stanza.meaning: May you forever reside in the flower of my heart, and remove this pain of separation from you.

stanza.lyrics: mēvunnatō ēṙe dūre ennākilummē hṛdi sarvadā sānnidhyam ēkaṇē
stanza.meaning: Even though you are far from me in physical form, reveal your presence always within my heart.

stanza.lyrics: mānattu mazha-mēgham vannu niṙayunnumayilukaḷ arikilitā āḍi timirkkunnu
stanza.meaning: Rain-laden clouds gather in the sky, and near me, peacocks dance in delight.

song.title: mānavanuḷḷil uḷḷoru satyam
song.source: Manavanullil ulloru satyam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mānavanuḷḷil uḷḷoru satyammādhavan ennatu vēditam ākkān
stanza.meaning: For humankind to realize the truth that the Lord resides in their heart,

stanza.lyrics: mādhavan avan tān mānavan āyimānavaneppōl līlakaḷ ādi
stanza.meaning: Krishna took on a human form and performed his divine play amidst us.

stanza.lyrics: mānavadēha dhāriyatākilummanassil yōgyatayillennākil
stanza.meaning: Though we take on a human form, if our mind lacks noble qualities,

stanza.lyrics: mānavalīlakaḷ ādunn-avanuḍe - mānasam bhrāntam atennē tōnnū
stanza.meaning: our actions in this world will resemble those of a deluded person.

stanza.lyrics: madamātsarya cintakaḷellāmmāyākṛtam ī ulakin bhāvam
stanza.meaning: Thoughts of pride and jealousy are of this illusionary world.

stanza.lyrics: matibhramam akalān manaḥsukham aṇayānmāyādhīśanil abhayam tēḍām
stanza.meaning: Let us take refuge in the Lord who controls Maya, that our delusions may vanish and our hearts may find peace.

stanza.lyrics: manaḥśuddhikkāy yatnam ceytorā - madhusūdananuḍe vākkukaḷe tān
stanza.meaning: Krishna strove to make our mind pure. If we reflect on his words and firmly establish them within,

stanza.lyrics: mananāl tatvam uṙappiccennālmānavan uḷḷam cinmayam ākum
stanza.meaning: our hearts will become a pristine reflection of pure consciousness.

song.title: mandānilan
song.source: Mandanilan tazhuki ananyu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mandānilan tazhuki aṇaññuvṛndāvanattil sugandham parannu
stanza.meaning: A gentle breeze drifted near, carrying with it a fragrance that filled all of Vrindavan.

stanza.lyrics: sundari-gōpikā-chintayil āke gōvinda-mukhāmbujam ēkam viḍarnnu
stanza.meaning: In the thoughts of the lovely Gopika, the vision of Govinda’s face began to blossom

stanza.lyrics: nandanandana-nētraṅgaḷ inn-ennōḍu - chollum kavitaykk-ētoru rāgam
stanza.meaning: With what music shall I tune the poem that Nanda’s son will speak through his eyes?

stanza.lyrics: ētākilum aten rāgaṅgaḷ māychu - manda-mandam virāgata ēkum
stanza.meaning: Whatever it may be, it will soothe my passions and gently lead me toward detachment.

stanza.lyrics: chandrikōpamitam nandippicchiḍummandasmitam entennōḍu chollum
stanza.meaning: What will his smile, more radiant than moonlight, say to me?

stanza.lyrics: entākilum aten antaraṅgattinkandaram āke śōbhitam ākkum
stanza.meaning: Whatever it speaks, it will illuminate the hidden cave of my heart.

stanza.lyrics: pullāṅkuzhal innu pozhikkuvat-ētuchollārnna śīlin nāda-taraṅgam
stanza.meaning: What lovely message will his flute’s sweet melody whisper to me?

stanza.lyrics: ētākilum ā nādam en mānasamvallāt-alayunnat-illāte ākkum
stanza.meaning: Whatever it is, it will calm the restless wanderings of my mind.

stanza.lyrics: Krishna … GovindaNandananda… Govinda
stanza.meaning: O Krishna

song.title: mandārakkombile śārika pāḍi
song.source: Mandarakkombile 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mandārakkombile śārika pāḍisundara-bhumiyām amṛta-tīramjagadambika vāzhum sundara-tīrammakkaḷkkāyi tīrttorī mātṛ-tīram
stanza.meaning: A parrot perched on the branch of the Mandaram tree sings—“This sacred shore, where the Mother of the Universe dwells, is a land beyond death.” O Jagadambika, you have lovingly created this divine Amritapuri for the sake of your children.

stanza.lyrics: bhupāḷa-rāgam pāḍi uṇarum ī tīramamma tan śvāsattin kuḷir ēṫṫu nilppū
stanza.meaning: The ocean waves rise, singing in the tones of Bhupala Raga at dawn, in a land infused with the cool breath of Mother herself.

stanza.lyrics: saṅgīta-priya tan nāda-taraṅgattilujjvalikkunnu ī mēdini
stanza.meaning: This blessed land glows brightly with the melodies flowing from Mother, lover of music and source of all harmony.

stanza.lyrics: tāpasa-vṛndaṅgaḷ tapam ceytirunnori dharaṇidivyapādam patiññori puṇyabhūmi
stanza.meaning: Here, great sages once performed deep and austere penance. It is a holy ground, graced by Mother’s footprints.

stanza.lyrics: vēda-mantradhvani uyarttunnu sāgaramdēvalōkam vellum ī dharitri
stanza.meaning: The ocean echoes with the sacred chanting of Vedic mantras. Even the celestial realms cannot rival the divine beauty of Amritapuri.

stanza.lyrics: hōmāgni nityam eriyunnori divya-kṣētrammantra-dhvanikaḷ muzhaṅgunna yajña-tīram
stanza.meaning: In the temple, every day, the sacred flames arise from ritual oblations. Mantras resound continuously in this land of sacrifice.

stanza.lyrics: ajñānadhvānta dīpikayām ammavijñāna-dīpam pakarunnu nityam
stanza.meaning: O Mother, the lamp that dispels the darkness of ignorance—you impart the light of true knowledge to all who come to you, each and every day.

song.title: maṇicceppu tuṙakkave orikkal
song.source: Manicheppu turakkave orikkal 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: maṇicceppu tuṙakkave orikkal mazhamukilvarṇṇanmakuḍattil cūḍiya mayilppīli kāṇke
stanza.meaning: When I opened my treasure chest, seeing the peacock feather Krishna had worn on his crown,

stanza.lyrics: maṙannu ñān svayam innu mādhavanēkiyamanōjñamām nimiṣaṅgaḷ ōrttirunnu
stanza.meaning: I forgot myself in the reverie of the sweet moments he gifted to me.

stanza.lyrics: smṛticceppu tuṙakkumō ‘mathuraykku rājan’ avanniṙamaṫṫī mayilppīli manam kāṇumō
stanza.meaning: Will the Lord of Mathura unlock his chest of memories and remember this heart, now a faded peacock feather?

stanza.lyrics: jalamiṫṫu mizhikaḷil niṙayumō kuḷirēkumiḷam tennalāy iha niṙaññīḍumō
stanza.meaning: Will his eyes fill up with tears, will he come to me as a gentle breeze?

stanza.lyrics: mathuraykku madhuram sumadhuram pakarunnōnadharam dhariccayā muraḷika kāṇumō
stanza.meaning: Will the one who brings sweetness to Mathura see the flute of my heart that yearns with longing,

stanza.lyrics: virahāpaśruti mīṭṭum en manōmuraḷikaprēmārdra-śrutipūrṇṇam ākkīḍumō
stanza.meaning: will he fill it with songs of love?

stanza.lyrics: gōvarddhanavum gōkkaḷum yamunayumgōparum mēvumī gōkulam kāṇumō
stanza.meaning: Will he see the Govardhana Mountain, the cows, the Yamuna River, the gopis and gopas who live here in Gokulam?

stanza.lyrics: gōpikā-hṛdayanavanītam urukunnugōpanandanan āgamiccīḍumō
stanza.meaning: The hearts of the gopis, like the fresh butter beloved by the Lord, are now melting with longing… Will the son of Nanda return to us?

song.title: manidarkaḷ palavidam
song.source: Manidarkal palavidam 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: manidarkaḷ palavidam, manaṅkaḷum palavitammanam evidamō vāzhkaiyum avidam
stanza.meaning: Humans are of many kinds, and minds too are of many kinds. Where the mind dwells, there too life will follow

stanza.lyrics: manadil tōnḍrum inbamum tunbamummanamē bandhamum muktiyum tantiḍum
stanza.meaning: . The joys and sorrows arise both in the mind; it is the mind itself that grants both bondage and liberation.

stanza.lyrics: manidarkaḷ palavidam, manaṅkaḷum palavitammanam evidamō vāzhkaiyum avidam
stanza.meaning: Humans are of many kinds, and minds too are of many kinds. Where the mind dwells, there too life will follow

stanza.lyrics: kēṭṭatai maṙappavar kātukaḷ-aṫṫravarellām uḷaṙuvār paṇbillādavar
stanza.meaning: Those who forget what they have heard are careless, those who repeat everything without imbibing the teaching are insincere.

stanza.lyrics: payantara uṙaippavar aṙivinil sānḍrōrmanidā sol inta mūvaril nī yār?
stanza.meaning: Those who speak with insight are the truly wise. O human, tell me—among these three, which one are you?

stanza.lyrics: manidā ō manidāsintittu pār inta mūvaril nī yār?
stanza.meaning: O human, reflect and see —among these three, which one are you?

stanza.lyrics: uṇarcciyil vāzhbavar vikāra manitarsintanai seybavar vicāra manitar
stanza.meaning: Those who live on impulse are emotional humans. Those who reflect are the thoughtful.

stanza.lyrics: pakuttaṙibavarē vivēka manitarmanidā sol inta mūvaril nī yār?
stanza.meaning: Those who live with discernment are the truly wise. O human, tell me—among these three, which one are you?

stanza.lyrics: manidā ō manidāsintittu pār inta mūvaril nī yār?
stanza.meaning: O human, reflect and see —among these three, which one are you?

stanza.lyrics: tanakkena sērppavar suyanalakkārarpiṙar poruḷ parippavar vañcanai-yāḷar
stanza.meaning: Those who hoard only for themselves are the selfish, those who snatch the wealth of others are deceivers,

stanza.lyrics: pakirntuṇḍu vāzhbavar uttama manitarmanidā sol inta mūvaril nī yār?
stanza.meaning: those who share with others are noble humans. O human, tell me—among these three, which one are you?

stanza.lyrics: manidā ō manidāsintittu pār inta mūvaril nī yār?
stanza.meaning: O human, reflect and see —among these three, which one are you?

song.title: maṇṇu vāri tinnarut-ennu
song.source: Mannu vari 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: maṇṇu vāri tinnarut-ennuvāram vāram connirunn-ammakuṙumbalpam kūḍiyō uṇṇīninne innu keṭṭiyiḍum ñān
stanza.meaning: Yashoda says to Krishna, "My son, how many times have I told you not to eat mud? Have you become even more mischievous now? Today, I shall tie you up!”

stanza.lyrics: maṇṇu vāri tinniṭṭillammēammēḍuṇṇi satyamē collūēṭṭan āṇu kaḷavu connatuammēḍuṇṇi pāvattānallē
stanza.meaning: Krishna replies, "I haven’t eaten mud, Mother! Your son always speaks the truth. It’s big brother who’s lying. I am a very good and gentle child!"

stanza.lyrics: attinantō tintinam tārōattinantō tintinam tārōattinantō tintinam tārōtaka taka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: (Joyful chorus)

stanza.lyrics: maṇṇu puraṇḍuṇṇi kaviḷukaḷtinnatinu sākṣyavum connupinnēyum kaḷavu collunnuennuṇṇī ponnuṇṇī nī
stanza.meaning: Yashoda says, "Your cheeks are stained with mud—that alone shows you’ve eaten it! And yet again, you’re lying to me—my own son, my darling child."

stanza.lyrics: uṇṇi maṇṇu tinnatall-ammēmaṇṇilāy vīṇu pōyammētakkam nōkki maṇṇaṅgu vāyilkayaṙi aṅg-iruppāy ammē
stanza.meaning: Krishna replies, "Mother, I didn’t eat mud! I just fell on the ground, and the mud was waiting for a chance to slip in and sit inside my mouth!"

stanza.lyrics: attinantō tintinam tārōattinantō tintinam tārōattinantō tintinam tārōtaka taka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: (Joyful chorus)

stanza.lyrics: uṇṇikkaikaḷ kūḍi piḍiccaṅguvā tuṙakkū kaṇṇan uṇṇī nīilleṅkil ninne viḍillayaśōdayum colliyat-appōḷ
stanza.meaning: She caught hold of both his hands and said, "Krishna, open your mouth! I won’t let you go unless you do." Yashoda spoke to him firmly.

stanza.lyrics: tellonnu ammaye nōkkiuṇṇivāya tuṙann-aṅguṇṇībrahmāṇḍam muzhuvanum āuṇṇi-vāyil darśicceśōda
stanza.meaning: Little Krishna looked at his mother for a moment, then slowly opened his tiny mouth. And there, inside her son’s mouth, Yashoda beheld the entire cosmos.

stanza.lyrics: attinantō tintinam tārōattinantō tintinam tārōattinantō tintinam tārōtaka taka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: (Joyful chorus)

stanza.lyrics: tannēyum prapañcattēyumoru mātra kaṇḍu yaśōdataḷarnnaṅgu vīṇitā maṇṇilvēpathu gātriyatāyi
stanza.meaning: For a moment, she saw the entire universe—and herself within it. Then she collapsed to the ground, her body trembling from what she had just seen.

stanza.lyrics: amma tan maḍittaṭṭilāykayaṙi aṅgirunniṭṭatāuṇṇikkaikaḷ koṇḍu talōḍiammayuḍe kṣīṇam akaṫṫi
stanza.meaning: Little Krishna climbed onto his mother's lap, gently caressing her with his tiny, soft hands, bringing her back to her senses and soothing her into calm.

stanza.lyrics: attinantō tintinam tārōattinantō tintinam tārōattinantō tintinam tārōtaka taka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: (Joyful chorus)

stanza.lyrics: uṇṇiye gāḍham puṇarnnuenduṇṇi-kaṇṇan allē nīvallāte viśakkunnuṇḍōpālaṅgu nalkaṭṭe amma
stanza.meaning: Yashoda hugged her son tightly. "You are my baby, my darling Krishna. Are you very hungry? Shall Mother give you some milk?"

stanza.lyrics: vālsalyattāl ellām maṙannukaṇṇane māṙōḍu cērttumāyakkaṇṇan puñciriyōḍepālum nukarnn-aṅgu mayaṅgi
stanza.meaning: She forgot everything else in the tenderness she felt for her child, drawing him close to her heart. Krishna, the Lord of divine illusion, drank her milk and fell asleep in her lap.

stanza.lyrics: attinantō tintinam tārōattinantō tintinam tārōattinantō tintinam tārōtaka taka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: (Joyful chorus)

song.title: mantra-sūnaṅgaḷ
song.source: Mantra sunangal 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mantra-sūnaṅgaḷ viriccēn gurumātēcintā-gṛhāṅgana-vīthiyil ākavē
stanza.meaning: O my Mother, my Guru! I have strewn the flowers of mantra along the path to my heart,

stanza.lyrics: centāraḍikaḷām satya-dharmaṅgaḷeanuyōgyam antarē ānayiccīḍuvān
stanza.meaning: so that your lotus feet, embodiments of truth and dharma, may be led within with sacred ceremony.

stanza.lyrics: mantra-sūnaṅgaḷ viriccēn gurumātēcintā-gṛhāṅgana-vīthiyil ākavē
stanza.meaning: O my Mother, my Guru! I have strewn the flowers of mantra along the path to my heart,

stanza.lyrics: sūkṣmata tēḍum vicāra-pathaṅgaḷesadpāda-nakhadamśu dīptam ākkīḍavē
stanza.meaning: Those subtle paths of reflection are illumined by the radiance of your toenails, which dispel darkness and ignorance.

stanza.lyrics: saphalam ī yātra enn-āśvāsamāy dēha-vasanam kozhiññ-ātma-vasatiye pūkuvān
stanza.meaning: I find solace, knowing that the journey of this human life shall find its fulfilment, leading me to complete union with the Atman, and detachment from the body.

stanza.lyrics: umayē nī ulakam niṙaññiripp-ennorāmahanīya bhāvamām bhēṣajē muṅgi en
stanza.meaning: O Goddess Uma, may I always immerse myself in the glorious medicine of the knowledge that you alone pervade the entire universe.

stanza.lyrics: matiyaṅgu bhavatīya-mahimāvil uyaravēmanatāru viriyumā pulari vann-ettaṇē
stanza.meaning: When I attain such a worthy state of mind, may the dawn arrive in which my heart flower blossoms.

stanza.lyrics: mātāvu kuññin kṛtajñataykkāyollamōdēna pālippat-eṅkilum ambikē
stanza.meaning: A mother expects no gratitude from the child she raises with love and joy.

stanza.lyrics: sarvadā tadguṇam sarvārttha-sādhakamcētass-śōbhitam ākkān tuṇaykka nī
stanza.meaning: Yet, grant me the virtue of gratitude so that I may achieve the true purpose of my life.

song.title: manujā japisu rāma-nāmava
song.source: Manuja japisu 2025 Kan in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: manujā japisu rāma-nāmavarāma smaraṇe śāśvata ventaṙitu
stanza.meaning: O human, chant the name of Rama! Know that remembrance of Rama alone is the eternal companion on your journey.

stanza.lyrics: janisidāka nī aḷuvemaṭidāga neṇḍaṙa aḷisuve
stanza.meaning: When you are born, you cry; and when you die, others cry over your body.

stanza.lyrics: ninna vivastra goḷisipañcabhūtagaḷig-arpaṇa gaivaru
stanza.meaning: Your body is stripped bare and offered to the five elements as part of the final rites.

stanza.lyrics: barigaili manege naṭevaru – neṇḍarubarigaili manege naṭevaru
stanza.meaning: After that, your near and dear ones return to their homes.

stanza.lyrics: huṭṭidāga ninna nāmakaraṇamaḍidāga ninna śava yātre
stanza.meaning: At birth, your naming ceremony is performed; at death, your funeral procession is arranged.

stanza.lyrics: bandāka yēnu taradē nīhōdāka yēnu vayyalāradē
stanza.meaning: What did you bring when you came? What will you carry when you go?

stanza.lyrics: maṇṇāguva ninnadēnide? manujāmaṇṇāguva ninnadēnide?
stanza.meaning: O human, what truly belongs to you, when in the end you will return to dust?

stanza.lyrics: janma nīḍidava ṙobbeṙu ninakenāmava niṭṭaru innobbaṙu
stanza.meaning: Someone gave you birth, another gave you a name;

stanza.lyrics: jñāna nīḍidaṙu mattaboṙuantya kriyegaiva ṙinnobbaṙu
stanza.meaning: someone else gave you knowledge, and yet another will perform your last rites.

stanza.lyrics: ahaṅkāra-vēdake ninage?rāma pādake śirabāgu
stanza.meaning: Therefore, why this pride and ego, O human? Bow down your head at Lord Rama’s feet.

stanza.lyrics: jay jay rām rām rām sītā rām rām rām jay jay rām rām rām sītā rām rām rām
stanza.meaning: Victory to Rama! Victory to Sita Rama!

song.title: mathurayil maṙann-orāgānam
song.source: Mathurayil marannoraganam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mathurayil maṙann-orāgānammadhumozhi rādha tan virahagānam
stanza.meaning: Have you forgotten, in Mathura, the song — the song of sweet Radha’s anguish, her sorrow in separation from her Lord?

stanza.lyrics: maṙakkān ākātta raṅgammazhamukil varṇṇande rāgabhāvam
stanza.meaning: Never forgotten is Krishna’s tender nature, as he stood beside Radha, playing sweet melodies on his flute.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: O Krishna…

stanza.lyrics: rādhayāṇō ninde gītamrādha illāt-ellām nilaccu pōyō
stanza.meaning: Is Radha the source of your song? Without Radha, has everything come to an end?

stanza.lyrics: rāsa-kēḷiyum nilaccu pōyōyamunayum kadambavum maṙannu pōyō
stanza.meaning: Do you no longer dance the rasa dance? Have you forgotten the river Yamuna and the Kadamba tree by its banks?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: O Krishna…

stanza.lyrics: vīṇḍumā rādhā-mādhava saṅgamamkālam orukkiya samāgamam
stanza.meaning: Time will surely unite Radha and Krishna again.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇan aṙiññu tan rāgam ellāmrādha tan prēmānurāgam-allō
stanza.meaning: And when Krishna sees Radha once more, he remembers the melodies born of Radha’s deep love for him.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: O Krishna…

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇande māṙil layiccu pōyōkaṇṇīr pravāham nilaccu pōyō
stanza.meaning: Have you merged into Krishna’s heart? Has the flow of tears come to a stop?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇan upēkṣiccu vēṇugānamrādha tan cētanayaṫṫa rāgam
stanza.meaning: For when Radha was no longer beside him, Krishna could not play his flute again — there are no melodies without his Radha.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: O Krishna…

song.title: mati kārnnu tinnum ī vyathayumāy jīvitam
song.source: Mati karnnu tinnu mi 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Mati karnnu tinnu mi 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mati kārnnu tinnum ī vyathayumāy jīvitamkatha aṙiyāte kazhiññu pōyi
stanza.meaning: My heart was consumed by pain, and I lived a life without meaning.

stanza.lyrics: hitamāyat-entennat-aṙiyāte niravadhijanimṛti tannil alaññu pōyi
stanza.meaning: I wandered through countless births, unaware of the truth that could save me.

stanza.lyrics: itutānō jīvita-vidhi ennu cinticcumati taḷarnninnu mayaṅgiḍavē
stanza.meaning: Exhausted and desolate, I resigned myself to the thought that this was my only destiny.

stanza.lyrics: varadāyakam tava karapallavam ennedayavōḍe vāri puṇarnnuvallō
stanza.meaning: But Mother, your hands of blessing embraced me with tender compassion.

stanza.lyrics: vidhi tanne māṫṫiḍum vidhidāyini – endehṛdi tannil innu nī nṛttam āḍū
stanza.meaning: You are the one who decrees our destiny—and the one who can overturn it. Dance within my heart, O Mother,

stanza.lyrics: pala janmam-ārjjicca karma-bījaṅgaḷemuḷa poṭṭiḍāte pizhuteṙiyū
stanza.meaning: and uproot the seeds of latent tendencies I have carried across many lives.

stanza.lyrics: arutarut-ini eniykk-ēkarutē – hṛditava pāda-vismṛti jagadīśvari
stanza.meaning: O Goddess who rules this universe, may I never forget your divine feet, which embody the eternal truth.

stanza.lyrics: aruṇābhayārnnorā padatāru mātram āṇ-abhayam ennennuḷḷil aṙiyēṇamē
stanza.meaning: Know that your radiant lotus feet are my only refuge—my sanctuary.

song.title: mati mati ennaruḷāte
song.source: Mati mati 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mati mati ennaruḷāteuzhalunn-oru manamēazhal allāt-entu bhujiccuitu vare onnatu collu
stanza.meaning: O restless mind, never content, never saying, “Enough, enough”—tell me, what have you truly consumed until now, except sorrow?

stanza.lyrics: mati ārnnatu mananam ceyvānini eṅkilum ōrkkūmada-matsara-cintakaḷ ārnnatumati mati enn-eṅkilum ōtu
stanza.meaning: Reflect with wisdom, and at least from now on, urge the mind to forsake thoughts of pride and envy.

stanza.lyrics: azhal ākunn-āzhiyil vīṇ-uzhalunn-oru nēramazhivōḍ-oru kai-nīḷānini ill-enn-aṙiyū
stanza.meaning: When you are drowning in an ocean of misery, remember—no hands will reach out in compassion.

stanza.lyrics: azhakiyalum ninnuḍal ennatuūzhiyil vīṇ-azhukānazhivillā-poruḷ enn-onnatuini uṇḍ- ennatum ōrkkū
stanza.meaning: This beautiful body will one day leave you, returning to Earth, becoming one with the elements. And yet remember: there is a treasure within that never leaves you.

stanza.lyrics: tirayin mēl ponti varumnīrkumiḷa itē vāzhvumniratīrtt-oru nurayāyatumaṙu tirayil māyunnatum aṙiyū
stanza.meaning: Like bubbles in a wave that vanish into foam, like a wave reaching the shore and merging with the ocean

stanza.lyrics: tira onnatu karayārnnālvan-kaḍaliṅkal cērumtirayārnn-oru nīrkumiḷaatin nila entatu collū
stanza.meaning: —tell me, what is the fate of a water bubble in the wave?

stanza.lyrics: itaḷ nīrttiya kusumaṅgaḷkozhiyunnatu pōlemadhu nukarum śalabham tanciṙak-utirum pōle
stanza.meaning: Like petals falling from a blossomed flower, like butterfly wings lost while sipping nectar,

stanza.lyrics: oru noḍiyil ciri ārnnatumizhi-munnil maṙayumpulnāmbile hima-kaṇam amarunnoru viravē vāzhv-ennatum aṙiyū
stanza.meaning: like joy disappearing in a moment before your eyes—remember, life is as fleeting as a dewdrop on a blade of grass.

stanza.lyrics: mati mati ennaruḷāteuzhalunn-oru manamēazhal allāt-entu bhujiccuitu vare onnatu collu
stanza.meaning: O restless mind, never content, never saying, “Enough, enough”—tell me, what have you truly consumed until now, except sorrow?

song.title: maunamām manassil
song.source: Maunamam manassil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: maunamām manassil ninn-uyarunna prēmamakam tiṅgi kara kaviññ-atiraṫṫ-ozhukaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: The love that wells up from a silent mind, may it overflow its shores and spread everywhere.

stanza.lyrics: ā dhanya-vāridhiyil muṅgi nivarum enkaṙakaḷaññā-bhakti ūṫṫam uṙaykkaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: Let my devotion, bathing in that divine river, become pure and unwavering.

stanza.lyrics: entinnu kuṙavennu eṇṇum manassiniakakkaṇṇin bimbam niṙaññ-eṅgum kāṇaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: Let my mind, which always finds fault with others, see the reflection of my own inner self in everyone.

stanza.lyrics: taḷarāte takarāte lakṣyattil ēṙānāysēviccu snēhiccu dhanyatayōḍ-aṅgane
stanza.meaning: Without becoming disheartened or weary, let us love and serve all beings to reach our goal. Let us move forward in gratitude.

stanza.lyrics: dīnadayākari jagadō-dhāriṇibhava-tāriṇi mama janani nīyē gati
stanza.meaning: The one who uplifts the world, who showers grace upon the helpless, who carries us across the ocean of birth and death. Mother! You are both the way and the goal.

stanza.lyrics: taṭṭi taḍaññoru cuvaḍaṅgu vekkavēāyiram cuvaḍōḍi aṇayunna amma tan
stanza.meaning: Though we may stumble at obstacles, when we take one step forward, Mother takes a thousand steps toward us.

stanza.lyrics: ā kṛpādhārayil pāte gamikkavēādhāram ētaṙiñña ‘aham’ ozhiññīḍaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: In that constant flow of grace, may my ego leave me, and may I know that you are the sustaining power.

stanza.lyrics: dīnadayākari jagadō-dhāriṇibhava-tāriṇi mama janani nīyē gati
stanza.meaning: The one who uplifts the world, who showers grace upon the helpless, who carries us across the ocean of birth and death. Mother! You are both the way and the goal.

song.title: maunattin-āzhattil āṇḍu pōy
song.source: Maunattin Azhattil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: maunattin-āzhattil āṇḍu pōy dhyānattil - layam ārnnu cittam vimūkamāyi
stanza.meaning: The mind sinks into the silent depths of meditation; in perfect stillness, the heart blooms for a moment.

stanza.lyrics: oru mātra nēram nimīlitam ākunnu - ēkāgra hṛdayaṅgaḷ niśabdamāyi
stanza.meaning: The mind sinks into the silent depths of meditation; in perfect stillness, the heart blooms for a moment.

stanza.lyrics: guruvin svarūpam viḷaṅgī hṛdayattilprēmāśruḍhāra ozhukīḍunnu
stanza.meaning: The form of the Guru shone within my heart, and tears of love began to flow.

stanza.lyrics: ā tṛppadaṅgaḷe vāri puṇaravēcolli en prāṇanām sadguravē
stanza.meaning: I embraced those divine feet and spoke to my Sadguru, my very life.

stanza.lyrics: tṛkkaiyyil viṇayāy māṫṫukī jīvaneā divya-saṅgītam ennilūḍe
stanza.meaning: Make this life a Veena in your holy hands, so all may hear your divine music through me.

stanza.lyrics: kēḷppikka sarvare ennu collīḍavēguruvinde cittavum ārdramāyi
stanza.meaning: As she heard my words, the Guru’s heart grew tender

stanza.lyrics: pavitram ā tṛkkaikaḷ vīṇayil amaravērāgavum tāḷa śruti-layaṅgaḷ
stanza.meaning: As her pure fingers played upon the Veena, from the disciple’s Veena flowed unceasingly the tune,

stanza.lyrics: śiṣyande vīṇayil aviratam ozhukunnuātmānubhūtiyil onnu cērnnu
stanza.meaning: the rhythm, the melody of a soul merged in the bliss of the Self.

stanza.lyrics: sarvarum dhyāna-nimagnarāyi cittaṅgaḷmūkamāy śāntamāy nirvṛtiyāyi
stanza.meaning: All became still in meditation; hearts fell silent, peaceful, and blissful.

stanza.lyrics: antaraṅgattil ā prēmam niṙayukildūram bhramam mātram ennaṙiññu
stanza.meaning: When love fills the heart, know that all delusion fades away.

song.title: māyālōkada marubhūmiyali
song.source: Mayalokada marubhumiyali 2025 Kan in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: māyālōkada marubhūmiyalialeyutihe andhakāra jāladi
stanza.meaning: In the arid desert of this illusory world, I wander amidst a dark web of ignorance.

stanza.lyrics: śivanē ajñāna timirava nīgisijñāna-jyōti beḷagisu hṛdayadi
stanza.meaning: O Shiva, remove the cataract of delusion and kindle the light of knowledge in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: ādiśivana kaṭākṣava nīḍimōha-mēghada mañju karagisi
stanza.meaning: When Lord Shiva’s compassionate gaze falls upon us, the fog of delusion melts away like dew.

stanza.lyrics: sōhaṁ emba sūryanu udisibhinnavalla nānu endu tiḷisiri
stanza.meaning: May the sun of soham (‘I am That’) dawn within me — please help me realize the truth that I am not separate.

stanza.lyrics: sōham śivōham (2)
stanza.meaning: I am That, I am Shiva…

stanza.lyrics: nijavannu maretu anyava nōḍimanavu silukide bhava-bandhanadi
stanza.meaning: We have forgotten the Truth and perceive only duality. The mind is ensnared by worldly bonds.

stanza.lyrics: śiva mahānāma sāgarava harisimunnaḍēsu nanna mōkṣa mārgadi
stanza.meaning: May the ocean of Shiva’s great name flow through me and guide me onward on the path to liberation.

song.title: māyē… mahāmāyē… īlōkam ellām
song.source: Maye Mahamaye 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: māyē… mahāmāyē… īlōkam ellām mayakkiḍunna tāyē… ōhō
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are Mahamaya — the great divine Illusion, enchanting and deluding the entire world.

stanza.lyrics: kāḷi… mahākāḷi…śōkam ellām akaṫṫiḍum karāḷi
stanza.meaning: You are Kali — the one who transcends time, and Mahakali, of immeasurable power and might. You are Karali, the fierce one who dispels all sorrow.

stanza.lyrics: mūnnaḍiyāl mūnnu lōkam aḷannu vāmanan – ōhōmūvulakam mizhimunayāl aḷanna tāy nī
stanza.meaning: Vamana measured the three worlds in just three steps — but you, O Mother, measured them with a mere glance from the corner of your eye.

stanza.lyrics: mukkaṇṇane mūkanākki bharaṇa-nipuṇa nīmūvulakin adhipatiyāy annapūrṇṇa nī
stanza.meaning: You are the great Empress who silenced even three-eyed Shiva. O Annapoorna, you became the sovereign of the three worlds.

stanza.lyrics: māyē… mahāmāyē… īlōkam ellām mayakkiḍunna tāyē… ōhō
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are Mahamaya — the great divine Illusion, enchanting and deluding the entire world.

stanza.lyrics: kaḍamizhiyāl eytu ende manam iḷakki nī ahāalakaḷ-ārnna mana-sarassin malam akaṫṫi nī
stanza.meaning: You shot an arrow from the corner of your eye and churned the depths of my mind. You cleansed the restless waves in the lake of my heart.

stanza.lyrics: madhu ozhukum mozhimalarāl madam aḍakki nī hāysudha pakarum oru ciriyāl manam mayakki nī
stanza.meaning: With words as sweet as flowing honey, you humbled my pride. With a smile full of bliss, you captivated my soul.

stanza.lyrics: māyē… mahāmāyē… īlōkam ellām mayakkiḍunna tāyē… ōhō
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are Mahamaya — the great divine Illusion, enchanting and deluding the entire world.

stanza.lyrics: trimūrtti nī mahēśinī mahādēvi nī – ellājīvanum jagattumparabrahmavum nīyē
stanza.meaning: O Great Goddess, you are Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva — you are all that exists, both the individual soul and the entire universe. . Mother, you are the Absolute Reality;

stanza.lyrics: nī allātī mūvulakil ārum illammēsatyam bōdhippicciḍāttamahāmāyayum nīyē/
stanza.meaning: there is none other for me in this world. You are Mahamaya — the Great Divine Illusion who veils the truth from mortal eyes.

stanza.lyrics: māyē… mahāmāyē… īlōkam ellām mayakkiḍunna tāyē… ōhō
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are Mahamaya — the great divine Illusion, enchanting and deluding the entire world.

song.title: māyī… mainē…
song.source: Mayi maine Govinda 2025 Braj in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: māyī… mainē… gōvinda līnō mōlmāyī mainē gōvinda līnō mōl
stanza.meaning: Mother, I have bought Govinda at a price…

stanza.lyrics: kōyī kahē sastā… kōyī kahē mahngākōyī kahē sastā kōyī kahē mahngālīnō tarāzū tōl
stanza.meaning: Some say it was cheap, some say it was expensive—but I bought him by weighing him on the scale of yearning.

stanza.lyrics: kōyī kahē ghar meiṅ… kōyī kahē ban meiṅkōyī kahē ghar meiṅ kōyī kahē ban meiṅrādhā kē saṅg kilōl
stanza.meaning: Some say he is in the home, some say he is in the forest—but he is engaged in playful love with Radha.

stanza.lyrics: mīrā kē prabhu… giridhar nāgarāvat prēm kē mōl
stanza.meaning: He is Meera’s Lord, Giridhar Nagar—he comes only at the price of love.

song.title: māyī… mainē…
song.source: Mayi maine Govinda lino Mayi maine 2025 Braj in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Mayi maine Govinda lino Mayi maine 2025 Braj in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: māyī… mainē… gōvinda līnō mōlmāyī mainē gōvinda līnō mōl
stanza.meaning: Mother, I have bought Govinda at a price…

stanza.lyrics: kōyī kahē sastā… kōyī kahē mahngākōyī kahē sastā kōyī kahē mahngālīnō tarāzū tōl
stanza.meaning: Some say it was cheap, some say it was expensive—but I bought him by weighing him on the scale of yearning.

stanza.lyrics: kōyī kahē ghar meiṅ… kōyī kahē ban meiṅkōyī kahē ghar meiṅ kōyī kahē ban meiṅrādhā kē saṅg kilōl
stanza.meaning: Some say he is in the home, some say he is in the forest—but he is engaged in playful love with Radha.

stanza.lyrics: mīrā kē prabhu… giridhar nāgarāvat prēm kē mōl
stanza.meaning: He is Meera’s Lord, Giridhar Nagar—he comes only at the price of love.

song.title: māyi mhārō supaṇāmā
song.source: Mayi mharo supanama 2025 Marwari in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: māyi mhārō supaṇāmā parṇyāṙe dīnānāthō dīnānāth… dīnānāth…
stanza.meaning: Mother, in my dream Lord Dinanath came. O Dinanath, Lord of the downtrodden…

stanza.lyrics: chappan kōṭā jaṇā padhāryādulhō siri brajnāth
stanza.meaning: In that dream, countless multitudes arrived, and the bridegroom was none other than the Lord of Braj.

stanza.lyrics: supaṇāmā tōraṇ bandhyā rīsupaṇāmā gayā hāth
stanza.meaning: The wedding garland was tied in the dream, and in that dream my hand was taken.

stanza.lyrics: supaṇāmā mhārē paraṇa gayāpāya acal suhāg
stanza.meaning: In that dream, I was married, and my wedded fortune became firm and eternal.

stanza.lyrics: mīrā rō giridhar mīlyārīpurāb janam rō hād
stanza.meaning: There, I was united with my Giridhār, and the bond of a previous birth was fulfilled.

stanza.lyrics: māyi mhārō supanāmā parnāṙe dīnānāthō dīnānāth… dīnānāth…ō dīnānāth… dīnānāth…
stanza.meaning: Mother, in my dream Lord Dinanath came. O Dinanath, Lord of the downtrodden…

song.title: mayilppīli azhakēṫṫiḍum
song.source: Mayil pili azhakettidum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mayilppīli azhakēṫṫiḍum ā cikurabhāramō ramyammuḷantaṇḍatil utirnniḍum ā madhuragānamō ramyam
stanza.meaning: Is it the dark, flowing hair adorned with peacock feathers that is beautiful? Or the enchanting melody that flows from the bamboo flute?

stanza.lyrics: pītāmbaramatil āvṛtam ā śyāmavarṇṇamō ramyamkaruṇāmadhurima vazhiññiḍum ā kaḍākṣasumamō ramyam
stanza.meaning: Is it the dusky form draped in radiant yellow silk that is beautiful? Or the tender glance from which sweet compassion pours forth?

stanza.lyrics: gōpimaṇtilaka-lasitam ā lalāḍatalamō ramyammaṇikuṇḍalaṅgaḷoḍu viḷaṅgiḍum ā karṇṇayugaḷamō ramyam
stanza.meaning: Is it the brow adorned with the tilak of Gopichandan that is beautiful, Or the ears where the Manikundala earrings gleam with light?

stanza.lyrics: anilanoḍu nṛtyaccuvaḍukaḷ vaykkum aḷakavṛndamō ramyamaruṇimayoḍu mṛduhāsamārnnayā adharaśobhayō ramyam
stanza.meaning: Is it the heavy locks of hair that dance in the wind, Or the smiling lips aglow with a crimson radiance that are beautiful?

stanza.lyrics: mauktikāvalīhāra-vilasita kaṇṭhaśrīyō ramyamkaṅkaṇamuraḷī-dhṛtayutamām ā karābjaṅgaḷō ramyam
stanza.meaning: Is it the neck where pearl necklaces gently dance that is beautiful, Or the lotus hands, adorned with bangles and holding the bamboo flute?

stanza.lyrics: kaustubha-maṇibhuṣita-manōjñamā vakṣasthalamō ramyammuktamañjīra-yutamatām ā muktidānghriyō ramyam
stanza.meaning: Is it the chest adorned with the radiant Kaustubha gem that is beautiful, Or the feet graced with pearl anklets that bestow liberation?

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇā… cārunētrā… pītavastrā… śyāmagātrā…cittacōrā… vēṇulōlā… puṣpahāsā… hṛdinivāsā
stanza.meaning: Krishna of the beautiful eyes, clad in yellow robes, with a dark-hued form, The flute player who steals our hearts, Whose blossoming smile enchants, and who dwells within our hearts.

song.title: mazha peytu nanavārnna vīthiyilūḍe
song.source: Mazha peytu nanavarnna 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mazha peytu nanavārnna vīthiyilūḍe ñānenne tiraññu kaḍannu pōkē
stanza.meaning: I walk the rain-swept path in search of myself.

stanza.lyrics: vismaya dṛśyaṅgaḷ mūḍum manassitil - ēkānta maunam koticcu ñānum
stanza.meaning: My mind, clouded by dazzling sights, still yearns for silence and solitude.

stanza.lyrics: nirttāte peyyunna varṣamāyi cinta tan - kuttozhukkil peṭṭu uzhaṙi ñānum
stanza.meaning: Thoughts, like an unending downpour, carry me along in their strong currents.

stanza.lyrics: enneyum pēṙi ozhukunna kāzhcayil - sākṣiyāyi maṫṫoru ñānum uṇḍu
stanza.meaning: As I’m swept away and the sights drift past, there remains a witnessing “I.”

stanza.lyrics: iruḷārnna vipinattil tēḍunnu sūryāṁśuoru tari ponnoḷi uḷ niṙayān
stanza.meaning: The dark forest longs for a shaft of sunlight, a ray of molten gold to fill its heart.

stanza.lyrics: durghaḍam ī vīthi etra tāṇḍīḍilumoḍuvilā niśabda-bhuvil ettān
stanza.meaning: Yet I tread along this difficult path, seeking to at last reach the land of silence

stanza.lyrics: antaraṅgattil tuḍikkumā jīvande - nombaram īṙanā smṛti uṇartti
stanza.meaning: The painful yearning of the self (jiva) stiring within awakens a fresh memory.

stanza.lyrics: eviḍeyō kaṇḍu maṙanna mukhaṅgaḷe - vīṇḍumā mizhikaḷil kaṇḍīḍavē
stanza.meaning: My eyes once again behold faces that I had seen and forgotten elsewhere.

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷam vitumbiyō aṙivīla uṇmayum - tamassu mūḍi mana vanabhumiyil
stanza.meaning: Did my heart weep? I do not know. The truth lies hidden in the dark forest of the mind.

stanza.lyrics: enn-uṇarnnīḍum ā udayārkka kiraṇaṅgaḷcittaḍattil ātmasatyam ēki
stanza.meaning: When will the dawn’s first rays awaken self-realization within this heart?

song.title: mazhayāy pozhiyuk-ammē
song.source: Mazhayay pozhiyukayamme 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mazhayāy pozhiyuk-ammēmukilāy vann-aṇayūmalarāy madhu pakarūkāṫṫāy kuḷir pakarū
stanza.meaning: Mother! Descend as the rain, come as the cloud, bloom as a flower and offer your nectar. Come as the cool, gentle breeze.

stanza.lyrics: puzhayāy nadiyāy ozhukuk-ammētaruvāy taṇal ēkiḍū
stanza.meaning: Flow as a river—vast and mighty. Stand as a tree, offering the shade of your grace.

stanza.lyrics: latayāy paḍaruka nīaṙivāy niṙav-ēkū nī
stanza.meaning: Grow as a tender creeper, and fill our hearts with true knowledge.

stanza.lyrics: manatāril madhu-mozhi tūvuk-ammē - māya tan maṙa nīkki teḷiyuk-ammē
stanza.meaning: Rain down the nectar of compassion upon my heart; lift the veil of illusion and reveal your radiant form.

stanza.lyrics: kāvya-kāḷindiyāy ozhukuk-ammē - nādāmṛta-dhāra coriyuk-ammē
stanza.meaning: Flow as Kalindi, the river of sacred poetry, and shower me with the ambrosial music of your soul.

stanza.lyrics: śāntiyil nistula-śānti ēkutatvattil ātma-tatvam pakarū
stanza.meaning: Grant me peace—unsurpassed and eternal. Bless me with the knowledge of the Self.

stanza.lyrics: ammayāy uṇma ēkūprabhayāy prabha tūkiḍū
stanza.meaning: Come, O Mother, as truth incarnate; come as light, and illumine the depths of my being.

song.title: mīṇākṣi dēviyē
song.source: Meenakshi deviye 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mīṇākṣi dēviyē en manatil vāzhum annayē
stanza.meaning: O Goddess Meenakshi, O Mother who lives in my heart,

stanza.lyrics: madurai āḷum rāṇiyēun anbu maṭṭum pōtumē
stanza.meaning: O Queen who rules Madurai, your love alone is enough for me.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇ imai mūḍāmal bhaktargaḷai kāppādināḷ
stanza.meaning: The one who protects devotees without even blinking your eyes,

stanza.lyrics: mīnākṣi ammai ena pōṫṫrapaḍum bairaviyē
stanza.meaning: Meenakshi Ammai is also praised as Bhairavi,

stanza.lyrics: tāyāga tuṇaiyāga guruvāga vantavaḷ
stanza.meaning: the one who came as mother, companion, and guru

stanza.lyrics: mīnākṣi… mahādēvi… mahāgauri… śaṅkari…
stanza.meaning: Meenakshi, Mahadevi, Mahagauri, Shankari.

stanza.lyrics: sundararin pādiyāna pārvatiyum śaktiyum nī
stanza.meaning: You are Parvati and Shakti, the half of the beautiful Shiva,

stanza.lyrics: kuṙaigaḷai pōkki en mēl karuṇai seyum kārttikayē
stanza.meaning: Kartika who removes faults and shows me compassion,

stanza.lyrics: tāyāga tuṇaiyāga guruvāga vantavaḷ
stanza.meaning: the one who came as mother, companion, and guru

stanza.lyrics: mīnākṣi… mahādēvi… mahāgauri… śaṅkari…
stanza.meaning: Meenakshi, Mahadevi, Mahagauri, Shankari.

song.title: mīnākṣi manadāḷum tāyē
song.source: Meenakshi manamalum taye 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mīnākṣi manadāḷum tāyēennil māyayai nīkki nin malaraḍi taruvāy
stanza.meaning: O Mother Meenakshi, who dwells within my heart! Remove the delusion within me and grant me the vision of your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: kāmakṣiyē karuṇākariyēsamsāra kaḍalinai tāṇḍavē dayai sey
stanza.meaning: Kamakshi, ocean of compassion, bestow your mercy and help me cross the vast ocean of worldly existence.

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷanpōḍum uṇarvōḍum unnai tudikkaumaye nī uḷḷam kanindu aruḷ purivāy
stanza.meaning: O Uma, let your heart soften and shower your grace on me, so that I worship you with heart and awareness.

stanza.lyrics: kāmākṣi mīnākṣi en manasākṣimāyattirai nīkki viraindu nī kāppāy
stanza.meaning: O Kamakshi, O Meenakshi, witness of my mind, remove the veils of illusion and come swiftly to protect me.

stanza.lyrics: tudippārin tunbattai tīrppāy dēvitīrāda vinaikaḷai tīrttu nī aruḷvāy
stanza.meaning: O Goddess, you alone can remove the sorrows of the afflicted. Destroy the endless chain of deeds (karma) and bestow your grace.

stanza.lyrics: mātaṅgi jaganmātē māyēulakattin uḷ poruḷ uṇmayum nīyē
stanza.meaning: O Matangi, Mother of the universe, O Maya! You are the essence and the truth of this world.

stanza.lyrics: ammā ammā anbāna ammāammā ammā azhakāna ammāammā ammā aṇaikkum ammāammā ammā amudāna ammā
stanza.meaning: Mother — the loving Mother, the beautiful Mother, the Mother who embraces, the Mother who is sweet as nectar.

song.title: mēre tō giridhar gōpāldūsrō na kōī
song.source: Mere to Giridhar Gopal 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Mere to Giridhar Gopal 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mēre tō giridhar gōpāldūsrō na kōī
stanza.meaning: There is no one else for me, other than my Giridhar Gopal

stanza.lyrics: jākē sir mōr mukuṭmērō pati sōī rēdūsrō na kōī
stanza.meaning: —He who wears a crown of peacock feathers is my beloved, my Lord; for me, there is truly no other.

stanza.lyrics: tāt māt bhrāt bandhuāpaṇā na kōī
stanza.meaning: Father, mother, brother, and relatives—there is none truly mine.

stanza.lyrics: chāḍ gaī kul kī lājkā kahiyē kōī rēdūsrō na kōī
stanza.meaning: I have left behind the honor of the family; what can anyone say about me? For me, there is no one else.

stanza.lyrics: asuvan jal sīñc sīñcprēm bēl bōyi
stanza.meaning: Watering it with tears, I planted the vine of love.

stanza.lyrics: ab tō dēkh phail gayiānand phal hōy rēdūsrō na kōī
stanza.meaning: Now see, it has spread far and wide, bearing the fruit of bliss. There is no one else for me but Him.

stanza.lyrics: bhagat dēkh rāji hōījagat dēkh rōī
stanza.meaning: The Lord is pleased to see His devotee, while the world weeps upon seeing her.

stanza.lyrics: dāsī mīrā lāl giridhardārō ab hōyidārō ab hōyi rēdūsrō na kōī
stanza.meaning: Meera, the humble servant of her beloved Giridhar, has now found refuge. She has found refuge indeed, and for her, there is no one else.

stanza.lyrics: mēre tō giridhar gōpāldūsrō na kōī
stanza.meaning: There is no one else for me, other than my Giridhar Gopal

stanza.lyrics: jākē sir mōr mukuṭmērō pati sōī rēdūsrō na kōī
stanza.meaning: —He who wears a crown of peacock feathers is my beloved, my Lord; for me, there is truly no other.

song.title: mhārā rē giridhar gōpāl
song.source: Mhara re Giridhar Gopal 2025 Marwari in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Mhara re Giridhar Gopal 2025 Marwari in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mhārā rē giridhar gōpāldūsrā ṇa kōyādūsrā ṇa kōyādūsrā ṇa kōyā
stanza.meaning: My Lord is Giridhar Gopal-there is no other for me, none at all.

stanza.lyrics: sadā sakal lōk jōyā dūsrā ṇa kōyāmhārā rē giridhar gōpāl
stanza.meaning: Throughout all the worlds, I have seen and known—there is no one else for me. My Lord is Giridhar Gopal.

stanza.lyrics: bhāyā chāḍyā bandhā chāḍyāchāḍyā sagā bhūyā…
stanza.meaning: I left behind my fears, I left behind my family and kin. I abandoned every worldly tie.

stanza.lyrics: sādhū saṅg baiṭh baiṭhsādhū saṅg baiṭh baiṭhlōk lāj khōyā
stanza.meaning: Sitting in the company of saints, I lost all concern for what people may think or say.

stanza.lyrics: bhagat dēkhyā rājihyā jagat dēkhyā rōyā
stanza.meaning: When I beheld the true devotee, I rejoiced; but when I looked upon the world, I wept.

stanza.lyrics: dūdh math gṛt kāḍh laiyādār gayā chuyādār gayā chuyā
stanza.meaning: I churned the milk of devotion and drew out the pure ghee—yet the world laughed and scorned me.

stanza.lyrics: rāṇā viṣ rō pyālā bhējāpiyā magaṇ hōyā
stanza.meaning: Rana sent me a cup of poison, but I drank it with joyful surrender.

stanza.lyrics: mīrā rī lagan lagyāmīrā rī lagan lagyāhōṇa hō jō hōyā
stanza.meaning: Mira has given her heart completely—whatever is to happen, let it happen.

song.title: mil gayā mil gayā darśan
song.source: Mil gaya 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mil gayā mil gayā darśan mujhē mil gayāmil gayā mil gayā cain mujhē mil gayā
stanza.meaning: I have received it—I have received the divine vision! I have found peace—I have truly received it.

stanza.lyrics: anāth ki rakṣā karne vālīvijñānī kō jñān dēnē vālī
stanza.meaning: She who protects the abandoned, who grants wisdom to the wise,

stanza.lyrics: nirbal kō śakti dēnē vālībacōṅ ki pyārī dulārī mayyā
stanza.meaning: who gives strength to the weak, who is the beloved darling of children

stanza.lyrics: ambē mayyā pyārī mayyā
stanza.meaning: —she is my sweet Mother, my beloved Mother.

stanza.lyrics: janam janam sē ḍhūṇḍhā har din har kṣaṇpāyā tō hai is janam mēṅ tujhkō mā
stanza.meaning: I searched for you through many lifetimes, every single day and every single moment—and now, in this very birth, I have finally found you, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: mil gayā mil gayā darśan mujhē mil gayākhil gayā khil gayā hṛdaya-kamal khil gayā
stanza.meaning: I have received it—I have received your darshan! My heart-lotus has blossomed in full bloom with joy and love.

stanza.lyrics: phūlōṅ kī mahak se… galē lagāke…karuṇā sē… muskurākē…
stanza.meaning: With the fragrance of flowers, with a loving embrace, with compassion and a gentle smile,

stanza.lyrics: dil kī bāt sunkē hal nikālā
stanza.meaning: you listened to the deepest feelings of my heart and brought resolution to my pain.

stanza.lyrics: mil gayā mil gayā darśan mujhē mil gayāmiṭ gayā miṭ gayā dard mērā miṭ gayā
stanza.meaning: I have received it—I have truly received your darshan. My sorrow has been wiped away—completely gone.

song.title: Miles away from you
song.source: Miles away 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: Miles away from youCloser than my breathYour essence in hearts of allI pray to merge in you
Devi whose hair is skyPlease reveal your subtle form
Boundless and full, perfectly stillShine forth from the shrine within
Miles away from you
each and every drop of your loveDevi is like fragrant gold
the sun rises, the path unfoldsMoments with you etched in my soul
Miles away from you
Devi hold me close from farHold me close from farDevi hold me close from far

song.title: mizhi colli avan annu pōy
song.source: Mizhi cholli avanannu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mizhi colli avan annu pōy-oru vazhi nōkki‘vanamāli innu varum’
stanza.meaning: Radha’s eyes, lingering on the path Krishna had taken, spoke to her heart: “The one adorned with a garland of forest flowers will surely come today.”

stanza.lyrics: vazhi colli, ‘atināyi kāttirikkunnu ñāntirupāda sparśattināy’
stanza.meaning: The path whispered, “I await his return, yearning for the touch of his sacred feet.”

stanza.lyrics: lata colli, ‘kaṇṇande tazhukal ēṫṫ-ennendevyathakaḷ aliññu tīrum!’
stanza.meaning: The flowering creeper murmured, “The day he gently caresses me, all my sorrows will dissolve into nothingness.”

stanza.lyrics: sakhi colli, ‘varum avan hṛdayēśan allayōsukham ēkuvān aṇayum’
stanza.meaning: Her companion said with hope, “He will come—the Lord of our hearts will return and fill us with joy.”

stanza.lyrics: karuṇārdra-mānasā! karutukillē innukanivārnnu nī varillē?
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, your heart overflows with compassion—will you not think of our plight? Will you not return to Vrindavan, stirred by your boundless love?

stanza.lyrics: iruḷ tiṅgi niṙayumī ēzha tan mizhikaḷilnaṙunilāvāy varillē?
stanza.meaning: Will you not rise like the full moon in the eyes of this heartbroken one, whose vision is veiled in the darkness of your separation?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā…

song.title: mizhi nanayāte kaṇṇā nin rūpam
song.source: Mizhi nanayate 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mizhi nanayāte kaṇṇā nin rūpamkāṇuvān ākumō maṇivarṇṇā
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, you who shine like a blue jewel, how can I behold your form without my eyes brimming with tears?

stanza.lyrics: ā nimiṣattil en mizhi onn-aḍaññappōḷōḍi oḷiccatō giridhāri
stanza.meaning: You, who lifted the Govardhana mountain—did you run away and hide the very moment I closed my eyes

stanza.lyrics: vilvamaṅgalam ninne puṙamkaiyyāl taḷḷiyatuen karmam āṇō collu collu
stanza.meaning: Vilwamangalam pushed you aside with his hand when you pretended to be naughty and tried to disturb his worship. But tell me—how can it be my karma that you ran away and hid from me?

stanza.lyrics: kuṙūramma ninne kalattil aḍaccatumen pizhav-āṇennu ninaccuvō nī
stanza.meaning: Kurur Amma, your great devotee, shut you inside a pot when you tried to disturb her worship. But tell me—do you consider that to be my fault?

stanza.lyrics: akrūran mathuraykku koṇḍu pōm nērattuarutē – ennu ñān ōtiyillē… en
stanza.meaning: When Akrura came to Vrindavan to take you to Mathura, did I not plead with you, 'Do not leave'?

stanza.lyrics: manassām vipinattil ēkayāy tīruvānvidhiccatu ucitamō vraja-nandanā
stanza.meaning: You are the delight of Vrindavan—so is it just, then, that you have decreed I remain all alone in the forest of my mind?

stanza.lyrics: kāḷiya-phaṇattil nin nṛtta-cuvaḍukaḷkaṇḍu rasikkān ñān vannatallē…
stanza.meaning: Did I not come to see and rejoice in your dance atop Kaliya’s hoods?

stanza.lyrics: nṛttam āḍum nēram ā mṛdu-pādaṅgaḷtazhukān ñān aṇaññatum maṙannuvō nī…
stanza.meaning: Have you forgotten how I drew near to gently rub your tender feet as you danced?

stanza.lyrics: nirmālya-darśana-puṇyattāl ī janmamkarppūra-dīpamāy tīrnniḍaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: Let me become a camphor lamp, blessed with the great fortune of your Nirmalya Darshan.

stanza.lyrics: paṭṭu-pītāmbaram cuṫṫiya nin rūpammanatāril ennum ñān kaṇḍiḍaṭṭe kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: Let me ever behold your form—clad in yellow silk, shining within the lotus of my heart.

stanza.lyrics: pādāravindattil cērnnīḍaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, let me become one with your lotus feet.

song.title: mizhinīril āzhnnu
song.source: Mizhiniril azhnnu mazhkum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mizhinīril āzhnnu māzhkum manassiluṇarv-ēkān aṇayū janani…
stanza.meaning: My heart is weary from tears that endlessly flow. Mother, make me anew.

stanza.lyrics: kaniv-ūṙum tirumizhi tumbāl onn-aḍiyandeeriyunn-akam onnuzhiyū jananieriyunn-akam onnuzhiyū
stanza.meaning: With your eyes, aglow with compassion, caress this aching heart.

stanza.lyrics: jananieriyunn-akam onnuzhiyū
stanza.meaning: O Mother, caress this aching heart.

stanza.lyrics: nīḷum ī rāvil kāḷum manassilpāḷunnu cintakaḷ ammē
stanza.meaning: The night stretches on, and my mind is on fire.

stanza.lyrics: viḷaṙunnu vadanam pataṙunnu mizhikaḷtirayunn-aharniśam ninne
stanza.meaning: My thoughts run wild, my face has grown pale, and my eyes are weary. Day and night, I search for you

stanza.lyrics: ammē… tirayunn-aharniśam ninne
stanza.meaning: —Mother, every moment, I yearn for you.

stanza.lyrics: viṅgunn-en karaḷil tiṅgunna kadanamcīntunnu cittam endammē
stanza.meaning: Sorrow surges within my weeping heart, as if it's being torn apart.

stanza.lyrics: enmana poykayil nin vadanāmbujamteḷiyunna sudinam ētammē
stanza.meaning: When will the blessed day dawn, when your lotus face shines clear in the lake of my heart?

stanza.lyrics: ammē… teḷiyunna sudinam ētammē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, when will that sacred day arrive?

song.title: Mother with you as our shield
song.source: Mother with You as our shield 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Mother with You as our shield 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: Mother with you as our shieldthere is nothing left to fearknowing the battles are already wonlet us not waste this life
you have cleared the path Mother, you have lit the wayknowing the battles are already wonlet us not waste this life
you give the strength that we needMother, you give the air that we breathe
knowing the battles are already wonlet us not waste this life

song.title: mṛg-tṛṣṇā meiṅ bhaṭakē manvā
song.source: Mriga trishna mein Bhatke manva 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Mriga trishna mein Bhatke manva 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mṛg-tṛṣṇā meiṅ bhaṭakē manvācir sukh kahiṅ na pāvē
stanza.meaning: Mesmerised by the mirage, the mind never finds lasting happiness.

stanza.lyrics: ḍhūṇḍhē jag meiṅ sukh kī chāyācit hari meiṅ na lagāvē
stanza.meaning: It searches in this world for the shadow of comfort, yet never fixes itself on the Lord.

stanza.lyrics: kām kāñcan mōha-jāl meiṅman kyōṅ uljhā jāyē?
stanza.meaning: Why does the mind get entangled in the snare of desire, wealth, and attachment?

stanza.lyrics: jisē sadā tū apnā mānēvō bhī ik din jāyē
stanza.meaning: Even those you consider forever your own will one day leave you.

stanza.lyrics: hari ōm namō nārāyaṇayahari ōm namō nārāyaṇaya
stanza.meaning: I bow to God, the ultimate reality…

stanza.lyrics: guru vāṇī jō śravaṇ karēantaḥkaraṇ vō jāgē
stanza.meaning: One who listens to the Guru’s words awakens the inner self.

stanza.lyrics: viṣay vikār, sab tyāg dēnij svarūp sō sājē
stanza.meaning: Giving up all cravings and impurities, one attains his/her true nature.

stanza.lyrics: khulē nayan tō darśan pāēhari kī alaukik sūrat
stanza.meaning: When the inner eye opens and beholds the divine form of God,

stanza.lyrics: bhītar sōham bhāv jab khilēhar or hari kī mūrat
stanza.meaning: the realization that 'I am That' dawns within. Then Hari alone remains, forever abiding.

song.title: mujhē apnā banā lō
song.source: Mujhe apna bana lo 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Mujhe apna bana lo 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mujhē apnā banā lō mērī mā…mērī mā… mērī mā…
stanza.meaning: Mother, make me your own... O Mother, my Mother.

stanza.lyrics: har dam tērē sāth rahūṅtērē binā maiṅ jī nā sakūṅ
stanza.meaning: Always let me remain with you, for without you I cannot live.

stanza.lyrics: andhiyārē jīvan meiṅpyār kā dīp jalā dē…pyār kā dīp jalā dē
stanza.meaning: In the darkness of this life, light the lamp of love,

stanza.lyrics: mērī mā… mērī mā…
stanza.meaning: O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: kitnē sāvan baras gayēmaiyā tērī yādōṅ meiṅ
stanza.meaning: So many monsoons have passed, Mother, while I remained absorbed in your memories.

stanza.lyrics: yē nayanā taras rahēab tō darśan dē dē…ab tō darśan dē dē
stanza.meaning: These eyes are longing, waiting with yearning. Now at least, grant me your vision… now at least, reveal yourself.

stanza.lyrics: mērī mā… mērī mā…
stanza.meaning: O my Mother…

stanza.lyrics: jab tak jīvan caltā rahēnit tērī ham pūjā karēṅ
stanza.meaning: As long as life continues, I will worship you every day. As long as life continues, I will worship you every day.

stanza.lyrics: tērī dayā hō mūjh partū mujhē pās bulā lē…tū mujhē pās bulā lē
stanza.meaning: Let your compassion be upon me, and call me close to you,

stanza.lyrics: mērī mā… mērī mā…
stanza.meaning: O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: mujhē apnā banā lō mērī mā… mērī mā… mērī mā…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, make me your own.

song.title: mūkam ī hṛdayam
song.source: Mukam i Hridayam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: mūkam ī hṛdayam pāḍum nin kīrttanamkēḷkkātta bhāvam naḍiccīḍallē
stanza.meaning: Mother, do not pretend that you cannot hear the hymns my mute heart is singing.

stanza.lyrics: kāruṇya-vāridhiyāya en amma nīkāruṇyam alpavum ēkukillē
stanza.meaning: You are the ocean of compassion—won’t you give me at least a drop of your grace?

stanza.lyrics: nōvunnen hṛttaḍam aṙiyāte allammaventu nīṙīḍān vidhiccatāṇō
stanza.meaning: You know this heart of mine that grieves for you. Please do not decree that I must forever bear this searing anguish.

stanza.lyrics: onnum aṙiyāte takarunna hṛdayamāynin snēham tēḍi aṇaññīḍunnu
stanza.meaning: I know nothing—as I wander, searching for your love with a broken heart.

stanza.lyrics: bāhyamāy kēṇīḍunnilla eṅkilumnīṙi pukayunnen antaraṅgam
stanza.meaning: Even though my lips do not plead aloud, the pain within is unbearable.

stanza.lyrics: entaparādhattinuḷḷa śikṣayāṇ-ennōḍu colli taraṇam ammē
stanza.meaning: Mother, tell me—what wrong have I committed, that you have punished me thus?

stanza.lyrics: teṫṫu tiruttuvān nērvazhi kāṭṭuvānammayall-āruṇḍu ī ulakil
stanza.meaning: Who but you, O Mother, can correct my faults and guide me to the right path?

stanza.lyrics: nin prēma-bhaktiyil ninn-akaṫṫīḍallēninnil aliññu ñān tīrnniḍaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: Do not cast me away from the love and devotion I hold for you. Draw me near—let me merge into you, let me become one with you.

stanza.lyrics: ammē… ammē… ammē… ammē…
stanza.meaning: Oh Mother

song.title: muppiraviyin tavamō
song.source: Mupiraviyil tavamo 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: muppiraviyin tavamō ammā ippiraviyin unai nān kaṇḍēn
stanza.meaning: O Mother, was it because of penance done in a past life that I am able to see you in this life?

stanza.lyrics: eppiravi eḍuttālum ammā unnai sārndē nān iruppēn
stanza.meaning: O Mother, if I have to be reborn, may I always have a close bond with you.

stanza.lyrics: nī puviyānāl nān nilavāvēn unnai suttriyē vandiḍuvēn
stanza.meaning: O Mother, if you are the earth, I would be the moon, ever orbiting you.

stanza.lyrics: nī raviyānāl nān seḍiyāvēn un disai nōkkiyē pārttiruppēn
stanza.meaning: If you are the sun, I would be a plant, facing you always.

stanza.lyrics: nī mazhaiyānāl vānavillāvēn vaṇṇaṅkaḷāl unnai varavērppēn
stanza.meaning: If you are rain, I would be the rainbow, welcoming you with a profusion of colours.

stanza.lyrics: nī malaiyānāl nān paniyāvēn panittuḷiyāl unnai arccippēn
stanza.meaning: If you are a mountain, I would be snow, showering you with snowflakes.

stanza.lyrics: nī maramānāl nān koḍiyāvēn pādam pattriyē vaḷarndiḍuvēn
stanza.meaning: O Mother, if you are a tree, I would be a vine, clinging to your holy feet.

stanza.lyrics: nī kaḍalānāl nān nadiyāvēn tēḍi vandu unil karaindiḍuvēn
stanza.meaning: If you are a sea, I would be a river flowing in search of and uniting with you.

stanza.lyrics: nī vanamānāl nān malarāvēn pādaiyay pūkkaḷāl alaṅkarippēn
stanza.meaning: If you are a forest, I would be flowers, carpeting your path with vibrant blossoms.

stanza.lyrics: nī iravānāl viṇmīnāvēn un tōraṇamāy minniḍuvēn
stanza.meaning: If you were night, I would be stars, festooning you with my sparkles.

song.title: murahara muraḷika pāḍi en
song.source: Murahara muralika padi en 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Murahara muralika padi en 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: murahara muraḷika pāḍi enrādhikē nī eṅgu pōyi
stanza.meaning: The flute of Sri Krishna, slayer of the demon Mura, sang out in longing: "O my beloved Radhika, where have you gone?

stanza.lyrics: rāvēṙe cenniṭṭum rākkuyil pāḍiyiṭṭumnin vazhittārayō śūnyam
stanza.meaning: The night grows deep and silent, and the koel pours forth its sweet, yearning song—yet the path you once tread remains bare.

stanza.lyrics: mal prāṇasakhī… ennātma-sakhī
stanza.meaning: O my beloved, one with my very soul..."

stanza.lyrics: murahara muraḷika pāḍi enrādhikē nī eṅgu pōyi
stanza.meaning: The flute of Sri Krishna, slayer of the demon Mura, sang out in longing: "O my beloved Radhika, where have you gone?

stanza.lyrics: vannu mānattāy tāraṅgaḷ – ponambiḷikk-ēzhazhakāy
stanza.meaning: Clusters of stars have gathered in the sky to adorn the moon with their beauty.

stanza.lyrics: ī niśā malarukaḷ kūmbi aḍayunnunin priyanē maṙannō – mal
stanza.meaning: Night-blooming flowers gently close their petals. Have you forgotten me—the one who is in love with you?

stanza.lyrics: prāṇasakhī… ennātma-sakhī…
stanza.meaning: O my beloved, one with my very soul...

stanza.lyrics: murahara muraḷika pāḍi enrādhikē nī eṅgu pōyi
stanza.meaning: The flute of Sri Krishna, slayer of the demon Mura, sang out in longing: "O my beloved Radhika, where have you gone?

stanza.lyrics: mādhava-mānasam niṙavārnnubhakta-malarukaḷālē
stanza.meaning: The heart of Madhava blooms with flowers of many hues—flowers that are none other than his loving devotees.

stanza.lyrics: rādhikē nin pada-nṛtta-cuvaḍināyrādhikēśan ī dāsan kāttirippū – mal
stanza.meaning: O Radhika! This humble servant of yours, the Lord of your heart, waits in longing, yearning to dance with you.

stanza.lyrics: prāṇasakhī… ennātma-sakhī…
stanza.meaning: O my beloved, one with my very soul...

stanza.lyrics: murahara muraḷika pāḍi enrādhikē nī eṅgu pōyi
stanza.meaning: The flute of Sri Krishna, slayer of the demon Mura, sang out in longing: "O my beloved Radhika, where have you gone?

stanza.lyrics: tava pāda-dāsi ī rādha mama prāṇanum ātmāvum nīyē
stanza.meaning: Radha replies, “I am the servant of your lotus feet. You are my very life, my innermost self.

stanza.lyrics: nin mukha-candrikayāl niṙaññoru mānasamrajani tan varav-aṙiññīlā…
stanza.meaning: My heart was bathed in the radiance of your graceful face, as bright as the full moon

stanza.lyrics: rāvēṙe cennat-aṙiññīla – rādharāvēṙe cennat-aṙiññīla – rādha
stanza.meaning: —I did not know that night had fallen, nor that its silence had deepened.”

stanza.lyrics: nin pādadāsi ī rādha – kaṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, I remain ever your devoted servant at your lotus feet.

song.title: muraḷi ūti ūti
song.source: Murali uti uti 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: muraḷi ūti ūtimūḷippāṭṭukaḷ pāḍimadhupan paṙannu vannālmalarinn-entu tōnnum
stanza.meaning: Humming a tune as if playing on a flute, the honeybee comes flying to sip nectar from the flower—imagine the emotion of the flower.

stanza.lyrics: taḷiru tinniḍuvāntañcam onnu nōkki nōkkikuyilu vanniḍumbōḷmāvinn-entu tōnnum
stanza.meaning: The koel finds a moment to nibble on the tender shoot of the mango tree—imagine the emotion of the tree.

stanza.lyrics: katirmaṇi kottiḍuvānkaḷivākku colli collikiḷikaḷ vanniḍumbōḷvayalinn-entu tōnnum
stanza.meaning: The little birds chatter playfully, pecking at the ripened grains ready for harvest—imagine the emotion of the field.

stanza.lyrics: katiravan kizhakkumalayēṙi vanniḍumbōḷkākkum kamalattindemanassil entu tōnnum
stanza.meaning: When the sun climbs the mountain peaks and rises golden in the east, imagine the emotion in the heart of the lotus waiting to bloom.

stanza.lyrics: mazha-mēghaṅgaḷ vannumānam niṙaññiḍumbōḷmārivil teḷiññālmayil inn-entu tōnnum
stanza.meaning: When dark rain clouds gather in the sky and the rainbow shines in all its beauty, imagine the emotion of the dancing peacock.

stanza.lyrics: iḍiyum minnalumāytuḍitāḷam tīrttiḍumbōḷiḍaneñcam tuḍikkumbhumikk-entu tōnnum
stanza.meaning: When the rain thunders down amid flashes of lightning, imagine the emotion of the earth, waiting with a trembling heart.

stanza.lyrics: niśayil pūntiṅkaḷpāloḷi parattiḍumbōḷnīlattāmara tanninavil entu tōnnum
stanza.meaning: When the moon rises in silvery radiance at night, imagine the emotion of the blue lotus waiting to bloom.

stanza.lyrics: kanavu kaṇḍu kaṇḍukātaṅgaḷ tāṇḍi vannapuzhaye kaṇḍiḍumbōḷkaḍal inn-entu tōnnum
stanza.meaning: Dreaming of union with the sea, the river flows for miles from its birth as a tiny stream; imagine the emotion of the ocean when it sees the river come flowing to merge with it.

stanza.lyrics: paramānandattin sāgarattil vilayam koṇḍāl viṣaya-sukham nukarum manassē entu ceyyum
stanza.meaning: When it merges into the ocean of supreme bliss imagine the emotion of the mind that once sipped only fleeting pleasures

song.title: naḍanam āḍiḍū naḍanam āḍiḍū
song.source: Nadanam adidu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: naḍanam āḍiḍū naḍanam āḍiḍūkāḷi-mahēśvarī naḍanam āḍiḍūhṛdaya-rāgamāy hṛdaya-tāḷamāyhṛdaya-vēdiyil naḍanam āḍiḍū
stanza.meaning: O Kali, Great Goddess, dance as the melody of my heart, as the rhythmic beat of my heart, dance upon the stage of my heart.

stanza.lyrics: tām ta takadhimi kāḷi mahēśvaritajam ta takadhimi mēgha-varṇṇinitām ta takajaṇu śyāma-sundaritajam ta takajaṇu karāḷi bhadrē
stanza.meaning: Kali, the Supreme Goddess, the hue of dark rain clouds, the beautiful dark one, the terrible and most auspicious one.

stanza.lyrics: prēmamām bhadradīpam teḷicc-ennilemōhāndhakāram nī nīkkiḍān ettumbōḷ
stanza.meaning: When you arrive to light the lamp of my heart and destroy the darkness of ignorance,

stanza.lyrics: mānasa-vātāyanaṅgaḷ ninakkāytuṙanniḍān kelpenikk-ēkuk-ammē
stanza.meaning: Mother, grant me the strength and courage to keep the doors of my heart wide open.

stanza.lyrics: bhadrātmikē ninde jñāna-khaḍgattāl enahambōdha dārikan śirassaṫṫu vīzhumbōḷ
stanza.meaning: Mother, our protector—when you come with the sword of knowledge and sever the head of my demon-ego Darika,

stanza.lyrics: ā śānti bhuvonnenikku svantamaviḍe ñān pōyi sarvavum ñān-āyiḍunnahō
stanza.meaning: I reach the abode of peace, where I behold myself in all beings.

song.title: nadi munnōṭṭ-ozhukunnu
song.source: Nadi munnottu ozhukunnu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nadi munnōṭṭ-ozhukunnunavajāta-tirakaḷ uyarttinaṙu-puñciri tūki koṇḍunadam aṅgane ozhukunnu
stanza.meaning: The river flows onward, new waves rising as it journeys on. With a fresh new smile, the river moves unceasingly forward.

stanza.lyrics: jīvita-vāhini ozhukunnu…jīvita-vāhini ozhukunnu
stanza.meaning: The course of life flows onwards…

stanza.lyrics: kaḍalil cenn-ettēṇamvilayam koṇḍīḍēṇamnadi tannuḍe hṛdayattiṅkalini maṫṫoru cintayatilla
stanza.meaning: To reach the ocean, to merge into the ocean, the heart of the river contains no other thought.

stanza.lyrics: jīvita-vāhini ozhukunnu…jīvita-vāhini ozhukunnu
stanza.meaning: The course of life flows onwards…

stanza.lyrics: ātmīya-pātayil ettummōkṣārtthikaḷ ātmāviṅkallayam ākān ozhukum vēgamitu pōle nadiyē pōle
stanza.meaning: The soul of those who seek liberation, who walk upon the path of spirituality, swiftly flows to merge with the Supreme just like the river.

song.title: nallōnāy iruntuviḍa
song.source: Nallonay 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nallōnāy iruntuviḍa nāḷ ellām muyanḍrālumpullōnāy manam kīzhē uruṭṭiḍutē naṭarājā
stanza.meaning: Though I strive every day to live as a good person, my mind keeps rolling downwards like a blade of grass — O Nataraja!

stanza.lyrics: varuṅkālam senḍratoḍu nikazhumoru kālattilum
stanza.meaning: In times that have passed, in times yet to come, and at every moment in between,

stanza.lyrics: peruṅkāval nīyenḍrē pētaiyanum tutikkinḍrēn
stanza.meaning: this ignorant one knows you as the supreme protector.

stanza.lyrics: neruṅkāmal ōḍiḍavē nērilvarum tumbam ellāmkarumbāna naṭarājā karuttinilē niṙaivāyē
stanza.meaning: May your sweet thoughts fill my heart, O Nataraja, so that all the suffering that comes may be driven away instantly.

stanza.lyrics: nallōnāy iruntuviḍa nāḷ ellām muyanḍrālumpullōnāy manam kīzhē uruṭṭiḍutē naṭarājā
stanza.meaning: Though I strive every day to live as a good person, my mind keeps rolling downwards like a blade of grass — O Nataraja!

stanza.lyrics: nikazhkālam un ninaivē niṙaiyum oru manam tantāl
stanza.meaning: If you grant me a mind filled with remembrance of you in this very moment,

stanza.lyrics: ikazhkālam inimēlum enakkuṇḍō naṭarājā
stanza.meaning: will there be any wasted time for me hereafter, O Nataraja?

stanza.lyrics: akazhntāyntu akattinilē aḍiyēnum unvaḍivāy
stanza.meaning: Won't you open your divine eyes and bestow your grace upon me,

stanza.lyrics: tikazhvatanai uṇarntiḍavē tiruvizhikaḷ tiṙavāyō
stanza.meaning: so that I may contemplate and realise that the ‘inner I’ and you are one and the same?

stanza.lyrics: nallōnāy iruntuviḍa nāḷ ellām muyanḍrālumpullōnāy manam kīzhē uruṭṭiḍutē naṭarājā
stanza.meaning: Though I strive every day to live as a good person, my mind keeps rolling downwards like a blade of grass — O Nataraja!

stanza.lyrics: kaṫṫruṇai pūṭṭi kaḍalil pāyccinumnaṫṫruṇai ākum namaśśivāyavē
stanza.meaning: Even if one is thrown into the sea after being bound to a stone pillar, the mantra ‘Namah Shivaya’ will prove to be the true saviour.

song.title: naman karē ham sabhī tujhē
song.source: Naman kare ham sabhi tujhe 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Naman kare ham sabhi tujhe 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: naman karē ham sabhī tujhēcaraṇ sarōruh dikhalā dō
stanza.meaning: We all bow to you, O Ganesha, please grant us the vision of your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: āpadā-vipadā harō tum hīvighna-vināyaka namō namaḥ
stanza.meaning: You alone remove troubles and calamities—Salutations to You, O Remover of Obstacles!

stanza.lyrics: madagajarūpā… manasukhadāta… sabavidhi naman karū
stanza.meaning: In the form of a majestic elephant… Giver of peace to the mind… We offer our full devotion in every way.

stanza.lyrics: gaṇēśa gajēndra śubhāṅga gajāsya suvadana jaya jaya hō
stanza.meaning: O Ganesha, King of elephants, auspicious bodied one with an elephant face, beautiful of form—victory to You, victory to You!

stanza.lyrics: acal kalēvar gajānanājag paripālak mahāprabhō
stanza.meaning: O Elephant-faced One, with an immovable body, great Lord, protector of the world,

stanza.lyrics: kamal vilōcan kṛpāmayāharaṇ karō dukh namōstutē
stanza.meaning: Your lotus eyes are full of compassion. Take away our sorrow—salutations to You!

stanza.lyrics: madagajarūpā… manasukhadāta… sabavidhi naman karū
stanza.meaning: In the form of a majestic elephant… Giver of peace to the mind… We offer our full devotion in every way.

stanza.lyrics: gaṇēśa gajēndra śubhāṅga gajāsya suvadana jaya jaya hō
stanza.meaning: O Ganesha, King of elephants, auspicious bodied one with an elephant face, beautiful of form—victory to You, victory to You!

stanza.lyrics: makuṭ sudhākar trilōcanānayan dayāmay prēm bharē
stanza.meaning: Your crown is adorned with the moon, and You have three eyes. Your gaze overflows with mercy and love.
