stanza.lyrics: varad vibhō! ham karē praṇām - vibhav hame tū pradān karē
stanza.meaning: O Bestower of boons! We offer our salutations, grant us prosperity and wealth, O Lord!

stanza.lyrics: madagajarūpā… manasukhadāta… sabavidhi naman karū
stanza.meaning: In the form of a majestic elephant… Giver of peace to the mind… We offer our full devotion in every way.

stanza.lyrics: gaṇēśa gajēndra śubhāṅga gajāsya suvadana jaya jaya hō
stanza.meaning: O Ganesha, King of elephants, auspicious bodied one with an elephant face, beautiful of form—victory to You, victory to You!

song.title: namma karmaphalava tānuṇḍu
song.source: Namma karma phalavu - Garike Sakemba 2025 Kan in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Namma karma phalavu - Garike Sakemba 2025 Kan in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: namma karmaphalava tānuṇḍuvighna sarisi dāri sugama goḷisuvavighnēśvara ninage jayakāra jaya jayakāra
stanza.meaning: O Vighneshwara, you consume our karmaphala, remove the obstacles from our path, and make the way smooth for us to tread—victory to you!

stanza.lyrics: garike sākemba dēvanivanu
stanza.meaning: He is a God so humble that he accepts even a single blade of Karuga grass as an offering.

stanza.lyrics: bhaktarellarige tṛptiyāgali
stanza.meaning: To satisfy all his devotees

stanza.lyrics: hasidahoṭṭe bēga tumbali
stanza.meaning: and to quickly fill every hungry stomach,

stanza.lyrics: endu āśisuta… kaḍubu tindanu
stanza.meaning: he happily eats the modaka,

stanza.lyrics: gabagabā gabagabāgabagabā gabagabā
stanza.meaning: making the sounds gabagaba gabagaba!

stanza.lyrics: vakratuṇḍaniva ēkadandanu
stanza.meaning: He is the one with the curved trunk and single tusk;

stanza.lyrics: hoṭṭe tumbā kaḍubu tindanu
stanza.meaning: his belly full, he keeps eating modakas.

stanza.lyrics: nelava kāṇade eḍavi biddanu
stanza.meaning: Not watching his step, he stumbles and falls to the ground

stanza.lyrics: cauti-candranida kaṇḍu nakkanu
stanza.meaning: —this was seen by the fourth-day moon,

stanza.lyrics: pakapakā pakapakāpakapakā pakapakā
stanza.meaning: who laughed aloud, pakapaka!

stanza.lyrics: ḍumma gaṇapana hoṭṭe nōḍu – hoysa hoysa
stanza.meaning: Look at big-bellied Ganapa—hoysa hoysa!

stanza.lyrics: tiruvutiruva soṇḍila nōḍu – hoysa hoysa
stanza.meaning: Look at his swaying trunk—hoysa hoysa!

stanza.lyrics: misukadiruva iliya nōḍu – hoysa hoysa
stanza.meaning: Look at his steady unmoving mouse—hoysa hoysa!

stanza.lyrics: laḍḍu nōḍu – hoysa
stanza.meaning: Look at the laddu—hoysa!

stanza.lyrics: kaḍubu nōḍu – hoysa
stanza.meaning: Look at the modaka—hoysa!

stanza.lyrics: hoṭṭe nōḍu – hoysa
stanza.meaning: Look at the belly—hoysa!

stanza.lyrics: soṇḍila nōḍu – hoysa
stanza.meaning: Look at the trunk—hoysa!

stanza.lyrics: iliya nōḍu – hoysa
stanza.meaning: Look at the mouse—hoysa!

stanza.lyrics: laḍḍu nōḍu – hoysa
stanza.meaning: Look at the laddu—hoysa!

stanza.lyrics: kaḍubu nōḍu – hoysa
stanza.meaning: Look at the modaka—hoysa!

song.title: nandanandan diṭh paḍiyā
song.source: Nandanandan bith padiya 2025 Braj in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nandanandan diṭh paḍiyā māyi sāṅvrō sāṅvrō
stanza.meaning: I caught a glimpse of the son of Nanda, O mother, so dark, so dark in hue!

stanza.lyrics: nandanandan diṭha paḍiyā māyi dārayā sab lōk lāj
stanza.meaning: Just one look at him, and I was undone-lost all sense of worldly shame.

stanza.lyrics: sudh budh bisrāye sāṅvrō sāṅvrō
stanza.meaning: The whole world faded away from my mind; nothing remained but him, that dark one, that beautiful, dark one.

stanza.lyrics: mōr candr kā kirīṭ mukuṭ jab suhāye
stanza.meaning: How radiant he looked with a peacock-feathered crown, a crest of moonlight adorning his head!

stanza.lyrics: kēsar rō tilak bhāl lōcan sukhdāyi
stanza.meaning: A sandal-mark of saffron graced his forehead, and his eyes—those eyes!—poured bliss into the soul.

stanza.lyrics: lōcan sukhdāyi sāṅvrō sāṅvrō
stanza.meaning: Such joy they gave, those eyes of the dark one, the ever-enchanting dark one.

stanza.lyrics: kuṇḍal jhalkā kapōl alkā lahrāye
stanza.meaning: His earrings glimmered against his cheeks, and soft curls danced upon his temples.

stanza.lyrics: mīnā taj sarvar jāū makar milan dhāyi
stanza.meaning: Compared to the beauty of this form, the fish abandoned the lake and rushed to embrace him

stanza.lyrics: makar milan dhāyi sāṅvrō sāṅvrō
stanza.meaning: —such was the magnetism of the dark one, the all-attractive dark one.

stanza.lyrics: naṭavar prabhu vēṣ dhariyā rūp jag lubhāye
stanza.meaning: In the garb of a divine dancer, he stole the hearts of the world with his bewitching form.

stanza.lyrics: giridhar prabhu aṅg aṅg mīrā balijāyi
stanza.meaning: To see his limbs, each one divine, Giridhar himself incarnate-Mira surrendered completely.

stanza.lyrics: mīrā balijāyi sāṅvrō sāṅvrō
stanza.meaning: She gave herself wholly to him, to that irresistible dark one, her beloved dark one.

song.title: nandri ammā kōḍi nandri ammā
song.source: Nandri Amma Kodi nandri Amma 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Nandri Amma Kodi nandri Amma 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nandri ammā kōḍi nandri ammā
stanza.meaning: Thank you, Mother, a crore times thank you, Mother.

stanza.lyrics: kōḍi janaṅgaḷil enakkenna takuti ammāun karam nīṭṭi ennai unniḍam sērttāy
stanza.meaning: Among crores of people, what worth did I have, Mother? You extended your hand and brought me to you.

stanza.lyrics: aḷavaṫṫra aruḷ nī tandāyēkaimmāṙu ennatān seyvēn ammā
stanza.meaning: You gave me boundless grace. What can I possibly give in return, Mother?

stanza.lyrics: nandri ammā kōḍi nandri ammā
stanza.meaning: Thank you, Mother, a crore times thank you.

stanza.lyrics: unnaḍiyil vāzhavaittāyē….unnuḍanē pāḍavaittāyē…
stanza.meaning: You made me live at your feet... You made me sing with you...

stanza.lyrics: nān enna pizhai seytālum tirutti ennaiun anbāl aṇaittāyēun anbāl aṇaittāyē
stanza.meaning: Even if I made a mistake, you corrected me and embraced me with your love. You embraced me with your love…

stanza.lyrics: ammā… tāyē… karuṇai… kaḍalē…
stanza.meaning: O Mother… Ocean of compassion…

stanza.lyrics: un anbirku takuti illayē…unai aṙiya jñānam illayē
stanza.meaning: I am not deserving of your love. I have no knowledge to understand you.

stanza.lyrics: endrālum en vāzhvil eppozhutum ammāen priya sakhiyāy iruppāyēen priya sakhiyāy iruppāyē
stanza.meaning: Even so, O Mother, remain as my dearest friend, always in my life.

stanza.lyrics: ammā… tāyē… karuṇai… kaḍalē…
stanza.meaning: O Mother… Ocean of compassion…

song.title: nanna hṛdayadi nirantara nelesendu
song.source: Nanna hridayadi 2025 Kannada in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nanna hṛdayadi nirantara nelesenduprārthane ondenna manadali amma
stanza.meaning: O Mother, may you be the prayer that lives forever in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: sukhadalli dukhadalli naguvalli aḷuvallinalivū nōvalli ennoḍaniru amma
stanza.meaning: In happiness and in sorrow, in laughter and in tears, in joy and in pain, be with me, Mother.

stanza.lyrics: nī enna śrīrakṣe amṛtēśvari
stanza.meaning: You alone are my sacred protection, O Amriteshwari…

stanza.lyrics: geddāga higgade biddāga kuggadenindane stutiyalli samatva nīḍamma
stanza.meaning: When I win, without pride; when I fall, without despair; in blame and in praise, grant me equanimity, Mother.

stanza.lyrics: dhairyadi dharmadi śraddheyoḍagūḍinisvārtha sēveyinda dhanyavāgisamma
stanza.meaning: With courage and righteousness joined with faith, and through selfless service, make me blessed, Mother.

song.title: nārāyaṇā śrī rāmā nārāyaṇā śrī rāma
song.source: Narayana Sri Rama 2025 Samskritam in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nārāyaṇā śrī rāmā nārāyaṇā śrī rāmanārāyaṇā… śrī rāmā…
stanza.meaning: O Rama, Narayana, the eternal one, Sri Rama…

stanza.lyrics: uttiṣṭhatām jāgratāmamṛtasya putrā uttiṣṭhatām
stanza.meaning: O children of immortality, arise, awake!

stanza.lyrics: jāgratām amṛtasya putrājāgratām amṛtasya putrā
stanza.meaning: O children of immortality, arise, awake!

stanza.lyrics: daśaratha-putrā raghurāmākausalya-nandanā śrī rāma
stanza.meaning: Rama, son of King Dasharatha, scion of Raghu, shining jewel of the solar dynasty, born of Devi Kausalya,

stanza.lyrics: sītā-nāthā puruṣōttamālakṣmaṇa-sōdarā mama dēvā
stanza.meaning: beloved Lord of Devi Sita… Supreme Being, elder brother of Lakshmana, you are my God!

stanza.lyrics: nārāyaṇā śrī rāmā nārāyaṇā śrī rāmanārāyaṇā… śrī rāmā…
stanza.meaning: O Rama, Narayana, the eternal one, Sri Rama…

stanza.lyrics: dīyatām mē āśrayamdīyatām tē pāda-sēvanam
stanza.meaning: Grant me refuge, grant me opportunities to serve your lotus feet,

stanza.lyrics: jñāna-bhakti dīyatāmprēma-bhakti dīyatām
stanza.meaning: bless me with knowledge and devotion, bless me with steadfast, loving devotion.

stanza.lyrics: nārāyaṇā śrī rāmā nārāyaṇā śrī rāmanārāyaṇā… śrī rāmā…
stanza.meaning: O Rama, Narayana, the eternal one, Sri Rama…

song.title: naśvara-prapañcattil
song.source: Nasvara prapanchattil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: naśvara-prapañcattil uṇma tēḍi alaññu ñānnanma enikk-entennu aṙiññu nalkēṇam ammē
stanza.meaning: In this unstable, perishable world, I wandered in search of the imperishable truth.

stanza.lyrics: duḥkha-bhārattil taḷarnnōrō vēḷayilumuḷkkarutt-ēki nayiccoru dēvi nī
stanza.meaning: O Mother, you alone know what is truly good and beneficial for me, please grant me that.

stanza.lyrics: aham enna bōdham enne bhrāntam-ākkīḍāteātma-viśvāsattāḷ dhīrayākkiḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: You are the goddess who gave me inner strength and guided me when I was crushed under the weight of sorrow. Let me not be deluded by the sense of “I.” Instead, grant me faith in my true self and fill me with courage.

stanza.lyrics: satyamāyuḷḷorī pātayil iḍaṙātesadguruvāy-amma enne nayikkaṇē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, you are the Satguru, lead me on the path of truth without letting me falter or lose strength.

stanza.lyrics: rāgavum dvēṣavum enne bharikkātesnēhavum śāntiyum ennil niṙaykkaṇē
stanza.meaning: Let neither attachment nor aversion rule over me; Instead, fill my heart with love and peace.

stanza.lyrics: ennēkkāḷ enne aṙiyunna jagadambēenne nī ninnōḍu cērttu rakṣikkaṇē
stanza.meaning: O Mother of the universe, you know me better than I know myself. Let me merge in you, and rescue me…

song.title: nāthan munnē amarnt-irukkum
song.source: Nathan Munne 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nāthan munnē amarnt-irukkum nandi-nāthanē nāḷum naḍakkum nāḍagattai pārum dēvanē
stanza.meaning: O Lord Nandi, who sits before Lord Shiva, witness the drama that unfolds each day in the human world.

stanza.lyrics: aṙivināl āṇavamāy tuḷḷuvārē - avarāṇavattai aṙivārō nandi-nāthanē
stanza.meaning: People jump with pride, inflated by their knowledge—but do they possess knowledge of their own ego, O Nandinatha?

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷoṇḍru vaittu vañcagamāy pēsuvār avaruṇmaiyai uṇarvārō kūṙuvāyē nandi-dēvane?
stanza.meaning: Those who speak with hidden deceit in their hearts—tell me, O Nandideva, will they ever recognize the truth?

stanza.lyrics: nāthan munnē amarnt-irukkum nandi-nāthanē nāḷum naḍakkum nāḍagattai pārum dēvanē
stanza.meaning: O Lord Nandi, who sits before Lord Shiva, witness the drama that unfolds each day in the human world.

stanza.lyrics: āsaiyennum tīyai piḍittiḍuvārē avaratu suṭṭālum viḍuvārō nandi-nāthanē
stanza.meaning: Those who cling to the fire of desire—even when it burns them—will they let it go, O Nandinatha?

stanza.lyrics: inbam tēḍi eṅgum alaintiḍuvārē - avaridayattil tēḍuvārō solluvāyē nandi-dēvane?
stanza.meaning: They roam in search of happiness everywhere, yet tell me, O Nandideva, do they seek it within their own hearts?

stanza.lyrics: nāthan munnē amarnt-irukkum nandi-nāthanē nāḷum naḍakkum nāḍagattai pārum dēvanē
stanza.meaning: O Lord Nandi, who sits before Lord Shiva, witness the drama that unfolds each day in the human world.

stanza.lyrics: śivanārai sumakkum śiva-vāhanamē - nīsēvikkum bhaktargaḷai kāppavanē
stanza.meaning: O Lord Nandi, you are the vehicle of Lord Shiva and you carry him. You are the protector of the devotees who worship Lord Shiva.

stanza.lyrics: nāthan nāmam nāḷum sollum nandi-dēvanē - namnaṭarājan porpādam manadil dinam tozhuvōmē
stanza.meaning: O Nandideva, who chants the name of Lord Shiva daily—let us all worship the golden feet of Lord Nataraja in our hearts, every day!

stanza.lyrics: śivāya namaḥ om harāya namaḥ omśiva śiva śiva śiva namaḥ śivāya
stanza.meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva, the most auspicious one…

stanza.lyrics: harāya namaḥ om śivāya namaḥ omhara hara hara hara namaḥ śivāya
stanza.meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva, the most auspicious one…

song.title: Souriez, Souriez - Navvu Navvu Navvu
song.source: Navvu Navvu Souriez souriez 2025 French in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Navvu Navvu Souriez souriez 2025 French in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: Souriez, Souriez... Essuyez vos larmes« Souriez » dit Amma... « Riez » nous dit Amma
stanza.meaning: Smile, smile… wipe away your tears “Smile,” Amma says… “Laugh,” Amma tells us

stanza.lyrics: Si tu as la richesse, et que tu es honoré,Même bien entouré, es-tu vraiment satisfait ?
stanza.meaning: If you have wealth and if you’re honored, And are even well surrounded, are you truly satisfied?

stanza.lyrics: Celui qui naît va mourir, et renaître à nouveau,En pleurant... mais à quoi rime cette vie de tourments
stanza.meaning: The one who is born will die, and be born again, Crying... but what’s the point of this life of torment?

stanza.lyrics: « Riez » nous dit Amma... ha ha ha ha ha ha !« Riez » nous dit Amma... ho ho ho ho ho ho !
stanza.meaning: “Laugh,” Amma tells us... ha ha ha ha ha ha! “Laugh,” Amma tells us... ho ho ho ho ho ho!

stanza.lyrics: On pourrait te blâmer... Il vaudrait mieux en rire !
stanza.meaning: They could blame you... Better to just laugh about it!

stanza.lyrics: Si tu viens à tomber... Relève-toi en riant !
stanza.meaning: If you stumble and fall… get back up laughing!

stanza.lyrics: Oublie tous tes soucis... Et de nouveau souris
stanza.meaning: Forget all your worries... And smile again

stanza.lyrics: Que le souffle qui t'anime, soit un sourire à la vie
stanza.meaning: May the breath that animates you be a smile to life itself

stanza.lyrics: « Riez » nous dit Amma... ha ha ha ha ha ha !« Riez » nous dit Amma... ho ho ho ho ho ho !
stanza.meaning: “Laugh,” Amma tells us... ha ha ha ha ha ha! “Laugh,” Amma tells us... ho ho ho ho ho ho!

stanza.lyrics: Amma demeure en tout, alors ne t'en fais pasElle est toujours en nous, aie la foi et la joie
stanza.meaning: Amma dwells in everything, so don’t worry She’s always within us, have faith and joy

stanza.lyrics: Sitôt que tu souris, la création aussi
stanza.meaning: The moment you smile, creation smiles too

stanza.lyrics: Vois le sourire d'Amma, viens danser dans la joie !
stanza.meaning: See Amma’s smile, come dance with joy!

stanza.lyrics: « Riez » nous dit Amma... ha ha ha ha ha ha !« Riez » nous dit Amma... ho ho ho ho ho ho !
stanza.meaning: “Laugh,” Amma tells us... ha ha ha ha ha ha! “Laugh,” Amma tells us... ho ho ho ho ho ho!

song.title: naynōṅ se chalaktā yē pyār tērā
song.source: Nayanon se chalakta 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: naynōṅ se chalaktā yē pyār tērātarasātā hai man mērā
stanza.meaning: This love of yours overflows from your eyes leaves my heart yearning.

stanza.lyrics: hōṅṭhōṅ pe khilī yē haṅsi tērīkhil uṭhātī hai yē dil mērā
stanza.meaning: This smile blooming on your lips makes my heart blossom.

stanza.lyrics: har pal tujhē hī nihāṙūṅ māhar kṣaṇ tujhē hi pukārūṅ mā
stanza.meaning: Every moment, may I gaze only at you, Mother. Every second may I call only you, Mother.

stanza.lyrics: mērā kaṇ kaṇ bōlē ammā maiṅ tērīmērī dhaṭkan bōlē ammā tū mērī
stanza.meaning: Every atom of mine says, “Mother, I am yours.” My heartbeat says, “Mother, you are mine.”

stanza.lyrics: mā tumhī se mērī khuśītumhī hō mērī bhakti mukti
stanza.meaning: Mother, my happiness is from you. You are my devotion and liberation.

stanza.lyrics: tumhī sē mērā śyām savērātumhī hō mērā ēk sahārā
stanza.meaning: My bright mornings and nights start and end in you. You are my only support.

stanza.lyrics: bikharē is man kā cain hō tumṭūṭtē is dil kī ās hō tum
stanza.meaning: You are the peace of this scattered mind. You are the hope of this broken heart.

stanza.lyrics: mērī har sāṅs meiṅ basī hō tumhar uṭhē kadam kā viśvās hō tum
stanza.meaning: You are present in every breath of mine. You are the faith behind every step I take.

stanza.lyrics: giruṅ maiṅ agar uṭhā lēnā māṙōū agar tō galē lagānā
stanza.meaning: If I fall, lift me up, Mother. If I cry, hold me in your embrace.

stanza.lyrics: bhaṭkū agar tō path dikhlānā māthak jāū agar tō sahārā dēnā
stanza.meaning: If I stray, show me the path, Mother. If I grow weary, support me.

song.title: neñcukku nītiyum tōḷukku vāḷumniṙainta cuḍarmaṇippūṇ
song.source: Nenjukku Nitiyum 2025 Tamil in english with meaning.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Nenjukku Nitiyum 2025 Tamil in english with meaning.pptx

stanza.lyrics: pañcukku nērpala tunpaṅkaḷām, ivaḷpārvaykku nērperuntī
stanza.meaning: Her children bow down to Her whose very gaze is like a blazing fire in which the cotton of our sorrows burn instantly.

stanza.lyrics: vañcanayindri pakayindri sūtindrivayyaka māntarellām
stanza.meaning: Abandoning treachery, enemity and deceit, may all beings in the universe, take refuge in Her

stanza.lyrics: tañcamendē uṙaippīr avaḷ pēr, śaktiōm śakti ōm śakti ōm
stanza.meaning: – calling out Shakti Om Shakti Om Shakti Om

stanza.lyrics: nambuvadēvazhiyendremaṙaitanai nāmindrunambiviṭṭōm
stanza.meaning: We trust the words of the Immaculate Vedas,

stanza.lyrics: kumbiṭṭenēramum ‘śakti’yendālunaikumbiḍuvēn manamē!
stanza.meaning: that claim that claim that FIRM faith (Shraddha) is the only way to reach the truth.

stanza.lyrics: ambukkum tīkkum viḍattukkumnōvukkum accamillāta paḍi
stanza.meaning: In order to be free from fear of weapons, fire, poison and disease – (fear of death due to body identification), we call out to You

stanza.lyrics: umbarkkum imbarkkum vāzhvutarum patamōm śakti ōm śakti ōm
stanza.meaning: – who are the giver of life to the Gods and men – Shakti Om Shakti Om Shakti Om

stanza.lyrics: veḷḷai malarmśaivēdakkarupporuḷāka viḷaṅkiḍuvāḷ
stanza.meaning: Seated on a white Lotus, O beautiful Goddess of knowledge, who is the essence of the Vedas

stanza.lyrics: teḷḷuttamizh kalaivāṇi ninakkoruviṇṇappam seytiḍuvēn
stanza.meaning: – I beseech you who speaks poetic Tamil!

stanza.lyrics: eḷḷatanai pozhutum payanindriirātendan nāvinilē
stanza.meaning: Let not a single moment be useless –

stanza.lyrics: veḷḷamena pozhivāyśaktivēl śaktivēl śaktivēl śaktivēl
stanza.meaning: Be now present in my tongue – May Your Grace flow torrentially - Shakti Om Shakti Om Shakti Om

song.title: nērāṇē nērāṇinnitu rārāri rārārīka rārāri
song.source: Nerane neraninnitu - rarari rararika 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Nerane neraninnitu - rarari rararika 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: rārāri rārārīka rārāri – rārārō…taka taka rārāri rārārō…
stanza.meaning: (Traditional Chorus)

stanza.lyrics: rārāri rārārīka rārāri – rārārō…taka taka rārāri rārārō…
stanza.meaning: (Traditional Chorus)

stanza.lyrics: nērāṇē nērāṇinnitu tēvi udiccu vannē-taka taka ōḍi vā… māḷōrē…
stanza.meaning: This is the truth, the absolute truth, Devi has appeared in the world like the rising sun in all its brilliance.

stanza.lyrics: vāzhtteḍi vāzhtti pāḍeḍi tēvi vann-ādumeḍitaka taka uḷḷam aṙiññāḍum
stanza.meaning: Come, all of you, run to her and praise her. Let her be pleased, let her dance with us in overflowing love, knowing our hearts and removing all our sorrows.

stanza.lyrics: rārāri rārārīka rārāri – rārārō…taka taka rārāri rārārō…
stanza.meaning: (Traditional Chorus)

stanza.lyrics: vāḷuṇḍē cilambum uṇḍē tārile tēvikkūtaka taka mantram aṙiññāḍu
stanza.meaning: Devi holds a shining sword in her hands, heavy anklets ringing on her feet. Let us chant her mantra deep in our hearts and dance in step with her.

stanza.lyrics: kēṭṭālō ñeṭṭi viṙaykkum krōdha-ciriyum uṇḍētaka taka pēḍi kaḷaññāḍu
stanza.meaning: When enemies hear her fierce laughter, they tremble in fear. Let us see it as her grace and dance with her fearlessly.

stanza.lyrics: rārāri rārārīka rārāri – rārārō…taka taka rārāri rārārō…
stanza.meaning: (Traditional Chorus)

stanza.lyrics: māṙilō muṇḍana-mālyam cārtti varunnuṇḍētaka taka tāṇu vaṇaṅgiyāḍu
stanza.meaning: Let us bow low before Devi. Let us dance with her wearing a garland of skulls,

stanza.lyrics: nīṅkaḍe ūnameṅgum tāyatān pōkkumeḍitaka taka kumbiṭṭu cērnnāḍu
stanza.meaning: in her fierce and terrible form. Her very darshan destroys the hardships of her devotees.

stanza.lyrics: rārāri rārārīka rārāri – rārārō…taka taka rārāri rārārō…
stanza.meaning: (Traditional Chorus)

stanza.lyrics: cēlotta cetti kaṇakke cembaṭṭ-uḍutt-āḍutaka taka cuṫṫi uṙaññāḍu
stanza.meaning: Clad in lovely red silk, dance in graceful rhythm,

stanza.lyrics: orōrō kālaḍi veccē kaṇṇam maṙiññ-āḍutaka taka tuḷḷi uṙaññ-āḍu
stanza.meaning: with each step, dance in fervour, letting your whole being flow into the movement.

stanza.lyrics: rārāri rārārīka rārāri – rārārō…taka taka rārāri rārārō…
stanza.meaning: (Traditional Chorus)

stanza.lyrics: ēṅkaḷe kāttu koḷḷān nī allāt-ārumillētaka taka tēviye cērttāḍu
stanza.meaning: Know this truth, there is none but Devi to protect and save us.

stanza.lyrics: cēlaḍi cēlōḍāḍeḍi cēlil tiriññāḍutaka taka cēmmē maṙiññāḍu
stanza.meaning: With that certainty, dance together with her. Turn this way and that, moving in beauty, forgetting yourself

stanza.lyrics: rārāri rārārīka rārāri – rārārō…taka taka rārāri rārārō…
stanza.meaning: (Traditional Chorus)

stanza.lyrics: nī allātārumillē neññil iruppavaḷētaka taka ōrttu vaṇaṅgi āḍu
stanza.meaning: Know there is no refuge but Devi, who dwells in our heart. Surrender to her, bow low, and dance.

stanza.lyrics: ōrunnē ōrō nimiṣavum ninde tiru rūpamtaka taka ninde tiru mantram
stanza.meaning: See her lovely form at every moment; chant her mantra with each movement.

stanza.lyrics: rārāri rārārīka rārāri – rārārō…taka taka rārāri rārārō…
stanza.meaning: (Traditional Chorus)

stanza.lyrics: ammāḷe ēṅgi viḷiccāl kūḍe vannāḍum eḍitaka taka ōḍi vannāḍum eḍi
stanza.meaning: If we call to her in deep yearning, Mother will come running and dance within our midst.

stanza.lyrics: nērāṇē nērāṇinnitu tēvi vannāḍum eḍitaka taka uḷḷattil āḍum eḍi
stanza.meaning: It is the truth, the eternal truth, Devi will enter and dance within our hearts.

stanza.lyrics: rārāri rārārīka rārāri – rārārō…taka taka rārāri rārārō…
stanza.meaning: (Traditional Chorus)

stanza.lyrics: rārāri rārārīka rārāri – rārārō…taka taka rārāri rārārō…
stanza.meaning: (Traditional Chorus)

song.title: nērin niṙavāy udicc-uyarnnu
song.source: Nerin niravay 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nērin niṙavāy udicc-uyarnnusaccidānanda-saundaryamē nī
stanza.meaning: You are the beauty of existence, awareness, and bliss risen as the fullness of Truth.

stanza.lyrics: mēdini tan sukṛtamō ninkṛpā-pūrṇṇamī maṇṇinn-ēkunnatum
stanza.meaning: Is it the merit of the Earth that she is blessed by the fullness of your grace?

stanza.lyrics: āzhitan puṇyamō nin tṛkkarālkōrttoru mālyavum meyyil ēṫṫīduvān
stanza.meaning: Was it the merit of the ocean that it bore upon its bosom a garland strung by your own hands?

stanza.lyrics: praṇava-dhvanikaḷāl mantraṇam ceyyunnuōrō tirakaḷum nin apadānaṅgaḷ
stanza.meaning: Each wave whispers the sacred Omkara, the primal sound from which you arose.

stanza.lyrics: anubhutiyil amṛtānanda-magnarāyāḍum ōrālila tandeyā sandēśam
stanza.meaning: Each banyan leaf dances in exaltation, immersed in rapturous bliss.

stanza.lyrics: pīyūṣā-gaṅgayām ninne aṙiyuvānuḷḷatāṇī narajanmam ennuḷḷatō
stanza.meaning: Are they whispering that this human birth is meant to know you—the nectarine Ganges, the sacred river flowing down from heaven?

stanza.lyrics: nin tiru vaibhavam āṇakhilam ennutanne prakṛtiyum pērttu paṙayunnu
stanza.meaning: All of nature declares that this world is your divine splendour.

stanza.lyrics: eṅkilum ammē ñān enn-aṙiyunnorāsaccidānanda-svarūpamām tvad-rūpam
stanza.meaning: Yet, O Mother, when will I come to know your true essence—existence, awareness, and bliss?

song.title: nī biḍḍanammā cinni śiśuvunu
song.source: Ni biddanamma chinni sisuvunu 2025 Telugu in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Ni biddanamma chinni sisuvunu 2025 Telugu in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nī biḍḍanammā cinni śiśuvunuceyyi vadalakkammā paḍipōtānu
stanza.meaning: O Mother, I am your child, a helpless infant. Please don’t let go of my hand—if you do, I will fall.

stanza.lyrics: vadili veḷḷakammā tappipōtānunī koṅgu paṭṭē nī biḍḍanu
stanza.meaning: Please do not leave me alone—if you do, I will lose my way, even though I cling to the edge of your saree.

stanza.lyrics: ceyyipaṭṭi naḍipiñcammā - ō ammādāricūpi daricērcavammā
stanza.meaning: Please hold my hand tightly and make me walk, O Mother. Show me the path and lead me, Mother.

stanza.lyrics: āśalennō ammā caṇṭi kūnanuadi idi kāvālammā āḍukōnu
stanza.meaning: So many desires, Mother — I stubbornly insist: “I want this, I want that, I want to play!”

stanza.lyrics: aṭṭu iṭṭu pōtānammā cūsirānunī ceyyi jārē nī biḍḍanu
stanza.meaning: wander here and there, Mother — see how I roam. Your child slips from your grasp so easily.

stanza.lyrics: cevvupiṇḍi naḍipiñcammā - ō ammāmoṭṭumoṭṭi saricēyammā
stanza.meaning: Twist my ears and make me walk, O Mother. Rap me on the head with your knuckles and correct me, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: naḍavalēnu ammā ciṭṭi buḍutanuguccukunnadamma saṁsāra muḷḷu
stanza.meaning: O Mother, I, a mere toddler, I am not able to walk on my own. Thorns of worldly bondage prick me.

stanza.lyrics: bhayapeḍutunnadi māyābhūtaṁ nīvē śaraṇu anna nī biḍḍanu
stanza.meaning: The ghost of Māyā (illusion) scares me. This child of yours takes refuge in you alone.

stanza.lyrics: ettukoni naḍavavamma - ō ammāhattukoni muddāḍamma
stanza.meaning: Lift me up and help me walk, O Mother. Hug me tightly and shower me with kisses, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: ammā ettukō ammā hattukō
stanza.meaning: O Mother, lift me. O Mother, hold me close.

song.title: nī enna gānatte pāḍān
song.source: Ni enna ganatte 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nī enna gānatte pāḍān tuḍikkunnuen manōvīṇa ennum
stanza.meaning: The veena of my heart yearns to sing your song, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: nī enna nāmam marmaram ceyyunnuen antaraṅgattil ennum ammē
stanza.meaning: Your sacred name resounds within me;

stanza.lyrics: nin pāda-smaraṇayil en jīva sañcāramdivārātram enyē varēṇam
stanza.meaning: let me journey through day and night in remembrance of your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: ñān ennil uṇaravē en amma pulariyāycemmē vann-enne tazhukum
stanza.meaning: And when I awaken to my true Self, Mother, rise like the dawn and bathe me in your gentle radiance.

stanza.lyrics: urukunna nēram pozhikkunna nīrilumozhukunnu gaṅgayāy mātṛ-snēham
stanza.meaning: When my heart is scorched by sorrow and tears stream from my eyes, your love flows to me like the sacred river Ganga.

stanza.lyrics: ñān carikkum vazhi ētonnum āvaṭṭeśariyatil ettikkum enne amma
stanza.meaning: Mother, on every path I may walk, you are there, guiding me toward the highest truth.

stanza.lyrics: nin karalāḷana sukham aṙiyānāy ñānkāttirippū ninne ōrttirippū
stanza.meaning: I wait with deep longing, immersed in your memories, yearning to feel the bliss of your tender touch.

stanza.lyrics: onnōḍi vannīḍū vārī puṇarnnīḍūninnil layikkān anugrahikkū
stanza.meaning: Come running to me, Mother, gather me in your arms—for I long to dissolve into you.

song.title: nī mātram nī mātram nī mātram ambikē
song.source: Ni matram 2025 - Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nī mātram nī mātram nī mātram ambikēbhūvitil ānanda-śaraṇāgati
stanza.meaning: O Mother Ambika, you alone bestow a blissful refuge in this world;

stanza.lyrics: ninnileykk-aṇayān tuḍiccu kēzhunn-ōrījīvande saṅgītam kēḷppatillē
stanza.meaning: do you not hear this soul’s quiet plea, its heartbeat singing with a yearning to reach you?

stanza.lyrics: samsāra sāgara tīrattu nī ammēenne upēkṣiccu pōyat-entē
stanza.meaning: Mother, why did you abandon me on the shores of saṁsāra

stanza.lyrics: nī ennil uṇḍ-enna satyam aṙiyāte - nin prēma mozhikaḷil āzhnniḍāte
stanza.meaning: —when I knew not the truth of your presence within, nor sought the depths of your words of love?

stanza.lyrics: mizhikaḷil pozhiyunna mizhinīrumāy ñānninnilēykk-aṇayuvān kāttu nilppū
stanza.meaning: With tears streaming from my eyes, I wait to reach your side.

stanza.lyrics: nī vannu cārattu ninnīḍilum ammēninne aṙiyāte śōkārdrayāy
stanza.meaning: Mother, even when you stand beside me, I remain sorrowful, blind to your presence.

stanza.lyrics: kēzhunnu cinta tan tirakaḷ ārttīḍunnudūreyā pakalōnde ponkiraṇam
stanza.meaning: Distraught thoughts rise as waves within my heart, while the golden rays of dawn feel far away.

stanza.lyrics: ennī manakkaḍal tira aḍaṅgīḍumōnin prēma-sāgarē muṅgīḍumō
stanza.meaning: When will these restless tides subside? When will my heart dissolve into the boundless ocean of your love?

song.title: nī tanne pulariyum sandhyayum
song.source: Ni tanne pulariyum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nī tanne pulariyum sandhyayum rāvum īkuḷir tūki aṇayunna pūntennalum
stanza.meaning: You are the dawn, the evening, and the night; the cool, fragrant breeze;

stanza.lyrics: nī tanne aruṇanum pūnilā-candranum - nī tanne gaganavum viśvam ammē
stanza.meaning: you are the rising sun and the full moon; you are the sky and the entire universe, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: vāyuvum jalavum ī agniyum nī tannenadiyum jaladhi ammē
stanza.meaning: You are the air, the water, and the fire; the rivers and the oceans, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: mazhayum ī ponveyil cantavum nī tanneaḍaviyum prakṛti ammē
stanza.meaning: You are the rain, the golden sunlight, the forest, and all of nature, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: mukilum ī tārāpathaṅgaḷum nī tanneakhilāṇḍa janani ammē
stanza.meaning: You are the clouds and the starry skies; the mother of the entire world, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: sṛṣṭiyum sraṣṭāvum sṛṣṭi-jālaṅgaḷumjīvanum prāṇan ammē
stanza.meaning: You are the creation and the creator, all beings in creation, and their very life and breath, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: brāhmiyum brahmavum ambikē nī tanneparamātma prēmam ammē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, you are Goddess and God, O Mother, the Supreme Self and Love.

stanza.lyrics: jñānavum jñēyavum jñāna-svarūpavumcinmayī ninnil ammē
stanza.meaning: You are knowledge, the knower, and the very form of knowledge—the embodiment of pure consciousness.

stanza.lyrics: māyayum māyā-svarūpavum nī tannesattayum satyam ammē
stanza.meaning: You are divine illusion and all its myriad of forms; you are the essence and truth, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: sukhavum duḥkhavum ānandavum nīyēsaccidānanda svarūpiṇi
stanza.meaning: You are happiness, sorrow, and bliss—you who embody existence, consciousness, and bliss.

song.title: nija svarūpada kaḍege
song.source: Nija svarupada 2025 Kan in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nija svarūpada kaḍege karedoyyammabadalāgade iruva śāntiyalli irisu
stanza.meaning: O Mother, pleaser lead me to the true Self. Guide me to the changeless peace within.

stanza.lyrics: nīnē nānemba satyavanu biṭṭuī māye lōkadali mōhitanādenu
stanza.meaning: Forgetting the truth that you and I are one, I wandered about in delusion through this bewitching world.

stanza.lyrics: dēhavē nānendu nambi ajñānadinannannē marete-dṛśyagaḷa nāṭakadi
stanza.meaning: Such was my ignorance that I mistook myself to be the body. Entangled in the play of appearances, I lost sight of my true nature.

stanza.lyrics: nanna munde nī nintu prītiya rūpadiātmada niśśabda doḷage karedihe nī
stanza.meaning: You appeared before me in the form of love. You were always calling me from the silence of the Self.

stanza.lyrics: ennammā karuṇe tōrammā x2
stanza.meaning: O Mother, please show me compassion!

stanza.lyrics: ninna pādagaḷalli, nā kaḷedu hōgalinā beḷagi ā śuddha caitanya jyōtiyali
stanza.meaning: Let me surrender the false self at your holy feet. Let me bask in the pure light of consciousness.

stanza.lyrics: nā kartanalla barī kāṇutihe kēvalananna nija sākṣi bhāvavu nenapāgali
stanza.meaning: I do nothing—I only witness. Help me remember my true nature as the eternal witness.

stanza.lyrics: ennammā karuṇe tōrammā x2
stanza.meaning: O Mother, please show me compassion!

stanza.lyrics: nija svarūpada kaḍege karedoyyu nannaalli nānilla nīnilla onde ella
stanza.meaning: Lead me to my Self, where there is no 'I' and 'You’—only One.

stanza.lyrics: ninna kāṇuva hādi ā mōkṣa-mārga maunadi mugiva śuddha prajñeya sāgara
stanza.meaning: The path to liberation, illuminated by Your grace, culminates in the ocean of pure awareness and stillness.

stanza.lyrics: ennammā karuṇe tōrammā x2
stanza.meaning: O Mother, please show me compassion!

song.title: nīlavānil nī niṙaññu
song.source: Nila vanil ni niranyu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Nila vanil ni niranyu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nīlavānil nī niṙaññu kāṫṫu ninde gānam mūḷi
stanza.meaning: Mother! Your presence fills the vast blue skies; the gentle breeze hums hymns in your praise.

stanza.lyrics: pūkkaḷ ninde pādam pulkān vembi vembi kāttu nilppū
stanza.meaning: Every flower in creation longs to touch your feet, offering itself in adoration and love.

stanza.lyrics: vānil minnum tārakaṅgaḷ ninde muḍi-pūkkaḷāyi
stanza.meaning: The stars become blossoms adorning your hair;

stanza.lyrics: sūrya-candra-śōbha ninde kātil-āḍum kammalāyi
stanza.meaning: the sun and moon, delicate earrings that grace your ears.

stanza.lyrics: nīlavānil nī niṙaññu kāṫṫu ninde gānam mūḷi
stanza.meaning: Mother! Your presence fills the vast blue skies; the gentle breeze hums hymns in your praise.

stanza.lyrics: pūkkaḷ ninde pādam pulkān vembi vembi kāttu nilppū
stanza.meaning: Every flower in creation longs to touch your feet, offering itself in adoration and love.

stanza.lyrics: sāgaraṅgaḷ cēlakaḷāy pāriḍam nin pūmaḍiyāy
stanza.meaning: The oceans flow as your silken raiment, and the whole world becomes your soft lap.

stanza.lyrics: māmalakaḷ prēma-nadi pāl curattum māṙiḍaṅgaḷ
stanza.meaning: From the great mountains flow the milky streams of your boundless compassion.

stanza.lyrics: nīlavānil nī niṙaññu kāṫṫu ninde gānam mūḷi
stanza.meaning: Mother! Your presence fills the vast blue skies; the gentle breeze hums hymns in your praise.

stanza.lyrics: pūkkaḷ ninde pādam pulkān vembi vembi kāttu nilppū
stanza.meaning: Every flower in creation longs to touch your feet, offering itself in adoration and love.

stanza.lyrics: pāvanī parātparē nin pādam eṅgu… tēḍiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: O pure and radiant one, supreme goddess—where are those sacred feet that bestow liberation?

stanza.lyrics: vēda-sāramām ateṅgō mēviḍunn-anantatayil
stanza.meaning: Your lotus feet—the very essence of the Vedas—reside somewhere in the eternal vastness, beyond the bounds of time.

stanza.lyrics: nīlavānil nī niṙaññu kāṫṫu ninde gānam mūḷi
stanza.meaning: Mother! Your presence fills the vast blue skies; the gentle breeze hums hymns in your praise.

stanza.lyrics: pūkkaḷ ninde pādam pulkān vembi vembi kāttu nilppū
stanza.meaning: Every flower in creation longs to touch your feet, offering itself in adoration and love.

stanza.lyrics: kāṇmatinnu kāraṇamē kālātīta pūrṇa-sattē
stanza.meaning: You are the source of this manifest world, the timeless perfection itself.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇḍu kaṇḍu kaṇ niṙaññī kuññu kaikaḷ kūppi nilppū
stanza.meaning: This child gazes upon you again and again, eyes brimming with tears, palms joined in humble prayer.

stanza.lyrics: nīlavānil nī niṙaññu kāṫṫu ninde gānam mūḷi
stanza.meaning: Mother! Your presence fills the vast blue skies; the gentle breeze hums hymns in your praise.

stanza.lyrics: pūkkaḷ ninde pādam pulkān vembi vembi kāttu nilppū
stanza.meaning: Every flower in creation longs to touch your feet, offering itself in adoration and love.

song.title: nīla-vihāyasin vyāptiyilō
song.source: Nila vihayasin 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nīla-vihāyasin vyāptiyilōnīla-niśīthini cārutayilō
stanza.meaning: In the vastness of the deep blue sky, in the beauty of the dark and silent night,

stanza.lyrics: nabhasin nakṣatra-pūrṇimayilōnāthē nin prēma-svarūpam…
stanza.meaning: in the star-strewn glow of the full moon’s light—O sovereign of the universe, are these not but manifestations of your boundless love?

stanza.lyrics: nāthē nin prēma-svarūpam
stanza.meaning: are these not but manifestations of your boundless love?

stanza.lyrics: arṇṇavattin praśāntiyilōārttirambīḍum alamālayilō
stanza.meaning: In the serenity of the tranquil sea, in the roar of its untamed waves,

stanza.lyrics: āzhakkaḍalin samṛddhiyilōādima-nādattin āndōḷanam… āndōḷanam
stanza.meaning: in the abundance of the deep blue ocean—do we not hear your movement, the primal sound of creation?

stanza.lyrics: vasundharā-mātāvin kṣāntiyilōvṛkṣa-sasyādikaḷin kuḷirmayilō
stanza.meaning: In Mother Earth's enduring grace, in the coolness of trees and green, living flora,

stanza.lyrics: vindhyādi-parvata prauḍhiyilōvāṇu-viḷaṅgum nin vaibhavaṅgaḷ… vaibhavaṅgaḷ
stanza.meaning: in the grandeur of mountains like the Vindhyas—is it there that your resplendent glory shines?

stanza.lyrics: satyam śivam sundaram saccidānanda-bhāvam
stanza.meaning: You are truth, auspiciousness and beauty, you are existence, consciousness and bliss.

song.title: nin mizhittumbil ninnūṙunna
song.source: Nin mizhittumbil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nin mizhittumbil ninnūṙunna snēha-pravāhattil amba! ñān nīrāḍi nilkke
stanza.meaning: I joyfully bathe in the river of love that flows from your sidelong glance.

stanza.lyrics: ninnil aliyān piḍayunn-ennuḷḷamninnōḷam uyarān kazhiyāte ennum
stanza.meaning: My heart longs to dissolve into you, yet I find myself unable to soar to your heights, unable to reach you.

stanza.lyrics: padatār-atil oru madhu-makṣikayāynukaraṭṭe vātsalya makaranda-madhuram
stanza.meaning: Let me be a honeybee, sipping the sweet nectar of tenderness from your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: punarapi madhu tēḍi māyā-jagattil uzhaṙāt-irunniḍān tāru kūmbarutē
stanza.meaning: Do not fold your petals, lest I stray once more through this illusory world, seeking honey in vain.

stanza.lyrics: karatāril upakaraṇam atākuvānkaṙayaṫṫa padabhakti ēkīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: Grant me the gift of pure devotion, that I may become an instrument in your hands.

stanza.lyrics: katiravan pōle enn-akatāril jñānamāmkatir tūki narajanma-dhanyata ēkaṇē
stanza.meaning: Shine the light of knowledge in my heart like the sun, and fulfill the true purpose of this human life.

stanza.lyrics: ambikē śaraṇam amṛtāmbikē śaraṇam kāḷikē śaraṇam hṛdayāmbikē śaraṇam
stanza.meaning: Mother, I take refuge in you. Eternal Goddess, Kalika, Mother of my heart — I take refuge in you.

song.title: nin nāmam
song.source: Nin namam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nin nāmam ennum japiccu japiccu ñānende pērennō maṙannu pōyi
stanza.meaning: O Mother! Constantly chanting your name, I have forgotten mine.

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷil tiḷaṅgiḍum nin rūpa-kāntiyilen rūpavum cērnn-aliññu pōyi
stanza.meaning: My form has merged into your resplendent form that shines in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: tulyam-illāttat-ī snēham ammē prēma-sarvasvamē nammaḷ tammil ennum
stanza.meaning: O Mother! Your love is everything to me. Let no thought come between us.

stanza.lyrics: anya-cintakk-iṭam tellum illāteyāyen manam dhanyamāy tīrnniṭaṭṭē
stanza.meaning: Let my mind remain blessed and content.

stanza.lyrics: pakalil ñān virahattin-aṅgāra-śayya tansahanavum sādhana ākkiṭunnu
stanza.meaning: In my sleeplessness, bearing the intense pain of separation from you becomes my spiritual practice.

stanza.lyrics: rāvil, kināvil nin pādāmbujaṅgaḷiltala cāyccu, mizhivārtt-uṙaṅgiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: At night, I rest my head on your lotus feet and cry myself to sleep.

stanza.lyrics: taḷarum en tanu-mānasaṅgaḷe tazhukiḍānnī ozhiññ-ārini-amṛtāmbikē
stanza.meaning: O Mother of immortal bliss! Who but you can caress and bring new life to my tired body and mind?

stanza.lyrics: tuḍarum ī janmāntaraṅgaḷ tan yātrayil tuṇa ennum amma nī varadāmbike
stanza.meaning: O Mother, granter of boons… who else will support and guide me in my journey through my future lives?

song.title: nin pāvana-sannidhi tēḍi tēḍi
song.source: Nin pavana sannidhi tedi 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Nin pavana sannidhi tedi 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nin pāvana-sannidhi tēḍi tēḍioru prēma-gītam mūḷi mūḷi
stanza.meaning: Seeking your divine abode, humming a song of love, O Mother!

stanza.lyrics: nin pādāmbuja-madhu nukarānāypaṙann-aṇaññoru tēn-vaṇḍu ñān ammē
stanza.meaning: I am a honey bee, who has flown here to drink the nectar from your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: ā prēma-rasāmrṭam nuṇaññu nuṇaññuunmādam pūṇḍu mayaṅgumī enne
stanza.meaning: Drinking the ambrosia of your love, I am left intoxicated and dazed.

stanza.lyrics: nin pāda-padma-daḷam kūmbiyatin-uḷḷil paṙann-akalāte kāttīḍuk-ammē
stanza.meaning: O Mother! Fold the petals of your lotus feet, that I may never fly away.

stanza.lyrics: nin pāvana-sannidhi tēḍi tēḍioru prēma-gītam mūḷi mūḷi
stanza.meaning: Seeking your divine abode, humming a song of love, O Mother!

stanza.lyrics: bhavabhōga-sukhaṅgaḷ tēḍi alayāteprēma-vairāgyam nilanirtti ennum
stanza.meaning: Do not let me wander in search of fleeting comforts, keep me ever steadfast in love and dispassion.

stanza.lyrics: divya-kusumamām ninnil amarnnu ninsnēha-gānam mūḷi rasikkaṭṭe ñān
stanza.meaning: Let me dwell within the divine flower that is you, singing and rejoicing in blissful songs of love.

stanza.lyrics: ninnile nīyum ennile ñānumonnenn-advaitamām uṇmayil uṇaraṭṭe
stanza.meaning: Let me awaken to the non-dual truth that the you within you and the me within me are one

stanza.lyrics: nin cidākāśattilēkk-uyarnnu ñānā divya-cētassil layiccu cērnnīḍaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: . Let me soar into the boundless sky of inner space, and dissolve in the radiance of your divine consciousness.

song.title: ninna nōḍuttalē karagidenammā
song.source: Ninna noduttale 2025 Kan in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ninna nōḍuttalē karagidenammābhaktiya jōtegē jñānava nīḍammā
stanza.meaning: Seeing you, O Mother, I melt within. Please bless me with devotion and the gift of true knowledge.

stanza.lyrics: ajñānada mōhadinda dāri tappihenuninna śaraṇāgatiyali nijava kaṇḍenu
stanza.meaning: Lost in the confusion of ignorance and delusion, I had strayed from the path—but in surrendering at your feet, I have found what is real.

stanza.lyrics: "ātmanastu kāmāya" endu śrutiyu sārutidēātmana icchegāgi ellavū priyavāguvudu
stanza.meaning: The Upanishadic truth proclaims: “For the sake of the Self, all things are loved.” It is only for the sake of the Self that anything becomes dear.

stanza.lyrics: ī jagavu āsegaḷā cakradali tirugutidēkarma-phalava tyajisi nā yōgadi sthiragoḷḷali
stanza.meaning: This world spins endlessly in the wheel of desires. Let me renounce the fruits of action and become steady in yoga.

stanza.lyrics: ātmanastu kāmāya sarvam priyaṁ bhavati
stanza.meaning: Everything is dear for the sake of the Self.

stanza.lyrics: bāḷalli baṙuvudellā ninna kṛpeyendusvīkarisuve enna śānta hṛdaya sannidhiyalli
stanza.meaning: Everything that comes in life, may I accept as your grace. With a peaceful heart, may I receive it in the sanctuary of your presence.

stanza.lyrics: raviya tējavuḷḷa ninna nayana kiraṇagaḷu enna dēha manavannu pariśuddhagoḷisali
stanza.meaning: May the radiant beams of your sun-like eyes purify my body and my mind.

stanza.lyrics: ātmanastu kāmāya sarvaṁ priyam bhavati
stanza.meaning: Everything is dear for the sake of the Self.

stanza.lyrics: ī dharma-mārgadi śraddhe nannalludisalisatya jāgṛtagoḷipa nauke nānērali
stanza.meaning: Let me be filled with unwavering faith upon this path of dharma. May I become the sailor of the boat awakened by truth.

stanza.lyrics: mānava rūpa taḷedu bhuviyall-avatarisidēdurgē… durgē… ninna pādake śaraṇu
stanza.meaning: You, who have taken human form upon this earth, O Durga… Durga… I take refuge at your sacred feet.

stanza.lyrics: ātmanastu kāmāya sarvam priyam bhavati
stanza.meaning: Everything is dear for the sake of the Self.

song.title: ninne kuṙiccetra ezhutiyālum
song.source: Ninne kurichetra ezhutiyalum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ninne kuṙiccetra ezhutiyālum ammēmati varumō? koti tīrumō?
stanza.meaning: Mother, I write so many poems about you, yet it's never enough. My longing to write more never fades,

stanza.lyrics: etra janmaṅgaḷ nī nalkīḍilum ammēāyiram kavitakaḷ raciccīḍum ñān
stanza.meaning: and even if you gave me countless births, I would still write a thousand more poems for you.

stanza.lyrics: ninakkāy mātram ezhuti ezhuti ñānennile ninne tiricc-aṙiyum
stanza.meaning: Writing more and more, just for you, I will come to find you within myself.

stanza.lyrics: oḍuvil ñān illāte nī mātram ākunnaparamārtha tatvattil vilayiccīḍum
stanza.meaning: In the end, I will dissolve into that supreme state where I no longer exist—only you remain.

stanza.lyrics: ānandam ānandam ānanda-sāyūjyamnitya-nitāntam ā nirvṛtiyil
stanza.meaning: This soul dreams of that moment -

stanza.lyrics: onnu cērnnīḍum ā nimiṣa kanavitilkāttirippū ī jīvan ammē
stanza.meaning: —when it merges with you and enters a state of infinite, eternal bliss.

song.title: ninnil nirantara bhakti
song.source: Ninnil nirantara bhakti 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ninnil nirantara bhakti ezhāykil hā!en janmam ammē nirartham
stanza.meaning: Mother, my life will be without meaning if devotion to you does not fill my every breath

stanza.lyrics: ninne maṙakkunnu vidyakaḷāl eṅkil entin-enikku avayellām?
stanza.meaning: If the study of the scriptures only sharpens my intellect but makes me forget you, what use is such knowledge to me?

stanza.lyrics: ninne aṙiyuvān nirmalan ākuvānnin ninavil cērnn-aliyān
stanza.meaning: To know you who dwells within me, to purify my heart, to live a life immersed in thoughts of you,

stanza.lyrics: nī nalkum āśḷēṣam ēṫṫ-uṙaṅgīḍuvānēṙunn-abhilāṣam uḷḷil
stanza.meaning: the longing grows within me to rest in your embrace as I leave this body.

stanza.lyrics: ēṙunn-abhilāṣam uḷḷil
stanza.meaning: the longing grows within me

stanza.lyrics: ninnil nirantara bhakti ezhāykil hā!en janmam ammē nirartham
stanza.meaning: Mother, my life will be without meaning if devotion to you does not fill my every breath

stanza.lyrics: nī tanne ellāmāy nilppat-ennallayōōtunnu nālu vēdaṅgaḷ
stanza.meaning: The four Vedas proclaim that you are both the creator and the creation itself.

stanza.lyrics: nī ende amma tān nī mātram āṇendetāyum tuṇayum en ammē
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are my very own, my mother, and my sole refuge.

stanza.lyrics: tāyum tuṇayum en ammē
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are my very own, my mother, and my sole refuge.

stanza.lyrics: ammē… ammē… ammē… ammē…
stanza.meaning: Mother, O Mother…

song.title: nīradavarṇṇande nīla-tirumēni
song.source: Nirada varnnande 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nīradavarṇṇande nīla-tirumēniālambahīnarkk-orēkāśrayam
stanza.meaning: Your radiant form, the colour of blue clouds, is the sole refuge of the helpless

stanza.lyrics: arkkande kiraṇattāl nīhāram ennapōl nīkkiḍum pāpatte ninaccīḍukil
stanza.meaning: Like dewdrops vanishing in the morning sun, my sins dissolve in the thought of you.

stanza.lyrics: nirākāra-sākāram ōmkāravumsāyujyam ēkunna sākṣi-caitanyavum
stanza.meaning: You are the formless one, and yet the one who assumes form. You are the sacred syllable Om, the witness consciousness who grants liberation.

stanza.lyrics: satya-svarūpamē saccidānandamēsāmōdam aṅgē stuticciḍām ñānharē… kṛṣṇa…
stanza.meaning: You are the absolute truth, existence, consciousness, and bliss. I will sing your hymns with joy overflowing from my heart. O Krishna…

stanza.lyrics: vēda-vēdāntādi tatva-jñānaṅgaḷālētum tiriyumō nin mahima
stanza.meaning: O Krishna! Who can truly fathom your glory through the study of the Vedas and Vedanta?

stanza.lyrics: padatāril aṇayunna nirmala bhaktanmār ārādhyar ākunna dhanyātmākkaḷharē… kṛṣṇa…
stanza.meaning: Yet those pure-hearted devotees who have surrendered at your lotus feet become great souls, revered and worshipped by all. O Krishna!

stanza.lyrics: hē mādhavā… madhusūdanā…gītānāyakā… jagadīśvarā…
stanza.meaning: Madhava, slayer of the demon Madhu, the Lord who sang the Gita, the ruler of this universe!

song.title: niṙakānti coriyum
song.source: Nirakanti choriyum 2025 Mal in Mal.pptx

stanza.lyrics: niṙakānti coriyum nin mukhapadmamkāṇmānen hṛdayam tuḍikkunnu jananī
stanza.meaning: Mother! My heart beats with longing to behold your lovely lotus face, whose beauty makes the whole world radiant.

stanza.lyrics: amṛtatvam aṇayunna vazhikāṭṭi kanivindetirinīṭṭi enne nayikkū…
stanza.meaning: Lead me with the lamp of compassion, guide my steps upon the path of immortal life.

stanza.lyrics: entinenn-aṙiyīla niṙayunnen kaṇṇukaḷamma tan mizhiyil uḍakki…
stanza.meaning: When your gaze meets mine, my eyes brim with tears, I know not why.

stanza.lyrics: viḍarum mizhikaḷil uṣassinde nairmalyamkaṇḍu ñān kaṇṇīr ozhukki
stanza.meaning: In the depths of your wide eyes, I saw the pure light of a new dawn, and my eyes overflowed with tears.

stanza.lyrics: madhuramāy amma mozhiññ-ende kātilninakku ñān uṇḍende muttē
stanza.meaning: Sweetly, Mother whispered in my ear, “My pearl, I am here for you.

stanza.lyrics: karayallē! nī inn-anāthayall-ōmanēamma uṇḍamma ennennum
stanza.meaning: Do not weep, you are never alone, with none to call your own, Mother is there with you, forever.”

stanza.lyrics: ozhukunna puzhayuḍe ōḷaṅgaḷ ōtunnuamma endamma endamma…
stanza.meaning: The wavelets of the flowing river murmur, “Mother… my Mother.”

stanza.lyrics: kāṫṫinde kaipiḍiccālōlam āḍipulnāmbum mozhiññu endamma!
stanza.meaning: The tiny blade of grass, holding the hands of the breeze, sways in joy and also whispers, “My Mother.”

song.title: niśayuḍe nīḷam niśabdamām tīrē
song.source: Nishayude nilam nishabdhamam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: niśayuḍe nīḷam niśabdamām tīrē - nilayillā prēma-pravāhamām ninne
stanza.meaning: Upon the silent shores of lengthening night, as I sit alone, my thoughts on You,

stanza.lyrics: ninacca ñān aṅgu taniccirikkumbōḷnivṛttamāy varum nitānta-duḥkhaṅgaḷ
stanza.meaning: my thoughts on You, the boundless torrent of love, endless sorrows come to an end.

stanza.lyrics: taniccirikketān tanikk-uḷḷiluḷḷa - tanisvarūpatte aviśramam aṅgu
stanza.meaning: As I sit alone, may your grace flow towards me, that I may realize the need to seek the true Self within—ceaselessly, without respite.

stanza.lyrics: tiraññiḍānuḷḷa tiricc-aṙivināy - tiru kṛpayonnu ozhukkiḍēṇamē
stanza.meaning: As I sit alone, may your grace flow towards me, that I may realize the need to seek the true Self within—ceaselessly, without respite.

stanza.lyrics: tirikillāvīthi atāṇit-ennatutiricc-aṙiññavar utirtta vāymozhi
stanza.meaning: Hearing from those who knew it is a path seldom travelled,

stanza.lyrics: tiriccu ñānumā pathē ennākilum - tiḍukkam uṇḍenikk-aṙiññiḍān ammē
stanza.meaning: I too have begun to walk upon it, but O Mother I want to know my true self, without any delay

stanza.lyrics: tirike ennilēkk-uḷḷorā yātrayil - taḍitu samāna-prakāśamāy vīthiyil
stanza.meaning: In this journey towards my true self, may you remove my lethargy.

stanza.lyrics: tamassām ālasyam okke akaṫṫi nī - tanmayī! ennum nayikkaṇē satpathē
stanza.meaning: Illuminate my path, O Tanmayi, and guide me along this glorious way!

song.title: nityabandhō nityanirmalā
song.source: Nitya bandho nitya nirmmala 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Nitya bandho nitya nirmmala 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nityabandhō nityanirmalānityanirāmayanē
stanza.meaning: Shiva! Forever my own, the ever-pure, free from all sorrow,

stanza.lyrics: sattāyi cittāyi nityam viḷaṅgunnasatya-sanātananē
stanza.meaning: O Lord, supreme essence and pure consciousness!

stanza.lyrics: śuddha caitanyamē śubhra-varṇṇāṅganēsiddhēśanē śivanē
stanza.meaning: Shiva, you remain as the boundless awareness itself, smearing sacred ash upon your body, granting your divine darshan in a pure white form.

stanza.lyrics: baddhabhāvam nīkki nityam akakkāmbilsiddham-ākēṇamē nī
stanza.meaning: You are the Lord of all siddhas, the perfected beings. Abide within me always, remove my attachments, and kindle within me the light of supreme knowledge.

stanza.lyrics: hānikaḷ nīkkuvān hālāhalatteyumpānīyam ākkiyōnē
stanza.meaning: O Lord, you drank the deadly halahala poison to save the world,

stanza.lyrics: ‘ñān’enna bōdham mahāviṣam nīkkiinnānandam ēkukillē
stanza.meaning: will you not also remove the far more dangerous poison of ego within me, and lift me to the state of eternal bliss?

stanza.lyrics: śūlam kapālavum cālē ḍamaruvumphālāgniyum jaṭayum
stanza.meaning: In your hands, you hold the spear, the skull-bowl, and the damaru; your hair is thick and matted, your third eye blazes with the fire of divine wisdom.

stanza.lyrics: tāriṇī-mātāvum ottuḷḷil ānandatāṇḍavam āḍān tozhām
stanza.meaning: I pray that you dance the blissful tandava within my heart, in union with Devi Parvati, the compassionate Mother who ferries us across the ocean of samsara.

stanza.lyrics: śambhō śaṅkara pārvati ramaṇapaśupati paramēśā x4
stanza.meaning: Lord Shiva, beloved of Devi Parvati, Supreme Lord of all living beings.

song.title: ñān oru kaṇṇunīrttuḷḷi
song.source: Nyan oru kannu nir tulli 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Nyan oru kannu nir tulli 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ñān oru kaṇṇunīrttuḷḷi atil nī onnu toṭṭu talōḍi
stanza.meaning: I was a teardrop, and you caressed me gently.

stanza.lyrics: amma tan prēmam ī tuḷḷiye sparśicc-utirnnatō kāvyattin bhaṅgi – kālamutirttatō prēmattin bhaṅgi
stanza.meaning: When the light of Mother's love touched that tear, a sweet poem blossomed within me, like a rainbow—and time brought alive the beauty of love.

stanza.lyrics: amma tan smēra-kaḍākṣa-vacassukaḷ - dīkṣayāy ennilēkk-āzhnniṙaṅgi
stanza.meaning: Mother’s memories, glances, and words sank into me like a sacred initiation

stanza.lyrics: ātma-vicāram uṇartti atennāḷummanaḥ-parivarttanam ceytiḍunnu ende - mānasam nirmalam ākkiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: awakening self-inquiry, transforming my mind, and purifying my heart.

stanza.lyrics: jaladamāy ammayā prēmam pozhiykkavēhṛdayamām cippiyil iṫṫu vīṇu
stanza.meaning: As Mother poured her love like rain from a cloud, each drop fell into the shell of my heart,

stanza.lyrics: antarmukhamāy agādhatayil cennuvirahattin mṛdupīḍha nalki ninnu - ennummananattin prēraṇa ēki ninnu
stanza.meaning: reaching the innermost depths of my being—awakening the ache of seperation and prompting me to reflect.

stanza.lyrics: prēmattin muttu viḷayikkuvānōhṛdayattin nombaram nīṇḍu ninnu
stanza.meaning: The ache in my heart lingered, waiting for the water drop to become a luminous pearl of love.

stanza.lyrics: ellām amma tan anugraham āyirunn-ennu ñān aṙiññiḍunnu – kālam koṇḍ-innu ñān aṙiññiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: But now I see: It was all her blessing. With time, I understand—It was always her blessing.

song.title: O Essentie
song.source: O Essentie 2025 Dutch in English.pptx

stanza.lyrics: O Essentie van het levenIn het hart van elk wezenAanwezig in elk atoomAls de heilige klank Oom
stanza.meaning: O Essence of life, present in the heart of every being, residing in each atom as the sacred sound Om.

stanza.lyrics: O Amma, Devi MaO Amma, jai Ma
stanza.meaning: O Mother, Devi !!! Victory to you…

stanza.lyrics: In illusie ben ik verlorenEn m'n ware Zelf vergetenO Moeder vol van genadeZegen Uw kind met overgave
stanza.meaning: Lost in illusion, I have forgotten my true Self. O Mother, full of compassion, bless your child with surrender.

stanza.lyrics: De ene waarheid bent uGelukzaligheid in het nuVerwijder m'n zorgen en pijnLaat me altijd bij U zijn
stanza.meaning: You are the one truth, bliss itself in the eternal now. Remove my worries and pain, and let me ever remain with you.

song.title: ō kāḷiyā rē ō kāḷiyā rē
song.source: O Kaliya re 2025 Odiya in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ō kāḷiyā rē ō kāḷiyā rēmatē manna lāgē āsa nāccibā rē
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, I am longing for you to come dance with me.

stanza.lyrics: eṭhi bṛndābana rē apēkhyā karuci ō rēgāyī sabū kānda kōṭākarī dūdha dēyipārunī
stanza.meaning: Here in Vrindavan, I am waiting for you. All the cows are lowing in distress and cannot give their milk.

stanza.lyrics: kānhā rē… kānhā rē…sigra dauḍi dauḍi ki ā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna... come running quickly!

stanza.lyrics: ō kāḷiyā rē ō kāḷiyā rēmatē mannā lāgē asa nāccibā rē
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, I am longing for you to come dance with me.

stanza.lyrics: tōṙō pāyiṅ mūṅ bahuta lōhuṇi rakhiki banēci ō rēā rē kānhā ḍēri kaṙaṇa gōpigaṇa bēsta hēgōlērē
stanza.meaning: I have prepared plenty of butter for you. Please don’t delay any longer— all the gopis are growing restless.

stanza.lyrics: kānhā rē… kānhā rē… sigra dauḍi dauḍi ki ā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna… come running quickly!

song.title: ō viśva-mātē
song.source: O Visva mate 2025 Kan in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ō viśva-mātē ninna sundara-rūpavanu tōrisu
stanza.meaning: O Mother of the Universe, reveal your radiant form to me.

stanza.lyrics: ōmkāradalli ondāgiruva amma
stanza.meaning: You who are one with the sacred sound 'Om'—O Divine Mother, let me behold your true form.

stanza.lyrics: ō viśvamātē – ninna sundara rūpavanu tōrisu
stanza.meaning: O Mother of the Universe, reveal your radiant form to me.

stanza.lyrics: janana-maraṇada cakradinda nannanu mēlettu
stanza.meaning: O Divine Mother, lift me beyond the endless cycle of birth and death.

stanza.lyrics: ō dēvi tāyi dayaviṭṭu nannanu ninnatta karedōyyu
stanza.meaning: O compassionate Mother, I call out to you with longing

stanza.lyrics: nānu… ninna svanta maguvallavēnu?
stanza.meaning: —am I not your very own child?

stanza.lyrics: dēvi… nannanu ninna divya maḍilallirisikō
stanza.meaning: O Goddess, let me rest in your sacred lap.

stanza.lyrics: nanna hṛdayadalli nī dhruva-tāre nanage dharma mārga tōrisu
stanza.meaning: In my heart, you are the pole star—show me the path of dharma.

stanza.lyrics: nanna manadalli jñāna-dīpavanu beḷagisu
stanza.meaning: Light the lamp of wisdom within my mind, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: nānu… ninna svanta maguvallavēnu?
stanza.meaning: Am I not your very own child?

stanza.lyrics: dēvī… nannanu ninna divya-maḍilallirisikō
stanza.meaning: O Goddess, let me rest in your divine lap.

stanza.lyrics: jay mā… jay mā... jay mā… jay mā…
stanza.meaning: Victory to Mother

song.title: Oh Ma you are everywhereAll is within you
song.source: Oh Ma You are everywhere 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Oh Ma You are everywhere 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: Search and only Amma is found
Holy Mother so divine Would you purify my mind?
Crying for you since the dawn Holy mother you are all, Hear this call
By grace everything is doneThrough you flows the sun
Wide blue sky without a cloud
The witness ever brightThe self is still as night
Divine light flowing through time
Amma! Amma!Amma! Amma!

song.title: ōmkāra jōtiyil piṙanta jōtiyē
song.source: Omkara jotiyile 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ōmkāra jōtiyil piṙanta jōtiyēōmkārattil iṇaintiḍa maṙavātē
stanza.meaning: We are born from the sacred syllable Om, the radiant light of the Absolute Self. Understanding this, let us strive to merge with that Omkara

stanza.lyrics: māyai nizhalil uzhalātē māyā ulakil maḍintiḍātē
stanza.meaning: —without getting entangled in the shadows of illusion or trapped in this illusory world.

stanza.lyrics: kallum maṇṇum kuzhaittu kaṭṭiyavīḍuillaṙam kuḍipukum kuzhaintiḍum kūḍu
stanza.meaning: A house built of stone and mud, may be a home where families live and children play.

stanza.lyrics: sataiyum elumbum kūḍum meykkūḍatu
stanza.meaning: Similarly, this body is a temporary dwelling of flesh and bones.

stanza.lyrics: sitaiyil eriyum munnē teḷintiḍuvōm
stanza.meaning: Before it is consumed by the fire of the pyre, let us realize the truth.

stanza.lyrics: mīṇḍum piṙantē kūṭṭai tuṙantēvēṇḍumō vīṇākum suzhal vāzhvē
stanza.meaning: Born again, wandering again—do we still desire this endless, fruitless cycle of life?

stanza.lyrics: eṅkiruntu vantōm aṙintē uṇaravē
stanza.meaning: Let us awaken and realize from where we have come.

stanza.lyrics: poṅkum iṙaiyaruḷai nāḍiyē teḷintiḍuvōm
stanza.meaning: Seeking the overflowing grace of God, let us understand the truth.

stanza.lyrics: vāṅkiya kūḍatuvum nilaittiḍa muḍiyātēvāṅkiya kaḍan aḍaittiḍa vazhi piṙakkumē
stanza.meaning: This borrowed body will not last forever. If we understand that the burden of karmic debts must be repaid and live with awareness, the path to liberation will open.

stanza.lyrics: piṙappatanai aṙintē aṙavazhiyil naḍantiḍa
stanza.meaning: Realizing the cause of birth, let us walk the path of dharma.

stanza.lyrics: iṙappin bayaminḍri anbālē iyaṅkiḍuvōm
stanza.meaning: Moving forward with love, we can be free from the fear of death.

stanza.lyrics: vaiyaka mēḍaiyil vāzhkkai nāḍakamseyalkaḷ yāvaiyum arppaṇittu vāzhavē
stanza.meaning: Life is a drama staged upon the platform of the world. Let us realize that we are but actors in this divine play, and live with an attitude of surrender.

stanza.lyrics: uyyum vazhi teḷiya guruvaruḷai nāḍuvōm
stanza.meaning: Through the grace of the Guru, may we come to know that the sacred syllable Om is the only truth—and merge into that supreme state.

stanza.lyrics: meyyākum ōmkārattil kalantiḍuvōm
stanza.meaning: Through the grace of the Guru, may we come to know that the sacred syllable Om is the only truth—and merge into that supreme state.

song.title: ōmkāra-rūpiṇi āyorammē
song.source: Omkara rupini ayor Amme 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Omkara rupini ayor Amme 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ōmkāra-rūpiṇi āyorammē sarvamōmkāram ennum aṙiññor-ammē
stanza.meaning: Mother is the personification of the syllable Om, the cosmic sound that symbolizes the Supreme Absolute.

stanza.lyrics: ōmana-makkaḷe ennōti ennumlōkare tannōḍ-aṇaykkum ammē
stanza.meaning: She knows all things spring from the sacred syllable Om; she embraces us all, lovingly calling each of us her darling children.

stanza.lyrics: pāpāgni tannil eriññu ñānumpāritil vallāt-alaññīḍunnu
stanza.meaning: I wander this world, my heart being consumed in the fire of sin;

stanza.lyrics: pārinnu sarvam nī nāthayallēkāruṇyam alpam coriññīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: you are the sovereign of the universe—won’t you pour down your compassion on me?

stanza.lyrics: kāruṇyam alpam coriññīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: —won’t you pour down your compassion on me?

stanza.lyrics: pādapadmattinn-ariku paṫṫānpāram koticcu ñān kēṇiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: I long to reach your lotus feet;

stanza.lyrics: pādasarattile muttākki en janmampāvanī pāvanam ākkīḍumō
stanza.meaning: O Pure One, make me a bead on your anklet let my life become blessed.

stanza.lyrics: pāvanī pāvanam ākkīḍumō
stanza.meaning: O Pure One, let my life become blessed.

song.title: ōmkāra-svaram ezhum niṙamāla cārtti
song.source: Omkara svaramezhum niramala 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ōmkāra-svaram ezhum niṙamāla cārttipon-sūrya-kiraṇattin śōbha tūki
stanza.meaning: Wearing a garland of the seven divine notes of the Pranava mantra, emanating Devi’s power and energy with the rosy glow of the golden dawn,

stanza.lyrics: kali tan prabhāvēna vikambita svāntēdhīra-samīranāy aṇayū ambē
stanza.meaning: Mother, come to me like a gentle breeze, soothing this mind that trembles in distress under the heavy shadow of Kali Yuga.

stanza.lyrics: dhīra-samīranāy aṇayū ambē
stanza.meaning: Mother, come to me like a gentle breeze.

stanza.lyrics: ōmkāra-svaram ezhum niṙamāla cārttipon-sūrya-kiraṇattin śōbha tūki
stanza.meaning: Wearing a garland of the seven divine notes of the Pranava mantra, emanating Devi’s power and energy with the rosy glow of the golden dawn,

stanza.lyrics: virahattin vēnalil ñān taḷarnnuhṛdi-śōbha ēkum nī eṅgu pōyi
stanza.meaning: I am weary, unable to bear the anguish of this long separation. Where have you gone, you who illumine my heart?

stanza.lyrics: akalayāy ñānō mizhi naṭṭirunnu
stanza.meaning: With eyes fixed on the distant horizon,

stanza.lyrics: āśā-kiraṇaṅgaḷ hā poliññu
stanza.meaning: I wait—yet every ray of hope has now faded away.

stanza.lyrics: ambām yajāmi anaghām namāmiśyāmām smārāmi bhāmām bhajāmi
stanza.meaning: Worship the Mother; bow down before the sinless One. Remember the dark-hued Goddess, and sing hymns in praise of her radiant beauty.

stanza.lyrics: ōmkāra-svaram ezhum niṙamāla cārttipon-sūrya-kiraṇattin śōbha tūki
stanza.meaning: Wearing a garland of the seven divine notes of the Pranava mantra, emanating Devi’s power and energy with the rosy glow of the golden dawn,

stanza.lyrics: nātidūre mṛdu svanam kēṭṭucitte viḷaṅgunnu ennu connu
stanza.meaning: I heard a gentle, sweet voice nearby, saying, “I am the one who shines within you as pure awareness.”

stanza.lyrics: sāntvanam ēki kṛpā-varṣam ēki
stanza.meaning: She comforted me, pouring her compassion into my grief-stricken heart,

stanza.lyrics: cērttu tirike sudīpta-mārgē
stanza.meaning: and guided me back to the radiant path of true knowledge.

stanza.lyrics: ambām yajāmi anaghām namāmiśyāmām smārāmi bhāmām bhajāmi
stanza.meaning: Worship the Mother; bow down before the sinless One. Remember the dark-hued Goddess, and sing hymns in praise of her radiant beauty.

song.title: ōrātta saubhāgya
song.source: Oratta saubhagya panktikal 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ōrātta saubhāgya-panktikaḷ ēki nī - ōmalāy enne vaḷartti ennum
stanza.meaning: You raised me as your cherished one, always blessing me with your grace

stanza.lyrics: amṛta-kaṇaṅgaḷ ī vanalataykk-ēki ninārāma-sīmayil iḍam tarumō?
stanza.meaning: —will you not spare a drop of nectar for this wildflower, and a place at the edge of your garden?

stanza.lyrics: ōrma tan kuvalaya-mukuḷam viḍarnnatu - oḷi tūkum nin smēra-prabhayil allō
stanza.meaning: The tender lotus bud of memory blossoms in the radiant light of your remembrance.

stanza.lyrics: ōḷaṅgaḷāl ēṙe ulayunnu eṅkilum - ōrkkunnu nin mahāvaibhavaṅgaḷ
stanza.meaning: Though tossed by restless waves, I recall your boundless glory

stanza.lyrics: oru mātra eṅkilum centāraḍikaḷilonn-amarnnīḍuvān uṇḍu mōham
stanza.meaning: and long to rest, if only for a moment, at your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: auddhatyam ennu ninaccīḍollē kaḍa-kaṇṇināl onnu viḷiccīḍumō
stanza.meaning: Do not mistake this yearning for pride; will you beckon me with a glance from the corner of your eye?

stanza.lyrics: onnum uriyāḍān kazhiyāte citaṙunnuorāyiram cuḍu-nisvanaṅgaḷ
stanza.meaning: I’ve shed a thousand sighs of longing, yet not a single word could I speak.

stanza.lyrics: oru dalamarmmaram pōlum aṙiyum nīonnum aṙiyāttapōl naḍippū
stanza.meaning: You — who understand even the murmur of a leaf — why do you pretend not to know?

stanza.lyrics: ōḍi taḷarnn-ende vāḍum akakkāmbupāḍē eriññaḍ-aṅgīḍum munnē
stanza.meaning: Before my innermost being withers, weary from seeking you,

stanza.lyrics: ōmkāra-poruḷē nin pāda-padmattiṅkal nirlīnam ākaṇē ende cittam
stanza.meaning: dissolve my mind at your lotus feet, O divine essence of Om.

song.title: ormma vacca nāḷ mutal
song.source: Ormma vacca nal 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ormma vacca nāḷ mutal kaṇṇane kāṇān kāttirunnu en manam
stanza.meaning: For as long as I can remember, my heart has longed for a glimpse of Krishna.

stanza.lyrics: oru nēram eṅkilum nīvannirunneṅkil ennu mōhiccu en hṛdayam
stanza.meaning: I hoped that you would come, if only once, to dwell within my heart.

stanza.lyrics: maunattin madhura-smṛtiyilmanassil oru gītam uṇarnnu
stanza.meaning: In the depths of silent remembrance, a song blossomed within my heart.

stanza.lyrics: niravadhi rāvil ninde nāmampāḍi pāḍi naḍannu ñān
stanza.meaning: Through countless nights, I wandered on, singing your holy name.

stanza.lyrics: snēham niṙañña nin cintakaḷennil tēn-nilāvāy paḍarnnu
stanza.meaning: Thoughts of you filled me with love, spreading within me like radiant moonlight.

stanza.lyrics: madhura-smaraṇakaḷ ōrōnnum ennilpuḷakattin ōḷaṅgaḷāy
stanza.meaning: Each sweet remembrance stirred waves of bliss in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: māṙi maṙayunna jīvita-svapnattilmāṙātta sattayil cērān
stanza.meaning: In this ever-changing dream we call life, I long to merge into the changeless essence.

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇā… nī varam aruḷū ennilanugraham coriyaṇē kaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, bless me—let me become one with you!

song.title: oru gānam ennil viriññu
song.source: Oru ganam ennil virinyu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Oru ganam ennil virinyu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: oru gānam ennil viriññu, atiluriyāḍān vākkukaḷ illa
stanza.meaning: A song blossomed within my heart — a song that could not be expressed in words.

stanza.lyrics: karuṇārdra-bhāvam viḷaṅgum ninnil aliyumā gānamarāḷam
stanza.meaning: O Mother, tender and compassionate, the song merged into you.

stanza.lyrics: iniyum varum oru sandhya, navapularkālayāmam tiraññu
stanza.meaning: Hope dawned within me — my mind whispered, “The dark nights of your life are over. The morning sun has risen.

stanza.lyrics: rajaniye nī veṙukkēṇḍa uṣass-avaluḍe kanyakayallō
stanza.meaning: But do not despise the night, for it is the night that has given birth to the dawn.

stanza.lyrics: oru gānam ennil viriññu, atiluriyāḍān vākkukaḷ illa
stanza.meaning: A song blossomed within my heart — a song that could not be expressed in words.

stanza.lyrics: karuṇārdra-bhāvam viḷaṅgum ninnil aliyumā gānamarāḷam
stanza.meaning: O Mother, tender and compassionate, the song merged into you.

stanza.lyrics: kariyunna malarukaḷ vīṇḍum cemmēkanikaḷāy māṙiḍum melle
stanza.meaning: My mind consoled me, “You thought that your efforts and hopes were in vain. But one day, slowly, they will bear fruit;

stanza.lyrics: cirakāla svapnam pūv-aṇiyum annā-caritārtha saukhyam aṇayum
stanza.meaning: My mind consoled me, “You thought that your efforts and hopes were in vain. But one day, slowly, they will bear fruit; your long-cherished dream will blossom, and your life will find its fulfillment.”

stanza.lyrics: oru gānam ennil viriññu, atiluriyāḍān vākkukaḷ illa
stanza.meaning: A song blossomed within my heart — a song that could not be expressed in words.

stanza.lyrics: karuṇārdra-bhāvam viḷaṅgum ninnil aliyumā gānamarāḷam
stanza.meaning: O Mother, tender and compassionate, the song merged into you.

stanza.lyrics: viriyunna pūvil ninnūṙum śuddha-madhuvine tēḍum bhramaram
stanza.meaning: The mind continued, “The honeybee will seek the pure nectar from the freshly blossomed flower that has realized the Self.

stanza.lyrics: oru nāḷil amma tan divya pada-malaratil cērnniḍum nūnam
stanza.meaning: And one day, the honeybee shall surely reach the lotus feet of the Divine Mother.”

stanza.lyrics: oru gānam ennil viriññu, atiluriyāḍān vākkukaḷ illa
stanza.meaning: A song blossomed within my heart — a song that could not be expressed in words.

stanza.lyrics: karuṇārdra-bhāvam viḷaṅgum ninnil aliyumā gānamarāḷam
stanza.meaning: O Mother, tender and compassionate, the song merged into you.

song.title: oru koccu svapnavum
song.source: Oru kocchu svapnam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: oru koccu svapnavum neñcōḍu cērttu ñānnī varum vīthiyil kāttu nilppū
stanza.meaning: I cradle lovely dreams of Krishna close to my heart, as I wait by the path by which he will come

stanza.lyrics: ennile svapnaṅgaḷ ārdramām oru pāṭṭiltīrttoru rāgamāy peytīḍunnu
stanza.meaning: —those dreams flow as a song with a tuneful melody.

stanza.lyrics: malaruṇḍu maṇamilla niṙamuṇḍu azhakillatānē viḍarnn-oru ceṙuvalli ñān
stanza.meaning: I am but a tender creeper, born of a grieving heart. My blossoms hold no sweetness, no beauty, only colour

stanza.lyrics: virahāgniyil vīṇu nīṙum manassumāyisvayamē viriyunnu ennile sūnuvum
stanza.meaning: —growing in the sorrow of being apart from you.

stanza.lyrics: oru koccu svapnavum neñcōḍu cērttu ñānnī varum vīthiyil kāttu nilppū
stanza.meaning: I cradle lovely dreams of Krishna close to my heart, as I wait by the path by which he will come

stanza.lyrics: kōrttiṇakki vecca svapnattil ennumkaṇṇande puñciri onnu mātram
stanza.meaning: Krishna, your smile fills every dream that I have woven.

stanza.lyrics: naṙunilāvāyi nī manassil niṙayumbōḷviḍarunnu ennile mōhaṅgaḷum
stanza.meaning: When your smile pours into me like radiant moonlight, my hopes begin to blossom.

stanza.lyrics: oru koccu svapnavum neñcōḍu cērttu ñānnī varum vīthiyil kāttu nilppū
stanza.meaning: I cradle lovely dreams of Krishna close to my heart, as I wait by the path by which he will come

stanza.lyrics: paurṇami paṭṭu viriccorā pātayilkēḷkkunnu kaṇṇande pada-nisvanam
stanza.meaning: I hear your footsteps on the path carpeted in moonlight.

stanza.lyrics: enneyum cērkkuvān ñān entu nalkaṇamkaiviḍallē enna vākku mātramkaṇṇā… kaiviḍallē enna vākku mātram
stanza.meaning: What can I give you to make me your own? Only this one prayer: “O Krishna, do not forsake me.”

stanza.lyrics: oru koccu svapnavum neñcōḍu cērttu ñānnī varum vīthiyil kāttu nilppū
stanza.meaning: I cradle lovely dreams of Krishna close to my heart, as I wait by the path by which he will come

song.title: oru kunnu kadanattin
song.source: Oru kunnu kadanattin 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: oru kunnu kadanattin bhāraṅgaḷ ēnti ñānammē nin tirumunnil vannu ninnu
stanza.meaning: Mother, I came into your divine presence carrying heavy bundles of sorrow

stanza.lyrics: tozhutu nilkkumbōḷ nī tirumizhiyāl ennetazhuki talōḍi atende puṇyam
stanza.meaning: . As I stood with palms folded in prayer before you, you caressed me with your gaze.

stanza.lyrics: patirillā prēmattin pāl kumbham nīṭṭi nīatirillā kāruṇyam tūkiḍumbōḷ
stanza.meaning: When you extend to me the milk pot of pure love and shower boundless compassion,

stanza.lyrics: utirumī mizhinīr malarukaḷ allāteillammē tṛpāda-pūjaykk-ēkān
stanza.meaning: I have nothing to offer at your divine feet but the tears that flow from my eyes like flowers of adoration.

stanza.lyrics: collāte collunna mizhikaḷālē endenombaraṅgaḷ munnil kāzhca vaccu
stanza.meaning: Through my eyes that spoke, I surrendered all my sorrows to you.

stanza.lyrics: vākkukaḷāl oṭṭum varṇṇikkān ākāttasnēhavāypil ñān tariccu ninnu…
stanza.meaning: In the flow of your love that transcends words, I forgot myself and stood in a blissful trance, unable to look away from you.

stanza.lyrics: /ammēenne maṙannu ñān nōkki ninnu…
stanza.meaning: I forgot myself and stood in a blissful trance, unable to look away from you.

song.title: oru neḍuvīrppumāy aṇayunnu ñān ammē
song.source: Oru neduvirppumay anayunnu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: oru neḍuvīrppumāy aṇayunnu ñān ammēoru mātra enne nī nōkkukillē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, I come to you with a forlorn sigh—will you not glance upon me, even for a moment?

stanza.lyrics: hṛdayattiloru tiri koḷutti vaykkām ennumaṇayāte nīyatu kākkukille
stanza.meaning: I will ever light a lamp within my heart—will you not keep it burning bright?

stanza.lyrics: ā tiru dīpam pradakṣiṇam ceytu nin - āyiram mantraṅgaḷ urukkazhikkām
stanza.meaning: Reverently circumambulating that sacred lamp, I will chant a thousand mantras in your praise.

stanza.lyrics: tāṅguvān ākātta bhārattāl hṛdayavum taḷarumbōzhamma nī aṇayukillē
stanza.meaning: When my heart becomes burdened with unbearable sorrow, O Mother, will you not draw near?

stanza.lyrics: cinta camaykkunna cakravyūham tanniluyirināy piḍayunnī jīvanammē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, this being writhes in agony, trapped in the Chakravyuha of endless thoughts.

stanza.lyrics: nin kṛpa onnallātinnilla en munnil coriyuvān tāmasam arutarutē
stanza.meaning: There is no way forward for me now but your grace alone. I beg you, O Mother, do not delay—shower your grace upon me.

song.title: oru pīlituṇḍināy ñān alaññu
song.source: Oru pili tundinay 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: oru pīlituṇḍināy ñān alaññuorāyiram pīlippū nī kaniññu
stanza.meaning: When I wandered in search of just a sliver of your love, a tiny piece of your peacock feather, you gave me a thousand in return.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna

stanza.lyrics: karaḷoru muḷantaṇḍāy mādhavādharam cērnnuanupama-lahariyil svayam maṙannu
stanza.meaning: My heart became a flute, and I lost myself in loving devotion as you held it gently to your lips.

stanza.lyrics: gōpakiśōrande vāymalar tūkiyanādāmṛtattil aliññu cērnnu
stanza.meaning: O Lord of the Gopis, I dissolved in the beautiful melody you played.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna

stanza.lyrics: paribhavam maṙannu tirumizhi tuṙannuhṛdayam orukkiya naṙuveṇṇa nukarnnu
stanza.meaning: All my feelings of neglect vanished when you opened your eyes. You tasted the fresh butter churned from the depths of my heart.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇīr muttine nī puṇarnnu prēmasāgara-yamunayil ñān alaññu
stanza.meaning: You compassionately embraced this life—a mere teardrop. And I merged into the Yamuna, into the vast ocean of your love.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna

stanza.lyrics: oru pīlituṇḍināy ñān alaññuorāyiram pīlippū nī kaniññu
stanza.meaning: When I wandered in search of just a sliver of your love, a tiny piece of your peacock feather, you gave me a thousand in return.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā… kaṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna

song.title: oru svarga gaṅgayāy amma vannu
song.source: Oru svarga Gangayay 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: oru svarga gaṅgayāy amma vannu - viṇṇile veṇṇilā candrikayāy
stanza.meaning: Mother came like a heavenly Ganga, like silver moonlight lighting up the night sky.

stanza.lyrics: dīnānukambayāy dāsānu dāsiyāy - prēma pravāhamāy amma vannu
stanza.meaning: Mother came as compassion for the downtrodden, as the servant of servants. Mother came as a torrent of divine love

stanza.lyrics: manassil orāyiram ōrmakaḷ viḍartti - hṛdaya puṣpamāy amma vannu
stanza.meaning: Mother came as the flower of the heart, and a thousand sweet memories blossomed in the mind.

stanza.lyrics: ōrmayil āyiram pīli nivarttijīvita vīthiyil amma vannu
stanza.meaning: Like a peacock spreading a thousand feathers of memories, Mother came into the path of my life.

stanza.lyrics: ātmāvilēkkoru amṛtavarṣamāyhṛdayattin bhāṣayāy amma vannu
stanza.meaning: Mother came as a downpour of nectar on the soul, as the language of the heart.

stanza.lyrics: oru pūvinde mṛdula-bhāvamāytēn ūṙum mozhiyumāy amma vannu
