stanza.meaning: Mother came as the softness of a flower, with words flowing with honey.

song.title: oru tuḷḷi-amṛtam
song.source: Oru tulli amritam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: oru tuḷḷi-amṛtam nalkīḍuvāntiruvuḷḷattil kaniv-ēkumō
stanza.meaning: O Mother! Will you have the compassion to grant me a drop of nectar?

stanza.lyrics: mativiṭṭu maruvunna mānasa-bhṛṅgattinumadhuram tellu nalki aṇaccīḍumō
stanza.meaning: The honeybee of my mind, wandering in delusion, may it be drawn near by a single drop of your sweetness.

stanza.lyrics: rāgamēgha śūnyamāya vānilnīla-varṇamāy amma vann-aṇayavē
stanza.meaning: In the inner sky, free from the clouds of desire, Mother, you appear as infinite blue.

stanza.lyrics: śyāma pādaṅgaḷām nīla-padmaṅgaḷ enhṛddēśśa viḍarnnīḍumē
stanza.meaning: Then, the blue lotuses of your radiant feet blossom within my heart.

stanza.lyrics: manaḥ-bhṛṅgam madhu nukarnnīḍavēennēkkum pādē vilayiccīḍān
stanza.meaning: As the honeybee of my heart drinks of your nectar, may I be absorbed in the radiance of your smile.

stanza.lyrics: pūntiṅkaḷ pālōḷi tūkiḍaṇēdaḷaṅgaḷ kūmbi tuṇaccīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: Close the petals of your lotus feet, and shelter me there forever.

song.title: oru tumba-malarinde azhak-ezhum veṇmayil
song.source: Oru tumba malarinde 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: oru tumba-malarinde azhak-ezhum veṇmayiloru mahākaravirutillē amba tantirukaravallari mudrayillē
stanza.meaning: In the pristine white beauty of the Thumba flower, is there not the mark of great artistry—the imprint of Mother’s dexterous fingers?

stanza.lyrics: oru mullamalarinde māsmara-gandhattil - hṛdayattin saurabhyam-illē amba tankaruṇāmaya-rasatantramillē
stanza.meaning: In the bewitching fragrance of jasmine, is there not the fragrance of Mother’s heart—the alchemy of her compassion?

stanza.lyrics: kēka tan nṛtya-manōhāritayil ābhāvahāvādikaḷ illēamba tan lāsya-bhāvam-ārnna layamatillē
stanza.meaning: In the mesmerizing dance of the peacock is there not an expression of divine movement—Mother’s graceful dance of oneness?

stanza.lyrics: kōkilam tan svara-mādhuri tannilum - śruti cērum īṇamatillē amba tanmatiyārnna gītavidhānam-illē
stanza.meaning: In the sweet ditties of the cuckoo bird, is there not the touch of Mother’s melodious harmony, the musical symphony that flows from her divine heart?

stanza.lyrics: dṛśyamī viśvattin vismaya-varṇṇaṅgaḷ - vaśya-mṛduhāsam-allē - amba tan sattvādi-guṇabhēdam-allē
stanza.meaning: In the wondrous sights and colours of this visible universe, is there not the radiance of her alluring smile? The reflections of Mother’s divine moods and qualities?

stanza.lyrics: mati kṛti samskṛti smṛti gati prakṛtiyil - kuḍikoḷḷum caitanyam-allē amba nījagatsarvam vyāpitam-allē
stanza.meaning: Mother, are you not the very consciousness that resides in the cycle of life—in the intellect, in works of art, in noble culture, in memory, our very direction forward? Are you not the consciousness that pervades this universe?

song.title: ozhukaṇa puzhayil vīṇa - teyyō taka taka
song.source: Ozhukunna puzhayil vina - teyyo taka taka 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Ozhukunna puzhayil vina - teyyo taka taka 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: teyyō taka taka teyyō taka takateyyō taka taka tōmteyyō taka taka teyyō taka takateyyō taka taka tōm
stanza.meaning: (Traditional chorus)

stanza.lyrics: ozhukaṇa puzhayil vīṇa puḷiyilayō kālamozhukām, ozhuki nīṅgām aṙiyunnillē āzham
stanza.meaning: Life is like a small tamarind leaf drifting in the ceaseless river of time. We float upon its surface, unaware of its unfathomable depths.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇāle, kaṇḍiḍunna, lōkam ennumpoykaṇṇonnaḍacc-ennāl… uḷḷilayyā poruḷē
stanza.meaning: The world we grasp through our senses is but an illusion. If we can draw back the mind and turn it inward, we will behold the supreme essence dwelling within.

stanza.lyrics: uyir azhiññāluḍal vaḷaccu muṙa tuḍaṅgum nammaḷuyir pōyāl muṙayiḍāne maṫṫuḷḷoru vēṇḍē
stanza.meaning: At birth, we arch our tiny bodies and cry. At death, don’t we need others to weep for us?

stanza.lyrics: periya muṙa pōlākum ī uyirum maṇṇilmaṫṫuḷḷōrkkum vaḷamāyāl onnatinē cēlu
stanza.meaning: This body will one day blend with the earth—let us, while it still breathes, offer it in service to the world.

stanza.lyrics: tirayinmēl ponti varum nīrkkumiḷa kaṇḍō-noḍiyonnil takarum nīrkkumiḷayallō uyir
stanza.meaning: Life is no more than a bubble atop a foaming wave—it is shattered in a moment;

stanza.lyrics: maṇṇōḍu… cērum munpu oru noḍiyē vāzhvuallāte, tōnnippikkum ellām nin kanavu
stanza.meaning: there is only a brief pause between birth and death, when our body returns to earth. It is but a dream to think we live forever.

stanza.lyrics: azhak-ozhukum vaḍivārnna uḍalu pōlum nāḷetī eriyum vañcitayil viṙakupōl-endeyō
stanza.meaning: Our body may be beautiful, but one day it will be given to the flames.

stanza.lyrics: ñān ennu conna nēram onnumilla pinnecollānāy, endētāyi onnumilla ponnē
stanza.meaning: Then our ego and self-praise will become mere ash. Then, what remains to call our own?

stanza.lyrics: nīṫṫil nilkkum tāmara tan, ilayil oru tuḷḷisūryayanē uḷḷil ēlkkum, cembavizha-tuḷḷi
stanza.meaning: When sunlight touches a drop of water resting on a lotus leaf, it shines like a priceless gem. But when it falls to the ground, it vanishes.

stanza.lyrics: maṇṇōḍu, maṇṇil vīṇāl tuḷḷiyeṅgu pōyiayyayyō, maṇṇāyi, māṙiḍallē, ponnē…
stanza.meaning: So too, before we return to dust, let us awaken to the blazing sun of the supreme self within, and taste the nectar of immortality.

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷil-uḷḷor-īśvarane, aṙiyunnillennāyālmunniluḷḷor-īśvaranōḍ-entu collum nammal
stanza.meaning: If we do not find God within, how will we see that all the world is God?

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷoḷḷa… kālamatu īśvarane ōrkkāneḷḷōḷam kaiviḍallē īśvarane ponnē
stanza.meaning: As long as we breathe, we must not forget, even for an instant to remember the divine.

stanza.lyrics: onnāyoronnine nām, palatāyi kaṇḍēpalatāy-aronnine nām, kaṇḍatillenn-aṙiyū
stanza.meaning: The one supreme reality wears countless forms and names yet we fail to see the one God in this diverse universe.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇāle kāṇuvatull-ulakattin poruḷēporuḷḷil teḷiyān uḷkaṇṇu vēṇam kaṇṇē
stanza.meaning: To seek what lies beyond the reach of the senses, mind, and intellect in the outer world is to search in vain. Turn the mind inward; open the eye of wisdom to let the radiance of the supreme self shine forth.

song.title: pādapadmam veḍiññ-eṅgōṭṭu pōkum
song.source: Padapadmam vedinyu engottu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: pādapadmam veḍiññ-eṅgōṭṭu pōkum ī kuññunī allātāruṇḍ-ivaḷkku
stanza.meaning: Mother, where can this child go, leaving your lotus feet? Who else is there for me,

stanza.lyrics: ōrō nimiṣavum tēṅgi karayunnuennuḍe hṛdayam ammē…
stanza.meaning: Mother-who else but you? Every moment, my heart weeps in longing.

stanza.lyrics: ennile ninne aṙiyān kotikkum ī kuññinekaiviḍallē ammē kaividallē
stanza.meaning: Do not let go of this child who yearns to find You within me.

stanza.lyrics: ēkāntatayuḍe āzhaṅgaḷilārōrum illāte alayumbōḷ
stanza.meaning: When I wandered, lost in loneliness, with no one beside me,

stanza.lyrics: karam nīṭṭi duḥkha-kaḍalil ninnammauyartti enne maḍittoṭṭilil āṭṭi
stanza.meaning: you reached out, Mother—your hands lifted me from the vast ocean of sorrow. You placed me in your lap and gently rocked me.

stanza.lyrics: paṅkattil tāmara enna pōleen manassil amma vasikkunnu
stanza.meaning: Mother, you dwell in me like a lotus blooming in the mire.

stanza.lyrics: vāsanakaḷ-ākum paṅkam akaṫṫi ennumvasikkaṇē manatāritil vasikkaṇē manatāritil
stanza.meaning: Cleanse the dirt of my dark and restless thoughts, and reside forever within the flower of my heart.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇunīr allāte onnum tarānillaende ambōṫṫi ammē…
stanza.meaning: My Ambottiamma! I have nothing to offer—only these tears I lay before you.

stanza.lyrics: eppōzhum ninnōḍu cērttaṇacc-ennevaḷarttēṇamē ammē…vaḷarttēṇamē ammē…
stanza.meaning: Keep me near, Mother; raise me in your embrace.

stanza.lyrics: kuññē karayallē ninde kaṇṇunīrveṙute ākukayillā
stanza.meaning: "Daughter, your tears will not be in vain.

stanza.lyrics: amma aṙiyunnu nin manōvēdanaamma uṇḍeppōzhum kūḍe amma uṇḍeppōzhum kūḍe
stanza.meaning: Mother knows the pain within your heart, and Mother will always remain with you.”

song.title: pādapaṅgaḷe pāvanayām amma tan
song.source: Padapangale 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: pādapaṅgaḷe pāvanayām amma tanpāda-padmam itu vazhi tazhuki ennō
stanza.meaning: O trees, did the divine Mother pass this way? O ocean, you dance in delight—do you exult in joy at the touch of her sacred feet?

stanza.lyrics: sāgaramē nīyum innu ārtt-ullasippatummātṛpāda sparśa-harṣa-puḷakitan āyō
stanza.meaning: O trees, did the divine Mother pass this way? O ocean, you dance in delight—do you exult in joy at the touch of her sacred feet?

stanza.lyrics: arddha-vidhu-śōbha ezhum nāsābharaṇattināltapta hṛdayaṅgaḷil śānti-dānam ceyyuvōḷ
stanza.meaning: Her nose ornament, like a crescent moon, brings solace to the suffering.

stanza.lyrics: mārddavam ēṙum karaṅgaḷ mānasam tazhukavēmāyā bandhanaṅgaḷ nīkkum ammaye darśiccuvō
stanza.meaning: When her tender hands caress the heart, all worldly attachments fall away. Have you ever beheld such a Mother?

stanza.lyrics: tyāga-mārga-ponviḷakkē mōkṣa-śilpinī – tavapātayil carikkuvān mōham ēṙe uṇḍumē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, you are the guiding light on the path of renunciation, the one who bestows liberation. I long to walk in your footsteps, but I lack the strength and the virtues praised in the scriptures.

stanza.lyrics: dhairyam illa tellume śrautamām guṇaṅgaḷumdhīran ākki brahma-vākya bōdham ēkiḍēṇamē
stanza.meaning: Mother, grant me the wisdom to dive deep within, and awaken in me the awareness that I am That—the supreme reality itself.

song.title: pāḍavantēn ammā paravaśamāy
song.source: Padavanten Amma 2025 Tamil in Eng R1.pptx

stanza.lyrics: pāḍavantēn ammā paravaśamāypāḍavantēn ammā
stanza.meaning: O Mother — I have come to sing; in ecstasy I come, to sing Your glory.

stanza.lyrics: pāḍi āḍiḍum bhaktar kuzhuvinil tēḍi kāṇāmal ōḍi vantēn unnai
stanza.meaning: I sought You among those who danced and sang Your praise — and finding You not, I ran here, Mother — breathless, longing.

stanza.lyrics: pāḍavantēn ammā paravaśamāypāḍavantēn ammā
stanza.meaning: O Mother — I have come to sing; in ecstasy I come, to sing Your glory.

stanza.lyrics: bhakti ennum cuṭar parava vēṇḍum
stanza.meaning: May the flame of devotion spread —

stanza.lyrics: pāmara janaṅgaḷ nalam peṙa vēṇḍumśaktiyin pukazh pāḍa vēṇḍum… śiva
stanza.meaning: may the humble and helpless find well-being. May I forever sing the praise of the supreme power — the eternal Truth,

stanza.lyrics: sakala kōḍikaḷ payan pera vēṇḍum
stanza.meaning: and may countless hearts be blessed by Your grace.

stanza.lyrics: pāḍavantēn ammā paravaśamāypāḍavantēn ammā
stanza.meaning: O Mother — I have come to sing; in ecstasy I come, to sing Your glory.

stanza.lyrics: ni sa ga… sa ga ma… ga ma pa… ma pa ni
stanza.meaning: (Musical swaras)

stanza.lyrics: veṇmayāna ammayē kalādēvivēṇḍinēn ninniḍam varam aruḷvāyē
stanza.meaning: O radiant Mother robed in white — source of all sacred arts — I stand before You in prayer; grant me a blessing, O Divine Mother.

stanza.lyrics: veṇmayāna ammayē…
stanza.meaning: O resplendent Mother clothed in white —

stanza.lyrics: kalvi selvam kanindu aruḷvāy selviyē śivakāmi manōhari
stanza.meaning: O embodiment of abundance — Shivakami — beloved consort of Shiva, enchantress of the heart — bestow upon me the wealth of sacred knowledge.

stanza.lyrics: veṇmayāna ammayē…
stanza.meaning: O resplendent Mother clothed in white —

stanza.lyrics: vāṇi sarasvati vāymai aruḷvāy
stanza.meaning: O Vani — Sarasvati — one with braided hair ! Grant purity to my life and speech, so that I may worthily sing Your praise.

stanza.lyrics: vēṇi nindan pukazhinai pāḍiḍa
stanza.meaning: O Vani — Sarasvati — one with braided hair ! Grant purity to my life and speech, so that I may worthily sing Your praise.

stanza.lyrics: nāṇi annanaḍai niṙai vaḍivāypēṇi nin aḍiyār kuṙaikaḷe tīrppāy
stanza.meaning: O graceful One — whose gait is soft as a swan’s — O beloved Mother — remove the burdens and faults of all Your devotees.

stanza.lyrics: veṇmayāna ammayē kalādēvivēṇḍinēn ninniḍam varam aruḷvāyē
stanza.meaning: O radiant Mother robed in white — source of all sacred arts — I stand before You in prayer; grant me a blessing, O Divine Mother.

stanza.lyrics: veṇmayāna ammayē… ammayē…
stanza.meaning: O resplendent Mother clothed in white —

song.title: pakalōn pōy maṙaññu
song.source: Pakalon poy maranyu 2025 Mal in Eng v2.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Pakalon poy maranyu 2025 Mal in Eng v2.pptx

stanza.lyrics: pakalōn pōy maṙaññu – nabhassiliruḷin ala ñoṙiññu
stanza.meaning: The sun has set, and night is entering the sky.

stanza.lyrics: panimati-vadanande tirumukham kāṇātemizhiyiṇa kūmbi ninnu – rādha tanhṛdayavum vembi ninnu
stanza.meaning: Radha stands with downcast eyes, unable to behold the radiant, moon-like face of her Lord. She stands with a grieving heart.

stanza.lyrics: vidhiyō karmamō viparītamāyviḷayāḍunn-alivezhāte
stanza.meaning: Is it fate, or the fruit of my own deeds, that now turns against me?

stanza.lyrics: vijanatayil nīṙi nīṙi en hṛdayamōvirahattin van citayāyikanal tiṅgum van citayāyi
stanza.meaning: In this desolate land, my heart—unable to bear the torment of separation—has become a vast pyre, glowing with the burning embers of loss.

stanza.lyrics: kara-kaviññ-ozhukum nin smaraṇayil ulayunnahṛdayam nī aṙiyillayō
stanza.meaning: Do you not see this heart, tossed in the overflowing memories of you?

stanza.lyrics: niravadya nirmala nīrajanayanā ninpriyasakhi kāttu nilppū – īvirahiṇi ōrttu nilppū
stanza.meaning: O flawless one, pure, lotus-eyed Krishna, your beloved Radha waits for you—lost in your memories, grieving in her separation from you.

stanza.lyrics: arutē amāntam enn-arikatt-aṇaññīḍānarutē upēkṣa tellum
stanza.meaning: Delay no longer-come to me now. Do not neglect me any longer.

stanza.lyrics: arutē ī rādhaykku tāṅguvān kazhivillīazhalinde nōvu tellum – ninnilaliyātta nōvu tellum
stanza.meaning: Radha has no strength left to endure this sorrow, this heavy pain that refuses to melt.

song.title: pālmaṇam māṙātta paital allē ammē
song.source: Pal manam maratta paitalalle 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Pal manam maratta paitalalle 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: pālmaṇam māṙātta paital allē ammēpēlava kaikaḷāl onn-eḍukkū
stanza.meaning: O Mother, am I not but a small infant? Will you not gather me into your soft arms,

stanza.lyrics: jñānappāl ūṭṭi nī pālikkaṇē cemmē - jñānattāl uttama putran ākkū
stanza.meaning: feed me the milk of wisdom, and protect me? Grant me knowledge and make me your worthy son.

stanza.lyrics: entin-ennō vyatha ētin-ennō ivanjīvitam entenn-aṙiññiḍāte
stanza.meaning: O auspicious Mother, not knowing why I am grieving, not knowing the purpose of this life,

stanza.lyrics: manam enna tōṇi tuzhaññiḍunnu śivēmāyā kaḍalilēkk-āññiḍunnu
stanza.meaning: I am rowing the boat of my mind towards the ocean of Maya.

stanza.lyrics: māyā kinākkaḷil āzhnniḍunn-en - ī mānasa-poykayil nī varillē
stanza.meaning: Will you not come to the pond of my mind that is sinking in the dream of maya?

stanza.lyrics: mānava janmam kṛtārttham ākkuvān ammēmāṙōḍu cērttaṅg-aṇaykkukillē
stanza.meaning: O Mother will you not draw me close to your heart and make this human birth worthwhile?

song.title: pañca-bhūtamum paramasivam
song.source: Pancha bhutamum paramasivam 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: pañca-bhūtamum paramasivamneñjil perukum anbē sivam
stanza.meaning: The five elements—earth, water, fire, air and ether—express the boundless and absolute spiritual essence of Lord Shiva.

stanza.lyrics: aruvil ēkan uruvil anēkananaittilum iruppadu sadāsivan
stanza.meaning: Shiva is the love that awakens within our hearts. He is one in essence and yet many in form, pervading the whole universe.

stanza.lyrics: analāy oḷirum aruṇaiyin īsāahattai aṙuppāy amarēsā
stanza.meaning: O Lord of Arunachala, You blaze as the radiant fire element. O Lord of immortality, cut away our ego.

stanza.lyrics: visumpāy tillaiyil naṭarājāvinaikaḷai tīrppāy visvēsā
stanza.meaning: O Cosmic Dancer of Chidambaram, you pervade space as ether. O Universal Lord, dissolve the bonds of our karma.

stanza.lyrics: ōm namaḥ śivāy (4)
stanza.meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva, the auspicious one!

stanza.lyrics: kāṫṫrāy vīsum kāḷattiyappākaṇṇimai pōlē kāttiḍappā
stanza.meaning: O Lord of Kalahasti, who blows like the gentle breeze, shelter us as the eyelid protects the eye.

stanza.lyrics: maṇṇuruvāna ēkāmbaranēviṇṇavar pōṫṫrum sarvēśanē
stanza.meaning: O Lord of Kanchipuram, you are the very embodiment of the Earth. O Lord of all, divine beings worship you.

stanza.lyrics: ōm namaḥ śivāy (4)
stanza.meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva, the auspicious one!

stanza.lyrics: nīrāy pozhiyum appuliṅgamēninaippōr manadil aruḷ tarumē
stanza.meaning: O Lord of Tiruvanaikkaval, you flow as the sacred waters. Your grace flows into the hearts of those who remember you.

stanza.lyrics: anbē sivamē karuṇai oḷiyēaḍaikkalam undan tiruvaḍiyē
stanza.meaning: You are divine love and the radiant light of compassion. We take refuge in the cool shade of your sacred feet.

stanza.lyrics: ōm namaḥ śivāy (4)
stanza.meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva, the auspicious one!

song.title: paramēśa gōpāla jaya hārati
song.source: Paramesa Gopala 2025 Telugu in English.pptx

stanza.lyrics: paramēśa gōpāla jaya hāratijaya hārati nitya hārati
stanza.meaning: Victory to the Supreme Gopala! We offer this arati of victory, this eternal arati of praise to Gopala, the Lord.

stanza.lyrics: paramēśa gōpāla jaya hārati, jaya hārati…
stanza.meaning: Victory to the Supreme Gopala! We offer this arati of victory, this eternal arati of praise to Gopala, the Lord.

stanza.lyrics: mallēlū mōllalū sirī virajājūlūkōllālūgā tēccē gōpāla kṛṣṇunakku
stanza.meaning: O Gopala Krishna, we have brought for you garlands of jasmine and fragrant offerings.

stanza.lyrics: sēva tatparatayanu sūvāsana nimpū
stanza.meaning: O child Gopala, fill us with the sweet fragrance of eagerness for your service.

stanza.lyrics: īvēḷa ninu vēḍi kōriyūmṭimi
stanza.meaning: We pray to You

stanza.lyrics: daya rādā… mā mīda… gōpāla bāla
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, will you not shower your compassion upon us?

stanza.lyrics: paramēśa gōpāla jaya hārati – jaya hārati
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, will you not shower your compassion upon us?

stanza.lyrics: jala kṛīṭā lāḍiṙī gōpāla kṛṣṇadēhacitananē jayimpa cēsitivi
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, Gopala, you encouraged the gopis to overcome their identification with the body as they bathed.

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇa nī smaraṇalō mēmū mēnē maricāmū
stanza.meaning: In remembrance of you, O Krishna, we forget ourselves completely.

stanza.lyrics: gōpāla bāla gōpika lōlā
stanza.meaning: O Little Krishna, darling of Gopis

stanza.lyrics: daya rādā… mā mīda… gōpāla bāla
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, will you not shower your compassion upon us?

stanza.lyrics: paramēśa gōpāla jaya hārati – jaya hārati
stanza.meaning: Supreme Gopala, victory arati to you, eternal arati to you!

stanza.lyrics: daya rādā mā mīda gōpāla bālajaya hārati nitya hārati
stanza.meaning: Shower your mercy upon us, O child Gopala. Victory arati, eternal arati to you!

stanza.lyrics: paramēśa gōpāla jaya hāratijaya hārati nitya hārati
stanza.meaning: Supreme Gopala, victory arati to you, eternal arati to you!

song.title: pāriḍam eṅgum pāvanam ākki
song.source: Paridam engum pavanamakki 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: pāriḍam eṅgum pāvanam ākki pāritil ozhukunnupatita manassine bhāgīrathiyāyi pavitram ākkunnu
stanza.meaning: Mother flows through this world, purifying all with her presence—cleansing fallen hearts like the sacred Ganga.

stanza.lyrics: āśrayam-aṫṫavan āśādīpam pakarnnu nalkunnuāśvāsattinu aruḷ mozhiyāle āśiss-aruḷunnu
stanza.meaning: She offers the lamp of hope to the hopeless and forsaken, blessing them, consoling them through the wisdom of her words.

stanza.lyrics: āśāpāśa keṭṭu kuruṅgiya ātura mānasarilamṛtattvattin arumakaḷ ennōraṙivatu pakarunnu
stanza.meaning: To minds distressed and bound by the ropes of endless desire, she reveal the truth: they are your beloved children of immortality.

stanza.lyrics: amma ānandattin uḍamakaḷ ennōruṇarvatu nalkunnu
stanza.meaning: Mother awakens us to the knowledge that we are the source of boundless bliss.

stanza.lyrics: kālam kāttoru nidhi āṇamma karuṇa kaḍal āṇammakāmana viṭṭoru pāvana hṛttinu kāval viḷakk-āṇamma
stanza.meaning: She is a treasure guarded by time, an ocean of boundless compassion— a lighthouse for hearts made pure, freed from all desire.

stanza.lyrics: tūkaṇam ennum tava kāruṇyam lōbham ezhātivarilmāmaka janani aḍi paṇiyunnu atināyi tava makkāḷ
stanza.meaning: Never withhold your grace; always shower us with your compassion. For this, O my Mother, your children seek refuge in you.

song.title: pariśuddha anbin uruvamē
song.source: Parisuddha anbin 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: pariśuddha anbin uruvamē rādhika unprēma-bhaktiyil aṇaittum maṙantān mādhavan
stanza.meaning: O Radhika, you are the very embodiment of pure love. In your prema-bhakti, Madhava forgot everything else.

stanza.lyrics: gōpiyarē nīṅkaḷ tūya anpōḍu kūṙuṅkaḷ
stanza.meaning: O Gopis, sing with pure love!

stanza.lyrics: rādhā rādhā rādhā mādhavā harē harērādhā rādhā rādhā ramaṇa mādhavā harē
vṛndāvanattile ovvoru maṇtukazhunpariśuddha-prēmattin pukazhai pāḍum
stanza.meaning: In Vrindavan every grain of sand sings the praises of Radha’s sacred love.

stanza.lyrics: ennilum untan tūya anpinai tantu nīgōpēśvaranil layikka aruḷvāy dēvī
stanza.meaning: O Radha Devi, grant me that pure love and bless me with union with Gopeshvaran (the Shivalinga in a temple in Vrindavan)

stanza.lyrics: rādhā rādhā rādhā mādhavā harē harērādhā rādhā rādhā ramaṇa mādhavā harē
nī kēṭṭat-ellām avanin tiru nāmamēkaṇpārttat-ellām avanin sundara-rūpamē
stanza.meaning: O Radha, to you, every sound is his sacred name, and every sight his enchanting form.

stanza.lyrics: malaraḍi nān paṇintēn kanivōḍu nānumannilayai aḍaya aruḷvāy dēvi
stanza.meaning: I bow at your feet—please bless me, that I too may attain that supreme state.

stanza.lyrics: rādhā rādhā rādhā mādhavā harē harērādhā rādhā rādhā ramaṇa mādhavā harē
rādhā mādhavā harērādhā mādhavā harē

song.title: pāyo jī mainē
song.source: Payo ji maine 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: pāyo jī mainē rām ratan dhan pāyō
stanza.meaning: I have found it, truly I have found it — the jewel of Rama's name

stanza.lyrics: vastu amōlik dī mērē satgurukirpā kar apanāyo
stanza.meaning: the jewel of Rama's name, the treasure beyond compare. My Satguru, in his compassion, has given me this priceless gift and accepted me as his own.

stanza.lyrics: janam janam kī pūñjī pāī
stanza.meaning: This is the wealth gathered over countless lifetimes;

stanza.lyrics: jag meiṅ sabī khōvāyō
stanza.meaning: while all else in the world has been lost, this alone have I gained.

stanza.lyrics: kharac nāhi khūṭē cōr nāhi lūṭē
stanza.meaning: It can neither be spent nor stolen, nor can any falsehood diminish it

stanza.lyrics: din din baḍhat savāyo
stanza.meaning: — it grows ever richer, day by day.

stanza.lyrics: sat kī nāv khēvaṭiyā satgurubhavasāgar tar āyō
stanza.meaning: The boat of truth is steered by the true Guru; with it, I have crossed the ocean of worldly existence.

stanza.lyrics: mīrā kē prabhu giridhar nāgarharakh harakh jas gāyō
stanza.meaning: Mira’s Lord is Giridhar, the uplifter of Govardhan — in boundless joy, she sings his praise.

song.title: pazhani malayil vāṇaruḷum
song.source: Pazhani malayil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: pazhani malayil vāṇaruḷumdaṇḍāyudha pāṇiye ni vā vā/
stanza.meaning: Come, O Muruga, bearer of the spear, you who dwell in grace on the hill of Pazhani.

stanza.lyrics: ēzhakaḷe kāttiḍuvān vēlavane vā vāvaḍi vēlavane vā vā
stanza.meaning: Come, Lord Velavan, come to protect the downtrodden!

stanza.lyrics: villin ñāṇolikaḷ ulakam āke muzhaṅgunnughōra sarppaṅgaḷ phaṇam uyartti nilkkunnu
stanza.meaning: The fearsome twang of the bow resounds throughout the world, fierce serpents raise their hoods and stand in awe.

stanza.lyrics: vēṅkamaramāyavane vā vāēzhakaḷe kāttiḍuvān vēleḍuttu vā vāvaḍi vēlavane vā vā
stanza.meaning: Come, O Lord of the sacred Vijaysara tree, come wielding the spear, come to protect the downtrodden!

stanza.lyrics: pālkkāvaḍikaḷ pūṅkāvaḍikaḷ āḍunnu - hara hara putranu hara harō hara
stanza.meaning: The festive Kavadis of milk and flowers are dancing on our shoulders. Victory to the son of Shiva, Haro Hara!

stanza.lyrics: vēṅkamaramāyavane vā vāēzhakaḷe kāttiḍuvān vēleḍuttu vā vāvaḍi vēlavane vā vā
stanza.meaning: Come, O Lord of the sacred Vijaysara tree, come wielding the spear, come to protect the downtrodden!

song.source: Peace to the ocean 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Peace to the ocean 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx

song.title: picca veccu naḍakkunnōn-ende
song.source: Piccha vecchu nadakkunnon 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: picca veccu naḍakkunnōn-endekoccu kayyil piḍicceṅkil
stanza.meaning: Mother, if you hold the tiny hands of this child, who takes unsteady, baby steps,

stanza.lyrics: ambikē dēvi ninde mārgattilambōḍe gamiccīḍām ñān
stanza.meaning: Devi, O Ambika, with great joy, I will walk upon your path.

stanza.meaning: Mother, if you hold the tiny hands of this child, who takes unsteady, baby steps,

stanza.lyrics: ambikē dēvi ninde mārgattilambōḍe gamiccīḍām ñān
stanza.meaning: Devi, O Ambika, with great joy, I will walk upon your path.

stanza.lyrics: ‘ñān mumbē alla ñān mumbē’ ennabhāvattil tiramālakaḷ
stanza.meaning: Like the waves of the ocean rushing in, each crying, “me first, me first,”

stanza.lyrics: ārttirambi varunnatu pōlemōha-sāgaram uḷkkāmbil
stanza.meaning: there is an ocean of desire in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: picca veccu naḍakkunnōn-endekoccu kayyil piḍicceṅkil
stanza.meaning: Mother, if you hold the tiny hands of this child, who takes unsteady, baby steps,

stanza.lyrics: ambikē dēvi ninde mārgattilambōḍe gamiccīḍām ñān
stanza.meaning: Devi, O Ambika, with great joy, I will walk upon your path.

stanza.lyrics: valiya-lōkattil ‘valiya’ bhāvattilceṙiyavan-āyi tīrumbōḷ
stanza.meaning: In this vast world, when I think, “I am great,” truly, I become mean and small.

stanza.lyrics: valutilum pinne ceṙutilum vāzhum‘valutine’ ennu kāṇum ñān?
stanza.meaning: When will I behold the real Great One who dwells in both the great and the small?

stanza.lyrics: picca veccu naḍakkunnōn-endekoccu kayyil piḍicceṅkil
stanza.meaning: Mother, if you hold the tiny hands of this child, who takes unsteady, baby steps,

stanza.lyrics: ambikē dēvi ninde mārgattilambōḍe gamiccīḍām ñān
stanza.meaning: Devi, O Ambika, with great joy, I will walk upon your path.

stanza.lyrics: śrita-mandāramē śruti-vihāramēsakalārāddhya sudhāmamē
stanza.meaning: You are my cherished, pure white mandara flower. You are the abode of the Vedas, the source of nectar, worshipped all over the world.

stanza.lyrics: janimṛti ākum durita-sāgaramkayaṙuvān kaniyēṇamē
stanza.meaning: Through your grace, may I cross this ocean of sorrow the endless cycle of birth and death.

stanza.lyrics: picca veccu naḍakkunnōn-endekoccu kayyil piḍicceṅkil
stanza.meaning: Mother, if you hold the tiny hands of this child, who takes unsteady, baby steps,

stanza.lyrics: ambikē dēvi ninde mārgattilambōḍe gamiccīḍām ñān
stanza.meaning: Devi, O Ambika, with great joy, I will walk upon your path.

song.title: Pīlippu cūṭiya
song.source: Pilippu chutiya tamara 2021 mal in eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: pīlippu cūṭiya tāmara-kaṇṇanekāṇuvān entoru bhaṅgi
stanza.meaning: Krishna wearing the peacock feather on his hair is so very beautiful to behold!

stanza.lyrics: ārāṇavan sarva-kāraṇan-āṇennat-aṙiyāte ārānum-uṇḍō
stanza.meaning: Who is He? Is there anyone who doesn’t know that He is the origin of all?

stanza.lyrics: pīlippu cūṭiya tāmara-kaṇṇanekāṇuvān entoru bhaṅgi
stanza.meaning: Krishna wearing the peacock feather on his hair is so very beautiful to behold!

stanza.lyrics: pūvāyapūv-onnum pōrā neṙukayilcūṭuvān pīlippu vēṇam
stanza.meaning: All the flowers in this world are not enough to decorate Your hair- a peacock feather is needed.

stanza.lyrics: cēlottorā mukha kāntikk-itu pōlecērunna pū vēṙeyuṇḍō?
stanza.meaning: Nothing suits the beauty of Your radiant face better than a peacock feather!

stanza.lyrics: itu pōle cērunna pū vēṙe uṇḍō?itupōle cērunna pū vēṙe uṇḍō?
stanza.meaning: Nothing suits the beauty of Your radiant face better than a peacock feather!

stanza.lyrics: pīlippu cūṭiya tāmara-kaṇṇanekāṇuvān entoru bhaṅgi
stanza.meaning: Krishna wearing the peacock feather on his hair is so very beautiful to behold!

stanza.lyrics: kāla-varṣam vannu mānam kaṙukkumbōḷkēkikaḷ nṛttam āḍīḍumbōḷ
stanza.meaning: When the monsoon comes and the sky darkens, the peacocks dance and their feathers fall.

stanza.lyrics: tāne kozhiyunna pīlikaḷ koṇḍorupīli-kirīṭam orukkām
stanza.meaning: I shall make a crown for You from those peacock feathers. O Krishna! I shall make a peacock feather crown for You!

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇanu pīli-kirīṭam orukkām kaṇṇanu pīli-kirīṭam orukkām
stanza.meaning: I shall make a crown for You from those peacock feathers. O Krishna! I shall make a peacock feather crown for You!

stanza.lyrics: pīlippu cūṭiya tāmara-kaṇṇanekāṇuvān entoru bhaṅgi
stanza.meaning: Krishna wearing the peacock feather on his hair is so very beautiful to behold!

song.title: pīlippu cūḍiya tāmara-kaṇṇane
song.source: Pilipu chudiya 2025 Mal in English.pptx

stanza.lyrics: pīlippu cūḍiya tāmara-kaṇṇanekāṇuvān entoru bhaṅgi
stanza.meaning: How lovely it is to behold lotus-eyed Krishna, adorned with peacock feathers in his hair.

stanza.lyrics: ārāṇavan sarva-kāraṇan-āṇennat-aṙiyāte ārānum uṇḍō
stanza.meaning: Is there anyone who does not know that He is the very source of all creation?

stanza.lyrics: pūvāya-pūvonnum pōrā neṙukayilcūḍūvān pīlippu vēṇam
stanza.meaning: He is not content with ordinary blossoms—only a peacock feather will do for his hair.

stanza.lyrics: cēlottorā mukha kāntikkitu pōlecērunna pūvēṙe uṇḍō?
stanza.meaning: What flower could ever rival the beauty of his face?

stanza.lyrics: itu pōle cērunna pūvēṙe uṇḍō?
stanza.meaning: Is there any bloom more fitting than that?

stanza.lyrics: kāla-varṣam vannu mānam kaṙukkumbōḷkēkikaḷ nṛttam āḍīḍumbōḷ
stanza.meaning: When the monsoon arrives and the skies grow dark, as peacocks begin their joyous dance,

stanza.lyrics: tāne kozhiyunna pīlikaḷ koṇḍorupīli-kirīḍam orukkām
stanza.meaning: their feathers will fall to the earth—and I shall weave a crown of peacock plumes for Krishna.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇanu pīli-kirīḍam orukkām
stanza.meaning: and I shall weave a crown of peacock plumes for Krishna.

song.title: piḷḷaiyārin peyarai
song.source: Pillaiyarin 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: piḷḷaiyārin peyarai colla tollai tolaintiṭum - vaḷḷalām avar aruḷāl vinaigaḷ vilagiḍum
stanza.meaning: Chanting the name of Ganapati will alleviate all our troubles. Through the grace of the compassionate Lord, our karmas will be dissolved.

stanza.lyrics: peṭrōrai ulagam ena suṭri vanda piḷḷaiyē - jñāna-pazham peṭravanē jñālam kākkum gaṇapatiyē
stanza.meaning: O Lord Vinayaka, you circumambulated your parents, seeing them as your entire world, and were granted the fruit of Knowledge. You are the guardian of the world.

stanza.lyrics: dantam koṇḍu vyāsarukku ezhuti tanda vaḷḷalēbandam nīkki kāttiḍuvāy ēka danta nāthanē
stanza.meaning: When Veda Vyasa dictated the Mahabharata, in your compassion you broke off one tusk to write with. O Lord with the single tusk, please protect us and free us from our bondages.

stanza.lyrics: gaṇapati ayyā pōṭriyē… maṅgaḷa vaḍivē pōṭriyē…gaṇaṅgaḷin nāthā pōṭriyē...
stanza.meaning: Victory to Ganapati, the Lord of all, the embodiment of ultimate purity, the Lord of divine beings,

stanza.lyrics: siddhi vināyagā pōṭriyē...maṅgaḷa vaḍivē, maṅgaḷa vaḍivē… maṅgaḷa vaḍivē pōṭriyē…
stanza.meaning: and the bestower of success and accomplishments. O auspicious one, victory to you!

stanza.lyrics: mūvinai tīrpavanē, nān maṙaiyin poruḷē aindu karāttōnē, ārumukha sōdaranē
stanza.meaning: O Lord Ganapati, you eradicate the three kinds of karmas and embody the essence of the four Vedas. You are the Lord with five hands and the brother of the six-faced Lord Muruga.

stanza.lyrics: āṇavam aṙuttiḍum un pāśāṅkuśa āyudhamānandam tandiḍum untanatu mōdakam
stanza.meaning: The noose and goad you hold vanquish our ego, and the modaka sweet you offer brings us joy.

stanza.lyrics: gaṇapati ayyā pōṭriyē… maṅgaḷa vaḍivē pōṭriyē…gaṇaṅgaḷin nāthā pōṭriyē...
stanza.meaning: Victory to Ganapati, the Lord of all, the embodiment of ultimate purity, the Lord of divine beings,

stanza.lyrics: siddhi vināyagā pōṭriyē...maṅgaḷa vaḍivē, maṅgaḷa vaḍivē… maṅgaḷa vaḍivē pōṭriyē…
stanza.meaning: and the bestower of success and accomplishments. O auspicious one, victory to you!

song.title: piṙavā varam tarum pēraṇaṅkē
song.source: Pirava varam 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: piṙavā varam tarum pēraṇaṅkēinta piṙaviyil tavaṙāmal
stanza.meaning: O great One who grants freedom from birth—in this very life, without wavering,

stanza.lyrics: pēraṙivāl unnil iraṇḍaṙakkalantuiṙavā varam vēṇḍum – umayēiṙavā varam vēṇḍum
stanza.meaning: may I gain supreme knowledge and merge into you. O Uma! I seek the boon of deathlessness, I seek the boon of deathlessness.

stanza.lyrics: vinaiyatan tākkattāl ulakiyal nañcatanaiaruntinēn amudāy aṙiyāmal
stanza.meaning: By the force of karma, in this worldly life, I unknowingly drank the deadly poison of materialism, thinking it was nectar.

stanza.lyrics: uṙavum selvamum balamenḍru iruntēnkaṙavā paśuvāy poruḷaḍru pōnēn
stanza.meaning: I took relationships and wealth to be my strength — yet, like a cow whose milk is never drawn, I wasted this life without true substance.

stanza.lyrics: aṙiyā kuzhantaipōl āsaikaḷ niṙaivēṙaālayam pala senḍru tozhutuninḍrēn
stanza.meaning: Like an ignorant child, to fulfill my desires I went to many temples and stood worshipping

stanza.lyrics: ātmā layam peṙum uṇmai ālayamnīyē ena un aruḷāl aṙintēn
stanza.meaning: but by your grace, I have understood that you alone are the true temple where the soul attains bliss.

song.title: ponniṉ kālvaḷakaḷaṇiññu
song.source: Ponnin kalvalakal aninyu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: ponniṉ kālvaḷakaḷaṇiññuampāṭi taṉ kaṇmaṇi ōṭipuṟake ōṭi ōṭi taḷarnnuamma yaśōdayumappōḷ
stanza.meaning: Wearing golden anklets, the darling of Ambadi (Krishna) ran. Mother Yashoda then became exhausted from running and running after him.

stanza.lyrics: tannārō tannārō takatannārō taka tannārōtannārō taka tannārō takatannārō taka tannārō
stanza.meaning: (This is a rhythmic folk refrain/beat without a specific literal meaning, used to maintain the tempo of the song.)

stanza.lyrics: uṇṇikkaṇṇā nī māmuṇṇāteiṅṅane ōṭi ōṭi naṭannāleṅṅane nī valutākum kaṇṇākaṇmaṇiyē en poṉmaṇiyē
stanza.meaning: "Little Krishna, if you keep running around like this without eating your food, how will you grow up, my dear? My darling, my golden one!"

stanza.lyrics: achante kaiyyilirikkumā chōṉṉachōṉṉu tuṭutta paḻam tarāteammēṭe uṇṇi māmuṇṇillauṇṇikkiṉṉiṉi onnuṃ vēṇṭa
stanza.meaning: "Unless you give me that red, plump fruit in Father’s hand, Mother’s little boy won't eat. Now, the little boy doesn't want anything else!"

stanza.lyrics: paḻamalla eṉṟe ponnuṇṇī atuchōṉṉa taram muḷakāṇennēkaḻichālō uṇṇī vāyeriññiṭumponnuṇṇikkaṇṇante vāy chuvaṉṉīṭum
stanza.meaning: "That is not a fruit, my golden child, it is a type of red chili! If you eat it, little one, your mouth will burn; little golden Krishna's mouth will turn bright red."

stanza.lyrics: amma iṉṉeṉṟe ponnuṇṇikkāypālaṭa piḻiñña chōṟu tarānnēuṇṇikkaṇṇane tañchattilaṅṅuvāriyeṭuttaṅṅaṇachchu yaśōda
stanza.meaning: "Today, Mother will give her golden boy rice mixed with sweet Palada (milk dessert)." With that, Yashoda gently picked up little Krishna and hugged him close.

stanza.lyrics: achaṉarike iruttiyiṭṭaṅṅuveṇṇayūṭṭāṉoruṅṅīṭavēchōṉṉa muḷakil onnaṅṅeṭuttuvāyilumiṭṭu nuṇaññū kaṇṇan
stanza.meaning: While he was seated next to his father and they were preparing to feed him butter, Krishna suddenly grabbed one of those red chilies and popped it into his mouth to taste it.

stanza.lyrics: onnu kaṭichēnayyō ammēvāviṭṭu karaññu viḷichchu kaṇṇanammaye nōkki vimmi vitumpikaṇṇīroḻukkikkaraññū kaṇṇan
stanza.meaning: He took one bite and cried out, "Oh Mother!" Krishna screamed and wept aloud. Looking at his mother, sobbing and gasping, Krishna cried with tears flowing down.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇane vāriyeṭuttiṭṭaṅṅutēnuṃ pāluṃ paḻavuṃ nalkineñchōṭu chērttupiṭichchaṅṅaṇachchuammēṭe kaṇṇuṃ niṟaññu kaviññu
stanza.meaning: Gathering Krishna into her arms, she gave him honey, milk, and fruit. As she held him tight against her chest, Mother's eyes also filled and overflowed with tears.

song.title: poṭṭi karaññu karaññu – manam
song.source: Potti karanyu karanyu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: poṭṭi karaññu karaññu – manampoṭṭi takarnnu viḷippū
stanza.meaning: Mother! I cry out loud, calling to you.

stanza.lyrics: taṭṭi takarnnorī jīvita-naukayeteṫṫennu tīram aṇaykkū
stanza.meaning: The boat of my life is caught in the whirlpools of this ocean of samsara. Do not delay—carry this boat, battered by the rocks of sorrow, to the shore of your peace.

stanza.lyrics: muṫṫi vaḷarunnu duḥkham – cuṫṫumceṫṫalla collān kaḍuppam
stanza.meaning: I cannot describe the pain that surrounds me.

stanza.lyrics: ceṫṫu kṛpa coriññ-attal-akaṫṫāykilvaṫṫi varaḷum en cittam
stanza.meaning: If you do not rain down your grace, Mother, my heart will wither into an arid desert.

stanza.lyrics: hṛttil nṛttam caviṭṭīḍān kaniññ-ettān arutē amāntam
stanza.meaning: Do not delay any longer—dance your blissful dance in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: kattunna neñcil nin mettum kṛpāvarṣamettunna nāḷ kāttirippū
stanza.meaning: Come, overflowing with grace, into this heart burning with grief. I count every moment, awaiting your arrival.

song.title: Pour illumine
song.source: Pour illuminer cette nuit 2025 French in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Pour illuminer cette nuit 2025 French in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: Pour illuminer cette nuitEt vivre tous en harmonie
stanza.meaning: To brighten this night and allow everyone to live in harmony,

stanza.lyrics: Regarde le ciel, et le soleil
stanza.meaning: look up at the sky and the sun,

stanza.lyrics: Ta planète et ses merveilles
stanza.meaning: and at your planet with all its wonders.

stanza.lyrics: ōm lōkāḥ samastāḥ sukhinō bhavantuōm lōkāḥ samastāḥ sukhinō bhavantu
stanza.meaning: May all beings in all worlds be happy.

stanza.lyrics: Comme la mère veille l'enfantLa Terre nous porte patiemment
stanza.meaning: Just as a mother watches over her child, the Earth bears us patiently.

stanza.lyrics: Suivant ses pas, donne en retour
stanza.meaning: Follow her example by giving back in return,

stanza.lyrics: Et dans la joie, repands l'amour
stanza.meaning: and in that spirit of joy, spread love.

stanza.lyrics: ōm lōkāḥ samastāḥ sukhinō bhavantuōm lōkāḥ samastāḥ sukhinō bhavantu
stanza.meaning: May all beings in all worlds be happy

song.title: prābhavam sarva-vyāptam
song.source: Prabhavam sarva vyaptam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: prābhavam sarva-vyāptam-itaṙiyāte - prabhavamām tava cārē aṇayān piḍaññu
stanza.meaning: Not knowing your omnipresent nature, I yearned to draw near to you, the source of all.

stanza.lyrics: pralīnam ākāte ī kaṇṇunīr tē padē - prayāṇam ī jīvītam patham itil poliyumō
stanza.meaning: Will my life be extinguished on this path before my tears can merge with your sacred feet?

stanza.lyrics: pramādam hṛdi gati-bhramśam varuttunnupracaṇḍamāy vāsanāvātaṅgaḷ vīśave
stanza.meaning: The deluded mind makes me lose my way as the winds of old tendencies fiercely blow.

stanza.lyrics: pratīkṣa tan nilaviḷakk-aṇayātirikkuvānprāvīṇyam tāvakam onnu tān āśrayam
stanza.meaning: Let not the lamp of my hope go out; my only hope is your flawless skill.

stanza.lyrics: prasuptamāy antarātmani mēvunna - prabhāvatī ammē nī ennil uṇarnniḍū
stanza.meaning: My inner self lies fast asleep, O, Effulgent Mother, awaken in me,

stanza.lyrics: prabuddham ākki jñāna-dugdhattāl en prajñapracōdanam ēkū ī panthāvil munnēṙān
stanza.meaning: let my intellect blossom with the milk of knowledge, and inspire me to walk forward on this path.

stanza.lyrics: pratītam ākum dṛśya-prapañca-vilāsaṅgaḷprabhāvitam āyiḍum cidānanda-bōdhattāl
stanza.meaning: The sights of this observed universe will disappear in the dawn of blissful consciousness;

stanza.lyrics: pradōṣam aṇayunnatin pūrvam jīvanilprōjjvalippicciḍū jñānāgni cinmayi
stanza.meaning: before I enter life’s evening shade, O Pure Awareness, light the dazzling fire of knowledge in me.

song.title: prabhu caraṇan
song.source: Prabhu charanan 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: prabhu caraṇanu meiṅ prīt lagā lēprabhu pyārē kō mīt banā lē
stanza.meaning: Develop love for the feet of the Lord, and make the beloved Lord your closest friend.

stanza.lyrics: vōhī sabkē snēhī trātāvō pāvan bhāvōṅ kē dātā
stanza.meaning: He alone is the compassionate savior of all, the giver of pure feelings.

stanza.lyrics: kāl bhī jiskō bāndh na pāyēus nirguṇ kō mīt banā lē
stanza.meaning: Even time itself cannot bind him. Make that formless One your true friend.

stanza.lyrics: prabhu caraṇanu meiṅ prīt lagā lēprabhu pyārē kō mīt banā lē
stanza.meaning: Develop love for the feet of the Lord, and make the beloved Lord your closest friend.

stanza.lyrics: jag kē karm tō duḥkh hī dētēsab kō tyāg kē āvō
stanza.meaning: The actions of the world bring only sorrow, so let them all go and come to the Lord.

stanza.lyrics: prabhu hī sukh kā dhām hai bandēusmeiṅ hī bas jāvō
stanza.meaning: The Lord alone is the abode of happiness—dwell in Him.

stanza.lyrics: jag meiṅ rahtē bhī mērē mitvājag kō svarg banā lē
stanza.meaning: Even while living in this world, my friend, you can make the world itself a heaven.

stanza.lyrics: prabhu caraṇanu meiṅ prīt lagā lēprabhu pyārē kō mīt banā lē
stanza.meaning: Develop love for the feet of the Lord, and make the beloved Lord your closest friend.

stanza.lyrics: prīt usī kī sāñcī jisnēsab sansār racāyā
stanza.meaning: True love belongs only to Him who created the whole universe.

stanza.lyrics: māyā sē sab rūpōṅ kō dharjan-jan kō bilgāyā
stanza.meaning: Through Maya He has taken on all forms and manifested countless beings.

stanza.lyrics: aisē māyā-pati kō bandēapnē man meiṅ basā lē
stanza.meaning: O seeker, establish that Lord of Maya within your heart.

stanza.lyrics: prabhu caraṇanu meiṅ prīt lagā lēprabhu pyārē kō mīt banā lē
stanza.meaning: Develop love for the feet of the Lord, and make the beloved Lord your closest friend.

stanza.lyrics: rāmakṛṣṇa… hari hari rāmakṛṣṇa… hari harirāmakṛṣṇa… hari hari – hari hari bōl
stanza.meaning: O Lord Rama, O Lord Krishna!

song.title: praṇavākṣarāmṛta
song.source: Pranavaksharamrita 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: praṇavākṣarāmṛta pāna-kutūhalapriyaśiva prītida nartana-rasikē
stanza.meaning: Mother! Beloved of Shiva, who rejoices in the bliss of the immortal nectar of the Pranava mantra—you, who are in love with dance

stanza.lyrics: priyajana suta dhana yuvatī saukhyamprēmamayi tava māyā-kalpitam
stanza.meaning: —it is through your divine illusion that dear ones, children, wealth, youth, and health come into our lives.

stanza.lyrics: yauvana-prauḍha vimōhita-citramkautuka vanmada krōdha-vilāsam
stanza.meaning: The bloated ego, the delusions of youth, the plays of anger, jealousy, pride, and envy

stanza.lyrics: kanmaṣa-hāriṇi ninpada-cintayiljanma-jarā-maraṇādi vināśam
stanza.meaning: —all these vanish when the mind becomes absorbed in contemplation of your lotus feet. Then, one becomes free of all sin and the endless cycle of birth and death.

stanza.lyrics: vanbhava-sāgara-tīram aṇayuvāntvanmaya-bhāvam anāratam ēkū
stanza.meaning: O Mother, grant me the constant awareness that “I am you,” so that I may cross this vast ocean of samsara.

stanza.lyrics: en manapañjara ramya-svarūpiṇīcinmaya dvaita-vināśi cirantani
stanza.meaning: O beautiful Mother, dwelling within my heart! You are the pure consciousness that pervades the universe, ever new—you are the one who destroys the illusion of duality.

song.title: prāṇēśvarā en hṛdayēśvarāvanamāli kaṇṇā varumō
song.source: Pranesvara en hridayesvara 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: viraha tīyil urukunn-ennilkṛpa māri coriyān varumō?
stanza.meaning: I burn in the heat of unbearable longing — will you not shower your grace upon me?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā gōpī manōhara rādha tan mānasa cōrā…
stanza.meaning: Krishna, the beautiful cowherd — the one who stole Radha’s heart...

stanza.lyrics: rāppakal ninne kāttirunnen manamoru nerippōḍāyi māṙi
stanza.meaning: My mind, waiting for you day and night, burns like a furnace.

stanza.lyrics: mizhinīru vaṫṫiya iru mizhikaḷum innupaḍutiri kattukayāyi
stanza.meaning: My eyes, emptied of tears, are like wicks slowly burning away.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā gōpī manōhara rādha tan mānasa cōrā…
stanza.meaning: Krishna, the beautiful cowherd — the one who stole Radha’s heart...

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā nin kayyile muraḷika ākuvānēṙe koticcat-āṇī rādhā
stanza.meaning: Krishna, this Radha longed to be the flute in your hands

stanza.lyrics: pavizhādharattile muraḷiyil ozhukunnaoru prēma-rāgam āṇī rādhā
stanza.meaning: — the melody of love flowing from the flute you press to your lips.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā gōpī manōhara rādha tan mānasa cōrā…
stanza.meaning: Krishna, the beautiful cowherd — the one who stole Radha’s heart...

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇane kāttu kārvarṇṇane ōrttu ñānkaṇṇīr ozhukkaṭṭe ennum ennum
stanza.meaning: Let me weep forever, remembering the Dark One.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇande dāsiyām rādhaykku maṫṫorukarmavum dharmavum illa tellum
stanza.meaning: Radha is your servant — she has no duty but to shed tears for you.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇā gōpī manōhara rādha tan mānasa cōrā…
stanza.meaning: Krishna, the beautiful cowherd — the one who stole Radha’s heart...

song.title: prēma-sāgaramē! jagadīśvarī ammē
song.source: Prema Sagarame 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: prēma-sāgaramē! jagadīśvarī ammēkāruṇya-dhāmamē hṛdayēśvarī ammē
stanza.meaning: Mother! Goddess who reigns over this universe, you are an ocean of love. You are the abode of compassion- you dwell within our hearts.

stanza.lyrics: udayārkka-kiraṇaṅgaḷ tazhukiḍumbōḷprēyasiyām vārijam viḍarunnapōl
stanza.meaning: When the sun’s rays caress their beloved lotuses, they bloom.

stanza.lyrics: ammē nin karuṇayāl en hṛdaya-padmamviḍarnnuvallō!
stanza.meaning: Mother, the lotus of my heart blossomed in the warmth of your compassion.

stanza.lyrics: prēma-sāgaramē! jagadīśvarī ammēkāruṇya-dhāmamē hṛdayēśvarī ammē
stanza.meaning: Mother! Goddess who reigns over this universe, you are an ocean of love. You are the abode of compassion- you dwell within our hearts.

stanza.lyrics: jīvita-vīthiyil kāl iḍaṙiḍumbōḷtāṅgāy nī vannu ende kai piḍiccu
stanza.meaning: When my steps faltered on the path of life, you came as my support and held my hand.

stanza.lyrics: jīvande jīvanil nī prabha-tūki ninnuvallō!
stanza.meaning: You became the radiant light that illumined my inner being.

stanza.lyrics: prēma-sāgaramē! jagadīśvarī ammēkāruṇya-dhāmamē hṛdayēśvarī ammē
stanza.meaning: Mother! Goddess who reigns over this universe, you are an ocean of love. You are the abode of compassion- you dwell within our hearts.

stanza.lyrics: kālam ende mānasattil kōṙiyiṭṭumāyātta vēdanakaḷ ennum ennum
stanza.meaning: Time had left many unhealed wounds in my heart,

stanza.lyrics: nin divya-snēham ennum mānasattil maññu peytu!
stanza.meaning: but your divine love, pure as fresh snow has soothed them all away.

stanza.lyrics: prēma-sāgaramē! jagadīśvarī ammēkāruṇya-dhāmamē hṛdayēśvarī ammē
stanza.meaning: Mother! Goddess who reigns over this universe, you are an ocean of love. You are the abode of compassion- you dwell within our hearts.

song.title: prēmāmṛtattinde nanav-ūṙum mizhiyiṇa
song.source: Premamritattinde 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: prēmāmṛtattinde nanav-ūṙum mizhiyiṇaini ennu kaṇḍīḍum ñān? ammē…/
stanza.meaning: When will I see those eyes brimming with divine love?

stanza.lyrics: akatārin-uṇarv-ēkum madhu-mozhimuttukaḷini ennu kēṭṭīḍum ñān?ammē ini ennu kēṭṭīḍum ñān?
stanza.meaning: When will I hear those sweet words that rejuvenate the soul? O Mother, when will I hear those words?

stanza.lyrics: praṇamicciḍunnu ñān ammē nin kazhaliṇatuṇa enikkēkukillē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, I bow down at your sacred feet, will you not give me your support?

stanza.lyrics: onnu kaniññ-enne karaḷil nī karutukilkanal ennil aṇayukillē? duḥkhatīkanal ennil aṇayukillē?
stanza.meaning: Will you not compassionately keep me within your heart and extinguish the fire of sorrow within me?

stanza.lyrics: kāruṇya-dhāmamē nin kazhal viṭṭorujīvitam ēkiḍollē
stanza.meaning: O abode of compassion, never let me live a life away from your sacred feet.

stanza.lyrics: paramārtha bōdham uṇarttuma tṛppādavismṛti ēkiḍollē ammēdurmati ēkiḍollē
stanza.meaning: Let me never forget those divine feet that bestow true knowledge. May I never be overcome by arrogance.

stanza.lyrics: khēdikkill-ini mēlil jananī nī ennuḍecāratt-aṇaññīḍukil
stanza.meaning: I will not grieve anymore, O Mother, if only you stand beside me.

stanza.lyrics: alayil peṭṭila pōle duḥkhattil ulayāte - kazhal tīratt-aṇaññiḍum ñān - ammē nin kazhaliṇa cērnnīḍum ñān
stanza.meaning: No longer will I be swept away like a leaf in sorrow’s tide. I will reach the shore, the sanctuary of your divine feet, and there I will merge into you.

song.title: priyataram rādhē nin azhakārnna mizhikaḷil
song.source: Priyataram radhe 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: priyataram rādhē nin azhakārnna mizhikaḷilteḷiyunnor-anurāga-dīptaraśmi
stanza.meaning: O Radha! The radiance of love that shines from your eyes is sweeter than nectar.

stanza.lyrics: kanavilāy kaṇṇanu naivēdyam ēkuvānpakarumō nin snēha-dugdha-sāram
stanza.meaning: In our meditation, will you grant us that nectarine milk of love, that we may offer it as abhisheka to Krishna?

stanza.lyrics: teḷinīr-ozhukunna kāḷindiyāṙilealakaḷil alayunna pūvitaḷ nī
stanza.meaning: You are like a tender flower petal, drifting gently upon the clear waters of the Kalindi.

stanza.lyrics: oru mṛdu-cumbanam uṇarunna kaḷavēṇulahariyil aliyunna rāgamō nī
stanza.meaning: Are you not the melody of bliss itself, flowing from the flute blessed by Krishna’s kiss?

stanza.lyrics: lahariyil aliyunna rāgamō nī
stanza.meaning: Are you not the melody of bliss itself, flowing from the flute blessed by Krishna’s kiss?

stanza.lyrics: cāre aṇayunna kāṙōḷi-varṇandeakatāril pūkkum vasanta-sūnam
stanza.meaning: You are the blossom that unfolds in Krishna’s heart when he draws near to you.

stanza.lyrics: vaḍivotta virimāṙil cērunna vanamālaitaḷilō nin prēmarāgatalpam
stanza.meaning: Do you not dwell within the wildflower garland the handsome Lord wears?

stanza.lyrics: itaḷilō nin prēmarāgatalpam
stanza.meaning: Do you not dwell within the wildflower garland the handsome Lord wears?

stanza.lyrics: nīla-nilāvinde sukham ārnna kaikaḷiloru maññu tēnkaṇam cērnnat-entē
stanza.meaning: The fresh, sweet dewdrops dissolving in the silvery-blue moonlight

stanza.lyrics: mādhava-hṛdayattilāy manam cērkkunnarādha tan prēma-prasādam āṇō
stanza.meaning: —are they not your offerings of love to Madhava, in whom your heart is united?

stanza.lyrics: rādha tan prēma-prasādam āṇō
stanza.meaning: —are they not your offerings of love to Madhava, in whom your heart is united?

stanza.lyrics: īṙakkuzhalile pālkkaḍal-vīciyilnīrāḍum ētō marāḷa-yugmam
stanza.meaning: Like the royal swan couple that bathes in the song-waves of the milky ocean flowing from Krishna’s flute,

stanza.lyrics: rādhē nī kaṇṇande rāga-vipañciyilśruti cērum ētō vasantamāyi
stanza.meaning: O Radha! You have become the melody of spring flowing from the flute of Lord Krishna’s heart!

stanza.lyrics: śruti cērum ētō vasantamāyi
stanza.meaning: O Radha! You have become the melody of spring flowing from the flute of Lord Krishna’s heart!

song.title: pūvāli paśuvuṇḍu
song.source: Puvali pasuvundu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: rādhē gōvinda hari rādhēśyāmhari rādhē gōvinda hari rādhē śyām
stanza.meaning: Govinda, the dark one, the beloved of Radha—Hari, Govinda, Radha’s Krishna!

stanza.lyrics: pūvāli paśuvuṇḍu pūvākamaram uṇḍupūnuḷḷān pōrunnō uṇṇikaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: There is a cow with a lovely tail, and a flame tree bursting into bloom. Little Krishna, will you come and pluck flowers with me?

stanza.lyrics: pūvāka kombile pūkkaḷ niṙaññoruponnuññāl-āḍān vā uṇṇikkaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: Will you come and play with me on a swing tied to the flowering branch of the flame tree?

stanza.lyrics: rādhē gōvinda hari rādhēśyāmhari rādhē gōvinda hari rādhē śyām
stanza.meaning: Govinda, the dark one, the beloved of Radha—Hari, Govinda, Radha’s Krishna!

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvanattile sakhimāre kāṇānāyiveṇṇakkaḷḷā varū uṇṇikkaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: Little Krishna, O butter thief, come visit the gopikas of Vrindavan.

stanza.lyrics: koti ūṙum ninnuḍe kuzhal-nādam kēḷkkānāyigōpi-gōpanmār kātōrkkayāy
stanza.meaning: The gopis and gopas long to hear your flute—they listen to its sweet melodies, and their yearning deepens.

stanza.lyrics: rādhē gōvinda hari rādhēśyāmhari rādhē gōvinda hari rādhē śyām
stanza.meaning: Govinda, the dark one, the beloved of Radha—Hari, Govinda, Radha’s Krishna!

stanza.lyrics: kāḷindi tīrattil kaḷiyāḍān ōḍi vākārmēgha niṙamuḷḷa uṇṇikkaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: Come running to play on the banks of the Kalindi, O Little Krishna, dark as a rain-filled cloud.

stanza.lyrics: kaḷakūjanam ceyyum kiḷikaḷe kāṭṭīḍāmmuḷam taṇḍil tīrttoru muraḷi nalkām
stanza.meaning: I will show you the birds that sing sweet songs, I will give you a flute carved from a bamboo reed.

stanza.lyrics: rādhē gōvinda hari rādhēśyāmhari rādhē gōvinda hari rādhē śyām
stanza.meaning: Govinda, the dark one, the beloved of Radha—Hari, Govinda, Radha’s Krishna!

song.title: rādhā-mādhava rādhē-śyām
song.source: Radha Madhava Radhe Shyam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Radha Madhava Radhe Shyam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: rādhā-mādhava rādhē-śyām rādhā-jīvana rādhē-śyāmhē giridhārī rādhē-śyām hē vanamālī rādhē-śyām
stanza.meaning: Shyam, the beloved of Radha, her very life, He who lifted the Govardhana mountain, who wears garlands of forest flowers.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇande priyasakhi rādhēkaṇṇande sarvasvam allē nī?
stanza.meaning: Radha! You are dearest to Krishna, Aren’t you his everything?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇane tanne ninaccu ninaccuā nīlavarṇṇam kavarnnatallē?
stanza.meaning: Constantly immersed in his memories, Your body has stolen his blue hue and made it your own.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇan varum sakhī en manam ōtunnurādha illātavan vāzhum ennō?
stanza.meaning: Krishna will come, my dear friend—my heart tells me so. How can he live without his Radha?

stanza.lyrics: vanamāla tannavan muraḷiyum tannavanvarum enn-uraceytu pōyatallō
stanza.meaning: He gave you his garland of wildflowers, he gave you his beloved flute. And when he left, he said he would surely return.

stanza.lyrics: vanavallikk-iḍayilāy pīli-nētraṅgaḷ kaṇḍō?kāṫṫinum kaṇṇande sugandham illē?
stanza.meaning: Do you see his lotus eyes, dark-fringed with long lashes, amidst the forest creepers? Doesn’t the breeze carry the fragrance of Krishna?

stanza.lyrics: pullāṅkuzhal-nādam kēḷkkunnuvō sakhīkālccilambocca iṅgaḍuttu vannō?
stanza.meaning: My friend, don’t you hear the melody rising from his flute? Isn’t the sound of his anklets drawing nearer and nearer?

stanza.lyrics: ōrkkumbōḷ taḷarunnu kaṇṇan vannīḍumbōḷentāmō ende avastha sakhī
stanza.meaning: When I see him after all these years, O friend, what will become of me? Will my feet falter?

stanza.lyrics: pādam iḍaṙumō dēham taḷarumōprāṇa-sañcāram nilaccu pōkumō?
stanza.meaning: Will my body lose all strength to move? Will my breath cease the very moment I behold him?

song.title: rādhā ramaṇā gōpi-gōpālā
song.source: Radha Ramana Gopi Gopala 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Radha Ramana Gopi Gopala 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: rādhā ramaṇā gōpi-gōpālāgōkula-nandana kṛṣṇā harē
stanza.meaning: Radha’s Lord, the beloved cowherd of the gopikas, son of Nanda of Gokula—O Krishna, I take refuge in you!

stanza.lyrics: neṫṫiyil cēlezhum gōpimaṇ poṭṭumkanaka-kaṅkaṇam tōḷ vaḷayum
stanza.meaning: With a tilak of gopichandan gracing his brow, golden bangles and armlets adorning his limbs,

stanza.lyrics: piccaka-pūmāla cārtti mṛduveṇṇilā-puñciri tūki
stanza.meaning: and a garland of fragrant jasmine resting on his chest, he smiles as radiantly as silvery moonlight.

stanza.lyrics: pēlava kaiyil pullāṅkuzhal ēntikārmukil varṇṇan vannuvallō
stanza.meaning: A flute rests gently in his tender fingers— the dark-hued one has come…

stanza.lyrics: ende kārmukil varṇṇan vannuvallō
stanza.meaning: yes, my dark-hued one has come!

stanza.lyrics: mauliyil mayilppili tiruki paricōḍaṅgu cērttu keṭṭi
stanza.meaning: A peacock feather crowns the curls upon his head,

stanza.lyrics: pūṅkaviḷine umma vaccīḍunnamakara-kuṇḍalam kātil aṇiññu
stanza.meaning: while dangling fish-shaped earrings kiss his soft cheeks.

stanza.lyrics: ciluciluṅgane kiluṅgi āḍumkāñcana-cilamb-aṇiññu koṇḍu
stanza.meaning: Golden anklets tinkle sweetly with each graceful step.

stanza.lyrics: ōḍakkuzhal ūti kōḍakkārvarṇṇangōpikāmāruḍe cāratt-etti
stanza.meaning: Playing his flute, the dark-hued one comes to stand beside the gopikas.

stanza.lyrics: vēṇu-gānāravam kēṭṭu vrajattilgōpikāmār-aṅgu mattarāyi
stanza.meaning: Hearing the melodies of his flute, the gopikas of Vraja were swept into ecstasy.

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvana-sthitan nandasūnu tandecāratt-aṇaññ-aṅgu mōhitarāy
stanza.meaning: The son of Nanda, the dweller of Vrindavan, came among them, and their hearts were enraptured by him.

stanza.lyrics: prēmānubhūtiyil kaṇṇanōḍ-ottavarānanda-rāsa naḍanam āḍi
stanza.meaning: In the bliss of divine love, they danced the joyous rasa with Krishna,

stanza.lyrics: ā rāsakēḷiyil brahmāṇḍam ākavēbhakti unmattarāy onnu cērnnu
stanza.meaning: and the entire cosmos, intoxicated by devotion, joined in that sacred dance of love.

stanza.lyrics: bhakti unmattarāy onnu cērnnu
stanza.meaning: intoxicated by devotion, joined in that sacred dance of love.

song.title: rādhākṛṣṇana anudina bhajisuta
song.source: Radhakrishna anudina 2025 Kannada in Eng v2.pptx

stanza.lyrics: rādhākṛṣṇana anudina bhajisuta rāga-dvēṣagaḷa kaḷeyōna
stanza.meaning: Let us worship Radha and Krishna daily, forsaking attachment and aversion.

stanza.lyrics: kāma-krōdhagaḷa tyajisuta prēmadi sītāramana smarisōna
stanza.meaning: Let us remember Sita and Rama devoutly and discard desire and anger.

stanza.lyrics: mithyā-lōkada viṣaya sukhagaḷa mōhava dūragoḷisōna
stanza.meaning: Let us not become mesmerised by the flashy pleasures of the illusory world.

stanza.lyrics: nitya satya sukha nīlōtpalasthita nīrajākṣana bhajisoṇa
stanza.meaning: Let us glorify the lotus-eyed Lord, who resides in the lotus and who is eternal, true and blissful.

stanza.lyrics: rādhākṛṣṇana anudina bhajisuta rāga-dvēṣagaḷa kaḷeyōna
stanza.meaning: Let us worship Radha and Krishna daily, forsaking attachment and aversion.

stanza.lyrics: kāma-krōdhagaḷa tyajisuta prēmadi sītāramana smarisōna
stanza.meaning: Let us remember Sita and Rama devoutly and discard desire and anger.

stanza.lyrics: dhana dhānya aiśvarya sampattu kēvala kṣaṇikavu ariyōṇa
stanza.meaning: Let us understand that wealth, belongings and property are fleeting.

stanza.lyrics: dāna dharma nija puṇya kāryagaḷa cācūtappade gaiyyōṇa
stanza.meaning: Let us immerse ourselves steadfastly in charity, righteousness and virtuous deeds.

stanza.lyrics: rādhākṛṣṇana anudina bhajisuta rāga-dvēṣagaḷa kaḷeyōna
stanza.meaning: Let us worship Radha and Krishna daily, forsaking attachment and aversion.

stanza.lyrics: kāma-krōdhagaḷa tyajisuta prēmadi sītāramana smarisōna
stanza.meaning: Let us remember Sita and Rama devoutly and discard desire and anger.

stanza.lyrics: samāja sēvē parōpakāra kāyakagaḷa nau mādōṇa
stanza.meaning: Let us engage ourselves in social service and altruistic deeds.

stanza.lyrics: muktikāraka rādhākṛṣṇana jānaki rāmana bhajisōṇa
stanza.meaning: Revering the liberator Radha-Krishna, let us chant the name Janaki-Rama.

stanza.lyrics: rādhākṛṣṇana anudina bhajisuta rāga-dvēṣagaḷa kaḷeyōna
stanza.meaning: Let us worship Radha and Krishna daily, forsaking attachment and aversion.

stanza.lyrics: kāma-krōdhagaḷa tyajisuta prēmadi sītāramana smarisōna
stanza.meaning: Let us remember Sita and Rama devoutly and discard desire and anger.

stanza.lyrics: sītā-rāma jānakī-rāma vaidēhī-rāma jai jai jai
stanza.meaning: Hail to Sita-Rama, Janaki-Rama, Vaidehi-Rāma!

stanza.lyrics: rādhā-kṛṣṇa rukmiṇi-kṛṣṇa ramā mādhava jai jai jai
stanza.meaning: Victory to Radha-Krishna, Rukmini-Krishna, Rama-Madhava!

song.title: rādhaye aṙiyillayō kaṇṇā
song.source: Radhaye ariyillayo 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: rādhaye aṙiyillayō kaṇṇāvṛndāvanam nī maṙannō?
stanza.meaning: Krishna, do you not remember Radha? Have you forgotten Vrindavan?

stanza.lyrics: pavitra-mānasā, parama-kṛpālōmama hṛdayēśvarā paṙayū nī
stanza.meaning: O pure-hearted one, supremely compassionate, Lord of my heart, tell me…

stanza.lyrics: rādhaye aṙiyillayō kaṇṇāvṛndāvanam nī maṙannō?
stanza.meaning: Krishna, do you not remember Radha? Have you forgotten Vrindavan?

stanza.lyrics: śrīrāgam pāḍi yamuna pinneyumprēma-kallōlam tīrkkunnu
stanza.meaning: The Yamuna still sings in the melody of Sri Raga, her waves rising with the rhythm of love.

stanza.lyrics: pontaḷa cūḍumō tṛppāda-pallavanarttana-sāyūjyam ōrkkunnu tēṅgunnu
stanza.meaning: She weeps in longing, recalling your dance, your tender lotus feet wearing golden anklets.

stanza.lyrics: prēmārdra mānasā pōrukillē?bhaktajana-priya pōrukillē?
stanza.meaning: O Krishna! Your heart is tender with love for us, won’t you come? You who cherish your devotees with boundless love, won’t you come?

stanza.lyrics: rādhaye aṙiyillayō kaṇṇāvṛndāvanam nī maṙannō?
stanza.meaning: Krishna, do you not remember Radha? Have you forgotten Vrindavan?

stanza.lyrics: manvantaraṅgaḷāy ninne tapam ceyyumoru kṛṣṇa-tuḷasī-daḷam ivaḷ
stanza.meaning: I am but a small Tulasi leaf, meditating on your form through endless ages.

stanza.lyrics: innum ī sandhyayil ī pātavakkilnin pada-nisvanam kātōrttirikkunnu
stanza.meaning: And now, in this dusk, I wait by the path, longing to hear the music of your nearing steps.

stanza.lyrics: prēmārdra-mānasā pōrukillē?bhaktajana-priyā pōrukillē?
stanza.meaning: O Krishna! Your heart is tender with love for us, won’t you come? You who cherish your devotees with boundless love, won’t you come?

stanza.lyrics: rādhē gōvinda hari rādhēśyāmhari rādhē gōvinda hari rādhē śyām
stanza.meaning: Govinda, the dark one, the beloved of Radha—Hari, Govinda, Radha’s Krishna!

stanza.lyrics: kāḷindi tīrattil kaḷiyāḍān ōḍi vākārmēgha niṙamuḷḷa uṇṇikkaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: Come running to play on the banks of the Kalindi, O Little Krishna, dark as a rain-filled cloud.

stanza.lyrics: kaḷakūjanam ceyyum kiḷikaḷe kāṭṭīḍāmmuḷam taṇḍil tīrttoru muraḷi nalkām
stanza.meaning: I will show you the birds that sing sweet songs, I will give you a flute carved from a bamboo reed.

stanza.lyrics: rādhē gōvinda hari rādhēśyāmhari rādhē gōvinda hari rādhē śyām
stanza.meaning: Govinda, the dark one, the beloved of Radha—Hari, Govinda, Radha’s Krishna!

song.title: rādhē rādhē rādhē rādhē kṛṣṇa
song.source: Radhe Radhe Radhe 2025 Samskritam in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: rādhē rādhē rādhē rādhē kṛṣṇa rādhē rādhē rādhē rādhē kṛṣṇa
gōvinda kṛṣṇa gōpāla kṛṣṇa rādhē kṛṣṇaśrīdhara kṛṣṇa kēśava kṛṣṇa rādhē kṛṣṇa
rādha ramana rādhē kṛṣṇa vanamāli kṛṣṇa rādhē kṛṣṇa
gōvardhana giridhāri kṛṣṇa navanita cōra rādhē kṛṣṇa

song.title: rādhikē… kaṇ tuṙakkū
song.source: Radhike Kan turakku 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: rādhikē… kaṇ tuṙakkūkaṇṇanitā vannu munnil nilppū
stanza.meaning: O lovely Radhika, open your eyes—your Krishna stands before you,

stanza.lyrics: neñcakam pūkkunna puñciri pūṇḍu ninañjana-kaṇṇan muraḷiyum ūti
stanza.meaning: the dark-eyed one, playing his flute, with a smile that blossoms your heart with joy.

stanza.lyrics: kaḷavēṇu-nādam nī kēḷppatillē nindemanamayil pīli viḍarttiyillē?
stanza.meaning: Do you not hear the enchanting notes of his flute? Does not the peacock of your mind spread its iridescent feathers,

stanza.lyrics: naḍavaranōḍottu nṛttam āḍān nindepadamalar tellum tuḍippatillē?
stanza.meaning: dancing to that divine melody? Do your tender feet not yearn to dance with him—he who is the very source of the divine dance?

stanza.lyrics: mizhi tuṙakkāte irippat-entē nindevyathayāl maraviccirunnu pōyō?
stanza.meaning: Why do you not open your eyes, Radhe? Have they been numbed by sorrow?

stanza.lyrics: kadanattāl hṛdayam mūkam āyō? nindeprāṇa-sañcāram nilaccu pōyō?
stanza.meaning: Has your heart fallen silent beneath the weight of pain? Has the flow of your breath come to a standstill?

stanza.lyrics: pūmēni nīlimayārnnat-entē nī ninkaṇṇande nīla niṙam kavarnnō?
stanza.meaning: Why has your tender body turned this deep blue hue? Have you taken on Krishna’s very colour?

stanza.lyrics: nī ennilō atō ñān ninnilō? rādhēī mahābhāvattin arttham entu
stanza.meaning: Are you within me, or am I within you? O Radhe, what is this divine bhava you are revealing?

stanza.lyrics: pūvuḍal melle eḍuttu kaṇṇan tandepēlava-sundara pāṇikaḷāl
stanza.meaning: Slowly, Krishna gathered her delicate form into his arms.

stanza.lyrics: ‘rādhē’ ennārdramām mantraṇam kēṭṭavaḷrādhēśanil vīṇ-aliññu cērnnu
stanza.meaning: With boundless love, he softly whispered, 'Radhe...' And at the sound of his voice, she dissolved into him—into Radhesha, the Lord who belongs to Radha.

song.title: raṅg khēlō hamrē saṅg
song.source: Rang khelo 2025 HIndi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: raṅg khēlō hamrē saṅg, hamrē saṅg ō kānā āj
stanza.meaning: Play with colors with me, O Krishna, come play with me;

stanza.lyrics: apnē raṅg meiṅ hī raṅg dē ō kānāapnē raṅg meiṅ hī raṅg dē
stanza.meaning: immerse me only in your colors, O Krishna, immerse me only in your colors.

stanza.lyrics: lāl gulāl abīr yē raṅg sabhī, āj uḍē braj meiṅ
stanza.meaning: The red powder, the fragrant colors, and all the hues rise and fly in Vraj today.

stanza.lyrics: mānav kyā dēv bhī āyē haiṅ braj meiṅ līlā tērī dēkhnē
stanza.meaning: Not only humans but even the gods have come to Vraj to witness your divine play.

stanza.lyrics: khēlō mōhan phāg aisī… kī chūṭē kabhī na yē saṅg
stanza.meaning: Play, O Krishna, spring festival of colors in such a way that this companionship never breaks.

stanza.lyrics: prēm kē raṅg meiṅ aisā tū raṅg dē
stanza.meaning: Color me in such a shade of love that it may never fade,

stanza.lyrics: chūṭē kabhī na yē raṅg ō kānāchūṭe kabhī na yē raṅg
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, may this color never fade.

stanza.lyrics: gvāl-gōpin sab hārī ō kānā, bhar pichkārī tūne mārī
stanza.meaning: The cowherd boys and gopis all surrendered, O Kanha, when you struck with your full water-sprayer.

stanza.lyrics: ḍhūṅḍhūṅ tujhē par raṅgōṅ ki āndhī meiṅ dēkh na pāvūṅ tujhē
stanza.meaning: I search for you, but in the storm of colors I can no longer see you.

stanza.lyrics: khēlō mōhan phāg aisī… kī chūṭē kabhī na yē saṅg
stanza.meaning: Play, O Krishna, spring festival of colors in such a way that this companionship never breaks.

stanza.lyrics: prēm kē raṅg meiṅ aisā tū raṅg dē
stanza.meaning: Color me in such a shade of love that it may never fade,

stanza.lyrics: chūṭē kabhī na yē raṅg ō kānāchūṭe kabhī na yē raṅg
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, may this color never fade.

stanza.lyrics: prēm kē raṅg karuṇā kē raṅg bhartē rahō calō aṅg-saṅg
stanza.meaning: The colors of love, the colors of compassion—let them keep filling us as we walk together.

stanza.lyrics: jhūmō rē nācō rē, prēm sē gāvō rē āyō śrī raṅg gōvindātērē raṅg meiṅ raṅg gōvindā
stanza.meaning: Rejoice, dance, sing with love, for Shri Rang Govinda has arrived. In your colors, Govinda, we are dyed.

stanza.lyrics: āyō śrī raṅg gōvindātērē raṅg meiṅ raṅg gōvindā
stanza.meaning: Rejoice, dance, sing with love, for Shri Rang Govinda has arrived. In your colors, Govinda, we are dyed.

stanza.lyrics: kānā rē khēlō hamrē saṅgkānā rē raṅg dē tērā raṅg
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, come play with me. O Krishna, color me in your own hue.

song.title: saccidānanda-rūpiṇī
song.source: Sacchidananda rupini 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: saccidānanda-rūpiṇīśuddha-bōdha svarūpiṇī
stanza.meaning: Your form is truth, existence, and bliss—the very essence of pure awareness.

stanza.lyrics: enne entinu dūre nīkki nīmāya bādhiccu māzhkuvānōśivē… śivē…
stanza.meaning: O Shive, why do you keep me at a distance? Am I to live my life lost in the delusion of your illusion?

stanza.lyrics: dēham ennorī nīrkkumiḷayilmōham ārnnu maṙannu satyavum
stanza.meaning: I have grown attached to this body, as fragile and fleeting as a water bubble. I have forgotten the truth,

stanza.lyrics: dvēṣa-rāga-malīmasam manamdōṣamāṫṫi viśūddhi ēkūśivē… śivē…
stanza.meaning: and my mind is tainted by attachment and aversion. O Shive, cleanse my faults and purify my heart.

stanza.lyrics: āgamārkkande śōbha ēlkkilumāmayaṅgaḷ maṙaññiḍāykayāl
stanza.meaning: Though the radiant sun of the Vedas shines upon me, the maladies of my mind still cling to me.

stanza.lyrics: āśrayiccitu kāḷikē ahamāṫṫi nin padam ēṫṫumō… śivē… śivē…
stanza.meaning: I have sought refuge at the feet of Kalika. O Shive, will you not destroy my ego and lead me to merge at your lotus feet?

song.title: saccinmayā cidākāśa
song.source: Sacchinmaya Chidakasa Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: saccinmayā cidākāśa-sthitā nitya-sadāśivāvandē’ham sarva pāpaṅgaḷ tīrkkuka kṛpāmbudhē
stanza.meaning: O Eternal, ever auspicious Siva, who abides in the pure space of consciousness, truth and awareness, I bow down to you, O ocean of compassion

stanza.lyrics: sarvēśvara sadākālam kāttu koḷḷuka ñaṅgaḷesatyavum dharmavum nalla bōdhavum nalkaṇam vibhō
stanza.meaning: — cleanse us of all sins. O Lord of all, ever protect us always. Bestow upon us truth, righteousness, and noble understanding, O all-pervading, supreme one…

stanza.lyrics: ennum eṅgum viḷaṅgīḍum saccidānandā daivamēmaṇṇilum dyōvilum pinne ennilum ninnilum bhavān
stanza.meaning: O God of existence, consciousness, and bliss, whose eternal light shines everywhere, you are in the earth, in heaven, and beyond — within me and within yourself.

stanza.lyrics: ñaṅgaḷkku vēṇḍat-ellām tannu rakṣiccu nityavumdhanyar-ākkunna ninpādam tanne ñaṅgaḷkku daivatam
stanza.meaning: You grant us all that we need and ever protect us; your blessed feet, which fulfil our lives, are equal to God.

stanza.lyrics: jñānavum jayavum sākṣāl bhānuvum tārajālavumbhūtavum bhāviyum pinne vartamānavum okke nī
stanza.meaning: You are knowledge and victory, the radiant sun and the starry constellation. You are the past, the future, and the present.

stanza.lyrics: nīyallō dyōvum tējassum nīyallō daivamē niśayumnīyallō kaḍalum kāṫṫum nīyallō dhātriyāyatum
stanza.meaning: You are the sky and the life-giving light, O God, you are also the night. You are the sea, and the wind, and you also became the Earth…

stanza.lyrics: nī nityam jñānam ānandam nī tanne mōkṣa-rūpavumnī ninde mahimayāl tanne viḷaṅgīḍunnu jagat prabhō
stanza.meaning: you are eternity, knowledge and bliss, you are the very embodiment of liberation. O Lord of the Universe, you shine through your own greatness

stanza.lyrics: iravum pakalum sākṣāl mahimāvārnna ninpadam pukazhttunnu ñaṅgaḷ aṅgaye bhagavāne viḷaṅguka
stanza.meaning: Day and night alike sing praise to your glorious feet, and we, too, worship you, O Lord — shine forth within us!

stanza.lyrics: jayikkuka jagannātha bhaktavatsalā brahmamē jayikkukasaccidānandā karuṇā-sindhō jayikkuka
stanza.meaning: Victory be to you, O Lord of the Universe, O beloved of devotees, O Supreme Brahman, victory to you! Victory be to you, O Embodiment of existence, consciousness, and bliss, O ocean of compassion, victory to you!

stanza.lyrics: sīmayēṙum nin mahāsāgarē ñaṅgaḷ ākavēmuṅgaṇam poṅgaṇam pāpam pōkaṇam ēkaṇam sukham
stanza.meaning: O boundless ocean of greatness, when we reach you let our sins sink and vanish, and let bliss alone arise.

stanza.lyrics: daivamē hē dayāsindhō daivamē dīnarakṣakādaivamē ninde kāruṇyam dīrghakālam varēṇamē
stanza.meaning: O God, O ocean of mercy, O protector of the lowly, grant us your compassion for all time.

stanza.lyrics: sṛṣṭiccu ñaṅgaḷe pinne rakṣiccu vazhi pōle nīsṛṣṭāvē ninne ōrkkātta duṣṭarēyum kṛpākarālsiṣṭar-ākkēṇamē dēva viṣṭapēśa namōstutē
stanza.meaning: O Creator, you have created and then protected us as needed. By your grace, transform even the wicked who forget you into the righteous and the pure. O Lord of the worlds, to you our reverent salutations…

stanza.lyrics: anna-vastraṅgaḷum pinne maṇṇil vēṇḍa padārthavumonnum pizha kūḍāte tannīḍunnu vibhō bhavān
stanza.meaning: O Lord, the omniscient one, you bestow upon us unfailingly food, clothing, and all that is needed upon this earth.

stanza.lyrics: śrī buddhan bhagavān kristu aḷḷā śrī paramēśvaranśrīkṛṣṇan ennī pērōti ninne vāzhttunnu mānavar
stanza.meaning: Humanity praises you with many names as Buddha, as Bhagavan, as Christ, as Sri Parameswara, Sri Krishna—yet they all worship you alone.

stanza.lyrics: ellām daivam orāḷ ennāl ñaṅgaḷkkokke aṙiññiḍānaviḍutte kṛpā varṣam ñaṅgaḷil coriyēṇamē
stanza.meaning: Shower your grace upon us so that we may know that all is One, all is you alone.

stanza.lyrics: ñaṅgaḷe kāttukoḷḷēṇam kāruṇya-vāridhē bhavānnamaskāram dēvadēva namaskāram parātparā
stanza.meaning: Protect us, O Ocean of Compassion, O Lord divine. Salutations to you, O Lord of gods, salutations to you, O Supreme transcendent One;

stanza.lyrics: namaskāram cidānandā namaskāram jagatprabhōdīpasandhānā sandhānā saccidānandā nirmalā
stanza.meaning: salutations to you, O consciousness and bliss incarnate, salutations to you, O Lord of the Universe. O Light of lights, O Embodiment of existence, consciousness, and bliss, pure one

stanza.lyrics: nārāyaṇā yatīndrā tasmai namō namaḥ
stanza.meaning: … O Narayana, O Lord of ascetics, I bow again and again unto you…

song.title: Sādhō Sādhō
song.source: Sadho Sadho main bairagan 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Sadho Sadho main bairagan 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: Sādhō Sādhōmain bairāgan har kībhūṣan vastra sab hī hum tyāgōkhān pān biśara dō
stanza.meaning: Hear this, all. Listen. I am she who has renounced all …a Vagabond for my Lord Krishna. Ornaments, clothes. all have I given up. Forgotten are food and drink

stanza.lyrics: bhūṣan vastra sab hī hum tyāgō khān pān biśara dō Sādhō Sādhōmain bairāgan har kī
stanza.meaning: Ornaments, clothes. all have I given up. Forgotten are food and drink. Hear this, all. Listen. I am she who has renounced all …a vagabond for my Lord Krishna.

stanza.lyrics: yē vraj vāsī kehet bāvarimain dāsī giridhar kī
stanza.meaning: The people of Vraj say I am mad. I am just a slave of that Giridhar.

stanza.lyrics: uddhavji tum jāvō dwārakāvipat kahō gōpiyan kī
stanza.meaning: Uddhav ji, take this message to my Lord in Dwarka. Tell him of the agony of the gopikas (.. Meera is suffering the same agony)

stanza.lyrics: jaisē jal bin mīn taḍapesaugat bhay sakhiyan kī
stanza.meaning: Like the fish out of water that is gasping and writhing in pain, such is the frightful state of my friends

stanza.lyrics: pāt pāt vrindavan ḍhūṇḍiyōḍhūṇḍ phiri vraj har kī
stanza.meaning: In a frenzy am I searching every nook and corner of Vrindavan… Searching in fevered agony, this Vraj bhoomi of Krishna

stanza.lyrics: āp tō jāyē dwāraka chāyēpharimōti giridhar kī
stanza.meaning: You my Lord, simply went and glorified Dwaraka with Your presence Leaving me behind as a widow.

stanza.lyrics: mīrā kē prabhu giridhar nāgardāsi rādhā var kī
stanza.meaning: For, O Lord of Meera - - this Meera is nothing, but the slave of Radha’s Lord

song.title: sakhī rī lāj
song.source: Sakhi ri laj 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: sakhī rī lāj bairaṇ bhayiśrī lāl gōpāl kē saṅg
stanza.meaning: O friend, modesty has become my enemy; in the company of my beloved Gopal,

stanza.lyrics: kahē nā… hīgayisakhī rī lāj bairaṇ bhayi
stanza.meaning: I could no longer remain silent. O friend, modesty has become my enemy.

stanza.lyrics: calan cāhat gōkul hī tērath sajāyō nāhīṅ
stanza.meaning: He wished to depart for Gokul, but the chariot was not yet decorated.

stanza.lyrics: rath caḍhāyē gōpāl lai gayō hāth miñjat rahī
stanza.meaning: Yet Gopal mounted it and was carried away, while I was still just clutching his hand.

stanza.lyrics: sakhī rī lāj bairaṇ bhayi
stanza.meaning: O friend, modesty has become my enemy.

stanza.lyrics: kaṭhin chātī śyām bichuḍatbirah meiṅ tanatayi
stanza.meaning: With a heavy heart, Shyam departs, and in separation my body trembles.

stanza.lyrics: dāsi mīrā lāl giridharbikhar kyūṅ nā gayi
stanza.meaning: O Giridhar, my beloved, this servant Mira wonders how it is that I have not shattered apart.

stanza.lyrics: sakhī rī lāj bairaṇ bhayi
stanza.meaning: O friend, modesty has become my enemy.

song.title: samatvam, samatvamsamatvam, samatvam
song.source: Samatvam Samatvam 2025 - English.pptx

stanza.lyrics: the key to our mind’s freedomsamatvam, samatvam
the key to our mind’s freedomsamatvam, samatvam
life passes by in yearning
likes and dislikes churning
in desire’s fire we’re burning
samatvam, samatvam
samatvam, samatvamsamatvam, samatvam
the key to our mind’s freedomsamatvam, samatvam
the key to our mind’s freedomsamatvam, samatvam
in this world of duality
true yoga is equanimity
discover this and you are free
samatvam, samatvam
samatvam, samatvamsamatvam, samatvam
the key to our mind’s freedomsamatvam, samatvam
the key to our mind’s freedomsamatvam, samatvam
go beyond… samatvam, samatvam
our mind’s bonds… samatvam, samatvam
we lose and we gain… samatvam, samatvam
but it’s all the same… samatvam, samatvam
