song.title: śambhō śambhō śambhō(Telugu 2025)
song.source: Sambho Sambho Sambho anarada 2025 Tel in Eng v2.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Sambho Sambho Sambho anarada 2025 Tel in Eng v2.pptx

stanza.lyrics: śambhō śambhō śambhō śambhō anarādā manasāśambhu-bhajana rañjimpanu vākkunu jihvanu ivvarādā
stanza.meaning: O Mind, why don’t you call out “Shambho Shambho”? Why not offer your speech and tongue to revel in Shambho’s bhajans?

stanza.lyrics: aṅkili tericiyu hara hara ani nī jaṅku tīralēdāmaṅku budhulu māniyu paraśiva śaṅkara anarādā
stanza.meaning: Why does your hesitation to utter “Hara Hara” still remain? Why cling to your stubbornness instead of calling out “Parashiva, Shankara!”?

stanza.lyrics: enta kālamu cintincina nī kintē gati kādā - antalōnē nī jīvita kālamu antam ayipōdā
stanza.meaning: However long you brood, will your fate truly change? And in the meantime, might your life not slip away then and there?

stanza.lyrics: śambhō śambhō śambhō śambhō anarādā manasāśambhu-bhajana rañjimpanu vākkunu jihvanu ivvarādā
stanza.meaning: O Mind, why don’t you call out “Shambho Shambho”? Why not offer your speech and tongue to revel in Shambho’s bhajans?

stanza.lyrics: śiva śiva ani uccāraṇa ceyyagā jihvayāḍalēdā – manasāmanana cēsi manaḥsākṣi gā kaliya cūḍarādā
stanza.meaning: Is your tongue not capable of uttering the name of Shiva? Why don’t you let go of your excuses? Look around with a clear conscience.

stanza.lyrics: mōdambomduc kaivalyambunu munduga kānarādā – manāsākaliyacūsiyō mānasambunanu sannutincarādā
stanza.meaning: O Mind, why do you delay in recognizing the supreme wisdom with patience? Why not open your eyes and appreciate this truth within yourself?

stanza.lyrics: śambhō śambhō śambhō śambhō anarādā manasāśambhu-bhajana rañjimpanu vākkunu jihvanu ivvarādā
stanza.meaning: O Mind, why don’t you call out “Shambho Shambho”? Why not offer your speech and tongue to revel in Shambho’s bhajans?

stanza.lyrics: śivaśiva śaṅkara haraśiva śaṅkara śivuni talacarādāannapūrṇanu kaṇṇa talligā manana ceyyarādā
stanza.meaning: Why don’t you see Shiva as Shiva Shankara, Hara Shankara? Why not regard Annapurna as your very own mother?

song.title: samsāra-tāpattil uzhaṙumī jīvanil
song.source: Samsara tapattil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: samsāra-tāpattil uzhaṙumī jīvanilkāruṇya-gaṅgā-pravāhamāy nī
stanza.meaning: Mother! Like the sacred Ganga, you became a torrential flow of compassion for this Jiva, wandering amidst the sorrows of the world.

stanza.lyrics: oru cuvaḍu vaykkuvān āññorī kuññinevātsalyamoḍ-aṅgu uyartti amma
stanza.meaning: When this child tried to take a single step toward you, you tenderly lifted me into your arms.

stanza.lyrics: anbōḍ-arikil aṇacc-ennakatārilāyiram muttaṅgaḷ ēki ammā…
stanza.meaning: You held me close and showered me with a thousand loving kisses.

stanza.lyrics: vazhi teṫṫi alayāt-iḍavarāt-eppōzhumkanivōḍe meyyōḍu cērtt-aṇaccū
stanza.meaning: So I may not stray from the path, Mother clasped me to her bosom.

stanza.lyrics: kanivōḍe meyyōḍu cērtt-aṇaccū
stanza.meaning: Mother clasped me to her bosom.

stanza.lyrics: vivēka-prasūna-saurabhyam pakarnn-enniluttama-cintakaḷ ēki ammā…
stanza.meaning: She offered me the fragrant flowers of wisdom, and noble thoughts arose within me.

stanza.lyrics: ennennum kaipiḍicc-enne nayicc-ammaātmāvabōdhattilēykk-uṇarānātmāvabōdhattilēykk-uṇarān
stanza.meaning: Holding my hand, Mother gently leads me to realize my blissful true self.

song.title: saṅkaṭa-haraṇa siddhi-vināyaka
song.source: Sankata harana Siddhi Vinayaka 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Sankata harana Siddhi Vinayaka 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: saṅkaṭa-haraṇa siddhi-vināyakagaṇapati vinati sunō
stanza.meaning: O remover of troubles, giver of success, Ganapati, please hear our prayer

stanza.lyrics: śaṅkara-nandana vighna-vināśakakaṣṭ kō dūr karō
stanza.meaning: Son of Shankara, destroyer of obstacles, take away our suffering.

stanza.lyrics: jay jay gaṇēś jay jay gaṇēśjay jay gaṇēś bōlō
stanza.meaning: Victory to Ganesha, victory to Ganesha—say it aloud.

stanza.lyrics: jay jay gaṇēś jay jay gaṇēśjay jay gaṇēś gāvō
stanza.meaning: Victory to Ganesha, victory to Ganesha—sing it with joy.

stanza.lyrics: ēkadanta tum jñāna-pradāyakasadbuddhi ham kō dījō prabhō
stanza.meaning: You have a single tusk, and bestow knowledge. Grant us right understanding

stanza.lyrics: mūṣika-vāhana mōdaka-hastadṛḍha-viśvās samarpaṇ dē dō
stanza.meaning: O Lord. You who ride the mouse and hold sweet modakas—give us firm faith and surrender.

stanza.lyrics: pāśāṅkuśa-dhara praṇava-svarūpaprēma-bhakti ham kō dījō
stanza.meaning: You hold the noose and goad, and are the embodiment of Om—grant us love and devotion.

stanza.lyrics: pārvati-priyasuta ṣaṇmukha-sōdaraparamajñāna ham kō dījiyē
stanza.meaning: Beloved son of Parvati, brother of Shanmukha—grant us supreme wisdom.

stanza.lyrics: niścal man dēkar gaṇanāyaka hṛdaya mandir meiṅ vās karō
stanza.meaning: O Lord of the Ganas, grant us a steady mind and dwell in the temple of our hearts.

stanza.lyrics: tērē śaraṇ meiṅ āyē haiṅ prabhuśubha-maṅgal ham kō dē dō
stanza.meaning: We have come to your refuge, Lord—give us blessings and auspiciousness.

song.title: sāṅvarā rē mhāri
song.source: Sanvara re mhari 2025 Marwari in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: sāṅvarā rē mhāri prīt nibhājyō jīmhāri prīt nibhājyō jī…mhāri prīt nibhājyō jī
stanza.meaning: O Dark One, uphold my love, uphold my love.

stanza.lyrics: thē chō mhārō ō… guṇ rō sāgaravaguṇ mhā bisrājō jī…
stanza.meaning: You are my ocean of virtues, please forget my faults.

stanza.lyrics: sāṅvarā rē mhāri prīt nibhājyō jīmhāri prīt nibh nibhājyō jī
stanza.meaning: O Dark Beloved, stay true to my love, stay true to my love.

stanza.lyrics: lōk na sijaya manana patījamukhaḍā sabad suṇājō jī
stanza.meaning: Let me not be swayed by the world’s opinions or promises—let me only hear the words from your lips.

stanza.lyrics: dāsi thāri janama janama rimhārē āṅgan ājō jī
stanza.meaning: I am your servant for birth after birth—please come into my courtyard today.

stanza.lyrics: mīra rē prabhu giridhar nāgarbēḍa pār lagājō jī
stanza.meaning: O Lord Giridhar, Beloved of Meera, carry my boat across to the other shore.

song.title: śaravaṇabhava śaravaṇabhava śaravaṇabhava
song.source: Saravanabhava Saravanabhava 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: śaravaṇabhava śaravaṇabhava śaravaṇabhava ṣaṇmukhāāṇḍavanē aṙumukhanē vaḷḷi maṇavāḷanē
stanza.meaning: O Lord Saravana, Shanmugha—the six-faced one, beloved husband of Valli...

stanza.lyrics: śaṅkarikkum śivanumāy oru kuññu vēlavanuṇḍēkuññu vēlavan kuññu vēlum koṇḍōḍi naḍakkaṇa nēram
stanza.meaning: Shiva and Parvati had a child, Vela—Lord Subramania—running about with his little spear,

stanza.lyrics: ēṭṭanāya gaṇapatiyumāy matsarikkaṇa nēramkuññumayil ēṙi vēlavan ulaku cuṫṫaṇa kaṇḍō
stanza.meaning: competing with his elder brother, Ganapathi. Did you see him soar on his youthful peacock, racing off to circle the world?

stanza.lyrics: matsarattil tōṫṫu pōyi piṇaṅgi pōkaṇa vēlanpaḷaniyil pōy maunam ārnnu kuḍiyirikkaṇa nēram
stanza.meaning: He lost the competition and went off in a sulk, climbing the Palani hills, where he remained in silence.

stanza.lyrics: ammayum punar-acchanum ōti tiriye varika uṇṇīini orikkalum tirike varikayilla ennu vēlan
stanza.meaning: His mother, and then his father, called out, “Come back, my son!” But Velan replied, “I will never, ever return.”

stanza.lyrics: vēlavande vākku kēṭṭu paśupatiyum umayum anugrahiccu vēlavane paḷani āṇḍavan ākki
stanza.meaning: Hearing his words, Uma and Pashupathi blessed him and made him lord of the Palani mountain.

stanza.lyrics: dēva-sainyādhipanāy śakti vaṭivēlanvaḷḷi maṇavāḷanāy śakti kārttikēyan
stanza.meaning: The mighty Velan became the commander of the gods and the husband of Valli. He is known as Karthikeya, the most powerful.

stanza.lyrics: dēvayāniye variccu śaṅkara-tanayantārakane nigrahiccu śakti vaṭivēlan
stanza.meaning: The son of Shiva married Devayani. The mighty Vela slew the asura Taraka.

stanza.lyrics: bhaktajana-rakṣakanāy sundara-vaṭivēlanpālkkāvaḍi bhasmakkāvaḍi nērcca nērnnu bhaktar
stanza.meaning: The beautiful Velan became the protector of his devotees, who surrender their burdens at his feet, offering Kavadis of milk and sacred ash.

song.title: sarvajñayām parāśakti (Malayalam)
song.source: Sarvajnayam Parashakti 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: sarvajñayām parāśakti nin paitalinusarvavum ajñātam avyaktam
stanza.meaning: O supreme power, the all-knowing Mother, everything remains unknown and unrevealed to this child.

stanza.lyrics: sṛṣṭiyum sraṣṭāvum raṇḍalla eṅkil īsṛṣṭi-vaicitryam itentu nyāyam…
stanza.meaning: If the creator and creation are not two, then how can this remarkable difference be justified?

stanza.lyrics: mātē nin putriyām māmaka samskārammakṣikā-tulyamō atyadbhutam
stanza.meaning: O my Mother, is it not strange that my nature is like that of a fly, my senses wandering indiscriminately,

stanza.lyrics: makṣikayil madhu-makṣikayōmakarandam darśippū malaratilum
stanza.meaning: while the honeybee, though among the flies, sips only nectar from every flower it visits?

stanza.lyrics: jay jay bhavāni… jay jay śivāni…jay bandha-mōcini… kātyāyani…
stanza.meaning: Victory to Bhavani, victory to Shivani! Victory to Katyayani, the Mother who frees us from all attachments.

stanza.lyrics: jay jay layaṅkarī… jay jay priyaṅkarī…jay mitra-rūpiṇī… māhēśvarī
stanza.meaning: Victory to the beloved One, in whom all beings dissolve. Victory to the supreme Goddess, who has taken the form of a friend.

stanza.lyrics: muttukaḷ āyiram mālyam onnil kāṇmūkōrtt-iṇakkum tantu kāṇmat-uṇḍō
stanza.meaning: A thousand beads may be seen strung in a long chain, yet the thread that holds them together remains unseen.

stanza.lyrics: nānātva-rūpa prapañcam-itinuḷḷilēkatva-darśanam ētuvidham
stanza.meaning: Likewise, how can one perceive the oneness in this world of diverse names and forms?

song.title: satyam jñānam anantam
song.source: Satyam Jnanam anantam 2025 Samskritam in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: satyam jñānam anantamśivatatva viśēṣam
stanza.meaning: Truth, knowledge, infinity—the unique essence of Shiva, the highest reality.

stanza.lyrics: sṛṣṭi-sthiti-laya spandamśivatāṇḍava naṭanam
stanza.meaning: The pulse of creation, sustenance, and dissolution, the dance of the cosmic Tandava.

stanza.lyrics: anupama-sundara rūpamśruti-laya-tāḷa nikētam
stanza.meaning: Of incomparable, beautiful form, the abode of rhythm, melody, and beat.

stanza.lyrics: guṇa-nirguṇa nilayam śivaliṅgam-arūpam
stanza.meaning: The seat of both attributes and the attributeless, the Shiva lingam, beyond all form.

stanza.lyrics: paramēśvara nāmam jagadāśraya-dhāmamśubha-maṅgaḷarūpam kailāsa-nivāsam
stanza.meaning: The name of Parameshvara (Supreme Lord), the refuge and support of the universe. The auspicious form, dwelling in Kailāsa,

stanza.lyrics: pañcākṣari-mantram bhavahara pāvana mantram
stanza.meaning: the five-syllabled mantra—purifying and liberating.

stanza.lyrics: śubhakara purahara śiva śiva hara hara jani-mṛti-duḥkha nivāraṇa mantram
stanza.meaning: Giver of blessings, destroyer of the cities—Shiva, Shiva! Hara, Hara! The mantra that ends the sorrow of birth and death.

stanza.lyrics: ōm namaḥ śivāya ōm namaḥ śivāya ōmōm namaḥ śivāya ōm namaḥ śivāya ōmōm namaḥ śivāya ōm namaḥ śivāya ōmōm namaḥ śivāya ōm namaḥ śivāya ōm
stanza.meaning: Salutations to Shiva, the auspicious Lord.

song.title: śyāma tan tiruneṫṫiyile
song.source: Shyama tan tirunettiyile 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: śyāma tan tiruneṫṫiyile candanattin poṭṭu pōleśyāma-vānil pūrṇa-candran udicc-uyarnnu
stanza.meaning: Like the sandal dot on Syama’s brow, the full moon rose in the dark sky.

stanza.lyrics: cārutayārnnorī dṛśyam kaṇḍorende hṛdayattilkāḷi tande mukhapadmam teḷiññ-uyarnnu
stanza.meaning: Beholding that lovely sight, Kali’s lotus face bloomed in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: sṛṣṭi-līla āḍiḍunna kṛṣṇa-varṇṇayōḍu cērnnenśiṣṭa-janmam sārtthakamāy tīrnniḍēṇam
stanza.meaning: The rest of my life must find its meaning with the Dark One who plays the game of creation.

stanza.lyrics: iṣṭam ellām ēkiḍunna viṣṭapēśi ākum endeiṣṭanāyikē en hṛttil narttanam ceyyū
stanza.meaning: O Great One, fulfiller of every desire, Queen of my heart, please dance within it.

stanza.lyrics: śyāma tan tiruneṫṫiyile candanattin poṭṭu pōleśyāma-vānil pūrṇa-candran udicc-uyarnnu
stanza.meaning: Like the sandal dot on Syama’s brow, the full moon rose in the dark sky.

stanza.lyrics: māya tande mālakannu śīladōṣam viṭṭakannukālakāriṇiyām ninne kāṇmatennō ñān
stanza.meaning: When will illusion fall away, and becoming free of faults, I will behold you, who are the source of time?

stanza.lyrics: pēlavam nin karaṅgaḷ tan śītaḷa-talōḍal ēṫṫu - kāḷi ninde pūmaḍiyil cāyvatennō ñān
stanza.meaning: O Kali, when will I rest upon your lap, cradled in the gentle caress of your hands…

stanza.lyrics: śyāma tan tiruneṫṫiyile candanattin poṭṭu pōleśyāma-vānil pūrṇa-candran udicc-uyarnnu
stanza.meaning: Like the sandal dot on Syama’s brow, the full moon rose in the dark sky.

song.title: sinam koṇḍa manam atu
song.source: Sinam konda manam atu 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Sinam konda manam atu 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: sinam koṇḍa manam atu raṇamākkiḍum pala manam
stanza.meaning: A mind consumed by anger turns thoughts into battlefields,

stanza.lyrics: guṇam koṇḍa manam atu guṇam ākkiḍum pala raṇam
stanza.meaning: but a mind filled with virtue can bring peace and virtue to embattled minds.

stanza.lyrics: tītum nandrum piṙar tara vāṙā maṙavātiru manamēnīyum maṙavātiru manamē
stanza.meaning: Good or bad does not come from others—O mind, never forget this truth.

stanza.lyrics: atanai nīyum manatil koṇḍāl āṙuvatu sinamēatanāl poṙumai koḷ manamē
stanza.meaning: If you hold onto this deep wisdom, your anger will cool down. So, be patient, O mind.

stanza.lyrics: kuṫṫram pārppin suṫṫrum illai maṙavātiru manamēnīyum maṙavātiru manamē
stanza.meaning: Those who find fault with others will find themselves alone—never forget this truth, O mind.

stanza.lyrics: poṙumai kāttāl sinamum azhiyum āruvatu sinamēatanāl poṙumai koḷ manamē
stanza.meaning: If you cultivate patience, your anger will fade, and its fiery heat will cool with time. Therefore, be patient, O mind.

stanza.lyrics: tīyināl suṭṭa puṇṇum āṙum vaḍuvum ārātē nāvin vaḍuvum ārāte
stanza.meaning: The burns caused by fire may heal, but the scars left by harsh words never fade away.

stanza.lyrics: avvai pāṭṭi andrē sonnāl āṙuvatu sinamēmanamē āṙuvatu sinamē
stanza.meaning: As the wise sage, Avvai Paati sang long ago, the heat of anger will cool with time. Therefore, be patient, O mind.

song.title: sindūrapoṭṭāṇu kāḷikku
song.source: Sindura pottanu kalikku 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: sindūrapoṭṭāṇu kāḷikkukarinīla-kaṇṇāṇukaṇṇil ūṙunnatum kāruṇyam āṇenkāḷī kaṙutta ponnē
stanza.meaning: Kali wears a vermilion dot upon her brow. From her dark eyes flows boundless compassion. Kali is a treasure—precious black gold.

stanza.lyrics: maṇṇile muttāṇu ammaviṇṇile candran āṇumaṇṇinum viṇṇinum āśrayam ākunnakāḷī kuḷēśvariyē
stanza.meaning: Mother is the pearl of this earth, the moon in the heavens. She is Kali, Kuleswari — the primal force, the very foundation of heaven and earth.

stanza.lyrics: tannanna tannānō tānōtānanna tannānōtannanna tānanna tannanna tānannatānanna tannānō
stanza.meaning: Rhythmic music...

stanza.lyrics: kaikaḷil triśūlam kāḷīmukkaṇṇan ēkiyallōcāpavum bāṇavum mārutan ēkicakramō śrī viṣṇuvum
stanza.meaning: Lord Shiva gifted her the trident. Marut, the Lord of Wind, gave Kali her bow and arrows. Lord Vishnu bestowed upon her the sacred Chakra — the divine discus.

stanza.lyrics: kaikaḷ nālilum ammaāyudham ēntiyallōśumbha-niśumbhanum caṇḍanum muṇḍanumbhīṣaṇiyāy-amma
stanza.meaning: With four arms bearing celestial weapons, Mother went into battle — fierce and glorious. She terrified and slew the demons Sumbha and Nisumbha, Chanda and Munda.

stanza.lyrics: ninnuḍe saundaryam vāzhttānnāvaṅgu pōrallōmūnnu-lōkaṅgaḷe mōhippiccīḍumkāḷipeṇṇāṇallō
stanza.meaning: O Mother, words fail to praise your splendour. Your beauty captivates the three worlds.

stanza.lyrics: kāḷi bhayaṅkari nī eṅkilum makkaḷkkuammayum nīvātsalyam koṇḍaṅgu makkaḷe onnākevāri puṇarnnīḍum nī
stanza.meaning: Kali, though fearsome in form, you are the mother who cradles her children in tender love.

stanza.lyrics: ninnuḍe poncilambin nādam ennilmuzhaṅgīḍaṇamuḷkkāmbil taṭṭunna ninnuḍenōṭṭattāl ennum nayicciḍēṇam
stanza.meaning: May the soft chime of your golden anklets resound forever within the depths of my being. May your glance, which touches my innermost heart, guide me always.

stanza.lyrics: ennil kaniññīḍaṇam kāḷīninnil cērttīḍaṇamcentāmaraykk-okkum nin mukham aṅguuḷḷil teḷiññīḍaṇam
stanza.meaning: Kali, show compassion to me; claim me as your own. Let your radiant face, as lovely as a blooming lotus, shine ever brightly within my heart.

song.title: śiśirattil ila pōl
song.source: Sisirattil ila pol 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: śiśirattil ila pōl dinaṅgaḷ kozhiññiṭṭumaṇaññatilla innum akatāril ennamma
stanza.meaning: The days fall away like autumn leaves, yet my Mother has not come into my heart.

stanza.lyrics: nīṙunna vyathayāl piḍayunna hṛdayattilnombaram amba nī aṙiyātirikkayō
stanza.meaning: My heart throbs in anguish—Mother, do you not know my pain?

stanza.lyrics: ramaṇīya kānti viḍarttumī prakṛtiyumamba nin varavināyi tapam-irippū
stanza.meaning: Nature, in all its beauty, waits in meditation for your arrival.

stanza.lyrics: kadana-bhāram sahiyān ākātevarṣamāyi patiyunnatu nī aṙiyāttatō
stanza.meaning: It pours down as rain, unable to bear the anguish of separation. Mother, do you not know Nature’s pain?

stanza.lyrics: tṛppādam en manamām śrīkōvililteḷiyānāyi ñān kāttirippū
stanza.meaning: I wait for your sacred feet to enter the temple of my heart.

stanza.lyrics: nin divya-rūpam ennum akatārilniṙayuvān enne nī anugrahikkū
stanza.meaning: Give me your blessing, that your divine form may ever shine within.

song.title: śivōham jyōtiraham
song.source: Sivoham jyotiraham 2025 French in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: śivōham jyōtirahamśivōham jyōtiraham je suis premier inspirje suis dernier soupir
stanza.meaning: I am the supreme, I am light. I am the first breath, I am the last sigh.

stanza.lyrics: je souffle ton destinet l’efface de ma main
stanza.meaning: I breathe out your destiny and erase it with my hand.

stanza.lyrics: je suis l’amour du coeursoleil d’être qui demeure
stanza.meaning: I am the love of the heart, the sun of being that endures.

stanza.lyrics: je suis nuit sans partagede la parole du sage
stanza.meaning: I am the night of silence, the word of the sage.

stanza.lyrics: śivōham jyōtirahamśivōham jyōtiraham je suis premier inspirje suis dernier soupir
stanza.meaning: I am the supreme, I am light. I am the first breath, I am the last sigh.

stanza.lyrics: je suis sérénitéde tout instant sacré
stanza.meaning: I am serenity in every sacred moment.

stanza.lyrics: je suis le soi qui te créémon enfant d’éternité
stanza.meaning: I am the Self that created you, my child of eternity.

stanza.lyrics: je suis nuit du partagede la parole du sage
stanza.meaning: I am the night of communion, the word of the sage.

stanza.lyrics: śivōham jyōtirahamśivōham jyōtiraham
stanza.meaning: I am the supreme, I am light.

stanza.lyrics: śivōham… śivōham…
stanza.meaning: I am the supreme,

song.title: skandana tandeye śivanē
song.source: Skandana tandeya Sivane 2025 Kan in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: skandana tandeye śivanēhērambana pitanē haranē
stanza.meaning: Skanda’s father, you are Shiva—also the father of Ganesha, you are Hara.

stanza.lyrics: uragabhūṣaṇa umā-mahēśanekṣayisu namma prārabdhagaḷahōgalāḍisu duritagaḷa
stanza.meaning: Adorned with serpents, O consort of Uma, may you destroy the effects of our past karmas and dispel the miseries we carry.

stanza.lyrics: mārkaṇḍēyana amaranāgisidebēḍara kaṇṇappana bhaktige maṇide
stanza.meaning: You made Markandeya immortal and became overpowered by the devotion of Kanappa the hunter-saint.

stanza.lyrics: pinākapāṇi ḍamaruga dhāridayāsāgara dīnōddhāri
stanza.meaning: Wielder of the Pinaka bow, bearer of the damaru drum, ocean of compassion, uplifter of the downtrodden

stanza.lyrics: lōkadi śāntiya mūḍisu nīmoḷagali ninnaya jayadhvani
stanza.meaning: —may peace spread through the world by your will. Let the victorious sound of your praise resound everywhere.

stanza.lyrics: śiva śiva śaṅkara śambhōbhava bhaya hara svayambhō
stanza.meaning: Shiva, Shankara, Shambho! Remover of the fear of worldly existence, O self-born One!

stanza.lyrics: kṣīra sāgarada manthana samayadiodagida hālāhalava hīride
stanza.meaning: During the churning of the ocean of milk, you drank the poison that arose

stanza.lyrics: nīlakaṇṭhanemba birudanu gaḷisitrilōkadoḷu prakhyātanāde
stanza.meaning: — thus you earned the name Nilakantha, the blue-throated one, and became renowned throughout the three worlds.

stanza.lyrics: jaya jaya jaya śrī bhavāni śaṅkaratryambaka mṛtyuñjayane namō
stanza.meaning: Victory, victory to Sri Bhavani’s consort Lord Shankara, to the three eyed One, the conqueror of death—salutations to you!

song.title: Souriez, Souriez - Navvu Navvu Navvu
song.source: Souriez souriez - Navvu Navvu 2025 French in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Souriez souriez - Navvu Navvu 2025 French in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: Souriez, Souriez... Essuyez vos larmes« Souriez » dit Amma... « Riez » nous dit Amma
stanza.meaning: Smile, smile… wipe away your tears “Smile,” Amma says… “Laugh,” Amma tells us

stanza.lyrics: Si tu as la richesse, et que tu es honoré,Même bien entouré, es-tu vraiment satisfait ?
stanza.meaning: If you have wealth and if you’re honored, And are even well surrounded, are you truly satisfied?

stanza.lyrics: Celui qui naît va mourir, et renaître à nouveau,En pleurant... mais à quoi rime cette vie de tourments
stanza.meaning: The one who is born will die, and be born again, Crying... but what’s the point of this life of torment?

stanza.lyrics: « Riez » nous dit Amma... ha ha ha ha ha ha !« Riez » nous dit Amma... ho ho ho ho ho ho !
stanza.meaning: “Laugh,” Amma tells us... ha ha ha ha ha ha! “Laugh,” Amma tells us... ho ho ho ho ho ho!

stanza.lyrics: On pourrait te blâmer... Il vaudrait mieux en rire !
stanza.meaning: They could blame you... Better to just laugh about it!

stanza.lyrics: Si tu viens à tomber... Relève-toi en riant !
stanza.meaning: If you stumble and fall… get back up laughing!

stanza.lyrics: Oublie tous tes soucis... Et de nouveau souris
stanza.meaning: Forget all your worries... And smile again

stanza.lyrics: Que le souffle qui t'anime, soit un sourire à la vie
stanza.meaning: May the breath that animates you be a smile to life itself

stanza.lyrics: « Riez » nous dit Amma... ha ha ha ha ha ha !« Riez » nous dit Amma... ho ho ho ho ho ho !
stanza.meaning: “Laugh,” Amma tells us... ha ha ha ha ha ha! “Laugh,” Amma tells us... ho ho ho ho ho ho!

stanza.lyrics: Amma demeure en tout, alors ne t'en fais pasElle est toujours en nous, aie la foi et la joie
stanza.meaning: Amma dwells in everything, so don’t worry She’s always within us, have faith and joy

stanza.lyrics: Sitôt que tu souris, la création aussi
stanza.meaning: The moment you smile, creation smiles too

stanza.lyrics: Vois le sourire d'Amma, viens danser dans la joie !
stanza.meaning: See Amma’s smile, come dance with joy!

stanza.lyrics: « Riez » nous dit Amma... ha ha ha ha ha ha !« Riez » nous dit Amma... ho ho ho ho ho ho !
stanza.meaning: “Laugh,” Amma tells us... ha ha ha ha ha ha! “Laugh,” Amma tells us... ho ho ho ho ho ho!

song.title: śrī laḷitāmbikē parāśakti
song.source: Sri Lalaitambike Parashakti 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: śrī laḷitāmbikē parāśaktisṛṣṭi-sthiti-laya-kāriṇiyētirupura-sundari ende amma
stanza.meaning: O Mother! You are Lalitambika, the playful divine, the supreme cosmic power, You are Tripurasundari, who creates, sustains, and dissolves the universe.

stanza.lyrics: vāgdēvatē ende nāvil nī ennumvākkin poruḷāyi tīrēṇamē
stanza.meaning: Goddess of Speech! May you become the very essence of the words I utter.

stanza.lyrics: anudinam ceyyunna karmaṅgaḷ aviḍutteaḍikaḷil malarāyi tīrēṇamē…aḍikaḷil malarāyi tīrēṇamē
stanza.meaning: May the actions I perform each day become flowers offered at your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: śrī laḷitāmbikē parāśaktisṛṣṭi-sthiti-laya-kāriṇiyētirupura-sundari ende amma
stanza.meaning: O Mother! You are Lalitambika, the playful divine, the supreme cosmic power, You are Tripurasundari, who creates, sustains, and dissolves the universe.

stanza.lyrics: taraṇam aviḍunnu kṛpa sadayamabhayam tava sannidhānam
stanza.meaning: Bestow upon me your boundless grace; your abode is my only sanctuary.

stanza.lyrics: śaraṇāgati ēkū mama jananīśaraṇam mama guru caraṇam…śaraṇam mama guru caraṇam
stanza.meaning: O Mother, grant me the spirit of true surrender unto you. The lotus feet of my Guru are my only refuge.

stanza.lyrics: śrī laḷitāmbikē parāśaktisṛṣṭi-sthiti-laya-kāriṇiyētirupura-sundari ende amma
stanza.meaning: O Mother! You are Lalitambika, the playful divine, the supreme cosmic power, You are Tripurasundari, who creates, sustains, and dissolves the universe.

stanza.lyrics: aviḍutte tiru-mantram uraceyyaṇam sadāakatāril nirmala bhakti ēkū
stanza.meaning: May I always chant your divine mantra with unwavering devotion.

stanza.lyrics: tava malaraḍikaḷil ī janmam ammēnaṙu-malaritaḷāyi cērnniḍaṭṭe…naṙu-malaritaḷāyi cērnniḍaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: Let this life become a petal adorning your sacred lotus feet!

stanza.lyrics: śrī laḷitāmbikē parāśaktisṛṣṭi-sthiti-laya-kāriṇiyētirupura-sundari ende amma
stanza.meaning: O Mother! You are Lalitambika, the playful divine, the supreme cosmic power, You are Tripurasundari, who creates, sustains, and dissolves the universe.

song.title: śrī rāmacandranu māruti enna pōl
song.source: Sri Ramachandranu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: śrī rāmacandranu māruti enna pōlnin pādadāsanāy enne māṫṫīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: In the manner that Hanuman served Sri Ramachandra, may I also serve at your lotus feet,

stanza.lyrics: bhaktiyāl ennum ahanta akaluvānbhaktapriyē kṛpa ēkīḍumō? Ammē
stanza.meaning: O Mother! You who are so fond of your devotees—will your grace not flow to me, so that my ego may be destroyed through my devotion to you?

stanza.lyrics: mukti-mārgattil nayiccīḍumō?
stanza.meaning: Mother, will you not guide me on the path to liberation?

stanza.lyrics: śrī rāmacandranu māruti enna pōlnin pādadāsanāy enne māṫṫīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: In the manner that Hanuman served Sri Ramachandra, may I also serve at your lotus feet,

stanza.lyrics: rāma-nāmattin karuttāl kaḍannitucōlayaruvi pōl sāgaram māruti
stanza.meaning: With the strength born of chanting Rama’s name, Hanuman leapt across the vast ocean as if it were a tiny stream.

stanza.lyrics: tāvaka mantrattāl jīvita-sāgaramtāṇḍuvān nī kaniññ-ēkēṇamē balam
stanza.meaning: With your mantra, won’t you compassionately grant me the strength and courage to cross the ocean of samsara?

stanza.lyrics: śrī rāmacandranu māruti enna pōlnin pādadāsanāy enne māṫṫīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: In the manner that Hanuman served Sri Ramachandra, may I also serve at your lotus feet,

stanza.lyrics: bhaktiyum prēmavum śauryavum vīryavumdāsatva-bhāvavum mārutiykkenna pōl
stanza.meaning: May devotion, love, courage, valour, and the spirit of service shine in me, just like they shone in Maruti.

stanza.lyrics: ennil viḷaṅgaṇē sadguṇaṅgaḷ sadāēkēṇamē enikkā varam ambikē…
stanza.meaning: O Ambika! Grant me the blessing that these noble qualities may grow in me.

song.title: śrīcakra-vāsini jagadambikē
song.source: Srichakra vasini Jagadambike 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: śrīcakra-vāsini jagadambikēnin rūpam ennuḷḷil teḷiyēṇame
stanza.meaning: O Jagadambika, the primordial energy who resides within the Sri Chakra, may your form become clear within my heart.

stanza.lyrics: mukti-mārgam nalkum cittaśuddhi – ammēennuḷḷil ennum nī niṙaykkēṇamē
stanza.meaning: Mother, give me a heart ever pure, so that it may lead me to liberation.

stanza.lyrics: śūddhamām nin prēma-valliyile orupuṣpam ākān nī kaniyēṇame
stanza.meaning: In your compassion, make me a flower in the creeper of your pure love.

stanza.lyrics: kāṭṭi tarēṇam ā prēma-mārgamprēma-svarūpiṇi amṛtāmbikē
stanza.meaning: O blissful mother, who is the personification of love, show me the path of true love.

stanza.lyrics: śrīcakra-vāsini jagadambikēnin rūpam ennuḷḷil teḷiyēṇame
stanza.meaning: O Jagadambika, the primordial energy who resides within the Sri Chakra, may your form become clear within my heart.

stanza.lyrics: nin tiru pādattil ettīḍuvānnin tiru vātsalyam āsvadikkān
stanza.meaning: That I may reach your lotus feet and rejoice in your motherly love,

stanza.lyrics: en manōmālinyam nīkki nī ammēennil kaniññu kaḍākṣikkaṇē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, bless me with your compassionate glance and cleanse all the impurities of my heart.

song.title: śrīgandhadantha manavanīḍu tāyē
song.source: Srigandhanatha 2025 Kan in Mal.pptx

stanza.lyrics: śrīgandhadantha manavanīḍu tāyēśrīgandhadantha manavanīḍu
stanza.meaning: Dear Mother, please bless me with a mind like sandalwood.

stanza.lyrics: addidarū tēydarū nontenonte entu
stanza.meaning: Just as sandalwood releases its fragrance even when it is cut or rubbed, help me remain calm and pure even when life is difficult.

stanza.lyrics: enna śrīsaugandhavā biḍenu ententu
stanza.meaning: Let me never lose the goodness inside me, no matter what happens.

stanza.lyrics: karma jñānadoḍatiyē ī manakeśaraṇāgati sugandhava nīḍu
stanza.meaning: You are the one who guides us with action and wisdom—please fill my heart with the sweet scent of surrender and peace.

stanza.lyrics: nuṭiyalli nōṭṭadalli sarvakarma gaḷalli
stanza.meaning: In everything I say, see, and do,

stanza.lyrics: tambu nīḍuvantha manava nīḍu
stanza.meaning: help me be someone who brings comfort and calm to others.

stanza.lyrics: janani jaganmātē… dēvī dayāpūrṇṇē…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, Mother of the world… Goddess full of mercy!

stanza.lyrics: nōṭṭadalli kāruṇya sugandha bhāva virisunuṭiyalli jñānada beḷakanu harisu
stanza.meaning: Let my eyes show kindness and my words shine with knowledge.

stanza.lyrics: cinteyalli pariśuddha aṙivu pasarisumanasē śrīgandhavu āgali tāyē
stanza.meaning: Let my thoughts bring clarity and peace, and may my mind become as pure and fragrant as sandalwood, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: ninna nāma parimaḷa elleḍe haraḍali
stanza.meaning: May your beautiful name spread everywhere like a sweet perfume.

song.title: sūryavamśa śōbha ēṫṫum rāmacandranō
song.source: Suryavamsa sobha 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: sūryavamśa śōbha ēṫṫum rāmacandranōazhakuḷḷa paṭṭuḍuttu villumēntinilppū munisavidham vannunilppū munisavidham
stanza.meaning: Sri Ramachandra, the radiant prince of the Solar Dynasty, stood beside Sage Vishwamitra, wearing royal robes, his bow and arrows in hand.

stanza.lyrics: vīracāpa-bāṇavumāyilakṣmaṇanum uḍuttoruṅgi
stanza.meaning: Lakshmana, too, got ready to leave—brave and steadfast, his weapons at his side.

stanza.lyrics: acchan āśīrvadicca bālar yātra tuḍaṅgīmunikku pinpē naḍa tuḍaṅgī
stanza.meaning: With their father’s blessings, the young brothers set forth on their journey, walking behind the sage.

stanza.lyrics: mantrasiddhi aḍakkamuḷḷavidyakaḷ aṅgōrōnnāyi
stanza.meaning: One by one, Sage Vishwamitra whispered into their ears the many branches of knowledge, granting them even mantra siddhi—the spiritual power attained through mantras.

stanza.lyrics: kātil ōtiya viśvāmitranumtṛptanāyī sōdaran vinayarāyī
stanza.meaning: The sage was content, having passed on all his powers to the princes, whose heads were bowed in humility.

stanza.lyrics: tanatintō tāna tintōtanatintō tāna tintōtanatintō tāna tintōtintinnārō taka tintinnārō
stanza.meaning: (A happy chorus)

stanza.lyrics: tāṭakaye vadhiccu rāman yajña-rakṣaṇam ceytu rāman
stanza.meaning: Rama slew the demoness Tataka and guarded Vishwamitra’s sacred yajña, striking down the rakshasas who sought to defile it.

stanza.lyrics: tṛptanāya munikku pinpē yātra tuḍarnnuraghukula śōbha ēṫṫi
stanza.meaning: With the sage walking ahead, calm and content, the princes followed behind—uplifting the name and glory of the noble Raghu lineage.

stanza.lyrics: janaka-puriyil etti rāmantryambakam aṅgeḍuttu rāman
stanza.meaning: Rama reached the kingdom of Sita’s noble father. There, he lifted and strung Shiva’s mighty bow, Tryambaka, and broke it with a thunderous crack.

stanza.lyrics: villu kulaccu lakṣyam nēḍi sītaye vēṭṭujānaki janmam sārtthakamāy
stanza.meaning: Thus, he won the hand of Princess Sita, and Janaki’s life found its sacred purpose.

stanza.lyrics: raghukulattinu kānti pakarnnuvīranāyakan rāmacandran
stanza.meaning: The valiant Rama brought everlasting glory to the lineage of Raghu.

stanza.lyrics: rāma rāma sītārāma japiccīḍū hṛttilmanassinu pinpē alayātē
stanza.meaning: Let us not chase the restless wanderings of the mind, and chant, “Rama Rama Sita Rama” within our hearts.

stanza.lyrics: sūryavamśa śōbha ēṫṫum rāmacandranōazhakuḷḷa paṭṭuḍuttu villumēnti
stanza.meaning: Sri Ramachandra, the radiant prince of the Solar Dynasty, clad in royal robes, with bow and arrows in hand,

stanza.lyrics: sitāsamētanāy vannunilppū hṛdayattil
stanza.meaning: has entered and taken his place within our hearts—with Sita, his beloved, standing by his side.

song.title: svarātmikē amba praṇavātmikē
song.source: Svaratmike 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: svarātmikē amba praṇavātmikēānanda-sundara nādātmikē
stanza.meaning: Mother! You are the vital essence of sound, the personification of the sacred syllable Om. You are the blissful, radiant soul of Nada, that dynamic, primordial vibration from which all creation arises.

stanza.lyrics: amṛtātmikē amba prēmātmikēśuddha-svarūpē paramātmikē
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are the true Self within all beings, the embodiment of pure love, the essence of purity, the Supreme Self.

stanza.lyrics: sapta-svaraṅgaḷ layikkum svarūpiṇīsaṅgīta-vartini sarasvati
stanza.meaning: In you, the seven notes of music merge and dissolve. You are Saraswati, the giver of music

stanza.lyrics: ātmāvil unmāda bhāvam uṇarttunnaōmkāra-rūpiṇī sarasvatī
stanza.meaning: —the divine form of the primordial Omkara, who awakens boundless joy within the inner self.

stanza.lyrics: mānava-mānasam dīptam ākkīḍunnajñāna-pradāyinī sarasvatī
stanza.meaning: O Saraswati, you illumine the human mind by bestowing true knowledge.

stanza.lyrics: vaikharī-nādamāy uḷḷil uṇarunnavāgīśvarī dēvī sarasvatī
stanza.meaning: You are Vagishwari, goddess of eloquence, who arises within us as intelligent and articulate speech.

stanza.lyrics: nādāmbikē amba vēdāmbikēvidyā-pradāyini jagadambikē
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are Music, you are the Vedas, you are Jagadambika, the Mother of this universe who grants us the highest knowledge.

stanza.lyrics: mṛdu-bhāṣiṇī amba mṛdu-hāsinīvaradāyinī dēvī amṛtēśvarī
stanza.meaning: O immortal Goddess, your speech is gentle, your smile tender, you bestow your blessings and grace upon us.

song.title: śyāmāmbarattin
song.source: Syamambarattin 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: śyāmāmbarattil layiccu cērnnennōśyāma-yamunayil aliññu cērnnennō
stanza.meaning: Have you vanished into the endless blue of the sky — or dissolved into the silent depths of the Yamuna’s dark waters?

stanza.lyrics: nōvinde tīrattinnu ēkākiyāy ñānnīṙi nīṙi kāttu kātt-aṅgirippū
stanza.meaning: Here I stand — alone on the aching shore of longing — waiting, aching, calling for you.

stanza.lyrics: kāttirikkām ñān ninakkāy…
stanza.meaning: Yet still — I wait, and I will continue waiting.

stanza.lyrics: akalukayāṇō piriyukayāṇōakale akale pōy maṙayukayāṇō
stanza.meaning: Are you turning away? Fading? Disappearing into a distance where my voice cannot reach?

stanza.lyrics: ēkāśrayamāyi kaṇḍū ninne ñānēkākiniyāy māṫṫi nī pōkayō
stanza.meaning: You were the one refuge my soul knew — will you leave me here, forsaken and alone?

stanza.lyrics: kāttirikkām ñān ninakkāy…
stanza.meaning: Yet still — I wait, and I will continue waiting.

stanza.lyrics: manassinde ceppil āyiram āyirammōhaṅgaḷ svapnaṅgaḷ niṙaccu veccu
stanza.meaning: I filled the treasure chest of my heart with a thousand hopes and dreams.

stanza.lyrics: ellām aṙiññiṭṭum kṛṣṇā ! nī ennegandha-vāhanan pōle tazhuki māṙi
stanza.meaning: Though you knew it all, O Krishna, you caressed me like a tender breeze-and then you were gone.

stanza.lyrics: kāttirikkām ñān ninakkāy…
stanza.meaning: Yet still — I wait, and I will continue waiting.

stanza.lyrics: nin adharattōḍu cērnnirunnā kuzhalneñcōḍu cērttu ñān āśvasikkām
stanza.meaning: I shall hold close to my heart the flute that once touched your lips, and console myself with it.

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷinde uḷḷil ninn-uyarum ā vēṇugānamuḷḷam aliññu nī ēkiyatō
stanza.meaning: But now — from deep within me — music rises like moonlight… is it your mercy? your tenderness awakening within me?

stanza.lyrics: kāttirikkām ñān ninakkāy
stanza.meaning: Yet still — I wait, and I will continue waiting.

stanza.lyrics: cērttīṭaṇē ninnilēykkāy kaṇṇā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna — let me dissolve into you, forever.

song.title: śyāmē tū hī sarjan kartī
song.source: Syame tu hi sarjjan karti 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Syame tu hi sarjjan karti 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: śyāmē tū hī sarjan kartīdēvī tū hī lōka-pālini
stanza.meaning: O dark-hued Mother, you alone create this entire creation; you alone are the protector of the worlds.

stanza.lyrics: mahiṣāsur-mardinī māsaṅkaṭ hāriṇī tū hī dēvī mā
stanza.meaning: O Mother, slayer of Mahishasura, you alone are the Goddess who removes all troubles.

stanza.lyrics: jay mātā kī… jay mātā kī… jay mātā kī… jay mātā kī… jay mātā kī… jay mātā kī… jay mātā kī… jay jay jay jay mā…
stanza.meaning: Victory to Mother!

stanza.lyrics: nahīṅ dekhā tujhkō kabhīphir bhī tū hai sab sē pyārī
stanza.meaning: I have never seen you, yet you are the dearest of all.

stanza.lyrics: kaisē milūṅ kaisē pāvūṅbanī yē bhī ēk pahēlī
stanza.meaning: How shall I meet you, how shall I reach you? This too is a puzzle for me.

stanza.lyrics: rāh mujhē dikhlā dē tūmā kaisē suljhē yē pahēlī
stanza.meaning: Show me the path, O Mother, so that this riddle may be solved.

stanza.lyrics: viśva raṅg mañc yē tērājahāṅ dēkhūṅ tērā pasārā
stanza.meaning: This whole universe is your stage, wherever I look I see your vast presence.

stanza.lyrics: nṛtya narttak sab hī tū haikahāṅ maiṅ aur kahāṅ mērā
stanza.meaning: The dance and the dancer are all you — where am I in this, and what is truly mine?

stanza.lyrics: rāh mujhē dikhlā dē mādarśan hō bas tērā hī tērā
stanza.meaning: Show me the way, O Mother, and may I have only your vision, always and only you.

song.title: taka tinantōm taka taka taka-tinantōm
song.source: Taka tinantom 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: taka tinantōm taka taka taka-tinantōmtittai tittai
stanza.meaning: (Traditional song of celebration)

stanza.lyrics: taka tinantōm taka taka taka-tinantōmtittai tittai
stanza.meaning: (Traditional song of celebration)

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇande aramaṇiyatā kiluṅgunnallōpāṭṭonnu pāḍunnuṇḍallō… āhā
stanza.meaning: The jingling bells of Krishna’s waistband sing a rhythmic, melodious song.

stanza.lyrics: tāḷattil nṛttam caviṭṭunnu rādhā ṙāṇigōpikā vṛndaṅgaḷ ellām
stanza.meaning: Radha and the Gopikas dance in delight, swaying to the rhythm of his jingling belt.

stanza.lyrics: taka tinantōm taka taka taka-tinantōmtittai tittai
stanza.meaning: (Traditional song of celebration)

stanza.lyrics: taka tinantōm taka taka taka-tinantōmtittai tittai
stanza.meaning: (Traditional song of celebration)

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇande kālccilambinde ponmaṇi-nādamtaka taka takadhimitā… āhā
stanza.meaning: The anklets of Krishna resound takataka takadhimita.

stanza.lyrics: tāḷattil nṛttam caviṭṭunnu dēva-lōkattumdēvādi dēvanmār-ellām
stanza.meaning: All the gods and celestials in heaven dance to the tinkling of his anklets.

stanza.lyrics: taka tinantōm taka taka taka-tinantōmtittai tittai
stanza.meaning: (Traditional song of celebration)

stanza.lyrics: taka tinantōm taka taka taka-tinantōmtittai tittai
stanza.meaning: (Traditional song of celebration)

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇande sugandham-aṅgu parann-ozhukimuppāriḍam āke… āhā
stanza.meaning: The fragrance of Krishna’s being flows through all the three worlds.

stanza.lyrics: nṛttattil layiccu maṫṫaṅgellām maṙannuī prapañcam āke
stanza.meaning: The universe forgets itself in bliss, merging into the rhythm of the dance.

stanza.lyrics: taka tinantōm taka taka taka-tinantōmtittai tittai
stanza.meaning: (Traditional song of celebration)

stanza.lyrics: taka tinantōm taka taka taka-tinantōmtittai tittai
stanza.meaning: (Traditional song of celebration)

stanza.lyrics: tōrāte nṛttam caviṭṭi taḷarnniḍumbōḷkaraghōṣam muzhakki… āhā
stanza.meaning: At last, weary yet happy from endless dancing,

stanza.lyrics: ellārum ēṫṫaṅgu colliharē kṛṣṇā harē hārē harē kṛṣṇā
stanza.meaning: all together they clap their hands and loudly sing Hare Krishna, Hare Krishna!

stanza.lyrics: harē kṛṣṇā harē harē harē kṛṣṇā
stanza.meaning: Oh Krishna

song.title: talatalli karayunna
song.source: Talatalli karayunna 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: talatalli karayunna tirakaḷkkum uṇḍammēoru noḍinēram neḍuvīrppiḍān
stanza.meaning: Mother! Even the waves that cry out, breaking their heads against the shore, find a moment’s respite to heave a deep sigh.

stanza.lyrics: pēmāriyāy peyyum mama duritaṅgaḷkkuaṇuviḍa pōlum śamanam illa
stanza.meaning: But my sorrows, falling like a constant, heavy downpour, do not lessen even slightly.

stanza.lyrics: oru piñcukuññāy arikil aṇayumbōḷtirumāṙil cērttentē pulkāttatu
stanza.meaning: When I come to you like a tiny infant, why do you not gather me to your heart?

stanza.lyrics: oru nuḷḷu snēham koticcu ñān aṇayumbōḷakalēkku akalēkku maṙayunnat-entammē?
stanza.meaning: When I draw near, yearning for a drop of your love, why do you vanish into the far distance?

stanza.lyrics: paribhavattin iruḷ mūḍi uzhalumbōḷaṙiyuvat-eṅgane ā mātṛ-vātsalyam
stanza.meaning: When my heart is clouded by misapprehensions, how can I ever know your motherly tenderness?

stanza.lyrics: ā prēma-sāgara-vaibhavam aṙiyāte andhata hṛttil niṙaññīḍunnu…
stanza.meaning: Darkness fills my heart, and I am unable to grasp the grandeur and glory of the ocean of your love.

stanza.lyrics: tazhuki uṇarttaṇē ālambahīnaye
stanza.meaning: Caress me awake, Mother—I have no one else to call my own.

stanza.lyrics: śāstrāvabōdhaṅgaḷ onnumē illammēniṣkāma-karmaṅgaḷ āṇende sādhana
stanza.meaning: I have no knowledge of scriptures, no flashes of insight. My only spiritual practice is selfless service.

stanza.lyrics: oru tuḷḷi pālināy poṭṭi karayunnanavajāta-śiśuvallē ammaykku ñān ennum
stanza.meaning: Mother! Am I not forever your newborn child, crying out for a single drop of your milk?

stanza.lyrics: enne tazhaññu nī tārāṭṭu pāḍumbōḷhṛttaḍam nīṙi pukayunnat-aṙiyaṇē
stanza.meaning: When you sing lullabies while ignoring me, know that my heart smoulders with searing pain.

stanza.lyrics: ā maḍittaṭṭonnu mātram āṇāśrayam
stanza.meaning: Your lap is my only refuge.

stanza.lyrics: pūjāvidhikaḷ aṙiyāte eṅganepūviḍum pūjitē pāda-padmaṅgaḷil
stanza.meaning: Mother! Worshipped by everyone, how can I offer flowers at your sacred feet, when I know nothing of rituals or ceremonial rites?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇīr-maṇikaḷāl kōrttoru mālyamnityavum cārttunnu nin tirumāṙil
stanza.meaning: Each day, I adorn you with a garland threaded from my teardrops.

stanza.lyrics: kaḍalōḷam saṅkaḍam ōtuvān uṇḍammēittiri nēram arikil aṇayaṇē
stanza.meaning: I carry an ocean of sorrows I long to share—please come, sit beside me for a while.

stanza.lyrics: neṙukayil tṛkkaram cērttonnu pulkaṇē
stanza.meaning: Place your lotus hand on my forehead, and hold me in your embrace.

song.title: tāna tantina tantinnō taka tāna tantinnō
song.source: Tana tantina tantinno 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: tāna tantina tantinnō taka tāna tantinnōtān it-entinu vann-ennaṙiyān kāḷi tuṇakkēṇam
stanza.meaning: Kali, help me know the purpose of my life.

stanza.lyrics: ennennum kāḷi tuṇakkēṇam ennennum kāḷi tuṇakkēṇam
stanza.meaning: Kali—be with me, always and forevermore.

stanza.lyrics: amba sundari-kāḷi ennuḷḷil nṛttam āḍiḍaṇēanbu mōnti rasiccu madiccivan āḍum tintakatōm
stanza.meaning: Mother, beautiful Kali, dance within my heart, so I may drink of your love and exult in joy.

stanza.lyrics: śaṅkarannu priyaṅkari nī en śaṅka nīkkiḍaṇē – ninn-aṅkam ēṙiyenn-āṙu ripukkaḷōḍ-aṅkam venniḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: You, beloved of Lord Shiva, dispel all my doubts. Seated in your lap, may I conquer the six enemies (lust, anger, greed, pride, attachment, jealousy, and laziness.)

stanza.lyrics: ennammē aṅkam venniḍaṇē ennammē aṅkam venniḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: Seated in your lap, may I conquer the six enemies (lust, anger, greed, pride, attachment, jealousy, and laziness.)

stanza.lyrics: pāriḍam śōkam ēkilum nī kaniññāriḍam vāzhilmāṙiḍunnu matibhramam oṭṭavan-āṙum tāpavumē
stanza.meaning: Though the world may give us grief, the one who has you beside him is free from delusion and sorrow.

stanza.lyrics: vāriḷam veṇ tiṅkaḷ kotiykkum ninnānanam kaṇḍālāru collum ninde vapussinu kār niṙam āṇennu
stanza.meaning: Whoever beholds your radiant face, outshining even the beauty of the full moon—how can they say you are the hue of rainclouds?

stanza.lyrics: ennammē kār niṙam āṇennu ennammē kār niṙam āṇennu
stanza.meaning: —how can they say you are the hue of rainclouds?

stanza.lyrics: duṣṭar eṅgum ñeṭṭi viṙacciḍum aṭṭahāsam ninśiṣṭar ennum kēṭṭu kuḷirkkum śānti tan saṅgītam
stanza.meaning: Your thunderous peals of laughter, which terrify the cruel and arrogant, resound like sweet, soothing music to the ears of your worthy children.

stanza.lyrics: tanta tannuḍe neñcinu mēl nī tāṇḍavam āḍīlē?tan tanayan keñcunn-ēnuḍe neñcakam nṛttam-iḍān
stanza.meaning: Mother! You danced the Tandava upon the chest of my father, Lord Shiva. If I plead with you, will you not also dance within the heart of your child?

stanza.lyrics: ennammē neñcakam nṛttam-iḍān ennammē neñcakam nṛttam-iḍān
stanza.meaning: If I plead with you, will you not also dance within the heart of your child?

stanza.lyrics: ennu vanniḍum onnennakam nī saṅkaṭam māṫṫīḍān annu toṭṭ-ivanuḷḷam nukarnniḍum uṇma tan pīyūṣam
stanza.meaning: On the day you enter my heart and lift my sorrow, from that moment my soul shall drink the nectar of truth and inner joy.

stanza.lyrics: pāḍiḍām tava gāthakaḷ āyiram mōdamōḍ-ennumpūkiḍān tava tṛppādattil ennum nin kṛpa ēkēṇam
stanza.meaning: Then, in delight, I will sing thousands of your glorious stories. O Mother, grant me the grace to reach your sacred lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: ennammē nin kṛpa ēkēṇam ennammē nin kṛpa ēkēṇam
stanza.meaning: O Mother, grant me the grace to reach your sacred lotus feet.

song.title: tanna tānana tannāna tāne
song.source: Tanna tanana 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: tanna tānana tannāna tānetāna tannana tannānatāna tannana tannāna tānetāna tannana tannāna
stanza.meaning: Chorus of joy

stanza.lyrics: celāṇu nalla cēlāṇu endekaṇṇane kāṇuvān cēlāṇugōpāla-bālane gōkula-nāthanekāṇūvān entoru cēlāṇu
stanza.meaning: Beautiful, so beautiful! Krishna is a beauty to behold—the cowherd boy, the Lord of Gokula, is wondrously beautiful to behold!

stanza.lyrics: picca naḍappatum cēlāṇuocca veykkunnatum nalla cēlāṇukoñci koñci amma cēlattumbil tuṅgiāḍunnatum kāṇān cēlāṇu
stanza.meaning: His toddling steps are so adorable; his baby words so sweetly endearing. How wondrous to see him cling to the end of his mother’s saree, frolicking joyfully by her side!

stanza.lyrics: tāmarakkaṇṇ-entu cēlāṇu – taḷirmēniyum entoru cēlāṇumēnikku nuṙu mēni matikkunnorānīla niṙam entu cēlāṇu
stanza.meaning: His wide, long eyes like blooming lotuses are so beautiful; his tender baby body so soft and lovely; and his blue hue adds a hundredfold charm. Krishna is beautiful to behold!

stanza.lyrics: ceñcuṇḍin-entoru cēlāṇu – nallamoñcuḷḷa puñciri cēlāṇucentāmalarinde kāntiye vellunnacentāraḍikk-entu cēlāṇu
stanza.meaning: His soft, red lips are beautiful; his lovely smile, so endearing; his feet rival the beauty of lotus blooms. Krishna is beautiful to behold!

stanza.lyrics: kārkuntal entoru cēlāṇuā kuntalil pīliyum cēlāṇuōmana-paitalin ōmal ceñcuṇḍileōḍakuzhal entu cēlāṇu
stanza.meaning: His dark, curly hair is beautiful; the peacock plume adorning it glows with beauty; the flute resting on this charming boy’s lovely lips is so wondrously beautiful!

stanza.lyrics: veṇṇa kavarnnatum cēlāṇumaṇṇu tinnunnatum kāṇān cēlāṇukōlumāy vannamma vāya tuṙannu nībhulōkam kāṭṭītum cēlāṇu
stanza.meaning: Seeing him steal butter is a delight; watching him eat mud fills us with joy. When his mother approached with a stick to scold him, it was truly wondrous that Krishna opened his mouth and revealed the entire universe within.

stanza.lyrics: gōvarddhanōdhāram cēlāṇukāḷiya-narttanam cēlāṇukōlum kuzhalumāy kāṭṭilum mēṭṭilumkāli mekkunnatum cēlāṇu
stanza.meaning: Wondrous is his divine play in lifting Govardhana Hill; wondrous his dance upon the serpent Kaliya’s hood; wondrous the sight of Krishna grazing the herds, flute and herding-stick in hand!

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇa-rūpam entu cēlāṇukṛṣṇa-nāmam entu cēlāṇunanda-kumāranām ambāḍi-kaṇṇandelīlakaḷ entoru cēlāṇu
stanza.meaning: Krishna’s form is beautiful; Krishna’s name is beautiful. The divine pastimes of Nanda’s beloved son—the darling of Ambadi—are wondrous to behold!

song.title: tanna tāne hṛdayavu
song.source: Tanna tane Hridayavu 2025 Kan in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: tanna tāne hṛdayavu teredide viṭhalatanna tāne hṛdayake bārenna viṭhala
stanza.meaning: My heart has opened on its own, O Vithala. Come into my heart yourself, O Vithala.

stanza.lyrics: mānasa pūje svīkarisu viṭhalamanasāre namisuvenu viṭhala
stanza.meaning: Accept this worship of the mind, O Vithala. With all my heart I bow to you, O Vithala!

stanza.lyrics: sonṭa hiḍida ninna honna karagaḷē andaiṭṭige mēliṭṭa ninna pādagaḷe canda
stanza.meaning: Your golden hands gracefully rest upon your waist; your feet rest beautifully upon the brick.

stanza.lyrics: nanagāgi kādiruveyā viṭhala?nānidō ōḍōḍi baruvenu viṭhala
stanza.meaning: Are you waiting there for me, O Vithala?

stanza.lyrics: nānidō ōḍōḍi baruvenu viṭhala
stanza.meaning: Here I come, running to you, O Vithala!

stanza.lyrics: viṭhala viṭhala viṭhala viṭhala pāṇḍuraṅgaviṭhala viṭhala viṭhala viṭhala pāṇḍuraṅga
stanza.meaning: O Vithala, O Panduranga!

stanza.lyrics: ōḍōḍi baruvenu viṭhalahṛdayake bārenna viṭhala
stanza.meaning: Running I come, O Vithala, come into my heart.

stanza.lyrics: tanna tāne hṛdayavu teredide viṭhalatanna tāne hṛdayake bārenna viṭhala
stanza.meaning: My heart has opened on its own, O Vithala. Come into my heart yourself, O Vithala.

song.title: tappate japisu avirata bhajisu
song.source: Tappade japisu 2025 Kan in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: tappate japisu avirata bhajisuśrīman nārāyaṇa mantra
stanza.meaning: Chant without fail, and ceaselessly repeat the sacred mantra of Shriman Narayana.

stanza.lyrics: jaḍa tanu manake caitanya goḷisijīvadāna vitta hariya
stanza.meaning: Let this inert body and mind be awakened into consciousness, and remember Hari, the giver of your very life.

stanza.lyrics: hṛdayadi hebeṭṭu gātrata rūpadikamalada moggina ākṛti iruvadaharākāśata garbha guḍiyōḷunelesiha sākṣibhāvana smarisu
stanza.meaning: In the inner sky of the subtle heart-space, within the sanctum of the spiritual womb, in a space no larger than a thumb, remember the Lord who dwells there in the form of a lotus bud, as the all-pervading witness.

stanza.lyrics: nārāyaṇa hari nārāyaṇa harinārāyaṇa hari nārāyaṇa
kārya-karaṇa saṅghātada oḍeyajīvarāśigella caitanyavīla
stanza.meaning: In the midst of the body-mind complex, and pervading all living beings, flows the stream of consciousness.

stanza.lyrics: jagadādhāranu sarva-vyāpiyunitya śuddha buddha paramdhāma
stanza.meaning: That supreme abode is the support of the universe, all-pervading, eternally pure, awakened, and absolute.

stanza.lyrics: nārāyaṇa hari nārāyaṇa harinārāyaṇa hari nārāyaṇa
śrī guru sēve niṣkāma karmaupāsane mārgava anusarisi
stanza.meaning: Serve the revered Guru through selfless action and follow the path of devotion.

stanza.lyrics: guru śāstra kṛpayinda jñānava paḍeyalukaruṇadi prabhuvu manati beḷaguvanu
stanza.meaning: By the grace of the Guru and the scriptures, attain true knowledge—and out of compassion, the Lord will illumine the mind.

song.title: tārāṭṭu-pāṭṭonnu pāḍi
song.source: Tarattu pattonnu padi 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: tārāṭṭu-pāṭṭonnu pāḍiuṇṇikkaṇṇan uṙaṅgiya nēram
stanza.meaning: Little Krishna drifted off to sleep, listening to Mother Yashoda’s lullaby.

stanza.lyrics: veṇṇa orukkānāy amma yaśōdakaṇṇande cārattu ninnu naḍannu
stanza.meaning: Quietly, she rose from beside her slumbering child and went away to churn butter.

stanza.lyrics: tārāṭṭu-pāṭṭonnu pāḍiuṇṇikkaṇṇan uṙaṅgiya nēram
stanza.meaning: Little Krishna drifted off to sleep, listening to Mother Yashoda’s lullaby.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇu tuṙann-onnu nōkki cuṫṫumneṫṫi cuḷiccu gōpālan
stanza.meaning: Krishna awoke, missing the warmth of her arms. He looked around, a faint furrow on his brow.

stanza.lyrics: veṇṇayō ammaykk-innēṫṫam priyamennu ninacc-aṅgeṇiṫṫu
stanza.meaning: So, my mother loves churning butter more than she loves me?—the thought crossed his mind as he stood up from where he lay.

stanza.lyrics: tārāṭṭu-pāṭṭonnu pāḍiuṇṇikkaṇṇan uṙaṅgiya nēram
stanza.meaning: Little Krishna drifted off to sleep, listening to Mother Yashoda’s lullaby.

stanza.lyrics: kālikaḷ kūṭṭattil etti kaṇṇanmelle tiriññ-onnu nōkki
stanza.meaning: He stepped outside and stood among his beloved cows. Slowly, he turned to look back toward his home

stanza.lyrics: amma yaśōda viḷiccu ‘kaṇṇā!’ādhiyāy ōḍi aṇaññu
stanza.meaning: —there he saw his mother, calling out, “Kanna!” She came running, anxious and full of love.

stanza.lyrics: tārāṭṭu-pāṭṭonnu pāḍiuṇṇikkaṇṇan uṙaṅgiya nēram
stanza.meaning: Little Krishna drifted off to sleep, listening to Mother Yashoda’s lullaby.

stanza.lyrics: entē ninakku piṇakkam kaṇṇā?amma tan ōmalkkurunnē
stanza.meaning: “Why are you upset with me, Kanna? Aren’t you Mother’s dearest darling?” she asked gently,

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇande kaṇṇīru kaṇḍa yaśōdakaṇṇane vāri puṇarnnu
stanza.meaning: seeing the tears welling up in his eyes. She lifted him into her arms and held him tenderly close.

stanza.lyrics: tārāṭṭu-pāṭṭonnu pāḍiuṇṇikkaṇṇan uṙaṅgiya nēram
stanza.meaning: Little Krishna drifted off to sleep, listening to Mother Yashoda’s lullaby.

song.title: tērē liyē ammā
song.source: Tere liye Amma 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: tērē liyē ammā tērē liyē
stanza.meaning: For you, Mother—for you alone.

stanza.lyrics: yē mērā jīvan tērē liyē
stanza.meaning: My entire life is for you.

stanza.lyrics: sūraj bhī tū maiyyā cānd bhī tū
stanza.meaning: You are the sun, Mother, and you are the moon.

stanza.lyrics: sāgar bhī tū un kē laharōṅ meiṅ tū
stanza.meaning: You are the ocean, and you are in its waves.

stanza.lyrics: ambar bhī tū maiyyā dhartī bhī tū
stanza.meaning: You are the sky, Mother, and you are the earth.

stanza.lyrics: phūlōṅ meiṅ tū unkī khuśbū bhī tū
stanza.meaning: You are in the flowers, and you are their fragrance.

stanza.lyrics: savālōṅ meiṅ tū, javābōṅ meiṅ tū
stanza.meaning: You are in the questions as well as in the answers.

stanza.lyrics: bātōṅ meiṅ tū khayālōṅ meiṅ tū
stanza.meaning: You are in my words, and in my thoughts.

stanza.lyrics: man meiṅ bhī tū sab kē dil meiṅ bhī tū
stanza.meaning: You are in my mind and in every heart.

stanza.lyrics: har diśā meiṅ bas tū hī tū
stanza.meaning: In every direction, it is only you.

stanza.lyrics: bhaktōṅ meiṅ tū unki bhakti bhī tū
stanza.meaning: You are in the devotees, and you are their devotion.

stanza.lyrics: rām hai tū mērē śyām bhī tū
stanza.meaning: You are Lord Rama, and you are my Krishna.

stanza.lyrics: pās hai nā tū mērē sāth hai na tū
stanza.meaning: Are you not near, are you not with me?

stanza.lyrics: mā hai nā tū mērī mā hai na tū
stanza.meaning: Are you not the Mother, my Mother?

song.title: tērī sōc sē hī khil uṭhā yē samsār
song.source: Teri Soch se 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: tērī sōc sē hī khil uṭhā yē samsāranādi-anant kālarūpī tū
stanza.meaning: From your very thought, this world has blossomed; you are the one who is eternal and infinite, the embodiment of time itself.

stanza.lyrics: kālī mā… tū hī hai samsārkāḷimā tū hī hai ādhār
stanza.meaning: O Kali Ma... You alone are this world; O dark Mother, you are its very foundation.

stanza.lyrics: sṛjan ki tū prēraṇāis jagat kī tū dhāriṇī
stanza.meaning: You are the inspiration behind creation; you are the sustainer of this universe.

stanza.lyrics: tū hī hai bhavatāriṇī mā sṛṣṭi sthiti samhāriṇī
stanza.meaning: You alone are the liberating Mother who ferries beings across; the one who creates, sustains, and dissolves the cosmos.

stanza.lyrics: tū hī hai samsārkāḷimā tū hī hai ādhār
stanza.meaning: You alone are the world; O dark one, you are its essential support.

stanza.lyrics: ōmkār kī dhvani tū hrīmkār kī mahimā tūśrīmkār kī samṛddhi tū kḷīmkār kā rahasya tū
stanza.meaning: You are the sound of Om, the glory of the sacred syllable Hrim; you are the prosperity of Shrim, and the mystery of Klim.

stanza.lyrics: ākār tū nirākār bhī tūsaguṇ tū nirguṇ bhī tū
stanza.meaning: You are form, and you are formless; you are with attributes, and you are beyond all attributes.

stanza.lyrics: puruṣ aur prakṛti bhī tūdvait tū advait tū
stanza.meaning: You are both the masculine and the feminine principle; you are duality, and you are non-duality.

stanza.lyrics: kāḷī tū, mahākāḷī tūśakti tū śivaśakti tū
stanza.meaning: You are Kali, you are the great Mahakali; you are the primal energy, the divine union of Shiva and Shakti.

song.title: tērī rāh kā ik chōṭā phūl maiṅ
song.source: Teri rah ka 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: tērī rāh kā ik chōṭā phūl maiṅ
stanza.meaning: I am just a small flower on your path.

stanza.lyrics: khuśbū nahīṅ nahīṅ raṅg mujhmeṅ
stanza.meaning: I have neither fragrance nor color in me.

stanza.lyrics: phir bhī havā meiṅ nit nāchtā hūṅnit nāchtā hūṅ
stanza.meaning: Yet, carried by the breeze, I keep on dancing, I dance every day.

stanza.lyrics: tērī rāh kā ik chōṭā phūl maiṅ
stanza.meaning: I am just a small flower on your path.

stanza.lyrics: is rāstē sē jab guzrōgī
stanza.meaning: When you pass along this path,

stanza.lyrics: ik bār mujhkō tum dēkh lēnā, tum dēkh lēnā
stanza.meaning: please look at me once—just once.

stanza.lyrics: us pal yē jīvan tērē caraṇōṅ meiṅarpit mā
stanza.meaning: In that very moment, this life of mine will be offered completely at your feet, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: tērī rāh kā ik chōṭā phūl maiṅ
stanza.meaning: I am just a small flower on your path.

stanza.lyrics: raṅg sē bharī is duniyā meiṅ
stanza.meaning: In this world filled with colors,

stanza.lyrics: raṅg hīn is phūl kā jīvan mā, yē jīvan mā
stanza.meaning: the life of this flower is colorless.

stanza.lyrics: tērī kṛpā sē mā is phūl kō apnā lē mā
stanza.meaning: By your grace, Mother, please accept this flower as your own.

stanza.lyrics: tērī rāh kā ik chōṭā phūl maiṅ
stanza.meaning: I am just a small flower on your path.

stanza.lyrics: kar kamalōṅ meiṅ lēlō mujhkō
stanza.meaning: Take me into your lotus hands,

stanza.lyrics: mar jānē sē pahelē mērī mā, pahele mērī mā
stanza.meaning: Mother, before I wither away.

stanza.lyrics: śaraṇ meiṅ lēlō mā tujhmēṅ līn hō jānā hai mā
stanza.meaning: Give me refuge, Mother—let me be absorbed in you, dissolved in you.

stanza.lyrics: tērī rāh kā ik chōṭā phūl maiṅ
stanza.meaning: I am just a small flower on your path.

song.title: This boat was lost at sea
song.source: This boat was lost 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/This boat was lost 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: This boat was lost at seauntil you rescued me
oh arbiter of my destinyambē mā amṛtēśvarī
samsara’s waves engulfing mewas calling for you desperately/
until you rose resplendentlyemerging from the deep blue sea emerging from the deep blue sea
oh arbiter of my destinyambē mā amṛtēśvarī
I reveled in your majestythe sound of om pervading me/
samsara’s tempest ceased to bein your arms, eternally in your arms, eternally
oh arbiter of my destinyambē mā amṛtēśvarī

song.title: gōlōka-pālakan kaṇṇan – Tintaka tintaka taro (long version)
song.source: Tintaka Tintaka taro Goloka palakan 2025 Full Mal in Eng v2.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Tintaka Tintaka taro Goloka palakan 2025 Full Mal in Eng v2.pptx

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tārō taka tintaka tārōtintaka tintaka tintaka tintakatintaka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: Chorus of exultation

stanza.lyrics: gōlōka-pālakan kaṇṇan annugōkkaḷe mēykkān iṙaṅgiārum koticcu pōyiḍum tasyabālaka-sundara-rūpam
stanza.meaning: Krishna, the youthful guardian of Gokul, sets out to graze the cows in the forest. His radiant form, so enchanting, draws every heart to him.

stanza.lyrics: cēlotta vārmuḍi keṭṭil orucēṇuṫṫa pīli tirukituṅgi kiḍakkunnu tellu atilcūḍiya mullappū-māla
stanza.meaning: A peacock feather adorns his hair-knot, from which a jasmine garland gracefully cascades.

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tārō taka tintaka tārōtintaka tintaka tintaka tintakatintaka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: Chorus of exultation

stanza.lyrics: nīlāḷakaṅgaḷ paṙakkum tiruneṫṫiyil gōpimaṇ poṭṭumvallavimāre mayakkum nallacilliyugaḷaṅgaḷ cemmē
stanza.meaning: Curly locks dance upon his brow, adorned with a streak of sandal paste. His gently arched eyebrows enchant the hearts of the gopis.

stanza.lyrics: vāliṭṭ-ezhutiya kaṇṇil ninnummūṙunnu kāruṇya-bhāvamkātile kuṇḍala-śōbha māṫṫukūṭṭunna gaṇḍa-sthalaṅgaḷ
stanza.meaning: Compassion overflows from his lotus eyes—wide, long, and lined with collyrium. His cheeks gleam with the shimmer of his earrings.

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tārō taka tintaka tārōtintaka tintaka tintaka tintakatintaka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: Chorus of exultation

stanza.lyrics: centoṇḍi vāy malar tūkumnaṙumanda hāsābhayiteṅgumvārtiṅkaḷ mōhiccu pōkumtava mōhaka mugda-vadanam
stanza.meaning: His lips curve in a tender smile that illumines the world. Even the radiant moon envies the beauty of his face.

stanza.lyrics: śrīvatsa vakṣasil ninnumveṙiṭṭu pōkāt-iriykkānpāḍupeṭṭ-oṭṭiyiriykkum tavanalla pulinakha-māla
stanza.meaning: Around his neck clings a tiger-claw necklace, struggling to remain upon the chest that bears the Śrīvatsa mark—the symbol of his divine glory.

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tārō taka tintaka tārōtintaka tintaka tintaka tintakatintaka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: Chorus of exultation

stanza.lyrics: āḍi-kaḷiykkunnu māṙil mōḍikūṭṭum ēṙe vanamālakayyil oru kālikkōlum – maṙukayyil kaḷiykkuvān pantum
stanza.meaning: Garlands of wildflowers sway upon his chest, enhancing the beauty of his form. In one hand he holds a herding staff, in the other, a ball for play.

stanza.lyrics: pītāmbara-paṭṭu cuṫṫi atilmīte aramaṇi cārttigōkulam pāḍi uṇarttum nallakōlakkuzhalum tiruki
stanza.meaning: A yellow cloth adorns his waist, over which a delicate belt of tiny bells softly tinkles. Tucked within it lies his cherished flute, whose melodies awaken and gladden every heart in Gokula.

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tārō taka tintaka tārōtintaka tintaka tintaka tintakatintaka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: Chorus of exultation

stanza.lyrics: uccaykk-amṛtēttināyi – ceṙupātrattil nalla pāl cōṙumkūṭṭukārkk-ēkuvānāyi – maṫṫupātraṅgaḷil naṙuveṇṇa
stanza.meaning: For lunch, he carries a small pot of milk rice in other pots, fresh butter for friends he adores.

stanza.lyrics: ellām eḍuttoru uṙiyil veccunannāy variññaṅgu keṭṭitūkkunna ninde pūmēni telluvāḍumō bhārattāl uṇṇi
stanza.meaning: He’s bundled them in a sling, gently dangling from his shoulders. O Lord, can your blossom-soft body bear such weight without tiring?

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tārō taka tintaka tārōtintaka tintaka tintaka tintakatintaka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: Chorus of exultation

stanza.lyrics: nī nivarnnonnu naḍannālbhumidēvi puḷakitayākumgōkkaḷum gōparum oppamgōpimārum ēṙe rasiccīḍum
stanza.meaning: When you walk, tall and strong, the Earth herself rejoices. The cows, the cowherd boys, and the gopikas are filled with joy at your presence.

stanza.lyrics: centāmara-pūkkaḷ vellum nindecentaḷir-pādaṅgaḷ pārilcintunnu śōbhayāl uḷḷamennum antastham āyiriykkēṇam
stanza.meaning: Krishna, even red lotuses must bow before the beauty of your sacred feet. May my heart dive deep into the light that radiates from them.

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tārō taka tintaka tārōtintaka tintaka tintaka tintakatintaka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: Chorus of exultation

stanza.lyrics: kāruṇya-vāridhē kṛṣṇā – tavakālkal arppiykkunni janmamtāvaka kāruṇya-varṣamennil ēkaṇam prēma-piyūṣam
stanza.meaning: Krishna, O ocean of compassion, I lay my life at your lotus feet. By your grace alone, may I be blessed with the nectar of your love.

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tārō taka tintaka tārōtintaka tintaka tintaka tintakatintaka tintaka tārō
stanza.meaning: Chorus of exultation
