song.title: kālccilambaṅgu dhariccuḷḷōḷ2025
song.source: Tintaka tintaka tintaka tom - Kal chilambangu dharicchullol 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Tintaka tintaka tintaka tom - Kal chilambangu dharicchullol 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: kālccilambaṅgu dhariccuḷḷōḷkāṙazhakinde niṙamuḷḷōḷkārmukil vēṇi aṇiññuḷḷōḷkāṭṭīḍuk-ammē karimkāḷī
stanza.meaning: She who wears heavy, tinkling anklets; she of radiant, dusky beauty, with dark, wavy hair like rain-laden clouds—protect us, O Mother, fierce and mighty Kali!

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm
stanza.meaning: Dance steps of exultation

stanza.lyrics: dārika-nigraham ceytavaḷdakṣande yajñam muḍiccavaḷdākṣāyaṇi ennu pēruḷḷōḷkāttīḍuk-ammē karimkāḷī
stanza.meaning: She who slew the demon Darika, who shattered Daksha’s prideful yajna, who is known as Dakshayani—protect us, O Mother, fierce and dark Kali!

stanza.lyrics: raktabījane vadhiccavaḷraktattil aṅgu nīrāḍiyōḷraktēśvariyāyi vāzhunnōḷkāttīḍuk-ammē karimkāḷī
stanza.meaning: She who slew the demon Raktabīja, who bathed in the torrent of his blood, who reigns supreme as Rakteswarī—protect us, O Mother, fierce and dark Kali!

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm
stanza.meaning: Dance steps of exultation

stanza.lyrics: nīṇḍu viḍarnna mizhiyuḷḷōḷtāraka-ratnam dhariccuḷḷōḷpauruṣam ārnna tējassuḷḷōḷkāttīḍuk-ammē karimkāḷī
stanza.meaning: She whose eyes are long and wide; who wears the stars as her ornaments; who embodies the vital force of Purusha, the Supreme Being—protect us, O Mother, fierce and dark Kali!

stanza.lyrics: cembaññiccāṙind-azhakuḷḷōḷcembaratti-māla cārttiyōḷcembaṭṭu cēla aṇiññuḷḷōḷkāttīḍuk-ammē karimkāḷī
stanza.meaning: She whose lovely hue resembles rosy red lac; who wears a garland of red hibiscus; who is draped in garments of deepest red—protect us, O Mother, fierce and dark Kali!

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm
stanza.meaning: Dance steps of exultation

stanza.lyrics: kaṇṇīru kaṇḍāl aliyunnōḷmātṛvātsalyam curattunnōḷbhakta-janaṅgaḷe pālippōḷkāttīḍuk-ammē karimkāḷī
stanza.meaning: She who melts at the sight of our tears; from whom flows the milk of motherly tenderness; who ever protects her devotees—protect us, O Mother, fierce and dark Kali!

stanza.lyrics: tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm tintaka tintaka tintaka tōm
stanza.meaning: Dance steps of exultation

song.title: tirumukham darśikkumbōzh-uṇḍākum
song.source: Tiru mukham darshikkumbol 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: tirumukham darśikkumbōzh-uṇḍākumparamānandam paṙayāvatō
stanza.meaning: The bliss I receive when I see your divine face, O Mother, cannot be expressed in words.

stanza.lyrics: ammē tirumāṙil amarumbōzh-uṇḍākumparama-śānti agādhamallō
stanza.meaning: I experience deep peace when you clasp me to your bosom.

stanza.lyrics: tṛkkaṇ kaḍākṣattāl akalāttor-azhal uṇḍōī avanīyil ammē…
stanza.meaning: All the sorrows I endure on this earth vanish when you cast a compassionate glance upon me.

stanza.lyrics: atulyamallō tiru-puñciri tan…vaśya-saundaryavum
stanza.meaning: The beauty of your smile is incomparable.

stanza.lyrics: tirumukham darśikkumbōzh-uṇḍākumparamānandam paṙayāvatō
stanza.meaning: The bliss I receive when I see your divine face, O Mother, cannot be expressed in words.

stanza.lyrics: tirunāvil ninn-utirunn-aruḷukaḷ allōī azhalārnna jīvan-amṛtakaṇam
stanza.meaning: The words you speak are like drops of ambrosia, dissolving the sorrows of my life.

stanza.lyrics: tiru-vacanaṅgaḷe kātōrkkum manujanījanimṛti cakrattin-avasānavum
stanza.meaning: Those who contemplate your words can break free from the cycle of birth and death.

stanza.lyrics: tirumukham darśikkumbōzh-uṇḍākumparamānandam paṙayāvatō
stanza.meaning: The bliss I receive when I see your divine face, O Mother, cannot be expressed in words.

stanza.lyrics: tiru-neṫṫīl oru muttam nalkumbōzh-uṇḍākumnirvṛtīl-akalunnu anāthatvavum…
stanza.meaning: When I place a kiss on your forehead, I become blissfully aware that I am not alone,

stanza.lyrics: tiru sannidhiyil abhayam tannennetṛppādaṅgaḷil cērkkukammē
stanza.meaning: Mother, grant me refuge in your sacred abode. Allow me to merge at your lotus feet.

stanza.lyrics: tirumukham darśikkumbōzh-uṇḍākumparamānandam paṙayāvatō
stanza.meaning: The bliss I receive when I see your divine face, O Mother, cannot be expressed in words.

song.title: tiru mumbil kāṇikka vaccū en hṛdayam
song.source: Tiru mumbil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: tiru mumbil kāṇikka vaccū en hṛdayammizhinīrāl pādābhiṣēkam ceytu
stanza.meaning: I offered my heart to you, O Divine Mother. With my tears, I performed the ceremonial washing of your holy feet.

stanza.lyrics: matimandahāsa prabhayil en uḷḷilematiyākum āmbalin mizhi tuṙannu
stanza.meaning: In the radiance of your smile, shining like the full moon, the blue lotus of my heart slowly opened her eyes.

stanza.lyrics: tiru mumbil kāṇikka vaccū en hṛdayammizhinīrāl pādābhiṣēkam ceytu
stanza.meaning: I offered my heart to you, O Divine Mother. With my tears, I performed the ceremonial washing of your holy feet.

stanza.lyrics: uruki ozhukum grīṣma hṛttilennō kozhiñña pūmēḷa uyirtt-eṇīṫṫu
stanza.meaning: In my heart, parched in the scorching summer of longing for you, a new spring of blossoms awoke.

stanza.lyrics: vīṇḍum uyarnna kuyilinde gānattālkariñña māmbūkkālam taḷiriḍunnu
stanza.meaning: The koel’s song resounds once more, and the withered mango blossoms come alive again

stanza.lyrics: tiru mumbil kāṇikka vaccū en hṛdayammizhinīrāl pādābhiṣēkam ceytu
stanza.meaning: I offered my heart to you, O Divine Mother. With my tears, I performed the ceremonial washing of your holy feet.

stanza.lyrics: pāpam-atitam en mey cērttu pulkisāntvanam ōtunna amma en puṇyamō?
stanza.meaning: O Mother! You tenderly embrace this impure body and console me; are you not my true merit, my punya?

stanza.lyrics: śiśuvām ennuḍe kai piḍicc-amma ennumnērvazhikkallō naḍattīḍunnu
stanza.meaning: You take the hand of this child and forever lead me upon the path of truth.

stanza.lyrics: tiru mumbil kāṇikka vaccū en hṛdayammizhinīrāl pādābhiṣēkam ceytu
stanza.meaning: I offered my heart to you, O Divine Mother. With my tears, I performed the ceremonial washing of your holy feet.

song.title: Toi qui luis en moi
song.source: Toi qui luis en moi 2025 French in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Toi qui luis en moi 2025 French in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: Toi qui luis en moi,Flamme créatriceFais briller le soiDans mes noirs abysses
stanza.meaning: You who shine within me, creative flame, make the Self shine forth in my dark abysses.

stanza.lyrics: Ma Kali, Immortelle,Ma l’âme chante, éternelle
stanza.meaning: Mother Kali, immortal one, Mother, the soul sings, eternal.

stanza.lyrics: dēvī mā… kālī mā
stanza.meaning: O Mother Devi, Mother Kali…

stanza.lyrics: Tu inspires cette aèdeEt brises sa mort,L’éphémère cèdeSous l’éclair sonore
stanza.meaning: You inspire this bard, and shatter his death; the fleeting yields beneath the thundering flash.

stanza.lyrics: Ma Kali me révèleLe soleil de son ciel
stanza.meaning: Mother Kali reveals to me the sun of her sky.

stanza.lyrics: dēvī mā… kālī mā
stanza.meaning: O Mother Devi, Mother Kali…

song.title: tū hai vidhātā jagat kā nirmātā
song.source: Tu hai vidhata 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: tū hai vidhātā jagat kā nirmātātū hī paramātmā astitva kī mahāmāyā
stanza.meaning: You are the giver of destiny, the creator of the universe. You alone are the Supreme Self,

stanza.lyrics: advait meiṅ tērī nirmalatātērī prakṛti meiṅ samāyī hai ēkatā
stanza.meaning: the great illusion of existence. In non-duality lies your purity, in your nature is contained unity.

stanza.lyrics: hē bhagavān, sunō mērī pukārtērē caraṇōṅ meiṅ mērā praṇām
stanza.meaning: O Lord, hear my call, at your feet I bow in reverence.

stanza.lyrics: kaṇ kaṇ meiṅ tērā svarūppūrē viśv meiṅ basā tērā divyarūp
stanza.meaning: In every particle is your form, in the whole universe abides your divine form.

stanza.lyrics: bāhar bhītar sab kuchtērī līlā, tērī līlā
stanza.meaning: Inside and outside, everything is your play, your play.

stanza.lyrics: hē bhagavān, sunō mērī pukārtērē caraṇōṅ meiṅ mērā praṇām
stanza.meaning: O Lord, hear my call, at your feet I bow in reverence.

stanza.lyrics: hē bhagavān, sunō mērī pukār… ō mā
stanza.meaning: O Lord, hear my call… O Mother…

song.title: uḍ jā rē kāgā
song.source: Ud ja re kaga 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Ud ja re kaga 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: uḍ jā rē kāgā ban kāuḍ jā rē kāgā
stanza.meaning: Fly away, O crow of the forest, fly away!

stanza.lyrics: mērē śyām gayā bahu din kā rēkā rē kā rē uḍ jā rē kāgā
stanza.meaning: My beloved Shyam (Krishna) has been gone for so many days

stanza.lyrics: uḍ jā rē kāgā
stanza.meaning: —fly away, O crow, fly away!

stanza.lyrics: tērē uḍyā su rām milēgārāmā rāmā…
stanza.meaning: When you soar upward you will meet Lord Rama!

stanza.lyrics: tērē uḍyā su rām milēgādōkā bhāg gayē man kā
stanza.meaning: The doubts and confusions of the heart will flee.

stanza.lyrics: it gōkul ut mathurā nagarīhari haiṅ gādēh ban kā, uḍ jā rē kāgā
stanza.meaning: From Gokul to the city of Mathura, the Lord has taken on the form of a cowherd—so fly, O crow!

stanza.lyrics: āp tō jāyē bidē sā chāyēham vāsī madhuban kā
stanza.meaning: You may go; stay there if you wish, for we are dwellers of the grove of Madhuban.

stanza.lyrics: mīrā kē prabhu hari avināśī caraṇ kē val harijan kā, uḍ jā rē kāgā
stanza.meaning: The Lord of Meera, the deathless Hari, is the refuge of his devotees—so fly, O crow!

stanza.lyrics: mērē śyām gayā bahu din kā rēkā rē kā rē uḍ jā rē kāgā
stanza.meaning: My Shyam has been away for long—fly away, O crow, fly away!

song.title: uḍukkin nādam kēkkaṇaṇḍaḷḷō
song.source: Udukkin nadam kekkanandallo 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: uḍukkin nādam kēkkaṇaṇḍaḷḷōendeccō ponnaccō
stanza.meaning: I hear the sound of Shiva’s damaru — O Shiva, my dear father!

stanza.lyrics: takil tāḷam koṭṭaṇaṇḍallōendeccō ponnaccō
stanza.meaning: I hear the beat of the small, sacred drum — O Shiva, my beloved and gracious father!

stanza.lyrics: aḍiyande uḷḷilum tāṇḍavam āḍuitaka itaka ponnaccō
stanza.meaning: Come and dance your ecstatic Tandava in my heart, O dear father, dance to the rhythm of the drumbeats!

stanza.lyrics: aḍiyande nēreyum kāruṇyam kāṭṭuitaka itaka ponnaccō
stanza.meaning: Show your kindness to your humble devotee, O Shiva, my dear and gracious father.

stanza.lyrics: hara hara hara ponnaccō ōhō ōhō ō…
stanza.meaning: Hara Hara! O my dear father!

stanza.lyrics: śiva śiva hara ponnaccō ōhō ōhō ō…
stanza.meaning: Shiva, Shiva, O my gracious father!

stanza.lyrics: hara hara hara śiva śiva śivatani taka taka ponnaccō
stanza.meaning: O beloved father, dance to the rhythm of the drumbeats.

stanza.lyrics: tripuram mūnnum ericcaḍakkiendeccō ponnaccō
stanza.meaning: You burned to ash the three impious cities of Tripura, O Shiva, my dear and gracious father.

stanza.lyrics: kāmaneyaṅgu bhasmam ākkiendeccō ponnaccō
stanza.meaning: You turned Kamadeva, the god of desire, to dust;

stanza.lyrics: vairāgiyāy aṅgu vāṇaruḷiitaka itaka ponnaccō
stanza.meaning: you reign in supreme and sovereign dispassion.

stanza.lyrics: aḍiyande nēreyum kāruṇyam kāṭṭuitaka itaka ponnaccō
stanza.meaning: O dear father, dance to the rhythm of the drumbeats! Show kindness to your humble devotee, O Shiva, my dear and gracious father!

stanza.lyrics: gaṅgēḍe garvam piḍīcc-aḍakkiendeccō ponnaccō
stanza.meaning: You halted the thundering descent of the prideful Ganga from the heavens, O Shiva, my dear and gracious father.

stanza.lyrics: tirujaḍayil sthānam koḍuttuendeccō ponnaccō
stanza.meaning: You gave her a home in your matted locks, O Shiva.

stanza.lyrics: aḍiyande garvam nīkkaṇē nāthāitaka itaka ponnaccō
stanza.meaning: O Lord, remove the pride from my heart.

stanza.lyrics: aḍiyande nēreyum kāruṇyam kāṭṭuitaka itaka ponnaccō
stanza.meaning: Show kindness to your humble devotee, O Shiva, my dear and gracious father!

song.title: uḷḷam nontu viḷikkum
song.source: Ullam nontu vilikkum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷam nontu viḷikkum nēram uṇṇikkaṇṇan ōdi varumkaṇṇanu karutiya naṙu tēn veṇṇa tiruvāy malaril ñān nalkum
stanza.meaning: Little Krishna will come running to me when I call him with a heart full of sorrowful yearning. I will feed him fresh butter, as sweet as honey.

stanza.lyrics: naṭṭu nanaccā tuḷasi ceḍiyum kāttirippu kārvarṇṇākṛṣṇa-tuḷasi pūkkaḷ koṇḍ-oru hāram cārttān maṇivarṇṇā
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, dark as storm clouds, even the sacred basil I’ve planted and tended waits eagerly for your arrival. O Lord, beautiful as a blue jewel, I shall weave a garland of its leaves and adorn you with it.

stanza.lyrics: nīradavarṇṇā nīla sarassile nīlāmbujavum tēṅgunnukamalakkaṇṇā nin tiru vadanam kāṇāt-eṅgane viḍarum ñān
stanza.meaning: Krishna, the blue cloud-hued one, the blue lotus in the blue lake is weeping. O Lotus-eyed One, how can I ever blossom without a vision of your divine face?

stanza.lyrics: mānatt-aṅgane vārmēghaṅgaḷ allum pakalum tirayunnunīla manōhara varṇṇam nalkiya nīlakkaṇṇā nī eviḍe
stanza.meaning: In the sky, the dark rain clouds search for you day and night. You gave them their beautiful blue—but where have you gone, O blue-hued One?

stanza.lyrics: kaḍalē nīlakkaḍalē entinu iḍamuṙiyāt-aṅgalaṙunnukaṇṇan pālkkaḍal varṇṇan ninne paṫṫicc-eṅgane pōyennō?
stanza.meaning: O ocean, vast and blue, why do you roar so restlessly? Did Krishna, radiant as the Milky Way, pass this way without granting you even a glimpse of him?

stanza.lyrics: karayu kaṇṇē kaṇṇanu vēṇḍi karaḷil kaṇṇan naḍamāḍumnanda-kumāran sundara-rūpan hṛttil teḷiyum kaṭṭāyam
stanza.meaning: O eyes, cry for Krishna—then he will come and dance in your heart. The beautiful, radiant form of Nanda’s son will surely shine within you.

song.title: uḷḷin himaśṛṅgam urukunnuvō
song.source: Ullin hima sringam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷin himaśṛṅgam urukunnuvō aśru tuḷḷikaḷ jāhnaviyāy ozhukunnuvō
stanza.meaning: Within my heart, does an ice mountain melt, and do tears flow like the sacred Ganga?

stanza.lyrics: ammayām kāruṇya-ratnākaram tēḍien cintādhārakaḷ alayunnuvō
stanza.meaning: Do my thoughts wander, seeking Mother, the jewel of compassion?

stanza.lyrics: azhal vēnal tāpattāl eriyunnuvōsantaptamāyuḷḷam piḍayunnuvō
stanza.meaning: Do I burn in the summer heat of yearning for You? Does my distressed heart beat with longing for You?

stanza.lyrics: ammayām mazha-mēgham putumazha - pozhiyuvān en manōcātakam kēzhunnuvō
stanza.meaning: Does the Chataka bird of my mind cry out, pleading for Mother—the rain cloud—to descend as fresh rain?

stanza.lyrics: niśayuḍe yavanika mūḍunnuvōmāyā nidrayilēkku ñān āzhunnuvō
stanza.meaning: Does the veil of night fall over me? Am I slipping into the sleep of delusion?

stanza.lyrics: ammayām āditya-bimbōdayattināyen hṛdayāmbujam vembunnuvō
stanza.meaning: Does the lotus of my heart silently weep, longing for Mother to rise like the Sun?

stanza.lyrics: ammē vannaṇayū… ennil kṛpa coriyū
stanza.meaning: Mother, come to me—Shower your grace upon me!

song.title: un maḍi mīdu talai sāyntu nān iṙukkavē
song.source: Un madi midu 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: un maḍi mīdu talai sāyntu nān iṙukkavēen talai kōti karam varuḍi nī iṙukkavē
stanza.meaning: As I rest my head upon your lap and sit there in peace; As you gently stroke my head and caress my hand,

stanza.lyrics: ānandam ānandam ānandamēānandam ānandam ānandamē
stanza.meaning: it is bliss, bliss, and only bliss

stanza.lyrics: unai pirintu uḷam vāḍi nān varundavēen manam arindu nī karuṇai mazhai pozhivāyē
stanza.meaning: Having been separated from you, my heart withers in sorrow; knowing the pain in my heart, you shower your grace like rain.

stanza.lyrics: ammā nī ennai kai piḍittu kāttaruḷvāyēatil ānandam ānandam ānandamē
stanza.meaning: Mother, you hold my hand and protect me. In that, there is bliss, only bliss...

stanza.lyrics: kanivōḍu enai pārttu nī azhaikkavēmakizh vōḍun karam piḍittu nān varuvēnē
stanza.meaning: When you look upon me with mercy and call me, with joy I will come and clasp your hand.

stanza.lyrics: ammā ulakeṅkum unnōḍu nān varuvēnēuḷamāra un sēvai nān seyvēnē
stanza.meaning: Mother, I will go with you across the whole world and serve you with all my heart.

stanza.lyrics: unai maṙavā sella piḷḷai nān vēṇḍavēaḷavillā anbu mazhai nī pozhivāyē
stanza.meaning: When, I, your darling child who never forgets you, pray to you, you pour down boundless showers of love.

stanza.lyrics: ammā paṇivōḍu kai kūppi nān vēṇḍavēkanivōḍu varam aruḷi nī kāppāyē
stanza.meaning: Mother, with folded hands, when I humbly pray with reverence, you grant me your grace and protect me with compassion.

song.title: unnai śaraṇaḍaintēn parāśakti
song.source: Unnai Saranadainten Parashakti 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: unnai śaraṇaḍaintēn parāśaktiunnai śaraṇaḍaintēn
stanza.meaning: I have taken refuge in you, O Parashakti, I have taken refuge in you.

stanza.lyrics: aṙiyāmaiyin āzha kaḍalil iruntukaipiḍittu ennai kāppāṫṫrināy
stanza.meaning: From the deep ocean of ignorance, you grasped my hand and protected me.

stanza.lyrics: dēvi un kaḍākṣattuḍan uyaravaittāysiṙu vāzhvu vāzhnta ennaianugrahittāy… anugrahittāy
stanza.meaning: O Goddess, with your glance of grace you uplifted me, you blessed me—one lost in a petty, material life—you blessed me…

stanza.lyrics: unnai śaraṇaḍaintēn parāśaktiunnai śaraṇaḍaintēn
stanza.meaning: I have taken refuge in you, O Parashakti, I have taken refuge in you.

stanza.lyrics: vāzhvil uḷḷa iruḷai akaṫṫrirviṭṭuidayattil dīpamāka vantutittāy
stanza.meaning: You removed the darkness in my life and came as a lamp in my heart.

stanza.lyrics: sattiyam ennavenḍru puriya vaittāy ammānittiyam nī enḍru aṙiya vaittāy… aṙiya vaittāy
stanza.meaning: You made me understand what truth is, O Mother, you made me know that you are the eternal…

stanza.lyrics: unnai śaraṇaḍaintēn parāśaktiunnai śaraṇaḍaintēn
stanza.meaning: I have taken refuge in you, O Parashakti, I have taken refuge in you.

stanza.lyrics: mantirattin mūlam teḷiyavaittāy ammāennil ennai uṇara vaittāy
stanza.meaning: Through the power of mantra, you made it clear, O Mother, you made me realize myself within me.

stanza.lyrics: karmattin mūlam un ninaivai tantiḍuvāyunnil cēra vazhi vakuttiḍuvāy… vazhi vakuttiḍuvāy
stanza.meaning: You will make me remember you, through selfless service; you will create the path for me to merge in you…

stanza.lyrics: śaraṇaḍaintēn ammā śaraṇaḍaintēndēvi un pādattil śaraṇaḍaintēn…
stanza.meaning: I have taken refuge, O Mother, I have taken refuge in you. O Goddess, at your feet I have taken refuge.

stanza.lyrics: śaraṇaḍaintēn ammā śaraṇaḍaintēndēvi un pādattil śaraṇaḍaintēn
stanza.meaning: I have taken refuge, O Mother, I have taken refuge in you. O Goddess, at your feet I have taken refuge.

stanza.lyrics: ammā śaraṇaḍaintēn…ammā śaraṇaḍaintēn…
stanza.meaning: Oh Mother, I have taken refuge in you

song.title: unnai śaraṇaḍaindēn ammā
song.source: Unnai Saranadainten Amma 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: unnai śaraṇaḍaindēn ammā unnai śaraṇaḍaindēn
stanza.meaning: I surrender to you, O Mother, I take refuge in you.

stanza.lyrics: sarvamum nīyena nin tāḷ paṇintēn
stanza.meaning: Recognizing that everything is you, I bow down at your holy feet.

stanza.lyrics: māyyaiyil uzhandra ennai taḍuttāṭkoṇḍāy
stanza.meaning: When I was lost in delusion, you restrained me with compassion.

stanza.lyrics: malaipondru ūzhvinaiyai panipōl urūkacceytāy
stanza.meaning: You melted away my heavy karmic burdens like ice beneath the sun.

stanza.lyrics: uttamarōḍu ennai sērttu vaittāy
stanza.meaning: You placed me in the company of the noble and pure,

stanza.lyrics: uḷḷuruki unnai azhaikka vaittāy
stanza.meaning: and you caused my heart to melt so that I might call out to you.

stanza.lyrics: azhaitta en kuṙaḷ kēṭṭu ōḍi vantāy
stanza.meaning: You heard my cry and came rushing to me.

stanza.lyrics: āṙutalāy ennai tāṅkinindrāy
stanza.meaning: You consoled me and bore my burdens.

stanza.lyrics: anbai pukaṭṭi un āḍalai kāṇa ceytāy
stanza.meaning: You filled me with love and allowed me to witness your divine dance

stanza.lyrics: ādaravāy ennai unnōḍu sērttāy
stanza.meaning: With deep affection, you united me with yourself.

stanza.lyrics: nandri navila enakku vārttaikaḷ illai ammā
stanza.meaning: I have no words to express my gratitude, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: nānilattil uṙaiyum māmaṙaiyē
stanza.meaning: O Veda that dwells on this wide earth!

stanza.lyrics: nin padam paṇindēn ammā ammā
stanza.meaning: I bow at your feet, O Mother,

stanza.lyrics: ninnaruḷ tantennai kāppāyē nī
stanza.meaning: O Mother—may you, in your grace, bless me and protect me.

song.title: valampurināthā unnai valamvantu vaṇaṅkukirōm
song.source: Valampurinatha 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: valampurināthā unnai valamvantu vaṇaṅkukirōmvaḷampeṙa vēṇḍumē uyirinam yāvaiyum
stanza.meaning: O Lord Ganapati, we come around you in circumambulation and bow at your feet. May all living beings prosper and flourish!

stanza.lyrics: uṇmaiyē pēsum nal uḷḷamum vēṇḍum - aṙavazhi vāzhum nal aṙivatu vēṇḍum
stanza.meaning: May we have pure hearts that speak only the truth! May we gain noble wisdom that walks the path of goodness!

stanza.lyrics: vēṙuvēṙena vāzhum manitaril pirivinai akanḍriḍavēvaiyam yāvumōr kuḍumbam ākavē anpinil iṇaintiḍavē
stanza.meaning: O elephant-faced Lord Ganapati, graciously bestow your blessings so that the divisions among people living in separation may be removed; so that the whole world may become one family, united in love;

stanza.lyrics: pazhaiyana kazhintiḍavē putuyukam piṙantiḍavēkarimuka kaḍavuḷ gaṇapati nāthā kanintaruḷ purivāyē
stanza.meaning: O elephant-faced Lord Ganapati, graciously bestow your blessings, so that the old and outdated may be cast away, and a new age be born.

stanza.lyrics: piṙarin kuṙaikaḷai kaṇḍu nakaittiḍum izhiguṇam akanḍriḍavētanatu kuṙaikaḷai eṇṇi sirittiḍum aruṅguṇam vaḷarntiḍavē
stanza.meaning: O elephant-faced Lord Ganapati, graciously bestow your blessings so that the tendency to laugh at the faults of others may be removed; so that the rare virtue of reflecting on one’s own faults and laughing at them may grow within us;

stanza.lyrics: tavaṙukaḷ tiruntiḍavē taḍaikaḷum nīṅkiḍavēkarimukakkaḍavuḷ gaṇapati-nāthā kanintaruḷ purivāyē
stanza.meaning: O elephant-faced Lord Ganapati, graciously bestow your blessings, so that our mistakes may be corrected and all obstacles removed.

stanza.lyrics: arputa karppaka kaḷirēvittakā virai kazhal śaraṇē
stanza.meaning: O wondrous wish-fulfilling tree, O wise One, at your lotus feet I take refuge.

stanza.lyrics: iruvinai illā tattuva nilaiyaitantaruḷ gaṇapatiyē
stanza.meaning: O Ganapati, graciously grant me the state of truth that is beyond the dualities of pain and pleasure.

song.title: vanamāla tannu maṇivēṇu tannu
song.source: Vana mala tannu 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: vanamāla tannu maṇivēṇu tannuvarumenna vāgdānam tannu kaṇṇanvarumennu vāgdānam tannu
stanza.meaning: He gave me his garland of forest flowers, he gave me his beloved flute, he gave me his word that he would return.

stanza.lyrics: maṇivarṇṇan varum enna madhura-kināvinemadhuvūṭṭi ñān kāttirunnu… ennummadhuripuve kāttirunnu
stanza.meaning: I wait, lost in sweet dreams, for the Lord of sweetness to come back to me.

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇā… gōpabālā… kṛṣṇā… vāsudēvā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, cowherd boy! O Krishna, who resides within every heart…

stanza.lyrics: oru cillayil vaḷarnnoru ñeṭṭilāy taḷirtt-orumayil pūviṭṭa pūkkaḷ
stanza.meaning: Like twin blossoms from a single stem, the dark-hued Krishna and I bloomed together on the vine of love,

stanza.lyrics: śyāmanum ñānumā sūnaṅgaḷ pōlavēprēma-taruvil viḍarnnu…
stanza.meaning: Like twin blossoms from a single stem, the dark-hued Krishna and I bloomed together on the vine of love,and the fragrance of our love spread everywhere.

stanza.lyrics: prēma-saugandham eṅgum parannu
stanza.meaning: and the fragrance of our love spread everywhere.

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇā… gōpabālā… kṛṣṇā… vāsudēvā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, cowherd boy! O Krishna, who resides within every heart…

stanza.lyrics: ambarattumbōḷam poṅgi paṙannorukambitam ākum kinākkaḷ
stanza.meaning: Her dreams flew as high as the sky, longing to reach and hold Krishna.

stanza.lyrics: sundara-pūnilāppāl ozhukkīḍunnacandrane nōkki kutippū
stanza.meaning: He rose as the full moon within the clear sky of her heart, and from him flowed a stream of silvery light.

stanza.lyrics: śyāma-candrane nēḍān kotippū
stanza.meaning: He rose as the full moon within the clear sky of her heart, and from him flowed a stream of silvery light.

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇā… gōpabālā… kṛṣṇā… vāsudēvā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, cowherd boy! O Krishna, who resides within every heart…

stanza.lyrics: ‘rādhēśan varavāyi’ madhuramāy mantriccukātil oru kuḷir kāṫṫu
stanza.meaning: A gentle breeze whispered in her ear, ‘Radha’s Lord is arriving.’

stanza.lyrics: prāṇēśane puṇarnnīḍuvān rādha tanprāṇan paṙann-aṅguyarnnu
stanza.meaning: Radha’s very life force leapt up to embrace her beloved

stanza.lyrics: jīva-nāthanil cērnnu layiccu
stanza.meaning: —her prana rose and merged with the Lord of her life.

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇā… gōpabālā… kṛṣṇā… vāsudēvā…
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, cowherd boy! O Krishna, who resides within every heart…

song.title: vannaṅgoru dinam
song.source: Vannangoru dinam 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: vannaṅgoru dinam kubēranōśrīśailattil aṅgu kṣaṇikkānāyuṇṇigaṇapati vannen manōrathamsādhippicc-aṅgu tannīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: One day, Kubera, the Lord of Wealth, arrived at Sri Saila, the abode of Siva and Parvati, to invite young Ganapati to his palace to fulfill a long-cherished dream.

stanza.lyrics: śrī śivapārvatimārō atu kēṭṭutelloru mandasmitattōḍeuṇṇigaṇēśane cēṛttu piḍicciṭṭupōyi varika ponnuṇṇi nī
stanza.meaning: Hearing his words, Siva and Parvati smiled slightly and embraced young Ganapathy. 'Go there and come back, dear son,' they said.

stanza.lyrics: uṇṇi-gaṇēśanum cinticc-aṅguṙaccuinnivand-ahanta tīrkkaṇamāśīrvādattināy acchanammamārecennu vaṇaṅgi vināyakan
stanza.meaning: Young Ganapati also decided to put an end to Kubera’s pride in his wealth. He went to his parents and bowed before them for their blessings.

stanza.lyrics: nūṙu-kaṇakkinu kaṙikaḷum cērttaṅgusadya viḷambī kubēranumtelloru ceṙu-pūppuñciriyōḍekumbha taḍavī gaṇēśanum
stanza.meaning: Kubera served a feast with hundreds of dishes. With a slight smile, Ganapati patted his paunch…

stanza.lyrics: vistariccaṅgu tuḍaṅgiyitā orumātrakoṇḍ-ellāmē tīrtteḍōiniyum varaṭṭe viśappusahikkaṇill-ennaṅgu collī gaṇēśanum
stanza.meaning: ….and finished all the dishes in a twinkling. 'Bring me more—I cannot bear my hunger,' said Ganapati

stanza.lyrics: vīṇḍum viḷambīṭṭum vīṇḍum viḷambīṭṭumviśappu tīrnnill-aṅguṇṇikkukoṇḍuvarika iniyum viśakkunnukōpattōḍaṅgu collīḍinēn
stanza.meaning: He was served more and more, but it did not appease young Ganapati’s hunger. Angrily, he said, ‘Bring me more food!’

stanza.lyrics: entu koḍukkaṇam ennaṅg-aṙiyāteninnu valaññu kubēranumvērttolikkaṇu viṙaṅgalikkaṇukāliḍaṙaṇ-endīśanē
stanza.meaning: Kubera was distraught, not knowing what more to give. He began sweating and shivering. O God! His legs started shaking.

stanza.lyrics: viśappu tīrāte uṇṇi-gaṇapatipātraṅgaḷ onnāy vizhuṅginēntān tan ahaṅkāram tiricc-aṙiññaṅgucolli karaññu kubēranum
stanza.meaning: Meanwhile, young Ganapathy, his hunger unabated, began eating the pots themselves. Recognizing his own pride, Kubera started crying out:

stanza.lyrics: rakṣikka śrījagadīśā mahēśvarārakṣikka pārvatī vallabhācennaṅgu kēṇu vaṇaṅgī kubēranumśrīparamēśvaran munpākē
stanza.meaning: Save me, Lord of this world, O Supreme God! Save me, O consort of Goddess Parvati!’ Kubera went to Sri Paramesa, bowed down, and pleaded with him.

stanza.lyrics: uṇṇi-gaṇapati tannantikē uḍan ettī śrīpārvatī vallabhanuṇṇi gaṇēśanē vāri eḍuttumaḍīl aṅgiruttī mahēśanum
stanza.meaning: At once, Sri Parvati’s consort reached young Ganapati’s side. Mahesha lifted the little one and placed him on his lap.

stanza.lyrics: oru nuḷḷu bhasmamā tiruvāyil iṭṭaṅgukumbha taḍavī mahēśanumēmbakkam viṭṭaṅgu tṛptiyōḍetalayāṭṭi ciriccū gaṇēśanum
stanza.meaning: He took a pinch of sacred ash and fed it to Ganapati. Then he gently caressed the young paunch. Giving a satisfied burp, young Ganapati nodded and laughed.

stanza.lyrics: gaṇapatayē gaṇapatayē śrīpārvatī nandananēgaṇapatayē gaṇapatayē śrīparamēśvara-nandananē
stanza.meaning: O Ganapati, son of Sri Parvathy! O Ganapati, son of Sri Parameswara!

song.title: vannīḍum ennallī colli kaṇṇan
song.source: Vannidum ennalli 2025 Mal in Eng v2.pptx

stanza.lyrics: vannīḍum ennallī colli kaṇṇan annu mathuraykku pōya nēram
stanza.meaning: When Krishna left for Mathura, he said he would return to Vrindavan.

stanza.lyrics: nāḷukaḷ ēṙe kozhiññuvallōnāḷīka-nētran varāttat-entē?
stanza.meaning: So many days have passed, why has the lotus-eyed one not come back?

stanza.lyrics: maññattukil ennum nīrtti vaykkumtiṇṇayil ēṙe ñān nōkki nilkkum
stanza.meaning: Each day, I lay out his yellow raiment, ready for him to wear. I wait for long on the verandah, eyes fixed on the path,

stanza.lyrics: uṇṇi varunnatum kāttu-kāttumaṇṇu tinnōruṇṇi vannatilla
stanza.meaning: hoping for a glimpse of him, my child, returning home. The one who ate mud with innocent mischief, my Krishna, has not yet returned to me.

stanza.lyrics: vannīḍum ennallī colli kaṇṇan annu mathuraykku pōya nēram
stanza.meaning: When Krishna left for Mathura, he said he would return to Vrindavan.

stanza.lyrics: ōṇavil ennum orukki vaykkumōmana-kaṇṇanu nalkiḍānāy
stanza.meaning: Every day, I keep the ceremonial bow ready—a gift for my darling Krishna,

stanza.lyrics: ōḍi aṇaññavan pulkiḍumbōḷōmana-muttaṅgaḷ ēṙe nalkum
stanza.meaning: When he comes running into my arms I will shower him with tender kisses.

stanza.lyrics: vannīḍum ennallī colli kaṇṇan annu mathuraykku pōya nēram
stanza.meaning: When Krishna left for Mathura, he said he would return to Vrindavan.

stanza.lyrics: veṇṇa-kalaṅgaḷ niṙaccu vaykkumuṇṇuvān uṇṇi varāttat-entē
stanza.meaning: I’ve filled the pots with butter, sweet and fresh, waiting for him to feast as he once did

stanza.lyrics: veṇṇayōḍuḷḷa priyam veḍiññō?ennu varum nī en uṇṇikkaṇṇā
stanza.meaning: . Has my little one lost his love for butter? My dearest Krishna, my beloved child—When will you return to me?

stanza.lyrics: vannīḍum ennallī colli kaṇṇan annu mathuraykku pōya nēram
stanza.meaning: When Krishna left for Mathura, he said he would return to Vrindavan.

stanza.lyrics: kōlakkuzhal ninde ōmal allē?kālikkōlum ninakk-iṣṭam allē?
stanza.meaning: Your flute is beloved to you, and your herding stick is dear to you. Don’t you long to wander once more through the forest, herding the cows?

stanza.lyrics: kāli-mēccīḍuvān pōyiḍēṇḍē?kālam kaḷayāte nī varillē?
stanza.meaning: Why do you delay, my Krishna? What great matters keep you away? But I am your mother — and I know you will return to me.

stanza.lyrics: vannīḍum ennallī colli kaṇṇan annu mathuraykku pōya nēram
stanza.meaning: When Krishna left for Mathura, he said he would return to Vrindavan.

stanza.lyrics: entāmō kaṇṇan varāttat-innumentuṇḍ-avan aviḍe ēṙe ceyyān?
stanza.meaning: Why indeed has little Kannan still not come? What keeps him there for so long?

stanza.lyrics: etrayāyālum ñān ammayallēetrayum vēgam aṇayum avan
stanza.meaning: After all, am I not his mother, and my son will return to my side as soon as possible.

stanza.lyrics: vannīḍum ennallī colli kaṇṇan annu mathuraykku pōya nēram
stanza.meaning: When Krishna left for Mathura, he said he would return to Vrindavan.

stanza.lyrics: ammaykku nalkukill-allal avanaṅgu dūrēykk-avan pōkukilla
stanza.meaning: He would never bring sorrow to his mother, nor would he go far away, leaving me behind.

stanza.lyrics: atraykku krūran allende kaṇṇan atra-mēl ende ponnuṇṇi avan
stanza.meaning: My Krishna is not so cruel. He is so very dear to me, and I, to him, am just as beloved.

stanza.lyrics: vannīḍum ennallī colli kaṇṇan annu mathuraykku pōya nēram
stanza.meaning: When Krishna left for Mathura, he said he would return to Vrindavan.

stanza.lyrics: nāḷukaḷ ēṙe kozhiññuvallōnāḷīka-nētran varāttat-entē?
stanza.meaning: So many days have passed, why has the lotus-eyed one not come back?

song.title: varavēṇḍum varavēṇḍum vāgīsvari
song.source: Varavendum varavendum Vagisvari 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: varavēṇḍum varavēṇḍum vāgīsvari - varam tara vēṇḍum tara vēṇḍum varadāyini
stanza.meaning: O divine Goddess of speech, we warmly welcome you. Bestower of boons, we humbly seek your grace.

stanza.lyrics: namaskāram namaskāram nāvarasi namaskāram vaiyamellām pugazh pāḍum kalaivāṇi namaskāram
stanza.meaning: Eloquent Goddess, we offer our deepest reverence. Queen of Arts revered throughout the world, we bow in adoration.

stanza.lyrics: veḷḷai tāmaraiyil vasippavaḷē namaskāram vīṇai tannai kaiyilēntum vēdarasi namaskāram
stanza.meaning: Salutations to the one who dwells in the white lotus. Salutations to Goddess Vedarasi, who gracefully holds the veena in her hand.

stanza.lyrics: paḷiṅku pōl mēni azhaguḍaiyāḷ namaskāram ponnarasi dēvi pugazharasi namaskāram
stanza.meaning: Salutations to the one whose complexion is as exquisite as marble. Salutations to the Golden Queen, renowned for her fame.

stanza.lyrics: akhilāṇḍēsvari anātha rakṣaki ādisaktiyē saraṇam paṅkajalōcani annavāhini mānilam pōṭriḍum tāyē
stanza.meaning: We surrender to the Goddess of the universe, the protector of orphans, the primordial power, the one with lotus-like eyes, who travels on a swan, and the mother revered by all.

stanza.lyrics: vaiyamellām pōṭri thozhum annaiyē śrīdēvi un tiru kaippaṭri vazhi naḍaintu vāzhvōmē
stanza.meaning: O Mother Sridevi, you are revered by all beings in the universe.

stanza.lyrics: nin tiruvaḍi malarai maṙavāmal dinamum paṇipuriya emakku varam taruvāy namaskāram
stanza.meaning: May we strive to follow your sacred path. Grant us the blessing to serve you daily, always remembering your holy feet.

song.title: vardāni mā jaya jaya durgā mā
song.source: Vardani Ma 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: vardāni mā jaya jaya durgā mā - bhar dō man kō tumhārē ālōk sē mā
stanza.meaning: O Mother, bestower of boons, victory to you, O Mother Durga! Fill this heart with your divine light, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: jhūktā hai caraṇōṅ meiṅ yah sansār - kartī hai tū mā sab kā uddhār
stanza.meaning: The entire world bows down at your feet, O Mother, and you uplift and liberate all.

stanza.lyrics: nihārō mā… āke man kō ājmiṭā dō man kā andhakār
stanza.meaning: Look upon me today, Mother—come into my heart and dispel the darkness within.

stanza.lyrics: mā… ō… mā… mā… ō… mā… - mērī mā… pyārī mā… janani mā…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, my Mother, darling Mother…

stanza.lyrics: kartī hai tū kṛpā aparampārtēri bhakti meiṅ magan hō man mērā
stanza.meaning: You bestow boundless grace, O Mother, and may my heart remain immersed in your devotion.

stanza.lyrics: śīṣ pē rakh dō vardāni hāthkarō mā tum karuṇā kī barsāt
stanza.meaning: Place your boon-giving hand upon my head, Mother, and shower your compassion upon me.

song.title: vātālayēśande vārmuḍikkeṭṭile
song.source: Vatalayesande varmudikkettile 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: vātālayēśande vārmuḍikkeṭṭilepīlikkaṇṇ-āvān koticcirunn-annu ñān
stanza.meaning: I longed to be a peacock plume, adorning the hair of Krishna, the Lord of Guruvayoor.

stanza.lyrics: vāḍiyile oru tuḷasikkatir-āyālpādattil eṅkilum ettām ennāśiccu
stanza.meaning: I longed to be a tulasi leaf in the garden, so I could somehow reach his feet.

stanza.lyrics: vātālayēśande vārmuḍikkeṭṭilepīlikkaṇṇ-āvān koticcirunn-annu ñān
stanza.meaning: I longed to be a peacock plume, adorning the hair of Krishna, the Lord of Guruvayoor.

stanza.lyrics: pāzhmuḷam taṇḍāy piṙannirunneṅkil āpāvanādharattil cērān kazhiññēnē
stanza.meaning: If I were born a bamboo reed, He might hold me close to His lips.

stanza.lyrics: pāril en mōhaṅgaḷ āraṙiññīḍuvānpāzhil en mōhaṅgaḷ ennu ninaccu ñān
stanza.meaning: I thought no one would ever know the quiet longing in my heart, and I feared all my hopes were in vain.

stanza.lyrics: vātālayēśande vārmuḍikkeṭṭilepīlikkaṇṇ-āvān koticcirunn-annu ñān
stanza.meaning: I longed to be a peacock plume, adorning the hair of Krishna, the Lord of Guruvayoor.

stanza.lyrics: pāzhilāyīl-ende mōhaṅgaḷ onnumē – pārinde īśanitā vanninn-ammayāy
stanza.meaning: But my hopes were not in vain—the Lord of the Universe came in the form of Mother.

stanza.lyrics: cērtt-aṇaccen duḥkha bāṣpam tuḍaccinnucēṇuṫṫa pādattil cērtt-ende janmavum
stanza.meaning: She held me close and gently wiped away my tears, and at her lotus feet, my life found its sanctuary.

stanza.lyrics: vātālayēśande vārmuḍikkeṭṭilepīlikkaṇṇ-āvān koticcirunn-annu ñān
stanza.meaning: I longed to be a peacock plume, adorning the hair of Krishna, the Lord of Guruvayoor.

song.title: vātsalyam etrayō nī coriññu
song.source: Vatsalyam etrayo 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: vātsalyam etrayō nī coriññuteṫṫukaḷ etrayō nī poṙuttu
stanza.meaning: Mother! You have showered immense grace upon me. You forgave the countless mistakes I made.

stanza.lyrics: śāsana etra nī nalki ammēsārōkti etrayō colli ammē
stanza.meaning: With loving discipline, you shaped me — teaching me virtue and moral truth.

stanza.lyrics: eṅgane ikkaḍam vīṭṭum ammē?eṅgane nandi collīḍum ivan
stanza.meaning: How can I ever repay this debt? In what way can I express my gratitude?

stanza.lyrics: tīrākkaḍavumāy ammē ivannityavum ninnuḍe cintayilāy
stanza.meaning: Lost in reverie of you, I dwell in this unending debt.

stanza.lyrics: ammaykku nalkān orumma mātramkaṇṇīr oru tuḷḷi ñān pozhikkām
stanza.meaning: I have only a kiss to offer you, O Mother — a single tear, born of love.

stanza.lyrics: en mānasam itil uṇḍu tāyēvākkāl paṙayāvatallat-ammē
stanza.meaning: Within that tear lies my heart, a silent offering beyond words.

stanza.lyrics: sāndra-maunattil ñān ammayumāyēkībhaviccallō nityam ammē
stanza.meaning: In a silence dense and profound, I became one with you, O Mother.

stanza.lyrics: ñān illātāyi kaḍam vīṭṭuvānānanda-nirvṛti mātramāyi
stanza.meaning: “I” ceased to exist. To repay the debt, only blissful fulfilment remains.

song.title: vazhi tavaṙiya kuzhantai nān
song.source: Vazhi tavariya kuzhantai nyan - Mannippaye taye 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Vazhi tavariya kuzhantai nyan - Mannippaye taye 2025 Tamil in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: vazhi tavaṙiya kuzhantai nāngati aṙiyāmal tavikkindren
stanza.meaning: I am a child who has lost its way, unable to find shelter, suffering and alone.

stanza.lyrics: vantu taḍuttāṭ koḷvāyē tāyēvantu taḍuttāṭ koḷvāyē
stanza.meaning: O Mother, please come—protect me and grant me refuge.

stanza.lyrics: mannippāyē tāyē mannippāyēmannippāyē nī ennai mannippāyē
stanza.meaning: Please forgive me, O Mother...

stanza.lyrics: seyda tavaṙugaḷ pala nūṙusonna vārttaigaḷ avadūṙu
stanza.meaning: I have committed countless mistakes. I have spoken harsh and hurtful words.

stanza.lyrics: karmaṅgaḷ palatum adharmamen eṇṇaṅgaḷum miga alaṅgōlam
stanza.meaning: Many of my actions have been unrighteous, and even my thoughts are impure and ugly.

stanza.lyrics: mīṇḍu ezhuntiḍa nān munaindēnmīṇḍum vizhundu nān paridavittēn
stanza.meaning: I tried to redeem myself, but kept falling, again and again, until despair overtook me.

stanza.lyrics: annaiyin aḷavillā karuṇaien vāzhvin orē oru nambikkai
stanza.meaning: O Mother, the only hope that remains in my life is your boundless compassion.

stanza.lyrics: iruṇḍa neñjidai nī aṙivāyvarundum en manam nī uṇarvāy
stanza.meaning: O Mother, You know my heart that is covered with darkness. You understand the sorrow and remorse within my mind.

stanza.lyrics: kalaṅgum kaṇgaḷai nī tuḍaippāyen ēkkam tīrttiḍum marundāvāy
stanza.meaning: You are the one who wipes away the tears that fill my eyes—you alone are the healing balm for the ache of my longing.

stanza.lyrics: tāyē mahāmāyē…dayai purivāy, aruḷ purivāy…tāyē mahāmāyē…dayai purivāy, aruḷ purivāy…
stanza.meaning: O Mother, the great divine Illusion—have mercy on me, and bless me with your grace.

song.title: viṇmēghaṅgaḷkk-iḍayil teḷiyum
song.source: Vin meghangal 2025 Mal in English.pptx

stanza.lyrics: viṇmēghaṅgaḷkk-iḍayil teḷiyumveṇtārakam pōle
stanza.meaning: Like a silver star shining through the clouds in the sky,

stanza.lyrics: maṇtarikaḷkk-iḍayil minni tiḷaṅgiḍumsuvarṇa-rēṇukkaḷ pōle
stanza.meaning: like a fragment of gold glowing among grains of sand…

stanza.lyrics: kaṇpīlikaḷkk-iḍayiltiḷaṅgi viḷaṅgiḍunnakṛṣṇamaṇi ennapōle
stanza.meaning: Like the light of the eye gleaming between its lashes,

stanza.lyrics: peṇkaḷil ratnamāyī lōkavēdiyil bhūjātayāy ennamma
stanza.meaning: like a radiant jewel among women, upon the stage of life, Mother has taken birth on the earth.

stanza.lyrics: hṛdaya-nabhassin mēghaṅgaḷ nīṅgumbōḷarkkanāy teḷiyum amma
stanza.meaning: Mother shines like the sun when the clouds are dispelled from the sky of the heart.

stanza.lyrics: kāruṇya kiraṇaṅgaḷāl akattāmarapūviriyikkum amma
stanza.meaning: With the rays of her compassion, she makes the lotus of the heart blossom.

stanza.lyrics: indīvaramatin itaḷukaḷ viḍarumbōḷmakaranda niṙavākum amma
stanza.meaning: When the petals of the blue lotus open, Mother shines as sweet nectar.

stanza.lyrics: mānasa-sarasijam malarkke viḍarumbōḷbhṛṅgamāy ettunnu amma
stanza.meaning: As the lotus of the mind blooms and unfolds, mother comes like a honey bee drawn to its fragrance.

stanza.lyrics: kalmānasattilum kāruṇyalēśa sphuraṇam teḷikkunnu amma
stanza.meaning: Even in a hardened heart, Mother shines as a spark of compassion.

stanza.lyrics: varaṇḍ-uṇaṅgiya hṛtsarōvaram ākeprēmavarṣam peyyunn-amma
stanza.meaning: She pours down as a rain of divine love, reviving the parched lake of the heart.

stanza.lyrics: madhu-mozhikaḷ tūkimanuja-manassukaḷ madhuritam ākkunnu amma
stanza.meaning: Mother sweetens human minds by gracing them with words full of nectar.

stanza.lyrics: karuṇā-kaḍākṣattāl dīnajanaṅgaḷkkujīvitāśayēkunn-amma
stanza.meaning: Through her sidelong glance exuding compassion, she grants hope to the afflicted and sorrow stricken.

stanza.lyrics: bhavasāgara-magna-jīvane karacērkkumkaḍattu-vañciyallō amma
stanza.meaning: Mother is the boat that carries the soul across the ocean of transmigration, guiding it safely to shore.

stanza.lyrics: mānasa-bhṛṅgaṅgaḷ madhu nukarnnīḍunnabhumi tan malarvāḍi amma
stanza.meaning: Mother is the garden on earth, and the bees of countless minds flock to sip the nectar of her love.

song.title: viśvam teḷiykkum
song.source: Visvam teliykkum 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: viśvam teḷiykkum vaśyamā mandahāsamdṛśyam maṙaykkum divyamā snēhapāśam
stanza.meaning: The lovely smile that illumines the universe, the divine rope of love that draws a veil over worldly sights,

stanza.lyrics: kālam nilaykkum tīṣṇamām tṛkkaḍākṣamvikalpam śamikkum jñānamayam ā vāgvilāsam
stanza.meaning: the piercing gaze that halts the flow of time, and the words of wisdom that dispel the distortions born of emotion and desire.

stanza.lyrics: svalpam labhikkān tapyam en antarāḷamjalpanaṅgaḷ nin nāmāvalikaḷ ākki
stanza.meaning: My heart undertook penance to receive but a drop of that grace. Meaningless speech transformed into the chanting of your sacred names.

stanza.lyrics: kalpanakaḷ nin rūpa-dhyānavum ākkikalpaṅgaḷ etrayāy kātōrtt-irippū ñān
stanza.meaning: Imagination turned into unbroken meditation on your form. How many aeons have I been waiting for you?

stanza.lyrics: ettuvān tellum vaikarut-ētum ammēettum piḍiyumilla ī kuññin munnil
stanza.meaning: For aeons, I have listened in longing. Delay no longer, Mother, to appear before this child who knows nothing.

stanza.lyrics: satyamām nin rūpa-darśanam ennilsattayat-ennum suvyaktamāyi kaṇḍiḍaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: And when I behold your true form in darshan, may I also clearly perceive the essence of my true Self.

song.title: viśvattin ādhāra caitanyamē nī
song.source: Visvattin adhara 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: viśvattin ādhāra caitanyamē nīviṇṇil ninn-ozhuki vanna prēma-gaṅgayō
stanza.meaning: You are the pure consciousness on which this vast universe is founded. Are you the sacred Ganga of love, flowing down from the skies above?

stanza.lyrics: kaṇḍatill-ārumē nin nija-rūpamkēṭṭat-illārumē nin nija-nādam
stanza.meaning: No one has seen your true form, no one has heard your eternal name.

stanza.lyrics: karayunna jīvane māṙōḍ-aṇakkum nīānanda-sindhuvāṇ-ōtiḍaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: You, who embrace the anguished, are an endless ocean of bliss.

stanza.lyrics: sṛṣṭiyum nī tanne sraṣṭāv-āyatumkanivu tūkum kāruṇya-murttiyum
stanza.meaning: You became both creation and creator, the very essence of compassion, showering loving kindness upon every being.

stanza.lyrics: janma-janmaṅgaḷāy jīvita-yātrayilenikkāy ammē nī kāttu ninnu
stanza.meaning: Mother, you waited patiently for me as I wandered through countless lives.

stanza.lyrics: māyā-prapañcattin pūttiri veṭṭattilsvayam maṙannu ñān bhramiccu pōyi
stanza.meaning: But I, deluded by the glitter of illusion, forgot the truth of who I truly am.

stanza.lyrics: ālambam illāttōrkk-orāśrayamāyikalikanmaṣa-bhāraṅgaḷ nīkki
stanza.meaning: You became the refuge of the helpless, lifting sorrows and removing burdens.

stanza.lyrics: prēma-sāmrājyam paḍutt-uyarttumbōzhumtyāgavum snēhavum nin mudrayāyi
stanza.meaning: Even as you build an empire of love, your very essence remains love and sacrifice.

stanza.lyrics: kālattinn-atita āṇende ammakālanum appuṙam āṇamma
stanza.meaning: My Mother transcends time; she reigns beyond the Lord of Death.

stanza.lyrics: pūrṇāvatāramāy mēvum mahēśinin padatāril layicciḍaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: You are the Great Goddess, an incarnation of supreme power—grant me the grace to merge at your lotus feet.

song.title: vole, vole, n'attends pas
song.source: Vole vers le soi 2025 French in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Vole vers le soi 2025 French in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: vole, vole, n'attends pasle temps passe et ne revient pas
stanza.meaning: Fly, fly, don't wait—time passes and doesn't come back.

stanza.lyrics: souviens toi où tu vas,elle seule est ta voie
stanza.meaning: Remember where you are going, she alone is your way…

stanza.lyrics: vole, vole, vers le soi amma, toi seule es ma voie!
stanza.meaning: Fly, Fly, towards the Self... Amma, you alone are my way!

stanza.lyrics: ferme les yeux, plonge en toi demande-toi, qui est là
stanza.meaning: Close your eyes, dive into yourself—ask yourself, who is there?

stanza.lyrics: fais un pas avec foi,elle en fera cent vers toi!
stanza.meaning: Take one step with faith, she will take a hundred towards you!

stanza.lyrics: en arrivant tu verrasamma était déjà là
stanza.meaning: When you arrive, you will see, Amma was already there, established in the Self.

stanza.lyrics: établie dans le soielle murmure "tout est en toi”
stanza.meaning: She whispers "everything is within you"

song.title: vṛndāvanam sundaramāy aṇiññ-oruṅgīlō
song.source: Vrindavanam Sundaramay 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvanam sundaramāy aṇiññ-oruṅgīlōpaurṇami candrikayum teḷiññu vannallo
stanza.meaning: Vrindavan adorned itself in beauty, the full moon rose high above the sky.

stanza.lyrics: vīthiyāke tārakaṅgaḷ tōraṇam cārttivrajabhūmi utsava-lahariyilāyi
stanza.meaning: Stars hung like ornaments along every street, the land of Vraja rejoiced at the festival.

stanza.lyrics: ō… rāsalīlaykkāy vrajam āke oruṅgi!
stanza.meaning: All of Vrindavan readied itself for the Rasalila!

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvana-pūkkaḷ ellām mizhi tuṙannallomandānilan bhūmi āke madhuritam ākki
stanza.meaning: The flowers of Vrindavan opened their eyes, a gentle breeze spread sweet fragrance all around.

stanza.lyrics: gōpabālan adharattil muraḷika cērttugōpīhṛdayaṅgaḷ taraḷitamāyi
stanza.meaning: Krishna, the boy of Gokula, raised his flute to his lips, and the hearts of the Gopis grew tender with longing.

stanza.lyrics: ō… rāsalīlaykkāy vanamāli oruṅgi!
stanza.meaning: The Lord who wears wildflower garlands got ready for the Rasalila!

stanza.lyrics: paimbāl kaṙannōr, tairu kaḍaññōrkarmam-ozhivāy kāla vismṛtarāyi
stanza.meaning: The gopis, milking cows and churning butter, became freed from their karma, forgetting all sense of time.

stanza.lyrics: paramārttha-lahariyatil mōhitarāyiparamātma-rūpan avan ōḍi aṇaññu
stanza.meaning: They were entranced in the bliss of the supreme as Krishna came running to them.

stanza.lyrics: ō… rāsalīlayāy jīvabrahma-yōgamāy!
stanza.meaning: The Rasalila began, and the jiva became united with Brahman.

stanza.lyrics: mṛdu-mandahāsamōḍē svāgatam ōtikārmēgha-varṇṇan avan bālagōpālan
stanza.meaning: With a soft, tender smile, the young cowherd, dark as the monsoon rainclouds, welcomed them.

stanza.lyrics: kārkkuntal keṭṭi vaccu, gōpabālakankōlukaḷāl tāḷam iṭṭu cuvaḍu vaccavar
stanza.meaning: He tied up his hair and began to dance, moving in rhythm with the gopis to the beat of their sticks.

stanza.lyrics: ō… rāsalīlayāy! jīvabrahma-yōgamāy!
stanza.meaning: The Rasalila began, and the jiva became united with Brahman.

song.title: vṛndāvanattil entāmō
song.source: Vrindavanattil entamo 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvanattil entāmō karivaṇḍukaḷ kāṇāttat-innu
stanza.meaning: Why are the black bees not seen today in Vrindavan?

stanza.lyrics: nandātmajan pōya śēṣam latā-kuñjaṅgaḷ pūkkāṙillennō?
stanza.meaning: Have the flower groves ceased to bloom since Krishna, the son of Nanda, departed?

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvanattil entāmō karivaṇḍukaḷ kāṇāttat-innu
stanza.meaning: Why are the black bees not seen today in Vrindavan?

stanza.lyrics: madhu pozhiccīḍunnatillē innu maṇam ēṙum malarukaḷ onnum?
stanza.meaning: Do the fragrant blossoms no longer hold nectar within them?

stanza.lyrics: malarukaḷ tānē kozhiññō innu mādhavan tan virahattāl?
stanza.meaning: Have the buds withered before flowering, mourning their separation from Madhava?

stanza.lyrics: innu mādhavan tan virahattāl?
stanza.meaning: Have the buds withered before flowering, mourning their separation from Madhava?

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvanattil entāmō karivaṇḍukaḷ kāṇāttat-innu
stanza.meaning: Why are the black bees not seen today in Vrindavan?

stanza.lyrics: illa vazhiyilla tellum, pūkkaḷ kaṇṇanāy pūttīḍum ennum
stanza.meaning: No, that cannot be—the flowers will always bloom for Krishna.

stanza.lyrics: dhanyamām janmaṅgaḷallō avar arccanā-sūnaṅgaḷallō
stanza.meaning: Their lives find fulfillment in being born as offerings to him.

stanza.lyrics: avar arccanā-sūnaṅgaḷallō…
stanza.meaning: Their lives find fulfillment in being born as offerings to him.

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvanattil entāmō karivaṇḍukaḷ kāṇāttat-innu
stanza.meaning: Why are the black bees not seen today in Vrindavan?

stanza.lyrics: teṫṫi illoṭṭum enikku pūkkaḷ teṫṫāte pūttu nilkkunnu
stanza.meaning: I am not mistaken—the flowers are indeed blooming.

stanza.lyrics: pinnentē pūkkaḷkku cuṫṫum karivaṇḍukaḷ pāṙāttat-innu
stanza.meaning: Then why are the black bees not hovering around them today?

stanza.lyrics: karivaṇḍukaḷ pāṙāttat-innu…
stanza.meaning: Then why are the black bees not hovering around them today?

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvanattil entāmō karivaṇḍukaḷ kāṇāttat-innu
stanza.meaning: Why are the black bees not seen today in Vrindavan?

stanza.lyrics: illava mūḷunnuṇḍallō cārē uḷḷatām vaḷḷikkuḍilil
stanza.meaning: I hear them humming from within the hut of entwined creepers nearby.

stanza.lyrics: tiṅgum virahattāl kēzhum tanvaṅgiyām rādha uṇḍaṅgu
stanza.meaning: Graceful Radha is inside, weeping tears of deep yearning for Krishna.

stanza.lyrics: tanvaṅgiyām rādha uṇḍaṅgu…
stanza.meaning: Graceful Radha is inside, weeping tears of deep yearning for Krishna.

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvanattil entāmō karivaṇḍukaḷ kāṇāttat-innu
stanza.meaning: Why are the black bees not seen today in Vrindavan?

stanza.lyrics: prēma-madhu ozhukumbōḷ veṙum pūmadhu tēḍumō vaṇḍu
stanza.meaning: When the nectar of love is flowing, why would the bees seek the honey of flowers?

stanza.lyrics: ā madhuvuṇḍu niṙayān ava rādhā-kapōlattil allō
stanza.meaning: They have gathered upon Radha’s cheeks, drinking their fill of that divine sweetness.

stanza.lyrics: ava rādhā-kapōlattilallō…
stanza.meaning: They have gathered upon Radha’s cheeks

song.title: vṛndāvanattile vīthiyil
song.source: Vrindavanattile vithiyil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvanattile vīthiyil ann-ende kaṇṇane oru nōkku kaṇḍu
stanza.meaning: I caught a glimpse of my Krishna on a path in Vrindavan.

stanza.lyrics: ā divya-darśanam en manōmukurattilprēma-sugandham niṙaccu, prēma-sugandham niṙaccu
stanza.meaning: That divine darshan filled the tender bud of my heart with the sweet fragrance of love.

stanza.lyrics: ini ennu kāṇum ā rūpam annōḷam en prāṇan tuḍikkumō kaṇṇā?prāṇan tuḍikkumō kaṇṇā?
stanza.meaning: When will I behold your form again? Will the breath of life remain in this body until that blessed day when I see you again? O Krishna, will my life energy remain within me?

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvanattile vīthiyil ann-ende kaṇṇane oru nōkku kaṇḍu
stanza.meaning: I caught a glimpse of my Krishna on a path in Vrindavan.

stanza.lyrics: ōrō dināntyam varēykkum ā vīthiyilaṅgaye ōrttu ñān kāttu nilppū
stanza.meaning: Until the day fades, I wait by the path, my mind filled with memories of you.

stanza.lyrics: grīṣma-vasanta śiśiraṅgaḷ onnonnāyminni māyunnatum kaṇḍu
stanza.meaning: I watch as the seasons—spring, summer, autumn, and winter—come and go, again and again.

stanza.lyrics: nī mātram entē varāttū kaṇṇā ī dāsikku darśanam ēkān?
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, why do you not appear before me, and grant darshan to one who has surrendered at your feet?

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvanattile vīthiyil ann-ende kaṇṇane oru nōkku kaṇḍu
stanza.meaning: I caught a glimpse of my Krishna on a path in Vrindavan.

stanza.lyrics: oru dinam ninneyum kāttu ninnīḍavēmizhiyiṇa tānē taḷarnn-uṙaṅgi
stanza.meaning: One day, as I waited for you, my weary eyes closed on their own.

stanza.lyrics: oru mṛdu sparśanam tazhuki uṇarttiarikil ñān ninne darśiccu
stanza.meaning: gentle touch awakened me, and there you were, standing near.

stanza.lyrics: dhanyam ākkiḍu ī mugdha-janmam kaṇṇā ninnil vilīnam ākaṭṭe
stanza.meaning: O Krishna, bless this life absorbed in you; so that I may become one with you!

song.title: where do you wander2025(English)
song.source: Where do you wander 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Where do you wander 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: where do you wander? where do you go?
the sun inside you is waiting to dawn
be without fear, be without sorrow
you are love itself
why do you cry? why do you cry?
where do you wander? where do you go?
the sun inside you is waiting to dawn
you have no past, give up your shame
in your hand alone
is the key of fate, is the key of fate
where do you wander? where do you go?
the sun inside you is waiting to dawn
you were never born, you will never die
you are life itself
why do you cry? why do you cry?

song.title: yadukulattinu nāthanāyi vāzhum yādavanē
song.source: Yadukulattinu nathanayi 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: yadukulattinu nāthanāyi vāzhum yādavanē…ī gōkulattinn-avastha onn-aṙiññīḍaṇē
stanza.meaning: O Yadava, Lord of the mighty Yadu clan, look upon the plight that has befallen Gokula

stanza.lyrics: gōpikaḷum gōkkaḷum gōpabālarum īgōkulavum jīvaccavamāy tīrnnu mādhavanē
stanza.meaning: — the gopis, the cows, your cherished companions the gopas, and all of Gokula have become desolate, bereft of life.

stanza.lyrics: vṛndāvanattil ōrō pulkkurunnukaḷum – nindevēṇugāna madhurimaykkāy kātōrkkunnu
stanza.meaning: Every tiny blade of grass in Vrindavan listens intently for the sweet strains of your flute, O Vanamali.

stanza.lyrics: vanamālī aṇayāte vanamāla aṇiyātevanasūnam viḍarāte kozhiññīḍunnu
stanza.meaning: The wild forest buds wither and fall to the earth without blossoming, for you have not come to adorn yourself with their garlands.

stanza.lyrics: maṙavikaḷil maṙaykkallē madhura-smaraṇakaḷepoḍipaḍalam atinu mēlkkāppaṇiyikkallē
stanza.meaning: Do not forget the sweet memories of Vrindavan; do not let the dust settle and cover them like a canopy.

stanza.lyrics: udaya-sūryan udikkāte abhayakaram nīṭṭiḍātehṛdaya-bhānuvum kadana-cōlayil mukham āzhttunnu
stanza.meaning: The morning sun has yet to rise and extend its hands to grant us refuge, while the sun within our hearts slowly sinks into the forest of despair.

stanza.lyrics: kṛṣṇa harē jaya kṛṣṇa harērādhā jīvana kṛṣṇa harēkṛṣṇa harē jaya kṛṣṇa harēgōpī-vallabha kṛṣṇa harē
stanza.meaning: Glory to Krishna, who is Radha’s very life! Glory to Krishna, the Lord of the gopis!

song.title: yamuna pāḍī nāda-lahariyil
song.source: Yamunapadi nada lahariyil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: yamuna pāḍī nāda-lahariyil ātma-nirvṛtiyāyprēma-nirjhariyāy
stanza.meaning: The Yamuna sang, intoxicated with music, a blissful hymn of joy, as love poured forth in endless streams

stanza.lyrics: bhuvana-mōhanan adhara-muraḷiyilsvaram ozhukunnumadhuramāy…
stanza.meaning: while the Enchanter of the Universe played on his flute a melody of sweetness, a song of oneness.

stanza.lyrics: mati-maṙannu madhu nukarānārttaṇaññ-oru bhṛnga-vṛndamatu maṙannu mati-mayaṅgi madhura-nādattil…
stanza.meaning: Like bees, a cluster of devotees, lost in themselves, hasten to sip the sweetness of His song,

stanza.lyrics: ātma-harṣōnmāda-bhāvam pozhikkunnu kadambaṅgaḷātma-nāthan īṇamīṭṭum kuzhal nādattil
stanza.meaning: while the Kadamba trees, enraptured by the melody, sway in the exuberant elation of the soul as the Lord of their innermost self plays music with His flute.

stanza.lyrics: muraḷi ūtum mādhavanetazhuki vannoru kuḷirtennalvazhi-maṙannu muzhuki ninnu amṛta-nādattil
stanza.meaning: A cool breeze blew in and caressed Mādhava, playing his flute, forgetting its path, it remained, enchanted by the music of the Self.

stanza.lyrics: giridharande padamalarin sparśam ēlkkumpulkkoḍikaḷ mugdharāyi nṛttamāḍi vēṇu-nādattil
stanza.meaning: Blades of grass, touched by Giridhara’s lotus feet, danced in rapture to the song of his divine flute.

song.title: yamunayum tīravum pūkkaḷum latakaḷum
song.source: Yamunayum tiravum 2025 Mal in Eng v2.pptx

stanza.lyrics: yamunayum tīravum pūkkaḷum latakaḷumtiṅkaḷ nilāvil kuḷiccu ninnu
stanza.meaning: The river Yamuna, its banks, the flowers, and the creeping vines lay bathed in the soft glow of moonlight.

stanza.lyrics: pālkkuḍam poṭṭiccum tūveṇṇa mōṣṭiccumuḷḷam kavarnna śrī kṛṣṇan varumhṛdaya-kamalam viḍarttuvān kaṇṇan varum
stanza.meaning: Sri Krishna — the One who stole hearts by breaking milk pots and stealing butter from the urns — will come. Krishna will come, and the lotus of our hearts will bloom.

stanza.lyrics: hṛttin-uḷḷil kṛṣṇa-rūpam pratiṣṭhiccumkṛṣṇa-gītaṅgaḷ abhaṅgamāy pāḍiyum
stanza.meaning: Enshrining Krishna’s form within their hearts and ceaselessly singing lyrical hymns in His praise,

stanza.lyrics: svāgatam ōtuvān sānandam āḍuvānsādhvikaḷ gōpikaḷ kāttirunnu
stanza.meaning: the devoted Gopis waited for His coming, longing to welcome Him and to dance in the ecstasy of divine love.

stanza.lyrics: ātmanāthā prabhō kāṇuvān kākkunnuyāmini pōlum vivaśayāyi
stanza.meaning: O Lord of our soul, beloved of our hearts, we wait with yearning eyes to behold You. Even the night waits in deep longing.

stanza.lyrics: ‘peṭṭennu vanneṅkil’ manasu mantriccappōḷ‘innu varillē?’ ennāśaṅkayum
stanza.meaning: When the heart whispers, “If only he would come soon…” an anxious thought follows: “What if he does not come today?”

stanza.lyrics: etrayō nāḷāyi kāṇunnu kaṇṇaneeppozhum mōhanam nūtanam darśanam
stanza.meaning: We have beheld Krishna for so long, yet with every darshan, He appears ever more enchanting and ever new.

stanza.lyrics: ā rūpam ā smitam ā vaśya-saundaryamadbhutam ānandam atyapūrvam
stanza.meaning: His form, his smile, his alluring beauty — wondrous, blissful, and a marvel to behold.

stanza.lyrics: vann-ettiyallo priyan prāṇa-nāthanpinnoṭṭumē vaikāte rāsānubhūtiyāy
stanza.meaning: Our beloved has come, the Lord of our hearts! At once, the gopis were swept into the bliss of the Rasa dance.

stanza.lyrics: tanmaya-rūpamāy tatbhāva magnarāydhyāna vilīnarāy… gōpījanam
stanza.meaning: They assumed his form, absorbed his divine mood, and became immersed in deep meditation.

song.title: yāru sondam yāru bandham
song.source: Yaru svantam yaru bandham 2025 Tam in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/Yaru svantam yaru bandham 2025 Tam in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: yāru sondam yāru bandham yāru tān sondam – orē sondam orē bandham amma tān sondam
stanza.meaning: Who is my kith? Who is my kin? Mother alone is my kith, my kin.

stanza.lyrics: amma nīyē tān sondam
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are my very own…

stanza.lyrics: en kaṇṇin kāṭciyāyi oḷirvadu yāruen kādin kēḷviyāyi olippadu yāru
stanza.meaning: Who shines as the sight in my eyes? Who resounds as the hearing in my ears?

stanza.lyrics: oḷirum śakti olikkum śakti ammā nīyēen uḷḷiluḷḷa śakti ellām ammā nīyē
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are the power that shines and resounds; Mother, you are the source of all the power within me.

stanza.lyrics: en nāvin pēccāyi uraippadu yāruen kaiyyin śaktiyāyi iruppadu yāru
stanza.meaning: Who speaks as the speech on my tongue? Who dwells as the power that moves my hand?

stanza.lyrics: uṙaiykum śakti irukkum śakti ammā nīyēen uḷḷiluḷḷa śakti ellām ammā nīyē
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are the power that speaks and moves; Mother, you are the source of all the power within me.

stanza.lyrics: en idayattil anbāyi nilaippadu yāruen manadin-uḷḷil irundu seyal paḍuvadu yāru
stanza.meaning: Who dwells in my heart as love? Who abides in my mind and makes me function?

stanza.lyrics: nilaippadum seyal paḍuvaduvum amma nīyēen uḷḷiluḷḷa śakti ellām amma nīyē
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are the power of love; you are the one who acts through me. Mother, you are the source of all the power within me.

stanza.lyrics: ōm śakti parāśakti ammā nīyēen uḷḷiluḷḷa śakti ellām ammā nīyē
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are the primordial power, you are Parashakti. Mother, you are the source of all the power within me.

stanza.lyrics: ādiśakti mahāśakti ammā nīyēun maḍiyil cella piḷḷai ennai kāppāy nīyē
stanza.meaning: Mother, you are the origin of all power, you are the Supreme Power. Protect this darling child who rests in your lap.

stanza.lyrics: amma nīyē jagadambā nīyē
stanza.meaning: You are my Mother; you are the Mother of the universe.

song.title: yaśōda taṉ eruttil oru nāḷ
song.source: Yasoda tan eruttil 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: yaśōda taṉ eruttil oru nāḷkaṟumbippaśuvuṇṭu kuññiḷampaikkiṭāvonniṉaṅṅu āmōdaṃjanmaṃ nalkiyallō
stanza.meaning: One day, in Yashoda's cowshed, a black cow joyfully gave birth to a tiny, young calf.

stanza.lyrics: pichchavachchu naṭakkum kaṇṇanōtattikkaḷichchu chennu toḻuttilpaikkiṭākkaṟumbane nōkkimandahasichchuvallō
stanza.meaning: Little Krishna, who was just learning to take his first toddling steps, waddled playfully into the cowshed. He looked at the little black calf and smiled.

stanza.lyrics: teyyattārō taka tōm teyyārōteyyattārō taka tōmteyyattārō taka tōm teyyārōteyyattārō taka tōm
stanza.meaning: (Rhythmic folk syllables used for the beat of the song.)

stanza.lyrics: muttukaḷ pōluḷḷa mūṉṉukuññari ppallukaḷ kaṇṭiṭṭāpaikkiṭākkaṟumbanō kaṇṇanenōkkichirichchuvallō
stanza.meaning: Seeing Krishna’s three tiny teeth that looked like little pearls or grains of rice, the little black calf looked at Krishna and "laughed" (mooed) back.

stanza.lyrics: paikkiṭāviṉ vāya niṟayeveḷḷāraṃ kallukaḷ pōlepallukaḷ kaṇṭiṭṭu ponnuṇṇiviṅṅikkaraññuvallō
stanza.meaning: But when the golden child (Krishna) saw that the calf’s mouth was full of teeth that looked like white pebbles, he began to sob bitterly.

stanza.lyrics: viṅṅikkaraññiṭum kaṇṇanevāriyeṭuttaṅṅu yaśōdakaṇṇunīr tuṭachchu ponnuṇṇīentināy kēṇiṭunnu
stanza.meaning: Yashoda scooped up the sobbing Krishna in her arms. Wiping away his tears, she asked, "My golden baby, why are you crying so hard?"

stanza.lyrics: ammatan kaṇṇukaḷil nōkkikaṇṇanum cholliyappōḷ ammēpaiykiṭāviṉ vāya niṟayepallukaḷ nōkkū atā
stanza.meaning: Looking into his mother's eyes, Krishna said, "Mother, look at that calf! Its mouth is completely full of teeth!"

stanza.lyrics: ammatan uṇṇikku ippōḷvayas'su raṇṭāyi ituvaremūnnē pallukaḷ vannuḷḷūnāṇakkēṭāyillē
stanza.meaning: "Your little boy is already two years old, but so far only three teeth have come in. Isn't it a shame (embarrassing), Mother?"

stanza.lyrics: eṉṟuṇṇi vaḷarumpōḷ vāyilmullappū moṭṭukaḷ pōl pallukaḷnirannu śōbhichchiṭuṃ ponnuṇṇisundarakkuṭṭanākum
stanza.meaning: (Yashoda comforted him:) "When my baby grows up, teeth like jasmine buds will line up and shine in your mouth. My golden boy will be the most handsome child of all."

stanza.lyrics: eṉṟuṇṇi vaḷarumpōḷ vāyilmullappū moṭṭukaḷ pōl pallukaḷnirannu śōbhichchiṭuṃ ponnuṇṇisundarakkuṭṭanākum
stanza.meaning: (Yashoda comforted him:) "When my baby grows up, teeth like jasmine buds will line up and shine in your mouth. My golden boy will be the most handsome child of all."

song.title: you are the one awake at nightoutside it's darkbut you're full of light
song.source: You are the one 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx
song.full_path: /Users/hisingh1/projects/bhajans2/create-index/ppts/2025/You are the one 2025 Eng in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: we are the onesawake in the daybut that for youis all just a play
śiva śiva śiva hara hara śaṅkara
for one who's awakethis world that is seenis nothing butillusory dream
for one who's asleepit all seems so realthe thoughts that we thinkthe feelings we feel
śiva śiva śiva hara hara śaṅkara

song.title: dans mon coeur - ma fille chérie
song.source: dans mon coeur 2025 French in English.pptx

stanza.lyrics: dans mon coeur, tu murmuresle secret de ma vraie nature passent les peines, passent les joies ô mon amma, tu es là pour moi
stanza.meaning: In my heart, you whisper the secret of my true nature. Sorrows pass, and joys pass, O my Amma, you are there for me.

stanza.lyrics: ma fille chérie, ma fille chérie amma, ton sourireéveille la flammede ces mots dans mon âme
stanza.meaning: My darling daughter, my darling daughter… Amma, your smile ignites the flame of these words in my soul.

stanza.lyrics: dans tes bras, je m’abandonneje ne suis ni quelqu’un ni personne passent les jours, passent les nuits ô mon amma, veille sur moi
stanza.meaning: Into your arms I surrender, I am neither someone nor no one. Days pass, and nights pass O my Amma, look upon me

stanza.lyrics: plus de moi, plus de mienun seul jeu, celui du divinpassent les doutes, passent les peurs ô mon amma, libère moi
stanza.meaning: No more of "me," no more of "mine." Only one play, that of the divine. Doubts pass, and fears pass—O my Amma, set me free.

song.title: entu tēḍi nī ōḍunnu mānavā
song.source: entu tedi ni 2025 Mal in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: entu tēḍi nī ōḍunnu mānavā?entu nēḍi nī innōḷam ōrttuvō?
stanza.meaning: O Human! What have you been seeking while you run? Have you reflected on what you have gained so far?

stanza.lyrics: kāntamām lōka-bandhaṅgaḷ ētumēśānti ēkiyō nityamāy nirbhayam?
stanza.meaning: All the worldly attachments that attract you like a magnet, have they given you lasting peace and fearlessness?

stanza.lyrics: svattināy ōḍi vāzhvu pāzhākkolānityamāy vāzhuk-illonnum ōrkkaṇam
stanza.meaning: Do not waste your life chasing wealth, remember that nothing will last forever;

stanza.lyrics: svatvamuttināy ūḷiyiṭṭ-āzhaṇamnitya-satyamām tatvakkayattil nī
stanza.meaning: dive deep to gain the pearl of the real self, dive into the infinite waters of eternal truth.

stanza.lyrics: nitya-satyamām tatvakkayattil nī
stanza.meaning: dive deep to gain the pearl of the real self, dive into the infinite waters of eternal truth.

stanza.lyrics: ninde ēkānta rathyayil kūṭṭināyentināre nī kāttu nilppū vṛthā?
stanza.meaning: Why wait in vain for another to walk beside you, on a journey destined to be travelled alone?

stanza.lyrics: onnu nī ninakkāy karam nīṭṭiḍūnī atil tūṅgi ninnilēkk-ettiḍum
stanza.meaning: Stretch out your own hand for yourself, and you will be able to hold on to it, as it guides you inward, to your true self.

stanza.lyrics: nī atil tūṅgi ninnilēkk-ettiḍum
stanza.meaning: Stretch out your own hand for yourself, and you will be able to hold on to it, as it guides you inward, to your true self.

stanza.lyrics: nī tiraññoru tṛkkaram nin karamnī koticcuḷḷat-okkeyum ninniḍam
stanza.meaning: The helping hand you seek is your own. All that you long for lies within you.

stanza.lyrics: nī carikkēṇḍa mārgavum lakṣyavumninde uṇmayum sarvavum ninniḍam
stanza.meaning: Within your true self lies the way, the goal, and the truth.

stanza.lyrics: ninde uṇmayum sarvavum ninniḍam
stanza.meaning: Within your true self lies the way, the goal, and the truth.

stanza.lyrics: ninnil ninnum tuḍaṅgunnorī yātraninnilūḍeyāy ninnilēkk-ettavē
stanza.meaning: The journey begins in you, continues through you, and reaches you.

stanza.lyrics: yuga-yugaṅgaḷāy dāhicc-alañña nīiviḍe mōnti kuḍicciḍum ninne nī
stanza.meaning: Then, at last, you will drink deeply of the bliss found within yourself, what you have thirsted for throughout your journey of countless ages.

stanza.lyrics: iviḍe mōnti kuḍicciḍum ninne nī
stanza.meaning: Then, at last, you will drink deeply of the bliss found within yourself, what you have thirsted for throughout your journey of countless ages.

stanza.lyrics: palatinē aṙiññīḍalin mīteyāyaṙivinē aṙiññīḍum uḷḷattil nī
stanza.meaning: More than knowing diverse things, seek to know the Self within.

stanza.lyrics: aṙiyum ādiyantaṅgaḷ-illāttatāmaṙivu mātramēyuḷḷu ennuḷḷatum
stanza.meaning: Know that this is the supreme knowledge, without beginning, without end.

stanza.lyrics: aṙivu mātramēyuḷḷu ennuḷḷatum
stanza.meaning: Know that this is the supreme knowledge, without beginning, without end.

stanza.lyrics: aṙivitadvayam nitya-muktam paramaṙivu tān śūddham ānanda-śāntiyum
stanza.meaning: It is the knowledge of the non-dual Self, ever free and supreme. It is pure bliss, it is perfect peace.

stanza.lyrics: aṙivu nī tanne ātma-svarūpavumaṙivu tatvam-ātatvavum nī ahō
stanza.meaning: You are this very knowledge, your own true Self. Knowledge of your true self is the ultimate reality, and that you are.

stanza.lyrics: aṙivu tatvam-ātatvavum nī ahō
stanza.meaning: You are this very knowledge, your own true Self. Knowledge of your true self is the ultimate reality, and that you are.

song.title: nandānandā harē… sundarāṅgā harē
song.source: nandananda hare 2025 Hindi in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: nandānandā harē… sundarāṅgā harēvandyarūpā harē… mukundā harē
stanza.meaning: Victory to you, delight of Nanda, the beautiful one, of worshipful form—victory to Mukunda!

stanza.lyrics: vrajavāsi harē… vanmāli harēmanhāri harē giridhāri harē
stanza.meaning: Victory to the dweller of Vraja who wears a garland of forest flowers. Victory to the enchanter of the mind, to the one who lifted the Govardhan Mountain!

stanza.lyrics: nandanandana-ānanda-sāgarā nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc…
stanza.meaning: Ocean of bliss, son of Nanda—dance, dance!

stanza.lyrics: sundarānanā candanāṅgitā nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc…
stanza.meaning: Beautiful-faced one, adorned with sandal paste—dance, dance!

stanza.lyrics: rādhikādhipā rāsa-nartakā nācō… nācō kānhā nācō
stanza.meaning: Lord of Radha, dancer of the Rasa—dance, O Kanha, dance!

stanza.lyrics: nāthā harē vāsudēvā harēpītavāsā parātparā śrīśā harē
stanza.meaning: Victory to you, O Lord, victory to you, O Vāsudeva! Clad in yellow robes, you are supreme among the supreme, Lord of Śrī, victory to you!

stanza.lyrics: cakrahastā harē cārurūpā harē - nara-nārāyaṇā kṛṣṇa-varṇṇā harē
stanza.meaning: Victory to you! In your hand you hold the discus, and your form is beautiful. Nara-Nārāyaṇa, of dark complextion, victory to you!

stanza.lyrics: nandanandana-ānanda-sāgarā nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc…
stanza.meaning: Ocean of bliss, son of Nanda—dance, dance!

stanza.lyrics: sundarānanā candanāṅgitā nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc…
stanza.meaning: Beautiful-faced one, adorned with sandal paste—dance, dance!

stanza.lyrics: rādhikādhipā rāsa-nartakā nācō… nācō kānhā nācō
stanza.meaning: Lord of Radha, dancer of the Rasa—dance, O Kanha, dance!

stanza.lyrics: yādavēndrā harē rādhikēśā harē - vēdavēdyā śubhāṅga kṣitīśā harē
stanza.meaning: Victory to you, Chief of the Yadavas, Lord of Radhika, victory to you! You know the Vedas, your form is most auspicious and you are the Lord of the Earth,

stanza.lyrics: rāsa-rāsēśvarā gōpa-gōpīśvarā - sukēśā vrajēśā ramēśā harē
stanza.meaning: victory to you! Lord of the Rasa dance, Lord of the gopas and gopis, Lord of joy, Lord of Vraja, beloved of Lakshmi—victory to you!

stanza.lyrics: nandanandana-ānanda-sāgarā nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc…
stanza.meaning: Ocean of bliss, son of Nanda—dance, dance!

stanza.lyrics: sundarānanā candanāṅgitā nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc…
stanza.meaning: Beautiful-faced one, adorned with sandal paste—dance, dance!

stanza.lyrics: rādhikādhipā rāsa-nartakā nācō… nācō kānhā nācō
stanza.meaning: Lord of Radha, dancer of the Rasa—dance, O Kanha, dance!

stanza.lyrics: vanasthā harē hṛdisthā harē - rathasthā jagadgurō śyāmā harē
stanza.meaning: Victory to you, O Lord who dwells in the forest, victory to you who dwells in the heart. Victory to you who rides the chariot, O dark-hued one, Guru of the world!

stanza.lyrics: gōpīśā harē gōkulēśā harēlōka-rakṣāparēśā kṛpālō harē
stanza.meaning: Victory to the Lord of the gopis, the Lord of Gokula. Supreme protector of the worlds, compassionate one—victory to you!

stanza.lyrics: nandanandana-ānanda-sāgarā nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc…
stanza.meaning: Ocean of bliss, son of Nanda—dance, dance!

stanza.lyrics: sundarānanā candanāṅgitā nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc… nāc…
stanza.meaning: Beautiful-faced one, adorned with sandal paste—dance, dance!

stanza.lyrics: rādhikādhipā rāsa-nartakā nācō… nācō kānhā nācō
stanza.meaning: Lord of Radha, dancer of the Rasa—dance, O Kanha, dance!

song.title: onn-uriyāḍiyirunneṅkil
song.source: onn uriyadiyirunnenkil 2025 MAl in Eng.pptx

stanza.lyrics: onn-uriyāḍiyirunneṅkilkoticcu pōy ēzhayām ī maithilī
stanza.meaning: My Lord Rama, I long to hear even one word from you.

stanza.lyrics: nityavum ninnil āṇī jānakinī ende jīvande spandanavum
stanza.meaning: I, Sita, live only in your remembrance. You are my very life, my heart beats in you…

stanza.lyrics: nāthā… malprāṇa-nāthārāmā dharma-puruṣōttamā…rāmā dharma-puruṣōttamā
stanza.meaning: O Rama, Lord of my life… Lord Rama, personification of dharma…

stanza.lyrics: nī illātt-ōrō nimiṣavumālayil urukum irumbu pōle
stanza.meaning: Each moment without you, I feel as if I am iron being melted in a blazing forge.

stanza.lyrics: nīṙi piḍaññīḍum enn-antaraṅgatteī uḍal tāṅgīḍukill-iniyum
stanza.meaning: This frail body can no longer endure the fierce torment of my heart.

stanza.lyrics: nin pada-nisvanam kēṭṭapōlōḍi ñān pūmukha-vātilkkalāy
stanza.meaning: Hearing the sound of your footsteps, I rushed to the door

stanza.lyrics: telloru nīṫṫalāy ñān aṙiññiḍunnunin pada-nisvanam uḷkkāmbilāy
stanza.meaning: —only to realize with pain that the sound was but an echo within my heart.

stanza.lyrics: nī veḍiññīḍumī dēhattilini entināy ninne kāttīḍaṇam
stanza.meaning: Why should I linger in this body you have forsaken?

stanza.lyrics: bhūmi-mātāvinde pūmaḍittaṭṭilāytalacāycciḍān ivaḷ koticcīḍunnū
stanza.meaning: I long to rest my head upon the gentle lap of Mother Earth.
